ETH-001.reasoning: Reasoning: Standard I(A) requires compliance with all applicable law and with the Code and Standards. When they conflict, the member follows the stricter requirement. Here the Code prohibits conduct that local law permits, so the Code is stricter.

why_wrong.A: Local permission does not override a stricter Code prohibition. Jurisdiction of the client does not select the looser rule.
why_wrong.C: Disclosure does not authorize knowing participation in a Code violation.

ETH-001.zh: 法律允許、Code 禁止時，跟較嚴的那套：這裡是Code。揭露不能把違規變成合 規。
ETH-001.core_idea: Follow whichever is stricter: applicable law or the Code and Standards
ETH-001.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-001.subtopic: 1.4 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-002.reasoning: Reasoning: The Study Book rejects a universal confront-first sequence. Intermediate action is factdependent. If the violation is not remedied, dissociate and document as appropriate. Remaining associated with a known violation is itself a violation.

why_wrong.A: Confronting is not a required first step.
why_wrong.C: Immediate resignation is not always required; documentation is not optional window-dressing when dissociation occurs.

ETH-002.zh: 沒有「一定先對質同事」的固定流程。重點是不要繼續參與；沒糾正就要脫離並視 情況留下紀錄。
ETH-002.core_idea: I(A) dissociation is not a mandatory confront-first sequence
ETH-002.exam_trap: I(A) sequence taught as mandatory confront →supervisor →dissociate
ETH-002.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-002.subtopic: 1.4 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-003.reasoning: Reasoning: I(B) is about whether independence and objectivity reasonably could be compromised. Modest/token gifts and ordinary entertainment are not automatic violations. Substantial gifts designed to influence manager selection or allocation are inconsistent. Existing-client pastperformance gifts are assessed as supplementary compensation/conflicts after employer disclosure — not a free pass, and not the same fact pattern as a prospect buying influence.

why_wrong.A: The Standard is not a blanket ban on every gift.
why_wrong.B: Disclosure does not cleanse an influence gift tied to a pending allocation.

ETH-003.zh: I(B) 看獨立性會不會被收買，不是「準客戶」三個字自動禁止一切。會影響選經 理人的豪華招待要拒；普通節日禮盒加揭露可以一致。
ETH-003.core_idea: I(B) modest gifts vs influence gifts; existing-client past reward vs prospective allocation gifts
ETH-003.exam_trap: Prospective-client gifts treated as an automatic ban
ETH-003.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-003.subtopic: 1.4 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-004.reasoning: Reasoning: II(A) bans acting on material nonpublic information. Mosaic theory permits combining public information with nonmaterial nonpublic information to reach a material conclusion. The store comment was judged nonmaterial; public filings are public.

why_wrong.B: A material conclusion is not automatically illegal; the test is whether an input was material and nonpublic.
why_wrong.C: Not every nonpublic input is MNPI.

ETH-004.zh: 禁的是重大且非公開。公開財報加非重大店長閒聊，拼出重大結論，是mosaic， 允許。
ETH-004.core_idea: Mosaic theory vs material nonpublic information (MNPI)
ETH-004.study_section: II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信
ETH-004.exam_trap: Treating every nonpublic input as inside information
ETH-004.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-004.subtopic: 1.4 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-005.reasoning: Reasoning: A selective call that conveys material earnings is not a public release. Using that figure is acting on MNPI. Prior public work does not convert a material tip into mosaic.

why_wrong.A: Own work does not legalize a material nonpublic tip.
why_wrong.C: Mosaic requires that no input is material nonpublic.

ETH-005.zh: 非公開電話會上的下季盈餘是MNPI。先前做過公開模型，不能把內線變成拼圖。
ETH-005.core_idea: A material tip on a selective call is MNPI, not mosaic
ETH-005.study_section: II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信
ETH-005.exam_trap: Treating a material conclusion as automatically illegal / mosaic over-claim
ETH-005.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-005.subtopic: 1.4 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-006.reasoning: Reasoning: III(A) answers whose interest; III(C) answers whether the holding is right for the client or mandate. An unsolicited unsuitable request is a Suitability problem. Loyalty does not mean doing whatever the client wants.

why_wrong.A: Loyalty is not a command to implement unsuitable instructions as advice.
why_wrong.C: Parking an unsuitable trade in a discretionary account without the Study Book’s client-directed/IPS path is not the required conduct.

ETH-006.zh: 客戶要買不適合的東西，不能用Loyalty 擋Suitability。先改IPS、客戶自決帳 戶、或拒絕／退出。
ETH-006.core_idea: Loyalty cannot override Suitability on an unsolicited unsuitable trade
ETH-006.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-006.exam_trap: Using Loyalty to override Suitability on an unsolicited trade
ETH-006.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-006.subtopic: 1.4 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-007.reasoning: Reasoning: The firm claims compliance. Verification is recommended/optional. Scope if performed: independent third party, firm-wide. Verification adds confidence in the claim; it does not certify a single composite’s returns.

why_wrong.A: Reads firm-wide verification as a prerequisite to the claim.
why_wrong.B: GIPS is not claimed for one composite; self-verification is not independent third-party verification.

ETH-007.zh: 宣稱GIPS 的是公司。驗證是自選。若做，必須獨立第三方且全公司，不是幫某 一複合體背書數字。
ETH-007.core_idea: Verification is optional; if performed it is firm-wide by an independent third party
ETH-007.study_section: Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS) ｜全球投資績效標準
ETH-007.exam_trap: Reading verification is firm-wide as verification is required
ETH-007.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-007.subtopic: 1.5 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-008.reasoning: Reasoning: GIPS compliance is a firm claim, not a composite-by-composite badge. Isolating one composite as “GIPS” while other composites sit outside the rules is the Study Book trap.

why_wrong.A: Disclosure of no verification does not fix a one-composite claim.
why_wrong.B: Verification does not license a partial-firm claim.

ETH-008.zh: 不能只讓旗艦複合體掛GIPS、其餘自己算。GIPS 是公司層級的宣稱。
ETH-008.core_idea: Cannot claim GIPS for one composite while the rest of the firm is outside the rules
ETH-008.study_section: Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS) ｜全球投資績效標準
ETH-008.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-008.subtopic: 1.5 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-009.reasoning: Reasoning: The Study Book connects quarterly/itemized statement procedures to control or custody of client assets. It rejects treating them as a universal fact for every member.

why_wrong.A: Over-generalizes a custody procedure into every role.
why_wrong.C: Statements to the client about the client’s own assets are not a confidentiality violation of that kind.

ETH-009.zh: 季報對帳單連到是否保管資產，不是每個CFA 角色的萬能義務。
ETH-009.core_idea: III(A) quarterly statements are custody-linked procedures, not a universal duty of every role
ETH-009.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-009.exam_trap: Quarterly statements as a universal III(A) duty
ETH-009.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-009.subtopic: 1.4 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-010.reasoning: Reasoning: Simultaneous duties. Client loyalty does not authorize MNPI. The Study Book rejects “market always first” and “client always first” as a universal ranking.

why_wrong.A: A waiting period does not turn MNPI into public information.
why_wrong.C: Client interest does not authorize MNPI. There is no invented hierarchy that a large account outranks market integrity.

ETH-010.zh: 幫客戶賺錢不能靠內線。不是「市場永遠壓過客戶」或「客戶永遠第一」，而是點 名Standard 再決定行為。
ETH-010.core_idea: No universal ranking that market interest always comes first or client interest always comes first
ETH-010.study_section: Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業
ETH-010.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-010.subtopic: 1.1 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-011.reasoning: Reasoning: Do not guarantee investment results or claim past results will certainly repeat. Stating a fact that is actually true (FDIC-insured CD) is not a guarantee. Recognized reporting-service data need not be cited; other people’s work and sourced definitions do.

why_wrong.A: Promising repetition of past results is a prohibited guarantee.
why_wrong.B: The reporting-service exception does not extend to another analyst’s proprietary model.

ETH-011.zh: 不能保證績效。陳述「這張CD 確實有FDIC」不是保證。引用別人的模型仍要註 明。
ETH-011.core_idea: I(C) Misrepresentation: no guarantee of results; true facts are not a guarantee
ETH-011.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-011.subtopic: 1.4 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-012.reasoning: Reasoning: II(B) targets distorting price or volume in order to mislead. Large genuine trades that move price are not automatically manipulation. Wash trades to fake volume show intent to mislead.

why_wrong.A: Treats any price impact as manipulation.
why_wrong.B: The Standard does not wait on a regulator’s charge.

ETH-012.zh: 真正再平衡把價格打上去，本身不是操縱。對敲製造量能、意圖誤導，才是 II(B)。
ETH-012.core_idea: II(B) manipulation requires intent to mislead; large trades that move price are not automatically manipulation
ETH-012.study_section: II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信
ETH-012.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-012.subtopic: 1.4 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-013.reasoning: Reasoning: Attempt simultaneous dissemination. After distribution, discussing implementation with the largest clients first is permitted. Favoring them instead of distributing the change is not.

why_wrong.A: Reverses the Standard into a large-client privilege.
why_wrong.B: Overbans a permitted post-distribution call.

ETH-013.zh: 建議變更要同時發給所有客戶。發完之後先打給大戶談執行，可以；用打電話取 代對全體發布，不行。
ETH-013.core_idea: III(B) Fair Dealing: simultaneous dissemination; calling largest clients first after distribution is permitted
ETH-013.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-013.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-013.subtopic: 1.4 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-014.reasoning: Reasoning: Use soft dollars for the client’s benefit. A firm-only terminal funded by client commissions fails that test even if execution quality is mentioned.

why_wrong.A: Wrong Standard family.
why_wrong.B: Best execution does not re-label a firm perk as a client benefit.

ETH-014.zh: 軟美元要用在客戶身上，不是拿客戶佣金幫公司自營台買終端機。
ETH-014.core_idea: Soft dollars must benefit the client
ETH-014.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-014.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-014.subtopic: 1.4 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-015.reasoning: Reasoning: The Study Book separates I(B) (independence of judgment) from IV(B) (additional compensation from clients; employer written consent). Future performance bonuses from existing clients sit in that pair, not MNPI or designation rules.

why_wrong.A: Wrong Standard.
why_wrong.C: A bonus is not automatically MNPI.

ETH-015.zh: 禮物／獎金：I(B) 問判斷會不會被買；IV(B) 問有沒有跟僱主利益衝突、有沒有 書面同意。
ETH-015.core_idea: I(B) vs IV(B) on gifts: independence vs employer consent for extra client pay
ETH-015.study_section: IV. Duties to Employers ｜對僱主的責任
ETH-015.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-015.subtopic: 1.4 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-016.reasoning: Reasoning: V(A): no duty to dissociate from group research merely because of disagreement, if the process has a basis. I(A)/II(A): no knowing participation in MNPI trading; dissociate from that violation.

why_wrong.A: Treats research disagreement as I(A) dissociation.
why_wrong.B: Allows MNPI piggybacking.

ETH-016.zh: 研究結論不同̸= 要脫離報告。同事在用MNPI，才要脫離那件違規。
ETH-016.core_idea: No obligation to dissociate from group research the member disagrees with if the process has a basis
ETH-016.study_section: V. Investment Analysis, Recommendations, and Actions ｜投資分析、建議與行動
ETH-016.exam_trap: I(A) dissociation applied to research disagreement
ETH-016.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-016.subtopic: 1.4 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-017.reasoning: Reasoning: Do not imply a partial designation or guaranteed charter. Stating candidacy factually is the consistent path. “CFA Level I” as a title and “CFA, expected” as a suffix misrepresent.

why_wrong.A: Expected-CFA suffix implies a credential not yet held.
why_wrong.B: Treats a level as a designation.

ETH-017.zh: 可以說自己是CFA Program candidate，不能把Level I 或「預計CFA」當成頭 銜。
ETH-017.core_idea: Do not misrepresent the CFA designation or candidacy
ETH-017.study_section: VII. Responsibilities as a CFA Institute Member or CFA Candidate ｜身為CFA Institute 會員或 考生的責任
ETH-017.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-017.subtopic: 1.4 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-018.reasoning: Reasoning: Referral fees are a conflict to disclose (client/prospect and employer), not an automatic independence death sentence and not a secret.

why_wrong.A: Competence of the other shop does not erase the conflict.
why_wrong.B: Over-bans a disclosable arrangement.

ETH-018.zh: 介紹費要跟僱主和客戶／準客戶揭露，不是偷偷收，也不是一律違法。
ETH-018.study_section: VI. Conflicts of Interest ｜利益衝突
ETH-018.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-018.subtopic: 1.4 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-019.reasoning: Reasoning: Client interests govern proxy voting, but the Study Book does not make “vote every card” a universal fact.

why_wrong.A: Turns a recommended informed-vote duty into an every-proxy mandate.
why_wrong.C: GIPS is unrelated.

ETH-019.zh: 投票要為客戶利益、要知情；不是每張委託書都必須投，前提是有成本效益與客 戶政策。
ETH-019.core_idea: Proxy voting: client interest governs; voting every proxy is not automatic
ETH-019.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-019.exam_trap: Voting every proxy as a universal III(A) fact
ETH-019.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-019.subtopic: 1.4 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-020.reasoning: Reasoning: The Study Book lists self-disclosure, written complaints, media/regulatory/public sources including monitoring of websites and social media, proctor reports, and score analysis. A rumor that never reaches Professional Conduct staff is not a listed start. Public-source monitoring is listed; inventing an unreceived rumor is not. The except-question’s best answer is the option that is not a PCP start.

why_wrong.B: Proctor reports are a listed start.
why_wrong.C: Self-disclosure is a listed start.

ETH-020.zh: PCP 可以從年報自揭、書面投訴、公開來源、監考報告、成績分析開始。沒進到 職員手上的傳聞不是列表中的啟動項。
ETH-020.core_idea: PCP inquiry sources and possible outcomes
ETH-020.study_section: How the Code and Standards Are Enforced ｜守則與準則的執行
ETH-020.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-020.subtopic: 1.2 Diagnostic / Reinforcement Practice ｜診斷／加強練習

ETH-021.reasoning: Reasoning: A code of ethics states values and overall expectations. Standards of conduct sit underneath the code and set the minimum acceptable behavior — the benchmark the group will actually enforce.

why_wrong.A: The sources put enforceable minimum behavior in the standards of conduct, not in a claim that standards are optional.
why_wrong.B: The sources treat them as two layers, not two names for one text.

ETH-021.zh: 守則講價值與整體期望；行為準則在下一層，寫的是集團真正會執行的最低行為。 不是同一份文件換標題。
ETH-021.core_idea: A code of ethics states values; standards of conduct set the enforceable minimum
ETH-021.study_section: Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業
ETH-021.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-021.subtopic: 1.1 Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業

ETH-022.reasoning: Reasoning: The sources treat a profession as a group that (1) is subject to licensing or technical standards and (2) aims to serve society while setting and enforcing professional conduct. Skill plus a fee is not enough.

why_wrong.A: High pay is not what the sources use to define a profession.
why_wrong.C: A slogan without enforceable conduct is not the sources’ definition.

ETH-022.zh: 專業不只是高薪技術活：要有執照或技術標準，並以服務社會為目標、自己訂並 執行行為準則。
ETH-022.core_idea: A profession combines licensing or technical standards with service to society
ETH-022.study_section: Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業
ETH-022.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-022.subtopic: 1.1 Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業

ETH-023.reasoning: Reasoning: Trust has a market price. Investors with low trust are less willing to accept risk and demand a higher return for the use of their capital. Unethical conduct can damage client wealth, reduce funds entrusted to advisers, raise the cost of capital, and distort allocation.

why_wrong.B: The sources say investment advice is intangible, so quality is harder to evaluate and trust carries more of the relationship.
why_wrong.C: Unethical conduct raises, not lowers, the cost of capital and can distort allocation.

ETH-023.zh: 信任有市場價格。信任低，投資人較不願承擔風險，會要求更高報酬。不道德行 為會推高資金成本、扭曲配置。
ETH-023.core_idea: Low trust raises the return investors demand for capital
ETH-023.study_section: Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業
ETH-023.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-023.subtopic: 1.1 Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業

ETH-024.reasoning: Reasoning: Investment advice is intangible. Quality and value are harder to evaluate than for a tangible product, so trust carries more of the relationship.

why_wrong.A: The sources tie market trust to the profession and to firms, not only to CFA Institute internally.
why_wrong.B: A performance table does not turn advice into a tangible good the client can inspect.

ETH-024.zh: 投資建議是無形產品，品質比機器難檢驗，信任因此承擔更大一部分關係。
ETH-024.core_idea: Investment advice is intangible, so trust carries more of the relationship
ETH-024.study_section: Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業
ETH-024.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-024.subtopic: 1.1 Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業

ETH-025.reasoning: Reasoning: The investment management profession and investment firms have to maintain that trust together. Neither can do it alone.

why_wrong.A: The sources do not treat the firm’s brand as a substitute for professional standards.
why_wrong.C: The sources do not assign trust only to the profession.

ETH-025.zh: 信任要專業社群和投資公司一起守。單靠公司品牌或單靠協會，來源都不接受。
ETH-025.core_idea: The profession and investment firms must maintain trust together
ETH-025.study_section: Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業
ETH-025.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-025.subtopic: 1.1 Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業

ETH-026.reasoning: Reasoning: Overconfidence is the first failure mode: people overrate how ethical they already are and put too much weight on internal traits or intrinsic motivation.

why_wrong.B: Honesty is necessary; it is not proof that ethical conduct follows automatically.
why_wrong.C: The sources treat situational influences as often dominating traits; they do not say character is the only variable.

ETH-026.zh: 第一個失效是過度自信：高估自己本來就很道德，把內在品格當成保證。來源反 而強調情境壓力常常壓過品格。
ETH-026.core_idea: Overconfidence: people overrate how ethical they already are
ETH-026.study_section: Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業
ETH-026.exam_trap: I am honest, so this choice is honest
ETH-026.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-026.subtopic: 1.1 Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業

ETH-027.reasoning: Reasoning: Situational influences — money, prestige, and loyalty to colleagues or to the firm — often dominate traits. External pressure is a greater driver of ethical quality than personal character. The correction is to consider long-term consequences, not only the immediate win.

why_wrong.B: The sources do not treat oaths as the main driver.
why_wrong.C: The sources reverse that ranking: external pressure is treated as the greater driver.

ETH-027.zh: 錢、面子、對同事或公司的忠誠，是情境影響，常常壓過個人品格。來源把外部 壓力當成更大的驅動；要看長期後果，不是眼前贏一次。
ETH-027.core_idea: Situational influences often dominate personal traits
ETH-027.study_section: Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業
ETH-027.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-027.subtopic: 1.1 Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業

ETH-028.reasoning: Reasoning: A compliance-only approach can help build an ethical culture, but it can oversimplify decisions and then become its own situational influence. The silent test becomes “is this allowed?” rather than “is this the conduct the duty requires?”

why_wrong.A: Written policies can support culture; they are not forbidden.
why_wrong.B: The sources reject treating “allowed?” as the whole test.

ETH-028.zh: 只問「准不准」也能幫文化，但會把決定簡化，本身變成情境影響。該問的是這項 義務要求什麼行為。
ETH-028.core_idea: A compliance-only test can become its own situational influence
ETH-028.study_section: Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業
ETH-028.exam_trap: If it is allowed, the duty is satisfied
ETH-028.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-028.subtopic: 1.1 Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業

ETH-029.reasoning: Reasoning: Legal and ethical are not the same set. Some unethical acts are legal; some illegal acts — whistleblowing or civil disobedience, in some places — are viewed as ethical. Ethical principles often set a higher standard than law and demand more judgment about stakeholders.

why_wrong.A: The sources reject treating legal permission as ethical clearance.
why_wrong.C: The sources expressly note illegal acts that can be viewed as ethical in some places.

ETH-029.zh: 合法̸= 道德。有些不道德是合法的；有些地方的揭弊或公民不服從，違法仍可能 被視為道德。倫理常比法律更高、更要判斷利害關係人。
ETH-029.core_idea: Legal and ethical are not the same set
ETH-029.study_section: Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業
ETH-029.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-029.subtopic: 1.1 Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業

ETH-030.reasoning: Reasoning: The framework is Identify (facts, stakeholders and duties, principles, conflicts) →Consider (situational influences, guidance, alternatives) →Decide and act →Reflect. It is a sequence, not a slogan. Skipping “identify the duty” is how a loyalty-to-the-firm story talks a member into an unsuitable trade.

why_wrong.A: Choosing first and labeling later is the reverse of the framework.
why_wrong.B: Reflect is the last step, not a substitute for identifying the duty.

ETH-030.zh: 框架是識別→考慮→決定並行動→反省。跳過「先點名義務」，公司忠誠的故 事就容易把人推進不適合的交易。
ETH-030.core_idea: The ethical decision framework is a sequence: identify, consider, decide, reflect
ETH-030.study_section: Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業
ETH-030.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-030.subtopic: 1.1 Ethics, Trust, and the Profession ｜倫理、信任與專業

ETH-031.reasoning: Reasoning: The Standards of Practice Handbook is the guide members must use when an ethical dilemma is in front of them. CFA Institute Bylaws and the Rules of Procedure for Professional Conduct structure the Code and Standards.

why_wrong.A: A colleague’s memory is not the Handbook.
why_wrong.B: A marketing brochure is not the named guide.

ETH-031.zh: 倫理兩難時，要用地的是Standards of Practice Handbook，不是公司文宣或同事 口述。
ETH-031.core_idea: The Standards of Practice Handbook is the guide in an ethical dilemma
ETH-031.study_section: How the Code and Standards Are Enforced ｜守則與準則的執行
ETH-031.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-031.subtopic: 1.2 How the Code and Standards Are Enforced ｜守則與準則的執行

ETH-032.reasoning: Reasoning: The CFA Institute Board of Governors oversees the PCP. The PCP and the DRC enforce the Code and Standards. The DRC reviews conduct and works with Professional Conduct staff on professional-conduct policies.

why_wrong.A: The sources name the PCP and DRC as the enforcers under Board oversight.
why_wrong.B: The Council evaluates the Code, Standards, and Handbook; it is not described as the sanctioning replacement for the DRC.

ETH-032.zh: 理事會監督PCP。PCP 與DRC 一起執行Code and Standards。不要把Standards of Practice Council 當成處分機關。
ETH-032.core_idea: Board of Governors oversees the PCP; PCP and DRC enforce
ETH-032.study_section: How the Code and Standards Are Enforced ｜守則與準則的執行
ETH-032.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-032.subtopic: 1.2 How the Code and Standards Are Enforced ｜守則與準則的執行

ETH-033.reasoning: Reasoning: If staff propose a sanction, the member or candidate may accept or reject it. If the sanction is rejected, the matter is referred to the DRC.

why_wrong.A: Rejection of a settlement does not by itself close the file.
why_wrong.C: The next step is DRC referral, not a required public announcement that ends review.

ETH-033.zh: 職員提出處分後，會員可接受或拒絕。拒絕就送到DRC，不是案子自動結案。
ETH-033.core_idea: If a proposed sanction is rejected, the matter is referred to the DRC
ETH-033.study_section: How the Code and Standards Are Enforced ｜守則與準則的執行
ETH-033.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-033.subtopic: 1.2 How the Code and Standards Are Enforced ｜守則與準則的執行

ETH-034.reasoning: Reasoning: Staff may interview the member or candidate, interview the complainant or other third parties, and collect records. Possible results: no disciplinary action, a cautionary letter, or continued proceedings toward discipline.

why_wrong.B: The sources list intermediate PCP outcomes; they do not reduce the process to a criminal indictment.
why_wrong.C: Revocation of the CFA designation is a sanction type for charterholders, not the only possible inquiry result for a candidate.

ETH-034.zh: 查完可能是不處分、警告信、或繼續走向紀律程序。不是只有撤證或刑事起訴兩 條路。
ETH-034.core_idea: PCP results include no action, a cautionary letter, or continued proceedings
ETH-034.study_section: How the Code and Standards Are Enforced ｜守則與準則的執行
ETH-034.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-034.subtopic: 1.2 How the Code and Standards Are Enforced ｜守則與準則的執行

ETH-035.reasoning: Reasoning: Sanctions include public censure, suspension of membership or of the right to use the CFA designation, revocation of the CFA designation, and — for candidates — suspension from participation in the CFA Program.

why_wrong.B: The sources do not reduce sanctions to an employer fine.
why_wrong.C: Public sanctions are among the available outcomes; a private apology is not the only tool.

ETH-035.zh: 處分包括公開譴責、停權或停用CFA 稱謂、撤銷稱謂；考生則可能暫停參加CFA Program。
ETH-035.core_idea: Named sanctions include censure, suspension, revocation, and candidate program suspension
ETH-035.study_section: How the Code and Standards Are Enforced ｜守則與準則的執行
ETH-035.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-035.subtopic: 1.2 How the Code and Standards Are Enforced ｜守則與準則的執行

ETH-036.reasoning: Reasoning: The Standards of Practice Council evaluates the Code, the Standards, and the Handbook so they remain representative of high standards, relevant, applicable, comprehensive, enforceable, and testable. The Professional Conduct division also enforces test policies and the professional conduct of CIPM certificants.

why_wrong.A: PCP oversight sits with the Board of Governors.
why_wrong.B: Exam grading is not the Council’s described role.

ETH-036.zh: Standards of Practice Council 的工作是評估Code、Standards 與Handbook，讓 它們維持高標準、可執行、可出題。不是取代理事會去監督PCP。
ETH-036.core_idea: The Standards of Practice Council keeps the Code, Standards, and Handbook testable and enforceable
ETH-036.study_section: How the Code and Standards Are Enforced ｜守則與準則的執行
ETH-036.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-036.subtopic: 1.2 How the Code and Standards Are Enforced ｜守則與準則的執行

ETH-037.reasoning: Reasoning: Members must place the integrity of the investment profession and the interests of clients above their own personal interests. The Code is the general expectation; the Standards are the minimum conduct.

why_wrong.B: The Code expressly places client interests and professional integrity above personal interests.
why_wrong.C: The Code does address self-interest: it ranks it below profession and clients.

ETH-037.zh: Code 要求把專業誠信與客戶利益放在自己的個人利益之上。這題是個人收費在推 一個比較適合自己、比較不適合客戶的產品。
ETH-037.core_idea: Place the integrity of the profession and the interests of clients above personal interests
ETH-037.study_section: The Code of Ethics ｜職業倫理守則
ETH-037.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-037.subtopic: 1.3 The Code of Ethics ｜職業倫理守則

ETH-038.reasoning: Reasoning: The Code requires members to maintain and improve their professional competence and strive to maintain and improve the competence of other investment professionals.

why_wrong.A: Competence is a named Code value, not “exam only.”
why_wrong.B: The Code is not silent on competence.

ETH-038.zh: Code 要求維持並提升自己的勝任能力，也要努力提升其他投資專業人員的能力。 不是考完就不管。
ETH-038.core_idea: Maintain and improve own competence and strive to improve others’ competence
ETH-038.study_section: The Code of Ethics ｜職業倫理守則
ETH-038.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-038.subtopic: 1.3 The Code of Ethics ｜職業倫理守則

ETH-039.reasoning: Reasoning: A party, nonmember, or firm may claim compliance with the Code and Standards only after ensuring that its own code meets the principles of the Code and Standards.

why_wrong.A: Employing a charterholder is not, by itself, the stated condition.
why_wrong.C: Using CFA in a larger or bolder font than a name is a VII(B) problem, not a complianceclaim permission.

ETH-039.zh: 非會員或公司要宣稱遵守Code and Standards，前提是自己的守則已對齊其原則。 不是僱了一個持證人就能自動掛這句。
ETH-039.core_idea: A firm or nonmember may claim compliance only after its own code meets the principles
ETH-039.study_section: The Code of Ethics ｜職業倫理守則
ETH-039.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-039.subtopic: 1.3 The Code of Ethics ｜職業倫理守則

ETH-040.reasoning: Reasoning: The Code is the general expectation. The Standards are the minimum conduct. Members of CFA Institute (including CFA charterholders) and candidates must adhere to the Code and Standards.

why_wrong.A: The Standards are the minimum conduct, not optional commentary.
why_wrong.C: Members (including charterholders) and candidates must adhere to both.

ETH-040.zh: Code 是整體期望；Standards 是最低行為。會員（含持證人）與考生都要遵守， 不是只有一邊適用。
ETH-040.core_idea: The Code is the general expectation; the Standards are the minimum conduct
ETH-040.study_section: The Code of Ethics ｜職業倫理守則
ETH-040.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-040.subtopic: 1.3 The Code of Ethics ｜職業倫理守則

ETH-041.reasoning: Reasoning: Do not knowingly participate in or assist a violation. If the violation is not remedied, dissociate from the activity and document the violation and the dissociation as appropriate. Remaining associated with a known violation is itself a violation.

why_wrong.A: Knowing assistance is still a violation; later ticket-processing is not a defense.
why_wrong.B: Not inventing the scheme does not license continued association.

ETH-041.zh: 明知違規還繼續掛在流程裡，本身就是違規。沒被糾正就要脫離，並視情況留下 紀錄。不是「我只是下單」就能免責。
ETH-041.core_idea: Remaining associated with a known violation is itself a violation
ETH-041.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-042.reasoning: Reasoning: When there are reasonable grounds to believe an activity is illegal or unethical and is ongoing or imminent, take appropriate intermediate action. If the violation is not remedied, dissociate and document the violation and the dissociation as appropriate.

why_wrong.A: Staying associated is the opposite of dissociation.
why_wrong.B: Joining the trade is participation, not dissociation.

ETH-042.zh: 中間步驟走完仍不改，就要脫離這項活動，並視情況記錄違規與脫離。留下自己 的單或跟著下單，都是繼續參與。
ETH-042.core_idea: If an unremedied violation continues, dissociate and document
ETH-042.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-043.reasoning: Reasoning: I(A) requires compliance with applicable laws and the Code and Standards. Do not knowingly participate in or assist a violation.

why_wrong.A: Custom does not authorize assisting a falsified file.
why_wrong.B: Blame-shifting does not erase knowing assistance.

ETH-043.zh: 明知要幫人改日期造假，就是明知故犯或協助違規。同事攬責或「大家都這樣」都 不能救。
ETH-043.core_idea: Do not knowingly participate in or assist a violation
ETH-043.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-044.reasoning: Reasoning: Issuer-paid research on a limited, flat fee that does not depend on the conclusion, with the relationship disclosed, is generally consistent with I(B).

why_wrong.A: A conclusion-dependent fee is the inconsistent form, not the permission.
why_wrong.C: The sources allow a limited flat fee that does not depend on the conclusion, with the relationship disclosed.

ETH-044.zh: 發行人付費研究：有限、固定、不隨結論變動的費用，並揭露關係，一般與I(B) 一致。結論越好錢越多，就不一致。
ETH-044.core_idea: Issuer-paid research: limited flat fee that does not depend on the conclusion, disclosed
ETH-044.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-045.reasoning: Reasoning: A flat fee that does not depend on the conclusion, with disclosure, can be consistent. A bonus that pays only for an overweight conclusion is designed to influence the research conclusion.

why_wrong.A: Issuer-paid research is expressly in the I(B) table.
why_wrong.C: A later disclosure sentence does not rewrite a conclusion-linked bonus as a flat fee.

ETH-045.zh: 費用綁「一定要寫買進」，就不是固定、不隨結論變動的安排。事後揭露救不了獨 立性。
ETH-045.core_idea: Issuer-paid research that pays for a favorable conclusion is not consistent with I(B)
ETH-045.exam_trap: Disclosure converts a conclusion-linked fee into a flat fee
ETH-045.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-046.reasoning: Reasoning: Expensive gifts from existing clients for past performance, disclosed to the employer so the conflict can be assessed, are generally consistent with I(B). They are not “existing client, so keep it private.”

why_wrong.B: The sources require employer disclosure so the conflict can be assessed.
why_wrong.C: The sources do not ban every existing-client gift.

ETH-046.zh: 現有客戶補過去績效的貴重禮物：要向僱主揭露，讓僱主評估利益衝突。不是現 有客戶就可以私下收。
ETH-046.core_idea: Expensive gifts from existing clients for past performance: disclose to the employer
ETH-046.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-047.reasoning: Reasoning: Expensive gifts from existing clients for future performance are generally consistent with I(B) if approved in advance.

why_wrong.A: Token baskets are the modest/ordinary category; this is an expensive futureperformance gift.
why_wrong.B: Secret after-the-fact acceptance is not the advance-approval path.

ETH-047.zh: 現有客戶用貴重禮物綁未來績效：要事先批准。不是節日禮盒那一類，也不是年 終再偷偷收。
ETH-047.core_idea: Expensive gifts from existing clients for future performance need advance approval
ETH-047.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-048.reasoning: Reasoning: Pay-to-play donations to government officials to influence hiring or fund allocation are not consistent with I(B).

why_wrong.A: The sources expressly list pay-to-play donations as not consistent with I(B).
why_wrong.B: A buried footnote does not convert pay-to-play into ordinary entertainment.

ETH-048.zh: 為了拿政府或基金配置去捐政治獻金，是pay-to-play，與I(B) 不一致。不是捐了 再加註腳就變招待。
ETH-048.core_idea: Pay-to-play donations to influence hiring or fund allocation are not consistent with I(B)
ETH-048.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-049.reasoning: Reasoning: Allocation of shares in an oversubscribed IPO to the member is not consistent with I(B).

why_wrong.A: That ranking is the opposite of client-priority / fair-dealing IPO rules.
why_wrong.C: Coverage status does not create an IPO exception.

ETH-049.zh: 超額認購的IPO 配給會員本人，與I(B) 不一致。不是熱門就能先塞進自己帳戶。
ETH-049.core_idea: Do not take an allocation of shares in an oversubscribed IPO
ETH-049.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-050.reasoning: Reasoning: Employee IPO participation without the firm’s pre-approval is not consistent with I(B). Restricting employee participation in IPOs by requiring pre-approval is a compliance procedure, not a substitute for the ban on taking oversubscribed IPO shares.

why_wrong.A: The sources say pre-approval does not replace the oversubscribed-IPO ban.
why_wrong.B: Firms may restrict IPO participation; pre-approval is a compliance tool, not a forbidden procedure.

ETH-050.zh: 員工參加IPO 要先得到公司預先批准；預先批准是程序，不能拿來取代「超額認 購IPO 股份不能拿」這條禁令。
ETH-050.core_idea: Employee IPO participation without the firm’s pre-approval is not consistent; pre-approval is not a substitute for the oversubscribed-IPO ban
ETH-050.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-051.reasoning: Reasoning: Firms use a restricted list — companies taken out of the research universe — to protect unbiased research.

why_wrong.A: A restricted list is a firm procedure; it does not retire the rest of I(B).
why_wrong.C: A restricted list is not an IPO-allocation program.

ETH-051.zh: 限制名單是把公司移出研究宇宙，保護研究不被利害綁住。不是拿來保證員工認 購IPO，也不能取代整條I(B)。
ETH-051.core_idea: A restricted list takes companies out of the research universe to protect unbiased research
ETH-051.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-052.reasoning: Reasoning: Cite other people’s work and sourced definitions. Information from a recognized financial or statistical reporting service does not need that citation.

why_wrong.B: Citation of others’ work is required, not a misrepresentation.
why_wrong.C: Other people’s work must be cited; only recognized reporting-service data is the exception.

ETH-052.zh: 別人的專有模型要註明出處。公認財經或統計資訊服務的數據，來源說不必那樣 引用。不是所有數字都算自己的。
ETH-052.core_idea: Cite other people’s work; recognized reporting-service data need not be cited
ETH-052.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-053.reasoning: Reasoning: Do not guarantee investment results or tell a client that past results will certainly be repeated. Stating a fact that is actually true is not a guarantee.

why_wrong.A: Attaching a process note does not authorize a certainty claim about repeating past results.
why_wrong.C: I(C) forbids that guarantee; it does not require it.

ETH-053.zh: 不能保證投資結果，也不能說過去績效一定會重演。附上流程說明，救不了「一 定再賺22%」。
ETH-053.core_idea: Do not guarantee investment results or say past results will certainly be repeated
ETH-053.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-054.reasoning: Reasoning: Stating a fact that is actually true is not a guarantee. Treasury securities may be described as without default risk.

why_wrong.B: The sources expressly allow that true description.
why_wrong.C: The sources separate a true credit-feature statement from a results guarantee. They do not turn the Treasury sentence into a total-return promise.

ETH-054.zh: 陳述真正的事實不是保證。來源允許把公債說成沒有違約風險。那不是在保證總 報酬或利率不會虧。
ETH-054.core_idea: A true statement that Treasuries are without default risk is not a guarantee
ETH-054.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-055.reasoning: Reasoning: Do not engage in dishonesty, fraud, or deceit, or in acts that reflect adversely on professional reputation, integrity, or competence. The Standard reaches conduct outside CFA work when the conduct is about honesty. Example: a member promises a good deal on a car, delivers a poor deal, and takes part of the commission.

why_wrong.A: “Not a securities trade” is not the I(D) test.
why_wrong.C: The sources expressly reach honesty-related conduct outside CFA work.

ETH-055.zh: I(D) 看的是誠實。週末賣車承諾好價錢、交出去是爛條件、再抽佣，來源當例子： CFA 工作以外、但關乎誠實的行為也管。
ETH-055.core_idea: I(D) reaches dishonest conduct outside CFA work when the conduct is about honesty
ETH-055.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-056.reasoning: Reasoning: I(D) targets dishonesty, fraud, or deceit, or acts that reflect adversely on professional reputation, integrity, or competence. Private misdemeanors that do not involve fraud, theft, or deceit are not what this Standard is aimed at.

why_wrong.A: The sources do not treat every private misdemeanor as I(D).
why_wrong.C: I(D) is about dishonesty, fraud, deceit, or acts reflecting adversely on reputation, integrity, or competence — including honesty outside CFA work.

ETH-056.zh: 沒有詐欺、偷竊、欺騙的私人輕罪，不是I(D) 要打的靶。不要把所有下班行為都 自動算違規。
ETH-056.core_idea: Private misdemeanors that do not involve fraud, theft, or deceit are not I(D)’s target
ETH-056.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-057.reasoning: Reasoning: I(D) forbids dishonesty, fraud, or deceit, or acts that reflect adversely on professional reputation, integrity, or competence.

why_wrong.B: Letterhead is not the test.
why_wrong.C: The Standard does not wait on a regulator’s filing.

ETH-057.zh: 偽造工時與簽名是詐欺、欺騙，會傷害專業聲譽與誠信。不是沒印CFA 抬頭、或 主管機關還沒起訴就不算。
ETH-057.core_idea: Fraud or deceit reflects adversely on professional reputation, integrity, or competence
ETH-057.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-058.reasoning: Reasoning: Standard I(D) Misconduct: do not engage in dishonesty, fraud, or deceit, or in acts that reflect adversely on professional reputation, integrity, or competence.

why_wrong.A: Larger-font CFA use is VII(B), not I(D).
why_wrong.B: Composite construction is GIPS, not I(D).

ETH-058.zh: I(D) 管不誠實、詐欺、欺騙，以及有損專業聲譽、誠信或勝任能力的行為。不是 稱謂字體，也不是GIPS。
ETH-058.core_idea: I(D) is about honesty, fraud, deceit, and adverse reflection on reputation, integrity, or competence
ETH-058.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-059.reasoning: Reasoning: Act with the competence necessary to fulfill professional responsibilities. The Code already names competence as a professional value. Standard I(E) makes the necessary competence a required standard of conduct, not only an aspiration.

why_wrong.A: I(E) is a required standard of conduct for fulfilling professional responsibilities.
why_wrong.C: Competence is named in the Code and made a Standard in I(E).

ETH-059.zh: Code 已把勝任能力當成專業價值；I(E) 把它做成必須遵守的行為準則，不是口 號，也不是只給退休的人看。
ETH-059.core_idea: I(E) makes necessary competence a required standard of conduct, not only an aspiration
ETH-059.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-060.reasoning: Reasoning: I(E) requires acting with the competence necessary to fulfill professional responsibilities.

why_wrong.B: Fees do not prove the necessary competence.
why_wrong.C: A generic risk disclosure does not replace the competence Standard.

ETH-060.zh: 接下自己沒能力做、又不去補能力的複雜委託，就是沒達到履行職責所需的勝任 能力。收費或一張風險聲明不能代替。
ETH-060.core_idea: Act with the competence necessary to fulfill professional responsibilities
ETH-060.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。

ETH-061.reasoning: Reasoning: Holders of material nonpublic information must not act on it and must not cause others to act on it.

why_wrong.A: The duty includes not causing others to act.
why_wrong.C: Tipping is the opposite of the required conduct.

ETH-061.zh: 持有重大非公開資訊，自己不能做，也不能叫別人做。沒自己下單、卻傳訊叫朋 友買，一樣違規。
ETH-061.core_idea: Holders of MNPI must not act on it and must not cause others to act on it
ETH-061.study_section: II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信
ETH-061.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-061.subtopic: 1.4 II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信

ETH-062.reasoning: Reasoning: Mosaic theory is the permitted path: an analyst may combine public information with nonmaterial nonpublic information and reach a material conclusion. The conclusion can be material. The inputs were not a material nonpublic tip.

why_wrong.A: That is the trap of treating any material conclusion as illegal.
why_wrong.B: Not every nonpublic color comment is MNPI; the sources permit public plus nonmaterial nonpublic.

ETH-062.zh: 公開財報與產業數據，加上非重大的參觀閒聊，拼出重大結論，是mosaic，允許。 不要看到非公開或看到重大結論就直接判違規。
ETH-062.core_idea: Mosaic theory: public information plus nonmaterial nonpublic information
ETH-062.study_section: II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信
ETH-062.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-062.subtopic: 1.4 II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信

ETH-063.reasoning: Reasoning: The conclusion can be material. The test is whether an input was material nonpublic information, not whether the analyst’s own conclusion is material.

why_wrong.A: Public information is a permitted mosaic input.
why_wrong.C: That is the trap the sources name: treating a material conclusion as automatically illegal.

ETH-063.zh: 結論可以重大。要問的是拼圖有沒有一塊本身是MNPI，不是「結論重大就不能 用」。
ETH-063.core_idea: A material conclusion does not by itself make mosaic research a violation
ETH-063.study_section: II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信
ETH-063.exam_trap: Material conclusion treated as automatically illegal
ETH-063.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-063.subtopic: 1.4 II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信

ETH-064.reasoning: Reasoning: The tempting rule is: if anything was not in a filing, you cannot trade. That over-bans mosaic research. II(A) bans material nonpublic information.

why_wrong.A: Mosaic theory is the permitted path the other way.
why_wrong.C: The sources do not add an age cutoff that turns mosaic off.

ETH-064.zh: 看到nonpublic 不要直接選違規。先問這則資訊本身重大嗎。來源禁止的是重大且 非公開，不是每一句非公開閒聊。
ETH-064.core_idea: II(A) bans material nonpublic information, not every nonpublic scrap
ETH-064.study_section: II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信
ETH-064.exam_trap: Every nonpublic input treated as inside information
ETH-064.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-064.subtopic: 1.4 II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信

ETH-065.reasoning: Reasoning: A selective analyst conference call that conveys material nonpublic information is not a public release; trading on it violates II(A).

why_wrong.A: Selective plus unpublished material is not a public release.
why_wrong.B: The sources treat a selective call conveying MNPI as not a public release.

ETH-065.zh: 只有受邀者聽到、且數字尚未公開的電話會，不是公開發布。聽到重大數字再買， 違II(A)。這題考的是「選擇性通話̸= 公開」，不是把自己的舊模型講成mosaic。
ETH-065.core_idea: A selective analyst conference call that conveys MNPI is not a public release
ETH-065.study_section: II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信
ETH-065.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-065.subtopic: 1.4 II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信

ETH-066.reasoning: Reasoning: Do not distort price or trading volume in order to mislead market participants. Intent to mislead is the test.

why_wrong.A: Letterhead is not the test.
why_wrong.C: A later client buy does not erase intent to mislead.

ETH-066.zh: 放假消息打壓股價再撿貨，意圖誤導市場，是II(B)。不是事後說「幫客戶買」或 沒印公司抬頭就能過。
ETH-066.core_idea: II(B) requires intent to mislead; do not distort price or volume to mislead
ETH-066.study_section: II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信
ETH-066.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-066.subtopic: 1.4 II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信

ETH-067.reasoning: Reasoning: Large trades that move the price are not, by themselves, manipulation. Intent to mislead is.

why_wrong.B: Size plus a price move is not the Standard’s test.
why_wrong.C: The sources do not add a pre-clearance condition for genuine large trades.

ETH-067.zh: 為了客戶真實流動性需要、bona fide 的大額賣出把價格打下去，本身不是操縱。 要看有沒有誤導意圖。
ETH-067.core_idea: A large bona fide client liquidation that moves price is not, by itself, manipulation
ETH-067.study_section: II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信
ETH-067.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-067.subtopic: 1.4 II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信

ETH-068.reasoning: Reasoning: Do not distort price or trading volume in order to mislead. Large trades that move the price are not, by themselves, manipulation. Intent to mislead is.

why_wrong.B: Record retention is V(C).
why_wrong.C: The sources reject treating size as automatic manipulation.

ETH-068.zh: II(B) 打的是為了誤導而去扭曲價格或量。大，本身不夠。也不是電子郵件保存規 則。
ETH-068.core_idea: Intent to mislead, not mere size, is the II(B) test
ETH-068.study_section: II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信
ETH-068.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-068.subtopic: 1.4 II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信

ETH-069.reasoning: Reasoning: Act for the client’s benefit. Place the client’s interests before the employer’s or your own.

why_wrong.A: III(A) ranks the client before the employer.
why_wrong.B: A proprietary book does not cancel the client-first duty.

ETH-069.zh: III(A) 是為客戶利益做事，客戶優先於僱主與自己。公司自營帳戶要先做，不能 蓋過這條。
ETH-069.core_idea: III(A): place the client’s interests before the employer’s or your own
ETH-069.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-069.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-069.subtopic: 1.4 III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任

ETH-070.reasoning: Reasoning: Know to whom a fiduciary duty is owed on trust and retirement accounts. A fiduciary acts in another party’s best interest.

why_wrong.A: The sources tie the “know to whom” duty to trust and retirement accounts, not to inventing extra fiduciary clients.
why_wrong.C: The sources expressly include retirement accounts in that fiduciary reminder.

ETH-070.zh: 信託與退休帳戶要先搞清楚忠實義務是對誰負的。不是對每個閒逛的準客戶都自 動變成這些帳戶的受託人。
ETH-070.core_idea: Know to whom a fiduciary duty is owed on trust and retirement accounts
ETH-070.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-070.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-070.subtopic: 1.4 III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任

ETH-071.reasoning: Reasoning: When the member has control or custody of client assets, recommended procedures include providing regular itemized statements. Disclose compensation arrangements and advisory relationships.

why_wrong.A: Both compensation arrangements belong in the disclosure.
why_wrong.B: The sources call for disclosure, not concealment.

ETH-071.zh: 報酬安排與顧問關係要揭露。不能只講顧問費、把銷售費藏起來。
ETH-071.core_idea: Disclose compensation arrangements and advisory relationships
ETH-071.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-071.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-071.subtopic: 1.4 III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任

ETH-072.reasoning: Reasoning: Use soft dollars for the client’s benefit, not to buy the firm a research product the client does not receive.

why_wrong.A: Lobby decoration is not a client benefit.
why_wrong.B: The sources permit soft dollars used for the client’s benefit.

ETH-072.zh: 軟美元要用在這些客戶身上。客戶佣金換成客戶真正用到的研究，與III(A) 一致。
ETH-072.core_idea: Soft dollars must be used for the client’s benefit
ETH-072.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-072.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-072.subtopic: 1.4 III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任

ETH-073.reasoning: Reasoning: Deal fairly and objectively with all clients. Do not personally take shares in oversubscribed IPOs, and do not steer those shares to favored accounts.

why_wrong.B: That ranking is the opposite of fair dealing.
why_wrong.C: III(B) expressly addresses IPO shares and favored accounts.

ETH-073.zh: 超額認購的IPO，自己不能先拿，也不能塞給寵兒帳戶。
ETH-073.core_idea: Do not personally take shares in oversubscribed IPOs
ETH-073.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-073.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-073.subtopic: 1.4 III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任

ETH-074.reasoning: Reasoning: Do not personally take shares in oversubscribed IPOs, and do not steer those shares to favored accounts.

why_wrong.A: III(B) is fair dealing among clients, not a fee-privilege mandate.
why_wrong.B: IPO steering is a III(B) fact pattern.

ETH-074.zh: 熱門IPO 只塞給收費最高的兩個帳戶，其他同樣適合、準時下單的客戶沒分到， 是厚此薄彼。
ETH-074.core_idea: Do not steer oversubscribed IPO shares to favored accounts
ETH-074.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-074.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-074.subtopic: 1.4 III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任

ETH-075.reasoning: Reasoning: Deal fairly and objectively with all clients. Attempt simultaneous dissemination of recommendations and recommendation changes.

why_wrong.A: Simultaneous dissemination is the required attempt, not a forbidden act.
why_wrong.C: Letting favorites trade first is the violation pattern.

ETH-075.zh: 評等變更要盡力同時發給所有客戶。先給名單、別人週一才收到，不是公平對待。
ETH-075.core_idea: Attempt simultaneous dissemination of recommendations and recommendation changes
ETH-075.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-075.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-075.subtopic: 1.4 III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任

ETH-076.reasoning: Reasoning: Fair is not identical. The Standard requires fair and objective dealing — simultaneous dissemination of recommendations and changes — not cloned service after that release.

why_wrong.A: The sources say fair is not identical; they do not demand identical scripts, sizes, and fees.
why_wrong.C: Different mandates do not excuse skipping dissemination.

ETH-076.zh: 公平不是完全相同。同時發布之後，依不同mandate 做不同執行討論，不自動違 規。但不能因此就不發給較小的mandate。
ETH-076.core_idea: Fair dealing is not identical service
ETH-076.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-076.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-076.subtopic: 1.4 III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任

ETH-077.reasoning: Reasoning: In an advisory relationship, before the recommendation or the trade: gather an IPS, update it regularly, test whether the investment aligns with the IPS, and judge suitability in the context of the client’s total portfolio.

why_wrong.B: Writing the IPS to match a trade already done reverses the sequence.
why_wrong.C: The sources require an IPS in an advisory relationship before the recommendation or trade.

ETH-077.zh: 顧問關係裡，建議或交易之前要先有IPS，還要定期更新、對照這筆投資是否符 合。不能先做再說。
ETH-077.core_idea: In an advisory relationship, gather an IPS before the recommendation or the trade
ETH-077.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-077.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-077.subtopic: 1.4 III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任

ETH-078.reasoning: Reasoning: Judge suitability in the context of the client’s total portfolio.

why_wrong.B: Standalone volatility without IPS/total-portfolio context is the wrong test.
why_wrong.C: The sources require total-portfolio context, not an automatic ban on every speculative name.

ETH-078.zh: 適合性要放在客戶整個投資組合裡看，不是單看這一檔單獨很兇。IPS 風險限度內 的小部位，可以符合。
ETH-078.core_idea: Judge suitability in the context of the client’s total portfolio
ETH-078.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-078.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-078.subtopic: 1.4 III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任

ETH-079.reasoning: Reasoning: If the relationship is a stated mandate or strategy, invest in line with that mandate — not a different strategy the member prefers.

why_wrong.B: The sources treat the mandate as the constraint.
why_wrong.C: Preference does not override a stated mandate.

ETH-079.zh: 有寫明的mandate，就按那個策略投資，不能因為自己比較喜歡高收益就換掉。
ETH-079.core_idea: A stated mandate or strategy must be followed; do not substitute a strategy the member prefers
ETH-079.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-079.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-079.subtopic: 1.4 III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任

ETH-080.reasoning: Reasoning: Unsolicited trade, minimal effect: discuss how the trade does not fit the IPS, then follow firm policy for unsuitable trades (example: do not trade).

why_wrong.A: The sources still require discussing the mismatch.
why_wrong.B: Minimal effect still requires the discussion and then firm policy — not a silent fill.

ETH-080.zh: 未經招攬、對組合影響很小：先講清楚與IPS 不合，再走公司對不適合交易的政 策（題幹是不要做）。不是silently 先成交。
ETH-080.core_idea: Minimal-effect unsolicited trade: discuss the IPS mismatch, then follow firm policy
ETH-080.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-080.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-080.subtopic: 1.4 III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任

ETH-081.reasoning: Reasoning: In an advisory relationship: gather an IPS, update it regularly, and test whether the investment aligns with the IPS.

why_wrong.B: The sources do not wait on an examination letter.
why_wrong.C: Regular updates are required, not forbidden.

ETH-081.zh: IPS 要定期更新。工作、流動性、年期變了還用兩年前那一版，就是沒做到。
ETH-081.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-081.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-081.subtopic: 1.4 III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任

ETH-082.reasoning: Reasoning: Advisory: IPS, regular updates, alignment, total-portfolio suitability. Mandate/strategy: invest in line with that mandate — not a different strategy the member prefers.

why_wrong.A: A house view does not erase IPS or mandate constraints.
why_wrong.C: The advisory path is gather/update/test the IPS; the mandate path is follow the mandate.

ETH-082.zh: 顧問帳戶對IPS 與總組合；有寫明mandate 的帳戶就按mandate 做。不是看空 就能兩邊都不管。
ETH-082.core_idea: Advisory IPS test versus a stated mandate: two III(C) paths
ETH-082.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-082.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-082.subtopic: 1.4 III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任

ETH-083.reasoning: Reasoning: Communicate performance fairly, accurately, and completely. Weight composites properly, include terminated accounts.

why_wrong.B: Dropping them to dress the mean is the opposite of the rule.
why_wrong.C: Selecting only winners among terminated accounts is still cherry-picking.

ETH-083.zh: 績效要公平、正確、完整。已終止帳戶要納入composite，不能為了好看就拿掉。
ETH-083.core_idea: Include terminated accounts when presenting composite performance
ETH-083.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
ETH-083.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-083.subtopic: 1.4 III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任

ETH-084.reasoning: Reasoning: Do not present a track record that is true only because the weak accounts have been dropped.

why_wrong.B: That is cherry-picking, not a completeness requirement.
why_wrong.C: A true number on a cleaned sample is the incompleteness the sources name.

ETH-084.zh: 數字可以對「還留著的帳戶」為真，但弱帳戶被拿掉，這條track record 就不完 整。III(D) 要的是完整，不是切片為真。
ETH-084.core_idea: Do not present a track record that is true only because weak accounts were dropped

why_wrong.B: The sources say terminated pooled funds need not remain, for both limitedand broad-distribution funds.

ETH-140.zh: 已終止的集合基金，不論有限或廣泛銷售，都不必留在那些名單上。五年留存是 terminated composites 的規則，不要套到pooled fund 名單。
ETH-140.core_idea: Terminated pooled funds need not remain on the LDPF or BDPF lists
ETH-140.study_section: Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS) ｜全球投資績效標準
ETH-140.source_note: 解答依據 ETH_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Ethical and Professional Standards。
ETH-140.subtopic: 1.5 Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS) ｜全球投資績效標準

QM-001.reasoning: Reasoning: The Study Book defines opportunity cost as the next-best use of the money being committed now. The $2.0 million can earn 9% elsewhere; that 9% is the market price of tying it up in K. The $400,000 study is a sunk cost and does not enter the required rate.

why_wrong.A: Mixing a sunk outlay into the hurdle rate as if it were an opportunity cost.
why_wrong.B: Sunk costs are already spent and do not enter the required rate.

QM-001.zh: 機會成本是「這筆錢現在不拿去最好的下一個用途」所放棄的報酬，不是去年已經 花掉、收不回來的可行性研究。沉沒成本不進required rate。
QM-001.core_idea: Opportunity cost is the next-best use of capital, not a sunk cash outlay
QM-001.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-002.reasoning: Reasoning: The exact link is multiplicative because the real rate must also be earned on the inflation premium. Given: R_real = 2.5%; expected inflation = 4.0%. Asked: Nominal risk-free rate. Formula: Rnom = (1 + Rreal)(1 + i) −1 Variables: R_nom = nominal risk-free rate; R_real = real risk-free rate; i = expected inflation / inflation premium. Why this formula: Inflation compensation itself must earn the real rate, so the pieces multiply. The 0.10 percentage-point gap versus 6.50% is the cross-product 2.5%×4.0%. Reasonableness check: Additive 6.50% understates the exact nominal rate whenever both pieces are positive. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Takes the difference in the wrong direction: 4.0% - 2.5% = 1.50%, instead of compounding the real rate and inflation.
why_wrong.C: Adds 2.5% + 4.0% and skips the cross-product.

QM-002.zh: 名目無風險利率是相乘不是相加：通膨補償那一層本身也要再賺到實質報酬。
QM-002.core_idea: Nominal risk-free rate is multiplicative in (1+real)(1+inflation)-1
QM-002.exam_trap: Adding real and inflation instead of multiplying
QM-002.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-003.reasoning: Reasoning: The Study Book splits the required rate into real + inflation (nominal risk-free) plus default, maturity, and liquidity premiums. Longer lock-up is the maturity premium. Default is credit; liquidity is exit difficulty.

why_wrong.A: Liquidity pays for harder exit, not for calendar length as such.
why_wrong.B: Default pays for uncertain amounts (credit), not for tenor by itself.

QM-003.zh: 到期溢酬補的是資金被鎖更久；違約溢酬補信用；流動性溢酬補不好出場。不要 把tenor 全部塞進違約。
QM-003.core_idea: Default, maturity, and liquidity premiums sit on top of the nominal risk-free rate
QM-003.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-004.reasoning: Reasoning: HPR is the percentage wealth change, including cash received: (P1-P0+income)/P0. Given: P0 = $48.00; P1 = $51.60; income = $1.20. Asked: Holding-period return. Formula: HPR = P1 −P0 + income P0 Variables: P0 = beginning price; P1 = ending price. Why this formula: One-period wealth change including cash received, scaled by what was invested. Value went from 48 to 52.80 of wealth-equivalent; that is a 10% gain. Reasonableness check: Price-only 7.50% is too low because the cash dividend is part of the return. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Adds the dividend to the beginning price in the denominator: (51.60- 48+1.20)/49.20.
why_wrong.C: Uses only (51.60-48)/48 = 7.50% and drops income.

QM-004.zh: 分子是價差加股利，分母只有期初買價。股利不是拿去除期初再加一次。
QM-004.core_idea: HPR includes price change and income, scaled by beginning price
QM-004.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-005.reasoning: Reasoning: Over several full years, chain the gross returns. Do not average and do not take a root; the root is the geometric mean, a different object. Given: r1 = +12%; r2 = -8%; r3 = +6%; full years, no intra-year flows. Asked: Three-year holding-period return. Formula: HPR = (1 + r1)(1 + r2)(1 + r3) −1 Why this formula: The multi-year wealth ratio is the product of one-year wealth ratios. The arithmetic mean is 3.33% per year; that is not the three-year wealth change. Reasonableness check: A +12 and -8 do not net to +4 in wealth terms: 1.12×0.92 = 1.0304, not 1.04. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Adds the three rates without compounding: 12-8+6 = 10.00%.
why_wrong.C: Reports the arithmetic mean of the three years as if it were the multi-year wealth change.

QM-005.zh: 多年HPR 是財富倍率相乘再減1，不是三年報酬加起來除3，也還不是幾何平均。
QM-005.core_idea: Multi-year HPR is the product of gross returns, not the average of annual rates
QM-005.exam_trap: Using the arithmetic mean as a compound growth rate
QM-005.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-006.reasoning: Reasoning: An interest rate can be a required return, a discount rate, or an opportunity cost — the price of money for one period. Opportunity cost is the next-best use you give up by parking the money here, not a coupon already paid. Sunk costs do not enter the required rate, but the capital still committed does have a next-best use.

why_wrong.B: Correctly drops sunk costs from the required rate, but then wrongly says the note has no opportunity cost going forward. Capital still has a next-best use.
why_wrong.C: Treats a past coupon as the opportunity cost; the Study Book says opportunity cost is not interest already paid.

QM-006.zh: 機會成本不是「已經付過的利息」，而是現在把錢鎖在這裡所放棄的下一個最好用 途。沉沒成本不進hurdle，但不代表持有這張票之後就沒有機會成本。
QM-006.core_idea: Opportunity cost is the next-best use, not interest already paid
QM-006.exam_trap: Treating a paid coupon as opportunity cost
QM-006.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-007.reasoning: Reasoning: The sources call the market interest rate yield, market discount rate, opportunity cost, YTM, or I/Y — same idea, different labels. Default, maturity, and liquidity premiums are the extra pieces, not these names.

why_wrong.A: Adds the labels as if they were separate pieces of the required-rate build-up.
why_wrong.B: Treats YTM as unusable in TVM. The Study Book lists YTM and I/Y as the same required-rate idea.

QM-007.zh: 要求報酬、殖利率、機會成本、YTM、I/Y，是同一層「資金一期的價格」的不同 叫法，不是三個要相加的溢酬。
QM-007.core_idea: Yield, market discount rate, opportunity cost, YTM, and I/Y are labels for the same required rate
QM-007.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-008.reasoning: Reasoning: Investment-specific premia pay for uncertain amounts (default), longer lock-up (maturity), and harder exit (liquidity). Y versus X, same tenor, adds credit and exit difficulty.

why_wrong.A: Inflation is in the nominal risk-free building block, shared by both.
why_wrong.B: Maturity is already matched at 7 years; lock-up is not the extra piece.

QM-008.zh: 年期相同，多出來的是違約（金額不確定）與流動性（不好出場），不是再加一層 到期或通膨。
QM-008.core_idea: Default premium pays for uncertain amounts; liquidity premium pays for harder exit
QM-008.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-009.reasoning: Reasoning: Rearrange: 1+R_real = (1+R_nom)/(1+i). Additive subtraction drops the crossterm. Given: R_nom = 4.342%; i = 2.8%. Asked: Real risk-free rate. Formula: Rreal = (1 + Rnom)/(1 + i) −1 Why this formula: The identity is multiplicative; invert by dividing. The additive shortcut 1.54% is close but not the exact real rate. Reasonableness check: Forward: 1.015 × 1.028 - 1 = 4.342%. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
QM-009.zh: 反求實質利率要相除：1.04342/1.028-1=1.50%，不是名目減通膨。
QM-009.core_idea: Recover the real rate from a multiplicative nominal identity
QM-009.exam_trap: Adding real and inflation instead of multiplying
QM-009.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-010.reasoning: Reasoning: Sunk costs are already spent and do not enter the required rate. Opportunity cost attaches to the capital you still have a choice about — here the $1.2 million that can earn 6% elsewhere.

why_wrong.A: Correctly drops the legal bill, then wrongly concludes there is no next-best use of the $1.2 million.
why_wrong.C: Amortizes a sunk cost into the required rate.

QM-010.zh: 律師費已沉沒，不進hurdle。現在還能選擇的120 萬，機會成本是外面6%。不是 「沉沒了就沒有機會成本」。
QM-010.core_idea: Sunk costs do not enter the required rate; committed capital still has a next-best use
QM-010.exam_trap: Treating a paid coupon as opportunity cost
QM-010.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-011.reasoning: Reasoning: Numerator is price change plus cash received; denominator is beginning price only. Given: P0 = 97.50; P1 = 96.20; income = 3.00. Asked: Holding-period return. Formula: HPR = (96.20 −97.50 + 3.00)/97.50 Why this formula: Percentage wealth change including cash received. A price decline can still produce a positive HPR if income more than offsets it. Reasonableness check: 1.74% is between the -1.33% price return and the 3.08% coupon/P0. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Puts ending price in the denominator.
why_wrong.B: Drops the coupon and reports a price loss only.

QM-011.zh: 票息要進分子；分母永遠是期初買價97.50，不是賣價。
QM-011.core_idea: HPR scales the entire wealth change, including income, by P0 only
QM-011.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-012.reasoning: Reasoning: Multi-year HPR = (1+r1)(1+r2)(1+r3)-1. The same product’s n-th root minus 1 is the geometric mean — the constant annual rate, a different object.

why_wrong.B: Confuses a geometric mean with an arithmetic mean.
why_wrong.C: Puts the root into multi-year HPR. The Study Book: over several full years do not take a root.

QM-012.zh: 三年HPR 只相乘減1。開三次方是幾何平均年化，不是「三年報酬」。
QM-012.core_idea: Multi-year HPR multiplies and stops; the root is a different object (GM)
QM-012.exam_trap: Using the arithmetic mean as a compound growth rate
QM-012.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-013.reasoning: Reasoning: The periodic rate is 9%/12. EAR compounds that rate 12 times. More frequent compounding raises EAR for a fixed stated rate. Given: Stated i = 9%; m = 12. Asked: EAR. Formula: EAR = ( 1 + i m )m −1 Variables: i = stated annual rate; m = compounds per year. Why this formula: Converts a quoted nominal rate into the one-year wealth change after intra-year compounding. You earn 0.75% twelve times, including interest on interest. Reasonableness check: EAR > stated rate when m > 1, so 9.38% > 9% is the right direction. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：ICONV 已知：NOM = 9; C/Y = 12 求：EFF (EAR) 按鍵： ①2nd →ICONV ②9 →ENTER (NOM) ③↓→12 →ENTER (C/Y) ④↓→CPT (EFF) 結果：EFF = 9.38 中文理解：NOM 是題目報價，C/Y 是一年複利次數，CPT EFF 才是EAR。連續複利不要 進ICONV。

why_wrong.A: Multiplies 9% by 12, confusing m with a scaling of the annual rate.
why_wrong.B: Treats the stated rate as already effective.

QM-013.zh: 報價9% 不是真正一年賺到的。月複利是每期0.75% 複利12 次，EAR 會高於 9%。
QM-013.core_idea: EAR compounds the periodic rate m times: (1+i/m)^m - 1
QM-013.study_section: Stated Rates and Effective Rates ｜名目利率與有效利率
QM-013.exam_trap: Treating the stated rate as already effective
QM-013.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：ICONV
已知：NOM = 9; C/Y = 12
求：EFF (EAR)
按鍵：
①2nd →ICONV ②9 →ENTER (NOM) ③↓→12 →ENTER (C/Y) ④↓→CPT (EFF)
結果：EFF = 9.38
中文理解：NOM 是題目報價，C/Y 是一年複利次數，CPT EFF 才是EAR。連續複利不要
進ICONV。
QM-013.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-013.subtopic: 2.1.3 Stated Rates and Effective Rates｜名目利率與有效利率

QM-014.reasoning: Reasoning: Periodic rate = (1+EAR)^1/m - 1; stated = m × periodic. This is the inverse of the EAR formula. Given: EAR = 5.12%; m = 12. Asked: Stated annual rate i. Formula: i = m [ (1 + EAR)1/m −1 ] Why this formula: ICONV can also convert EFF →NOM given C/Y. Monthly compounding means the stated quote sits below EAR. Reasonableness check: Stated < EAR for m>1, so 5.00% < 5.12% is reasonable. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：ICONV 已知：EFF = 5.12; C/Y = 12 求：NOM 按鍵： ①2nd →ICONV ②↓→5.12 →ENTER (EFF) ③↓→12 →ENTER (C/Y) ④↑↑to NOM →CPT 結果：NOM ≈5.00 中文理解：已知有效利率反求名目。先輸入EFF 與C/Y，再CPT NOM。方向與EAR 題相 反。

why_wrong.B: Treats EAR as already the stated quote.
why_wrong.C: Compounds 5.12% monthly a second time: (1.0512)12 - 1.

QM-014.zh: 反過來：先把EAR 開m 次方得到每期利率，再乘回m 才是stated。不要把 5.12% 再複利一次。
QM-014.core_idea: Reverse: recover the stated rate from EAR and m
QM-014.study_section: Stated Rates and Effective Rates ｜名目利率與有效利率
QM-014.exam_trap: Treating the stated rate as already effective
QM-014.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：ICONV
已知：EFF = 5.12; C/Y = 12
求：NOM
按鍵：
①2nd →ICONV ②↓→5.12 →ENTER (EFF) ③↓→12 →ENTER (C/Y) ④↑↑to NOM
→CPT
結果：NOM ≈5.00
中文理解：已知有效利率反求名目。先輸入EFF 與C/Y，再CPT NOM。方向與EAR 題相
反。
QM-014.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-014.subtopic: 2.1.3 Stated Rates and Effective Rates｜名目利率與有效利率

QM-015.reasoning: Reasoning: Periodic rate = 6%/2 = 3%. EAR = (1.03)2 - 1 = 6.09%. Continuous would apply only if the quote said continuous. Given: Stated i = 6%; m = 2. Asked: EAR. Formula: EAR = (1.03)2 −1 Why this formula: Two 3% credits in one year, with interest on the first 3%. Even two compounds already lift EAR above the stated quote. Reasonableness check: 6.09% sits between annual 6% and continuous 6.18%. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：ICONV 已知：NOM = 6; C/Y = 2 求：EFF (EAR) 按鍵： ①2nd →ICONV ②6 →ENTER (NOM) ③↓→2 →ENTER (C/Y) ④↓→CPT (EFF) 結果：EFF = 6.09 中文理解：NOM 是題目報價，C/Y 是一年複利次數，CPT EFF 才是EAR。連續複利不要 進ICONV。

why_wrong.A: Uses continuous compounding e^0.06-1.
why_wrong.B: Treats the stated 6% as already effective.

QM-015.zh: 半年複利是每期3% 兩次，EAR=6.09%。不要直接當6%，也不要改用連續複利。
QM-015.core_idea: Semiannual compounding: periodic rate is i/2, then square
QM-015.study_section: Stated Rates and Effective Rates ｜名目利率與有效利率
QM-015.exam_trap: Treating the stated rate as already effective

計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：ICONV
已知：NOM = 6; C/Y = 2
求：EFF (EAR)
按鍵：
①2nd →ICONV ②6 →ENTER (NOM) ③↓→2 →ENTER (C/Y) ④↓→CPT (EFF)
結果：EFF = 6.09
中文理解：NOM 是題目報價，C/Y 是一年複利次數，CPT EFF 才是EAR。連續複利不要
進ICONV。
QM-015.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
