QM-016.reasoning: Reasoning: Quarterly: (1.025)4 - 1 = 10.38%. Annual compounding of a 10% stated rate is 10%. Continuous e^0.10-1 = 10.52% is the m→∞ceiling, not the quarterly figure. Given: Stated i = 10%; m = 4 (not continuous). Asked: EAR and its position versus annual and continuous. Formula: EAR = (1.025)4 −1 Why this formula: Finite m=4, not e^r. Ordering for fixed stated 10%: annual 10% < quarterly 10.38% < continuous 10.52%. Reasonableness check: ICONV NOM=10, C/Y=4, CPT EFF ≈10.38. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：ICONV 已知：NOM = 10; C/Y = 4 求：EFF (EAR) 按鍵： ①2nd →ICONV ②10 →ENTER (NOM) ③↓→4 →ENTER (C/Y) ④↓→CPT (EFF) 結果：EFF = 10.38 中文理解：NOM 是題目報價，C/Y 是一年複利次數，CPT EFF 才是EAR。連續複利不要 進ICONV。

why_wrong.A: Jumps to continuous compounding, which the stem does not state.
why_wrong.C: Treats stated as earned whenever the word annual appears.

QM-016.zh: 同樣報價10%，季複利EAR≈10.38%，高於一年複利一次的10%，但仍低於連續 複利10.52%。
QM-016.core_idea: More frequent compounding raises EAR when the stated rate is held fixed
QM-016.study_section: Stated Rates and Effective Rates ｜名目利率與有效利率
QM-016.exam_trap: Treating the stated rate as already effective
QM-016.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：ICONV
已知：NOM = 10; C/Y = 4
求：EFF (EAR)
按鍵：
①2nd →ICONV ②10 →ENTER (NOM) ③↓→4 →ENTER (C/Y) ④↓→CPT (EFF)
結果：EFF = 10.38
中文理解：NOM 是題目報價，C/Y 是一年複利次數，CPT EFF 才是EAR。連續複利不要
進ICONV。
QM-016.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-016.subtopic: 2.1.3 Stated Rates and Effective Rates｜名目利率與有效利率

QM-017.reasoning: Reasoning: The stated rate is a quote. EAR = (1+i/m)^m - 1 rises with m when i is fixed. Bank Q’s monthly EAR exceeds 7%; Bank P’s EAR is 7%.

why_wrong.B: Reverses the compounding-frequency effect.
why_wrong.C: Treats any annual quote as the amount earned over a year.

QM-017.zh: 同樣寫7%，月複利的EAR 比較高，因為後面幾次是利息再賺利息。題目寫 annual 不代表已經是有效年利率。
QM-017.core_idea: The quoted annual rate is a label; EAR is the percentage actually earned in a year
QM-017.study_section: Stated Rates and Effective Rates ｜名目利率與有效利率
QM-017.exam_trap: Treating the stated rate as already effective
QM-017.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-017.subtopic: 2.1.3 Stated Rates and Effective Rates｜名目利率與有效利率

QM-018.reasoning: Reasoning: Change the rate to the payment period. Do not scale the payment. Book convention: P/Y=1, C/Y=1; periods in N; periodic rate in I/Y.

why_wrong.A: The book’s preferred setting is P/Y=1, C/Y=1, and the candidate puts the periodic rate in I/Y. Do not rely on P/Y=12 plus I/Y=12.
why_wrong.C: Scales the payment instead of the rate.

QM-018.zh: 期間對不上時，改的是利率（年利率÷ 期數），不要去改付款金額。全書預設 P/Y=1，自己把I/Y 設成每期利率。
QM-018.core_idea: If the payment period and the rate period do not match, change the rate, not the payment
QM-018.study_section: Stated Rates and Effective Rates ｜名目利率與有效利率
QM-018.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-018.subtopic: 2.1.3 Stated Rates and Effective Rates｜名目利率與有效利率

QM-019.reasoning: Reasoning: Continuous compounding is the m→∞limit: EAR = e^r - 1. ICONV is for finite C/Y, not continuous. Given: Stated r = 7% compounded continuously. Asked: EAR. Formula: EAR = e0.07 −1 Why this formula: m→∞turns (1+r/m)^m into e^r. For fixed stated 7%: annual 7% < monthly ≈7.23% < continuous 7.25%. Reasonableness check: Continuous must exceed any finite-m EAR for the same stated rate. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Leaves the stated rate uncompounded.
why_wrong.B: Uses monthly EAR instead of e^0.07-1.

QM-019.zh: 連續複利是e^0.07-1≈7.25%，比月複利略高。不要把連續複利丟進ICONV。
QM-019.core_idea: Continuous EAR is e^r - 1; ICONV does not do continuous compounding
QM-019.exam_trap: Treating the stated rate as already effective
QM-019.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-020.reasoning: Reasoning: CCR = ln(1+HPR). HPR = e^CCR-1 is the inverse. A 15% HPR is a CCR slightly below 15%. Given: HPR = 15%. Asked: Continuously compounded return. Formula: CCR = ln(1.15) Why this formula: The log converts a wealth ratio into an additive rate. Continuous rates add across periods; 13.98% is the additive one-year rate. Reasonableness check: CCR < HPR for positive HPR because ln(1+x) < x. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Sets CCR equal to HPR.
why_wrong.C: Computes e^0.15-1, which converts a CCR into an HPR — the inverse map.

QM-020.zh: ln(1.15)≈13.98%，不是15%。e^0.15-1 是把連續利率還原成HPR，方向反了。
QM-020.core_idea: CCR = ln(1+HPR); do not set CCR equal to HPR or invert the map
QM-020.exam_trap: Setting CCR equal to HPR or inverting the map
QM-020.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-021.reasoning: Reasoning: Continuous rates add across time, then convert once: HPR = e^3×0.05-1. Not 15%, and not 1.053-1. Given: CCR = 5% per year; N = 3 years. Asked: Three-year HPR. Formula: HPR = e0.05×3 −1 Why this formula: CCR adds; the exponential converts the summed rate back to a wealth ratio. 5% CCR each year compounds continuously, so three-year wealth exceeds 15%. Reasonableness check: Result must exceed 15% and also exceed 1.053-1 = 15.76%. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Treats 5% as an annual effective rate and uses 1.053-1.
why_wrong.C: Adds 5%+5%+5% as if CCR were already an HPR.

QM-021.zh: 連續利率跨期先相加再取指數。三年是e^0.15-1≈16.18%，不是15%，也不是普 通5% 複利三年。
QM-021.core_idea: Two-year HPR from a constant CCR is e^2r-1, not 2r and not (1+r)2-1
QM-021.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-022.reasoning: Reasoning: FV = PV e^rN = 4000 e^0.24. Ordinary (1+r)^N is not the continuous map. Given: PV = 4,000; r = 6% continuous; N = 4. Asked: Future value. Formula: FV = 4000 e0.06×4 Why this formula: Continuous compounding of a stated rate. Continuous 6% for four years grows faster than annual-effective 6%. Reasonableness check: 5,085 / 4,000 - 1 = 27.12% = e^0.24-1, the four-year HPR. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Applies simple growth 4000×(1+0.06×4).
why_wrong.C: Compounds 6% as an annual effective rate: 4000×1.064.

QM-022.zh: 連續複利終值是PV×e^rN，不是1.06 的四年次方，更不是單利24%。
QM-022.core_idea: FV = PV e^rN under continuous compounding
QM-022.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-023.reasoning: Reasoning: Continuous rates add across time. Two-year CCR = 4%+9% = 13%. The two-year HPR is e^0.13-1 = 13.88%, a different object.

why_wrong.A: Multiplies 4% × 9%.
why_wrong.C: Converts each CCR to an HPR, multiplies, then stops without logging back — that would be a two-year HPR, not the two-year CCR.

QM-023.zh: 連續複利報酬跨期直接相加：4%+9%=13%。普通HPR 才要相乘。
QM-023.core_idea: Continuous rates add; ordinary HPRs multiply
QM-023.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-024.reasoning: Reasoning: EAR = (1+0.12/52)^52-1 ≈12.73%. For fixed stated 12% the book’s ordering is annual < monthly (12.68%) < weekly < continuous (12.75%). Given: Stated i = 12%; m = 52. Asked: EAR. Formula: EAR = (1 + 0.12/52)52 −1 Why this formula: Finite weekly compounding, not continuous. Weekly is almost at the continuous ceiling but still below it. Reasonableness check: 12.00% < 12.68% (monthly) < 12.73% (weekly) < 12.75% (continuous). 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：ICONV 已知：NOM = 12; C/Y = 52 求：EFF (EAR) 按鍵： ①2nd →ICONV ②12 →ENTER (NOM) ③↓→52 →ENTER (C/Y) ④↓→CPT (EFF) 結果：EFF = 12.73 中文理解：NOM 是題目報價，C/Y 是一年複利次數，CPT EFF 才是EAR。連續複利不要 進ICONV。

why_wrong.B: Uses the continuous limit e^0.12-1 = 12.75%.
why_wrong.C: Treats stated 12% as EAR.

QM-024.zh: 週複利EAR≈12.73%，高於月複利12.68%，仍低於連續12.75%。不要停在12%， 也不要直接e^0.12-1。
QM-024.core_idea: Weekly compounding sits between monthly and continuous for a fixed stated rate
QM-024.study_section: Stated Rates and Effective Rates ｜名目利率與有效利率
QM-024.exam_trap: Treating the stated rate as already effective
QM-024.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：ICONV
已知：NOM = 12; C/Y = 52
求：EFF (EAR)
按鍵：
①2nd →ICONV ②12 →ENTER (NOM) ③↓→52 →ENTER (C/Y) ④↓→CPT (EFF)
結果：EFF = 12.73
中文理解：NOM 是題目報價，C/Y 是一年複利次數，CPT EFF 才是EAR。連續複利不要
進ICONV。
QM-024.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-024.subtopic: 2.1.3 Stated Rates and Effective Rates｜名目利率與有效利率

QM-025.reasoning: Reasoning: r_G is the constant annual rate that reproduces the multi-year wealth ratio. Variability pulls r_G below r_A. Given: +15%, -6%, +12%; full-year total returns. Asked: Geometric mean return. Formula: rG = [(1.15)(0.94)(1.12)]1/3 −1 Why this formula: Asked for the constant compound annual return, not the typical one-year draw. Arithmetic mean 7.00% overstates the compound path. Reasonableness check: r_G < r_A because returns vary. Equality only if every return is identical. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
QM-025.steps: ①Product of gross returns = 1.15 × 0.94 × 1.12 = 1.21072. ②r_G = (1.21072)^1/3 - 1 = 6.58%. ③Check: arithmetic mean = 7.00%; three-year HPR = 21.07%.

why_wrong.A: Reports the three-year HPR instead of the annual compound rate.
why_wrong.C: Reports the arithmetic mean, which does not recover the path.

QM-025.zh: 幾何平均讓每年同一個速率重現實際財富路徑。波動讓它低於算術平均；相乘減1 是三年HPR 不是年化。
QM-025.core_idea: Geometric mean is the constant compound rate that recovers the wealth path
QM-025.exam_trap: Using the arithmetic mean as a compound growth rate
QM-025.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-026.reasoning: Reasoning: AM is the best guess of the population mean / a typical draw. GM is the constant rate that recovers ending wealth. They answer different questions.

why_wrong.B: Uses GM as a forecast of a single random year; GM is the path rate, not E[r].
why_wrong.C: Uses AM as compound growth; that is the Study Book trap when returns vary.

QM-026.zh: 明年會抽到多少，用算術平均；這段期間財富實際怎麼複利，用幾何平均。不要 用同一個平均回答兩個問題。
QM-026.core_idea: Arithmetic mean answers expected value of a distribution, not compound growth
QM-026.exam_trap: Using the arithmetic mean as a compound growth rate
QM-026.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-027.reasoning: Reasoning: Compounding makes losses and gains asymmetric: 1.14×0.86 = 0.9804. AM = 0%, but wealth fell 1.96%, and GM is negative. Variability pulls GM below AM. Given: +14% then -14%; full years. Asked: Relationship among two-year HPR, GM, and AM. Formula: Why this formula: Wealth multiplies; AM does not recover the path. AM says “average zero.” The account is smaller. GM is the constant rate that matches that smaller wealth. Reasonableness check: (1-0.00985)2 - 1 ≈-1.96%, matching the HPR. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Treats +14/-14 as wealth-neutral. 1.14×0.86 = 0.9804, not 1.
why_wrong.C: Thinks symmetry of the raw rates forces GM = AM. They coincide only if every return is identical.

QM-027.core_idea: A +g year and a -g year do not cancel; variability pulls GM below AM
QM-027.exam_trap: Using the arithmetic mean as a compound growth rate
QM-027.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-028.reasoning: Reasoning: If every return is identical, AM and GM coincide. Variability is what pulls GM below AM. The four-year HPR is 1.094-1 = 41.16%, which is not an annual mean. Given: Four years of +9%. Asked: AM and GM. Formula: rA = rG = 0.09 Why this formula: No variability ⇒no AM–GM gap. The variability penalty is not automatic; it requires dispersion. Reasonableness check: 1.094 - 1 = 41.16% is the four-year HPR, not GM. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Applies the variability penalty when there is no variability.
why_wrong.B: Reports the four-year HPR as if it were GM.

QM-028.zh: 每年都9%，兩個平均都是9%。波動為零時沒有「幾何較低」。41.16% 是四年 HPR。
QM-028.core_idea: If every return is identical, AM and GM coincide
QM-028.formula: rG = rA when ri are identical
QM-028.exam_trap: Using the arithmetic mean as a compound growth rate
QM-028.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-029.reasoning: Reasoning: TWR is a geometric mean of subperiod HPRs: √ [(1+r1)(1+r2)]-1. Arithmetic (22- 4)/2 = 9% overstates the compound path. Given: r1 = +22%; r2 = -4%. Asked: Annualized TWR. Formula: TWR = √ Why this formula: TWR is the GM of subperiod HPRs. AM = 9.00% overstates the constant annual rate that recovers 17.12% over two years. Reasonableness check: 1.08222 - 1 = 17.12% = 1.22×0.96 - 1. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Reports the two-year wealth product without the root.
why_wrong.C: Averages the two HPRs arithmetically — the Study Book’s TWR-as-(r1+r2)/2 trap.

QM-029.zh: 兩年TWR 是幾何平均，不是(22-4)/2=9%。也不要停在1.22×0.96-1 當成年化。
QM-029.core_idea: Reporting a two-year TWR as (r1+r2)/2 is the AM-as-compound trap
QM-029.exam_trap: Using the arithmetic mean as a compound growth rate
QM-029.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-030.reasoning: Reasoning: Equal dollar amounts buy more shares when the price is low. Average price = total dollars / total shares, which is the harmonic mean. Given: $6 spent at $8, $12, and $24. Asked: Average purchase price. Formula: average price = total dollars total shares Why this formula: Same dollars at different prices; expensive prints get fewer shares. Harmonic mean sits below the $14.67 arithmetic mean of the prices. Reasonableness check: For positive observations, HM ≤GM ≤AM. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Uses the geometric mean of prices rather than shares bought with equal dollars.
why_wrong.C: Averages the three prices arithmetically, giving expensive shares too much weight.

QM-030.zh: 等額投入時，便宜價買到比較多股，所以平均買價是調和平均，不是把三個價格 直接平均。
QM-030.core_idea: Equal-dollar purchases: average price is the harmonic mean
QM-030.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-031.reasoning: Reasoning: Portfolio return is Σ w_i r_i with weights that sum to 1. Given: w = (0.25, 0.45, 0.30); r = (18%, 5%, -4%). Asked: Portfolio return. Formula: RP = 0.25(0.18) + 0.45(0.05) + 0.30(−0.04) Why this formula: Value weights, not equal weights, unless the question says equal. The losing sleeve drags, but it is only 30% of value. Reasonableness check: Result must lie between -4% and 18%, closer to B’s 5%. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports only the largest-named holding’s return.
why_wrong.B: Equal-weights the three funds instead of using value weights.

QM-031.zh: 組合報酬是市值加權，不是三檔各算1/3，也不是只看最大倉。
QM-031.core_idea: Portfolio return is a value-weighted mean
QM-031.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-032.reasoning: Reasoning: For positive observations, HM ≤GM ≤AM. Investment GMs use (1+r_i)>0. Do not apply the inequality mechanically to raw returns that can be zero or negative.

why_wrong.A: Swaps harmonic and geometric.
why_wrong.B: Reverses the inequality.

QM-032.zh: 正數觀測：調和≤幾何≤算術。報酬相對數1+r 必須為正；原始報酬可負時不 要硬套這不等式。
QM-032.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-033.reasoning: Reasoning: The book’s inequality is for positive observations. Harmonic mean of numbers that include 0 is not a usable average purchase-price construction. GM of returns is computed from gross relatives (1+r_i).

why_wrong.B: Applies the ranking to raw returns that include 0 and a negative.
why_wrong.C: Invented undefined-GM rule. GM uses (1+r_i); here 1.25, 1.00, 0.60 are positive, so GM exists.

QM-033.zh: 不等式只對正數。0 與-40% 是原始報酬，不要拿去排調和/幾何。幾何平均用的 是1+r（這裡都>0，所以GM 本身算得出來）。
QM-033.core_idea: Do not apply HM ≤GM ≤AM to raw returns that can be zero or negative
QM-033.exam_trap: Using the arithmetic mean as a compound growth rate
QM-033.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-034.reasoning: Reasoning: Expected return is a weighted mean with probability weights that sum to 1. Given: Outcomes (20%, 8%, -10%) with probabilities (0.25, 0.50, 0.25). Asked: Expected return. Formula: E(R) = 0.25(0.20) + 0.50(0.08) + 0.25(−0.10) Why this formula: Probability-weighted mean. The distribution’s typical draw is 6.50%, not the unweighted 6.00%. Reasonableness check: Weights sum to 1; result lies between -10% and 20%. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports only the middle outcome.
why_wrong.B: Equal-weights the three outcomes instead of using probabilities.

QM-034.zh: 期望報酬是概率加權，不是三種結果各1/3。
QM-034.core_idea: Expected return is a probability-weighted mean
QM-034.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-035.reasoning: Reasoning: The book’s table: AM for typical/expected value, not compound growth; GM for constant compound rate and TWR; HM for equal-dollar average price and averaging ratios; weighted for portfolio return and probability-weighted E[R].

why_wrong.A: Swaps AM and GM uses, and assigns HM to a typical draw.
why_wrong.C: TWR is a geometric mean of HPRs, not a harmonic mean. The book does use HM for averaging ratios.

QM-035.zh: 算術看典型／期望；幾何看複利路徑與TWR；調和看等額買價；加權看組合與期 望報酬。
QM-035.core_idea: Match the mean to the question: AM typical, GM path, HM equal-dollar price, weighted portfolio/E[R]
QM-035.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-036.reasoning: Reasoning: TWR: HPR each subperiod, then geometric mean. The withdrawal is stripped out by starting year 2 from the post-flow value. Given: Year-1 HPR = +16%; year-2 HPR = -5% after the withdrawal. Asked: Annualized TWR. Formula: TWR = √ Why this formula: Manager skill with client flows removed is the geometric mean of HPRs. The manager’s path is +16% then -5%, regardless of the withdrawal. Reasonableness check: TWR sits between -5% and +16%, below the 5.50% arithmetic mean because of volatility. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Computes account IRR (MWR) instead of chaining HPRs.
why_wrong.C: Averages +16% and -5% arithmetically.

QM-036.zh: TWR 先算每段HPR 再幾何平均，客戶提領不進報酬。算術平均兩年或去算IRR 都是錯題。
QM-036.core_idea: TWR is the geometric mean of subperiod HPRs; client flows are stripped out
QM-036.study_section: Time-Weighted versus Money-Weighted ｜時間加權與資金加權
QM-036.exam_trap: Using the arithmetic mean as a compound growth rate
QM-036.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-036.subtopic: 2.1.10 Time-Weighted versus Money-Weighted｜時間加權與資金加權

QM-037.reasoning: Reasoning: MWR is the IRR of the account’s cash flows. Deposit just before a weaker year pulls MWR toward that weaker year relative to TWR. Given: t=0: -80; t=1: -40; t=2: +154. Asked: Money-weighted return (IRR). Formula: 0 = −80 −40/(1 + rM) + 154/(1 + rM)2 Why this formula: Uneven account flows; IRR is MWR. TVM PMT cannot hold two different flow sizes. More money is in the account in the weaker second year (10% vs 25%), so MWR < TWR. Reasonableness check: MWR should lie near the two HPRs (25% and 10%) and below TWR. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：CF / IRR 已知：CF0 = -80; C01 = -40; F01 = 1; C02 = 154; F02 = 1 求：IRR 按鍵： ①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②80 →+/- →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→40 →+/- →ENTER (C01) ④↓→1 →ENTER (F01) ⑤↓→154 →ENTER (C02) ⑥↓→1 →ENTER (F02) ⑦ IRR →CPT 結果：IRR ≈15.98 中文理解：投入是流出（負號），期末一次領出是流入（正號）。不規則現金流用CF 表，不 要塞TVM 的PMT。
QM-037.steps: ①Timeline: -80 at t=0, -40 at t=1, +154 at t=2. ②Solve NPV = 0 for r. Newton IRR = 15.98%. ③For comparison, TWR = √ (1.25 × 154/140) - 1 = 17.26%.

why_wrong.A: Reports only the first year’s HPR.
why_wrong.C: Reports TWR (geometric mean of +25% and 154/140 - 1) instead of IRR.

QM-037.zh: MWR 是帳戶現金流的IRR。客戶在較弱年之前加碼，資金加權會被那一年拉近， 通常低於TWR。
QM-037.core_idea: MWR is the account IRR; extra money before a weaker year pulls MWR toward that year
QM-037.study_section: Time-Weighted versus Money-Weighted ｜時間加權與資金加權
QM-037.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：CF / IRR
已知：CF0 = -80; C01 = -40; F01 = 1; C02 = 154; F02 = 1
求：IRR
按鍵：
①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②80 →+/- →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→40 →+/- →ENTER
(C01) ④↓→1 →ENTER (F01) ⑤↓→154 →ENTER (C02) ⑥↓→1 →ENTER (F02) ⑦
IRR →CPT
結果：IRR ≈15.98
中文理解：投入是流出（負號），期末一次領出是流入（正號）。不規則現金流用CF 表，不
要塞TVM 的PMT。
QM-037.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-037.subtopic: 2.1.10 Time-Weighted versus Money-Weighted｜時間加權與資金加權

QM-038.reasoning: Reasoning: IRR gives more influence to periods with more money in the account. Adding money just before the loss drags MWR below TWR. TWR still chains +35% and -12%.

why_wrong.A: Treats every contribution as automatically return-enhancing.
why_wrong.C: Confuses TWR’s flow-stripping with MWR; MWR is affected by flows.

QM-038.zh: 大筆資金在虧損年前進去，MWR 會被虧損年拖下去，低於TWR。TWR 仍然只 看+35% 與-12%。
QM-038.core_idea: A contribution just before a weak period lowers MWR relative to TWR
QM-038.study_section: Time-Weighted versus Money-Weighted ｜時間加權與資金加權
QM-038.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-038.subtopic: 2.1.10 Time-Weighted versus Money-Weighted｜時間加權與資金加權

QM-039.reasoning: Reasoning: A contribution just before a strong period raises MWR relative to TWR. TWR remains the geometric mean of -8% and +28% and is the manager-skill measure because it strips client flows.

why_wrong.A: Uses the client’s experienced return to grade the manager. TWR is the manager measure.
why_wrong.C: Treats every deposit as return-reducing. Direction depends on the subsequent HPR.

QM-039.zh: 好年份之前大額投入，MWR 會被拉高、高於TWR。評經理人仍用TWR； MWR 是客戶自己經歷到的報酬。
QM-039.core_idea: A contribution just before a strong period raises MWR relative to TWR
QM-039.study_section: Time-Weighted versus Money-Weighted ｜時間加權與資金加權
QM-039.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-039.subtopic: 2.1.10 Time-Weighted versus Money-Weighted｜時間加權與資金加權

QM-040.reasoning: Reasoning: TWR = geometric mean of subperiod HPRs →manager skill; client flows removed. MWR = IRR of account cash flows →client’s experienced return.

why_wrong.A: Drops MWR even for the client-experience question.
why_wrong.C: Grades the manager with a flow-contaminated IRR.

QM-040.zh: 評經理人用TWR（去掉存提）；講客戶自己賺到多少用MWR（帳戶IRR）。
QM-040.core_idea: TWR for the manager; MWR for the client’s experienced return

QM-041.reasoning: Reasoning: Year 1 HPR = 260/200 - 1 = 30%. The deposit occurs after that return, so year 2 starts at 300, not 260. Year 2 HPR = 270/300 - 1 = -10%. TWR = √ (1.30×0.90) - 1 = 8.17%. Given: V0=200; V1-=260; deposit 40; V2=270. Asked: Annual TWR. Formula: r1 = 260/200 −1, r2 = 270/300 −1 Why this formula: Fresh HPR between cash flows, then geometric mean. TWR strips the client’s $40; the manager’s path is +30% then -10%. Reasonableness check: AM = 10.00% overstates the compound path because of the +30/-10 swing. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Ignores the deposit and treats 270/200 - 1 as TWR.
why_wrong.C: Averages the two HPRs arithmetically.

QM-041.zh: 現金流發生日要把帳戶切開。第二年分母是260+40=300，不是260，更不是200。
QM-041.core_idea: Compute a fresh HPR between cash flows; do not use pre-flow value as year-2 base
QM-041.study_section: Time-Weighted versus Money-Weighted ｜時間加權與資金加權
QM-041.exam_trap: Using the arithmetic mean as a compound growth rate

QM-041.subtopic: 2.1.10 Time-Weighted versus Money-Weighted｜時間加權與資金加權

QM-042.reasoning: Reasoning: Equal payments →TVM. Uneven payments →CF worksheet. NPV = -200 + 70/1.10 + 80/1.102 + 90/1.103. Given: CF0=-200; C01=70; C02=80; C03=90; I=10%. Asked: NPV. Formula: NPV = −200 + 70/1.10 + 80/1.102 + 90/1.103 Why this formula: Uneven inflows; discount each flow at 10%. The project barely fails a 10% hurdle; undiscounted +40 overstates value. Reasonableness check: PV of inflows ≈197.37 < 200, so NPV is a small negative — reasonable. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：CF / NPV 已知：CF0=-200; C01=70; C02=80; C03=90; I=10 求：NPV 按鍵： ①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②200 →+/- →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→70 →ENTER (C01) →↓→1 →ENTER (F01) ④↓→80 →ENTER (C02) →↓→1 →ENTER (F02) ⑤↓→ 90 →ENTER (C03) →↓→1 →ENTER (F03) ⑥NPV →10 →ENTER →↓→CPT 結果：NPV ≈-2.63 中文理解：先CLR WORK。成本打負號。I 放在NPV 工作表，不是I/Y 的TVM。頻率都 是1。

why_wrong.B: Adds the three inflows, subtracts 200, and skips discounting: 70+80+90-200 = 40.
why_wrong.C: Treats the discounted future inflows as additional outflows: -200 - 197.37 = -397.37, instead of -200 + 197.37.

QM-042.zh: 不規則現金流用CF 表算NPV，不要塞進TVM 的PMT。成本是流出，必須負 號。
QM-042.core_idea: Uneven cash flows: CF worksheet NPV, not TVM PMT

計算機操作｜BA II Plus
