已知：CF0=-200; C01=70; C02=80; C03=90; I=10
求：NPV
按鍵：
①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②200 →+/- →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→70 →ENTER (C01)
→↓→1 →ENTER (F01) ④↓→80 →ENTER (C02) →↓→1 →ENTER (F02) ⑤↓→
90 →ENTER (C03) →↓→1 →ENTER (F03) ⑥NPV →10 →ENTER →↓→CPT
結果：NPV ≈-2.63
中文理解：先CLR WORK。成本打負號。I 放在NPV 工作表，不是I/Y 的TVM。頻率都
是1。
QM-042.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-043.reasoning: Reasoning: Ordinary: first payment at t=1. PV = PMT × [1-(1+r)^-N]/r. Due is larger because every payment arrives one period sooner. Given: PMT=180; N=8; r=7%; ordinary (END); FV=0. Asked: PV of the ordinary annuity. Formula: PV = 180 × [1 −(1.07)−8]/0.07 Why this formula: Equal end-of-period payments →TVM, not CF. Eight undiscounted payments are $1,440; discounting must put PV below $1,440. Reasonableness check: PV_due would be 1,074.83 × 1.07 = 1,150, the BGN trap. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：TVM 已知：N=8; I/Y=7; PMT=180; FV=0; P/Y=1; END 求：PV 按鍵： ①2nd →CLR TVM ②Confirm END (screen must not show BGN) ③8 →N ④7 →I/Y ⑤ 180 →PMT ⑥0 →FV ⑦CPT →PV 結果：PV = -1,074.83 中文理解：PMT 正號表示你收取年金，PV 為負表示今天要付出的買價。用完確認沒停在 BGN。

why_wrong.A: Sums $180 × 8 without discounting.
why_wrong.C: Computes the annuity-due PV (ordinary × 1.07).

QM-043.zh: 期末年金第一筆在t=1。若誤開BGN，現值會乘上1.07 偏大。不要把180×8 當 現值。
QM-043.core_idea: Ordinary annuity: first cash flow at t=1 (END)
QM-043.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：TVM
已知：N=8; I/Y=7; PMT=180; FV=0; P/Y=1; END
求：PV
按鍵：
①2nd →CLR TVM ②Confirm END (screen must not show BGN) ③8 →N ④7 →I/Y ⑤
180 →PMT ⑥0 →FV ⑦CPT →PV
結果：PV = -1,074.83
中文理解：PMT 正號表示你收取年金，PV 為負表示今天要付出的買價。用完確認沒停在
BGN。
QM-043.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-044.reasoning: Reasoning: Every due payment arrives one period sooner, so PV_due = PV_ordinary × (1+r). FV_due is also larger, not smaller. Given: PV_ordinary = 1074.83; r = 7%. Asked: PV of the annuity due. Formula: PVdue = PVord × 1.07 Why this formula: Due stream is the ordinary stream shifted one period earlier. BGN raises PV. After the problem, restore END. Reasonableness check: Due PV must exceed ordinary PV. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：TVM (BGN) 已知：Same N, I/Y, PMT, FV as ordinary 求：PV 按鍵： ①2nd →BGN →2nd →SET (BGN on) →2nd →QUIT ②CPT →PV ③Then 2nd → BGN →2nd →SET →2nd →QUIT to restore END 結果：PV = -1150.07 中文理解：BGN 把每筆提早一期。算完一定改回END，否則下一題普通年金會全錯。

why_wrong.A: Divides ordinary PV by 1.07, reversing the due adjustment.
why_wrong.B: Leaves the ordinary PV unchanged.

QM-044.zh: 期初年金每筆早到一期，現值與終值都比較大。轉換是乘(1+r)，不是除。
QM-044.core_idea: Annuity due PV = ordinary PV × (1+periodic rate); BGN does not shrink FV
QM-044.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：TVM (BGN)
已知：Same N, I/Y, PMT, FV as ordinary
求：PV
按鍵：
①2nd →BGN →2nd →SET (BGN on) →2nd →QUIT ②CPT →PV ③Then 2nd →
BGN →2nd →SET →2nd →QUIT to restore END
結果：PV = -1150.07
中文理解：BGN 把每筆提早一期。算完一定改回END，否則下一題普通年金會全錯。
QM-044.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-045.reasoning: Reasoning: r_s must be the rate per payment period: 9%/12 = 0.75%. PV = 25 / 0.0075 = 3,333. If the quote is annual and payments are m times per year, use r_s/m. Given: Monthly PMT = $25; annual rate 9% with monthly periodicity. Asked: PV of the perpetuity. Formula: PV = 25/(0.09/12) Variables: r_s = discount rate per payment period. Why this formula: Infinite level stream; N→∞collapses the annuity formula to PMT/r. A 0.75% monthly yield on $3,333 produces $25 per month forever. Reasonableness check: 25 × 12 = 300 per year; 300 / 0.09 = 3,333, the same answer with annualized PMT and annual r. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Uses 25 / (0.09/12) but then multiplies by 12/13 or otherwise scales to $3,000.
why_wrong.C: Uses annual 9% on a monthly $25: 25/0.09 = 278.

QM-045.zh: 永續年金分母是「每一期」折現率。月付就要用9%/12=0.75%，不是拿年利率去 除月付款。
QM-045.core_idea: Perpetuity PV = PMT / r_s using the rate per payment period
QM-045.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-046.reasoning: Reasoning: r = (FV/PV)^1/N - 1. On the calculator, PV is negative (outflow) and FV positive (inflow). Given: PV = 1,800 outflow; FV = 2,650; N = 5; PMT = 0. Asked: I/Y (annual compound rate). Formula: r = (2650/1800)1/5 −1 Why this formula: One initial outlay, one terminal inflow, equal periods. Linear 9.44% overstates compound growth. Reasonableness check: 1.08045 ≈1.472, matching 2,650/1,800. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：TVM 已知：N=5; PV=-1,800; PMT=0; FV=2,650 求：I/Y 按鍵： ①2nd →CLR TVM ②5 →N ③1800 →+/- →PV ④0 →PMT ⑤2650 →FV ⑥CPT →I/Y 結果：I/Y = 8.04 中文理解：今天投入是流出，PV 打負號；五年後收回是流入，FV 打正號。兩邊都正號計算 機解不出I/Y。

why_wrong.A: Uses linear / arithmetic growth: (2650-1800)/1800/5.
why_wrong.C: Reports the five-year HPR without annualizing.

QM-046.zh: 複利年利率是開N 次方，不是把總漲幅除以年數。計算機PV 與FV 必須一正一 負。
QM-046.core_idea: TVM sign convention: PV and FV must have opposite signs to solve I/Y
QM-046.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：TVM
已知：N=5; PV=-1,800; PMT=0; FV=2,650
求：I/Y
按鍵：
①2nd →CLR TVM ②5 →N ③1800 →+/- →PV ④0 →PMT ⑤2650 →FV ⑥CPT
→I/Y
結果：I/Y = 8.04
中文理解：今天投入是流出，PV 打負號；五年後收回是流入，FV 打正號。兩邊都正號計算
機解不出I/Y。
QM-046.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-047.reasoning: Reasoning: N = ln(FV/PV) / ln(1+r). CLR TVM; opposite signs on PV and FV. Given: PV=5,000; FV=8,000; I/Y=6; PMT=0. Asked: N. Formula: N = ln(8000/5000)/ ln(1.06) Why this formula: Compound growth; solve the exponent. About eight years of 6% turns 5,000 into 8,000; linear 10 years is too long. Reasonableness check: 5,000 × 1.068 = 7,969, just shy of 8,000. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：TVM 已知：I/Y=6; PV=-5,000; PMT=0; FV=8,000 求：N 按鍵： ①2nd →CLR TVM ②6 →I/Y ③5000 →+/- →PV ④0 →PMT ⑤8000 →FV ⑥CPT →N 結果：N = 8.07 中文理解：PV 負、FV 正。P/Y=1，N 就是年數。

why_wrong.A: Uses linear years: 60%/6% = 10.
why_wrong.C: Divides ln(FV/PV) by r instead of ln(1+r).

QM-047.zh: 求年數用ln(FV/PV)/ln(1+r)，不是總漲幅除以利率。
QM-047.core_idea: Solve TVM for N when PV, FV, and I/Y are known
QM-047.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：TVM
已知：I/Y=6; PV=-5,000; PMT=0; FV=8,000
求：N
按鍵：
①2nd →CLR TVM ②6 →I/Y ③5000 →+/- →PV ④0 →PMT ⑤8000 →FV ⑥CPT
→N
結果：N = 8.07
中文理解：PV 負、FV 正。P/Y=1，N 就是年數。
QM-047.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-048.reasoning: Reasoning: Ordinary annuity: CPT PMT after N, I/Y, PV, FV=0. END mode. Given: PV=10,000; N=5; I/Y=8; FV=0; END. Asked: PMT. Formula: PMT = 10000 /( [1 −1.08−5]/0.08 ) Why this formula: Level end-of-year payments amortize the loan. Five undiscounted 2,505 payments exceed 10,000 by the interest embedded in the annuity. Reasonableness check: 2,505 × 3.99271 ≈10,000. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：TVM 已知：N=5; I/Y=8; PV=10,000; FV=0; END 求：PMT 按鍵： ①2nd →CLR TVM ②Confirm END ③5 →N ④8 →I/Y ⑤10000 →PV ⑥0 →FV ⑦ CPT →PMT 結果：PMT = -2,504.56 中文理解：PV 正號表示你借入，PMT 為負表示你每期要付出去。符號必須相反。

why_wrong.B: Ignores interest and splits 10,000 into five parts.
why_wrong.C: Adds one year of interest on the original principal to a straight-line principal slice (interest-plus-principal, not annuity).

QM-048.zh: 五期期末還清10,000，每期不是2,000，因為前幾期有利息。用TVM 求PMT。
QM-048.core_idea: Solve TVM for the ordinary-annuity PMT that amortizes a present value
QM-048.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：TVM
已知：N=5; I/Y=8; PV=10,000; FV=0; END
求：PMT
按鍵：
①2nd →CLR TVM ②Confirm END ③5 →N ④8 →I/Y ⑤10000 →PV ⑥0 →FV ⑦
CPT →PMT
結果：PMT = -2,504.56
中文理解：PV 正號表示你借入，PMT 為負表示你每期要付出去。符號必須相反。
QM-048.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-049.reasoning: Reasoning: FV = PV(1+r)^N with PMT=0. CLR TVM; opposite signs. Given: PV=3,000; N=6; I/Y=5; PMT=0. Asked: FV. Formula: FV = 3000(1.05)6 Why this formula: Single compound growth path. Six years of compound 5% adds about $1,020, more than simple $900. Reasonableness check: Simple 3,900 is too low; 3,000×1.05×6=945 is not a future value. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：TVM 已知：N=6; I/Y=5; PV=-3,000; PMT=0 求：FV 按鍵： ①2nd →CLR TVM ②6 →N ③5 →I/Y ④3000 →+/- →PV ⑤0 →PMT ⑥CPT → FV 結果：FV = 4,020.29 中文理解：今天投入打負號，CPT FV 會是正的終值。

why_wrong.A: Uses simple interest: 3,000 + 3,000×5%×6.
why_wrong.C: Multiplies by

QM-049.zh: 單筆終值是PV(1+r)^N，不是單利，也不是1.05×6。
QM-049.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：TVM
已知：N=6; I/Y=5; PV=-3,000; PMT=0
求：FV
按鍵：
①2nd →CLR TVM ②6 →N ③5 →I/Y ④3000 →+/- →PV ⑤0 →PMT ⑥CPT →
FV
結果：FV = 4,020.29
中文理解：今天投入打負號，CPT FV 會是正的終值。
QM-049.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-050.reasoning: Reasoning: FV_ordinary = PMT × [(1+r)^N - 1]/r. FV_due is larger: every payment compounds one extra period. BGN does not shrink FV. Given: PMT=200; N=7; r=6%; END; PV=0. Asked: FV of the ordinary annuity. Formula: FV = 200[(1.06)7 −1]/0.06 Why this formula: Equal end-of-year deposits, value at the last payment date. Seven raw deposits are $1,400; interest adds about $279. Reasonableness check: Due FV = 1,678.77 × 1.06 = 1,779, the BGN trap. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：TVM 已知：N=7; I/Y=6; PV=0; PMT=200; END 求：FV 按鍵： ①2nd →CLR TVM ②Confirm END ③7 →N ④6 →I/Y ⑤0 →PV ⑥200 →PMT ⑦ CPT →FV 結果：FV = -1,678.77 中文理解：PMT 正表示存入，FV 為負是計算機的符號慣例（方向相反）。確認END。

why_wrong.A: Reports the due FV (ordinary × 1.06), as if BGN were left on.
why_wrong.C: Sums seven deposits with no interest.

QM-050.zh: 期末年金終值用公式或END 模式。BGN 會讓終值變大（再乘1.06），不是變小。
QM-050.core_idea: Ordinary-annuity FV; due FV is ordinary FV times (1+r), not smaller
QM-050.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：TVM
已知：N=7; I/Y=6; PV=0; PMT=200; END
求：FV
按鍵：
①2nd →CLR TVM ②Confirm END ③7 →N ④6 →I/Y ⑤0 →PV ⑥200 →PMT ⑦
CPT →FV
結果：FV = -1,678.77
中文理解：PMT 正表示存入，FV 為負是計算機的符號慣例（方向相反）。確認END。
QM-050.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-051.reasoning: Reasoning: PV_due = PV_ordinary × (1+periodic rate) and FV_due = FV_ordinary × (1+periodic rate). Both values rise. The due stream is worth more because every payment arrives one period sooner.

why_wrong.A: Reverses the timing effect on both values.
why_wrong.B: Correctly raises PV then wrongly cuts FV. Calculator BGN places FV one period after the last payment and can create that mix-up if the conversion formula is forgotten.

QM-051.zh: 期初年金現值與終值都比較高，都是ordinary 再乘(1+r)。不要以為終值會變小。
QM-051.core_idea: Annuity due has both a higher PV and a higher FV than the matching ordinary annuity
QM-051.exam_trap: BGN raises PV but is thought to cut FV
QM-051.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-052.reasoning: Reasoning: A constant dividend with no growth uses the perpetuity formula PV = D/r = 3.20/0.08 = 40. Given: D = 3.20 per year forever; r = 8%; first dividend in one year. Asked: PV. Formula: PV = 3.20/0.08 Why this formula: Level perpetuity; r_s is already the payment-period rate. An 8% yield on $40 is $3.20 per year forever. Reasonableness check: If the first dividend were today (due), PV would be 40 + 3.20, which the stem does not ask. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Multiplies 3.20 × 8 instead of dividing.
why_wrong.B: Reports one dividend, as if N=1 were a perpetuity.

QM-052.zh: 不成長的永續股利就是PMT/r。是相除不是相乘，也不是只算一期股利。
QM-052.core_idea: A constant dividend with no growth is a perpetuity: PV = D/r
QM-052.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-053.reasoning: Reasoning: IRR is the rate that sets NPV of the cash flows to zero. Uneven flows →CF →IRR, not TVM PMT. Given: CF0=-150; C01=40; C02=60; C03=80. Asked: IRR. Formula: 0 = −150 + 40/(1 + r) + 60/(1 + r)2 + 80/(1 + r)3 Why this formula: MWR / project IRR is the NPV=0 rate. NPV at 10% is slightly negative, so IRR sits a little below 10%. Reasonableness check: NPV(10%) = $-3.94 < 0 ⇒IRR < 10%, matching 8.66%. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：CF / IRR 已知：CF0=-150; C01=40; C02=60; C03=80 求：IRR 按鍵： ①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②150 →+/- →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→40 →ENTER →↓→ 1 →ENTER ④↓→60 →ENTER →↓→1 →ENTER ⑤↓→80 →ENTER →↓→1 → ENTER ⑥IRR →CPT 結果：IRR ≈8.66 中文理解：先CLR WORK。期初流出負號。三筆流入正號。不要把PMT 設成40。
QM-053.steps: ①Enter the four flows on the CF worksheet. ②Newton IRR = 8.66%. ③Check: NPV at that rate is approximately 0; NPV at 10% is $-3.94.

why_wrong.A: Reports a scaled NPV at 10% as if it were a rate.
why_wrong.C: Assumes IRR equals the 10% trial rate used to think about NPV.

QM-053.zh: 不規則現金流的IRR 用CF 表。不要把某個折現率下的NPV 當成IRR。
QM-053.core_idea: Account / project IRR from uneven flows is an MWR-style CF worksheet problem
QM-053.study_section: Time-Weighted versus Money-Weighted ｜時間加權與資金加權
QM-053.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：CF / IRR
已知：CF0=-150; C01=40; C02=60; C03=80
求：IRR
按鍵：
①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②150 →+/- →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→40 →ENTER →↓→
1 →ENTER ④↓→60 →ENTER →↓→1 →ENTER ⑤↓→80 →ENTER →↓→1 →
ENTER ⑥IRR →CPT
結果：IRR ≈8.66
中文理解：先CLR WORK。期初流出負號。三筆流入正號。不要把PMT 設成40。
QM-053.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-053.subtopic: 2.1.10 Time-Weighted versus Money-Weighted｜時間加權與資金加權

QM-054.reasoning: Reasoning: The market interest rate is the required return / discount rate / opportunity cost — the price of money for one period. Choosing the project means giving up 4.5%.

why_wrong.B: Sunk cost is money already spent; a yield still available is the opposite.
why_wrong.C: A market yield can be a nominal risk-free rate or can embed premia; it is not “default only” by definition.

QM-054.zh: 4.5% 是把錢鎖進專案所放棄的市場用途，就是機會成本。它不是沉沒成本，也不 自動等於違約溢酬。
QM-054.core_idea: Opportunity cost is the market price of committing capital now
QM-054.exam_trap: Treating a paid coupon as opportunity cost
QM-054.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-055.reasoning: Reasoning: Convert each quote before comparing. EAR_A = (1.055)2 - 1 = 11.30%. EAR_B = (1+0.108/12)^12 - 1 = 11.35%. Loan A is slightly cheaper. B’s lower stated rate is more than offset by monthly compounding. Given: A: 11.0% m=2; B: 10.8% m=12. Asked: Which loan has the lower EAR. Formula: EARA = (1.055)2 −1; EARB = (1 + 0.108/12)12 −1 Why this formula: Stated rates are not comparable across different m. B’s lower stated quote is more than offset by monthly compounding; A is still slightly cheaper. Reasonableness check: Both EARs exceed their stated quotes, as required when m>1. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：ICONV 已知：NOM = 11; C/Y = 2 求：EFF (EAR) 按鍵： ①2nd →ICONV ②11 →ENTER (NOM) ③↓→2 →ENTER (C/Y) ④↓→CPT (EFF) 結果：EFF = 11.30 中文理解：先算A 的EFF，再清掉重算B：NOM=10.8、C/Y=12。兩個EFF 才能比。

why_wrong.A: Compares compounding frequency without converting, or assumes fewer compounds always win.
why_wrong.C: Treats both stated rates as EARs.

QM-055.zh: 兩個報價都要先轉EAR 才能比。名目較低加上較密複利，不一定比較便宜。
QM-055.core_idea: Compare two stated quotes only after converting each to EAR
QM-055.study_section: Stated Rates and Effective Rates ｜名目利率與有效利率
QM-055.exam_trap: Treating the stated rate as already effective
QM-055.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：ICONV
已知：NOM = 11; C/Y = 2
求：EFF (EAR)
按鍵：
①2nd →ICONV ②11 →ENTER (NOM) ③↓→2 →ENTER (C/Y) ④↓→CPT (EFF)
結果：EFF = 11.30
中文理解：先算A 的EFF，再清掉重算B：NOM=10.8、C/Y=12。兩個EFF 才能比。
QM-055.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-055.subtopic: 2.1.3 Stated Rates and Effective Rates｜名目利率與有效利率

QM-056.reasoning: Reasoning: A parameter describes a population. The matching number computed from the observations you actually have is a sample statistic. n=40 does not turn the 40 points into the population unless the question says they are the entire population.

why_wrong.B: Denies that a sample mean is a statistic.
why_wrong.C: Calls any mean a parameter. A parameter describes the population; 40 observed months are a sample.

QM-056.zh: 手上這40 個觀測算出來的平均是樣本統計量，不是母體參數。n 大不代表它就是 母體。
QM-056.core_idea: A parameter describes a population; the matching sample number is a statistic
QM-056.study_section: Describing Return Distributions ｜報酬分配的描述
QM-056.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-056.subtopic: 2.2 Describing Return Distributions ｜報酬分配的描述

QM-057.reasoning: Reasoning: Trimmed: drop a stated percentage of the largest and smallest, then average what remains. Winsorized: keep n; replace each extreme with the nearest remaining value.

why_wrong.A: Swaps delete versus replace.
why_wrong.B: Invented a median distinction; both still average (replaced or remaining) values.

QM-057.zh: 截尾是刪掉兩端再平均（n 變少）；溫氏是把極端值改寫成最靠近的留下值（n 不 變）。
QM-057.core_idea: Trimmed mean drops extremes; winsorized mean replaces them and keeps n
QM-057.study_section: Describing Return Distributions ｜報酬分配的描述
QM-057.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-057.subtopic: 2.2 Describing Return Distributions ｜報酬分配的描述

QM-058.reasoning: Reasoning: Odd n=5: median is observation (5+1)/2 = 3rd ordered value = 6%. A data set has only one median. Given: Ordered: 2, 5, 6, 9, 15. Asked: Median. Formula: n = 5 ⇒3rd ordered value Why this formula: Middle of the ordered list. Half the observations are at or below 6% in the ordered list sense; the mean 7.4% is pulled by 15%. Reasonableness check: Mean > median, consistent with a long right tail in this tiny set. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Picks observation (n+1)/2 + 1, the 4th value.
why_wrong.C: Reports the arithmetic mean (2+5+6+9+15)/5 = 7.4%.

QM-058.zh: 奇數個：中位數是排序後第(n+1)/2 個。這裡是第3 個=6%，不是平均。
QM-058.core_idea: Odd-n median is observation (n+1)/2 of the ordered list
QM-058.study_section: Median and Mode ｜中位數與衆數
QM-058.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-058.subtopic: 2.2.1 Median and Mode｜中位數與眾數

QM-059.reasoning: Reasoning: Even n=6: average observations 6/2=3rd and (6+2)/2=4th: (8+11)/2 = 9.5. Still only one median. Given: Ordered n=6: 3, 4, 8, 11, 12, 20. Asked: Median. Formula: (8 + 11)/2 Why this formula: Even-n rule from the Study Book. The median is a central location, not the mean 9.67 pulled by 20. Reasonableness check: 9.5 sits between 8 and 11, as required. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Reports the arithmetic mean of all six (58/6 = 9.67).
why_wrong.C: Reports only the 3rd value (n/2) without averaging with the 4th.

QM-059.zh: 偶數個：中位數是第n/2 與第(n+2)/2 的平均，(8+11)/2=9.5，不是全部再平 均。
QM-059.core_idea: Even-n median averages observations n/2 and (n+2)/2
QM-059.study_section: Median and Mode ｜中位數與衆數
QM-059.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-059.subtopic: 2.2.1 Median and Mode｜中位數與眾數

QM-060.reasoning: Reasoning: The mode is the most frequent value. A set can be bimodal or trimodal; it still has only one mean and one median.

why_wrong.A: Denies that a median always exists as a central location in the ordered sample.
why_wrong.B: Extends two modes to two means and two medians.

QM-060.zh: 可以有兩個衆數，但均值與中位數各只有一個。
QM-060.core_idea: A set can be bimodal; it still has only one mean and one median
QM-060.study_section: Median and Mode ｜中位數與衆數
QM-060.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-060.subtopic: 2.2.1 Median and Mode｜中位數與眾數

QM-061.reasoning: Reasoning: Range = largest - smallest = 9 - (-3) = 12. It is the simplest width and an absolute dispersion measure. Given: -3, 1, 4, 9, 2. Asked: Range. Formula: 9 −(−3) Why this formula: Simplest absolute width. The sample spans 12 points; that says nothing yet about typical distance from the mean. Reasonableness check: 12 > any MAD or SD computed from the same five points, which is typical. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports the sample standard deviation (≈4.4%) and treats typical distance from the mean as if it were the range.
why_wrong.C: Reports the arithmetic mean (-3+1+4+9+2)/5 = 2.6.

QM-061.zh: 全距是最大減最小：9-(-3)=12，不是平均，也不是只看兩個正數。
QM-061.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-062.reasoning: Reasoning: MAD = (1/n) Σ |X_i - ¯X|. Deviations: 6, 0, 6. Average = 12/3 = 4%. MAD does not square and divides by n, not n-1. Given: 8%, 14%, 20%; mean = 14%. Asked: MAD. Formula: MAD = (6 + 0 + 6)/3 Why this formula: Absolute deviations, divided by n. Typical absolute miss is 4 points; SD will be larger because it squares first. Reasonableness check: MAD 4% < s 6%, as expected when large misses are squared in SD. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Reports the sum of squared deviations (36+0+36) and stops.
why_wrong.C: Reports the sample standard deviation (uses n-1 and squares): s = 6%.

QM-062.zh: MAD 用絕對偏差除以n，不平方。同一組數的樣本SD 是6%，不要拿去當 MAD。
QM-062.core_idea: MAD averages absolute deviations and divides by n
QM-062.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-063.reasoning: Reasoning: Squared deviations: 36+0+36=72. Sample variance s2 = 72/(3-1) = 36. Population variance would be 72/3 = 24. SD is the square root — a different object. Given: Sample 8%, 14%, 20%; mean = 14%. Asked: Sample variance. Formula: s2 = 72/(3 −1) Why this formula: Sample: divide by n-1, not n. Using n instead of n-1 understates sample variance (24 vs 36). Reasonableness check: s = 6; σ = √ 24 = 4.90. The question asked for variance, not SD. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Divides the sum of squares 72 by N=3 (population variance).
why_wrong.C: Reports the sample standard deviation instead of the variance.

QM-063.zh: 題目寫sample variance：平方和除以n-1=2，得到36。除以3 是母體方差；再開 根號才是SD。
QM-063.core_idea: Population variance divides by N; sample variance divides by n-1
QM-063.exam_trap: Sample vs population n vs n-1
QM-063.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-064.reasoning: Reasoning: s = √ [72/(3-1)] = √ 36 = 6%. On BA II Plus, DATA / 1-V: Sx is the sample SD; σx is the population SD. Given: Sample 8%, 14%, 20%. Asked: Sample standard deviation. Formula: s = √ 72/2 Why this formula: Asked for SD of a sample: n-1, then square root. If the question had said population, the answer would be 4.90%. The word sample selects Sx. Reasonableness check: Sx must exceed σx for the same points. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：DATA / STAT 已知：X01=8; X02=14; X03=20; 1-V 求：Sx 按鍵： ①2nd →DATA →2nd →CLR WORK ②8 →ENTER →↓↓(X01) ③14 →ENTER →↓↓ (X02) ④20 →ENTER (X03) ⑤2nd →STAT →1-V →ENTER ⑥↓to Sx 結果：Sx = 6 中文理解：DATA / 1-V 的Sx 已經除以n-1。σx 才是除以n 的總體SD。題目寫sample，要 Sx。
QM-064.steps: ①Mean = 14%. ②Sum of squares = 72. ③s2 = 36; s = 6%.

why_wrong.A: Uses the population SD √ (72/3) = 4.90%.
why_wrong.B: Stops at the sample variance 36.

QM-064.zh: sample 就要Sx（除以n-1 再開根）。螢幕上的σx 是除以n，對應誘答4.90%。不 要停在方差。
QM-064.core_idea: Sample standard deviation is the square root after dividing by n-1; STAT Sx not σx
QM-064.exam_trap: Sample vs population n vs n-1
QM-064.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：DATA / STAT
已知：X01=8; X02=14; X03=20; 1-V
求：Sx
按鍵：
①2nd →DATA →2nd →CLR WORK ②8 →ENTER →↓↓(X01) ③14 →ENTER →↓↓
(X02) ④20 →ENTER (X03) ⑤2nd →STAT →1-V →ENTER ⑥↓to Sx
結果：Sx = 6
中文理解：DATA / 1-V 的Sx 已經除以n-1。σx 才是除以n 的總體SD。題目寫sample，要
Sx。
QM-064.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-065.reasoning: Reasoning: Population: σ2 = 72/3 = 24; σ = √ 24 = 4.90%. Sample formulas are for a sample, not for a stated full population. Given: Population 8%, 14%, 20%. Asked: Population standard deviation. Formula: σ = √ 72/3 Why this formula: Full set →divide by N, then root. Same three points, different divisor, different SD. Read sample versus population first. Reasonableness check: 4.90% < 6.00%, the required direction when switching from n-1 to N. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Uses the sample SD (n-1).
why_wrong.C: Reports population variance 24 and never takes the square root.

QM-065.zh: 題目寫complete population：除以N=3 再開根，4.90%。6% 是樣本SD；24 還 停在方差。
QM-065.core_idea: If the three points are the entire population, divide by N and then take the root for SD
QM-065.exam_trap: Sample vs population n vs n-1
QM-065.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-066.reasoning: Reasoning: Mean = 14. Squared deviations 64+16+16+64=160. s2 = 160/(4-1) = 53.33. The square root is SD, not variance. Given: Sample 6, 10, 18, 22. Asked: Sample variance. Formula: s2 = 160/3 Why this formula: Sample divisor n-1. Population variance would be 40. Using n understates dispersion. Reasonableness check: s ≈7.30; the question did not ask for s. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports the sample SD √ (160/3) ≈7.30 instead of the variance.
why_wrong.B: Divides by n=4 (population variance = 40).

QM-066.zh: 四個樣本：平方和160 除以3，不是除以4。題目要variance，不要再開根號。
QM-066.core_idea: Another n versus n-1: four-point sample variance
QM-066.exam_trap: Sample vs population n vs n-1
QM-066.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-067.reasoning: Reasoning: Drop 12% and 9% (above the target). Distances from B: 3-4 = -1 and -6-4 = -10. Squares 1+100=101. Denominator is n-1 = 3 (full sample n=4, as with sample SD). Semideviation = √ (101/3) = 5.80%. Given: Returns 12%, 3%, -6%, 9%; B=4%; n=4. Asked: Target semideviation. Formula: √ [(3 −4)2 + (−6 −4)2]/(4 −1) Why this formula: Downside from a threshold, sample-style n-1. Only below-target outcomes feed the sum; the divisor still uses the full sample’s n-1. Reasonableness check: Larger than MAD-style because -6% is 10 points below B and is squared. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Divides by the full n=4 as if this were a population formula.
why_wrong.B: Divides by (number of bad outcomes - 1) = 1, or by 2 as if the subsample were the sample.

QM-067.zh: 只留≤目標的結果，距離用目標B 不是均值。分母仍是全樣本的n-1，不是「壞 結果個數」。
QM-067.core_idea: Target semideviation uses only outcomes at or below B, distance from B, and n-1
QM-067.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-068.reasoning: Reasoning: CV = s / ¯X is risk per unit of mean return. CV_P = 15/10 = 1.50; CV_Q = 7/7 = 1.00. Smaller CV is preferred. Given: P: mean 10%, s 15%. Q: mean 7%, s 7%. Asked: Preferred fund under CV. Formula: CVP = 15/10; CVQ = 7/7 Why this formula: Relative dispersion; different typical levels. Q has less risk per unit of mean, even though P’s raw mean is higher. Reasonableness check: Both CVs are positive; the ranking uses smaller-is-better. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Reverses the CV rule (smaller CV preferred) and misreads CV as a return-to-risk ratio in the wrong direction.
why_wrong.C: Ignores dispersion.

QM-068.zh: CV 是每一單位報酬要承擔的波動。較小的CV 較佳。P 的均值較高，但波動更 大，CV 反而較差。
QM-068.core_idea: CV = s / mean; smaller CV is preferred under the CV criterion
QM-068.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-069.reasoning: Reasoning: Squaring removes signs and penalizes large misses more than MAD. SD is the square root of variance, back in the same units as the data. CV, not SD, is relative dispersion.

why_wrong.A: CV is the relative measure (s / mean). Range, MAD, variance, and SD are absolute.
why_wrong.B: Inverts the n versus n-1 story and the size ranking. Sample SD uses n-1 after squaring; it is not “always smaller than MAD.”

QM-069.zh: SD 先平方，大偏差被放大；開根後單位回到資料本身。相對離散是CV=s/均值， 不是SD。
QM-069.core_idea: MAD and SD both measure distance from the mean; SD squares first so large misses are amplified
QM-069.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-070.reasoning: Reasoning: Extreme values pull the mean the most. A long right tail slides the mean right of the median, which sits right of the mode: positive (right) skew.

why_wrong.A: Confuses tail side (skew) with tail weight (kurtosis). A symmetric normal has equal mean, median, and mode.
why_wrong.C: Uses the negative-skew order.

QM-070.zh: 右尾被拉開，均值被極端正報酬往右拖：衆數< 中位數< 均值。那是偏態，不是 峰度。
QM-070.core_idea: Positive (right) skew: long right tail; mode < median < mean
QM-070.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-071.reasoning: Reasoning: Pull the left tail and the order is mean < median < mode. Frequent small gains and a few extreme losses is the book’s negative-skew return pattern. Kurtosis asks how heavy both tails are, not which side the disasters sit on.

why_wrong.A: Confuses tail weight (kurtosis) with tail side. Platykurtic means thin tails, which is not “occasional large drawdowns.”
why_wrong.B: Reads “mostly up months” as positive skew. Positive skew is a long right tail of large upside, not a high win count.

QM-071.zh: 經常小賺、偶爾大虧是左偏：均值被大虧往左拖。不要因為「多數月份是正的」就 選正偏；那是尾在哪一側的問題，不是勝率。
QM-071.core_idea: Frequent modest gains with a few severe losses is negative (left) skew
QM-071.exam_trap: Reading a high win-count as positive skew
QM-071.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-072.reasoning: Reasoning: Investors prefer positive skew, other things equal, because the long tail is on the upside.

why_wrong.A: Platykurtic means kurtosis < 3 (thin tails). Excess kurtosis well above zero is leptokurtic, not platykurtic.
why_wrong.B: Chooses the left-tail pattern the book associates with occasional disasters.

QM-072.zh: 其他條件相同，投資人偏好正偏：極端值在上漲那一側。
QM-072.core_idea: Investors prefer positive skew, other things equal
QM-072.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-073.reasoning: Reasoning: A normal is mesokurtic: kurtosis = 3, excess kurtosis = 0. Excess kurtosis is kurtosis minus 3: 4.20 - 3 = 1.20. The distribution is leptokurtic (fat-tailed). Given: Kurtosis = 4.20. Asked: Excess kurtosis. Formula: 4.20 −3 Why this formula: Normal benchmark is 3. Positive excess kurtosis means fatter tails than normal — more chance of extremes. Reasonableness check: 4.20 > 3 ⇒leptokurtic, consistent with excess > 0. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Subtracts 3 in the wrong direction: 3 - 4.20.
why_wrong.C: Reports kurtosis itself, as if excess were the same number.

QM-073.zh: 超額峰度= 峰度- 3。4.20 - 3 = 1.20，是高峰厚尾，不是把4.20 直接當超額。
QM-073.core_idea: Excess kurtosis = kurtosis - 3; normal is mesokurtic with excess 0
QM-073.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-074.reasoning: Reasoning: Leptokurtic (fat-tailed): kurtosis > 3, higher peak, more probability in the extreme tails. Equity returns are typically leptokurtic. Fatter tails mean a higher chance of extreme outcomes — more risk in a risk-management sense.

why_wrong.B: A normal is mesokurtic and symmetric; the book says equity returns are typically leptokurtic, not that every sample is normal.
why_wrong.C: Reverses fat versus thin tails for equities.

QM-074.zh: 股票報酬通常是高峰厚尾（峰度>3）。厚尾代表極端結果機率更高，風險管理上 更危險。
QM-074.core_idea: Leptokurtic: kurtosis > 3, higher peak, more probability in the extreme tails
QM-074.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-075.reasoning: Reasoning: Platykurtic (thin-tailed): kurtosis < 3, lower peak, less mass in the extremes. Skew is a separate shape fact.

why_wrong.A: Kurtosis is tail weight on both sides, not the sign of skew.
why_wrong.C: Describes leptokurtic.

QM-075.zh: 低峰薄尾：峰度< 3，極端值比較少。不是左偏的同義詞。
QM-075.core_idea: Platykurtic means thin tails (kurtosis < 3), not “more extreme losses”
QM-075.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-076.reasoning: Reasoning: L_40 = (5+1)(0.40) = 2.4. Integer part 2, fraction 0.4. P_40 = 7 + 0.4(9-7) = 7.8. Given: Ordered n=5: 4, 7, 9, 13, 16; y=40. Asked: 40th percentile. Formula: L40 = 6 × 0.40 = 2.4; P40 = 7 + 0.4(9 −7) Why this formula: Book’s linear-interpolation percentile. 40% of the way from the 2nd to the 3rd ordered value. Reasonableness check: 7.8 lies between 7 and 9. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports the 2nd observation because L_40 is nearer 2 than 3, and skips interpolation.
why_wrong.B: Uses L_y = n×y/100 = 2.0, then interpolates from 7 toward 9 with the wrong position.

QM-076.zh: 位置是(n+1)× 百分位，不是n× 百分位。2.4 表示從第2 個往第3 個走40%： 7+0.4×2=7.8。
QM-076.core_idea: Percentile by linear interpolation: L_y = (n+1) y/100
QM-076.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-077.reasoning: Reasoning: IQR = Q3 - Q1 = 17 - 5 = 12, the width of the middle half. In a box-and-whisker plot, the middle of the box is the median — a different object. Given: Q1=5; Q3=17. Asked: IQR. Formula: 17 −5 Why this formula: Middle-half width. Half the ordered sample lies in an interval 12 units wide. Reasonableness check: IQR is nonnegative; 12 = 17-5. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Adds Q1+Q3.
why_wrong.C: Averages Q1 and Q3: (5+17)/2 = 11, which is a central location, not a width.

QM-077.zh: 四分位距是寬度Q3-Q1，不是兩個四分位的平均，也不是相加。
QM-077.core_idea: IQR = Q3 - Q1, the width of the middle half
QM-077.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-078.reasoning: Reasoning: Extreme values pull the mean the most, the median less, and the mode not at all. That is why a right-tail pull produces mode < median < mean.

why_wrong.A: The three locations do not shift in lockstep; that is why skew has an order.
why_wrong.C: A single extreme becomes the mode only if it repeats; one outlier is not “most frequent.”

QM-078.zh: 極端值拉均值最多、中位數次之、衆數幾乎不動。這就是正偏順序的來源。
QM-078.core_idea: Extremes pull the mean the most, the median less, and the mode not at all
QM-078.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-079.reasoning: Reasoning: Sample variance = 180/5 = 36. Sample SD = √ 36 = 6. The book warns that if the question asks for standard deviation, taking the square root is the step that is easy to skip. Given: Sum of squares = 180; n=6; asked for sample SD. Asked: Identify the 36 error and the correct SD. Formula: s = √ 180/5 Why this formula: n-1 then square root. Always read variance versus SD after choosing n versus n-1. Reasonableness check: 6 = √ 36. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Population variance would be 30, which is not what the candidate reported.
why_wrong.C: 36 is already in the units of a variance of percent-squared (or raw units squared), not an SD.

QM-079.zh: 樣本方差是36，樣本標準差是6。題目要SD 卻停在方差，是最常見的漏開根號。
QM-079.core_idea: If the question asks for standard deviation, taking the square root is the step that is easy to skip
QM-079.exam_trap: Sample vs population n vs n-1
QM-079.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-080.reasoning: Reasoning: Probabilities lie in [0,1]. Any collection of events that is both mutually exclusive and exhaustive has probabilities that sum to 1.

why_wrong.A: Exhaustive does not require each probability > 1/3.
why_wrong.C: Mutual exclusion removes the joint; it does not make probabilities sum to more than 1.

QM-080.zh: 互斥且窮盡：各概率在0 到1，加總等於1。
QM-080.core_idea: Probabilities lie in [0,1]; mutually exclusive and exhaustive events sum to 1
QM-080.study_section: Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations ｜機率樹與條件期望
QM-080.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-080.subtopic: 2.3 Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations ｜機率樹與條件期望

QM-081.reasoning: Reasoning: Multiplication rule: P(AB) = P(A|B) P(B) = 0.35 × 0.20 = 0.07. The factor P(A|B) is conditional probability. Given: P(recession)=0.20; P(default|recession)=0.35. Asked: Joint probability. Formula: P(rec ∩def) = 0.35 × 0.20 Why this formula: Definition of conditional probability rearranged. Only 7% of paths are “recession and default.” Reasonableness check: Joint must be ≤each of 0.20 and 0.35. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
QM-081.zh: 聯合概率是相乘：條件概率× 情境概率。不要把0.20 與0.35 相加。
QM-081.study_section: Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations ｜機率樹與條件期望
QM-081.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-081.subtopic: 2.3 Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations ｜機率樹與條件期望

QM-082.reasoning: Reasoning: P(A or B) = 0.40+0.30-0.10 = 0.60. If A and B cannot both occur, the joint term is zero and the sum is 0.70. Given: P(A)=0.40; P(B)=0.30; P(AB)=0.10. Asked: P(A or B). Formula: 0.40 + 0.30 −0.10 Why this formula: Inclusion-exclusion. The 0.10 overlap would be counted twice if you only added. Reasonableness check: 0.60 ≥each standalone probability and ≤1. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Adds 0.40+0.30 and forgets to subtract the joint — correct only if A and B cannot both occur.
why_wrong.B: Multiplies 0.40×0.30, which is the independence joint, not P(A or B).

QM-082.zh: 至少發生一個是相加再減掉重疊。互斥才可以不減。0.40×0.30 是獨立假設下的聯 合，不是聯集。
QM-082.core_idea: Addition rule: P(A or B) = P(A)+P(B)-P(AB); drop the joint only if they cannot both occur
QM-082.study_section: Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations ｜機率樹與條件期望
QM-082.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-082.subtopic: 2.3 Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations ｜機率樹與條件期望

QM-083.reasoning: Reasoning: E(X) = 0.20(12)+0.50(5)+0.30(-4) = 2.4+2.5-1.2 = 3.70. Given: Payoffs (12, 5, -4) with probabilities (0.20, 0.50, 0.30). Asked: E(X). Formula: 0.20(12) + 0.50(5) + 0.30(−4) Why this formula: Probability-weighted mean. The left tail of -4 pulls E(X) below the 5 modal outcome. Reasonableness check: 3.70 lies between -4 and 12. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports the middle payoff.
why_wrong.B: Equal-weights the three payoffs: (12+5-4)/3 = 4.33.

QM-083.zh: 期望值是概率加權，不是三種結果各1/3。
QM-083.core_idea: Expected value is a probability-weighted mean
QM-083.study_section: Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations ｜機率樹與條件期望
QM-083.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-083.subtopic: 2.3 Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations ｜機率樹與條件期望

QM-084.reasoning: Reasoning: E(X)=4. σ2(X)=E[(X-E(X))2]=0.40(6)2+0.60(-4)2=14.4+9.6=24. Variance is expected squared deviation from that mean. Given: P(X=10)=0.40; P(X=0)=0.60. Asked: Var(X). Formula: 0.40(10 −4)2 + 0.60(0 −4)2 Why this formula: Definition of variance as expected squared deviation. SD = √ 24 = 4.90, which is in X’s units; 24 is not. Reasonableness check: Var must be positive and is in squared units. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Uses 0.40×102 + 0.60×0 and forgets to center on E(X), or reports E(X2) as if it were variance.
why_wrong.B: Reports E(X)=4 and stops, or reports SD without squaring.

QM-084.zh: 先算期望4，再對期望取平方偏差的期望。不要把E(X) 或E(X2) 當成方差。
QM-084.core_idea: Variance is the expected squared deviation from E(X)
QM-084.study_section: Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations ｜機率樹與條件期望
QM-084.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-084.subtopic: 2.3 Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations ｜機率樹與條件期望

QM-085.reasoning: Reasoning: E(X|S)=Σ P(X_i|S) X_i = 0.40(2.50)+0.60(1.90) = 1.00+1.14 = 2.14. These weights are conditional on boom, not unconditional. Given: Given boom: 2.50 w.p. 0.40, 1.90 w.p. 0.60. Asked: E(EPS|boom). Formula: 0.40(2.50) + 0.60(1.90) Why this formula: Conditional probability-weighted mean. Given boom, typical EPS is 2.14, closer to 1.90 because that branch is more likely. Reasonableness check: 2.14 lies between 1.90 and 2.50. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Equal-weights 2.50 and 1.90.
why_wrong.C: Reports only the more probable outcome.

QM-085.zh: 條件期望只用「景氣好」底下的條件概率加權，不是兩結果各一半。
QM-085.core_idea: Conditional expected value uses probabilities given that scenario S has occurred
QM-085.study_section: Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations ｜機率樹與條件期望
QM-085.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-085.subtopic: 2.3 Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations ｜機率樹與條件期望

QM-086.reasoning: Reasoning: E(X)=E(X|S)P(S)+E(X|S^c)P(S^c)=2.16×0.55+1.00×0.45=1.188+0.450=1.638. A tree is this rule drawn as branches. Given: P(boom)=0.55; P(slump)=0.45; E(EPS|boom)=2.16; E(EPS|slump)=1.00. Asked: Unconditional E(EPS). Formula: 2.16 × 0.55 + 1.00 × 0.45 Why this formula: Total probability rule. The 45% slump chance pulls expected EPS well below the boom-only 2.16. Reasonableness check: 1.64 lies between 1.00 and 2.16, closer to boom because P(boom)>0.5. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Stops at the slump conditional expectation.
why_wrong.C: Stops at the boom conditional expectation.

QM-086.zh: 無條件期望要把各情境的條件期望再按情境概率加權。停在boom 或slump 都少 做一步。
QM-086.core_idea: Total probability rule rebuilds the unconditional expectation from exhaustive scenarios
QM-086.study_section: Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations ｜機率樹與條件期望
QM-086.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-086.subtopic: 2.3 Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations ｜機率樹與條件期望

QM-087.reasoning: Reasoning: Joints: 0.22, 0.33, 0.225, 0.225. E(EPS)=0.22(2.40)+0.33(2.00)+0.225(1.20)+0.225(0.80)=1.638. Same as 2.16×0.55+1.00×0.45. Nodes are conditional, not independent. Given: Boom 0.55 with (2.40, 0.40) and (2.00, 0.60); slump 0.45 with (1.20, 0.50) and (0.80, 0.50). Asked: Unconditional E(EPS). Formula: 0.22(2.40) + 0.33(2.00) + 0.225(1.20) + 0.225(0.80) Why this formula: Tree: multiply along a path; weight the leaves. Most probability mass is on boom outcomes, but slump leaves still pull the mean down. Reasonableness check: Joints sum to 1.00; mean between 0.80 and 2.40. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Reports E(EPS|slump)=1.00 and stops.
why_wrong.C: Reports E(EPS|boom)=0.40(2.40)+0.60(2.00)=2.16 and stops.

QM-087.zh: 沿路徑相乘得聯合概率，再對葉節點加權。不要停在單一情境的條件期望。
QM-087.core_idea: Multiply along a path for a joint; work backward from the leaves for today’s expected value
QM-087.study_section: Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations ｜機率樹與條件期望
QM-087.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-087.subtopic: 2.3 Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations ｜機率樹與條件期望

QM-088.reasoning: Reasoning: At each node the branches are mutually exclusive and exhaustive, but they are conditional, not independent. Multiply along a path to get a joint probability.

why_wrong.B: Summing to 1 at a node is exhaustiveness given that node, not independence of the two stages.
why_wrong.C: The numbers on the second-stage branches are P(EPS|boom), not joints. Joints are products along a path.

QM-088.zh: 節點上的0.40、0.60 是條件概率，加總為1 只代表在「景氣好」之下窮盡，不是 獨立，也還不是聯合概率。
QM-088.core_idea: Branches at a node are mutually exclusive and exhaustive, but they are conditional, not independent
QM-088.study_section: Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations ｜機率樹與條件期望
QM-088.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-088.subtopic: 2.3 Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations ｜機率樹與條件期望

QM-089.reasoning: Reasoning: P(beat)=0.70×0.30+0.20×0.70=0.35. P(skilled|beat)=(0.70×0.30)/0.35=60%. The denominator is the unconditional probability of the information from the total probability rule. Given: P(skilled)=0.30; P(beat|skilled)=0.70; P(beat|other)=0.20. Asked: P(skilled|beat). Formula: P(skilled | beat) = (0.70 × 0.30)/0.35 Why this formula: Bayes: prior × likelihood, scaled by P(data). Beating the benchmark doubles the 30% prior to 60%, but does not make skill certain. Reasonableness check: Posterior must exceed the prior because beating is more common for skilled managers. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports the likelihood P(beat|skilled) instead of the posterior.
why_wrong.C: Leaves the prior unupdated.

QM-089.zh: 分母是「所有人贏過指標」的總概率0.35。不要把先驗30% 原封不動，也不要把 70% 的likelihood 當成後驗。
QM-089.core_idea: Bayes updates a prior after new information: P(A|B)=P(B|A)P(A)/P(B)
QM-089.exam_trap: Reporting the likelihood as the posterior
QM-089.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-090.reasoning: Reasoning: P(signal)=0.90×0.15+0.12×0.85=0.135+0.102=0.237. P(default|signal)=0.135/0.237=56.96% ≈57%. The news more than triples the prior, but most signals still come from the much larger non-default group. A small prior plus a strong signal need not produce a posterior near 1. Given: P(D)=0.15; P(S|D)=0.90; P(S|D^c)=0.12. Asked: P(D|S). Formula: (0.90 × 0.15)/(0.90 × 0.15 + 0.12 × 0.85) Why this formula: Bayes with total-probability denominator. The signal is informative, not decisive. Most bonds do not default, so they still generate many signals. Reasonableness check: 57% is between 15% and 90%, as a posterior should be when the signal is positive but the prior is modest. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports P(signal|default)=90%.
why_wrong.B: Leaves the 15% prior unupdated.

QM-090.zh: 先驗只有15%，即使訊號很強，後驗大約57%，不是90%。分母要加進「沒違約 也亮燈」的那一大群。
QM-090.core_idea: A strong signal need not push the posterior near 1 if the prior is small
QM-090.exam_trap: Reporting the likelihood as the posterior
QM-090.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-091.reasoning: Reasoning: Bayes is not “the probability of the information itself.” It rewrites P(A|B). The numerator is the path’s joint; the denominator is all paths that can produce B.

why_wrong.A: Equates likelihood and posterior — the likelihood/posterior reversal.
why_wrong.B: Reverses what Bayes is for: A is the event you care about, B is the information.

QM-091.zh: 85% 是「若為詐欺，燈會亮」的likelihood，不是「燈亮了就是詐欺」的後驗。還 要先驗與P(燈亮)。
QM-091.core_idea: P(B|A) is not P(A|B); the update revises A after seeing B
QM-091.exam_trap: Reporting the likelihood as the posterior
QM-091.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-092.reasoning: Reasoning: When the distribution is given, variance is the expected squared deviation from E(X). The sample formula with n-1 is for observations you actually have, not for a fully specified distribution.

why_wrong.A: Confuses a location measure with a dispersion measure.
why_wrong.B: Applies the sample n-1 recipe to a stated probability distribution.

QM-092.zh: 題目若直接給概率分布，方差用期望平方偏差。n-1 是樣本公式，不是分布公式。
QM-092.core_idea: Variance of a random variable is not the sample s2 formula unless the question gives a sample
QM-092.study_section: Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations ｜機率樹與條件期望
QM-092.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-093.reasoning: Reasoning: E(R_X)=7.20%, E(R_Y)=4.40%. Cov=0.40(12-7.2)(8-4.4)+0.60(4-7.2)(2- 4.4)=0.40(4.8)(3.6)+0.60(-3.2)(-2.4)=11.52 (in %-point squared). Covariance shows direction of linear association. Given: P(12%,8%)=0.40; P(4%,2%)=0.60. Asked: Cov(R_X, R_Y) in percentage-point squared. Formula: 0.40(12 −7.2)(8 −4.4) + 0.60(4 −7.2)(2 −4.4) Why this formula: Joint-table covariance. Both points sit on the same side of their means together, so covariance is positive. Reasonableness check: Positive cov matches the two points (high,high) and (low,low). 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Assumes two-point support that always moves together must have zero covariance.
why_wrong.C: Multiplies the two expected returns and calls that covariance.

QM-093.zh: 先算兩個期望，再把離均差相乘用聯合概率加權。不是把兩個期望相乘，更不是 因為只有兩點就說協方差為0。
QM-093.core_idea: Covariance from a joint table is the probability-weighted product of deviations
QM-093.study_section: Covariance and Correlation ｜協方差與相關係數
QM-093.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-093.subtopic: 2.4.1 Covariance and Correlation｜協方差與相關係數

QM-094.reasoning: Reasoning: ρ = Cov/(σ_X σ_Y). If covariance is positive, correlation is positive. Correlation, not raw covariance, is the comparable strength measure. Given: Cov=11.52; σ_X=3.919%; σ_Y=2.939%. Asked: Correlation. Formula: ρ = 11.52/(σXσY ) Why this formula: Unit-free rescaling of covariance. The two-point (high,high)/(low,low) support is perfectly positively linearly associated, so ρ=1. Reasonableness check: ρ must lie in [-1,1]; 1 is attainable when points lie on a straight line. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Assumes two assets that sometimes differ must be uncorrelated.
why_wrong.C: Reports covariance and calls it correlation.

QM-094.zh: 相關是協方差除以兩個SD，壓進-1 到1。不要直接把11.52 當相關係數。
QM-094.study_section: Covariance and Correlation ｜協方差與相關係數
QM-094.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-094.subtopic: 2.4.1 Covariance and Correlation｜協方差與相關係數

QM-095.reasoning: Reasoning: ρ=1: perfect positive linear association, no risk reduction from combining the two assets. With ρ=1, σ_P equals the weighted average of the SDs.

why_wrong.B: ρ=1 is attainable (perfect positive linear association).
why_wrong.C: Confuses ρ=1 with ρ=-1.

QM-095.zh: ρ=1 完全正線性相關，沒有分散效果，組合SD 就是兩個SD 的加權平均。能降 到0 的是ρ=-1。
QM-095.core_idea: ρ=1: perfect positive linear association, no risk reduction from combining the two assets
QM-095.study_section: Covariance and Correlation ｜協方差與相關係數
QM-095.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-095.subtopic: 2.4.1 Covariance and Correlation｜協方差與相關係數

QM-096.reasoning: Reasoning: Cov=0.30×0.18×0.12=0.00648. σ_P2=0.552(0.18)2+0.452(0.12)2+2(0.55)(0.45)(0.00648)=0.01592 σ_P=12.62%. Given: w=(0.55,0.45); σ=(18%,12%); ρ=0.30. Asked: Portfolio SD. Formula: 0.552(0.18)2 + 0.452(0.12)2 + 2(0.55)(0.45)(0.00648) Why this formula: Two-asset variance with a covariance term. 0.30 correlation trims SD below the 15.3% ρ=1 value but not all the way to the 11.3% ρ=0 value. Reasonableness check: Ordering: ρ=-1 (4.50%) < ρ=0 (11.28%) < ρ=0.30 (12.62%) < ρ=1 (15.30%). 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Uses ρ=1: the weighted average of the SDs.
why_wrong.C: Drops the covariance term (treats ρ=0).

QM-096.zh: 組合變異數不是權重平均，一定有2w1w2Cov。丟掉協方差項就是當ρ=0；加權 平均SD 是ρ=1。
QM-096.core_idea: Two-asset portfolio variance includes the covariance term 2 w1 w2 ρ σ1 σ2
QM-096.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-097.reasoning: Reasoning: σ_P = √ (w12 σ12 + w22 σ22) = √ (0.009801+0.002916) = 11.28%. On a portfolio question, ρ=0 does mean the covariance term drops out. That calculation does not license the stronger claim that the two returns are independent. Given: w=(0.55,0.45); σ=(18%,12%); ρ=0. Asked: Portfolio SD. Formula: √ 0.552(0.18)2 + 0.452(0.12)2 Why this formula: Zero correlation zeroes the cross term. Diversification versus ρ=1 is real. Independence is a different, stronger claim. Reasonableness check: 11.28% < 15.30% (the ρ=1 value). 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Treats ρ=0 as a reason to refuse the variance formula. ρ=0 drops the covariance term; the SD is still defined.
why_wrong.C: Uses the ρ=1 weighted-average SD.

QM-097.zh: ρ=0 時協方差項消失，組合SD 仍算得出來。那只是風險公式，不是獨立的證明。
QM-097.core_idea: With ρ=0 the covariance term drops out; that is a diversification statement, not independence
QM-097.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-098.reasoning: Reasoning: |w1 σ1 - w2 σ2| = |0.55×18 - 0.45×12| = |9.90-5.40| = 4.50%. Perfect negative linear association lets SD be driven down; it equals zero only at the specific mix that offsets the two volatility contributions. Given: w=(0.55,0.45); σ=(18%,12%); ρ=-1. Asked: Portfolio SD. Formula: |0.55 × 0.18 −0.45 × 0.12| Why this formula: Perfect negative linear association. This particular mix is not the zero-risk mix; 4.5% is still far below the ρ=1 value of 15.3%. Reasonableness check: 4.5% < 11.3% (ρ=0) < 15.3% (ρ=1). 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Uses the ρ=1 weighted average.
why_wrong.C: Assumes any ρ=-1 portfolio is risk-free. A zero-risk mix exists in the two-asset case, but not at every weight.

QM-098.zh: ρ=-1 時組合SD 是兩個加權波動的差的絕對值，這裡是4.5%，不是任何權重都是 0。
QM-098.core_idea: ρ=-1 can drive two-asset portfolio SD down, all the way to a risk-free mix
QM-098.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-099.reasoning: Reasoning: N variance terms (i=j) and N(N-1)/2 distinct covariances: 30×29/2=435. When N is large, average covariance dominates because the number of covariance terms grows much faster than N.

why_wrong.B: The book’s large-N point is the opposite: the number of covariance terms grows much faster than N.
why_wrong.C: Counts every (i,j) pair including i=j as a “distinct covariance” in the book’s N(N-1)/2 sense, or drops variances.

QM-099.zh: 30 個方差項、435 個不同協方差。N 大時，組合風險由平均協方差主導，因為協 方差項數量增加得比N 快得多。
QM-099.core_idea: There are N variance terms and N(N-1)/2 distinct covariances; when N is large, average covariance dominates
QM-099.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-100.reasoning: Reasoning: Uncorrelated means E(XY)=E(X)E(Y) (covariance zero). Independent means the joint equals the product of the marginals. Independence ⇒uncorrelated. Zero correlation does not, by itself, establish independence: it only says there is no linear association.

why_wrong.A: That is the ρ=1 statement, not ρ=0. Zero correlation still drops the covariance contribution relative to ρ=1.
why_wrong.B: Equates ρ=0 with independence. Correlation is linear; a pair can have a curved relationship, zero covariance, and still fail the joint-factorization test.

QM-100.zh: 不相關只保證沒有直線關係。獨立要求聯合概率可以拆開，條件更強。ρ=0 仍有 分散效果，不能分散的是ρ=1。
QM-100.core_idea: Independent variables are uncorrelated; zero correlation does not establish independence
QM-100.study_section: Independence versus Uncorrelated ｜統計獨立與不相關
QM-100.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-100.subtopic: 2.4.3 Independence versus Uncorrelated｜統計獨立與不相關

QM-101.reasoning: Reasoning: Independent variables are uncorrelated. That is why independence would drop the covariance term. The converse is the trap: seeing ρ=0 does not prove independence.

why_wrong.A: Independence is stronger than uncorrelated; it forces covariance (and ρ) to zero. It does not leave ρ free.
why_wrong.C: Independence is not perfect negative correlation.

QM-101.zh: 獨立⇒不相關⇒協方差項為0。反過來不成立。獨立也不是ρ=-1。
QM-101.core_idea: Independence implies uncorrelated; the converse is not valid
QM-101.study_section: Independence versus Uncorrelated ｜統計獨立與不相關
QM-101.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-101.subtopic: 2.4.3 Independence versus Uncorrelated｜統計獨立與不相關

QM-102.reasoning: Reasoning: A pair can have a curved relationship, zero covariance, and still fail P(X,Y)=P(X)P(Y). Independence is that factorization, not a statement about the correlation coefficient.

why_wrong.B: The book’s trap: treating ρ=0 as independence. Correlation and covariance are linear.
why_wrong.C: Portfolio math may drop the covariance term when ρ=0; that does not rewrite the definition of independence.

QM-102.zh: 彎著依賴可以讓協方差為0。獨立是聯合概率能否拆開，不是相關係數是否為0。
QM-102.core_idea: A curved relationship can have zero covariance and still fail independence
QM-102.study_section: Independence versus Uncorrelated ｜統計獨立與不相關
QM-102.exam_trap: Treating ρ=0 as independence Which test statistic?
QM-102.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-102.subtopic: 2.4.3 Independence versus Uncorrelated｜統計獨立與不相關

QM-103.reasoning: Reasoning: Pearson’s null is no linear association. For categorical counts in a two-way table, a chi-square test of independence uses df=(r-1)(c-1) and a different H0: row and column classifications are not related.

why_wrong.A: Failing to reject ρ=0 would support “no linear association,” still not independence.
why_wrong.B: Reads H0: ρ=0 as “no dependence.” The book: that is not a test of statistical independence.

QM-103.zh: Pearson 的H0: ρ=0 只說沒有線性關聯，不是獨立檢定。獨立要用聯合概率能否 拆開，或類別表的卡方獨立檢定。
QM-103.core_idea: Pearson H0: ρ=0 is no linear association, not a test of statistical independence
QM-103.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-103.subtopic: 2.4.3 Independence versus Uncorrelated｜統計獨立與不相關

QM-104.reasoning: Reasoning: Covariance ranges over (-∞,∞). It is not a comparable strength measure across pairs, because each pair can have different individual variances. Correlation rescales to [-1,1].

why_wrong.B: Again reads “closer to zero covariance” as closer to independence, and ignores units.
why_wrong.C: Treats raw covariance as comparable strength.

QM-104.zh: 協方差帶單位、可大可小，不能靠「40 比8 大」就說關係比較強。要比較強度先 除以兩個SD。
QM-104.core_idea: Covariance is not a comparable strength measure across pairs; correlation is
QM-104.study_section: Covariance and Correlation ｜協方差與相關係數
QM-104.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-104.subtopic: 2.4.1 Covariance and Correlation｜協方差與相關係數

QM-105.reasoning: Reasoning: The covariance of a variable with itself is its variance; SD is the square root. Correlation of a series with itself is 1 because Cov is then divided by σ·σ.

why_wrong.A: Opposite of the definition.
why_wrong.C: Confuses covariance with correlation. ρ(R,R)=1, but Cov(R,R)=σ2, not 1.

QM-105.zh: 自己跟自己的協方差就是方差；相關係數才是1。
QM-105.core_idea: The covariance of a variable with itself is its variance
QM-105.study_section: Covariance and Correlation ｜協方差與相關係數
QM-105.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-105.subtopic: 2.4.1 Covariance and Correlation｜協方差與相關係數

QM-106.reasoning: Reasoning: Portfolio return is a value-weighted mean. Portfolio variance is not. It includes every pairwise covariance.

why_wrong.A: Weights summing to 1 does not remove covariances.
why_wrong.C: Drops all cross terms.

QM-106.zh: 組合報酬是權重平均；組合變異數不是，一定要把兩兩協方差算進去。
QM-106.core_idea: Portfolio return is a value-weighted mean; portfolio variance is not
QM-106.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-107.reasoning: Reasoning: Positive covariance: the two returns tend to sit on the same side of their means. Lower covariance means more diversification benefit. Diversification improves as correlation falls.

why_wrong.A: Ignores the cross term.
why_wrong.B: Misreads the +2w1w2Cov term: a smaller (more negative) covariance reduces variance.

QM-107.zh: 權重與各自SD 固定時，協方差愈低（愈負），組合風險愈低，分散效果愈大。
QM-107.core_idea: Lower covariance means more diversification benefit
QM-107.study_section: Covariance and Correlation ｜協方差與相關係數
QM-107.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-107.subtopic: 2.4.1 Covariance and Correlation｜協方差與相關係數

QM-108.reasoning: Reasoning: If X is normal, Y=e^X is lognormal: bounded below by 0, skewed right. That is why it is used for asset prices, not for asset returns. If the stock’s continuously compounded return is normal, the future price is lognormal.

why_wrong.B: Reverses prices versus returns. Returns can be negative; prices cannot.
why_wrong.C: A lognormal variable is bounded below by 0 and is skewed right.

QM-108.zh: 對數常態下界是0、右不對稱，用來模價格（不能負），不用來模報酬（可以負）。 連續複利報酬若為常態，未來價格就是對數常態。
QM-108.core_idea: If X is normal, Y=e^X is lognormal: bounded below by 0, skewed right — a model for asset prices, not returns
QM-108.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-109.reasoning: Reasoning: Monte Carlo: uniforms →inverse transform →simulated values from a chosen distribution. Typical uses are predictive modeling and quantifying risk. Historical simulation applies randomly selected actual past changes.

why_wrong.A: The book: it is an estimate; it does not identify cause-and-effect. The simulated distribution is only as good as the assumed inputs and correlations.
why_wrong.B: That is historical simulation.

QM-109.zh: 蒙地卡羅是用均勻亂數反轉換去抽所選分布，得到的是估計，不是因果。把過去 實際變動套到現在組合，那是歷史模擬。
QM-109.core_idea: Monte Carlo maps uniforms by inverse transformation; it is an estimate and does not identify cause-and-effect
QM-109.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-110.reasoning: Reasoning: Resampling builds new samples from the observations you already have. Bootstrap: with replacement. Jackknife: does not replace observations as it resamples.

why_wrong.A: Swaps the two resampling recipes.
why_wrong.C: Bootstrap/jackknife resample the observations you have; Monte Carlo draws from an assumed distribution.

QM-110.zh: 自助抽樣是有放回；刀切法重抽時不放回（不把抽到的再放回去）。兩者都是用你 已有的觀測，不是蒙地卡羅的假設分布。
QM-110.core_idea: Bootstrap draws with replacement; jackknife does not replace observations as it resamples
QM-110.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-111.reasoning: Reasoning: Historical simulation applies randomly selected actual past changes in prices or risk factors to a current portfolio. Future changes need not follow that historical distribution. Monte Carlo draws uniforms and maps them into a chosen distribution.

why_wrong.A: Neither historical nor bootstrap identifies cause-and-effect.
why_wrong.B: Random selection of past changes is historical simulation, not Monte Carlo’s inverse-transform from a chosen distribution.

QM-111.zh: 歷史模擬是把過去實際變動隨機抽來套在現在組合上；未來不必再走同一段歷史。 蒙地卡羅才是從選定分布反轉換。
QM-111.core_idea: Historical simulation applies randomly selected actual past changes; the future need not follow that history
QM-111.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-112.reasoning: Reasoning: Usual working assumption: i.i.d. If the stock’s CCR is normal, the future price is lognormal. If the CCRs are not themselves normal, their sum is still approximately normal for a large number of periods by the CLT.

why_wrong.A: The book uses exact normality of CCR as the usual working assumption for an exact lognormal price, but also says if CCRs are not normal their sum is still approximately normal for large N by the CLT.
why_wrong.B: CLT is about the sum (or the sample mean), not each single X_i becoming normal.

QM-112.zh: 連續複利報酬i.i.d. 但不常態時，很多期加總仍可依CLT 近似常態，價格仍可當 近似對數常態。CLT 不是說每一期自己變成常態。
QM-112.core_idea: i.i.d. continuously compounded returns: if they are not normal, their sum is still approximately normal for a large number of periods by the CLT
QM-112.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-113.reasoning: Reasoning: Fintech is technology-driven innovation in the financial-services industry. Big data is a large quantity of financial data, from various sources, in multiple formats.

why_wrong.A: The book’s big-data definition is quantity, various sources, multiple formats — not prices only.
why_wrong.B: ML output can be a black box — not fully understandable. Big data is not “any spreadsheet.”

QM-113.zh: 金融科技是金融服務業的科技創新。大數據是量大、來源多、格式多的金融資料， 不是「任何試算表」或「只有成交價」。
QM-113.core_idea: Fintech is technology-driven innovation in financial services; big data is large, multi-source, multiformat financial data
QM-113.study_section: Introduction to Big Data Techniques ｜大數據技術概論
QM-113.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-113.subtopic: 2.10 Introduction to Big Data Techniques ｜大數據技術概論

QM-114.reasoning: Reasoning: Two failure modes: overfitting (too tightly fitted to the sample) and underfitting. The modeling path is expert systems →neural networks →machine learning (train / validate / test). ML output can be a black box.

why_wrong.A: The path runs from expert systems (if–then rules) to neural nets to ML (train / validate / test). Fitting the sample perfectly is not the goal.
why_wrong.B: Validation failure after a perfect in-sample fit is overfitting, not underfitting.

QM-114.zh: 過度配適是把樣本的雜訊也學進去，驗證集就垮。配適不足是模型太粗。完美擬 合樣本不是目標。
QM-114.core_idea: Overfitting is too tightly fitted to the sample; underfitting is the opposite failure mode
QM-114.study_section: Introduction to Big Data Techniques ｜大數據技術概論
QM-114.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-114.subtopic: 2.10 Introduction to Big Data Techniques ｜大數據技術概論

QM-115.reasoning: Reasoning: Data science extracts information from big data with ML and statistics. Processing: capture, curation, storage, search, transfer. Visualization: tag cloud (text size encodes importance), text analytics (unstructured text), NLP (interpreting human language, including translation).

why_wrong.A: The book includes text analytics for unstructured text, including short-term trends — not a purge of text.
why_wrong.B: Invented statistics for tag clouds and NLP.

QM-115.zh: 處理鏈是擷取、清理、儲存、查詢、傳送。文字雲用字級大小表示重要性；NLP 是理解人類語言（含翻譯），不是峰度檢定或自助抽樣。
QM-115.core_idea: Processing: capture, curation, storage, search, transfer; visualization includes tag clouds, text analytics, NLP
QM-115.study_section: Introduction to Big Data Techniques ｜大數據技術概論
QM-115.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-115.subtopic: 2.10 Introduction to Big Data Techniques ｜大數據技術概論

QM-116.reasoning: Reasoning: Probability (random) sampling gives each population item a known chance of selection. Simple random: each item has the same likelihood of inclusion.

why_wrong.A: Convenience is a non-probability method.
why_wrong.C: Systematic is every k-th item after a random start — a different probability method.

QM-116.zh: 簡單隨機：每個個體被抽到的機會相同。系統抽樣是隨機起點後每隔k 個；便利 抽樣不是概率抽樣。
QM-116.core_idea: Simple random: each item has the same likelihood of inclusion
QM-116.study_section: Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理
QM-116.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-116.subtopic: 2.6 Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理

QM-117.reasoning: Reasoning: Systematic: every k-th item after a random start. Stratified: cut into strata (rating, maturity, …), then simple-random sample from each stratum, typically in proportion to stratum size.

why_wrong.A: Cluster selects whole clusters.
why_wrong.C: Stratified cuts the population into strata and then simple-random samples from each stratum.

QM-117.zh: 系統抽樣：隨機起點後每隔k 個。分層是先切層再在每一層簡單隨機抽；集群是 整群抽走。
QM-117.core_idea: Systematic sampling: every k-th item after a random start
QM-117.study_section: Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理
QM-117.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-117.subtopic: 2.6 Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理

QM-118.reasoning: Reasoning: Stratified: cut the population into strata, then simple-random sample from each stratum, typically in proportion to stratum size.

why_wrong.B: Choosing strata is part of stratified design; judgmental sampling is a non-probability method.
why_wrong.C: Cluster selects whole clusters by simple random sampling — not a proportional draw from every cell.

QM-118.zh: 分層抽樣：每一層都抽，通常按層的大小比例。不是整層端走（那是集群），也不 是判斷抽樣。
QM-118.core_idea: Stratified: sample from each stratum, typically in proportion to stratum size
QM-118.study_section: Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理
QM-118.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-118.subtopic: 2.6 Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理

QM-119.reasoning: Reasoning: Cluster: cut into clusters; select whole clusters by simple random sampling.

why_wrong.B: Accounts outside the 12 offices had zero chance, so it is not simple random sampling of accounts.
why_wrong.C: Offices used as groups that are taken in full are clusters, not strata from which a subset is drawn.

QM-119.zh: 集群抽樣：先切群，再整群抽走。分層是每一層都抽一部分；這不是對帳戶做簡 單隨機。
QM-119.core_idea: Cluster sampling selects whole clusters by simple random sampling
QM-119.study_section: Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理
QM-119.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-119.subtopic: 2.6 Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理

QM-120.reasoning: Reasoning: Non-probability methods include convenience sampling and judgmental sampling. Probability sampling gives each item a known chance of selection.

why_wrong.B: Equal likelihood is not guaranteed; these are the book’s non-probability examples.
why_wrong.C: Experience is not the stratified recipe.

QM-120.zh: 便利抽樣與判斷抽樣都不是概率抽樣：被抽到的機會未知。
QM-120.core_idea: Convenience and judgmental sampling are non-probability methods
QM-120.study_section: Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理
QM-120.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-120.subtopic: 2.6 Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理

QM-121.reasoning: Reasoning: Sampling error of the mean is ¯X-µ. Survivorship bias is the common sample-selection case: failed funds drop out, so average performance looks too good.

why_wrong.A: Look-ahead is using data that were not yet available on the test date.
why_wrong.B: Time-period bias is a window that is too short or too long — not specifically “dead funds vanish.”

QM-121.zh: 存活者偏誤：倒掉的基金被拿掉，平均績效被美化。那是樣本選擇偏誤，不是前 視、也不是單純期間長短。
QM-121.core_idea: Survivorship bias: failed funds drop out, so average performance looks too good
QM-121.study_section: Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理
QM-121.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-122.reasoning: Reasoning: Look-ahead: using data that were not yet available on the test date.

why_wrong.A: Delisting is survivorship; the stem’s problem is availability timing.
why_wrong.C: Data-mining is searching a database until a pattern “works,” or leaning on other people’s empirical findings instead of a testable theory.

QM-122.zh: 前視偏誤：回測當天還沒公布的資料卻被拿來用。不是存活者，也不是資料探勘 的定義。
QM-122.core_idea: Look-ahead bias uses data that were not yet available on the test date
QM-122.study_section: Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理
QM-122.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-122.subtopic: 2.6 Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理

QM-123.reasoning: Reasoning: Time-period bias: the window is too short or too long.

why_wrong.A: Sampling method is not the issue named here.
why_wrong.B: Look-ahead is about data availability on the test date, not window length.

QM-123.zh: 期間偏誤：視窗太短或太長。兩種都是期間選擇問題，不是前視。
QM-123.core_idea: Time-period bias: the window is too short or too long

QM-123.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-124.reasoning: Reasoning: Data-mining: searching a database until a pattern “works,” or leaning on other people’s empirical findings instead of a testable theory.

why_wrong.B: A data-mined “finding” is a mechanism that inflates false discoveries; the book lists data-mining as a bias, not as “Type I is impossible unless α is set last.”
why_wrong.C: This is not a sampling-design name.

QM-124.zh: 資料探勘：把資料庫搜到出現「有效」型態，或只靠別人的實證結果、沒有可檢驗 的理論。
QM-124.core_idea: Data-mining: searching until a pattern works, or leaning on others’ empirical findings instead of a testable theory
