QM-125.reasoning: Reasoning: CLT: sampling distribution of ¯X →normal, mean µ, variance σ2/n. Working threshold around n=30. The population itself need not be normal.

why_wrong.B: The book: the population need not be normal; for large n the mean’s sampling distribution is still approximately normal.
why_wrong.C: CLT is about the sample-mean statistic, not each X_i. You may always compute a mean.

QM-125.zh: CLT 說的是樣本均值這個統計量的分布，在n 夠大時接近常態，不是每一個X_i 變成常態。母體不必常態。
QM-125.core_idea: CLT: the sampling distribution of ¯X approaches normal with mean µ and variance σ2/n; the population need not be normal
QM-125.study_section: Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理
QM-125.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-125.subtopic: 2.6 Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理

QM-126.reasoning: Reasoning: σ_ ¯X = σ/√n = 16/8 = 2. Dividing by √n, not by n, is the whole reduction in uncertainty. Given: σ=16; n=64. Asked: SE of the sample mean. Formula: 16/ √ Why this formula: CLT variance of ¯X is σ2/n. A 64-observation mean is much less noisy than a single draw with SD 16. Reasonableness check: SE must be below 16 and well above 16/64. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Reports the population SD, unscaled.
why_wrong.C: Divides by n: 16/64=0.25.

QM-126.zh: 標準誤是σ/√n=16/8=2，不是σ/n，更不是原總體SD。
QM-126.core_idea: Standard error of the sample mean is σ/√n, not σ/n
QM-126.study_section: Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理
QM-126.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-126.subtopic: 2.6 Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理

QM-127.reasoning: Reasoning: SE = σ/√n. n from 36 to 144 is a fourfold increase, so √n doubles (6 to 12) and SE halves: 4 →2. Quadrupling the sample halves the standard error. Given: SE=4 at n=36; new n=144. Asked: New SE. Formula: 4 × √ 36/144 Why this formula: SE scales with 1/√n. n: 36 →144 is the book’s “n from 36 to 144, SE halves” illustration. Reasonableness check: Only a 16-fold n cut would quarter the SE. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Leaves SE unchanged.
why_wrong.C: Divides by 4 because n quadrupled, as if SE used n not √n.

QM-127.zh: n 從36 到144 是四倍，√n 才加倍，標準誤減半成2。不是除以4。
QM-127.core_idea: Quadrupling the sample halves the standard error
QM-127.study_section: Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理
QM-127.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-127.subtopic: 2.6 Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理

QM-128.reasoning: Reasoning: SE=7/7=1. 95% uses z_0.025=1.96. Interval: 12±1.96×1, or 10.04 to 13.96. Book critical values: 1.65 / 1.96 / 2.58 for 90 / 95 / 99%. Given: n=49; ¯X=12; σ=7; 95%. Asked: CI for µ. Formula: 12 ± 1.96 × 7/ √ Why this formula: Known variance, normal / large-n z interval. We are using a 95% z interval around the sample mean; width is governed by SE, not by σ. Reasonableness check: Half-width 1.96 is a bit under 2 SEs, as 95% requires. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Uses σ instead of σ/√n as the SE (interval 16 times too wide).
why_wrong.C: Uses z_0.05=1.65 (the 90% critical value) by mistake.

QM-128.study_section: Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理
QM-128.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-128.subtopic: 2.6 Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理

QM-129.reasoning: Reasoning: Use t when the population variance is unknown (and, for small n, when the population is normal or approximately normal). df=n-1. Lower df ⇒fatter tails ⇒wider interval. The z-statistic remains appropriate when variance is known.

why_wrong.A: Chi-square tests one variance, not the mean.
why_wrong.C: For n≥30 and unknown variance the book says t (z acceptable; t more conservative) — not “always z.” Here n=18, normal, unknown variance →t.

QM-129.zh: 母體方差未知用t，df=n-1。n=18 不能改用z。卡方是檢一個方差，不是檢均值。
QM-129.core_idea: Unknown variance: use t with df=n-1; z remains appropriate when variance is known
QM-129.study_section: Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理
QM-129.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-129.subtopic: 2.6 Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理

QM-130.reasoning: Reasoning: Table: nonnormal, variance unknown, n<30 →not available. Nonnormal, variance known, n<30 →not available. For n≥30, unknown variance →t; known →z.

why_wrong.A: t for small n requires a normal or approximately normal population.
why_wrong.C: CLT’s working threshold is around n=30; n=12 is below it, and the table says nonnormal n<30: not available.

QM-130.zh: 母體明顯非常態且n=12，書上的表寫not available。CLT 的工作門檻大約30， 小樣本又非常態不能硬用t 或z。
QM-130.core_idea: Nonnormal population, n<30: z or t for the mean is not available in the book’s table
QM-130.study_section: Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理
QM-130.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-130.subtopic: 2.6 Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理

QM-131.reasoning: Reasoning: Sampling error of the mean is ¯X-µ = 0.4. Several biases can make that error systematic. Given: ¯X=6.4; µ=6.0. Asked: Sampling error of the mean. Formula: 6.4 −6.0 Why this formula: Definition. This one sample’s mean sat 0.4 above the population mean. Reasonableness check: Error can be positive or negative; SE cannot. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: SE is the SD of the sampling distribution, not the realized ¯X-µ.
why_wrong.B: Reports ¯X itself.

QM-131.zh: 抽樣誤差是¯X-µ=0.4，不是樣本均值本身，也不是標準誤。
QM-131.core_idea: Sampling error of the mean is ¯X - µ
QM-131.study_section: Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理
QM-131.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-131.subtopic: 2.6 Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理

QM-132.reasoning: Reasoning: A normal is completely described by mean and variance, is symmetric (skewness 0), and has kurtosis 3. Use 1.65 / 1.96 / 2.58 for 90 / 95 / 99% z intervals.

why_wrong.A: Swaps the 90/95/99 pairing.
why_wrong.B: t approaches z only as n grows; it is not 1.65 at every df.

QM-132.study_section: Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理
QM-132.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-132.subtopic: 2.6 Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem ｜抽樣與中央極限定理

QM-133.reasoning: Reasoning: The researcher writes H0 (no relationship / the parameter equals the hypothesized value) and Ha. Steps: hypotheses; statistic; α; decision rule; compute; decide.

why_wrong.A: Failing to reject is not a proof of H0, and 1-α is the confidence level when H0 is true and you do not reject — not P(H0 true).
why_wrong.B: Ha is the alternative (there is a relationship / the parameter differs). A large p-value is evidence consistent with H0, not a proof of Ha.

QM-133.zh: 永遠不能在邏輯上「證明」Ha；能做的是拒絕H0 才有資格下Ha 的結論。不拒絕 也不等於證明H0。
QM-133.core_idea: You never prove Ha; rejecting H0 is what licenses concluding Ha
QM-133.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-134.reasoning: Reasoning: Two-tailed: whether a parameter is different from a number. One-tailed: whether it lies on one side; rejected only in the relevant tail.

why_wrong.B: Two-tailed is H0: µ=0 versus Ha: µ̸=0.
why_wrong.C: The book’s one-tailed example is exactly H0: µ≤0 vs Ha: µ>0.

QM-134.zh: H0: µ≤0、Ha: µ>0 是右尾單尾檢定。雙尾才是µ=0 對µ̸=0。
QM-134.core_idea: Two-tailed: µ ̸= 0; one-tailed: rejected only in the named tail
QM-134.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-135.reasoning: Reasoning: The test statistic is compared with a critical value. Smaller α ⇒larger critical value ⇒harder to reject H0. Reject when the statistic lies outside the acceptance region.

why_wrong.A: Reverses the α–critical-value link.
why_wrong.B: Critical values also depend on α (and on the distribution).

QM-135.zh: α 愈小，臨界值愈大，愈難拒絕H0。不是比較容易拒絕。
QM-135.core_idea: Smaller α ⇒larger critical value ⇒harder to reject H0
QM-135.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-136.reasoning: Reasoning: The p-value is the smallest significance level at which H0 can be rejected. Reject H0 if p≤α. 0.018≤0.05 and 0.018>0.01, so reject at 5%, not at 1%. A result can be significant at 5% and not significant at 1%.

why_wrong.A: Treats “significant” as independent of α — the book’s trap.
why_wrong.C: Reverses the rejection rule. Small p is evidence against H0; reject when p≤α.

QM-136.zh: p=0.018 表示顯著水平設在1.8% 或更寬就可以拒絕。所以5% 拒絕、1% 不拒絕。 小p 是對H0 不利，不是對H0 有利。
QM-136.core_idea: p-value is the smallest α at which H0 can be rejected; reject if p≤α
QM-136.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-137.reasoning: Reasoning: The p-value is not P(H0 | data). Whether you reject still depends on the α you chose before seeing p.

why_wrong.A: 0.04 > 0.01, so not rejected at 1%.
why_wrong.B: That is the trap the book names: reading a small p as the probability that H0 is true.

QM-137.zh: p 不是「H0 為真的概率」，也不是P(H0| 資料)。它是在H0 底下，這個統計量要 拒絕所需的最小α。
QM-137.core_idea: p-value is not P(H0 is true) and not P(H0 | data)
QM-137.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-138.reasoning: Reasoning: p=0.07 is the smallest α that rejects. So α=0.10 rejects; α=0.05 does not. Significance is not independent of α.

why_wrong.A: “Small” is not a substitute for the α comparison.
why_wrong.B: Reverses ≤: 0.07≤0.10 is a rejection at 10%.

QM-138.zh: p=0.07：10% 顯著、5% 不顯著。不要用「看起來小」取代跟α 比大小。
QM-138.core_idea: The same p can reject at one pre-set α and fail at a tighter α
QM-138.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-139.reasoning: Reasoning: A statistically significant result need not be economically meaningful. If the estimated gain is too small to cover the cost of trading on it, the t-statistic can reject H0 and still not change a decision. The same distinction applies to a high R2 that is too small to trade.

why_wrong.A: The book separates the two: the t-statistic can reject H0 and still not change a decision.
why_wrong.B: Large n can make a tiny effect statistically detectable.

QM-139.zh: 統計顯著不是經濟顯著。效果小到不夠付交易成本，即使拒絕H0 也不該因此去交 易。
QM-139.core_idea: A statistically significant result need not be economically meaningful
QM-139.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-140.reasoning: Reasoning: Type I: reject a true null (false positive), probability α. Type II: fail to reject a false null, probability β. Confidence level = 1-α when H0 is true and you do not reject. Power = 1-β.

why_wrong.A: That is Type II; P(Type II)=β, not α.
why_wrong.C: Rejecting a false H0 is a correct decision; power = 1-β.

QM-140.zh: Type I 是虛驚：H0 為真卻拒絕，概率就是α。漏掉真實關係是Type II。
QM-140.core_idea: Type I: reject a true null (false positive); α = P(Type I)
QM-140.study_section: Type I and Type II Errors ｜型一與型二錯誤
QM-140.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-140.subtopic: 2.7.1 Type I and Type II Errors｜型一與型二錯誤

QM-141.reasoning: Reasoning: Type II: fail to reject a false null. Power = 1-β. Power falls when Type II error rises.

why_wrong.A: α=5% is P(Type I), not a definition of Type II.
why_wrong.C: That is Type I, and it is not called power.

QM-141.zh: Type II 是漏網：其實H0 為假，你卻沒拒絕。檢定力是1-β。
QM-141.core_idea: Type II: fail to reject a false null; power = 1-β
QM-141.study_section: Type I and Type II Errors ｜型一與型二錯誤
QM-141.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-141.subtopic: 2.7.1 Type I and Type II Errors｜型一與型二錯誤

QM-142.reasoning: Reasoning: α = P(Type I) falls. β rises. Power = 1-β falls. Lowering α is a false-discovery approach: you become stricter about claiming a relationship.

why_wrong.B: Reverses Type I and confuses power with α. Lower α is a larger critical value, harder rejection.
why_wrong.C: Treats the two errors as moving together. Stricter α does not cut both.

QM-142.zh: α 從10% 降到5%：比較不容易虛驚（Type I 降），但比較容易漏網（Type II 升、 檢定力降）。兩種錯誤不會一起變小。
QM-142.core_idea: Lowering α lowers Type I and raises Type II; power falls
QM-142.study_section: Type I and Type II Errors ｜型一與型二錯誤
QM-142.exam_trap: Treating Type I and Type II as moving together
QM-142.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-142.subtopic: 2.7.1 Type I and Type II Errors｜型一與型二錯誤

QM-143.reasoning: Reasoning: Power is the chance of rejecting a false null. Confidence level = 1-α lives in the other column of the error table (H0 true, do not reject).

why_wrong.A: 1-α is the confidence level when H0 is true and you do not reject — not power.
why_wrong.C: α is P(reject | H0 true), a different conditional probability.

QM-143.zh: 檢定力是H0 為假時拒絕的概率，不是α，也不是1-α。把α 調低，檢定力會下 降。
QM-143.core_idea: Power is the chance of rejecting a false null, not another name for α
QM-143.study_section: Type I and Type II Errors ｜型一與型二錯誤
QM-143.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-143.subtopic: 2.7.1 Type I and Type II Errors｜型一與型二錯誤

QM-144.reasoning: Reasoning: H0: µ=5.0; Ha: µ̸=5.0. Statistic z=( ¯X-µ0)/(σ/√n). Decision rule: reject if |z|>1.96. SE=1.2/6=0.20; z=(5.4-5.0)/0.20=2.00>1.96 ⇒reject. Interpretation: at 5% two-sided, the mean is inconsistent with 5.0. Known variance and normal/large n license z. Given: H0: µ=5.0 vs Ha: µ̸=5.0; n=36; ¯X=5.4; σ=1.2; z_crit=1.96. Asked: Decision at 5% two-sided. Formula: z = (5.4 −5.0)/(1.2/ √ 36) Variables: µ0=5.0; σ known. Why this formula: Single mean, known variance, large/normal sample →z. at 5% two-sided, the mean is inconsistent with 5.0. Known variance and normal/large n license z. Given: H0: µ=5.0 vs Ha: µ̸=5.0; n=36; ¯X=5.4; σ=1.2; z_crit=1.96. Asked: Decision at 5% two-sided. Formula: z = (5.4 −5.0)/(1.2/ √ 36) Variables: µ0=5.0; σ known. Why this formula: Single mean, known variance, large/normal sample →z. Step-by-step: ①SE = 1.2/6 = 0.20. ②z = 0.40/0.20 = 2.00. ③|2.00| > 1.96 ⇒reject H0. Final answer: Reject H0 (z=2.00) Interpretation: At 5% two-sided, 5.4 is not consistent with a population mean of 5.0. Reasonableness check: z=2.00 is just beyond 1.96; at 1% (2.58) one would not reject — α still matters. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Compares the raw gap 0.4 with the critical z.
why_wrong.B: Direction alone does not reject; the statistic must clear the critical value.

QM-144.core_idea: z-test of one mean, known σ: z=( ¯X-µ0)/(σ/√n)
QM-144.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-144.subtopic: 2.7.1 Type I and Type II Errors｜型一與型二錯誤

QM-145.reasoning: Reasoning: H0: µ=8.0; Ha: µ̸=8.0. t=( ¯X-µ0)/(s/√n), df=15. Decision rule: reject if |t|>2.131. SE=1.6/4=0.40; t=0.60/0.40=1.50 < 2.131 ⇒do not reject. The mean 8.6 is consistent with 8.0 at 5% two-sided. Given: H0: µ = 8.0; Ha: µ ̸= 8.0; n=16; ¯X=8.6; s=1.6; t_crit=2.131. Asked: Decision. Formula: t = (8.6 −8.0)/(1.6/ √ 16) Why this formula: Unknown variance, normal small sample →t, df=n-1. The 0.60 gap is only one and a half standard errors — not unusual at 5% two-sided. Reasonableness check: t < z_0.025=1.96 as well, so z would not reject either; t is more conservative. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Compares the raw mean gap with the critical t instead of computing t=1.50.
why_wrong.C: Unknown variance selects t; it does not automatically reject.

QM-145.zh: 方差未知用t，df=15。t=1.50 < 2.131，不拒絕。不要拿0.6 去跟臨界t 比，更不 要以為「未知方差就一定顯著」。
QM-145.core_idea: t-test of one mean, unknown σ: t=( ¯X-µ0)/(s/√n), df=n-1
QM-145.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-145.subtopic: 2.7.1 Type I and Type II Errors｜型一與型二錯誤

QM-146.reasoning: Reasoning: Difference between two means, independent samples: t with df=n1+n2-2. If unknown variances are assumed equal, pool. If those variances are unequal as well as unknown, do not pool: use s12 and s22 separately.

why_wrong.A: Paired comparison is for two dependent samples (differences).
why_wrong.C: df is n1+n2-2, not n1+n2. Assumed-equal variances are why you pool.

QM-146.zh: 獨立兩樣本、方差未知但假設相等：合併方差，df=n1+n2-2。相依樣本才用成對 t。方差不等就不要合併。
QM-146.core_idea: Two independent means: t with df=n1+n2-2; pool only if unknown variances are assumed equal
QM-146.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-146.subtopic: 2.7.1 Type I and Type II Errors｜型一與型二錯誤

QM-147.reasoning: Reasoning: Paired comparison (two dependent samples, differences approximately normal): t=( ¯d- µ_d0)/(s_d/√n), df=n-1. Typically H0: µ_d0=0.

why_wrong.B: Before/after on the same funds are dependent samples; do not treat them as independent.
why_wrong.C: Pairing does not make σ known.

QM-147.zh: 同一組基金前後比，是成對樣本：對差額做t，df=19。不要當成兩組獨立樣本去 合併。
QM-147.core_idea: Paired comparison: t on the mean difference, df=n-1, typically H0: µ_d=0
QM-147.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-147.subtopic: 2.7.1 Type I and Type II Errors｜型一與型二錯誤

QM-148.reasoning: Reasoning: A test of one variance uses a chi-square statistic with df=n-1 and requires a normal population. The statistic compares the sample variance with the hypothesized variance σ02.

why_wrong.A: F tests two variances (ratio of two sample variances).
why_wrong.B: t tests a mean (or a slope, or ρ=0), not one variance.

QM-148.zh: 檢一個方差用卡方，df=n-1，母體要常態。兩個方差的比才是F；均值才是t。
QM-148.core_idea: One variance: chi-square with df=n-1, requires a normal population
QM-148.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-148.subtopic: 2.7.1 Type I and Type II Errors｜型一與型二錯誤

QM-149.reasoning: Reasoning: F is the ratio of two sample variances, df=(n1-1, n2-1). Placing the larger sample variance in the numerator means only the upper critical value is needed.

why_wrong.B: The book puts the larger s2 on top so only the upper tail is needed.
why_wrong.C: F degrees of freedom are the two variance dfs, not the pooled-mean df.

QM-149.zh: 兩個方差用F：較大的樣本方差放分子，只要看上尾臨界值。自由度是(n1-1, n2-1)。
QM-149.core_idea: Two variances: F = ratio of sample variances, df=(n1-1,n2-1); larger sample variance in the numerator
QM-149.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-149.subtopic: 2.7.1 Type I and Type II Errors｜型一與型二錯誤

QM-150.reasoning: Reasoning: Pearson correlation is tested with t and df=n-2. The null is H0: ρ=0: no linear association. That is not a test of statistical independence.

why_wrong.A: Chi-square independence is for categorical counts in a two-way table, df=(r- 1)(c-1).
why_wrong.B: Mean-test df is n-1; Pearson uses n-2.

QM-150.zh: Pearson 用t、df=n-2，H0 是沒有線性關聯，不是獨立。類別表獨立才用卡方。
QM-150.core_idea: Pearson correlation t, df=n-2, H0: ρ=0 is no linear association
QM-150.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-150.subtopic: 2.7.1 Type I and Type II Errors｜型一與型二錯誤

QM-151.reasoning: Reasoning: For categorical counts in a two-way table, a chi-square test of independence uses df=(r-1)(c-1). Expected cell counts are those implied by independence; they are compared with the observed frequencies.

why_wrong.A: n-2 is Pearson’s correlation df, a different test.
why_wrong.C: df is not the number of cells.

QM-151.zh: 列聯表獨立檢定：df=(列-1)(行-1)。期望次數是「若獨立」應有的次數，拿去跟觀 察次數比。
QM-151.core_idea: Chi-square test of independence: df=(r-1)(c-1); expected cells from independence
QM-151.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-151.subtopic: 2.7.1 Type I and Type II Errors｜型一與型二錯誤

QM-152.reasoning: Reasoning: Type I: reject a true null (false discovery). Type II: fail to reject a false null. Significance level α is P(Type I). A false-discovery approach lowers α, which lowers Type I and raises Type II.

why_wrong.B: Reverses the two names.
why_wrong.C: The miss of a genuine premium is Type II (fail to reject a false H0 of “no premium”).

QM-152.zh: 沒有關係卻宣布有，是Type I（虛驚／假發現）。有關係卻沒拒絕H0，是Type II（漏網）。
QM-152.core_idea: False discovery is Type I; a miss of a real relationship is Type II
QM-152.study_section: Type I and Type II Errors ｜型一與型二錯誤
QM-152.exam_trap: Treating Type I and Type II as moving together
QM-152.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-152.subtopic: 2.7.1 Type I and Type II Errors｜型一與型二錯誤

QM-153.reasoning: Reasoning: Use a nonparametric test when (1) the data do not meet those distributional assumptions, (2) there are many outliers, (3) the data are ranks or on an ordinal scale, or (4) the hypothesis is not about a parameter. Spearman is the rank-correlation substitute for Pearson.

why_wrong.A: Ranks / ordinal data and many outliers are stated reasons to avoid the parametric Pearson t.
why_wrong.B: Chi-square of one variance is a different hypothesis.

QM-153.zh: 等級資料加上很多極端值，不要用Pearson 的t。問的是兩個變量的關聯，也不是 卡方檢一個方差。
QM-153.core_idea: Use a nonparametric test when distributional assumptions fail, outliers are many, data are ranks, or the hypothesis is not about a parameter
QM-153.study_section: Parametric versus Nonparametric Tests ｜母數與無母數檢定
QM-153.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-153.subtopic: 2.8 Parametric versus Nonparametric Tests ｜母數與無母數檢定

QM-154.reasoning: Reasoning: Parametric tests (z, t, F, chi-square) assume a particular distribution. The book’s substitutes: Wilcoxon signed-rank; Mann–Whitney U; Wilcoxon or sign test for paired differences; Spearman for Pearson. Runs tests are another nonparametric example.

why_wrong.A: ANOVA F in SLR is a parametric test of b1=0, not a nonparametric catch-all.
why_wrong.B: Swaps unrelated procedures.

QM-154.zh: 均值用Wilcoxon 符號等級；兩獨立均值用Mann–Whitney；Pearson 改Spearman；成對差額用Wilcoxon 或符號檢定。
QM-154.study_section: Parametric versus Nonparametric Tests ｜母數與無母數檢定
QM-154.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-154.subtopic: 2.8 Parametric versus Nonparametric Tests ｜母數與無母數檢定

QM-155.reasoning: Reasoning: Spearman: rank each variable from largest (1) to smallest (n); tied ranks receive the average of the ranks they span (so a two-way tie at ranks 3 and 4 is 3.5 each). Then compute the paired rank differences d_i. Given: Three-way tie spanning ranks 3–5. Asked: Each tied rank. Formula: (3 + 4 + 5)/3 Why this formula: Book’s tie rule. The three items share the 3–5 block, so each is 4. Reasonableness check: A two-way 3-and-4 tie would be 3.5, the book’s own example. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: The book does not drop ties; it averages the ranks they span. Example given: a two-way tie at ranks 3 and 4 is 3.5 each.
why_wrong.C: Uses the lowest rank instead of the average.

QM-155.zh: 並列就取它們佔住的名次平均。3、4、5 名並列，各記4。不是全記最小名次，也 不是刪掉重排。
QM-155.core_idea: Spearman: rank 1 = largest; ties receive the average of the ranks they span
QM-155.study_section: Parametric versus Nonparametric Tests ｜母數與無母數檢定
QM-155.formula: tied rank = average of spanned ranks
QM-155.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-155.subtopic: 2.8 Parametric versus Nonparametric Tests ｜母數與無母數檢定

QM-156.reasoning: Reasoning: b̂1 = Cov(Y,X)/Var(X) = 12/8 = 1.50. A one-unit increase in X is associated with a 1.50-unit change in predicted Y. The intercept is ¯Y - b̂1 ¯X. Given: Cov(Y,X)=12; Var(X)=8. Asked: Slope. Formula: ˆb1 = 12/8 Why this formula: OLS slope is covariance scaled by Var(X). Predicted Y rises 1.50 when X rises 1. Association, not a proven cause. Reasonableness check: Positive cov ⇒positive slope. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Multiplies 12×8.
why_wrong.C: Inverts the ratio: Var(X)/Cov=8/12.

QM-156.zh: 斜率是Y 與X 的協方差除以X 的方差。除反了會得到0.67；相乘沒有意義。
QM-156.core_idea: Slope = Cov(Y,X)/Var(X); a one-unit increase in X is associated with a b1-unit change in predicted Y
QM-156.study_section: Simple Linear Regression ｜簡單線性迴歸
QM-156.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-156.subtopic: 2.9 Simple Linear Regression ｜簡單線性迴歸

QM-157.reasoning: Reasoning: b̂0 = ¯Y - b̂1 ¯X = 10 - 1.5×4 = 4. Fitted values are Ŷ = 4 + 1.5 X. Residuals e_i=Y_i-Ŷ_i sum to zero on the least-squares line. Given: ¯Y =10; ¯X=4; b̂1=1.5. Asked: Intercept. Formula: 10 −1.5 × 4 Why this formula: Line through the point of means. When X=0, predicted Y is 4. Whether X=0 is economically meaningful is a separate question. Reasonableness check: At X=4, Ŷ=4+1.5×4=10= ¯Y . 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports ¯Y - ¯X = 6, dropping the slope.
why_wrong.B: Reports ¯Y and skips the slope adjustment.

QM-157.zh: 截距是X=0 時的擬合Y：均值相減時要乘上斜率。10-1.5×4=4。
QM-157.core_idea: Intercept is fitted Y when X=0: b0 = ¯Y - b1 ¯X
QM-157.study_section: Simple Linear Regression ｜簡單線性迴歸
QM-157.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-157.subtopic: 2.9 Simple Linear Regression ｜簡單線性迴歸

QM-158.reasoning: Reasoning: If X is an indicator taking 0 and 1, b̂0 is the mean of Y when the indicator is 0, and b̂1 is the difference in mean Y between the two groups (after versus before a policy change, for example).

why_wrong.A: Swaps intercept and slope roles.
why_wrong.C: A dummy is a valid X; OLS still minimizes SSE.

QM-158.zh: 虛擬變數：截距是指標為0 那一組的Y 均值；斜率是兩組均值差（例如政策後減 政策前）。
QM-158.core_idea: Dummy (0/1): intercept is mean Y when the indicator is 0; slope is the difference in mean Y
QM-158.study_section: Simple Linear Regression ｜簡單線性迴歸
QM-158.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-158.subtopic: 2.9 Simple Linear Regression ｜簡單線性迴歸

QM-159.reasoning: Reasoning: SST=SSR+SSE=120. R2=SSR/SST=72/120=0.60. Smaller SSE means a narrower prediction interval and a better fit. R2 is a share of variance in Y, not a probability and not ρ. Given: SSR=72; SSE=48. Asked: R2. Formula: R2 = 72/(72 + 48) Why this formula: Coefficient of determination. The line captures 60% of Y’s variation; 40% remains in the residuals. Reasonableness check: R2 must lie in [0,1]; 1.50 is impossible. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Uses SSR/SSE = 72/48 = 1.50, which is not a share of SST and cannot be an R2.
why_wrong.C: Inverts the fit ratio: SSE/SSR = 48/72 = 0.67, which is not SSR/SST.

QM-159.core_idea: SST = SSR + SSE; R2 = SSR/SST is the fraction of Y’s variation explained by X
QM-159.study_section: Fit: SST, SSR, SSE, and R² ｜配適度
QM-159.exam_trap: R² is not correlation and not causality
QM-159.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-159.subtopic: 2.9 Fit: SST, SSR, SSE, and R² ｜配適度

QM-160.reasoning: Reasoning: Residual e_i=Y_i-Ŷ_i. Homoskedasticity: residual variance is the same for all observations. Heteroskedasticity makes ordinary t/F standard errors unreliable. Assumptions are about residuals.

why_wrong.A: The book is explicit: normality is of the residuals, not necessarily Y. Heteroskedasticity makes ordinary t/F standard errors unreliable.
why_wrong.C: Same mean at every X would be a flat line (b1=0), not homoskedasticity.

QM-160.zh: 假設是對殘差說的：同質變異、不相關、殘差常態——不是要求Y 本身常態。異 質變異數會讓平常的t/F 標準誤不可靠。
QM-160.core_idea: Homoskedasticity: residual variance the same for all observations; normality is about residuals, not necessarily Y
QM-160.study_section: Simple Linear Regression ｜簡單線性迴歸
QM-160.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-160.subtopic: 2.9 Fit: SST, SSR, SSE, and R² ｜配適度

QM-161.reasoning: Reasoning: If the fitted slope is positive, ρ(X,Y)= √ R2= √ 0.49=0.70. R2 is the fraction of Y’s variation explained by X. It is not the correlation itself. Given: R2=0.49; slope > 0. Asked: Correlation. Formula: ρ = √ 0.49 Why this formula: Signed square root of R2. A 0.49 share of variance is a 0.70 linear correlation when the slope is positive. Reasonableness check: 0.702 = 0.49. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Squares 0.49 again.
why_wrong.B: Treats R2 as the correlation.

QM-161.zh: R2=0.49 是「解釋了49% 的變異」，不是相關係數。斜率為正時開根號得0.70。 不要再平方一次。
QM-161.core_idea: Positive slope: ρ = √ R2, not R2 itself
QM-161.study_section: Fit: SST, SSR, SSE, and R² ｜配適度
QM-161.exam_trap: R² is not correlation and not causality
QM-161.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-161.subtopic: 2.9 Fit: SST, SSR, SSE, and R² ｜配適度

QM-162.reasoning: Reasoning: R2 is not a probability, not a causal claim, and not ρ. With R2=0.81, |ρ|=0.90. Causality is not established by a large R2.

why_wrong.B: Treats R2 as ρ and then squares it — two mistakes.
why_wrong.C: Positive slope signs the correlation; it does not turn R2 into a causal probability.

QM-162.zh: R2 不是「X 造成Y 的機率」，也不是相關係數。0.81 表示Y 的變異有81% 被這 條直線解釋；|ρ|=0.90。
QM-162.core_idea: R2 is not the probability that X causes Y
QM-162.study_section: Fit: SST, SSR, SSE, and R² ｜配適度
QM-162.exam_trap: R² is not correlation and not causality
QM-162.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-162.subtopic: 2.9 Fit: SST, SSR, SSE, and R² ｜配適度

QM-163.reasoning: Reasoning: If the slope is negative, the correlation is the negative square root: ρ=- √ 0.36=-0.60. Given: R2=0.36; slope < 0. Asked: Correlation. Formula: ρ = − √ 0.36 Why this formula: Sign comes from the slope; magnitude from √ R2. X and Y move linearly in opposite directions; 36% of Y’s variance is still captured. Reasonableness check: (-0.60)2 = 0.36. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports R2 as correlation and drops the sign.
why_wrong.C: Takes the positive square root and ignores the negative slope.

QM-163.zh: 斜率為負，相關是負的平方根-0.60。不要報0.36，也不要只開根號卻丟掉負號。
QM-163.core_idea: Negative slope: correlation is the negative square root of R2
QM-163.study_section: Fit: SST, SSR, SSE, and R² ｜配適度
QM-163.exam_trap: R² is not correlation and not causality
QM-163.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-163.subtopic: 2.9 Fit: SST, SSR, SSE, and R² ｜配適度

QM-164.reasoning: Reasoning: A high R2 can still come from a relationship that is statistically detectable but too small to trade — the economic-significance distinction. R2 is not causality.

why_wrong.B: High R2 is not a causal proof and not an economic-significance proof.
why_wrong.C: R2 is a variance share, not a payoff.

QM-164.zh: R2=0.90 只說直線抓得很緊，不說值博率夠大，更不說X 造成Y。經濟顯著性要 另外看。
QM-164.core_idea: A high R2 can still be economically small — the same statistical-versus-economic distinction as a t-test
QM-164.study_section: Fit: SST, SSR, SSE, and R² ｜配適度
QM-164.exam_trap: R² is not correlation and not causality
QM-164.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-164.subtopic: 2.9 Fit: SST, SSR, SSE, and R² ｜配適度

QM-165.reasoning: Reasoning: ANOVA splits SST=SSR+SSE. F=MSR/MSE asks whether the explained piece is large relative to residual noise. In SLR the F-test of the model and the two-sided t-test of the single slope are equivalent tests of H0: b1=0.

why_wrong.A: Invented a split between statistical and economic tests. Economic significance is a separate question, not F’s exclusive job.
why_wrong.B: SLR is k=1 ANOVA; F is still defined. MSR=SSR and MSE=SSE/(n-2).

QM-165.zh: 簡單迴歸的ANOVA F 與斜率雙尾t，檢的是同一個H0: b1=0，不是兩件事。F 不是經濟顯著性專用，也不要求多個回歸元。
QM-165.core_idea: In SLR the ANOVA F-test of the model and the two-sided t-test of the slope are equivalent tests of H0: b1=0
QM-165.exam_trap: ANOVA F and two-sided t test different SLR nulls
QM-165.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-166.reasoning: Reasoning: k=1 ⇒MSR=SSR=48. MSE=57/(20-2)=3.1667. F=48/3.1667=15.16. Decision: compare F with the critical F (or equivalently compare t= √ F with critical t). Same H0: b1=0. Given: n=20; k=1; SSR=48; SSE=57. Asked: ANOVA F. Formula: F = 48/(57/18) Why this formula: SLR mean squares. Explained mean square is about 15 times residual mean square — a large F against H0: b1=0. Reasonableness check: √ F = 3.89, the absolute two-sided t of the same slope. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Divides SSR by n-1 instead of comparing MSR with MSE=SSE/(n-2).
why_wrong.C: Uses SSR/SSE and skips the mean-square step.

QM-166.zh: 簡單迴歸MSR 就是SSR，MSE=SSE/(n-2)。F=48/3.17≈15.16。不要用 SSR/SSE 交差。
QM-166.core_idea: SLR ANOVA: k=1 so MSR=SSR, MSE=SSE/(n-2), F=MSR/MSE
QM-166.formula: F = MSR/MSE, MSR = SSR, MSE = SSE/(n −2)
QM-166.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-167.reasoning: Reasoning: H0: b1=0; Ha: b1̸=0. Statistic t=(b̂1-B1)/s_b̂1=0.55/0.20=2.75. Decision rule: reject if |t|>2.056. 2.75>2.056 ⇒reject. Interpretation: the slope is statistically distinguishable from 0 at 5% two-sided. In SLR this is the same decision as the ANOVA F test. Given: b̂1=0.55; s_b=0.20; B1=0; t_crit=2.056. Asked: Two-sided 5% decision on H0: b1=0. Formula: t = 0.55/0.20 Why this formula: t-test of one coefficient. the slope is statistically distinguishable from 0 at 5% two-sided. In SLR this is the same decision as the ANOVA F test. Given: b̂1=0.55; s_b=0.20; B1=0; t_crit=2.056. Asked: Two-sided 5% decision on H0: b1=0. Formula: t = 0.55/0.20 Why this formula: t-test of one coefficient. Step-by-step: ①t = 2.75. ②2.75 > 2.056 ⇒reject H0. Final answer: Reject H0 (t=2.75) Interpretation: 0.55 is 2.75 standard errors above 0 — inconsistent with a zero slope at 5%. Reasonableness check: F = t2 = 7.56 would be the matching ANOVA statistic. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Compares the slope to α.
why_wrong.C: Compares the slope to the critical t.

QM-167.zh: 檢驗用t= 斜率/斜率標準誤=2.75，去跟臨界t 比，不是拿0.55 跟2.056 或0.05 比。
QM-167.core_idea: t = (b̂1 - B1)/s_b̂1; compare t with critical t, not the slope with α or with t_crit
QM-167.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-168.reasoning: Reasoning: In SLR the F-test and the two-sided t-test of the slope are equivalent: F=t2=7.5625. Both test H0: b1=0. They are not two different hypotheses. Given: SLR t of the slope = 2.75. Asked: Matching ANOVA F. Formula: F = 2.752 Why this formula: Equivalence of F and two-sided t in SLR. Same reject/fail decision as |t| vs t_crit, after translating the F critical value. Reasonableness check: √ 7.56 = 2.75. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports √ t.
why_wrong.B: Reports t itself as F.

QM-168.zh: 簡單迴歸F=t2。t=2.75 就對應F≈7.56，同一個H0，不是另一個假設。
QM-168.core_idea: In SLR, F = t2 for the single slope; they are the same test
QM-168.exam_trap: ANOVA F and two-sided t test different SLR nulls
QM-168.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-169.reasoning: Reasoning: Three common one-variable transformations stay inside the same least-squares engine: log-lin, lin-log, log-log.

why_wrong.A: Logging Y does not change the test of one variance into the estimator.
why_wrong.B: Dummies are estimated by the same least squares.

QM-169.zh: log-lin、lin-log、log-log 仍用同一套最小平方法，只是誰取對數不同。
QM-169.core_idea: Log-lin, lin-log, and log-log stay inside the same least-squares engine
QM-169.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-170.reasoning: Reasoning: s_e = sqrt(MSE) is the SD of the residuals. The slope’s standard error divides s_e by sqrt(sum (X_i-Xbar)2). A prediction interval for a forecast is Yhat_f +/- t_alpha/2 s_f. Smaller SSE means a narrower prediction interval and a better fit.

why_wrong.A: R2 is a variance share; s_e is in Y’s units.
why_wrong.C: s_b1 = s_e / sqrt(sum (X-Xbar)2) is a different standard error.

QM-170.zh: 估計的標準誤s_e 是殘差的SD，單位跟Y 一樣。較小的SSE 讓預測區間變窄。 它不是R2，也不是斜率的標準誤。
QM-170.core_idea: s_e = sqrt(MSE) is the SD of the residuals; smaller SSE tightens the prediction interval
QM-170.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-171.reasoning: Reasoning: p is the smallest alpha that rejects. 0.04<=0.05 and 0.04>0.01. It is not P(H0|data). Failing to reject at 1% is not a proof of H0.

why_wrong.A: Reverses the rejection rule and treats non-rejection as a proof of H0.
why_wrong.B: That is the p-as-P(H0) trap, and it also treats significance as independent of alpha.

QM-171.zh: p=0.04 不是「H0 只有4% 可能為真」。規則是p≤α 才拒絕：5% 拒絕、1% 不拒 絕。不拒絕也不等於證明H0。
QM-171.core_idea: p=0.04 is not “H0 is 4% likely” and still depends on the pre-chosen alpha
QM-171.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-171.subtopic: 2.7 Reinforcement — Hypothesis Testing ｜加強練習— 假設檢定

QM-172.reasoning: Reasoning: alpha = P(Type I) rises from 1% to 5%. The critical value shrinks, so it is easier to reject: beta falls and power = 1-beta rises. The Type I / Type II trade-off runs in both directions.

why_wrong.A: More power is true, but the two errors do not both fall - Type I rises.
why_wrong.B: 5% has a smaller critical value than 1%, so rejection is easier: Type I up, power up.

QM-172.zh: α 從1% 放到5%：比較容易拒絕，Type I 上升、Type II 下降、檢定力上升。兩 種錯誤仍然此消彼長。
QM-172.core_idea: Raising alpha is the opposite trade: Type I up, Type II down, power up
QM-172.study_section: Type I and Type II Errors ｜型一與型二錯誤
QM-172.exam_trap: Treating Type I and Type II as moving together
QM-172.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-172.subtopic: 2.7.1 Type I and Type II Errors｜型一與型二錯誤

QM-173.reasoning: Reasoning: DATA / 1-V: Sx already divides by n-1. sigma_x divides by n. The question’s word sample selects Sx. If the question asks for SD, do not stop on a variance key either. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：DATA / STAT 已知：Any 1-V data list already entered 求：Sx not sigma_x 按鍵： ①2nd →STAT →1-V →ENTER ②↓past x-bar to Sx (sample SD) ③Next line sigma_x is the population SD — do not use it for a sample question 結果：Sx uses n-1; sigma_x uses n 中文理解：先看題目是sample 還是population。sample 讀Sx。不要把σx 當成比較正式的 標準差。

why_wrong.A: sigma_x is not MAD; MAD divides absolute deviations by n and does not square.
why_wrong.C: Sx exceeds sigma_x whenever n>1 and the points are not all equal.

QM-173.zh: 題目寫sample standard deviation，STAT 要讀Sx 不是σx。兩者只在沒有離散時 才會一樣。
QM-173.core_idea: STAT worksheet: Sx is sample SD (n-1); sigma_x is population SD (n)
QM-173.exam_trap: Sample vs population n vs n-1
QM-173.calculator:
