已知：Any 1-V data list already entered
求：Sx not sigma_x
按鍵：
①2nd →STAT →1-V →ENTER ②↓past x-bar to Sx (sample SD) ③Next line sigma_x
is the population SD — do not use it for a sample question
結果：Sx uses n-1; sigma_x uses n
中文理解：先看題目是sample 還是population。sample 讀Sx。不要把σx 當成比較正式的
標準差。
QM-173.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-174.reasoning: Reasoning: F=MSR/MSE with MSR=SSR/k and MSE=SSE/(n-k-1). In SLR, k=1. ANOVA is that same split of Y’s variation. In SLR, F and two-sided t of the slope test the same H0: b1=0.

why_wrong.A: The book defines SLR ANOVA with k=1: MSR=SSR, MSE divisor n-2.
why_wrong.B: Neither F nor t is an economic-significance test; R2=0.50 is not a critical value in the book.

QM-174.zh: 多元迴歸的F 是所有斜率一起為0。簡單迴歸只剩b1=0，此時F 與雙尾t 等價。 不是k 一定要≥2，也不是經濟顯著性檢定。
QM-174.core_idea: Multiple regression F tests b1=...=bk=0 jointly; in SLR that collapses to b1=0
QM-174.exam_trap: ANOVA F and two-sided t test different SLR nulls
QM-174.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。

QM-175.reasoning: Reasoning: Techniques include supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and deep learning (neural networks used to find patterns). The path runs from expert systems to neural networks to ML (train / validate / test). Two failure modes are overfitting and underfitting.

why_wrong.A: Deep learning is neural networks used to find patterns, not a trimmed/winsorized average.
why_wrong.B: Expert systems are the start of the modeling path, not the only technique, and ML can be a black box.

QM-175.zh: 監督式、非監督式、深度學習（用神經網路找型態）都在書上。輸出可以是黑箱。 專家系統是路徑起點，不是唯一方法。
QM-175.core_idea: Supervised, unsupervised, and deep learning are named ML techniques; output can be a black box
QM-175.study_section: Introduction to Big Data Techniques ｜大數據技術概論
QM-175.source_note: 解答依據 QM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Quantitative Methods。
QM-175.subtopic: 2.10 Introduction to Big Data Techniques ｜大數據技術概論

ECO-001.reasoning: Reasoning: The notes apply MR=MC in perfect competition, monopolistic competition, oligopoly, and monopoly. What changes is the demand curve that turns that quantity into a price. Price equals MR only when demand is perfectly elastic.

why_wrong.A: P=MR holds only when the firm’s demand is perfectly elastic.
why_wrong.B: Break-even P=ATC is a long-run result in some structures, not the output rule used by all four.

ECO-001.zh: 四種結構都在MR=MC 選產量。只有需求是水平線時才有P=MR。不要把損益 兩平或價格接受者套到每一種結構。
ECO-001.core_idea: All four structures maximize at MR=MC; P=MR only if demand is perfectly elastic
ECO-001.study_section: Firm and Market Structures ｜廠商與市場結構
ECO-001.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-001.subtopic: 3.1 Firm and Market Structures ｜廠商與市場結構

ECO-002.reasoning: Reasoning: P=MR only when the firm’s demand is perfectly elastic — the price-taker case. A downward-sloping demand curve means an extra unit requires a lower price, so MR lies below P.

why_wrong.A: A single-price monopolist also faces downward demand, so P>MR.
why_wrong.C: Differentiated demand is downward-sloping, so the firm must cut price to sell more and P>MR.

ECO-002.zh: 只有價格接受者（水平需求）才有P=MR。需求往下斜就要降價才能多賣，所以 P>MR。
ECO-002.core_idea: P equals MR only when the firm’s demand is perfectly elastic
ECO-002.study_section: Firm and Market Structures ｜廠商與市場結構
ECO-002.formula: P = MR only if demand is perfectly elastic
ECO-002.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-002.subtopic: 3.1 Firm and Market Structures ｜廠商與市場結構

ECO-003.reasoning: Reasoning: Industry supply is built from MC only when the firm is a price taker. With downwardsloping demand there is no supply function: pick Q from MR=MC, then read P off demand.

why_wrong.B: Neither monopoly nor oligopoly has a well-defined supply curve in the notes.
why_wrong.C: The notes give a supply curve only in perfect competition. Elsewhere quantity is chosen from MR=MC and price is read from demand.

ECO-003.zh: 只有完全競爭有供給曲線（AVC 以上的MC）。另外三種先用MR=MC 定Q，再 從需求讀P。
ECO-003.core_idea: Only perfect competition has a supply curve (MC above AVC)
ECO-003.study_section: Firm and Market Structures ｜廠商與市場結構
ECO-003.exam_trap: Assigning a supply curve to every structure
ECO-003.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-003.subtopic: 3.1 Firm and Market Structures ｜廠商與市場結構

ECO-004.reasoning: Reasoning: Classification uses number of firms and shares, how they compete, substitutes, and barriers — not a concentration statistic alone. HHI and CR_N are proxies that still ignore elasticity and entry.

why_wrong.B: Advertising is one oligopoly/monopolistic-competition clue, not a substitute for the classification list.
why_wrong.C: The notes never treat an HHI cutoff as sufficient classification. Concentration is a proxy, not a measure of power.

ECO-004.zh: 結構分類看家數、競爭方式、替代品、進出障礙。集中度只是代理變數，不能單 看一個數字定案。
ECO-004.core_idea: Classify a market by firms, rivalry, substitutes, and barriers — not a concentration statistic alone
ECO-004.study_section: Firm and Market Structures ｜廠商與市場結構
ECO-004.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-004.subtopic: 3.1 Firm and Market Structures ｜廠商與市場結構

ECO-005.reasoning: Reasoning: A price taker can sell any quantity at the market price. Selling one more unit does not require cutting price, so demand is horizontal and P=MR=AR.

why_wrong.A: Downward demand and P>MR belong to the other three structures.
why_wrong.C: Industry supply slopes up; the firm’s demand does not.

ECO-005.zh: 完全競爭是價格接受者：多賣一單位不必降價，需求是水平線，P=MR=AR。
ECO-005.core_idea: The perfectly competitive firm is a price taker, so demand is horizontal and P=MR
ECO-005.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-006.reasoning: Reasoning: Free entry and a homogeneous product drive the PC firm to the minimum of LRATC — the optimal firm size — and to zero economic profit.

why_wrong.A: PC does not need advertising, and long-run equilibrium is P=ATC (zero economic profit), not P>ATC.
why_wrong.C: Positive economic profit that survives entry is an oligopoly/monopoly possibility, not the PC long-run result.

ECO-006.zh: 完全競爭長期停在LRATC 最低點，經濟利潤為零。那是最適規模，不是靠廣告 守住的超額利潤。
ECO-006.core_idea: Long-run PC equilibrium is at minimum LRATC; economic profit is zero
ECO-006.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-007.reasoning: Reasoning: Break-even means revenue just covers total cost: P=ATC, TR=TC, or AR=ATC. That is zero economic profit, not the P=AVC shutdown test.

why_wrong.A: P=AVC is the shutdown boundary, not break-even, and not the PC long-run point (that is min LRATC / P=ATC).
why_wrong.C: MR=MC is the output rule in every structure, not a monopolist-only rule and not the break-even definition.

ECO-007.zh: 損益兩平是P=ATC（TR=TC）。P=AVC 是關廠界線。MR=MC 是產量法則， 四種結構都用。
ECO-007.core_idea: Break-even is P=ATC (equivalently TR=TC or AR=ATC)
ECO-007.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-008.reasoning: Reasoning: If P is below ATC the firm is losing money and will leave in the long run. If P still covers AVC, shutdown would sacrifice the contribution toward sunk fixed cost, so the firm keeps producing in the short run.

why_wrong.A: Price below ATC is a loss, but if P covers AVC the firm still contributes toward sunk fixed cost by operating.
why_wrong.C: P≥AVC with P<ATC is a short-run operate / long-run exit case, not a reason to add capacity.

ECO-008.zh: 價格蓋得住AVC、蓋不住ATC：短期繼續生產（至少幫忙扛固定成本），長期退 出。不要一看到虧損就立刻關廠。
ECO-008.core_idea: If ATC>P≥AVC the firm produces in the short run and exits in the long run
ECO-008.exam_trap: Treating any P<ATC as an immediate shutdown
ECO-008.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-009.reasoning: Reasoning: Below AVC, producing fails to cover even avoidable variable cost. Shutdown is immediate. The “operate because fixed cost is sunk” argument applies only when P≥AVC.

why_wrong.A: Sunk fixed cost justifies operating only while P covers AVC. Below AVC, each unit adds a cash loss.
why_wrong.B: A price taker does not advertise, and the shutdown test is AVC, not ATC.

ECO-009.zh: P 低於AVC 就要立刻停產。固定成本沉沒只能支持「還蓋得住變動成本」的短期 續產。
ECO-009.core_idea: If price falls below AVC the firm should shut down immediately
ECO-009.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-010.reasoning: Reasoning: Constant returns: all inputs ×X →output ×X, unit cost unchanged. Economies of scale: growing the firm lowers unit cost. They are not synonyms for P=ATC.

why_wrong.A: Reverses the two definitions.
why_wrong.B: Min LRATC is the PC long-run size; it is not a definition of either scaling concept.

ECO-010.zh: 規模報酬不變：投入乘X、產出也乘X，單位成本不變。規模經濟：變大後單位 成本下降。兩者不是損益兩平的別稱。
ECO-010.core_idea: Constant returns: scale inputs by X scales output by X; economies of scale: unit cost falls as the firm grows
ECO-010.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-011.reasoning: Reasoning: A unique-enough product gives negatively sloped demand. Extra sales require a lower price, so MR lies below P. Average revenue is still the price, so P=AR and P>MR.

why_wrong.B: The notes have P>MR (and P=AR) under downward demand, not P<MR.
why_wrong.C: Price-taker equality P=MR=AR is perfect competition, not differentiated demand.

ECO-011.zh: 有差異化，需求往下斜：多賣要降價，所以P>MR，但P 仍等於AR。
ECO-011.core_idea: Differentiated product: downward demand, P=f(Q), so P>MR and P=AR
ECO-011.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-012.reasoning: Reasoning: With downward demand there is no supply function. Profit max is still MR=MC; the price that clears that quantity is read from demand, and that price exceeds MR.

why_wrong.A: Advertising defends differentiation; it does not make demand horizontal or force P=MR.
why_wrong.C: MC-above-AVC as supply is the perfect-competition construction.

ECO-012.zh: 獨占性競爭沒有供給函數：MR=MC 定產量，再從需求曲線讀價格。
ECO-012.core_idea: Monopolistic competition has no supply function; Q from MR=MC, P from demand
ECO-012.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-013.reasoning: Reasoning: Differentiation slants demand, so P>MR. Low barriers still let entry compete the rent away: long-run break-even is P=ATC and zero economic profit. Do not read “P>MR” as “positive profit forever.”

why_wrong.A: Horizontal demand and min LRATC describe perfect competition.
why_wrong.B: P>MR does not lock in economic profit when entry barriers are low. Entry drives P to ATC.

ECO-013.zh: P>MR 只代表需求往下斜，不代表長期一定有超額利潤。進出容易，長期仍會 P=ATC、經濟利潤為零。
ECO-013.core_idea: Low entry still pushes the typical monopolistic competitor to P=ATC and zero economic profit
ECO-013.exam_trap: Reading P>MR as lasting economic profit
ECO-013.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-014.reasoning: Reasoning: PC products are homogeneous, so advertising is not needed. Under monopolistic competition, advertising can support profit by defending differentiation. It does not create a permanent rent once entry is free.

why_wrong.B: Low entry still pushes the typical firm to break-even; advertising defends differentiation, it does not repeal entry.
why_wrong.C: The notes say advertising does not help a monopolist’s profit; it does help under monopolistic competition.

ECO-014.zh: 獨占性競爭靠廣告守住差異化。完全競爭不必廣告；獨占的廣告也幫不上利潤。 自由進出仍會把長期經濟利潤壓向零。
ECO-014.core_idea: Advertising can support monopolistic-competition profit because it defends differentiation
ECO-014.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-015.reasoning: Reasoning: Zero long-run economic profit appears in both, but the mechanism differs: PC combines a homogeneous good with free entry; monopolistic competition keeps a downward demand curve and still cannot stop entry.

why_wrong.A: Only PC has horizontal firm demand.
why_wrong.B: Barriers are very low / low, not high, in these two structures.

ECO-015.zh: 兩邊長期經濟利潤都可以接近零，原因不同：一邊是同質＋自由進出，另一邊是 有差異化仍擋不住進入。
ECO-015.core_idea: PC and monopolistic competition can both reach zero LR profit for different reasons
ECO-015.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-016.reasoning: Reasoning: Oligopoly is few firms, high barriers, and interdependence. MR=MC still sets output; demand is downward, so there is no well-defined supply curve. Advertising is heavy and collusion is tempting.

why_wrong.A: That is monopolistic competition (plus a PC supply-curve error).
why_wrong.C: That mix is monopoly plus a PC demand-curve error.

ECO-016.zh: 寡占是少數廠商、高障礙、彼此牽制。產量仍看MR=MC，沒有明確供給曲線。
ECO-016.core_idea: Oligopoly: few sellers, high barriers, strategic interdependence; still MR=MC; no supply curve
ECO-016.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-017.reasoning: Reasoning: The kinked model: rivals match a cut (they will not be undercut) and do not match a hike (they take the share). Demand is therefore more elastic above the current price and less elastic below it.

why_wrong.B: Sequential quantity is Stackelberg.
why_wrong.C: Fixed rival output is Cournot, not kinked demand.

ECO-017.zh: Kinked：對手跟跌不跟漲。需求在現價上方較有彈性、下方較沒彈性。那不是 Cournot，也不是Stackelberg。
ECO-017.core_idea: Kinked demand: rivals match a price cut, not a price increase
ECO-017.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-018.reasoning: Reasoning: More elastic demand above the current price and less elastic demand below it can keep the observed price from moving. The model does not itself pick that price.

why_wrong.A: Collusion is tempting but usually not a Nash outcome; kinked demand is a stickiness story, not a cartel proof.
why_wrong.C: The notes say the model does not determine what the price is.

ECO-018.zh: Kinked 解釋「為什麼現價可能黏住」，不負責算出那個價格是多少。不要把它當成 求均衡價的公式。
ECO-018.core_idea: Kinked demand explains a sticky observed price; it does not determine what that price is
ECO-018.exam_trap: Treating kinked demand as a price-determination model
ECO-018.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-019.reasoning: Reasoning: Cournot: each firm maximizes taking the other firm’s output as given. Market demand is Q_D=q_1+q_2. In long-run equilibrium neither firm can raise profit by changing its own quantity while the other holds still.

why_wrong.B: Leader-then-follower quantity is Stackelberg.
why_wrong.C: Match-cutsnot-hikes is kinked demand.

ECO-019.zh: Cournot 是「把對手產量當成給定」再選自己的q。市場需求是兩家產量相加。
ECO-019.core_idea: Cournot: each firm chooses output taking the other firm’s output as given
ECO-019.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-020.reasoning: Reasoning: Cournot equilibrium is a rest point in quantities: given the other firm’s q, a unilateral change in own q does not raise profit. Price is then whatever demand assigns to the summed output.

why_wrong.B: A first mover is Stackelberg; Cournot is simultaneous.
why_wrong.C: That mixes kinked-demand price matching with Cournot’s quantity story.

ECO-020.zh: Cournot 長期均衡是產量穩定：對手不動時，自己改q 也抬不高利潤。
ECO-020.core_idea: Cournot long-run equilibrium: neither firm can raise profit by changing its own quantity while the other holds still
ECO-020.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-021.reasoning: Reasoning: Nash: no unilateral deviation raises profit given the others’ actions. Cournot is one such outcome. A cartel price is usually not, because each member wants the others to restrict output while it sells more.

why_wrong.A: Kinked demand does not determine the price and is not the Nash definition.
why_wrong.C: Joint-profit max is the collusive aim; secretly expanding is why a cartel is usually not Nash.

ECO-021.zh: Nash 是「別人不動，自己改策略也賺不了更多」。Cournot 是其中一種；卡特爾通 常不是。
ECO-021.core_idea: Nash: no firm can increase profit by changing its own price or output, given what the others are doing
ECO-021.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-022.reasoning: Reasoning: Collusion would raise the joint price, but the agreement is usually not Nash: the best unilateral reply is to sell more while others stay restricted. That is why cartels are hard to sustain.

why_wrong.B: Kinked demand says rivals do not match a hike; it does not make a cartel Nash or cheating impossible.
why_wrong.C: Cournot is a non-cooperative quantity Nash, not a joint-profit maximum.

ECO-022.zh: 卡特爾大家一起限產對全體較好，但對單一會員最好的是別人限產、自己偷賣。 所以通常不是Nash，也難維持。
ECO-022.core_idea: A collusive cartel price is usually not Nash because each member wants to cheat
ECO-022.exam_trap: Treating a cartel price as a Nash equilibrium
ECO-022.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-023.reasoning: Reasoning: The notes list the conditions that make collusion easier: few firms or a dominant firm, a homogeneous product, similar costs, frequent small orders, and less likely retaliation.

why_wrong.B: Those features make monitoring and punishment harder, not easier.
why_wrong.C: That is the perfect-competition setting, where collusion is not the structure.

ECO-023.zh: 家數少或有龍頭、產品同質、成本接近、訂單又小又密、報復較不容易——卡特 爾比較站得住。
ECO-023.core_idea: Collusion is more likely when firms are few or one is dominant, the product is homogeneous, costs are similar, orders are frequent and small, and retaliation is less likely
ECO-023.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-024.reasoning: Reasoning: Stackelberg keeps the quantity game but drops simultaneity: the leader moves first, the follower reacts. Do not attach kinked-demand price matching to it.

why_wrong.A: Cournot is simultaneous; matching price cuts is kinked demand.
why_wrong.B: Stackelberg in the notes is sequential quantity, not a kinked-price model.

ECO-024.zh: Stackelberg 還是比產量，只是改成先後手：領導者先選，跟隨者再反應。
ECO-024.core_idea: Stackelberg is the same quantity game, but firms move sequentially: leader first, follower reacts
ECO-024.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-025.reasoning: Reasoning: The price cut drives high-cost rivals out, so the dominant firm’s share rises in the short run. In the long run that share tends to fall as remaining participants share the profits.

why_wrong.A: Shares and HHI can move; the notes’ point is the time path of the dominant firm’s share, not a frozen CR.
why_wrong.B: Reverses the two horizons.

ECO-025.zh: 龍頭降價，小廠寧可退出也不賠本賣，短期市占上升；長期剩餘者一起分利潤， 龍頭市占往往回落。
ECO-025.core_idea: Dominant firm: short-run share rises after a price cut; long-run share tends to fall
ECO-025.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-026.reasoning: Reasoning: The output rule is still MR=MC. Price comes from demand and exceeds MR. Economic profit can persist and may be spent defending the monopoly.

why_wrong.B: Monopoly has no supply curve in the notes.
why_wrong.C: P=MR requires horizontal demand; monopoly demand is downward. Very high barriers, not free entry, are the structure.

ECO-026.zh: 獨占一樣MR=MC 定產量，再從需求讀P。高障礙讓經濟利潤可以留下，還可能 被拿去保衛獨占。
ECO-026.core_idea: A single-price monopolist produces at MR=MC and reads price from demand; economic profit may persist
ECO-026.study_section: Monopoly and Concentration ｜獨占與集中度
ECO-026.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-026.subtopic: 3.5 Monopoly and Concentration ｜獨占與集中度

ECO-027.reasoning: Reasoning: CR_N is the sum of the largest N percentage shares (0 to 100). It is a proxy, not a measure of market power: it misses elasticity, and some mergers do not move it.

why_wrong.A: The notes say a high share need not mean pricing power if entry is easy. Both CR and HHI ignore barriers.
why_wrong.B: Squaring shares is HHI. A merger of two firms not both among the largest N — or that only reshuffles shares inside the top group — can leave CR_N unchanged.

ECO-027.zh: N 家集中度是最大N 家市占相加（0 到100），不反映彈性。高市占若進出容易， 也不等於定價能力。
ECO-027.core_idea: Concentration is a proxy for market power, not a measure of it; CR_N ignores elasticity
ECO-027.study_section: Monopoly and Concentration ｜獨占與集中度
ECO-027.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-027.subtopic: 3.5 Monopoly and Concentration ｜獨占與集中度

ECO-028.reasoning: Reasoning: HHI uses the percentage numbers, not decimals, then sums the squares. 50²+25²+15²+10²=2,500+625+225+100=3,450. Given: s = 50, 25, 15, 10 (percentage points). Asked: HHI. Formula: HHI = ∑ i s2 i Variables: s_i = firm i’s percentage market share. Why this formula: The notes square the percentage numbers, not the decimals, then add. The index is 3,450 on the usual 0-to-10,000 percentage-point scale. Reasonableness check: 0.345 is the decimal-share version. 100 is CR_4. Neither is HHI as defined in the notes. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: That is the sum of the shares (CR_4), not HHI.
why_wrong.C: That is the sum of squared decimal shares (0.50²+0.25²+0.15²+0.10²), not the notes’ percentage-point convention.

ECO-028.zh: HHI 用百分點平方再加總，不是小數平方。四家市占相加是CR_4，不是HHI。
ECO-028.core_idea: HHI squares percentage shares (not decimals) and then sums
ECO-028.study_section: Monopoly and Concentration ｜獨占與集中度
ECO-028.exam_trap: Squaring decimal shares instead of percentage points
ECO-028.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-028.subtopic: 3.5 Monopoly and Concentration ｜獨占與集中度

ECO-029.reasoning: Reasoning: CR_2 uses only the largest two shares (50+25=75) before and after. HHI uses every squared share, and (a+b)2=a2+b2+2ab>a2+b2, so HHI rises from 3,450 to 50²+25²+25²=3,750. Given: Before: 50, 25, 15, 10. After merge of 15 and 10: 50, 25, 25. Asked: CR_2 and HHI before vs after. Formula: CR2 = s(1) + s(2); HHI = ∑ i s2 i ; (a + b)2 > a2 + b2 Variables: s_(1), s_(2) = two largest percentage shares. Why this formula: CR_2 ignores firms outside the top two. HHI does not, and combining shares adds the cross-term 2ab. The merger is invisible to CR_2 and visible to HHI. Reasonableness check: If HHI were unchanged, the 2ab cross-term would have to be zero. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: The top two shares are still 50 and 25, so CR_2 stays 75; HHI must rise when any two shares are combined.
why_wrong.C: A merger does not reduce HHI; squaring a combined share increases it. CR_2 is still 75, not 100.

ECO-029.zh: 兩家小的合併：最大兩家還是50 與25，CR_2 仍75。HHI 會上升，因為合併後 平方大於分開平方之和。
ECO-029.core_idea: Merging two firms raises HHI because (a+b)2 > a2+b2; CR_N may be unchanged
ECO-029.study_section: Monopoly and Concentration ｜獨占與集中度
ECO-029.exam_trap: Reading an unchanged CR_N as an unchanged HHI
ECO-029.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-029.subtopic: 3.5 Monopoly and Concentration ｜獨占與集中度

ECO-030.reasoning: Reasoning: HHI is a concentration proxy. It does not measure elasticity, and it does not include entry barriers. A high share need not mean pricing power if entry is easy.

why_wrong.A: The notes state that both statistics ignore barriers to entry.
why_wrong.C: The notes give no such HHI monopoly threshold and do not equate the proxy with power.

ECO-030.zh: HHI 高只代表集中度代理變數高。彈性與進出障礙它都沒算進去，所以不能直接 等於定價能力。
ECO-030.core_idea: Both CR and HHI ignore barriers to entry; a high share need not mean pricing power if entry is easy
ECO-030.study_section: Monopoly and Concentration ｜獨占與集中度
ECO-030.exam_trap: Treating HHI as a direct measure of pricing power
ECO-030.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-030.subtopic: 3.5 Monopoly and Concentration ｜獨占與集中度

ECO-031.reasoning: Reasoning: Three measurement conventions change when turning points are dated. Volume GDP is the classical cycle. Distance from potential/trend is the growth cycle. The growth rate of GDP is the growth-rate cycle and is dated earlier.

why_wrong.A: Reverses classical and growth-cycle objects and the timing claim.
why_wrong.B: The notes say the growth-rate cycle recognizes peaks and troughs earlier — the dating is not identical.

ECO-031.zh: 古典看實質GDP 水準；成長循環看相對潛能／趨勢；成長率循環看GDP 成長 率，轉折會較早被認出來。
ECO-031.core_idea: Classical cycle: GDP in volume; growth cycle: vs potential/trend; growth-rate cycle: GDP growth rate, turns earlier
ECO-031.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-032.reasoning: Reasoning: The classical cycle uses volume GDP. Contractions are peak-to-trough and, in the notes, short relative to expansions.

why_wrong.B: A still-positive gap with decelerating growth is the slowdown phase, not the definition of a classical contraction.
why_wrong.C: Longer-than-expansion dating is not the classical statement; earlier recognition is the growth-rate cycle.

ECO-032.zh: 古典循環用數量GDP；收縮是高峰到谷底，而且相對擴張較短。
ECO-032.core_idea: Classical contractions (peak to trough) are short relative to expansions
ECO-032.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-033.reasoning: Reasoning: The useful object is the causal chain, not the label, but the dating order is recovery (trough) →expansion →slowdown (peak) →contraction.

why_wrong.A: Recovery is the trough phase; it is not placed after expansion.
why_wrong.B: Slowdown is the peak phase, not the starting phase.

ECO-033.zh: 四階段由谷到谷：復甦→擴張→趨緩（高峰）→收縮。重點是因果鏈，不是標 籤本身。
ECO-033.core_idea: Four phases dated trough to trough: recovery, expansion, slowdown (peak), contraction
ECO-033.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-034.reasoning: Reasoning: At the trough, sales come back before production fully responds, so inventories are drawn down and I/S falls. The notes treat that as the recovery inventory signature.

why_wrong.A: I/S also moves in recovery and slowdown, not only in contraction.
why_wrong.B: Overproduction that lifts I/S is the slowdown pattern (sales slow first).

ECO-034.zh: 復甦時銷售先於生產回溫，庫存被抽掉，I/S 下降。I/S 上升是趨緩（銷售先慢下 來）。
ECO-034.core_idea: Recovery: negative gap; I/S falls because sales revive faster than production
ECO-034.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-035.reasoning: Reasoning: Slowdown is the peak: utilization is still above potential, but growth has already cooled. Sales slow before production, so I/S rises. Contraction is when the gap is negative again and production is cut below sales.

why_wrong.A: Negative gap plus falling I/S is recovery.
why_wrong.C: A negative gap plus production below sales is contraction, not slowdown.

ECO-035.zh: 趨緩時缺口仍為正，但成長已低於平均且在減速；銷售先慢，I/S 上升。缺口轉 負、產量低於銷售是收縮。
ECO-035.core_idea: Slowdown: gap still positive but growth below average and decelerating; I/S rises as sales slow
ECO-035.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-036.reasoning: Reasoning: In contraction the gap is negative again. Hours are cut, then come a hiring freeze and layoffs. Heavy construction is cut first. Production is pushed below sales so I/S returns toward normal. Inflation lags the demand drop.

why_wrong.A: Producing above sales would raise I/S further; the contraction response is to produce below sales.
why_wrong.B: Heavy construction is cut first, then short-lead equipment — the reverse of the distractor.

ECO-036.zh: 收縮期把產量壓到銷售以下去消化庫存。通膨會落後。重型營建先砍，不是先加。
ECO-036.core_idea: Contraction: hours cut then layoffs; heavy construction cut first; production below sales; inflation lags
ECO-036.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-037.reasoning: Reasoning: Expansion writes better profits into asset prices. Late in the phase, scarce labor and plant cap the supply response. Capacity that was overbuilt then weighs on later investment.

why_wrong.A: Overtime-not-hire and light capex are recovery traits.
why_wrong.C: When expansion is expected, risky assets are repriced upward and higher profit expectations are written into bond and stock prices.

ECO-037.zh: 擴張末期人力與產能變緊，需求再來也擴不快；過度投資本身會壓到後面的資本 支出。
ECO-037.core_idea: Late expansion: worker and plant shortages limit the response to demand; overinvestment can cut later capex
ECO-037.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-038.reasoning: Reasoning: Credit cycles track private-sector liquidity (loans, investment, real estate) and last longer than business cycles. Easy credit in a strong economy can feed bubbles and the crises that follow.

why_wrong.B: The growth-rate cycle is a GDP-dating convention, not the credit cycle, and credit cycles last longer.
why_wrong.C: I/S is a lagging indicator, not a definition of the credit cycle.

ECO-038.zh: 信用週期看民間流動性，持續時間比景氣循環長。景氣好會放寬信用，可能養出 資產與房地產泡沫。
ECO-038.core_idea: Credit cycles last longer than business cycles and can feed asset-price and real-estate bubbles
ECO-038.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-039.reasoning: Reasoning: Leading: turns before the cycle. Coincident: with it. Lagging: after it. The classification is about timing, not about whether the series is “real” or “financial.”

why_wrong.B: That is a lagging indicator.
why_wrong.C: That is a coincident indicator.

ECO-039.zh: 領先是週期還沒轉、序列先轉；同時是一起轉；落後是週期已轉、這支才跟上。
ECO-039.core_idea: Leading turns before the cycle; coincident with it; lagging after it
ECO-039.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-040.reasoning: Reasoning: Permits, equity prices, and initial claims turn before the cycle in the notes’ list. Industrial production and payroll-income/sales are coincident. Unemployment duration, unit labor cost, and installment-debt/income are lagging.

why_wrong.A: That trio is coincident.
why_wrong.B: That trio is lagging.

ECO-040.zh: 許可、股價、初次申領失業金是領先。工業生產是同時。失業持續期間、單位勞 動成本、分期負債比是落後。
ECO-040.core_idea: Building permits, equity prices, and initial jobless claims are leading
ECO-040.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-041.reasoning: Reasoning: Coincident indicators move with the cycle. Industrial production is in that list and is described as tracking the current goods cycle better than services.

why_wrong.B: Lagging production-after-duration is not the notes’ classification.
why_wrong.C: The notes put industrial production in the coincident list, not the leading list.

ECO-041.zh: 工業生產是同時指標，而且比較能追商品週期、不是服務週期。不要把它記成領 先或落後。
ECO-041.core_idea: Industrial production is coincident and tracks the current goods cycle better than services
ECO-041.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-042.reasoning: Reasoning: Unemployment duration lengthens after layoffs have already occurred, so it lags. Capital-goods orders and the term spread are on the leading list.

why_wrong.A: The term spread is leading; a wider spread is the constructive signal.
why_wrong.B: New orders for non-defense capital goods ex-aircraft are leading.

ECO-042.zh: 失業持續期間是裁員之後才拉長，所以是落後。資本財訂單與期限利差是領先。
ECO-042.core_idea: Average duration of unemployment, I/S, unit labor cost, and installment debt/income are lagging
ECO-042.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-043.reasoning: Reasoning: I/S rises late because sales have already slowed. That is why it lags rather than leads. The notes give a 10–20% usual band and treat a smaller ratio as constructive.

why_wrong.A: Industrial production is the coincident goods tracker; I/S is lagging.
why_wrong.C: I/S does rise in slowdown as sales slow, but the notes still classify it as lagging — it follows the cycle rather than forecasting it.

ECO-043.zh: I/S 在擴張末期因銷售已慢而上升，所以是落後不是領先。較小的比率才是偏正面 訊號。
ECO-043.core_idea: I/S is lagging; a smaller ratio is constructive; usual operating range is a 10–20% band
ECO-043.exam_trap: Treating a rising I/S as a leading forecast of the peak
ECO-043.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-044.reasoning: Reasoning: On the leading list, a wider 10y–fed-funds spread and higher ISM orders/output/employment are constructive. On the lagging list, a smaller I/S is constructive.

why_wrong.A: A larger I/S is not the constructive signal; a smaller ratio is.
why_wrong.B: Narrower spread / lower ISM are the weaker readings, not the constructive ones.

ECO-044.zh: 期限利差走寬、ISM 走高是領先面的正面訊號。I/S 較大不是正面，較小才是。
ECO-044.core_idea: Wider 10-year minus fed-funds spread is the constructive leading signal; higher ISM is constructive
ECO-044.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-045.reasoning: Reasoning: The notes place equity prices, house prices, and retail sales on the leading list. Follow that list; do not reclassify retail sales as coincident from outside memory.

why_wrong.A: The coincident list is industrial production, real personal income on non-farm payrolls, and manufacturing and trade sales — not retail sales or house prices.
why_wrong.B: Installment debt/income is lagging; retail sales and house prices are not on that list.

ECO-045.zh: 這份筆記把零售與房價放在領先，不要用外面記憶改成同時指標。同時名單是工 業生產、非農實質所得、製造與貿易銷售。
ECO-045.core_idea: Retail sales and house prices are leading in these notes
ECO-045.exam_trap: Reclassifying the notes’ leading retail sales as coincident
ECO-045.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-046.reasoning: Reasoning: Diffusion asks how many components agree with the index’s direction. It is a consensus statistic, not a new macro variable and not a synonym for nowcasting.

why_wrong.A: Nowcasting is real-time monitoring of series to read current conditions; it is not the diffusion-index definition.
why_wrong.C: That is the growth-rate cycle, not a diffusion index.

ECO-046.zh: 擴散指數是「有多少成分和整體同方向」的共識讀數，不是新的經濟變數，也不是 nowcasting。
ECO-046.core_idea: A diffusion index is the percentage of components moving with the overall index — a consensus reading
ECO-046.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-047.reasoning: Reasoning: Nowcasting uses timely series to read the current state of the economy instead of waiting for GDP that arrives late and is then revised.

why_wrong.A: That is closer to a diffusion reading, not nowcasting.
why_wrong.C: Nowcasting is about the present, not a lagging confirmation.

ECO-047.zh: Nowcasting 是即時讀「現在」的經濟與金融序列，而不是等已過時的GDP。
ECO-047.core_idea: Nowcasting monitors current conditions in real time rather than waiting for dated GDP
ECO-047.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-048.reasoning: Reasoning: Hours and expectations turn before hiring and spending fully show up. C&I loans outstanding adjust after the credit cycle has already turned, so they lag.

why_wrong.A: Reverses the leading/lagging assignment.
why_wrong.B: Hours are on the leading list, not coincident; expectations are leading, not lagging.

ECO-048.zh: 消費者預期與製造業週工時是領先；工商貸款餘額是落後。不要對調。
ECO-048.core_idea: Consumer expectations and average weekly manufacturing hours are leading; C&I loans outstanding are lagging
ECO-048.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-049.reasoning: Reasoning: Both aim at stable, positive growth and stable, low inflation. Fiscal = taxes and spending (and redistribution / allocation). Monetary = money and credit, and it typically acts faster.

why_wrong.A: Monetary policy is aimed at stable growth and low inflation; it is not described as inflation-irrelevant.
why_wrong.C: Taxation, spending, redistribution, and resource allocation are fiscal.

ECO-049.zh: 財政用稅與支出；貨幣用貨幣與信用數量，而且通常較快。兩邊目標都是穩定成 長與低通膨。
ECO-049.core_idea: Fiscal uses taxation and spending; monetary uses money and credit and typically acts faster
ECO-049.study_section: Fiscal and Monetary Policy ｜財政與貨幣政策
ECO-049.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-049.subtopic: 3.8 Fiscal and Monetary Policy ｜財政與貨幣政策

ECO-050.reasoning: Reasoning: Keynesians treat fiscal policy as effective on AD and output when spare capacity is substantial. Monetarists treat the real effect as temporary and prefer monetary policy to handle inflation.

why_wrong.A: That is the monetarist position in the notes.
why_wrong.B: That is closer to a classical full-employment setting, not the Keynesian spare-capacity case.

ECO-050.zh: 凱因斯：閒置產能（含失業）夠大時，財政才能拉AD 與產出。貨幣學派：實質 效果短暫，通膨交給貨幣政策。
ECO-050.core_idea: Keynesians: fiscal effective on AD when spare capacity is substantial; monetarists: real effect temporary
ECO-050.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-051.reasoning: Reasoning: The notes split three tools: transfers (not in GDP), current operations (skills / productivity), and infrastructure capex (potential output).

why_wrong.B: Transfers are not counted in GDP; capex is the potential-output tool.
why_wrong.C: Current spending is regular operations (and is not the “omitted from GDP” item). Transfers do not raise potential output in this pairing.

ECO-051.zh: 移轉支付不計入GDP。經常支出影響技能與勞動生產力。資本支出影響潛在產 出。
ECO-051.core_idea: Transfers are not counted in GDP; current spending affects skills; capex affects potential output
ECO-051.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-052.reasoning: Reasoning: Direct taxes hit income and wealth: slower to change, more powerful. Indirect taxes on goods and services can be adjusted more quickly.

why_wrong.B: Combines the speed of indirect taxes with the power of direct taxes.
why_wrong.C: Quicker is the indirect-tax trait.

ECO-052.zh: 直接稅較慢但較有力；間接稅較快。不要把速度與力度記反。
ECO-052.core_idea: Direct taxes are slower and more powerful; indirect taxes are quicker
ECO-052.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-053.reasoning: Reasoning: A tax system is judged on simplicity, efficiency (limited interference), fairness, and revenue sufficiency. Fairness splits into horizontal equity (similar situations treated similarly) and vertical equity (higher incomes pay more).

why_wrong.B: That is vertical equity.
why_wrong.C: Revenue sufficiency is a separate criterion; efficiency is limited interference.

ECO-053.zh: 水平公平是相同情況同等對待；垂直公平是高所得多繳。夠不夠用是財政充足， 不是公平的定義。
ECO-053.core_idea: Fairness: horizontal equity treats similar situations similarly; vertical equity has higher incomes pay more
ECO-053.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-054.reasoning: Reasoning: The damaging-debt list includes crowding out: the government borrows, interest rates rise, and private investment is displaced. Do not swap that mechanism for tax-financed spending or for Ricardian saving.

why_wrong.A: That is Ricardian equivalence, a different argument.
why_wrong.B: That is the balanced-budget / tax-financed-G confusion. Tax-financed G is not AD-neutral when MPC<1, and it is not the crowding-out definition.

ECO-054.zh: 排擠是「政府借錢→利率升→民間投資被擠掉」。加稅融通不是這個機制；李嘉 圖等價是民間預先多存稅。
ECO-054.core_idea: Crowding out: government borrowing raises interest rates and displaces private investment
ECO-054.exam_trap: Swapping crowding-out for tax-financed G or Ricardian equivalence
ECO-054.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-055.reasoning: Reasoning: The government spends the whole extra dollar. Households, facing one extra dollar of tax, cut consumption by only c<1; the rest comes out of saving. First-round AD therefore rises by 1-c. Seeing “financed by an equal tax increase” is not a reason to choose “AD unchanged.”

why_wrong.A: The tax reduces consumption by c, not by more than ∆G. First-round AD changes by 1-c>0.
why_wrong.C: The budget identity can be unchanged while AD is not. Offsetting G with T in the budget is not the same as offsetting them in AD.

ECO-055.zh: 預算平衡只表示G 與稅同一筆，不表示AD 抵銷。政府整塊花出去；家庭只少消 費MPC 那一塊。第一輪AD 增加1-c。
ECO-055.core_idea: Tax-financed G is not AD-neutral: government spends the whole extra dollar; households cut consumption by only c<1
ECO-055.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-056.reasoning: Reasoning: G injects 80. The matching tax cuts consumption by c×80=0.75×80=60. First-round AD rises by 80-60=20, which is also (1-c)×80. Given: ∆G = ∆T = 80; c = 0.75. Asked: First-round change in AD. Formula: ∆AD1 = (1 −c)∆G Variables: c = MPC out of disposable income. Why this formula: G is spent in full; households cut consumption by only the MPC slice of the tax. The budget is still balanced and first-round AD is not: MPC<1 leaves 20 of extra demand. Reasonableness check: 0 is the AD-neutral trap. 80 ignores the consumption cut. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
ECO-056.steps: ①Injection from G = 80 ②Consumption cut = 0.75 × 80 = 60 ③First-round ∆AD = 80 - 60 = 20 ④Check: (1 - 0.75) × 80 = 0.25 × 80 = 20

why_wrong.B: That is the balanced-budget intuition that AD does not move.
why_wrong.C: That would be the first-round effect of debt-financed G with no tax, or of treating the tax as having no consumption effect.

ECO-056.zh: 政府多花80，家庭只少消費60，第一輪AD 多20。選0 就是把預算恆等式當成 AD 恆等式。
ECO-056.core_idea: Tax-financed G: first-round AD rises by (1-c)∆G
ECO-056.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-057.reasoning: Reasoning: First-round AD rises by (1-0.80)×80=16. The recycled fraction is c(1- t)=0.80×0.75=0.60, so the multiplier is 1/0.40=2.5. Equilibrium output rises by 16×2.5=40. The budget can be unchanged while Y is not. Given: ∆G = ∆T = 80; c = 0.80; t = 0.25. Asked: Change in equilibrium output after the first-round increment is multiplied. Formula: ∆Y = (1 −c)∆G × 1 −c(1 −t) Variables: c = MPC; t = proportional tax rate. Why this formula: The notes: first-round AD rises by 1-c; that increment then runs through 1/[1-c(1-t)]. Balanced-budget G still raises Y because MPC<1; the full no-tax ∆G effect of 200 is the wrong experiment. Reasonableness check: 0 cancels G against T in AD. 200 is 2.5×80 with the tax ignored. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: That is the notes’ worked ∆G-only example (multiplier 2.5 times 80) and ignores the matching tax.
why_wrong.C: That is the AD-neutral balanced-budget trap.

ECO-057.zh: 第一輪只多16（因為加稅會少掉0.8 的消費），再乘2.5 得到40。選0 是AD 中 性陷阱；選200 是只加G、忘了配套的稅。
ECO-057.core_idea: The first-round increment from tax-financed G then runs through the fiscal multiplier
ECO-057.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-058.reasoning: Reasoning: Do not merge the two stories. Borrowing can raise rates and crowd out private I. Paying for G with taxes is a different experiment: the budget may balance while AD still rises because MPC<1. Ricardian equivalence is a third, separate argument.

why_wrong.B: The two channels are different, and a surplus is not required for AD to rise.
why_wrong.C: The notes do not treat either as automatically AD-neutral. Tax-financed G raises first-round AD by 1-c. Crowding out is about displaced investment, not a complete AD wipeout by assumption.

ECO-058.zh: 排擠＝借錢推升利率、擠掉民間投資。加稅融通＝預算可平衡但AD 仍增 （MPC<1）。兩者不是同一條機制，更不是自動AD 中性。
ECO-058.core_idea: Crowding-out is a borrowing/interest-rate channel; tax-financed G is a separate MPC channel that still raises AD
ECO-058.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-059.reasoning: Reasoning: Ricardian households treat deficit-financed G as future taxes and save the impulse away. That is an argument for using monetary rather than fiscal policy. It is not crowding out and not the MPC<1 balanced-budget story.

why_wrong.A: That is crowding out.
why_wrong.C: That is the tax-financed-G AD argument, which goes the other way: the impulse is not fully discounted to zero.

ECO-059.zh: 李嘉圖等價：民間知道以後要加稅，今天先多存，財政衝動被折現掉。這不是排 擠，也不是「加稅融通仍刺激AD」。
ECO-059.core_idea: Ricardian equivalence: the private sector may save more today because it sees future taxes
ECO-059.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-060.reasoning: Reasoning: Resident-held debt used for capital investment is the notes’ more defensible case. Damaging cases: taxes that discourage work and entrepreneurship; lost confidence that leads to printing money; crowding out.

why_wrong.A: That is another damaging case.
why_wrong.C: That is one of the damaging cases.

ECO-060.zh: 債若由居民持有、又用在資本投資，比較說得通。傷工作誘因的稅、印鈔、排擠， 是有問題的情況。
ECO-060.core_idea: Debt owned by residents and used for capital investment is the more defensible case
ECO-060.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-061.reasoning: Reasoning: Household spending recycles c(1-t)=0.75×0.80=0.60 of each round. The leakages take 0.40, so the sum of rounds is 1/0.40=2.50. Given: c = 0.75; t = 0.20; leakages are saving and the proportional tax only. Asked: Fiscal multiplier ∆Y/∆G. Formula: fiscal multiplier = 1 −c(1 −t) Variables: c = MPC; t = tax rate on national income; Y_D=(1-t)Y. Why this formula: The first round is spent in full (numerator 1). Each later round comes back only as c times the disposable slice (1-t). A 1 increase in G raises equilibrium Y by 2.50 if those are the only leakages. Reasonableness check: 4.00 ignores t. 1.67 inverts the recycle fraction instead of the leakage fraction. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
ECO-061.steps: ①Disposable recycle fraction = c(1 - t) = 0.75 × 0.80 = 0.60 ②Leakage fraction = 1 - 0.60 = 0.40 ③Multiplier = 1 / 0.40 = 2.50

why_wrong.B: 1/(1-c)=1/0.25=4, which drops the tax leakage.
why_wrong.C: 1/[c(1- t)]=1/0.60=1.67, which is the recycled fraction inverted, not the multiplier.

ECO-061.zh: 先算回收率c(1-t)=0.60，乘數是1/0.40=2.5。選4 是忘了稅；選1.67 是把回收率 直接倒數。
ECO-061.core_idea: Fiscal multiplier = 1/[1-c(1-t)]; larger c raises it, larger t lowers it
ECO-061.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-062.reasoning: Reasoning: The recycled fraction is c(1-t). Larger c puts more of each round back into demand. Larger t leaks more into taxes and shrinks the multiplier without a new statute — the automaticstabilizer role of an income tax.

why_wrong.A: A larger t lowers the multiplier: more of each round is taxed away. That is why an income tax is an automatic stabilizer.
why_wrong.C: Automatic stabilizers reduce the multiplier; they do not raise it.

ECO-062.zh: c 愈大、乘數愈大；t 愈大、乘數愈小。所得稅因此是自動穩定因子：不用新立法 就會縮小乘數。
ECO-062.core_idea: A larger c raises the multiplier; a larger t lowers it; an income tax is an automatic stabilizer
ECO-062.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-063.reasoning: Reasoning: c(1-t)=0.75×0.80=0.60, multiplier=1/0.40=2.50, so ∆Y=2.50×60=150. Given: c = 0.75; t = 0.20; ∆G = 60. Asked: Change in equilibrium output. Formula: ∆Y = 1 −c(1 −t)∆G Variables: Multiplier = ∆Y/∆G. Why this formula: The notes apply the multiplier to extra autonomous government spending when the only leakages are saving and the proportional tax. Sixty of extra G becomes 150 of equilibrium output after recycled rounds. Reasonableness check: 240 drops t. 60 is the first-round G only. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: That is ∆G with a multiplier of 1.
why_wrong.C: That is 1/(1- c)×60=4×60, which drops the tax leakage.

ECO-063.zh: 乘數2.5 乘上60 等於150。選240 是只用1/(1-MPC)。選60 是沒有乘數。
ECO-063.core_idea: ∆Y = multiplier × ∆G; worked structure from the notes
ECO-063.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-064.reasoning: Reasoning: Automatic stabilizers (income tax, VAT, social benefits) shrink the multiplier without a new statute. Discretionary moves are legislated. Stance is read from the cyclically adjusted budget: a smaller deficit or larger surplus is contractionary. G alone is not the stance.

why_wrong.A: The cyclically adjusted budget, not the raw headline deficit, is the appropriate stance indicator. A narrower headline deficit can be the cycle, not tightening.
why_wrong.B: Reverses automatic vs discretionary: automatic stabilizers move with the cycle and do not require a policy change; discretionary adjustments are legislated.

ECO-064.zh: 看循環調整後預算，不要只看G。赤字下降（或盈餘上升）才是緊縮。自動穩定 因子隨週期動、不必新立法。
ECO-064.core_idea: The cyclically adjusted budget is the indicator of expansionary vs contractionary stance; looking only at G is not enough
ECO-064.exam_trap: Reading the headline deficit or G alone as the fiscal stance
ECO-064.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-065.reasoning: Reasoning: The notes list those operational roles. Fiscal tools (tax, spending, infrastructure) and the WTO’s trade mandate are different institutions.

why_wrong.A: Tax and infrastructure are fiscal tools; monetary policy typically acts faster, not slower.
why_wrong.C: WTO is the trade-rules body. Target independence is about who defines the inflation target, not a replacement for the listed CB roles.

ECO-065.zh: 央行是政府與銀行的銀行、最後貸款人、支付系統管理者、唯一發鈔者、銀行監 理者，並執行貨幣政策。稅與建設是財政；WTO 管貿易規則。
ECO-065.core_idea: Central-bank roles: banker to government and banks, LOLR, payments regulator, sole issuer, supervisor, policy conductor
ECO-065.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-066.reasoning: Reasoning: Open-market purchases, including QE, raise bank reserves and are expansionary. Sales reverse that. The policy rate then feeds into short-term rates, asset prices, the exchange rate, and expectations — and through those into inflation.

why_wrong.A: The notes treat purchases as raising reserves and as expansionary. QE is listed with open-market operations.
why_wrong.B: Sales, not purchases, drain reserves and are contractionary.

ECO-066.zh: 向銀行買債（含QE）會把準備金打上去，是寬鬆。賣債才是抽流動性。
ECO-066.core_idea: OMO/QE: bond purchases from banks raise reserves (expansionary); sales do the reverse
ECO-066.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-067.reasoning: Reasoning: Neutral = 2.5% + 2.0% = 4.5%. A policy rate of 5.5% is above that benchmark, so policy is tight. Direction: above neutral is contractionary relative to the benchmark. Given: Trend real growth = 2.5%; expected stable inflation = 2.0%; policy rate = 5.5%. Asked: Policy stance relative to the neutral rate. Formula: rneutral = gtrend + πe; tight if i > rneutral Variables: g_trend = long-run real growth; π^e = long-run expected stable inflation; i = policy rate. Why this formula: The notes add the two long-run pieces to get the benchmark, then compare the policy rate with that benchmark. The extra 100 bp above the benchmark is contractionary relative to the notes’ definition. Reasonableness check: Swapping “above” for “easy” reverses the stance. The notes do not replace the sum with inflation plus an output gap. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
ECO-067.steps: ①Neutral rate = 2.5% + 2.0% = 4.5% ②Policy rate - neutral = 5.5% - 4.5% = 1.0 percentage point ③Because i > neutral, policy is tight

why_wrong.A: Above-neutral is tight, not easy.
why_wrong.B: The notes define the neutral rate as trend real growth plus expected stable inflation, not inflation plus an output gap.

ECO-067.zh: 中性利率＝長期實質成長＋長期穩定通膨預期。政策利率高於它才叫緊。5.5% 對 4.5%，是緊不是鬆。
ECO-067.core_idea: Neutral rate = long-run trend real growth + long-run expected stable inflation; policy is tight when the policy rate is above it
ECO-067.exam_trap: Reading a policy rate above neutral as easy
ECO-067.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-068.reasoning: Reasoning: A demand shock (households keen to spend) is a case for tightening. A negative supply shock (oil-cost spike) can raise inflation and reduce output at the same time, so the policy response is a trade-off: it depends on inflation persistence, expectations, output conditions, and objectives. It is not a universal ‘never tighten’ rule, and it is not the same mechanical tighten-for-any-inflation response used after a demand shock. Tightening into the oil shock would add demand weakness on top of already higher costs.

why_wrong.A: Reverses the demand-shock prescription and treats the oil shock as a reason to tighten.
why_wrong.C: A mechanical tighten-for-any-inflation rule ignores that a cost spike is a different shock from a demand boom.

ECO-068.zh: 需求衝擊可以升息。負向供給衝擊會同時推升通膨、壓低產出，是權衡，不是「油 價衝擊就一律不升息」的萬能規則，也不是和需求衝擊同一套機械升息。對油價升息，會在已 經變貴的成本上再疊更弱的需求。
ECO-068.core_idea: Demand shock: case for tightening. Negative supply shock: inflation up and output down — a trade-off, not a mechanical tighten-for-any-inflation rule
ECO-068.exam_trap: Tightening into a supply shock as if it were demand
ECO-068.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-069.reasoning: Reasoning: Policy is not a helicopter drop into the GDP identity. It moves lending rates, asset prices, expectations, and the exchange rate, and those channels move inflation and activity.

why_wrong.A: The policy rate is described as feeding into short-term rates, asset prices, the exchange rate, and expectations.
why_wrong.B: The notes reject a “put money straight into GDP” story.

ECO-069.zh: 貨幣政策走利率、資產價格、預期和匯率，不是直接把錢塞進GDP。
ECO-069.core_idea: Transmission runs through lending rates, asset prices, expectations, and exchange rates
ECO-069.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-070.reasoning: Reasoning: Inflation targeting needs credibility, transparency, and independence. Operational independence is the instrument: set the policy rate for a given target. Target independence is the right to define the target, the inflation rate, and the horizon.

why_wrong.A: That is target independence.
why_wrong.C: The listed CB roles remain; independence is about the target versus the instrument, not dropping payments.

ECO-070.zh: 操作獨立是「目標已給，利率自己訂」。目標獨立才是連目標、通膨率、期限都可 以自己定。
ECO-070.core_idea: Operational independence: freedom to set the policy rate to hit a given inflation target
ECO-070.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-071.reasoning: Reasoning: The target is given; the bank still chooses the policy rate. That is operational independence. Target independence would let the bank define the target itself.

why_wrong.A: The notes distinguish the two; they are not automatically bundled.
why_wrong.B: Target independence would include defining the target, the rate, and the horizon — already written into the statute here.

ECO-071.zh: 目標已被法律寫死，央行只能調政策利率：這是操作獨立，不是目標獨立。
ECO-071.core_idea: Target independence is freedom to define the target, the inflation rate, and the horizon
ECO-071.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-072.reasoning: Reasoning: Faster inflation than the anchor country weakens A’s currency. Selling reserves / buying domestic money is contractionary: the money stock shrinks and short rates rise. That tightening is what lifts the exchange rate back to the dollar peg. The imported-inflation cost is the loss of an independent domestic stance.

why_wrong.A: Reverses the pressure on the currency and the defense operations.
why_wrong.B: The notes say exchange-rate targeting imports the other economy’s inflation and still uses the money/rate channel to defend the peg.

ECO-072.zh: 盯住美元等於進口美國通膨。本國通膨較快，匯率會往下；護盤要賣外匯、買本 幣，錢變少、短率上升，匯率才被拉回去。
ECO-072.core_idea: Exchange-rate targeting imports another economy’s inflation; defending a peg after faster domestic inflation shrinks money and raises short rates
ECO-072.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-073.reasoning: Reasoning: When money demand is perfectly elastic, extra money is absorbed without a decline in rates, so real activity does not lift. That is a limit of monetary policy, separate from vigilantes forcing yields up.

why_wrong.A: Bond-market vigilantes are a different limit: they may dump long bonds and force yields up.
why_wrong.C: A liquidity trap is about the ineffectiveness of extra money at the zero/elastic-demand bound, not a ban on being above neutral in other regimes.

ECO-073.zh: 流動性陷阱裡，貨幣需求彈性無窮，多印錢也壓不低利率、拉不起實質活動。這 和債市vigilantes 逼升長率是兩種限制。
ECO-073.core_idea: In a liquidity trap, money demand is perfectly elastic, so injecting money does not lower rates or lift real activity
ECO-073.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-074.reasoning: Reasoning: Contractionary: inflation is rising, so rates go up and liquidity is drained. The reverse is expansionary. Stance is also read against the neutral-rate benchmark.

why_wrong.A: Bond purchases / added reserves are expansionary.
why_wrong.C: Belowneutral plus QE is easy policy, not contractionary.

ECO-074.zh: 看到通膨在升，就升息、抽流動性，這是緊縮。買債加準備是寬鬆。
ECO-074.core_idea: Contractionary policy: inflation seen rising, so authorities raise rates and drain liquidity
ECO-074.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-075.reasoning: Reasoning: Tight money raises rates and squeezes the private sector. Easy fiscal — tax cuts or higher G — supports the public sector. The notes still allow aggregate output to rise. Do not swap the mix or treat it as double tightening.

why_wrong.A: Lower rates and a larger private sector is tight fiscal / easy money.
why_wrong.B: Both sectors down is tight / tight.

ECO-075.zh: 財鬆幣緊：利率升、民間縮，但減稅或加G 撐住公部門，總產出仍可能上升。不 要和財緊幣鬆對調，也不要當成雙緊。
ECO-075.core_idea: Easy fiscal / tight money: rates up, private sector down; tax cuts or higher G support the public sector; output can still rise
ECO-075.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-076.reasoning: Reasoning: Easy money lowers rates and lifts the private sector. Tight fiscal shrinks the public sector. The mix is the mirror of easy fiscal / tight money.

why_wrong.A: That is easy fiscal / tight money.
why_wrong.B: Both sectors up with lower rates is easy / easy.

ECO-076.zh: 財緊幣鬆：利率降、民間擴、公部門縮。和「財鬆幣緊」正好對調。
ECO-076.core_idea: Tight fiscal / easy money: rates down, private sector up, public sector shrinks
ECO-076.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-077.reasoning: Reasoning: When both tools ease, rates fall and both the public and private sectors expand, so AD rises. When both tighten, rates rise and both sectors contract, so AD falls. Short-run wages and prices are assumed rigid.

why_wrong.A: Reverses both double mixes.
why_wrong.C: Easy/easy and tight/tight move rates in opposite directions.

ECO-077.zh: 雙鬆：利率降、兩部門都擴、AD 升。雙緊：利率升、兩部門都縮、AD 降。
ECO-077.core_idea: Easy/easy: rates down, both sectors up, AD up; tight/tight: rates up, both down, AD down
ECO-077.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-078.reasoning: Reasoning: Three tools are listed: open-market operations (including QE), the policy rate (several official names), and reserve requirements (the reserves banks must hold).

why_wrong.A: Those purchases are open-market operations / QE.
why_wrong.C: Those are names for the policy rate, not reserve requirements.

ECO-078.zh: 存款準備率是銀行依法要留的準備。政策利率是官方／再融資／附買回／貼現／ 聯邦基金那些名字。買債是公開市場操作。
ECO-078.core_idea: Reserve requirements set the reserves banks must hold; the policy rate is the official / refinancing / repo / discount / fed-funds rate
ECO-078.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-079.reasoning: Reasoning: Actors include individuals, organizations, firms, and national governments. The state / non-state split is about who has direct authority over security and resources.

why_wrong.B: National governments are the core state actors.
why_wrong.C: NGOs and charities do not write tax law and are listed as non-state.

ECO-079.zh: 國家行為者（政府、政治組織、領導人）直接管安全與資源。NGO、跨國公司、 慈善機構是非國家行為者。
ECO-079.core_idea: State actors exert direct authority over security and resources; non-state actors include NGOs, MNCs, and charities
ECO-079.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-080.reasoning: Reasoning: The plant-level menu is: bring essentials home; fortify or duplicate chains abroad; or keep concentrating on a risky but important destination. Do not swap that list for the political archetypes or the IOs.

why_wrong.A: Those are the three international organizations, not production responses.
why_wrong.C: Those four archetypes are cooperation/globalization stances, not the three plant-level responses.

ECO-080.zh: 產能三條路：必要品回流、在海外加固或複製供應鏈、或繼續押注重要但有風險 的市場。不要和自給／霸權／多邊那些政治原型搞混。
ECO-080.core_idea: Three production responses: reshoring essentials, reglobalizing production, doubling down on key markets
ECO-080.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-081.reasoning: Reasoning: Keep the three IOs distinct: IMF on payments and stability, World Bank on development and poverty, WTO on trade rules.

why_wrong.A: A common currency is a monetary union; a common external tariff is a customs union — neither is assigned to all three IOs.
why_wrong.C: Swaps the three mandates.

ECO-081.zh: IMF 管匯率穩定與支付體系；世銀管發展中國家減貧與永續成長；WTO 是多邊 貿易的法律架構。
ECO-081.core_idea: IMF: payments/stability; World Bank: poverty/development; WTO: legal foundation of multilateral trade
ECO-081.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-082.reasoning: Reasoning: Openness vs control have different tools. Risk comes as event, exogenous/black-swan, or thematic, and is scored on likelihood, velocity, and size/nature.

why_wrong.A: Espionage is a national-security tool. Event risk is date-driven; thematic risk builds over time (climate, migration, cyber). Exogenous / black-swan risk is sudden.
why_wrong.B: Autarky is political self-sufficiency and no trade. Hegemony uses influence to control resources. Multilateralism is mutually beneficial trade and extensive rule harmonization.

ECO-082.zh: 開放的金融工具是貨幣自由兌換；控制的經濟工具是國有化。地緣風險看事件機 率、衝擊速度、衝擊大小／性質。
ECO-082.core_idea: Archetypes from closed to open; tools of control vs openness; risk as likelihood, velocity, size
ECO-082.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-083.reasoning: Reasoning: Comparative advantage is the common engine. Ricardo’s source is technology / labor productivity. Heckscher–Ohlin’s source is factor endowments. Protection still cuts consumer surplus and raises producer surplus.

why_wrong.A: The notes say both generate trade from comparative advantage.
why_wrong.C: Swaps the two sources and invents a tariff-revenue source for HO.

ECO-083.zh: 兩個模型都從比較利益長出貿易。李嘉圖看技術（勞動生產力）差異；HO 看要素 稟賦差異。
ECO-083.core_idea: Ricardo locates comparative advantage in technology (labor productivity); Heckscher–Ohlin in factor endowments
ECO-083.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-084.reasoning: Reasoning: The notes group those instruments as protection. The surplus pattern is the same qualitative hit: consumers lose, protected producers gain.

why_wrong.B: HO’s source is factor endowments, not protection instruments.
why_wrong.C: Those tools restrict trade; they do not raise CS.

ECO-084.zh: 禁運、自製率、出口補貼、關稅、配額都是保護：消費者剩餘少、生產者剩餘多。
ECO-084.core_idea: Protection — embargoes, domestic-content rules, export subsidies, tariffs, quotas — cuts CS and raises PS
ECO-084.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-085.reasoning: Reasoning: Small country: P_W is given. The tariff puts the internal price at P_W+t, so imports shrink. The government collects rectangle C. Aims can include protecting domestic output or reducing a trade deficit.

why_wrong.A: A lower internal price and C going abroad describe neither a small-country tariff nor the notes’ surplus table.
why_wrong.B: Price-taker in the world market means the country takes P_W as given before the tariff; the tariff still lifts the internal price to P_W+t.

ECO-085.zh: 小國在世界市場是價格接受者，但關稅仍把國內價從P_W 抬到P_W+t，貿易 量縮小，矩形C 進政府。
ECO-085.core_idea: A small country is a price taker; a tariff raises the domestic price, shrinks trade volume, and the government collects the tariff
ECO-085.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-086.reasoning: Reasoning: Consumers lose A+B+C+D. A is a transfer to producers, C a transfer to the government. What is not a transfer — triangles B and D — is the net national loss.

why_wrong.A: A+C cancel only part of the CS loss; B and D remain as deadweight loss.
why_wrong.B: C is a transfer from consumers to the government; it does not outweigh B+D. Net is -(B+D).

ECO-086.zh: 消費者少A+B+C+D；A 給生產者、C 給政府。國家淨損失是兩個無謂損失三角 形B+D。
ECO-086.core_idea: Small-country tariff: CS -(A+B+C+D), PS +A, government +C, net -(B+D)
ECO-086.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-087.reasoning: Reasoning: A quota is a quantity cap implemented with import licenses. Price and the four areas match the equivalent tariff; the difference is that C is rent. Who captures that rent decides the importer’s welfare.

why_wrong.B: Who keeps C is the whole point: domestic holders or an auction keep it at home; foreign exporters take it abroad.
why_wrong.C: B and D are still there at the same protected price.

ECO-087.zh: 配額在同樣的保護價下，A、B、C、D 都還在。C 不再是關稅而是租金，留給誰 決定進口國福利。
ECO-087.core_idea: A quota is a quantity cap; the same four areas appear, but C is a quota rent, not a tariff
ECO-087.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-088.reasoning: Reasoning: When domestic holders keep C — including when the government auctions the licenses — the importer’s loss matches the tariff: -(B+D). C stays at home as revenue or rent.

why_wrong.A: Auctioning C does not delete B and D.
why_wrong.C: -(B+D+C) is the case in which foreign exporters (or a foreign government) capture the rent.

ECO-088.zh: 政府標售進口許可，矩形C 留在國內，福利損失就和關稅一樣是-(B+D)。B 與 D 不會因為標售而消失。
ECO-088.core_idea: If domestic holders capture C, or the government auctions licenses, importer welfare equals the tariff: -(B+D)
ECO-088.formula: welfare = −(B + D) if C is retained
ECO-088.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-089.reasoning: Reasoning: At the same internal price the efficiency triangles are the same. The extra hit is C leaving the country. That is why foreign capture of the quota rent is worse for the importer than the equivalent tariff.

why_wrong.B: B and D are the same, but losing C as well makes the importer worse. “Same B and D” is not “same national welfare.”
why_wrong.C: B and D are still there at the same price.

ECO-089.zh: 價格抬到同一水準，B 與D 還在。外國人再把C 拿走，進口國就比關稅多輸一 塊，損失是-(B+D+C)。
ECO-089.core_idea: If foreign exporters capture quota rent C, the importer’s loss is -(B+D+C)
ECO-089.exam_trap: Treating foreign-captured quota rent as tariff-equivalent welfare
ECO-089.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-090.reasoning: Reasoning: A VER is a quota on the exporter’s side. The internal price still rises, but C goes abroad. Domestic buyers pay more and keep none of the rent, so the importer’s welfare loss is the largest of the standard cases.

why_wrong.A: Voluntary does not delete B, D, or the lost rent. The notes call this the largest importer loss.
why_wrong.B: A VER is imposed by the exporting country; C is not the importer’s tariff revenue.

ECO-090.zh: VER 幾乎就是把C 讓給出口國。進口國消費者付較貴的價格、租金一毛不留，福 利損失最大。
ECO-090.core_idea: A VER is a quota imposed by the exporting country; rent is steered abroad, so the importer takes the largest welfare loss
ECO-090.exam_trap: Treating a VER as tariff-equivalent or as zero DWL
ECO-090.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-091.reasoning: Reasoning: Tariff versus quota is not “one has DWL and the other does not.” Both have B and D. The fork is C: home keeps it (tariff, auction, domestic license holders) or foreigners keep it (foreign exporters, VER).

why_wrong.A: B and D exist under both instruments at that price.
why_wrong.B: The surplus table in the notes is the small-country case; the fork is about C, not about terms-of-trade power.

ECO-091.zh: 關稅與配額的真正差別在矩形C 留給誰，不是三角形在不在。小國表已經假設吃 不下世界價格。
ECO-091.core_idea: Who captures C is the welfare fork: domestic/auction →-(B+D); foreign →-(B+D+C)
ECO-091.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-092.reasoning: Reasoning: Capital restrictions are about who may own which assets across borders — inward or outward — not about the goods-market rectangles A–D.

why_wrong.B: The WTO is the trade-rules body; it does not automatically collect quota rents.
why_wrong.C: A tariff is a goods-trade tax, not a capital-account ownership limit.

ECO-092.zh: 資本管制限制外國人持有本國資產，或本國人持有外國資產。那不是關稅，也不 是WTO 收租金。
ECO-092.core_idea: Capital restrictions limit foreigners’ ownership of domestic assets, or residents’ ownership of foreign assets
ECO-092.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-093.reasoning: Reasoning: Each step adds a provision: FTA = free movement of goods and services among members. Customs union = FTA + common policy toward non-members. Common market adds free factor movement. Economic union adds common institutions and policies. Monetary union adds a common currency.

why_wrong.A: A common currency is the extra step that makes a monetary union (after an economic union).
why_wrong.B: Free factor movement is the extra step that makes a common market.

ECO-093.zh: 關稅同盟比自由貿易區多的是「對非會員的共同貿易政策」。要素自由移動是共同 市場；共同貨幣是貨幣同盟。
ECO-093.core_idea: FTA →customs union (+ common external policy) →common market (+ free factor movement) →economic union →monetary union
ECO-093.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-094.reasoning: Reasoning: Learn the ladder as cumulative: goods, then a common external policy, then factors, then common institutions/policies, then a currency.

why_wrong.A: Reverses the order and starts at the most integrated step.
why_wrong.C: Puts the common external tariff before the FTA and jumps to a currency too early.

ECO-094.zh: 梯子是往上加條款：FTA →關稅同盟→共同市場→經濟同盟→貨幣同盟。不 要倒著背。
ECO-094.core_idea: A common market adds free movement of factors; an economic union adds common institutions and policies; a monetary union adds a currency
ECO-094.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-095.reasoning: Reasoning: Creation: the bloc replaces a high-cost home supplier with a lower-cost partner. Diversion: it replaces a still-cheaper outsider with a higher-cost partner.

why_wrong.A: A VER is a protection instrument, not the definition of trade creation.
why_wrong.B: That is trade diversion.

ECO-095.zh: 貿易創造：本來較貴的本國來源，被會員較便宜的進口取代。那是效率改善。
ECO-095.core_idea: Trade creation: expensive domestic source replaced by cheaper member imports
ECO-095.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-096.reasoning: Reasoning: Diversion is the efficiency loss from switching away from the world’s cheaper outsider toward a protected partner. Creation is the opposite switch, away from a costly domestic source.

why_wrong.A: A common currency is the monetary-union step, not the diversion definition.
why_wrong.C: That is trade creation.

ECO-096.zh: 貿易轉向：本來從非會員買較便宜的，改向會員買較貴的。不要和貿易創造對調。
ECO-096.core_idea: Trade diversion: cheaper non-member imports replaced by more expensive member imports
ECO-096.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-097.reasoning: Reasoning: Price/base: USD/EUR is dollars per one euro. Read the slash as “price currency per one unit of base.” The real rate is a separate adjustment for relative price levels.

why_wrong.B: The spot (nominal) quote is not the real rate. The real rate multiplies by P_f/P_d.
why_wrong.C: That inverts price and base.

ECO-097.zh: USD/EUR ＝1.17 就是1 歐元值1.17 美元。分子是價格貨幣，分母是基準貨幣。 名目報價還不是實質匯率。
ECO-097.core_idea: S_d/f is a price/base quote: units of price currency d per one unit of base currency f
ECO-097.study_section: Quotes, participants, and the real rate
ECO-097.formula: Sd/f = units of d per one f
ECO-097.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-097.subtopic: 3.16 Quotes, participants, and the real rate

ECO-098.reasoning: Reasoning: Direct quote = domestic per one foreign. If USD is domestic, USD/EUR is direct. If EUR is domestic, that same print is not the resident’s direct quote. Name the domestic currency first.

why_wrong.A: Direct vs indirect is residency-dependent. The notes warn not to force a European resident onto USD/EUR as if it were already a direct quote.
why_wrong.C: For a EUR-based investor the domestic currency is EUR, so the residency reading of the same USD/EUR print is reversed.

ECO-098.zh: 直接報價是「一單位外幣要幾單位本幣」。本幣是誰要先講清楚。美元居民看 USD/EUR 才是直接報價。
ECO-098.core_idea: A direct quote is domestic-currency units per one unit of foreign currency; residency must be stated
ECO-098.study_section: Quotes, participants, and the real rate
ECO-098.exam_trap: Treating USD/EUR as a direct quote for every residency
ECO-098.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-098.subtopic: 3.16 Quotes, participants, and the real rate

ECO-099.reasoning: Reasoning: USD/EUR is dollars per euro. A fall means one euro buys fewer dollars — the dollar is stronger, the euro weaker. Percentage change in the quote is the percentage change in the base (the euro).

why_wrong.B: The two currencies move in opposite directions; they do not both depreciate.
why_wrong.C: A lower dollar-per-euro price is a cheaper euro, not a more expensive euro.

ECO-099.zh: USD/EUR 從1.25 掉到1.00，一歐元比較不值錢，美元升、歐元貶。報價的百分 比變化就是基準貨幣的百分比變化。
ECO-099.core_idea: A fall in USD/EUR means the euro costs fewer dollars: USD appreciating, EUR depreciating
ECO-099.study_section: Quotes, participants, and the real rate
ECO-099.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-099.subtopic: 3.16 Quotes, participants, and the real rate

ECO-100.reasoning: Reasoning: The quote is the price of the base. %∆in USD/EUR = 1.00/1.25 - 1 = -20%. That -20% is the euro’s move. The dollar’s move is the inverse, not +20%. Given: S_0 = 1.25; S_1 = 1.00; quote is USD/EUR. Asked: Percentage change in the euro (the base). Formula: %∆base = S1 S0 −1 Variables: S = price-currency units per one base unit. Why this formula: The notes: percentage change in the quote is the percentage change in the base. The euro depreciated 20% against the dollar on this quote. Reasonableness check: (1.25-1.00)/1.00 = 25% is the wrong denominator. +25% is the other currency’s appreciation, not the euro’s change. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: That is the inverse appreciation of the dollar, and with the wrong sign for the euro.
why_wrong.C: That is (1.25-1.00)/1.00, which uses the wrong base for the percentage.

ECO-100.zh: 報價變動百分比＝基準貨幣（歐元）變動百分比：1.00/1.25-1=-20%。另一邊要用 倒數，不是對調正負號。
ECO-100.core_idea: Percentage change in the quote is the percentage change in the base
ECO-100.study_section: Quotes, participants, and the real rate
ECO-100.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-100.subtopic: 3.16 Quotes, participants, and the real rate

ECO-101.reasoning: Reasoning: A 20% depreciation multiplies A’s price by 0.80. The reciprocal move is 1/0.80 - 1 = 0.25. Exchange rates are reciprocals; the percentages are not plus-or-minus the same number. Given: A depreciates x = 20% relative to B. Asked: Appreciation of B relative to A. Formula: %∆B = 1 −x −1 Variables: x = proportional depreciation of A versus B. Why this formula: The other currency’s move is the inverse, not the same number with the opposite sign. B must rise 25% to undo A’s 20% decline. Reasonableness check: 20% is the symmetric-percentage trap. 16.67% is 0.20/1.20 (the inverse of a 20% rise). 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
ECO-101.steps: ①Factor on A = 1 - 0.20 = 0.80 ②Reciprocal factor on B = 1 / 0.80 = 1.25 ③Appreciation of B = 1.25 - 1 = 0.25 = 25%

why_wrong.B: That is 0.20/1.20, the inverse of a 20% appreciation, not of a 20% depreciation.
why_wrong.C: The two percentage changes are not equal in magnitude.

ECO-101.zh: 匯率是倒數關係，不是正負對稱。A 貶20% 等於乘0.8，B 要除0.8，升幅是 25%，不是20%。
ECO-101.core_idea: If A depreciates x relative to B, B appreciates 1/(1-x)-1, not x
ECO-101.study_section: Quotes, participants, and the real rate
ECO-101.exam_trap: Treating two-sided FX percentage changes as equal in magnitude
ECO-101.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
