ECO-102.reasoning: Reasoning: Bid: the dealer buys the base; it is what the client receives for one unit of base. Offer: the dealer sells the base; it is what the client pays. Selling EUR hits 1.1583; buying EUR hits 1.1585.

why_wrong.A: The client does not receive the offer when selling the base.
why_wrong.C: Paying 1.1585 is how the client buys one euro (dealer sells the base).

ECO-102.zh: 賣一歐元給銀行，收到的是bid 1.1583。買一歐元才付offer 1.1585。客戶不會在 賣出時吃到較高的那個價。
ECO-102.core_idea: Bid: dealer buys the base (client receives that much price currency); offer: dealer sells the base (client pays)
ECO-102.study_section: Quotes, participants, and the real rate
ECO-102.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-102.subtopic: 3.16 Quotes, participants, and the real rate

ECO-103.reasoning: Reasoning: R_d/f is the real price of foreign goods in domestic terms. When it increases, each domestic basket buys fewer foreign goods. Do not read a higher real exchange rate as higher purchasing power.

why_wrong.A: The real rate — not the nominal quote alone — is the purchasing-power statistic in the notes.
why_wrong.B: “Up” is the cost of foreign goods, not the benefit. R is the real price of foreign goods in domestic terms.

ECO-103.zh: 看到real exchange rate increases，不要選purchasing power increases。實質匯率 是相對價格；價格上升，能買到的外國貨變少。
ECO-103.core_idea: A rise in the real exchange rate is a rise in the real price of foreign goods: domestic relative PP falls
ECO-103.study_section: Quotes, participants, and the real rate
ECO-103.exam_trap: Reading a rise in the real exchange rate as a rise in purchasing power
ECO-103.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-103.subtopic: 3.16 Quotes, participants, and the real rate

ECO-104.reasoning: Reasoning: R=1.50×110/100=1.65. S×P_f puts the foreign basket in dollars; dividing by P_d makes a relative purchasing-power ratio. R above the old 1.50 means euro-area goods became more expensive in real terms, so US relative PP fell. Given: S_d/f = 1.50; P_f = 110; P_d = 100; d = USD; f = EUR. Asked: Real USD/EUR rate and the implied US relative PP versus euro-area goods. Formula: Rd/f = Sd/f × Pf Pd Variables: S = nominal price/base; P_f = foreign price level; P_d = domestic price level. Why this formula: S×P_f is the foreign basket in domestic currency; dividing by P_d converts it into a relative purchasing-power ratio. A higher real rate is a higher real price of foreign goods. Reasonableness check: 1.36 inverts the price ratio. 1.50 skips the price-level adjustment. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
ECO-104.steps: ①P_f / P_d = 110 / 100 = 1.10 ②R = 1.50 × 1.10 = 1.65 ③R > S, so euro-area goods are more expensive in real terms ④US relative purchasing power over those goods is lower, not higher
ECO-104.final_answer: 1.65 (US relative PP down vs the unadjusted 1.50)

why_wrong.B: Price levels are not 100 and 100; leaving S unadjusted is the nominal-as-real trap.
why_wrong.C: 1.50×100/110=1.36 inverts P_f/P_d. And a lower computed R would mean higher, not lower, relative PP — the distractor also reverses the interpretation.

ECO-104.zh: 先算R=1.50×110/100=1.65，再解釋：R 上升是外國貨變貴，美元相對購買力下 降。選1.36 是把物價比寫反。
ECO-104.core_idea: R_d/f = S_d/f × P_f/P_d; then interpret PP in the opposite direction of R
ECO-104.study_section: Quotes, participants, and the real rate
ECO-104.exam_trap: Reading a rise in the real exchange rate as a rise in purchasing power
ECO-104.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-104.subtopic: 3.16 Quotes, participants, and the real rate

ECO-105.reasoning: Reasoning: Country A can buy fewer of B’s goods if the nominal rate for B’s currency appreciates or if B’s price level rises — that is, if R_d/f rises. A 5% rise in the real rate is a 5% fall in A’s relative purchasing power over B.

why_wrong.A: PPP is the long-run equilibrium condition for nominal rates; it does not say that a real-rate move leaves PP unchanged.
why_wrong.B: The notes state the 5% mapping in the opposite direction of the usual “up is good” reflex.

ECO-105.zh: 實質匯率升5%，就是A 對B 的相對購買力降5%。「上升」是成本，不是好處。
ECO-105.core_idea: A 5% rise in the real rate is a 5% fall in A’s relative purchasing power over B
ECO-105.study_section: Quotes, participants, and the real rate
ECO-105.exam_trap: Reading a rise in the real exchange rate as a rise in purchasing power
ECO-105.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-106.reasoning: Reasoning: PP down means foreign goods became more expensive in real terms, so R is up. S can be one reason; a rise in P_f or a fall in P_d can do it with S unchanged. Do not treat the nominal print as the PP statistic.

why_wrong.A: The notes put P_f and P_d into R. PPP is the long-run condition for nominal rates; the real rate is the PP measure.
why_wrong.C: That is the misread: treating R and PP as moving in the same direction.

ECO-106.zh: 相對購買力下降，代表實質匯率上升。名目報價只是輸入，不是購買力本身。R 與PP 方向相反。
ECO-106.core_idea: Reverse: a fall in relative PP means R rose; the nominal quote is an input, not the PP statistic
ECO-106.study_section: Quotes, participants, and the real rate
ECO-106.exam_trap: Reading a rise in the real exchange rate as a rise in purchasing power
ECO-106.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-106.subtopic: 3.16 Quotes, participants, and the real rate

ECO-107.reasoning: Reasoning: R=S×P_f/P_d. With S and P_d fixed, a higher P_f lifts R. A higher real price of euro-area goods is a lower US relative purchasing power. The nominal quote is an input, not the PP measure.

why_wrong.A: P_f is in the numerator of R. S unchanged does not freeze R.
why_wrong.B: Reverses both legs of the real-rate / PP pair.

ECO-107.zh: 名目匯率沒動，外國物價漲，R 還是會升，美元相對購買力下降。不要以為只有S 會影響實質匯率。
ECO-107.core_idea: S unchanged, P_f up: R rises and domestic relative PP falls
ECO-107.study_section: Quotes, participants, and the real rate
ECO-107.exam_trap: Reading a rise in the real exchange rate as a rise in purchasing power
ECO-107.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-107.subtopic: 3.16 Quotes, participants, and the real rate

ECO-108.reasoning: Reasoning: R=0.80×90/120=0.60. Foreign goods in pounds are S×P_f; dividing by P_d scales by UK prices. If this R later rose toward 0.80, UK relative PP over US goods would be falling, not rising. Given: S_d/f = 0.80; P_f = 90; P_d = 120. Asked: Real GBP/USD rate. Formula: Rd/f = Sd/f × Pf Pd Variables: d = GBP; f = USD. Why this formula: Foreign basket in domestic currency is S×P_f; P_d converts it into a relative PP ratio. R below S here means US goods are cheaper in real terms than the nominal quote alone says. A later rise in R would still be a PP loss. Reasonableness check: 1.07 flips the price ratio. 0.80 is the unadjusted nominal rate. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: That leaves the nominal quote unadjusted.

ECO-108.zh: R=0.80×90/120=0.60。物價比不要寫反。就算R 低於名目報價，R 若往上走， 仍是相對購買力下降。
ECO-108.core_idea: Compute R when P_d exceeds P_f; still interpret higher R as lower PP
ECO-108.study_section: Quotes, participants, and the real rate
ECO-108.exam_trap: Reading a rise in the real exchange rate as a rise in purchasing power
ECO-108.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-108.subtopic: 3.16 Quotes, participants, and the real rate

ECO-109.reasoning: Reasoning: Covered interest equates investing one domestic unit at r_d with converting at S, investing at r_f, and selling the foreign principal forward. Solving gives F=S×(1+r_f)/(1+r_d)=1.4000×1.06/1.02=1.4549. Given: S_f/d = 1.4000; r_d = 2%; r_f = 6%; τ = 1. Asked: No-arbitrage forward F_f/d. Formula: Ff/d = Sf/d 1 + rfτ 1 + rdτ Variables: S_f/d = foreign per one domestic; r_d = domestic risk-free; r_f = foreign risk-free; τ = year-fraction. Why this formula: Two ways to hold a domestic risk-free payoff must finish at the same amount, or arbitrage remains. F>S because r_f>r_d: the price currency has the higher interest rate, so the base trades at a forward premium. Reasonableness check: 1.3472 flips r_f and r_d. 1.4560 is S×[1+(r_f-r_d)]. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: That inverts the rates: 1.4000×1.02/1.06=1.3472.
why_wrong.B: That multiplies by 1+(r_f-r_d): 1.4000×1.04=1.4560, skipping the divide by 1+r_d.

ECO-109.study_section: Forwards and Covered Interest ｜遠期與拋補利率
ECO-109.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-109.subtopic: 3.17 Forwards and Covered Interest ｜遠期與拋補利率

ECO-110.reasoning: Reasoning: F=S(1+r_f τ)/(1+r_d τ) exceeds S when the foreign (price) rate exceeds the domestic (base) rate. The base is then at a forward premium and the high-interest currency is at a forward discount. That is carry, not a prediction.

why_wrong.A: The notes say this is the cost of carry in the quote, not a forecast.
why_wrong.B: F>S is the r_f>r_d case, not r_d>r_f.

ECO-110.zh: F>S 代表價格貨幣利率較高。基準貨幣是遠期溢價；高利率那一邊是遠期折價。 這是持有成本，不是預測。
ECO-110.core_idea: F>S when r_f>r_d: the price currency has the higher interest rate; the base is at a forward premium; the high-interest currency is at a forward discount
ECO-110.study_section: Forwards and Covered Interest ｜遠期與拋補利率
ECO-110.exam_trap: Reading CIP’s F>S as a forecast rather than carry
ECO-110.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-110.subtopic: 3.17 Forwards and Covered Interest ｜遠期與拋補利率

ECO-111.reasoning: Reasoning: F=1.4000×1.06/1.02=1.4549, so F/S-1=1.4549/1.4000-1=3.92%. Equivalently (r_fr_d)/(1+r_d)=0.04/1.02=3.92%. The base is at a premium because r_f>r_d. Given: S_f/d = 1.4000; r_d = 2%; r_f = 6%; τ = 1. Asked: Forward premium on the base (domestic currency in this notation). Formula: F S −1 = (rf −rd)τ 1 + rdτ Variables: F/S-1 is the forward premium on the base. Why this formula: The notes give both F/S-1 and the scaled rate-gap form. They must match. The base trades at a 3.92% forward premium; that is carry, not a 4% forecast. Reasonableness check: 4.00% skips the 1+r_d scaling. -3.77% flips the rate gap. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: That is r_f-r_d without dividing by 1+r_d.
why_wrong.B: That is (r_d-r_f)/(1+r_f)=-0.04/1.06, which flips the premium’s sign and the scaling rate.

ECO-111.zh: 遠期溢價是F/S-1，也等於(r_f-r_d)/(1+r_d)。這裡是0.04/1.02=3.92%，不是 直接用4% 利差。
ECO-111.core_idea: Forward premium on the base is F/S-1, equivalently S(r_f-r_d)τ/(1+r_d τ)
ECO-111.study_section: Forwards and Covered Interest ｜遠期與拋補利率
ECO-111.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-111.subtopic: 3.17 Forwards and Covered Interest ｜遠期與拋補利率

ECO-112.reasoning: Reasoning: F=0.9000×1.03/1.05=0.8829. F<S because r_f<r_d: the price currency is not the high-interest currency, so the base is at a forward discount. Given: S_f/d = 0.9000; r_d = 5%; r_f = 3%; τ = 1. Asked: No-arbitrage forward. Formula: Ff/d = Sf/d 1 + rf 1 + rd Variables: Same CIP notation as the notes. Why this formula: The high-interest currency trades at a forward discount. Here that currency is the base (domestic), so F<S. The base is cheaper forward than spot because it is the higher-yielding currency. Reasonableness check: 0.9175 flips the two rates. 0.9000 is the unadjusted spot. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: That inverts the rates: 0.9000×1.05/1.03=0.9175.
why_wrong.C: That sets F=S because someone treated the rate gap as zero.

ECO-112.zh: 外國利率較低，F=0.90×1.03/1.05=0.8829，基準貨幣是遠期折價。利率放反會得 到0.9175。
ECO-112.core_idea: If r_f<r_d then F<S: the base is at a forward discount
ECO-112.study_section: Forwards and Covered Interest ｜遠期與拋補利率
ECO-112.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-112.subtopic: 3.17 Forwards and Covered Interest ｜遠期與拋補利率

ECO-113.reasoning: Reasoning: F=S×1.04/1.04=S. When the two risk-free rates match, the forward equals the spot. That is still a no-arbitrage condition, not a forecast that the spot will stay at 1.10. Given: S_f/d = 1.1000; r_d = r_f = 4%; τ = 1. Asked: No-arbitrage forward. Formula: Ff/d = Sf/d 1 + rf 1 + rd Variables: r_d = r_f. Why this formula: The rate ratio is 1, so the forward cannot differ from spot without offering a free carry trade. Zero carry in the quote; CIP still holds. Reasonableness check: 1.1440 or 1.0577 pretends one of the two rates is zero. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: That divides by 1.04 as if the foreign rate were zero: 1.10/1.04.
why_wrong.C: That multiplies by 1.04 as if the other rate were zero: 1.10×1.04.

ECO-113.zh: 兩邊利率相同，F 就等於S。這仍是無套利，不是預測即期會停在1.10。
ECO-113.core_idea: Equal rates imply F=S; CIP is the no-arbitrage link, not a forecast
ECO-113.study_section: Forwards and Covered Interest ｜遠期與拋補利率
ECO-113.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-113.subtopic: 3.17 Forwards and Covered Interest ｜遠期與拋補利率

ECO-114.reasoning: Reasoning: The notes define τ as the year-fraction. Half-year payoffs use 1+rτ. F=1.6000×(1+0.08×0.5)/(1+0.04×0.5)=1.6000×1.04/1.02=1.6314. Given: S_f/d = 1.6000; r_d = 4%; r_f = 8%; τ = 0.5. Asked: No-arbitrage forward for the half-year horizon. Formula: Ff/d = Sf/d 1 + rfτ 1 + rdτ Variables: τ = year-fraction (τ=1 is a full year in the notes). Why this formula: Each risk-free payoff scales with the fraction of the year, not with a forced one-year compounding unless τ=1. Still F>S because r_f>r_d; the premium is smaller than the full-year case. Reasonableness check: 1.6615 ignores τ. 1.5692 flips the two half-year factors. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
ECO-114.core_idea: τ is a year-fraction; for a half year use rτ in both legs
ECO-114.study_section: Forwards and Covered Interest ｜遠期與拋補利率
ECO-114.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-114.subtopic: 3.17 Forwards and Covered Interest ｜遠期與拋補利率

ECO-115.reasoning: Reasoning: F-S is a premium or discount. If the base is at a premium, the price currency is at a discount. In the notes’ notation that is the r_f>r_d case.

why_wrong.A: The high-interest currency trades at a forward discount, and CIP is carry, not a forecast.
why_wrong.C: Forward premium on one side is a forward discount on the other. The percentages are not the same number with a shared sign.

ECO-115.zh: 基準貨幣遠期溢價，價格貨幣就是遠期折價。高利率貨幣才是折價的那一邊。這 不是預測。
ECO-115.core_idea: If the base trades at a forward premium, the price currency trades at a forward discount
ECO-115.study_section: Forwards and Covered Interest ｜遠期與拋補利率
ECO-115.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-115.subtopic: 3.17 Forwards and Covered Interest ｜遠期與拋補利率

ECO-116.reasoning: Reasoning: The notes’ three ideals — a credible fix, full convertibility, and fully independent monetary policy — cannot be maintained together. Cut A’s rate while the peg is believed, and capital leaves toward the higher foreign return without a natural bound.

why_wrong.B: The outflow is toward the higher foreign return, not an inflow that restores independence.
why_wrong.C: CIP and capital mobility still apply; a fixed rate is one of the three ideals that cannot all be held.

ECO-116.zh: 匯率真的釘死、貨幣又能自由兌換，就不能再完全獨立地降息：資金會無限制流 向較高的外國收益。三個理想不能同時成立。
ECO-116.core_idea: A credibly fixed rate, fully convertible currencies, and fully independent monetary policy cannot be maintained at the same time
ECO-116.study_section: Forwards and Covered Interest ｜遠期與拋補利率
ECO-116.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。
ECO-116.subtopic: 3.17 Forwards and Covered Interest ｜遠期與拋補利率

ECO-117.reasoning: Reasoning: The rigidity ranking starts at no independent tender (dollarization / monetary union), then a currency board (Hong Kong is the usual example), then conventional pegs, bands, crawls, dirty floats, and independent floats. Seigniorage: pay little on the monetary base, earn a market rate on the reserve assets.

why_wrong.A: Those reserve-backing traits belong to the currency board, not to an independent float.
why_wrong.C: A currency board is explicitly not LOLR and issues only against foreign reserves.

ECO-117.zh: 美元化或貨幣同盟＝沒有獨立法償。貨幣局只對外匯準備發鈔、不是最後貸款人， 但可以吃鑄幣稅。香港是典型例子。
ECO-117.core_idea: No independent legal tender: dollarization or a monetary union; a currency board issues only against foreign reserves and is not LOLR
ECO-117.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-118.reasoning: Reasoning: Hong Kong is the usual example. The fit conditions keep the real economy adjustable and the reserve asset from importing inflation through rapid global supply growth.

why_wrong.B: Those powers are exactly what a currency board does not have.
why_wrong.C: Reverses the three fit conditions.

ECO-118.zh: 貨幣局較適合：工資有彈性、非貿易部門小、準備資產的全球供給增得夠慢。它 不能當最後貸款人、也不能對國內信用隨便發鈔。
ECO-118.core_idea: A currency board fits best when wages are flexible, non-traded sectors are small, and the reserve asset’s global supply grows slowly
ECO-118.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-119.reasoning: Reasoning: S-I=120-150=-30 and T-G=40-55=-15, so X-M=-30+(-15)=-45. A current-account deficit is the counterpart of an excess of domestic investment over combined private and government saving. Given: S = 120; I = 150; T = 40; G = 55. Asked: Trade balance X-M. Formula: X −M = (S −I) + (T −G) Variables: S = private saving; I = investment; T = taxes net of transfers; G = government spending. Why this formula: The identity splits the external balance into the private saving–investment gap and the government surplus. Domestic investment exceeds combined private and government saving by 45, so the trade balance is -45. Reasonableness check: +15 flips a sign. -15 reports only the budget gap. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: That is +(T-G)-(S-I) or a sign flip on only one gap: (40-55)-(120-150)=-15-(- 30)=15.
why_wrong.C: That is only T-G=-15, dropping the private S-I gap.

ECO-119.zh: 貿易餘額＝(儲蓄-投資)+(稅-政府支出)。這裡是-30+(-15)=-45。經常帳赤字對應 的是投資超過民間加政府的儲蓄。
ECO-119.core_idea: X-M=(S-I)+(T-G); a current-account deficit is I in excess of combined private and government saving
ECO-119.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-120.reasoning: Reasoning: Investors pre-position in the currency expected to strengthen. Asset prices adjust until actual flows can sit with trade flows. A sudden drop in foreign holdings of liquid domestic assets is met by restricting those liquid inflows and encouraging FDI instead.

why_wrong.A: The notes give potential capital flows the short-to-intermediate-term exchangerate role: investors sell the currency expected to depreciate and buy the one expected to appreciate until actual flows stay consistent with trade flows.
why_wrong.B: That reverses the capitalflight prescription.

ECO-120.zh: 短中期是「潛在資本流動」在推匯率。要擋資本外逃：限制外資買高流動性本國資 產，改鼓勵FDI。
ECO-120.core_idea: Short to intermediate term, potential capital flows move the exchange rate; to stop capital flight, restrict liquid inflows and encourage FDI
ECO-120.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-121.reasoning: Reasoning: Price/base quotes multiply when the middle currency cancels. USD/JPY = (USD/EUR)×(EUR/JPY) = 1.2000×0.01000 = 0.01200 dollars per yen. 120 treats EUR/JPY as JPY per EUR and divides. 0.00833 inverts the chain. Given: USD/EUR=1.2000; EUR/JPY=0.01000 (price/base). Asked: USD/JPY Formula: 1.2000 × 0.01000 The euro cancels; the product is dollars per one yen. Reasonableness check: If EUR/JPY were yen per euro, the quote would be 100, not 0.01000. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: That treats EUR/JPY as yen per euro and divides. The stem’s EUR/JPY is euros per one yen.
why_wrong.B: That inverts the chain. The cancelled currency is EUR, so the quotes multiply.

ECO-121.zh: 報價是price/base：USD/EUR×EUR/JPY ＝USD/JPY。1.20×0.01 ＝0.012。 不要把EUR/JPY 當成「一日圓兌多少日圓的倒數寫法」去除法。
ECO-121.core_idea: Price/base quotes chain: USD/JPY = (USD/EUR)×(EUR/JPY); invert a quote before chaining if the middle currency is in the wrong slot
ECO-121.study_section: Quotes, participants, and the real rate
ECO-121.exam_trap: Dividing price/base quotes or treating EUR/JPY as JPY per EUR
ECO-121.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

ECO-122.reasoning: Reasoning: Need EUR per one JPY. Invert USD/EUR to EUR/USD = 1/1.2500 = 0.8000, then EUR/JPY = (EUR/USD)×(USD/JPY) = 0.8000×0.00800 = 0.00640. Equivalently USD/JPY ÷ USD/EUR = 0.00800/1.2500 = 0.00640. 156.25 is the inverse (JPY per EUR) if someone treats the prints as same-way yen quotes. Adding the prints has no FX meaning. Given: USD/EUR=1.2500; USD/JPY=0.00800. Asked: EUR/JPY Formula: 0.00800/1.2500 Same triangle as chaining through the dollar; invert the quote that puts USD in the wrong slot. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: 1.2500/0.00800 is JPY-per-EUR if both quotes were dollars-per-currency in the other order; the asked quote is EUR per JPY.
why_wrong.C: Spot quotes are not added.

ECO-122.zh: 要EUR/JPY，先把USD/EUR 倒過來再乘USD/JPY：0.008/1.25 ＝0.0064。 156.25 是倒過來的JPY/EUR。兩個報價不能相加。
ECO-122.core_idea: To chain quotes, both must be price/base in a path that cancels the middle currency; invert when the given print is upside down
ECO-122.study_section: Quotes, participants, and the real rate
ECO-122.exam_trap: Skipping the inversion when the middle currency is not aligned
ECO-122.source_note: 解答依據 ECO_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Economics。

CI-001.reasoning: Reasoning: A corporation is a separate legal person: it can contract, sue, and be sued in its own name. Shareholders have limited liability — they can lose the equity they invested, not personal assets. That combination is what makes outside equity and public listing feasible.

why_wrong.B: A general partnership typically mixes partners with the firm and leaves ordinary partners with unlimited liability.
why_wrong.C: A sole proprietorship has no separate legal person and the owner has unlimited personal liability.

CI-001.zh: 公司是獨立法律人格，能以自己的名字簽約、被起訴。股東的limited liability 只 賠到投入的股權。獨資與普通合夥沒有這層隔開。
CI-001.core_idea: A corporation is a separate legal person; shareholders have limited liability
CI-001.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-002.reasoning: Reasoning: In a sole proprietorship the owner equals the firm: unlimited personal liability, passthrough tax, and the weakest access to outside capital. Limited liability and public listing belong to the corporate form.

why_wrong.B: Separate legal identity and limited liability are corporate features, not soleproprietorship features.
why_wrong.C: Public claims and heavier disclosure describe public corporate issuers, not a sole prop.

CI-002.zh: 獨資＝老闆就是企業：無限責任、盈餘進個人稅、外面資金最難找。不要把公司 的有限責任套上去。
CI-002.core_idea: Sole proprietorship: owner equals the firm; unlimited liability; hardest outside capital
CI-002.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-003.reasoning: Reasoning: A partnership shares profits. Ordinary (general) partners typically share unlimited liability. A limited-partnership form is what locks some partners’ losses at the amount contributed. Do not treat every partnership as if it were a corporation.

why_wrong.B: Limited liability for all owners is the corporate default, not the ordinarypartnership default.
why_wrong.C: Partnerships often leave general partners with unlimited liability; drawings are not a liability cap.

CI-003.zh: 普通合夥人通常仍是無限責任。只有有限合夥才把部分合夥人的損失鎖在出資額。 不要把所有合夥都當成公司。
CI-003.core_idea: Limited partners can cap loss at capital contributed; general partners typically cannot
CI-003.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-004.reasoning: Reasoning: Public issuers sell claims to a broad investor base and face heavier disclosure. Private issuers raise capital from a smaller set of owners: control is more concentrated, liquidity is lower, and reporting cost is lower.

why_wrong.A: Those are private-issuer traits: concentrated control, lower liquidity, lower reporting cost.
why_wrong.B: Unlimited liability and pass-through tax describe a sole prop / typical partnership, not a public issuer.

CI-004.zh: 公開發行面對廣大投資人、揭露較重。私人發行人股東較集中、流動性較差、報 告成本較低。
CI-004.core_idea: Public issuers face a broad investor base and heavier disclosure; private issuers are more concentrated
CI-004.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-005.reasoning: Reasoning: Shareholders’ limited liability — they can lose invested equity, not personal assets — is what makes outside equity and public listing feasible. A sole proprietorship has no such shield. Unlimited liability would make a dispersed public float less, not more, workable.

why_wrong.A: Unlimited liability deters dispersed outside equity; it is the opposite mechanism.
why_wrong.B: Pass-through tax does not create a liability shield for outside public shareholders.

CI-005.zh: 有限責任才讓分散的外部股權與公開發行變可行。無限責任會嚇跑公眾股東，不 是在保護他們。
CI-005.core_idea: Limited liability is what makes dispersed outside equity and a public listing feasible
CI-005.exam_trap: Treating unlimited liability as a selling point for public equity
CI-005.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-006.reasoning: Reasoning: Corporate control: shareholders elect the board; the board hires and monitors management. That is the principal–agent chain. Residual ownership sits with shareholders, not creditors or a committee.

why_wrong.A: Creditors have contractual claims; they do not elect the board as residual owners.
why_wrong.B: The audit committee is a board committee, not the residual-owner electorate.

CI-006.zh: 股東選董事會，董事會聘任並監督經理人。審計委員會是董事會底下的機制，不 是剩餘請求權人。
CI-006.core_idea: Shareholders elect the board; managers run the firm — corporate control chain
CI-006.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-007.reasoning: Reasoning: Shareholders own residual claims. Creditors have contractual claims on cash and, if secured, on collateral. The residual is what is left after contractual claims are met — not a reversal that makes creditors residual owners.

why_wrong.A: Creditors have contractual claims and, if secured, collateral — they are not the residual owner.
why_wrong.B: Employee claims are not the residual equity claim.

CI-007.zh: 股東拿剩餘；債權人拿契約現金，有擔保再加抵押品。不要把「破產清償順序」說 成債權人是剩餘請求權人。
CI-007.core_idea: Shareholders own residual claims; creditors have contractual claims, secured if collateral exists
CI-007.study_section: Investors and Other Stakeholders ｜投資人與其他利害關係人
CI-007.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。
CI-007.subtopic: 4.2 Investors and Other Stakeholders ｜投資人與其他利害關係人

CI-008.reasoning: Reasoning: Claims can conflict. A leverage increase can transfer value from creditors toward equity by raising default risk on already-outstanding debt. That is a shareholder–creditor agency / stakeholder conflict. Limited liability remains; independence rules are not the mechanism named here.

why_wrong.A: Limited liability is still in force — that is why equity can leave extra default risk with creditors.
why_wrong.C: Board independence is a monitoring mechanism; it is not the value-transfer mechanism in the stem.

CI-008.zh: 加槓桿會讓舊債更險、價格下跌，價值從債權人移向股東。這是利害衝突，不是 有限責任消失，也不是審計委員會沒簽字。
CI-008.core_idea: A leverage increase can transfer value from creditors toward equity
CI-008.study_section: Investors and Other Stakeholders ｜投資人與其他利害關係人
CI-008.exam_trap: Reading a creditor-to-equity transfer as loss of limited liability
CI-008.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。
CI-008.subtopic: 4.2 Investors and Other Stakeholders ｜投資人與其他利害關係人

CI-009.reasoning: Reasoning: Agency conflict: the agent (management) does not automatically act for the principal (shareholders, or sometimes a broader stakeholder set). Hidden information and hidden action are the usual mechanisms. Exam focus: whose interest is sacrificed, and which mechanism realigns it.

why_wrong.A: Creditors have contractual claims; shareholders have residual claims — they are not the same claim.
why_wrong.B: Identical residual claims would remove, not create, the conflict the chapter defines.

CI-009.zh: 代理衝突：經理人不一定自動為委託人做事。考點是誰的利益被犧牲、用什麼機 制對齊。
CI-009.core_idea: Agency conflict: agent (management) does not automatically act for the principal
CI-009.study_section: Investors and Other Stakeholders ｜投資人與其他利害關係人
CI-009.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。
CI-009.subtopic: 4.2 Investors and Other Stakeholders ｜投資人與其他利害關係人

CI-010.reasoning: Reasoning: Employees, customers, suppliers, governments, and communities also have stakes. A price cut can help customers and squeeze suppliers. Stakeholder analysis asks whose claim is helped or hurt — it does not shrink the set to shareholders only.

why_wrong.A: Stakeholders include customers, suppliers, employees, governments, and communities, not only shareholders.
why_wrong.B: Price changes are ordinary operating decisions; the issue is claim conflict, not a blanket ban.

CI-010.zh: 利害關係人不只股東。降價可能利客戶、壓供應商。分析看誰被幫、誰被擠，不 是把非股東全部排除。
CI-010.core_idea: A price cut can help customers and squeeze suppliers — stakeholder claims conflict
CI-010.study_section: Investors and Other Stakeholders ｜投資人與其他利害關係人
CI-010.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。
CI-010.subtopic: 4.2 Investors and Other Stakeholders ｜投資人與其他利害關係人

CI-011.reasoning: Reasoning: A plant closure can hit a community while raising ROE. That is an example of conflicting claims, not a proof that only equity matters and not a rule that community effects always override value analysis.

why_wrong.B: An ROE increase does not erase other claims; it can coexist with a community loss.
why_wrong.C: The chapter does not replace NPV / ROE analysis with a rule that community effects always win.

CI-011.zh: 關廠可以同時提高ROE 與傷害社區。這是利害衝突的例子，不是「只有股東算 數」，也不是「社區永遠壓過價值」。
CI-011.core_idea: A plant closure can hit a community while raising ROE — claims can conflict
CI-011.study_section: Investors and Other Stakeholders ｜投資人與其他利害關係人
CI-011.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。
CI-011.subtopic: 4.2 Investors and Other Stakeholders ｜投資人與其他利害關係人

CI-012.reasoning: Reasoning: Agency conflict arises because the agent need not automatically serve the principal. Hidden information and hidden action are the usual mechanisms. Limited liability and liquidity sources answer different questions.

why_wrong.A: Those are liquidity classifications, not agency mechanisms.
why_wrong.B: Those are organizational-form features, not agency mechanisms.

CI-012.zh: 代理衝突的常見機制是隱藏資訊與隱藏行動，不是有限責任或流動性分類。
CI-012.core_idea: Hidden information and hidden action are the usual agency mechanisms
CI-012.study_section: Investors and Other Stakeholders ｜投資人與其他利害關係人
CI-012.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。
CI-012.subtopic: 4.2 Investors and Other Stakeholders ｜投資人與其他利害關係人

CI-013.reasoning: Reasoning: Shareholders elect the board; the board hires and monitors management. Independence is a mechanism (majority non-executive; independent audit, compensation, and nomination committees), not a claim that independent directors are “nicer.” ESG on the risk map is not a substitute for fiduciary analysis.

why_wrong.A: ESG-related governance asks whether E/S/G risks are on the board’s risk map; it is not a substitute for fiduciary analysis.
why_wrong.B: Independence is associated with non-executive directors, not with packing the board with executives.

CI-013.zh: 獨立董事不是「比較好心」，而是比較沒有經營層的利益綁定。審計／薪酬／提名 委員會是機制。ESG 不能取代受託分析。
CI-013.core_idea: Board independence is a mechanism: majority non-executive; independent audit, compensation, nomination
CI-013.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-014.reasoning: Reasoning: Audit / compensation / nomination committees oversee financial reporting, pay, and director nomination. They are part of board oversight, not a replacement for shareholder voting and not a product-pricing desk.

why_wrong.B: Those pairings scramble the tasks the chapter assigns.
why_wrong.C: Committees are board mechanisms; they do not replace voting rights.

CI-014.zh: 審計管財務報導，薪酬管薪水，提名管董事名單。委員會是監督機制，不是取代 股東投票。
CI-014.core_idea: Audit, compensation, and nomination committees monitor reporting, pay, and director slates
CI-014.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-015.reasoning: Reasoning: Governance mechanisms include voting rights, board oversight, incentive pay, debt covenants, the market for corporate control, and disclosure. Stakeholder management tries to keep claims from destroying firm value.

why_wrong.B: Those are business-model pricing patterns, not governance mechanisms.
why_wrong.C: Those are liquidity tools, not governance mechanisms.

CI-015.zh: 治理機制：投票、董事會監督、激勵薪酬、債務契約、控制權市場、揭露。不要 跟流動性或訂價模式搞混。
CI-015.core_idea: Governance mechanisms include voting, board oversight, incentive pay, covenants, control market, disclosure
CI-015.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-016.reasoning: Reasoning: ESG-related governance asks whether environmental, social, and governance risks are in the board’s risk map. Putting them there does not retire fiduciary analysis of project and financing decisions.

why_wrong.A: Legal form does not change because a risk map was updated.
why_wrong.B: The chapter says ESG-related governance is not a substitute for fiduciary analysis.

CI-016.zh: ESG 進風險地圖，是問董事會有沒有看到這些風險，不能拿來取代受託義務分析。
CI-016.core_idea: ESG-related governance is not a substitute for fiduciary analysis
CI-016.exam_trap: Treating an ESG risk map as a substitute for fiduciary analysis
CI-016.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-017.reasoning: Reasoning: Debt covenants and incentive pay sit on the chapter’s list of governance mechanisms. They are alignment tools. Their existence does not prove agency conflict is impossible, and they are not liquidity sources.

why_wrong.A: Covenants and incentive pay are governance tools, not liquidity classifications.
why_wrong.B: Mechanisms reduce, they do not erase, the possibility of agency conflict.

CI-017.zh: 債務契約與激勵薪酬是對齊機制，不是流動性來源，也不能保證代理衝突從此消 失。
CI-017.core_idea: Incentive pay and debt covenants are alignment mechanisms, not personality labels
CI-017.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-018.reasoning: Reasoning: Governance mechanisms include the market for corporate control. A bid that can replace management is that mechanism. It is not a primary liquidity source and is not an MM capital-structure theorem.

why_wrong.A: MM irrelevance is a capital-structure claim under stated assumptions, not a denial that control markets exist.
why_wrong.C: A control bid is not the firm’s ordinary cash engine (sales, collections, trade credit, short-term borrowing).

CI-018.zh: 控制權市場是治理機制：股價落後可能引來收購、換掉經理人。不是primary liquidity，也不是MM 定理。
CI-018.core_idea: The market for corporate control is a governance mechanism outside day-to-day operations
CI-018.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-019.reasoning: Reasoning: Primary sources are the firm’s ordinary short-term cash engines: selling goods and services, collecting receivables, using trade credit, and borrowing short-term. Secondary sources are the back-up actions when those engines are not enough.

why_wrong.B: Those are governance mechanisms, not liquidity sources.
why_wrong.C: Those are secondary sources — used when ordinary engines are not enough.

CI-019.zh: Primary 是正常做生意就會進來的錢：銷貨、收應收、用供應商信用、短借。砍股 利、發新股、賣資產是secondary。
CI-019.core_idea: Primary liquidity is the ordinary short-term cash engine
CI-019.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-020.reasoning: Reasoning: Secondary sources include suspending or reducing dividends and issuing equity. Cash arrives from the issue, but existing shareholders are diluted. These are back-up actions, not the ordinary operating engine, and they are not drag/pull labels.

why_wrong.A: Drag/pull classify inflow delay versus forced outflow, not these secondary financing actions.
why_wrong.C: Primary sources are ordinary sales, collections, trade credit, and short-term borrowing — not emergency dividend cuts or new equity.

CI-020.zh: 生意現金不夠才動的後手：砍股利、發新股。發新股能進現金，但會稀釋既有股 東。這不是drag/pull。
CI-020.core_idea: Secondary sources: cut dividends or capex, issue equity (dilutes), renegotiate, sell assets, bankruptcy
CI-020.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-021.reasoning: Reasoning: A drag is an inflow problem: cash that should arrive is delayed or reduced. Uncollected receivables (more days outstanding) and obsolete inventory (no demand, or sale only at a discount) are the chapter’s drag examples. A pull is an outflow forced earlier than matching sales proceeds.

why_wrong.A: Uncollected or discounted items are inflow failures, not the ordinary cash engine.
why_wrong.C: Pulls are outflow problems (early payment, cut credit lines), not delayed or discounted inflows.

CI-021.zh: Drag 是錢進不來：應收變慢、過時存貨只能打折。Pull 是錢被提前抽走。不要把 週轉變差一律叫流出。
CI-021.core_idea: A drag is an inflow problem: cash that should arrive is delayed or reduced
CI-021.exam_trap: Calling every working-capital problem a pull
CI-021.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-022.reasoning: Reasoning: A pull is an outflow problem. Reduced supplier credit after late payment forces the firm to spend before matching sales proceeds arrive. That is the opposite of a drag (inflow delayed or reduced).

why_wrong.A: The inflow side did not slow; the outflow was pulled forward by lost supplier credit.
why_wrong.C: Reduced supplier credit after late payment is listed as a pull, not as a primary source.

CI-022.zh: 供應商砍信用、要貨到付款，是流出被提前抽走，屬於pull。不是應收變慢那種 drag。
CI-022.core_idea: A pull is an outflow problem: cash spent before matching sales proceeds
CI-022.exam_trap: Calling a forced earlier outflow a drag
CI-022.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-023.reasoning: Reasoning: Paying suppliers early without a compensating benefit is a listed pull: the firm gives up the use of those funds. It is not a delayed inflow and not a secondary financing source.

why_wrong.B: Secondary sources are back-up actions (cut dividend, issue equity, sell assets). This is an operating outflow timing problem.
why_wrong.C: No inflow was delayed; cash left earlier.

CI-023.zh: 提早付款又沒有折扣，等於把錢提前交出去，是pull。不是inflow 變慢，也不是 發新股那種secondary。
CI-023.core_idea: Paying suppliers early without a compensating benefit is a pull
CI-023.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-024.reasoning: Reasoning: The chapter splits credit stress by direction. Borrowing constraints that stop an inflow from arriving are a drag. Limits on short-term credit lines that force cash out or block the buffer are a pull. Do not dump every credit event into one bucket.

why_wrong.A: Event (1) is a listed drag: borrowing constraints when credit tightens.
why_wrong.B: Event (2) is a listed pull: limits on short-term credit lines.

CI-024.zh: 借不到（錢進不來）是drag；額度被砍、被迫提早拿出現金是pull。信用出問題 要先問流入還是流出。
CI-024.core_idea: Borrowing constraints and credit-line limits: drag vs pull by inflow vs outflow
CI-024.exam_trap: Treating every credit event as the same liquidity label
CI-024.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-025.reasoning: Reasoning: Operating cycle = inventory days + receivable days = 48+36 = 84. Cash conversion cycle subtracts payable days: 84-30 = 54. CCC measures how long cash is tied in the operating cycle. Given: Inventory days = 48; receivable days = 36; payable days = 30. Asked: Cash conversion cycle. Formula: CCC = 48 + 36 −30 Variables: CCC = days cash is tied in the operating cycle. Why this formula: Inventory and receivables tie cash up; payables are a spontaneous source that shortens the cash gap. Cash is tied for 54 days after counting supplier financing. Reasonableness check: 84 is the operating cycle, not CCC. Forgetting to subtract AP is the usual miss. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: That is the operating cycle (48+36), which does not subtract payables.
why_wrong.B: Subtracts inventory as well: 48+36-30-36, or 48-30.

CI-025.zh: 營業週期是存貨天數加應收天數；CCC 再減應付天數。漏減應付會算出84。
CI-025.core_idea: CCC = inventory days + receivable days - payable days
CI-025.formula: CCC = inv days + AR days −AP days
CI-025.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-026.reasoning: Reasoning: CCC = inventory + receivables - payables. Longer inventory or receivable days delay inflows (drags). Stretching payables shortens the cycle, but late payment can become a pull if suppliers cut credit. Do not treat every CCC change as a pull.

why_wrong.B: The chapter warns that late payment can become a pull when suppliers cut credit.
why_wrong.C: A longer CCC from slower inflows is a drag story, not a forced-earlier outflow.

CI-026.zh: 存貨或應收變長是drag。拉長應付會縮短CCC，但拖成遲付、被砍信用，就變成 pull。
CI-026.core_idea: Longer inventory or receivable days are drags; stretching payables shortens CCC but late payment can become a pull
CI-026.exam_trap: Treating every CCC lengthening as a pull
CI-026.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-027.reasoning: Reasoning: Issuing equity is listed among secondary sources: cash arrives; existing shareholders are diluted. It is not the ordinary operating engine and not a drag (inflow delay from customers).

why_wrong.B: Primary sources are ordinary sales, collections, trade credit, and short-term borrowing.
why_wrong.C: Dilution is an ownership effect, not a delayed customer inflow.

CI-027.zh: 發新股是secondary：錢進來，但舊股東被稀釋。不是銷貨那種primary，也不是 應收變慢。
CI-027.core_idea: Issuing equity is a secondary source: cash arrives; existing shareholders are diluted
CI-027.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-028.reasoning: Reasoning: Limits on credit lines and an already-low liquidity position are listed as pulls: the firm has less room before outflows become a problem. That is not a primary source and does not force a sign on CCC.

why_wrong.B: The chapter does not make a negative CCC a required implication of a weak position.
why_wrong.C: A thin buffer is not an ordinary cash engine.

CI-028.zh: 流動性本來就薄，被歸在pull：緩衝不夠，流出更容易出問題。不是primary，也 不必然讓CCC 變負。
CI-028.core_idea: Already-low liquidity is listed as a pull (buffer already gone)
CI-028.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-029.reasoning: Reasoning: Decisions use incremental after-tax cash flows, timed when they occur. The outlay is not expensed at once on the income statement; cash is what the model times. Interest is not a Year-1 project outflow.

why_wrong.B: The income statement records non-cash depreciation over the life; the decision uses incremental cash, timed when spent or received.
why_wrong.C: Financing costs sit in the required return, not as a project cash-flow line.

CI-029.zh: 只看「做與不做」差出來的稅後現金流，而且要對準發生時點。利息不進項目CF， 折舊不是現金。
CI-029.core_idea: Capital allocation uses incremental after-tax cash flows timed when they occur
CI-029.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-030.reasoning: Reasoning: Incremental cash flows only. Sunk costs are ignored. The study is already spent whether Orchid takes the expansion or not. The 12 million equipment is the incremental outlay. Depreciation later is a non-cash income-statement item, not a reason to drop the cash purchase.

why_wrong.B: A sunk study is spent in both the take and no-take worlds, so it is not incremental.
why_wrong.C: The equipment outlay is cash when incurred; calling it non-cash because it will later be depreciated reverses the chapter’s cash-versus-accrual split.

CI-030.zh: 已經花掉、收不回的研究是sunk，做不做都一樣，不進模型。現在要買的設備才 是增量現金流出。
CI-030.core_idea: Sunk costs are ignored; they are already spent whether the project is taken or not
CI-030.exam_trap: Putting a sunk study into project CF
CI-030.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-031.reasoning: Reasoning: Externalities count, including cannibalization of the firm’s existing sales. Incremental operating cash = 9.0 - 2.4 = 6.6 million after tax. The lost old cash is a cost of taking the project. Given: New-product after-tax CF = 9.0; lost after-tax CF on existing sales = 2.4. Asked: Incremental annual operating cash flow. Formula: 9.0 −2.4 = 6.6 Variables: Cannibalization = externality on the firm’s own old sales. Why this formula: Incremental means take-versus-not-take. Lost old cash exists only if the project is taken. Only the change in the firm’s after-tax cash enters the model. Reasonableness check: 9.0 ignores the externality; 11.4 signs it backwards. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Adds the lost old sales instead of subtracting the externality.
why_wrong.B: Drops cannibalization, treating new-product cash as if old sales were unaffected.

CI-031.zh: 自我蠶食是外部性，要扣。新烤箱9.0 減掉被搶走的舊款稅後現金2.4，增量是 6.6。
CI-031.core_idea: Cannibalization is an externality that counts: lost after-tax cash on existing sales
CI-031.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-032.reasoning: Reasoning: Opportunity costs count: cash flows the firm gives up by taking the project. Using the depot means not selling it for 4.5 million after tax. Book value is not that cash figure. Sunk is the past purchase, not the current alternative use.

why_wrong.B: Book value is an accounting carrying amount, not the cash given up.
why_wrong.C: The historical purchase may be sunk, but the current sale that is given up is not — that is the opportunity cost.

CI-032.zh: 機會成本是「拿去做專案就放棄的現金」。現在能賣4.5（稅後）卻不賣，這4.5 要 進模型。帳面2.0 不是現金，過去買價才是sunk。
CI-032.core_idea: Opportunity costs count: cash the firm gives up by taking the project
CI-032.exam_trap: Replacing opportunity cost with book value or calling it sunk
CI-032.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-033.reasoning: Reasoning: The candidate error the chapter flags: interest on the loan that happens to fund Project X is not a Year-1 outflow in the NPV spreadsheet. That cost is already in the discount rate. Internally generated cash is not a cheaper source either.

why_wrong.B: Putting interest in CF and still using WACC double-counts the cost of capital.
why_wrong.C: The chapter’s rule is: financing costs are not in project CF; they sit in the required return. Zeroing the hurdle is not the rule.

CI-033.zh: 剛好用來做這個project 的貸款利息，不要再當成項目現金流出。資本成本已經在 折現率裡；再扣一次就是算兩次。
CI-033.core_idea: Financing costs are not put in project cash flows; they sit in the required return
CI-033.exam_trap: Putting loan interest into project CF
CI-033.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-034.reasoning: Reasoning: Internally generated cash (CFO) is not a cheaper source. It still has an opportunity cost equal to what capital providers require. Using a near-zero hurdle because “we already have the cash” is a listed cognitive error.

why_wrong.A: The chapter rejects treating internal cash as free.
why_wrong.B: The opportunity cost does not disappear for all-equity firms; providers still require a return.

CI-034.zh: 帳上的經營現金不是免費的錢。機會成本仍是資本提供者要求的報酬。用接近零 的折現率，是把內部資金當成便宜來源。
CI-034.core_idea: Internally generated cash (CFO) is not a cheaper source; it still has the capital providers’ opportunity cost
CI-034.exam_trap: Treating CFO as cheaper than outside capital
CI-034.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-035.reasoning: Reasoning: After-tax cash flows: 40×(1-0.25) = 30. Interest of 6 is a financing cost and stays out of the project CF; it is already in the required return. The tax that belongs here is tax on incremental operating earnings, not a second copy of interest. Given: Pretax incremental operating cash = 40; t = 25%; pretax interest = 6 (financing, not in CF). Asked: Incremental after-tax operating cash flow for the NPV column. Formula: 40 × (1 −0.25) = 30 Variables: t = corporate tax rate on incremental operating earnings. Why this formula: The decision uses after-tax operating cash. Financing is in r, so interest is not deducted again. Tax on operations is in CF; the loan coupon is in WACC. Reasonableness check: 25.5 double-counts capital cost. 40 ignores tax. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
CI-035.steps: ①After-tax operating CF = 40 × (1 - 0.25) = 30. ②Do not subtract 6 or 6×(1-0.25).

why_wrong.A: Leaves the 40 pretax, ignoring the after-tax rule.
why_wrong.B: Subtracts after-tax interest as well: 40×(1-0.25)-6×(1-0.25) = 25.5, putting financing in CF.

CI-035.zh: 稅後營運現金是40×(1-0.25)=30。利息6 不進CF。若再扣稅後利息得到25.5， 就是把融資成本放進現金流。
CI-035.core_idea: After-tax cash flows: tax on incremental operating earnings belongs in the CF, not as a financing item
CI-035.exam_trap: Netting after-tax interest out of project CF
CI-035.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-036.reasoning: Reasoning: Item 1 is sunk and is ignored. Item 2 is a financing cost and sits in the required return. Item 3 is cannibalization, an externality that counts. Only 3 enters the cash-flow column. (New fact pattern; not the Mixed Practice stem.)

why_wrong.A: Item 2 is financing, not an incremental operating cash flow; item 3 does belong.
why_wrong.B: Item 1 is sunk; item 2 is financing and belongs in the discount rate.

CI-036.zh: 已花的原型是sunk；貸款利息進折現率；被取代的舊產品稅後現金才是增量。只 有第3 項進CF。
CI-036.core_idea: Sunk, financing, and cannibalization: only the externality enters incremental CF
CI-036.exam_trap: Putting sunk cost and interest into incremental CF
CI-036.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-037.reasoning: Reasoning: Recorded at cost on the balance sheet. The income statement does not expense the outlay; it records non-cash depreciation over the life. Cash spending appears on the cash flow statement when incurred. NPV times that cash, not the later accrual.

why_wrong.A: Depreciation is non-cash; it does not replace the timed cash outlay in the decision.
why_wrong.C: The chapter separates the cash spending (when incurred) from later non-cash depreciation.

CI-037.zh: 資本支出先入帳，損益不一次費用化，而是分年提非現金折舊。現金流量表在付 出當下認列現金。NPV 跟的是現金時點。
CI-037.core_idea: The income statement does not expense the capex outlay; cash is reported when spent
CI-037.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-038.reasoning: Reasoning: Opportunity cost is the cash given up. Selling today would produce 8×(1-0.25) = 6 after tax. Using the machine forgoes that 6, so time-0 incremental CF includes a 6 million outflow. Pretax 8 ignores tax; zero ignores the alternative use. Given: Pretax sale proceeds given up = 8; t = 25%; sale would be fully taxable. Asked: Time-0 incremental CF effect of using the spectrometer. Formula: 8 × (1 −0.25) = 6 Variables: After-tax proceeds = cash the take-the-project world does not receive. Why this formula: After-tax cash flows; the alternative is a taxable sale today. The project must cover the missed after-tax sale as well as any new outlays. Reasonableness check: Zero treats a live alternative as sunk. 8 forgets tax. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
CI-038.steps: ①After-tax proceeds given up = 8 × 0.75 = 6. ②Enter as a time-0 opportunity-cost outflow.

why_wrong.A: Ownership does not erase the sale that is given up.
why_wrong.C: The chapter’s cash flows are after-tax; the missed sale would have been taxed.

CI-038.zh: 現在能賣、稅後拿6 卻不賣，這6 是機會成本，要當成今天的流出。不是「反正 機器已在手上就零」。
CI-038.core_idea: Opportunity cost of a used asset is the after-tax cash given up, not a later depreciation charge
CI-038.formula: opportunity cost = (1 −t) × pretax proceeds given up
CI-038.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-039.reasoning: Reasoning: Projects may be independent (evaluate one by one) or mutually exclusive (the firm can take only one). A unique site is a mutually exclusive constraint. With that constraint, NPV is the theoretically preferred ranking because it is the estimated addition to firm value.

why_wrong.A: The shared site makes them mutually exclusive, not independent.
why_wrong.B: NPV and IRR can rank differently on size or timing; NPV is the theoretically preferred ranking.

CI-039.zh: 同一塊地只能上一個，是互斥，不是獨立。兩個NPV 都正也不能兩個都做。互斥 聽NPV，不要自動聽IRR。
CI-039.core_idea: Independent projects: evaluate one by one; mutually exclusive: take only one
CI-039.exam_trap: Treating mutually exclusive projects as independent
CI-039.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-040.reasoning: Reasoning: Unlimited capital: take every positive-NPV project. Capital rationing: take the most valuable group the limited capital can fund. Do not apply the unlimited-capital rule when capital is rationed, and do not shrink unlimited capital to one IRR winner.

why_wrong.A: Unlimited capital means every positive-NPV project, not a single IRR champion.
why_wrong.B: Rationing means the firm cannot fund every positive-NPV project; it must pick the most valuable feasible group.

CI-040.zh: 資金不限：所有NPV>0 都做。資本配給：在額度內選最能增加價值的組合。不 要把兩種情況的規則對調。
CI-040.core_idea: With unlimited capital, take every positive-NPV project; under rationing, take the most valuable feasible group
CI-040.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-041.reasoning: Reasoning: Decisions use incremental after-tax cash flows, timed when they occur. Timing matters: a positive required return makes earlier cash more valuable. Do not treat “incremental” as “undiscounted.”

why_wrong.A: Incremental cash flows are still discounted; timing is one of the five decision principles.
why_wrong.C: Tax is applied when cash is earned; delaying does not create a free tax holiday in the chapter.

CI-041.zh: 增量稅後現金仍要折現。同一筆20，早到的現值較高。Incremental 不是「不用折 現」。
CI-041.core_idea: Timing matters: the same after-tax cash is worth less if it arrives later
CI-041.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-042.reasoning: Reasoning: After-tax incremental CF = (16 - 4) × (1 - 0.25) = 12 × 0.75 = 9. Both the new cash and the lost old cash are taxed. Leaving cannibalization pretax, or dropping it, breaks the after-tax incremental rule. Given: New pretax = 16; lost old pretax = 4; t = 25%. Asked: Annual incremental after-tax operating cash. Formula: (16 −4) × (1 −0.25) = 9 Variables: Lost old pretax is the cannibalization externality. Why this formula: Incremental pretax change is then taxed; financing is not in this line. The firm keeps 75% of the net operating change. Reasonableness check: 12 ignores tax on the net change or drops cannibalization after taxing new only. 13 mixes pretax and after-tax pieces. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Taxes only the new cash: 16×0.75 = 12, and drops the externality.
why_wrong.C: Subtracts pretax cannibalization from after-tax new cash: 16×0.75 - 4 = 8, or 16-4×0.75 = 13.

CI-042.zh: 新舊都要稅後。增量稅前12，乘(1-0.25) 得9。只稅新產品、或只扣稅前蠶食， 都會錯。
CI-042.core_idea: Cannibalization is after-tax: subtract the tax-adjusted lost old cash
CI-042.exam_trap: Taxing new cash but leaving cannibalization pretax
CI-042.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-043.reasoning: Reasoning: Cost-reducing replacement is a listed project type; the rule is still incremental after-tax cash. After-tax saving = 10 × (1 - 0.30) = 7. The loan interest stays in the discount rate. Given: Pretax cost saving = 10; t = 30%; interest = 2 (not in CF). Asked: Incremental after-tax operating cash. Formula: 10 × (1 −0.30) = 7 Variables: Replacement cash is the change versus keeping the old machine. Why this formula: Only the after-tax operating change is incremental; financing sits in r. The replacement is worth the tax-adjusted cost cut, discounted at the project rate. Reasonableness check: 5.6 puts financing in CF. 10 ignores tax. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
CI-043.steps: ①After-tax saving = 10 × 0.70 = 7. ②Do not subtract interest.

why_wrong.A: Leaves the cost saving pretax.
why_wrong.B: Nets after-tax interest: 10×0.70 - 2×0.70 = 5.6.

CI-043.zh: 省下的營運成本要稅後：10×0.7=7。借錢買機器的利息不進CF。
CI-043.core_idea: A cost-reducing replacement still uses incremental after-tax cash, not the whole firm’s CFO
CI-043.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-044.reasoning: Reasoning: Expected inflation is already in WACC, so forecast cash flows must be raised for positive inflation. Mixing a nominal WACC with unadjusted (real) cash flows rejects projects that would have been wealth-increasing. That is a listed cognitive error: internally inconsistent forecasts / mixing real and nominal.

why_wrong.A: The chapter’s point is the mismatch rejects good projects; inflation does not automatically cancel.
why_wrong.C: Mixing real CF with a nominal rate makes the discounted value too small, not too large.

CI-044.zh: 名目WACC 已含通膨，現金流也要含通膨。用未調整的實質現金流去折，NPV 偏低，好案子會被誤殺。
CI-044.core_idea: Because expected inflation is already in WACC, forecast cash flows must be raised for positive inflation
CI-044.exam_trap: Mixing nominal WACC with real cash flows
CI-044.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-045.reasoning: Reasoning: Financing costs are not put in the project’s cash flows. They sit in WACC, and debt’s weight already uses rd(1-t) when interest is deducted in full. Putting after-tax interest in CF as well counts the same capital cost twice. Project-specific loan mix does not override target weights.

why_wrong.B: The chapter’s rule is that financing is not in project CF; WACC already has after-tax debt.
why_wrong.C: How this particular project is financed does not change the rule: use target WACC, keep interest out of CF.

CI-045.zh: WACC 已經用rd(1-t)，再在項目CF 扣稅後利息，稅盾被算兩次。融資成本只待 在折現率。
CI-045.core_idea: WACC already uses rd(1-t), so interest tax shields are not a second project CF line
CI-045.exam_trap: Putting interest tax shields in CF while using after-tax WACC
CI-045.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-046.reasoning: Reasoning: Incremental means take-versus-not-take. Headquarters rent that is paid either way is not incremental (it behaves like a sunk / non-incremental allocation). The warehouse cash given up is an opportunity cost and counts.

why_wrong.A: The warehouse rent given up is a live opportunity cost; it is not sunk.
why_wrong.C: A cost sheet allocation is not incremental if the cash is spent in both worlds.

CI-046.zh: 總部租金做不做都要付，不是增量。倉庫若能出租0.5 卻拿去自用，那才是機會成 本。
CI-046.core_idea: Allocated costs that will be incurred anyway are not incremental
CI-046.exam_trap: Treating a non-incremental allocation as project CF
CI-046.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-047.reasoning: Reasoning: Sequencing means a later accept/reject depends on the first project’s outcome. That is different from independent evaluation and different from capital rationing (limited funds across projects).

why_wrong.A: Rationing is a limited-capital constraint, not a technical dependence of Phase 2 on Phase 1.
why_wrong.C: Separate IRRs do not make a dependent follow-on independent.

CI-047.zh: 序列投資：第二期能不能做，取決於第一期結果。這不是獨立項目，也不是資本 配給。
CI-047.core_idea: Sequencing: a later accept/reject can depend on the first project’s outcome
CI-047.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-048.reasoning: Reasoning: The process still generates ideas, analyzes proposals, forms the budget, and postaudits. But the chapter notes that some high-risk R&D / new-business projects are not easily analyzed with standard tools. That is not a command to switch everything to payback.

why_wrong.A: NPV is the value rule for ordinary analyzable projects, including replacements.
why_wrong.B: Mandates are a listed project type; they are not dropped from the process.

CI-048.zh: 維修、擴產、合規都能進資本預算；有些高風險研發／新事業不容易用標準工具 分析。不是全部改用回收期。
CI-048.core_idea: Some high-risk initiatives are not easily analyzed with standard capital-budgeting tools
CI-048.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-049.reasoning: Reasoning: For a conventional independent project, NPV>0 ⇔IRR> required return ⇔PI>1. A positive NPV of 4.2 at 10% means IRR is above 10% and PI is above 1. Do not mix the accept side with the indifference equalities.

why_wrong.B: Those inequalities are the reject side (NPV < 0).
why_wrong.C: Equality is the NPV = 0 boundary, not a positive-NPV project.

CI-049.zh: 獨立常規項目：NPV>0、IRR>r、PI>1 是同一道接受門。NPV 已經是正的， IRR 一定高於10%，PI 一定大於1。
CI-049.core_idea: For a conventional independent project: NPV>0 ⇔IRR>r ⇔PI>1
CI-049.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-051.reasoning: Reasoning: PI = 1 + NPV/outlay = 1 + 18/90 = 1.20. Equivalently, PV of future cash flows is 108, and 108/90 = 1.20. Accept if PI>1, which matches NPV>0. PI = 1 is the NPV = 0 boundary. Given: NPV = 18; initial outlay = 90. Asked: Profitability index. Formula: PI = 1 + 18/90 = 1.20 Variables: PI is PV of future CF / outlay. Why this formula: Adding 1 converts a dollar NPV into a ratio of PV to outlay. Future cash flows are worth 1.20 per unit of outlay; NPV>0 and PI>1 agree. Reasonableness check: 0.20 is the extra value ratio, not PI. 1.00 is the indifference point. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Treats any computed PI as the indifference value 1.
why_wrong.C: Reports NPV/outlay = 18/90 = 0.20 and forgets the leading 1.

CI-051.zh: PI = 1 + NPV/初始投入= 1 + 18/90 = 1.20。只算0.20 是漏掉前面的1。PI 是 比率，不是美元價值。
CI-051.core_idea: PI = PV of future CF / outlay = 1 + NPV/outlay; accept if PI>1
CI-051.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-052.reasoning: Reasoning: If cash-flow signs change more than once, more than one IRR can exist. NPV at the required return is still the value rule. Do not invent a unique-IRR law, and do not treat extra roots as automatic acceptance.

why_wrong.A: A conventional one-sign-change project has one IRR; this pattern is not conventional.
why_wrong.C: An extra root is not an accept instruction.

CI-052.zh: 現金流正負號翻超過一次，IRR 可以有多個。價值判斷仍看用要求報酬折現的 NPV，不要看到一個IRR>r 就接受。
CI-052.core_idea: If cash-flow signs change more than once, more than one IRR can exist
CI-052.exam_trap: Assuming a unique IRR when signs flip more than once
CI-052.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-054.reasoning: Reasoning: IRR solves 0 = -150 + 40/(1+IRR) + 60/(1+IRR)2 + 80/(1+IRR)3. IRR ≈8.66%. Because 8.66% < 12%, NPV is negative (-9.51) and PI < 1: reject the conventional independent project. Uneven CF: CF worksheet, not TVM. Given: CF0=-150; CF1=40; CF2=60; CF3=80; hurdle = 12%. Asked: IRR, and the accept/reject versus 12%. Formula: 0 = −150 + 40/(1 + IRR) + 60/(1 + IRR)2 + 80/(1 + IRR)3 Variables: IRR sets NPV=0; compare with r, do not replace r. Why this formula: Conventional independent: IRR>r ⇔NPV>0. Here IRR<r. IRR below the hurdle is the same decision as negative NPV. Reasonableness check: 12% is the hurdle, not the IRR. 20% is an undiscounted net-cash ratio. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：CF / IRR 已知：CF0=-150; C01=40; C02=60; C03=80 求：IRR (then compare with 12%) 按鍵： ①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②150 →+/- →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→40 →ENTER (C01) →↓→1 →ENTER (F01) ④↓→60 →ENTER (C02) →↓→1 →ENTER (F02) ⑤↓→ 80 →ENTER (C03) →↓→1 →ENTER (F03) ⑥IRR →CPT 結果：IRR = 8.66 中文理解：IRR 鍵不需要先輸入I。求出8.66% 再跟12% 比。CF0 負號：今天投入是流出。 三期流入不同，F 都是1。
CI-054.steps: ①Timeline: -150, +40, +60, +80. Interest stays out. ②Solve IRR ≈8.66%. ③8.66% < 12% →reject. Check: NPV at 12% ≈-9.51 < 0.

why_wrong.B: Averages 40, 60, 80 into 60 and does 60/150 = 40% then halves it, or uses (40+60+80-150)/150 = 20%.
why_wrong.C: Treats the hurdle as the IRR.

CI-054.zh: IRR 是讓NPV=0 的折現率，約8.7%，低於門檻12%，應拒絕。不要把hurdle 當成IRR，也不要用還本比率冒充。
CI-054.core_idea: IRR is the discount rate that sets NPV to zero; accept a conventional independent project only if IRR>r
CI-054.exam_trap: Reading the hurdle rate as the IRR

80 →ENTER (C03) →↓→1 →ENTER (F03) ⑥IRR →CPT
結果：IRR = 8.66
中文理解：IRR 鍵不需要先輸入I。求出8.66% 再跟12% 比。CF0 負號：今天投入是流出。
三期流入不同，F 都是1。
CI-054.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-055.reasoning: Reasoning: Interest is already in the 10% required return, so the timeline is CF0 = -120, C01 = 55 with F01 = 3. NPV = -120 + 55/1.10 + 55/1.21 + 55/1.331 = 16.78. Sunk items are none in the stem. Do not net 6 out of 55. Given: Outlay 120; operating CF 55 at t=1,2,3; r=10%; interest 6 is NOT in CF. Asked: NPV. Formula: NPV = −120 + 55 × 1 −1.10−3 0.10 Variables: Equal operating inflows; financing stays in r. Why this formula: Annuity of incremental after-tax operating cash, discounted at the hurdle that already prices capital. NPV>0 ⇔IRR>10% ⇔PI>1 for this conventional independent project. Reasonableness check: 1.9 nets interest in CF. 45 skips discounting. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：CF / NPV 已知：CF0=-120; C01=55; F01=3; I=10. Interest 6 is not a CF. 求：NPV 按鍵： ①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②120 →+/- →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→55 →ENTER (C01) ④↓→3 →ENTER (F01) ⑤NPV →10 →ENTER →↓→CPT 結果：NPV = 16.78 中文理解：三年相同流入用頻率3，不要把55 打三次。貸款利息不要打成負的C02。P/Y=1。 CF0 負號是今天的淨流出。

why_wrong.A: Subtracts interest in the CF column: 55-6 = 49 each year, NPV ≈1.86 — double-counts capital cost.
why_wrong.C: Undiscounted 55×3 - 120 = 45.

CI-055.zh: 三年流入相同，用F01=3。每年6 的利息已在10% 裡，再扣就是資本成本算兩 次。NPV≈16.8。
CI-055.core_idea: Loan interest is not a project CF; two equal inflows use frequency F01
CI-055.exam_trap: Putting loan interest into project CF

求：NPV

①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②120 →+/- →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→55 →ENTER (C01)
④↓→3 →ENTER (F01) ⑤NPV →10 →ENTER →↓→CPT
結果：NPV = 16.78
中文理解：三年相同流入用頻率3，不要把55 打三次。貸款利息不要打成負的C02。P/Y=1。
CF0 負號是今天的淨流出。
CI-055.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-057.reasoning: Reasoning: Incremental operating CF = 50 - 12 = 38 each year (cannibalization). Interest stays out. Timeline: -90, +38, +38, +38. NPV = -90 + 38 × (1 - 1.10^-3) / 0.10 = 4.50. Small positive NPV: accept if independent; PI slightly above 1. Given: Outlay 90; new AT CF 50; lost old AT CF 12; r=10%; interest 4 excluded. Asked: NPV of incremental cash flows. Formula: CFt = 50 −12 = 38; NPV = −90 + 38 × 2.48685 Variables: 38 is incremental after-tax operating cash. Why this formula: Externalities count; financing does not enter the CF column. NPV>0, so IRR>10% and PI>1, but only after the externality is subtracted. Reasonableness check: 34.3 skips cannibalization. 14.5 is a timing or interest-netted miss. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：CF / NPV 已知：CF0=-90; C01=38; F01=3; I=10. Do not enter 50 or -4. 求：NPV 按鍵： ①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②90 →+/- →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→38 →ENTER (C01) ④ ↓→3 →ENTER (F01) ⑤NPV →10 →ENTER →↓→CPT 結果：NPV = 4.50 中文理解：頻率3。打50 就是忘記蠶食。打34（38-4）就是把利息放進CF。CF0 負號。
CI-057.steps: ①Incremental CF1–3 = 50 - 12 = 38. Drop interest. ②Sunk: none given. Opportunity/externality: cannibalization is in. ③NPV = -90 + 38/1.10 + 38/1.21 + 38/1.331 = 4.50.

why_wrong.B: Ignores cannibalization: CF = 50 each year, NPV ≈34.3.
why_wrong.C: Treats the three inflows as an annuity due (BGN on): PV ≈38 + 38/1.10 + 38/1.21 = 103.95; 103.95 - 90 ≈14.5.

CI-057.zh: 先扣自我蠶食12，增量每年38，再折現。不要用50 去算。利息4 不進CF。 NPV≈4.5。
CI-057.core_idea: Cannibalization reduces incremental CF before NPV is computed
CI-057.exam_trap: Omitting cannibalization from the CF worksheet
CI-057.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus

已知：CF0=-90; C01=38; F01=3; I=10. Do not enter 50 or -4.
求：NPV
按鍵：
①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②90 →+/- →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→38 →ENTER (C01) ④
↓→3 →ENTER (F01) ⑤NPV →10 →ENTER →↓→CPT
結果：NPV = 4.50
中文理解：頻率3。打50 就是忘記蠶食。打34（38-4）就是把利息放進CF。CF0 負號。
CI-057.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-058.reasoning: Reasoning: Time-0 incremental outflow = 70 + 15 opportunity cost = 85. The 8 study is sunk and stays out. Interest is not in the stem as a CF. Timeline: -85, +40, +45, +50. NPV at 11% = 24.12. Omitting the sublet overstates NPV by 15. Given: New outlay 70; after-tax sublet given up 15; CF1–3 = 40,45,50; r=11%; sunk 8 excluded. Asked: NPV. Formula: NPV = −85 + 40/1.11 + 45/1.112 + 50/1.113 Variables: CF0 includes opportunity cost; sunk study does not. Why this formula: Take-versus-not-take: using the suite forgoes 15 of after-tax cash today. Still NPV>0 after charging the opportunity cost. Reasonableness check: 39.1 forgets the sublet. 8 is the sunk figure, not NPV. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：CF / NPV 已知：CF0=-85; C01=40; C02=45; C03=50; I=11 求：NPV 按鍵： ①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②85 →+/- →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→40 →ENTER →↓→ 1 →ENTER ④↓→45 →ENTER →↓→1 →ENTER ⑤↓→50 →ENTER →↓→1 → ENTER ⑥NPV →11 →ENTER →↓→CPT 結果：NPV = 24.12 中文理解：CF0 必須包含放棄的轉租15。不要只打70，也不要把沉沒的8 加進去。各期流入 不同，F=1。

why_wrong.A: Omits the 15 opportunity cost (CF0 = -70 only); NPV ≈39.1.
why_wrong.C: Adds the sunk 8 to CF0 (-93) or treats 15 as pretax.

CI-058.zh: 今天流出是新投入70 加放棄轉租15，共85。去年可行性研究8 是sunk。漏掉機 會成本會把NPV 多算15。
CI-058.core_idea: Opportunity cost raises CF0; omit it and NPV is overstated

中文理解：CF0 必須包含放棄的轉租15。不要只打70，也不要把沉沒的8 加進去。各期流入
不同，F=1。
CI-058.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-059.reasoning: Reasoning: After-tax operating CF = 70 × (1 - 0.30) = 49 each year. Timeline: -100, +49, +49, +49. Coupon stays in WACC. NPV = -100 + 49 × (1 - 1.09^-3) / 0.09 = 24.03. Using 70 overstates NPV; netting the coupon double-counts financing. Given: Outlay 100; pretax operating 70 for 3 years; t=30%; r=9%; coupon 5 excluded. Asked: NPV. Formula: 49 = 70 × 0.70; NPV = −100 + 49 × 2.5313 Variables: 49 is incremental after-tax operating cash. Why this formula: The decision uses after-tax cash; tax is on operations, not a second copy of interest. NPV>0 ⇔IRR>9% ⇔PI>1. Reasonableness check: 77.2 is pretax. 5.4 nets financing or uses a wrong n. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：CF / NPV 已知：CF0=-100; C01=49; F01=3; I=9. Not 70; not 49-5. 求：NPV 按鍵： ①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②100 →+/- →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→49 →ENTER (C01) ④↓→3 →ENTER (F01) ⑤NPV →9 →ENTER →↓→CPT 結果：NPV = 24.03 中文理解：稅要先算在現金流上：打49 不是70。利息已在9%。三年相同用F01=3。CLR WORK 避免留下舊頻率。

why_wrong.A: Discounts pretax 70 each year: NPV ≈77.2, ignoring the after-tax rule.
why_wrong.C: Nets the coupon after tax (70×0.7 - 5×0.7 = 45.5) and discounts that.

CI-059.zh: 先把70 變稅後49，再進CF 表。不要折稅前70，也不要再扣貸款利息。 NPV≈24。
CI-059.core_idea: After-tax operating CF = pretax × (1-t) before it enters the CF worksheet
CI-059.exam_trap: Discounting pretax operating cash or netting interest

求：NPV
按鍵：
①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②100 →+/- →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→49 →ENTER (C01)
④↓→3 →ENTER (F01) ⑤NPV →9 →ENTER →↓→CPT
結果：NPV = 24.03
中文理解：稅要先算在現金流上：打49 不是70。利息已在9%。三年相同用F01=3。CLR
WORK 避免留下舊頻率。
CI-059.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-060.reasoning: Reasoning: Incremental timeline: -180, +60, +70, +105. Salvage is after-tax cash at t=3, so it belongs in CF3. Sunk items are not in the stem; interest is not a CF. IRR ≈13.20% > 10%, and NPV ≈11.28 > 0, so PI > 1. Uneven CF including salvage: CF worksheet, not TVM. Given: CF0=-180; CF1=60; CF2=70; CF3=80+25 salvage; compare with r=10%. Asked: IRR. Formula: CF3 = 80 + 25 = 105 Variables: Salvage is timed at t=3, after tax. Why this formula: IRR zeroes the NPV of the incremental after-tax timeline. IRR>r, NPV>0, and PI>1 are the same accept door. Reasonableness check: 10% is the hurdle. 7.7% is a dropped-salvage IRR. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：CF / IRR 已知：CF0=-180; C01=60; C02=70; C03=105 求：IRR 按鍵： ①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②180 →+/- →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→60 →ENTER →↓→ 1 →ENTER ④↓→70 →ENTER →↓→1 →ENTER ⑤↓→105 →ENTER →↓→1 → ENTER ⑥IRR →CPT 結果：IRR = 13.20 中文理解：殘值加在最後一期，不要另開TVM。CF0 負號。想核對再進NPV、I=10、CPT， 應約11.28。
CI-060.steps: ①Build CF3 = 80 + 25 = 105. ②Solve IRR ≈13.20%. ③13.20% > 10% →accept if conventional independent. NPV check ≈11.28.

why_wrong.B: Drops salvage (CF3 = 80) and computes that lower IRR ≈7.7%.
why_wrong.C: Reports the hurdle as the IRR.

CI-060.zh: 期末稅後殘值25 加進第三期，C03=105。IRR≈13.2%>10%，與NPV>0 一致。 漏掉殘值會低估IRR。
CI-060.core_idea: Terminal salvage is incremental after-tax cash at the horizon, not a reason to use TVM PMT

按鍵：
①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②180 →+/- →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→60 →ENTER →↓→
1 →ENTER ④↓→70 →ENTER →↓→1 →ENTER ⑤↓→105 →ENTER →↓→1 →

CI-060.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-061.reasoning: Reasoning: IRR prefers L (35% vs 25%). NPV prefers M (21.82 vs 18.18). For mutually exclusive projects, NPV and IRR can rank differently because of project size. NPV is the theoretically preferred ranking: it is the estimated addition to firm value. Take M. (New numbers; not the chapter’s 50/70 vs 100/130 pair.) Given: Only one project; r=10%; L: -80,+108; M: -160,+200. Asked: Which project to take, and why NPV overrides IRR here. Formula: NPVL = 108/1.10 −80; NPVM = 200/1.10 −160 Variables: One-period IRRs are CF1/outlay - 1. Why this formula: NPV is dollars of value; IRR is a percentage on a different scale. Shareholder wealth follows the larger dollar NPV, not the larger percentage. Reasonableness check: L wins on IRR only. Both is the independent-project error. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：CF / NPV 已知：Two separate CF worksheets; I=10 each 求：NPV_L and NPV_M 按鍵： ①CF →2nd →CLR WORK →80 +/- ENTER →↓108 ENTER →NPV 10 ENTER ↓ CPT →18.18 ②CF →2nd →CLR WORK →160 +/- ENTER →↓200 ENTER →NPV 10 ENTER ↓CPT →21.82 結果：NPV_L = 18.18; NPV_M = 21.82 中文理解：兩個專案分開清CF 表。互斥比的是兩個CPT 出來的美元，不是IRR 百分比。

why_wrong.A: Mutually exclusive means one project, not both.
why_wrong.C: IRR prefers the smaller project; that is the size conflict the chapter describes.

CI-061.zh: 小項目IRR 可以很高、NPV 較小。互斥要比誰比較能增加公司價值，聽NPV： M 的21.82 大於L 的18.18。
CI-061.core_idea: Mutually exclusive ranking: NPV is the estimated addition to firm value when IRR disagrees
CI-061.exam_trap: Ranking mutually exclusive projects by IRR when size differs
CI-061.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：CF / NPV
已知：Two separate CF worksheets; I=10 each
求：NPV_L and NPV_M
按鍵：
①CF →2nd →CLR WORK →80 +/- ENTER →↓108 ENTER →NPV 10 ENTER ↓
CPT →18.18 ②CF →2nd →CLR WORK →160 +/- ENTER →↓200 ENTER →NPV
10 ENTER ↓CPT →21.82
結果：NPV_L = 18.18; NPV_M = 21.82
中文理解：兩個專案分開清CF 表。互斥比的是兩個CPT 出來的美元，不是IRR 百分比。
CI-061.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-062.reasoning: Reasoning: Different cash-flow timing can make NPV and IRR disagree. At a 5% cost of capital, Q’s distant cash still has a high present value (NPV 33.1 vs 29.3). IRR still prefers P. The theoretically preferred ranking is NPV. (The incremental Q-P IRR, the crossover, is about 8.7%; below it, Q has the higher NPV.) Given: P: -100,70,50,20; Q: -100,20,40,90; r=5%; mutually exclusive. Asked: Which project, using NPV. Formula: r = 0.05 : NPVP ≈29.3, NPVQ ≈33.1 Variables: Crossover ≈incremental IRR of Q-P ≈8.7%. Why this formula: At a discount rate below the crossover, the back-loaded project has the higher NPV. Size was the same; timing produced the conflict. NPV remains the value rule. Reasonableness check: P is the IRR ranking. “P at every r” denies crossover. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：CF / NPV 已知：Two CF sheets at I=5 求：NPV_P and NPV_Q 按鍵： ①CF →2nd →CLR WORK →100 +/- ENTER →70 ENTER →50 ENTER →20 ENTER →NPV 5 CPT →≈29.29 ②CF →2nd →CLR WORK →100 +/- ENTER →20 ENTER →40 ENTER →90 ENTER →NPV 5 CPT →≈33.07 結果：NPV_Q > NPV_P at 5% 中文理解：每個專案先CLR WORK。互斥比兩個NPV。若要交叉折現率，把Q-P 的增量現 金流打進CF 再CPT IRR。
CI-062.steps: ①NPV_P(5%) ≈29.29; NPV_Q(5%) ≈33.07. ②IRR prefers P, but the firm can take only one: choose Q. ③Optional check: incremental CF Q-P = 0, -50, -10, +70 has IRR ≈8.74%.

why_wrong.A: NPV profiles can cross: the back-loaded project can win at a low r even if its IRR is lower.
why_wrong.C: IRR is not the mutually exclusive value rule.

CI-062.zh: Q 的現金較晚到，低折現率時現值可以反超。5% 時聽NPV 選Q，不要因為P 的 IRR 較高就選P。
CI-062.core_idea: Cash-flow timing can reverse NPV vs IRR ranking; NPV at the cost of capital decides
CI-062.exam_trap: Assuming the higher-IRR project has higher NPV at every r
