計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：CF / NPV
已知：Two CF sheets at I=5
求：NPV_P and NPV_Q
按鍵：
①CF →2nd →CLR WORK →100 +/- ENTER →70 ENTER →50 ENTER →20 ENTER
→NPV 5 CPT →≈29.29 ②CF →2nd →CLR WORK →100 +/- ENTER →20 ENTER
→40 ENTER →90 ENTER →NPV 5 CPT →≈33.07
結果：NPV_Q > NPV_P at 5%
中文理解：每個專案先CLR WORK。互斥比兩個NPV。若要交叉折現率，把Q-P 的增量現
金流打進CF 再CPT IRR。
CI-062.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-063.reasoning: Reasoning: Payback is years to recover the undiscounted outlay. Discounted payback recovers it in present-value terms. Both need an imposed cutoff and both ignore cash flows after the cutoff; ordinary payback also ignores TVM. Neither replaces NPV as a value rule.

why_wrong.A: NPV, not payback, is the theoretically preferred value ranking.
why_wrong.B: Matching the cutoff to life does not turn payback into IRR.

CI-063.zh: 回收期要自訂截止，截止後的現金一律不看。普通回收期還不認時間價值。互斥 排序仍聽NPV。
CI-063.core_idea: Payback ignores TVM and cash flows after the cutoff; discounted payback still ignores post-cutoff CF
CI-063.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-064.reasoning: Reasoning: The theoretical link is price + NPV per share. Practice is messier because the price already reflects expected project-finding ability. Do not turn the theory into a guaranteed announcement jump, and do not claim WACC always equals IRR on accepted work.

why_wrong.A: The chapter distinguishes the theoretical mechanical effect from embedded expectations.
why_wrong.B: Accepted projects can have IRR > WACC; that is the NPV>0 case, not equality.

CI-064.zh: 理論上NPV>0 會讓股價增加每股NPV；實務上價格已反映市場對公司找得到好 案子的預期。不要保證公告當天一定剛好跳那麼多。
CI-064.core_idea: In theory a positive-NPV project raises price by NPV per share; in practice prices already embed expectations
CI-064.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-065.reasoning: Reasoning: Uneven project cash flows: CF worksheet, not TVM. TVM is for a single opening outlay plus equal PMT. ICONV is the wrong worksheet.

why_wrong.A: ICONV converts stated/effective rates; it does not discount a project timeline.
why_wrong.C: Averaging unequal inflows into a PMT mis-times the cash.

CI-065.zh: 不規則流入用CF 表。把三期平均再塞進TVM 的PMT，時點全錯。ICONV 不 是專案折現。
CI-065.core_idea: TVM is for a single opening outlay plus equal PMT; uneven CF uses the CF worksheet
CI-065.exam_trap: Using TVM PMT for uneven project cash flows
CI-065.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-066.reasoning: Reasoning: The required return is also called a hurdle rate: the minimum return the investment must earn. It is not automatically the IRR, and it is not the coupon on the loan that happens to fund the project.

why_wrong.A: The project rate is WACC or a rate built from it, not the incidental loan coupon as a CF substitute.
why_wrong.B: The hurdle is an input; IRR is an output. They coincide only at NPV = 0.

CI-066.zh: Hurdle rate 就是最低要求報酬，是輸入。IRR 是輸出。不要把剛好拿來融資的票 面利率當成hurdle。
CI-066.core_idea: Hurdle rate is the minimum return the investment must earn — the same object as the required return
CI-066.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-067.reasoning: Reasoning: Accept if PI>1, which is the same accept rule as NPV>0 for a single conventional project. PI is still a ratio, not a dollar addition to value. With unlimited capital, take every positive-NPV project — here both.

why_wrong.A: A PI near 1 is the indifference boundary, not a safety ranking that discards a large NPV.
why_wrong.C: For a single conventional project PI and NPV agree on accept/reject; they need not agree on which project adds more dollars. Unlimited capital: take every positive-NPV project.

CI-067.zh: 獨立且資金不限：PI>1 的都做。PI 是比率，不能拿1.40 去打敗NPV 40 的大案 子。
CI-067.core_idea: PI is a ratio, not a dollar addition to value — same accept/reject as NPV, different ranking information
CI-067.exam_trap: Treating the higher PI as the dollar value ranking
CI-067.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-068.reasoning: Reasoning: The survey is reported as an empirical observation, not as a principle. The decision rules remain: NPV for value, IRR/PI in the conventional independent equivalence, payback’s cut-off blind spots unchanged.

why_wrong.A: Who uses payback does not repair payback’s blind spots.
why_wrong.B: NPV remains the theoretically preferred value ranking.

CI-068.zh: 誰比較常用回收期，是資料裡的觀察，不是決策原則。互斥仍聽NPV；回收期的 盲點不會因為使用者改變而消失。
CI-068.core_idea: A survey observation about payback use is empirical, not a timeless capital-budgeting principle
CI-068.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-069.reasoning: Reasoning: Ordinary payback: 40 in year 1, 20 more needed of the year-2 25 →1 + 20/25 = 1.8 years, inside a 2-year cutoff (accept on payback). NPV = 40/1.10 + 25/1.21 + 2/1.331 - 60 = 36.36 + 20.66 + 1.50 - 60 = -1.47 < 0 (reject on value). That is payback’s blind spot: it ignores TVM and the thin year-3 tail does not save the present value. Given: CF: -60, 40, 25, 2; payback cutoff 2 years; r=10%. Asked: Whether payback and NPV agree. Formula: NPV = −60 + 40/1.10 + 25/1.21 + 2/1.331 Variables: Payback uses undiscounted cumulative cash. Why this formula: NPV discounts every incremental CF; payback stops at the cutoff. The cutoff screen and the value screen disagree — payback’s listed blind spot. Reasonableness check: Do not claim that meeting payback implies NPV>0. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Recovering the undiscounted outlay does not guarantee a positive NPV when later cash is tiny and TVM matters.
why_wrong.B: Discounted payback is longer than ordinary payback, not shorter, because later cash is discounted.

CI-069.zh: 兩年內回收並不保證NPV>0。後面幾乎沒有現金、又要折現時，回收期會放行、 NPV 會拒絕。
CI-069.core_idea: Ordinary payback can accept a project NPV would reject if later cash is ignored
CI-069.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-070.reasoning: Reasoning: Discounted payback recovers the outlay in present-value terms, using the project’s cost of capital. It still requires an imposed cutoff and still ignores cash flows after that cutoff. It is not a restatement of NPV or of the IRR rule.

why_wrong.A: Discounted payback still has a cutoff and still ignores later cash; it is not NPV.
why_wrong.C: The discount rate is the cost of capital, not a swap-in of IRR.

CI-070.zh: 折現回收期有用資金成本，但仍有截止日，截止後現金不看。它不是NPV，也不 等於IRR 規則。
CI-070.core_idea: Discounted payback uses the cost of capital but still ignores post-cutoff cash
CI-070.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-071.reasoning: Reasoning: ROIC compared with the required return is a firm-level accounting signal. It does not override the mutually exclusive constraint: if only one project can be taken, NPV still ranks the value effect. Take H.

why_wrong.B: The exclusive constraint forbids taking both.
why_wrong.C: ROIC is an accounting, backward-looking firm screen; it does not rank two exclusive plants.

CI-071.zh: 互斥時仍用NPV 比誰比較能增加價值。ROIC 是回看的會計指標，不能拿去推翻 「只能上一個」。
CI-071.core_idea: Mutually exclusive constraint is not overridden by ROIC or by both NPVs being positive
CI-071.exam_trap: Using ROIC to override mutually exclusive NPV ranking
CI-071.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-072.reasoning: Reasoning: Under capital rationing, take the most valuable group that the limited capital can fund. That is a value (NPV) grouping problem, not a command to keep the unlimited-capital rule and not a command to sort only by IRR.

why_wrong.B: Rationing binds: the unlimited-capital “take every positive NPV” rule is off.
why_wrong.C: IRR ranking can disagree with the value of the funded group; the chapter’s rationing language is the most valuable group.

CI-072.zh: 資本配給：在額度內選最能增加價值的組合。不是三個都做，也不保證兩個最高 IRR 的加總NPV 最大。
CI-072.core_idea: Capital rationing: pick the most valuable feasible group, not every positive NPV
CI-072.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-074.reasoning: Reasoning: Behavioral (judgment) errors include inertia; choosing on EPS, net income, or ROE instead of incremental cash value; pet-project bias; and ignoring alternatives. Cognitive errors are inconsistent forecasts, treating CFO as cheaper, and mixing real and nominal.

why_wrong.A: EPS is not incremental cash value and not a substitute for NPV.
why_wrong.C: Mixing real/nominal is a listed cognitive error, not this fact pattern.

CI-074.zh: 用明年EPS 選案子，是判斷錯誤，不是算錯通膨。EPS ／ROE 不能替代增量現 金價值。
CI-074.core_idea: Choosing on EPS, net income, or ROE instead of incremental cash value is a behavioral error
CI-074.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-075.reasoning: Reasoning: The process is generate ideas, analyze, budget, monitor and post-audit. Skipping alternatives and protecting a pet project are judgment errors on the chapter’s list. They are not the CFO-as-cheap calculation error.

why_wrong.B: CFO-as-cheap is a cognitive error with a different mechanism.
why_wrong.C: Post-audit is monitoring after the fact, not a license to skip alternatives.

CI-075.zh: 寵案加上不找替代方案，是行為／判斷錯誤。不是把內部現金當成便宜資金那種 計算錯誤。
CI-075.core_idea: Pet-project bias and ignoring alternatives are judgment errors, not NPV formula errors
CI-075.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-076.reasoning: Reasoning: Cognitive (calculation) errors: internally inconsistent forecasts; treating CFO as cheaper than debt; mixing real and nominal inflation. Behavioral errors: inertia; EPS/NI/ROE instead of cash value; pet-project bias; ignoring alternatives.

why_wrong.A: Pet-project bias is a listed behavioral error.
why_wrong.C: Inertia is a listed behavioral error.

CI-076.zh: 預測自相矛盾（含名目／實質混用）是計算類錯誤。惰性、寵案是判斷類。
CI-076.core_idea: Internally inconsistent forecasts are a cognitive (calculation) error
CI-076.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-077.reasoning: Reasoning: ROIC = 45/360 = 12.5% > 11%, a positive comparison to the required return, with the chapter’s limits: not cash-based, backward-looking. It does not override mutually exclusive NPV ranking. (New numbers; not the Mixed Practice 36/300 set.) Given: After-tax operating profit = 45; average invested capital = 360; required return = 11%. Asked: ROIC and the allowed interpretation. Formula: 45/360 = 0.125 Variables: Invested capital = average LT liabilities and equity (LT debt, share capital, RE). Why this formula: An accounting return on the capital employed in the business. Compare with the required return; do not promote ROIC into a cash value rule. Reasonableness check: Do not relabel 12.5% as 11% or as forward cash value. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
CI-077.steps: ①ROIC = 45/360 = 12.5%. ②12.5% > 11% is a positive comparison, with accounting limits.
CI-077.final_answer: 12.5% vs 11%: positive signal, not cash NPV

why_wrong.A: There is no supported operation that restates 45/360 as 11%.
why_wrong.C: ROIC is not cash-based and not a substitute for discounted incremental cash flows.

CI-077.zh: 45/360=12.5%，高於11% 是正面訊號，但ROIC 是回看的會計指標，不能冒充 折現現金流。
CI-077.core_idea: ROIC = after-tax operating profit / average invested capital
CI-077.formula: ROIC = after-tax operating profit/average invested capital
CI-077.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-078.reasoning: Reasoning: After-tax operating profit = 80 × (1 - 0.25) = 60. Average invested capital = [(200+280) + (220+320)] / 2 = (480 + 540) / 2 = 510. ROIC = 60/510 = 11.76%. Average across t-1 and t; tax-adjust operating profit. Given: OP=80; t=25%; LTD+E: 480 at t-1, 540 at t. Asked: ROIC. Formula: 60/510 = 0.1176 Variables: Average IC = average of long-term liabilities and equity. Why this formula: Numerator is after-tax operating profit; denominator averages the two balancesheet dates. An 11.8% accounting return is then compared with the required return. Reasonableness check: 15.7% is pretax. Using only ending capital changes the ratio. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Uses pretax 80 / 510 = 15.7% and skips (1-t).
why_wrong.C: Uses after-tax operating profit but drops debt from invested capital: 60 / (280 + 320) = 60/600 = 10.0%.

CI-078.zh: 稅後營運利益60，平均投入資本是期初480 與期末540 的平均510， ROIC≈11.8%。不要用稅前80。
CI-078.core_idea: After-tax operating profit is (1-t) times operating profit; capital is an average of t-1 and t
CI-078.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-079.reasoning: Reasoning: ROIC = (after-tax operating profit / sales) × (sales / average invested capital) = (48/600) × (600/400) = 0.08 × 1.50 = 0.12. Same as 48/400. The breakdown shows a margin piece and a capital-turnover piece. Given: AT operating profit=48; sales=600; average IC=400. Asked: ROIC via the two-factor breakdown. Formula: (48/600) × (600/400) = 0.12 Variables: Margin × turnover multiplies back to profit / capital. Why this formula: The sales terms cancel; the breakdown is diagnostic, not a second definition. Higher margin or faster capital turnover raises ROIC. Reasonableness check: 8% is only the margin. 20% is 80/400 or a doubled margin. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports turnover 600/400 = 1.5 as a percent, or 48/240.
why_wrong.C: Stops at the margin 48/600 = 8% and forgets turnover.

CI-079.zh: 利潤率8% 乘週轉1.5 等於12%，也等於48/400。只報8% 是漏掉週轉。
CI-079.core_idea: ROIC = after-tax operating profit margin × capital turnover
CI-079.formula: ROIC = AT operating margin × capital turnover
CI-079.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-080.reasoning: Reasoning: If ROIC > required return, the firm looks as if it is creating value across its investments; the reverse comparison is a negative signal. Either way, ROIC is not cash-based and is backwardlooking.

why_wrong.A: WACC is the market opportunity cost, not a number forced to equal last year’s ROIC.
why_wrong.B: ROIC does not identify each project’s NPV sign.

CI-080.zh: ROIC 低於要求報酬，是負面的會計訊號，仍不是各專案的現金NPV。不要反過 來去改WACC。
CI-080.core_idea: ROIC below the required return is a negative accounting signal, still not a cash NPV
CI-080.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-081.reasoning: Reasoning: Average invested capital is average long-term liabilities and equity across t-1 and t (long-term debt, share capital, retained earnings). That is a different object from WACC’s marketvalue weights and from liquidity ratios.

why_wrong.A: The definition given is an accounting average of LT claims, not a market-equityonly figure.
why_wrong.B: ROIC here is not CCC / liquidity.

CI-081.zh: ROIC 的分母是長期負債與權益的平均（長期債、股本、保留盈餘）。不是流動性 比率，也不等於WACC 的市值權數。
CI-081.core_idea: Average invested capital is LT debt, share capital, and retained earnings — not current liabilities
CI-081.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-082.reasoning: Reasoning: Real options are choices the project creates: timing; sizing (abandon or grow); flexibility (set price, or set quantity); fundamental options over supply costs. They are not liquidity labels.

why_wrong.A: Those are liquidity classifications.
why_wrong.B: Those mix liquidity with capital-structure theory.

CI-082.zh: 實質選擇權：何時做、做大或放棄、訂價或訂量彈性、以及供應成本上的根本選 擇。不是流動性或融資順位。
CI-082.core_idea: Real options are choices the project creates: timing, sizing, flexibility, fundamental
CI-082.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-083.reasoning: Reasoning: Project NPV = NPV without options - option cost + option value = 12 - 3 + 8 = 17. Analysis layers: (1) NPV with no options, (2) add the option with this identity, (3) a decision tree when the sequence of choices matters. Given: Static NPV=12; option cost=3; option value=8. Asked: Project NPV with the option. Formula: 12 −3 + 8 = 17 Variables: Layer 2 of the chapter’s three-layer analysis. Why this formula: The option is an extra claim: pay its cost, add its value, on top of the static NPV. The mine is more valuable once the expansion choice is priced in. Reasonableness check: 23 double-adds cost and value. 9 drops the option value. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Subtracts the value instead of the cost: 12-3-0, or 12-3 = 9 and drops the +8.
why_wrong.C: Adds the option value without subtracting its cost: 12+8 = 20, or 12+3+8 = 23.

CI-083.zh: 先算沒有選擇權的NPV，再減掉選擇權成本、加上選擇權價值：12-3+8=17。不 要只加8 或只減3。
CI-083.core_idea: Project NPV = NPV without options - option cost + option value
CI-083.formula: project NPV = NPV without options −option cost + option value
CI-083.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-084.reasoning: Reasoning: Three layers: (1) NPV with no options, (2) add the option with NPV without - cost + value, (3) a decision tree when the sequence of choices matters. Sequencing plus abandon/grow is exactly that third layer.

why_wrong.B: WACC weights are market (target) weights; options are not a reason to switch to book.
why_wrong.C: The chapter does not send option problems to payback.

CI-084.zh: 選擇有先後（先做一期、成功才擴、失敗就放棄）時，用決策樹。不是改用回收 期或帳面WACC。
CI-084.core_idea: A decision tree is the third layer when the sequence of choices matters
CI-084.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-085.reasoning: Reasoning: Sizing: abandon or grow. Flexibility: set price, or set quantity. Timing is a separate type. The factory pair is sizing; the hotel’s price-setting is flexibility (the chapter’s hotel-style dynamic pricing sits in business models too, but here it is the flexibility option).

why_wrong.A: Fundamental options are over supply costs, not a dump-all label.
why_wrong.B: Timing is when to start; abandon/grow is sizing; dynamic pricing is flexibility.

CI-085.zh: 工廠能關能擴是sizing。旅館能改房價是flexibility。不要全部叫供應成本選擇權。
CI-085.core_idea: Sizing options are abandon or grow; flexibility is set price or set quantity
CI-085.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-086.reasoning: Reasoning: Project NPV = -2 - 1 + 6 = 3. Layer 1 can be negative while layer 2 is positive if option value exceeds static shortfall plus option cost. That is why the chapter adds options instead of stopping at static NPV. Given: Static NPV=-2; cost=1; value=6. Asked: Project NPV with the option. Formula: −2 −1 + 6 = 3 Variables: Same identity as the expansion-option case. Why this formula: Options are incremental claims stacked on the static NPV. Do not reject solely on static NPV when a real option is material. Reasonableness check: Rejecting on -2 ignores layer 2. Dropping the cost overstates by 1. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: The identity adds the option; a sufficiently valuable option can change the sign.
why_wrong.C: Option cost is subtracted in the identity; it is not dropped as sunk at the analysis date.

CI-086.zh: 靜態NPV 是-2，加上放棄選擇權後-2-1+6=3。有價值的選擇權可以翻案。選擇 權成本在分析時不是sunk。
CI-086.core_idea: A static NPV that ignores a valuable option understates project NPV if option cost is smaller than option value
CI-086.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-087.reasoning: Reasoning: Fundamental options over supply costs are the listed type that covers choices about input-cost exposure. Liquidity drags and MM identities are different chapters of the same file, not this mechanism.

why_wrong.A: MM Prop II is the leverage–cost-of-equity identity, not an operating option.
why_wrong.B: Fuel switching is not an inflow-delay liquidity drag.

CI-087.zh: 可以改用哪一種燃料，是針對供應成本的fundamental option。不是流動性drag， 也不是MM 命題。
CI-087.core_idea: Fundamental options over supply costs are a listed real-option type
CI-087.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-088.reasoning: Reasoning: WACC is the firm’s cost of financing, the opportunity cost of funds, and the required return of capital providers — the same object, three names. It is not the last loan’s coupon and not last year’s ROIC.

why_wrong.A: Investment and financing are separate; do not replace WACC with the incidental loan coupon.
why_wrong.C: ROIC is an accounting screen, not a definition of WACC.

CI-088.zh: WACC 有三個名字：融資成本、資金機會成本、資本提供者要求報酬。不是最近 一筆貸款利率，也不是ROIC。
CI-088.core_idea: WACC is the firm’s cost of financing, the opportunity cost of funds, and the required return of capital providers
CI-088.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-089.reasoning: Reasoning: Market weights wd=50/200=0.25, we=0.75. After-tax debt = 6%×(1-0.20)=4.80%. WACC = 0.25×4.80% + 0.75×12% = 1.20% + 9.00% = 10.20%. Book values are not the weights. Pretax rd omits the tax shield. (Different levels from the chapter’s 40/60, 8%, 14%, 25% illustration.) Given: Market D=50, E=150; book D=120, E=80; rd=6%; re=12%; t=20%; interest fully deductible. Asked: Project-discounting WACC. Formula: 0.25 × 6% × (1 −0.20) + 0.75 × 12% Variables: wd, we are target/current market-value proportions. Why this formula: WACC is the market opportunity cost of replacing the firm’s capital today. Use 10.20% as the hurdle, not the book 7.68% or the pretax 10.50%. Reasonableness check: 7.68% is the book-weight trap. 10.50% forgot (1-t). 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Market weights but pretax debt: 0.25×6% + 0.75×12% = 10.50%.
why_wrong.C: Book weights 120/200 and 80/200 with the tax adjustment: 0.60×6%×0.80 + 0.40×12% = 7.68%.

CI-089.zh: 權數用市值25/75，債務要乘(1-0.20)。帳面60/40 會得到7.68%；市值但不稅後 會得到10.50%。
CI-089.core_idea: WACC uses market-value weights and rd(1-t); book weights and pretax rd are the paired traps
CI-089.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-090.reasoning: Reasoning: 8.28% matches book weights (140/200=0.70) and rd(1-t). The market after-tax hurdle is 11.16%. Pretax market is 12.60%. The intern’s error is book weights, not “forgot tax” and not a correct market calculation. Given: Market 80/120; book 140/60; rd=9%; re=15%; t=40%. Intern’s WACC=8.28%. Asked: Which weighting/tax error produces 8.28%. Formula: 0.70 × 9% × 0.60 + 0.30 × 15% = 8.28% Variables: Book wd=0.70 vs market wd=0.40. Why this formula: Matching the intern’s number identifies the book-weight path. Diagnose the error by recomputing all three common wrong paths. Reasonableness check: Correct is 11.16%. Forgot-tax is 12.60%. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Forgetting tax on market weights gives 0.40×9% + 0.60×15% = 12.60%, not 8.28%.
why_wrong.C: Correct market after-tax WACC is 0.40×9%×0.60 + 0.60×15% = 11.16%.

CI-090.zh: 8.28% 對得上帳面權數加稅後債務。正確市值稅後是11.16%。忘掉稅盾會得到 12.60%，不是8.28%。
CI-090.core_idea: Reverse: a 8.28% quote is the book-weight WACC, not the market after-tax WACC
CI-090.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-091.reasoning: Reasoning: Market wd = (D/E)/(1+D/E) = 0.50/1.50 = 1/3, we = 2/3. WACC = (1/3)×7%×(1- 0.30) + (2/3)×13% = (1/3)×4.90% + 8.666...% = 10.30%. Book D/E is not the WACC weight. Pretax rd overstates the hurdle. Given: Market D/E=0.50; book D/E=2; rd=7%; re=13%; t=30%. Asked: WACC. Formula: (0.50/1.50) × 7% × (1 −0.30) + (1/1.50) × 13% Variables: Convert the ratio to a weight before multiplying costs. Why this formula: wd is the share of firm value that is debt, not the D/E ratio itself. A stated book D/E of 2 does not license book weights in WACC. Reasonableness check: 8.60% is book D/E. 10.67% is market weights with pretax rd. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Uses market weights but pretax rd: (1/3)×7% + (2/3)×13% = 11.00%.

CI-091.zh: 市值D/E=0.5 →權數1/3 與2/3，再乘rd(1-t)。用帳面D/E=2 會得到8.60%； 忘了稅會靠近10.67%。
CI-091.core_idea: If leverage is quoted as D/E, convert to wd = (D/E)/(1+D/E) using market D/E
CI-091.formula:
wd =
D/E
1 + D/E ,
rWACC = wdrd(1 −t) + were
CI-091.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-092.reasoning: Reasoning: WACC = 0.40×8%×(1-0.25)+0.60×14% = 10.80%. Using pretax rd gives 11.60%. Multiplying re by (1-t) is the other mechanical error: only deductible interest gets the tax adjustment, and only when interest is deducted in full. Book weights are a separate trap. Given: wd=0.40; we=0.60; rd=8%; re=14%; t=25%; interest fully deductible. Asked: Correct WACC and the named traps. Formula: 0.40 × 8% × 0.75 + 0.60 × 14% = 10.80% Variables: Tax adjustment on debt only. Why this formula: Interest is deductible; equity returns are not. Remember the pair: market weights, and tax on debt only. Reasonableness check: 11.60% forgot (1-t). Tax-shielding re understates WACC. Book weights are the other trap. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 8.40% is the chapter’s book-weight illustration, not a license to use book whenever book debt is larger.
why_wrong.C: Equity is not tax-deductible; 11.60% is pretax rd with market weights.

CI-092.zh: 只有利息抵稅才乘(1-t)。股權成本不要乘。正確10.80%；11.60% 是忘了稅；再 把re 也稅後就是第二個機械錯誤。
CI-092.core_idea: Only deductible interest gets (1-t); never multiply re by (1-t)
CI-092.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-093.reasoning: Reasoning: The marginal after-tax cost of debt is rd(1-t) when interest is deducted in full. A higher tax rate lowers that after-tax cost: more income is shielded. Do not flip the direction, and do not confuse it with the separate market-weight rule.

why_wrong.B: The chapter’s direction is: a higher tax rate lowers that after-tax cost.
why_wrong.C: Market weights answer a different input question; they do not freeze rd(1-t).

CI-093.zh: 稅率上升，稅後債務成本rd(1-t) 下降，不是上升。權數用市值，與這個方向是兩 件事。
CI-093.core_idea: A higher tax rate lowers the after-tax cost of debt when interest is deducted in full
CI-093.exam_trap: Saying a higher tax rate raises after-tax rd
CI-093.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-094.reasoning: Reasoning: WACC = wd rd(1-t) + wps rps + we re = 0.30×5%×0.75 + 0.20×8% + 0.50×14% = 1.125% + 1.60% + 7.00% = 9.725%. Preferred stock, if used, is weighted at rps without a (1-t) factor. Given: Market 30/20/50; rd=5%; rps=8%; re=14%; t=25%. Asked: WACC. Formula: 0.30 × 5% × 0.75 + 0.20 × 8% + 0.50 × 14% Variables: wps on preferred; no tax adjustment on rps. Why this formula: Only deductible interest gets (1-t). Debt is tax-adjusted; preferred and common are not. Reasonableness check: 9.33% tax-shields preferred. 10.10% leaves debt pretax. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
CI-094.zh: 特別股沒有利息抵稅，不要乘(1-t)。正確約9.73%。對特別股也稅後會得到 9.33%；債務也不稅後會得到10.10%。
CI-094.core_idea: Preferred stock is weighted at rps with no (1-t) factor
CI-094.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-095.reasoning: Reasoning: WACC is an opportunity cost in the market: what it would cost to replace the firm’s capital today. That yield is 6%, then after-tax 6%(1-t). The historical coupon is not the replacement cost.

why_wrong.B: There is no supported blending of coupon and yield as a product.
why_wrong.C: The chapter: debt’s cost is the current market yield on the firm’s outstanding debt, not the coupon.

CI-095.zh: 債務成本是現在的市場殖利率6%，不是票面9%。WACC 問的是今天替換資本要 多少。
CI-095.core_idea: Debt’s cost is the current market yield, not the coupon
CI-095.exam_trap: Using the coupon instead of the market yield for rd
CI-095.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-096.reasoning: Reasoning: Weights are target market-value proportions. If the target is unknown, current marketvalue weights are the usual stand-in; an industry average is an alternative. Book values are not the weights. Project-specific financing does not reset the weights.

why_wrong.A: Investment choice and financing mix are separate: do not use the last dollar’s source as the weight.
why_wrong.C: Stability is why managers may state a target in book metrics — that reporting choice does not license book weights in WACC.

CI-096.zh: 目標市值權數；不知道目標就用當前市值，或產業平均。帳面不是WACC 權數。 今年這個案子向誰借錢，也不改權數。
CI-096.core_idea: Weights are target market-value proportions; if the target is unknown, current market weights (or industry average)
CI-096.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-097.reasoning: Reasoning: Investment choice and financing mix are separate problems. Projects are discounted at a WACC that uses target weights, regardless of how this particular project is financed and regardless of which source was raised last. A project-specific 100% loan does not reset wd to 1.

why_wrong.A: The chapter: projects are discounted at a WACC that uses target weights, regardless of how this particular project is financed.
why_wrong.C: Repayment source does not make the project all-equity for discounting.

CI-097.zh: 就算這個案子全數貸款，折現仍用目標（市值）結構。不要把wd 改成100%。
CI-097.core_idea: A project is discounted at target WACC regardless of how this particular project is financed
CI-097.exam_trap: Using the project’s own financing mix as WACC weights
CI-097.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-098.reasoning: Reasoning: Target capital structure is management’s desired mix. It is often stated in book values or leverage metrics because market values fluctuate and outsiders watch those measures. That does not license book weights in WACC. WACC remains a market opportunity-cost question.

why_wrong.A: The chapter says that reporting choice does not license book weights in WACC.
why_wrong.C: A rating may inform a stated target; it does not replace market-weighted WACC.

CI-098.zh: 目標可以用帳面或評等來說，但WACC 權數仍是市值。不要看到「目標用帳面表 述」就改用帳面加權。
CI-098.core_idea: Target may be stated in book D/E or rating metrics; WACC still uses market weights
CI-098.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-107.reasoning: Reasoning: The marginal after-tax cost of debt is rd(1-t) when interest is deducted in full. That is the stated condition. Preferred stock does not get the factor. Book-versus-market size is a weighting issue, not the tax-condition.

why_wrong.A: The tax factor is about deductibility of interest, not about book vs market being larger.
why_wrong.C: Preferred is weighted at rps without (1-t); preferred dividends are not the interest deduction.

CI-107.zh: 利息能全額抵稅，才用rd(1-t)。特別股股利不抵稅。帳面槓桿高於市值，不是動 用稅盾的條件。
CI-107.core_idea: Interest deducted in full is the condition for using rd(1-t)
CI-107.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-108.reasoning: Reasoning: Without taxes, capital structure is irrelevant: VL = VU. Firm value is expected future cash flows discounted at WACC, and WACC does not change with leverage. “Debt is cheaper” is not a value argument here: required returns reprice the extra risk.

why_wrong.B: tD is the corporate-tax, no-distress result — taxes were shut off.
why_wrong.C: Interior D* is the trade-off once distress has a present value — distress was shut off.

CI-108.zh: 無稅MM：VL=VU，WACC 不隨槓桿變。不要把有稅的tD 或有困境的D* 套進 來。題幹已關掉稅與困境。
CI-108.core_idea: MM without taxes: VL = VU; WACC does not change with leverage
CI-108.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-109.reasoning: Reasoning: re = r0 + (r0-rd)D/E = 11% + (11%-5%)×0.80 = 11% + 4.8% = 15.8%. Weights: wd = 0.80/1.80 = 4/9, we = 1/1.80 = 5/9. WACC = (4/9)×5% + (5/9)×15.8% = 2.222% + 8.778% = 11.0% = r0. The rise in re exactly offsets the larger weight on cheaper debt. Given: MM, no taxes; r0=11%; rd=5%; D/E=0.80. Asked: re and WACC. Formula: re = 11% + (11% −5%) × 0.80 = 15.8% Variables: r0 = all-equity cost of capital. Why this formula: Leverage raises equity risk; the extra re offsets the larger debt weight, so WACC stays at r0. “Debt is cheaper ⇒borrow more to cut WACC” is false in no-tax MM. Reasonableness check: 8.8% would be a WACC that forgot the re increase. re cannot stay at 11%. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Leaves re at r0 and treats WACC as rd.
why_wrong.C: Computes re correctly but then lets WACC fall — the no-tax offset is missing.

CI-109.zh: 無稅時re 升到15.8%，剛好把WACC 頂回11%。算出re 卻讓WACC 下降，就 是漏掉「風險加價對沖便宜債務」。
CI-109.core_idea: MM without taxes, Proposition II: re = r0 + (r0-rd)D/E; the rise in re offsets cheaper debt
CI-109.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-110.reasoning: Reasoning: MM with corporate tax and no financial distress: VL = VU + tD = 400 + 0.30×150 = 445. VL = VU needs the no-tax world. Adding all of D treats the shield as if t = 1. (New levels; not the Mixed Practice 500/200/40% set.) Given: VU=400; D=150; t=30%; no personal tax; no distress. Asked: VL. Formula: 400 + 0.30 × 150 = 445 Variables: tD is the debt tax shield. Why this formula: Interest shields income from tax, so a profitable firm can raise value by using debt. WACC falls as debt rises in this setting; 100% debt would be optimal while distress stays off. Reasonableness check: 400 is the no-tax conclusion. 550 adds D instead of tD. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Adds the entire principal: 400+150 = 550, as if the shield were 100% of D.
why_wrong.C: Applies no-tax irrelevance VL = VU after the stem opened corporate tax and shut distress.

CI-110.zh: 有公司稅、無困境：VL=400+0.30×150=445。看到MM 就答400，是把無稅結 論套到有稅。加整筆150 是把稅盾當成100%。
CI-110.core_idea: MM with corporate tax and no distress: VL = VU + tD, not VL = VU
CI-110.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-111.reasoning: Reasoning: Applying an MM conclusion after dropping its assumptions is the chapter trap. VL = VU + tD and “100% debt is optimal” need corporate tax and no distress. The trade-off formula is the one that survives once distress has a present value: subtract PV(distress); interior D* maximizes value.

why_wrong.A: VL = VU needs the no-tax world. Tax is on.
why_wrong.B: 100% debt needs corporate tax and no distress. Distress is on in the stem.

CI-111.zh: 困境已打開，就不能再說百分百負債。那是有稅且關掉困境的MM。現在用 VL=VU+tD-PV(困境)，最優在內部D*。
CI-111.core_idea: Once distress has a present value, 100% debt is not optimal — that conclusion needs no-distress
CI-111.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-112.reasoning: Reasoning: VL = VU + tD needs corporate tax (and no distress). The stem is the no-tax world, so VL = VU. The tempting shortcut “debt is cheaper after tax” is being used after the tax door was closed. 100% debt is the other mismatched conclusion.

why_wrong.A: 100% debt is the with-tax, no-distress optimum, not the no-tax result.
why_wrong.C: Distress is off in no-tax MM; the trade-off subtraction is not the no-tax identity.

CI-112.zh: 無稅世界卻加上tD，就是把有稅公式套進無稅假設。無稅是VL=VU。百分百負 債也不是無稅結論。
CI-112.core_idea: Without taxes, do not add tD; the tax-shield line requires corporate tax
CI-112.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-113.reasoning: Reasoning: The tempting shortcut: debt is cheaper after tax, therefore more debt is always better. That shortcut is MM-with-tax with the distress door left open. It is also the no-tax error if the candidate forgets that re rises. Here distress is acknowledged, so the surviving formula is VL = VU + tD - PV(distress).

why_wrong.A: No-tax MM says structure is irrelevant, not that 100% debt is optimal.
why_wrong.B: After-tax debt can be cheaper; the issue is using that as an unbounded value argument once distress exists.

CI-113.zh: 「稅後債務比較便宜，所以永遠該加槓桿」是把有稅無困境的結論，用在困境還開 著的世界。權衡理論會減PV(困境)。
CI-113.core_idea: “Debt is cheaper after tax, therefore more debt is always better” leaves the distress door open
CI-113.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-114.reasoning: Reasoning: Leverage still raises re, but more slowly than in the no-tax case. WACC falls as debt rises, and firm value rises. With tax and no distress, debt is value-enhancing and 100% debt is optimal. A higher tax rate raises that benefit.

why_wrong.B: Leverage still raises re; the tax shield does not reverse that into a falling re or a zero-debt optimum.
why_wrong.C: No-tax invariance of WACC does not survive once corporate tax is on.

CI-114.zh: 有稅無困境：re 仍升但比較慢，WACC 下降，價值上升，最優是百分之百負債。 不要把無稅的「WACC 不變」搬過來。
CI-114.core_idea: With tax and no distress, leverage still raises re, but more slowly; WACC falls; 100% debt is optimal
CI-114.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-115.reasoning: Reasoning: VL = VU + tD. At 20%, shield = 40; at 35%, shield = 70. The increase in VL is 30. A higher tax rate raises the benefit. Zero change is the no-tax conclusion applied after tax was turned on. Given: VU=600; D=200; t rises 20% →35%; no distress; no personal tax. Asked: Change in VL. Formula: ∆VL = ( 0.35 −0.20 ) × 200 = 30 Variables: The shield is tD; only t changed. Why this formula: The extra value from leverage is the tax rate times debt. Higher t makes each unit of debt more valuable while distress stays off. Reasonableness check: 70 is the new shield, not the change. 0 is the no-tax mismatch. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports tD at 35% (70) as the change, rather than the change in the shield.
why_wrong.B: Applies no-tax irrelevance so VL cannot change.

CI-115.zh: 稅盾從0.20×200=40 升到0.35×200=70，價值多30。不要把70 當成「增加額」， 也不要說無稅所以不變。
CI-115.core_idea: A higher corporate tax rate raises the tax-shield benefit tD
CI-115.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-116.reasoning: Reasoning: Static trade-off: past D*, more leverage reduces firm value because PV(distress) exceeds the tax benefit. Higher business risk magnifies the value reduction from distress and bankruptcy. The graph is a hump, not the flat VU line and not the straight VU+tD line.

why_wrong.B: The linear tD line is MM with tax and no distress — the straight upward line on the chapter graph, not the hump past D*.
why_wrong.C: Trade-off does not collapse back to VL = VU for all D.

CI-116.zh: 過了D* 再加槓桿，困境現值大於稅盾，價值下降。那不是直線tD，也不是回到 無稅的水平線。
CI-116.core_idea: Trade-off: past D*, more leverage reduces firm value because PV(distress) exceeds the tax benefit
CI-116.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-117.reasoning: Reasoning: Higher business risk magnifies the value reduction from distress and bankruptcy. That is a trade-off comparative, not a reason to drop tD entirely and not a reason to send the riskier firm to the 100% debt MM-with-tax corner.

why_wrong.B: Higher business risk worsens distress; it does not justify the no-distress 100% debt corner for the riskier firm.
why_wrong.C: The tax shield formula still has a tD term; business risk works through distress.

CI-117.zh: 營業風險較高，困境與破產對價值的傷害較大。不是稅盾消失，更不是高風險公 司該百分百負債。
CI-117.core_idea: Higher business risk magnifies the value reduction from distress and bankruptcy
CI-117.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-118.reasoning: Reasoning: The flat line is MM without tax. The straight upward line is MM with corporate tax and no distress (VU+tD). The hump is the trade-off: tax shield first, distress later, peak at D*.

why_wrong.B: Those are other chapter objects, not the three value-versus-debt schedules.
why_wrong.C: The hump is trade-off, not the flat no-tax line.

CI-118.zh: 水平線＝無稅MM。向上直線＝有公司稅、無困境。拱形＝權衡，頂點是D*。
CI-118.core_idea: The chapter graph: flat = no tax; straight up = tax no distress; hump = trade-off
CI-118.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-119.reasoning: Reasoning: Pecking-order financing ranks sources by information sensitivity, not merely by “visibility”: (1) internally generated funds / retained earnings; (2) debt; (3) new external equity. Asymmetric information makes outside investors treat a new share issue as a signal that managers think the stock is rich.

why_wrong.A: External equity is last, not first: it is the most information-sensitive source.
why_wrong.C: Pecking order is about asymmetric information, not the MM tax-shield optimum.

CI-119.zh: 融資順位：內部盈餘→負債→外部新股。不是「比較看得見就先用」。新股最敏 感，常被解讀成股價被高估。
CI-119.core_idea: Pecking-order ranks sources by information sensitivity: internal →debt →new external equity
CI-119.exam_trap: Reversing pecking order or treating it as MM-with-tax
CI-119.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-120.reasoning: Reasoning: Asymmetric information: outside investors treat a new share issue as a signal that managers think the stock is rich. That is why external equity is the most information-sensitive source and the last resort. Do not confuse this with MM irrelevance or with primary liquidity.

why_wrong.B: Pecking order is not a test of MM no-tax.
why_wrong.C: An equity issue is a secondary liquidity source, not the ordinary operating engine, and that classification is a different topic.

CI-120.zh: 資訊不對稱：發新股常被看成「經理人覺得股價貴」。所以外部新股排最後。這不 是在否定無稅MM，也不是primary liquidity。
CI-120.core_idea: A new share issue is the last resort in pecking order because it is the most information-sensitive
CI-120.exam_trap: Reading a pecking-order equity issue as an MM or liquidity statement
CI-120.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-121.reasoning: Reasoning: The chapter’s Chinese box: do not only memorize more-hidden vs more-visible. Managers know more than outside investors. Internal funds send almost no new signal; debt is a weaker signal; a new issue is the most sensitive. Rank: internal →debt →external equity.

why_wrong.A: 100% debt is MM with tax and no distress, not pecking order.
why_wrong.B: WACC weights are a cost-of-capital input, not the pecking-order rank.

CI-121.zh: 不要只背「比較看不見」。內部資金幾乎不發新訊號，借債較弱，發新股最敏感。 順位是內部→債→外部新股。
CI-121.core_idea: Pecking order is not merely “less visible vs more visible” — it is information sensitivity
CI-121.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-122.reasoning: Reasoning: Modigliani–Miller start from that strict market. Conclusions (VL=VU, or VL=VU+tD, or 100% debt) are then attached to whether tax and distress are opened. Dropping the market assumptions silently is the trap.

why_wrong.A: Those are business-model patterns.
why_wrong.C: Those are WACC/payback tools, not MM assumptions.

CI-122.zh: 先核對MM 的市場假設：同質預期、完美市場、無代理成本等。結論要跟著稅與 困境的開關，不能默默丟掉假設。
CI-122.core_idea: MM baseline assumptions include perfect markets, no agency costs, and independent decisions
CI-122.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-123.reasoning: Reasoning: “Debt is cheaper” is not a value argument in no-tax MM. Proposition II: leverage raises the cost of equity. The rise in re exactly offsets the larger weight on cheaper debt, so WACC and firm value are unchanged. The analyst dropped that offset.

why_wrong.A: WACC is invariant in no-tax MM; it does not fall one-for-one.
why_wrong.C: The premise rd < re can be true; it is not a value argument once re adjusts.

CI-123.zh: 無稅時借錢利率較低，但re 剛好升高把WACC 頂回去。用rd<re 當「該盡量借」 的價值論點，是漏掉風險加價。
CI-123.core_idea: In no-tax MM, “debt is cheaper” is not a value argument because re reprices the extra risk
CI-123.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-124.reasoning: Reasoning: With tax and no distress, debt is value-enhancing and 100% debt is optimal. Trade-off subtracts PV(distress) and uses the interior D* that maximizes firm value. Swapping those optima is applying a conclusion after dropping its assumptions.

why_wrong.B: VL = VU is the no-tax result, not either of these taxed settings.
why_wrong.C: That pairing reverses the two optima.

CI-124.zh: 有稅無困境：角落、百分百負債。權衡：內部D*。兩者對調就是假設沒對上結 論。無稅才是VL=VU。
CI-124.core_idea: Trade-off assigns an interior optimum; MM with tax and no distress assigns the 100% debt corner
CI-124.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-125.reasoning: Reasoning: The observed order is the pecking-order rank. MM conclusions are value/WACC statements under tax/distress switches, not a command to raise sources in that information order. Do not force an MM optimum onto a pecking-order story.

why_wrong.A: The 100% debt corner is not a pecking-order prediction.
why_wrong.C: No-tax MM is about value invariance, not a financing sequence ordered by information.

CI-125.zh: 先內部、再負債、不發新股，是融資順位。不要把它說成無稅MM 的無差異，或 說成有稅無困境的百分百負債。
CI-125.core_idea: Pecking order can describe a firm that issues debt after using internal funds even if it is below D*
CI-125.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-126.reasoning: Reasoning: Complex-product devices include bundling, razor-and-blade (cheap initial good, highmargin consumable), and add-on optional services. Dynamic pricing sets price by time or customer as supply changes (hotels). Do not dump both into penetration or hidden-revenue.

why_wrong.A: Hidden-revenue is an advertising-supported digital pattern, not these two.
why_wrong.C: Penetration is cutting price to enter a market — not the ink-margin device and not hotel yield management.

CI-126.zh: 印表機便宜、墨水很貴是razor-and-blade。旅館隨空房改價是dynamic pricing。 不是一律叫滲透定價或隱藏廣告收入。
CI-126.core_idea: Pricing patterns: tiered, dynamic, value-based, auction; complex devices include razor-and-blade
CI-126.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-127.reasoning: Reasoning: Value-chain analysis looks for the specific activities inside the firm that create customer value. The supply chain is broader — creation and delivery inside and outside the firm. Contract manufacturer, value-added reseller, and licensing are alternative roles in that chain.

why_wrong.A: Committees and CCC are governance and liquidity objects.
why_wrong.B: The chapter separates the two; neither is WACC.

CI-127.zh: 價值鏈是公司內部創造顧客價值的活動系統；供應鏈更寬，涵蓋公司內外的創造 與交付。兩者都不是WACC。
CI-127.core_idea: Value chain is inside the firm; supply chain is the broader creation-and-delivery process
CI-127.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-128.reasoning: Reasoning: Contract manufacturer, value-added reseller, and licensing are alternative roles: make for a brand, add customization or support, or rent the brand. Digital patterns (freemium, hiddenrevenue, subscription, leasing, franchising) are pricing/model devices, not this three-role list.

why_wrong.B: Those are liquidity labels.
why_wrong.C: Those are organizational forms, not chain roles.

CI-128.zh: 代工、加值經銷、授權，是價值鏈／供應鏈上的角色：替品牌做、加上服務、或 把品牌租出去。不是組織型態，也不是流動性。
CI-128.core_idea: Contract manufacturer, VAR, and licensing are alternative roles in the chain
CI-128.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-131.reasoning: Reasoning: Simple-product pricing in the chapter includes tiered pricing: different price by buyer, volume, or feature. Dynamic pricing moves with time or remaining supply (hotels). An auction lets the market bid the price. The stem is a posted menu, not yield management and not a bid.

why_wrong.A: Dynamic pricing is price by time or customer as supply changes, e.g. hotels — not a posted volume/feature menu.
why_wrong.C: An auction lets bids set the price. Here the vendor posts the schedule.

CI-131.zh: 同一商品依客戶、量、功能設不同價，是tiered。不是旅館式的dynamic，也不是 拍賣。
CI-131.core_idea: Tiered pricing charges different prices by buyer, volume, or feature 核心觀念｜中文理解：分層定價是賣方先掛出依買方／數量／功能而不同的價；不是隨剩餘供給改價，也不 是讓市場出價。
CI-131.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-132.reasoning: Reasoning: Value-based pricing sets price from effectiveness received (pharmaceuticals in the chapter). Auction pricing lets the market bid. Razor-and-blade is a cheap device plus a highmargin consumable. Hidden-revenue is advertising-supported. Neither of those last two is in the stem.

why_wrong.B: Tiered is a posted menu by buyer/volume/feature, not effectiveness-based pharma pricing and not a bid.
why_wrong.C: Razor-and-blade needs a cheap initial good plus a high-margin consumable. Hidden-revenue is advertising. The stem has neither.

CI-132.zh: 藥價依療效定，是value-based。讓市場出價是auction。不要塞進razor-and-blade 或廣告隱藏收入。
CI-132.core_idea: Value-based prices from effectiveness received; auction lets the market bid 核心觀念｜中文理解：Value-based 看買方得到的效果；auction 把定價權交給出價。兩者都不是耗材加價或 廣告養免費。
CI-132.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-133.reasoning: Reasoning: Complex-product devices in the chapter include bundling and add-on optional services. The kit is one price for complementary goods. The warranty is optional and separate. Razor-andblade is cheap hardware plus a high-margin consumable, which is not this pair. Penetration is cutting price to enter a market.

why_wrong.A: Razor-and-blade is a cheap initial good with a high-margin consumable (printer/ink), not a kit price or an optional warranty.
why_wrong.C: Penetration cuts price to enter a market. The stem is a packaging / optional-service pair, not an entry-price cut.

CI-133.zh: 鏡頭已經包在相機套裝價裡是bundling。手機可另買延保是add-on。不是耗材加 價，也不是滲透降價。
CI-133.core_idea: Bundling sells complements in one price; add-on is an optional extra service 核心觀念｜中文理解：捆綁是一次賣一組；add-on 是可選的額外服務。不要看到兩件商品就叫razor-andblade。
CI-133.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-134.reasoning: Reasoning: Penetration pricing cuts price to enter a market. Freemium is a listed digital pattern: free basic access, paid premium. Dynamic pricing is hotel-style supply-timed prices. Hidden-revenue is advertising-supported; a paid upgrade is not an ad model.

why_wrong.B: Dynamic pricing moves with time or remaining supply. The beverage cut is entry; the digital split is a tier, not hotel yield.
why_wrong.C: Hidden-revenue is advertising. The digital product charges an upgrade; the beverage is not ad-funded.

CI-134.zh: 為了進場而把價砍低是penetration。基本免費、進階付費是freemium。不是旅館 動態定價，也不是廣告養免費。
CI-134.core_idea: Penetration cuts price to enter; freemium is free basic / paid premium 核心觀念｜中文理解：滲透是進場降價；freemium 是同一產品的免費層與付費層。免費層若靠廣告，那才 是hidden-revenue。
CI-134.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-135.reasoning: Reasoning: Hidden-revenue (advertising) and subscription are listed digital patterns. The news site is ad-funded. The app is a recurring access fee with no ads. Freemium needs a free basic tier plus a paid upgrade of the same product. Auction and leasing are other chapter labels, not this pair.

why_wrong.A: Auction lets bids set price. Leasing is use of an asset for a periodic payment without transferring ownership — not an ad-funded site.
why_wrong.C: Freemium is free basic plus paid premium of the same product. The news site is ad-funded; the app has no free tier in the stem.

CI-135.zh: 讀者免費、廣告付錢是hidden-revenue。按期付使用費、沒廣告是subscription。 不是拍賣，也不是同一產品的免費／升級層。
CI-135.core_idea: Hidden-revenue is advertising-supported; subscription is a recurring access fee 核心觀念｜中文理解：Hidden-revenue 的付費人是廣告主；subscription 的付費人是使用者自己的定期費。
CI-135.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-136.reasoning: Reasoning: The chapter lists leasing and franchising among the commercial patterns. Leasing is paid use without transferring ownership. Franchising is operating under the owner’s branded system. Licensing is renting the brand (CI-128’s Firm C). Contract manufacturer and value-added reseller are chain roles (make for a brand; add customization/support), not this pair.

why_wrong.B: Licensing is renting the brand. The copier stem is use of an asset; the restaurant stem is operating a branded outlet (franchising).
why_wrong.C: Contract manufacturer makes for another company’s brand. A value-added reseller adds customization or support. Neither is a lease or a franchise.

CI-136.zh: 按月使用、所有權仍在對方是leasing。付費去開品牌店、照體系經營是franchising。授權是租品牌名稱；代工／加值經銷是供應鏈角色。
CI-136.core_idea: Leasing is paid use without ownership; franchising is running a branded outlet 核心觀念｜中文理解：租賃是用資產但不取得所有權；加盟是用品牌體系去經營據點。授權比較接近把品牌 租給別人，不是這組對照。
CI-136.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-137.reasoning: Reasoning: The chapter’s simple-product pricing list is tiered, dynamic, value-based, and auction. Complex-product devices (bundling, razor-and-blade, add-on) and chain roles (contract manufacturer, VAR, licensing) are separate lists. Drags/pulls are liquidity.

why_wrong.A: Those three are alternative roles in the value/supply chain, not the simpleproduct pricing list.
why_wrong.C: Liquidity labels, not pricing patterns.

CI-137.zh: 簡單商品定價四種：分層、動態、價值基礎、拍賣。代工／經銷／授權是價值鏈 角色；drags/pulls 是流動性。
CI-137.core_idea: Simple-product pricing: tiered, dynamic, value-based, auction 核心觀念｜中文理解：先把「簡單商品怎麼標價」和「複雜商品怎麼捆／耗材／加購」分開，再和供應鏈角 色分開。
CI-137.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。

CI-050.reasoning: Reasoning: At NPV = 0 the project is value-neutral: IRR equals the required return and PI equals 1. The chapter warns: do not mix ≥on NPV with > on IRR and PI and call those three statements the same rule. Accept if NPV>0 (indifferent at 0).

why_wrong.A: At NPV = 0, PI = 1, not PI < 1.
why_wrong.B: Mixing ≥on NPV with > on IRR and PI and calling them the same rule is the chapter’s warning.

CI-050.zh: NPV=0 是無差異：IRR=r、PI=1。不要把≥跟> 混成「完全等價」。NPV=0 不是PI<1 的拒絕。
CI-050.core_idea: Indifferent at NPV=0 ⇔IRR=r ⇔PI=1; do not mix ≥with >
CI-050.exam_trap: Mixing NPV≥0 with IRR>r and PI>1 as one rule
CI-050.source_note: 解答依據 CI_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Corporate Issuers。
CI-050.subtopic: 4.5 Extra Capital Allocation Practice ｜資本配置加強練習

CI-053.reasoning: Reasoning: Timeline: CF0 = -240, CF1 = 90, CF2 = 110, CF3 = 130. Sunk design is already excluded; loan interest is already in the 9% hurdle, so it is not a fourth outflow. NPV = -240 + 90/1.09 + 110/1.092 + 130/1.093 = 35.54. NPV>0 ⇔IRR>9% ⇔PI>1, so accept if independent. Given: CF0=-240; CF1=90; CF2=110; CF3=130; r=9%. Sunk and interest already excluded. Asked: NPV. Formula: NPV = −240 + 90/1.09 + 110/1.092 + 130/1.093 Variables: r = project required return (nominal, P/Y=1). Why this formula: Present value of incremental after-tax cash minus the timed outlay. Positive NPV: expected addition to firm value; IRR will exceed 9% and PI will exceed 1. Reasonableness check: 90 is undiscounted. 16.6 is the IRR percent, not NPV. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：CF / NPV 已知：CF0=-240; C01=90; C02=110; C03=130; I=9; P/Y=1; C/Y=1 求：NPV 按鍵： ①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②240 →+/- →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→90 →ENTER (C01) →↓→1 →ENTER (F01) ④↓→110 →ENTER (C02) →↓→1 →ENTER (F02) ⑤↓→ 130 →ENTER (C03) →↓→1 →ENTER (F03) ⑥NPV →9 →ENTER →↓→CPT 結果：NPV = 35.54 中文理解：CF0 是今天淨流出，必須負號。三期流入不同，不要用頻率把90 打三次。利息與 沉沒成本不要再當一筆CF。NPV 鍵先輸入I=9 再CPT。
CI-053.steps: ①Write the incremental timeline: t=0 -240; t=1 +90; t=2 +110; t=3 +130. ②Do not put sunk design or loan interest on the timeline. ③PV inflows = 90/1.09 + 110/1.1881 + 130/1.2950 = 82.57 + 92.58 + 100.39 = 275.54. ④NPV = 275.54 - 240 = 35.54.

why_wrong.B: Reports the IRR percent (about 16.6) as if it were the NPV.
why_wrong.C: Undiscounted 90+110+130-240 = 90, ignoring TVM.

CI-053.zh: 不規則現金流用CF 表，不要塞TVM 的PMT。CF0 打負號。沉沒設計費已排 除；利息已在9% 裡。NPV≈35.5>0，應接受。
CI-053.core_idea: Uneven project cash flows: CF worksheet, not TVM; CF0 is the outlay with a minus sign
