FSA-015.reasoning: Reasoning: Profit is the same under gross or net revenue reporting. Gross reporting shows higher sales (and COGS). Do not read a larger top line as a larger bottom line.

why_wrong.A: The chapter states profit is the same; gross just inflates sales and COGS.
why_wrong.C: The chapter discusses both presentations; it does not ban gross reporting.

FSA-015.zh: 總額或淨額，利潤一樣；總額只是銷貨和銷貨成本都比較大。不要把營收變大當 成獲利變大。
FSA-015.core_idea: Gross versus net reporting: same profit, higher sales and COGS under gross
FSA-015.study_section: Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列
FSA-015.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-015.subtopic: 5.2 Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列

FSA-016.reasoning: Reasoning: Barter revenue is measured at fair value only with a reliable benchmark. U.S. GAAP uses the firm’s own historical cash sales of the same service. IFRS uses fair value from similar non-barter deals with unrelated parties. Do not swap the two benchmarks.

why_wrong.B: The chapter does not make the counterparty’s list price the measurement rule.
why_wrong.C: That pairing reverses the two frameworks.

FSA-016.zh: 物物交換要有可靠基準：美國用自己過去現金銷售；IFRS 用與非關係人的類似非 物易交易公允價值。不要對調。
FSA-016.core_idea: Barter: U.S. GAAP uses own historical cash sales; IFRS uses similar non-barter deals with unrelated parties
FSA-016.study_section: Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列
FSA-016.exam_trap: Reversing the IFRS vs U.S. GAAP barter benchmark
FSA-016.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-016.subtopic: 5.2 Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列

FSA-017.reasoning: Reasoning: Recognize over time when any of these hold: the customer routinely receives and consumes the benefit; the entity’s performance creates or enhances an asset the customer controls; or the performance creates no alternative use and the entity has an enforceable right to payment. Delivery-only and cash-only rules skip those tests.

why_wrong.A: Specialization plus customer control and an enforceable payment right is exactly an over-time fact pattern, not a delivery-only rule.
why_wrong.B: The 2014 converged model replaced industry recipes with one transfer-of-control principle.

FSA-017.zh: 隨時間認列：客戶邊耗用、客戶控制被增強的資產，或無替代用途且有可強制執 行的收款權。不要死守交貨或收現。
FSA-017.core_idea: Revenue over time when the customer consumes as you perform, controls the enhanced asset, or you have no alternative use plus an enforceable right to payment
FSA-017.study_section: Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列
FSA-017.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-017.subtopic: 5.2 Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列

FSA-018.reasoning: Reasoning: A license is recognized over the license term if the seller keeps performing (upgrades, enhancements) that affect the customer and those activities are not themselves a transfer of a good or service; otherwise recognize when the license transfers. Do not treat every license as automatic ratable revenue.

why_wrong.A: Over-the-term recognition requires ongoing performance (upgrades, enhancements) that affect the customer and are not themselves a transfer of a good or service.
why_wrong.C: Cash collection is not the five-step trigger.

FSA-018.zh: 授權要在期間內認列，前提是賣方持續履約（升級等）且影響客戶。否則在授權 移轉時一次認列。
FSA-018.core_idea: A license is over the term only if the seller keeps performing in a way that affects the customer and is not itself a separate transfer
FSA-018.study_section: Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列
FSA-018.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-018.subtopic: 5.2 Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列

FSA-019.reasoning: Reasoning: Bill-and-hold is revenue only if the reason is substantive (the customer asked), the product is identified as the customer’s, it is ready to ship, and the entity cannot use it or redirect it. Seller convenience, fungible unmarked inventory, and an invoice do not meet those four conditions. This is a different failure pattern from a customer-requested hold that meets all four.

why_wrong.B: Invoice plus collectability is the shortcut the chapter rejects.
why_wrong.C: Title remaining with or passing from the producer is a control fact; an invoice does not by itself pass control.

FSA-019.zh: 賣方自己倉庫塞車、貨還能轉賣，不是bill-and-hold。要客戶要求、貨已指定、可 交運、且不能再轉走。
FSA-019.core_idea: Bill-and-hold needs a substantive customer request, identification, readiness, and no redirection
FSA-019.study_section: Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列
FSA-019.exam_trap: Treating an invoice as bill-and-hold control
FSA-019.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-019.subtopic: 5.2 Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列

FSA-020.reasoning: Reasoning: Consignment: revenue when the consignee sells. Channel stuffing is not a recognition principle — it is a warning that this period’s revenue, receivables, and low inventory will reverse. Do not treat warehouse exit as step 5.

why_wrong.A: Possession by a consignee is not the same as a completed sale to the end customer.
why_wrong.B: Bill-and-hold is a different fact pattern with its own four conditions; you do not invoice yourself into revenue.

FSA-020.zh: 寄售是代銷商賣出時才認列收入。貨離開倉庫或自己開一張bill-and-hold 發票， 都不是認列時點。
FSA-020.core_idea: Consignment revenue is recognized when the consignee sells
FSA-020.study_section: Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列
FSA-020.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-020.subtopic: 5.2 Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列

FSA-021.reasoning: Reasoning: Incremental costs of obtaining a contract and costs to fulfill, previously expensed, are capitalized under the converged model, so near-term profitability looks higher. That is an accounting-timing effect, not a change in the cash commission itself.

why_wrong.A: The chapter says incremental costs of obtaining a contract and costs to fulfill, previously expensed, are capitalized.
why_wrong.C: The commission is an operating contract cost, not a financing classification.

FSA-021.zh: 取得合約的增額成本現在資本化，短期獲利看起來比較好。現金佣金還是那筆錢， 只是費用時點延後。
FSA-021.core_idea: Incremental costs of obtaining a contract are capitalized, so near-term profitability looks higher
FSA-021.study_section: Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列
FSA-021.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-021.subtopic: 5.2 Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列

FSA-022.reasoning: Reasoning: Expense recognition follows matching: cost of sales and estimated bad-debt or warranty cost hit the same period as the related revenue. Period costs that cannot be tied to revenue (executive salaries, most administrative costs) are expensed as incurred. Delayed expense recognition is aggressive: it raises current net income.

why_wrong.B: Expense recognition is matching, not cash. Salaries are not held for cash settlement.
why_wrong.C: Internally generated items such as start-up and SG&A are expensed; executive salaries are period costs, not capitalized intangibles.

FSA-022.zh: 保證與呆帳跟收入同一期估列；總經理薪資是期間費用，發生就認。延後認費用 是偏激進。
FSA-022.core_idea: Matching puts cost of sales and estimated warranty in the same period as the related revenue; period costs are expensed as incurred
FSA-022.study_section: Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列
FSA-022.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-022.subtopic: 5.2 Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列

FSA-023.reasoning: Reasoning: Capitalizing rather than expensing, in the early years: higher NI, profitability ratios, assets and book value, taxable income and tax paid if tax follows the books; lower current expense and activity ratios. Depreciation is non-cash, so total cash outflow is the same. Capitalized cash is CFI; expensed cash is CFO. Later years reverse the income effect once depreciation exceeds what the immediate-expense alternative would have taken.

why_wrong.A: That is the immediate-expense pattern, not capitalization.
why_wrong.B: Depreciation and amortization are non-cash; capitalization changes classification and timing, not the total cash spent.

FSA-023.zh: 資本化：早期NI、資產較高，現金在CFI 而不是CFO；總現金一樣。折舊不是 現金。
FSA-023.core_idea: Capitalizing versus expensing: early-year NI, assets, and CFO vs CFI, same total cash
FSA-023.study_section: Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列
FSA-023.exam_trap: Treating depreciation as a cash outflow that changes total cash
FSA-023.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-023.subtopic: 5.2 Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列

FSA-024.reasoning: Reasoning: If the asset is for the firm’s own use, capitalized interest sits in PPE and later hits depreciation. If the asset is for sale, it sits in inventory and hits COGS when sold. Capitalized interest is a CFI outflow; expensed interest is a CFO outflow. For coverage analysis, add capitalized interest back to interest expense.

why_wrong.A: Expensed interest is a CFO outflow. Capitalized interest is a CFI outflow. The chapter’s IFRS flexibility on interest paid is a cash-flow classification choice for expensed interest, not a rule that capitalized construction interest is CFO.
why_wrong.C: The chapter’s placement is PPE versus inventory, not CFF versus revenue.

FSA-024.zh: 自用工程利息進PPE 再折舊；待售進存貨再進銷貨成本。資本化利息現金在 CFI，費用化在CFO。
FSA-024.core_idea: Interest on a self-constructed asset sits in PPE then depreciation; interest on an asset for sale sits in inventory then COGS; cash is CFI if capitalized
FSA-024.study_section: Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列
FSA-024.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-024.subtopic: 5.2 Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列

FSA-025.reasoning: Reasoning: A change in accounting principle is retrospective (restate presented priors). A change in estimate (useful life, salvage) is prospective. Correction of an error is a prior-period adjustment (restate). Do not flatten the three into one treatment.

why_wrong.B: Useful-life change is the chapter’s example of a prospective estimate. Not everything that uses judgment is prospective.
why_wrong.C: Estimate changes are not retrospective. The chapter separates the three.

FSA-025.zh: 原則變更追溯；估計變更推延；錯誤是前期更正。不要三件事同一套。
FSA-025.core_idea: Principle change is retrospective; estimate change is prospective; error is a prior-period restatement
FSA-025.study_section: Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列
FSA-025.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-025.subtopic: 5.2 Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列

FSA-026.reasoning: Reasoning: Unusual or infrequent items stay in continuing operations. Discontinued operations (physically and operationally distinct) are reported net of tax below continuing operations. Do not move an infrequent gain below the line just because it is unusual.

why_wrong.A: Reverses the two presentations.
why_wrong.B: Unusual or infrequent items stay in continuing operations. IAS 1’s no-offsetting rule is not a ban on displaying discontinued operations.

FSA-026.zh: 不尋常／不常發生仍在繼續營業。停業單位（可分開的營運）稅後列在下面。不 要把「少見」當成停業。
FSA-026.core_idea: Unusual or infrequent items stay in continuing operations; discontinued operations are net of tax below continuing operations
FSA-026.study_section: Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列
FSA-026.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-026.subtopic: 5.2 Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列

FSA-027.reasoning: Reasoning: Delayed expense recognition is aggressive: it raises current net income. The same cluster of aggressive choices: lower allowance for uncollectibles, longer useful lives, FIFO in rising prices. Lengthening lives lowers this period’s depreciation; a lower allowance lowers bad-debt expense.

why_wrong.A: Longer useful life or higher salvage lowers periodic depreciation and raises current NI.
why_wrong.C: These estimates hit expense and therefore NI; they are not offincome-statement.

FSA-027.zh: 拉長耐用年限、少提呆帳，都是延後費用，今年NI 上升，屬激進選擇。
FSA-027.core_idea: Delayed expense recognition is aggressive: it raises current net income
FSA-027.study_section: Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列
FSA-027.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-027.subtopic: 5.2 Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列

FSA-028.reasoning: Reasoning: A consolidated subsidiary that is not wholly owned reports the outside share as noncontrolling interest. That is an income-statement attribution, not a discontinued-operation or OCI substitute.

why_wrong.B: Discontinued operations are physically and operationally distinct disposed businesses, not the minority share of a continuing subsidiary.
why_wrong.C: The outside share is reported on the income statement as noncontrolling interest, not parked only in OCI.

FSA-028.zh: 未全資子公司的外部股東份額是非控制權益，不是停業或OCI。
FSA-028.core_idea: Noncontrolling interest is the outside share of a consolidated subsidiary that is not wholly owned
FSA-028.study_section: Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列
FSA-028.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-028.subtopic: 5.2 Revenue and Expense Recognition ｜收入與費用認列

FSA-029.reasoning: Reasoning: Taxable income × tax rate = taxes payable (the return’s current claim). Income tax expense = taxes payable + ∆DTL - ∆DTA. Here payable = 2,000 × 0.30 = 600. Expense is not 600 unless net deferred movement is zero. EBT is 2,400, so a taxable temporary difference of 400 is sitting in the gap; that typically builds a DTL and pushes expense above payable. Given: Taxable income = 2,000; EBT = 2,400; t = 30%. Temporary differences explain the gap. Asked: Taxes payable versus how to obtain tax expense. Formula: taxes payable = taxable income × t; expense = payable + ∆DTL −∆DTA Variables: Taxes payable = return bill; ∆DTL / ∆DTA = deferred movement. Why this formula: Two machines: the return and the books. Expense bridges them with deferred tax. Payable is what the tax authority is owed now. Expense is that bill plus future catch-up. Reasonableness check: Effective rate = 720/2,400 = 30% when there are no permanent differences — expense tracks EBT, payable tracks taxable income. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-029.steps: ①Taxes payable = 2,000 × 0.30 = 600. ②Book EBT exceeds taxable income by 400, a taxable temporary difference →DTL = 400 × 0.30 = 120 if the whole gap is one originating DTL. ③Tax expense = 600 + 120 - 0 = 720, not 600.
FSA-029.final_answer: Payable 600; expense 720 if the 400 gap is a single originating DTL.

why_wrong.A: EBT × rate is not automatically the tax-return bill, and a larger EBT does not shrink payable.
why_wrong.B: The chapter’s core trap: taxes payable is not tax expense.

FSA-029.zh: 應付稅款是稅單；所得稅費用還要加減遞延。兩者同名是陷阱。這裡應付是600， 費用通常更高。
FSA-029.core_idea: Taxes payable is the tax-return bill; tax expense adds net deferred buildup
FSA-029.exam_trap: Tax payable ̸= tax expense; DTA vs DTL reversed
FSA-029.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-030.reasoning: Reasoning: For an asset, carrying amount above tax base is a taxable temporary difference (DTL): you have already taken more tax deduction than the books have recognized, so future taxable income will be higher. Straight-line on the books and accelerated on the return this year is the workhorse DTL. Do not treat ‘more depreciation’ as a DTA.

why_wrong.A: The tempting reversal: extra tax depreciation feels like a prepaid tax (DTA). Extra tax deduction relative to the books is the opposite — future taxable income will be higher (DTL).
why_wrong.C: The workhorse depreciation difference reverses as book depreciation later catches up; it is temporary.

FSA-030.zh: 稅務折舊快→今年少繳→DTL。看到折舊不要反射選DTA；那是把「多扣」誤 當成「預付」。
FSA-030.core_idea: Accelerated tax depreciation: CA > tax base →DTL, not DTA
FSA-030.exam_trap: Tax payable ̸= tax expense; DTA vs DTL reversed
FSA-030.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-031.reasoning: Reasoning: The workhorse DTA is warranty (or other accrued) expense on the books now, deductible only when paid: taxable income is higher this year, you pay more tax now, and you have prepaid a future deduction. Carrying amount of the related liability exceeds its tax base in the deductible direction. Do not flip it into a DTL.

why_wrong.B: Accrued warranty is the workhorse DTA, not a DTL. Future deduction is a prepaid-tax right, not a future extra tax bill.
why_wrong.C: Warranties reverse when paid; tax-exempt interest never reverses.

FSA-031.zh: 賬面先認保證費用、稅局以後才扣→今年先多繳→DTA。不要和加速稅務折舊 的DTL 對調。
FSA-031.core_idea: Warranty/book-first expense: taxable income higher now →DTA
FSA-031.exam_trap: Tax payable ̸= tax expense; DTA vs DTL reversed
FSA-031.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-032.reasoning: Reasoning: Taxable temporary difference from depreciation is 2,500, so DTL = 500. Deductible temporary difference from the warranty is 600, so DTA = 120. Tax expense exceeds taxes payable by 500 - 120 = 380. Formula: expense = payable + ∆DTL - ∆DTA. Given: t = 20%. Book dep 1,500; tax dep 4,000; warranty 600 not yet deductible. No permanent differences; no beginning deferreds. Asked: Tax expense minus taxes payable. Formula: ∆DTL = (4,000 −1,500) × 0.20; ∆DTA = 600 × 0.20 Variables: DTL from extra tax depreciation; DTA from book-first warranty. Why this formula: Expense exceeds payable by the net originating deferred position. The return underpays relative to book expense by the net DTL buildup. Reasonableness check: If EBT minus taxable income = 2,500 - 600 = 1,900, then 1,900 × 0.20 = 380. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-032.steps: ①Accounting causality: extra tax depreciation 2,500 →future taxable income higher →DTL 500. Warranty 600 on books only →tax overpaid now →DTA 120. ②∆DTL - ∆DTA = 500 - 120 = 380. ③Do not add 500 + 120.

why_wrong.A: 500 is the DTL alone (2,500 × 0.20), ignoring the warranty DTA.
why_wrong.B: Adds DTL 500 and DTA 120 instead of subtracting the DTA.

FSA-032.zh: 費用= 應付+ ∆DTL - ∆DTA。只算折舊DTL 會得500；把DTA 加回去會得 620。
FSA-032.core_idea: Tax expense = payable + ∆DTL - ∆DTA, with both originating differences
FSA-032.exam_trap: Tax payable ̸= tax expense; DTA vs DTL reversed
FSA-032.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-033.reasoning: Reasoning: Permanent differences never reverse (tax-exempt interest, some dividends received, certain donations, tax credits, non-deductible expenses). They create no DTA or DTL; they show up as a wedge between the statutory rate and the effective rate. Temporary differences reverse and do create deferred tax.

why_wrong.A: Book income above taxable income is a DTL only when the difference is temporary and will reverse.
why_wrong.C: Tax-exempt interest is never taxed later; there is no prepaid future deduction.

FSA-033.zh: 免稅利息永不迴轉，不生DTA ／DTL，只是法定稅率與有效稅率的缺口。不要 當成暫時性差異。
FSA-033.core_idea: Permanent differences create no DTA or DTL; they wedge statutory versus effective rates
FSA-033.exam_trap: Tax payable ̸= tax expense; DTA vs DTL reversed
FSA-033.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-034.reasoning: Reasoning: Effective tax rate = income tax expense / EBT = 200/800 = 25%. Cash tax rate = tax paid / EBT = 140/800 = 17.5%. Use the effective rate to project tax expense; use the cash tax rate to project cash taxes. Statutory rate is the domestic corporate rate. Given: EBT = 800; tax expense = 200; tax paid = 140. Asked: Effective tax rate and cash tax rate. Formula: 200/800 = 25%; 140/800 = 17.5% Variables: Expense is the provision; paid is cash. Why this formula: Two different numerators over the same book pretax. The firm’s books take a 25% provision; cash taxes this period are lighter. Reasonableness check: If someone swaps numerators they report 17.5% ‘effective,’ which is the cash rate. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Swaps the two numerators.
why_wrong.C: Tax paid may differ from payable and from expense; the chapter separates the two rates.

FSA-034.zh: 有效稅率用稅費／EBT；現金稅率用實繳／EBT。實繳可以跟應付、跟費用都不 同。
FSA-034.core_idea: Effective tax rate = tax expense / EBT; cash tax rate = tax paid / EBT
FSA-034.formula:
ETR = tax expense/EBT,
cash tax rate = tax paid/EBT
FSA-034.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-035.reasoning: Reasoning: Deferred tax = temporary difference × the expected future tax rate. Remeasure: DTL becomes 900, DTA becomes 300. Net liability drops by 200, current tax expense falls by 200, NI and equity rise, leverage falls. Rate changes hit this period’s expense through the remeasurement of balances that were built in the past. Given: DTL 1,200 and DTA 400 at 40%; enacted rate falls to 30%. Asked: Remeasurement effect on tax expense and NI. Formula: DTL = 1,200 × 30/40 = 900; DTA = 400 × 30/40 = 300 Variables: Net DTL = 1,200 - 400 = 800 at 40%; 600 at 30%. Why this formula: The same temporary differences are now taxed at 30%, so the deferred balances scale by 30/40. A growing firm’s leftover DTL is smaller after a rate cut — good for current earnings. Reasonableness check: Net × (0.10/0.40) = 800 × 0.25 = 200. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-035.steps: ①New DTL = 1,200 × (0.30/0.40) = 900. New DTA = 400 × (0.30/0.40) = 300. ②Net liability 800 →600, a 200 decline. ③A decline in net DTL reduces tax expense by 200 and raises NI and equity.

why_wrong.A: The chapter remeasures already-built balances through this period’s expense. It does not freeze old balances.
why_wrong.B: A lower rate shrinks a net DTL, which reduces tax expense.

FSA-035.zh: 稅率下降要重估舊餘額：淨DTL 變小→本期稅費下降→NI 上升。不是只改今 年新發生的差異。
FSA-035.core_idea: Enacted rate cut remeasures existing DTA/DTL through this period’s tax expense
FSA-035.formula: Deferred tax = temporary difference × enacted future rate
FSA-035.exam_trap: Tax payable ̸= tax expense; DTA vs DTL reversed
FSA-035.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-036.reasoning: Reasoning: If a DTA’s economic benefit is not probable: IFRS reverses the DTA; U.S. GAAP records a valuation allowance. An increase in the valuation allowance is treated like a decrease in the DTA: it raises tax expense and lowers NI. Releasing the allowance raises NI. That allowance is a smoothing lever.

why_wrong.A: Realizability is a separate overlay. The originating difference can exist and still fail the benefit test.
why_wrong.C: That pairing reverses the two frameworks and misplaces the allowance.

FSA-036.zh: DTA 利益很可能無法實現：IFRS 沖掉DTA；美國提valuation allowance。加準 備金會推高稅費、壓低NI。
FSA-036.core_idea: IFRS reverses an unrealizable DTA; U.S. GAAP uses a valuation allowance
FSA-036.exam_trap: Tax payable ̸= tax expense; DTA vs DTL reversed
FSA-036.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-037.reasoning: Reasoning: For an asset, carrying amount above tax base is a taxable temporary difference (DTL). Difference = 1,800; DTL = 1,800 × 0.25 = 450. Carrying amount below tax base would be a DTA. Depreciation timing differences are temporary, not permanent. Given: CA = 5,000; tax base = 3,200; t = 25%. Asked: Deferred tax asset or liability and amount. Formula: (5,000 −3,200) × 0.25 = 450 Variables: CA = carrying amount. Why this formula: The extra 1,800 already deducted for tax will reverse as taxable income. Future tax bills, not a prepaid refund. Reasonableness check: If CA were 3,200 and tax base 5,000, the same 450 would be a DTA. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Tax base below carrying amount means more deduction has already been taken for tax — future taxable income is higher (DTL), not a prepaid DTA.
why_wrong.C: This is the chapter’s asset rule and it reverses.

FSA-037.zh: 資產帳面> 稅基→應課稅暫時性差異→DTL。這裡1,800 × 25% = 450。不要 看到稅基較小就選DTA。
FSA-037.core_idea: Asset CA > tax base is a taxable temporary difference (DTL)
FSA-037.exam_trap: Tax payable ̸= tax expense; DTA vs DTL reversed
FSA-037.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-038.reasoning: Reasoning: DTAs and DTLs are not netted for analysis even if presentation nets them. The 90 is a presentation compacting. A DTL that will not reverse in a growing firm is, for analysis, closer to equity than to a claim that will be paid — that is a DTL comment, not a reason to call a DTA equity.

why_wrong.A: Presentation netting is not the analytical treatment.
why_wrong.B: A DTA is a prepaid future deduction, not automatic equity. The chapter’s equity-like comment is about a DTL that will not reverse in a growing firm.

FSA-038.zh: 分析時DTA 和DTL 不要互抵。報表上的淨額只是表達，不是分析起點。
FSA-038.core_idea: Do not net DTA and DTL for analysis even if presentation nets them
FSA-038.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-039.reasoning: Reasoning: A DTL that will not reverse in a growing firm is, for analysis, closer to equity than to a claim that will be paid. If it will reverse, a present-value haircut is the cleaner treatment when it can be estimated. Do not dump the whole balance into taxes payable.

why_wrong.A: Taxes payable is the current return bill. An unreversing DTL is not that bill.
why_wrong.C: Growth that prevents reversal does not flip a taxable difference into a deductible one.

FSA-039.zh: 持續成長、差異不迴轉的DTL，分析上比較像權益而不是即將支付的稅單。會迴 轉才比較像負債（必要時折現）。
FSA-039.core_idea: A DTL that will not reverse in a growing firm is closer to equity than to a payable
FSA-039.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-040.reasoning: Reasoning: An increase in the valuation allowance is treated like a decrease in the DTA: it raises tax expense and lowers NI. Releasing it raises NI. IFRS would reverse the DTA rather than use this allowance, but the NI direction of ‘benefit no longer probable’ is the same: earnings fall.

why_wrong.B: An allowance is a contra to the DTA, not an extra prepaid asset.
why_wrong.C: The chapter ties the allowance movement to tax expense and NI; it is also a smoothing lever, which is why it is not ‘footnote only.’

FSA-040.zh: 美國加valuation allowance = 把DTA 縮小：稅費升、NI 降。不是預付稅，也不 是只寫在附註。
FSA-040.core_idea: Valuation-allowance increase raises tax expense and lowers NI
FSA-040.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-041.reasoning: Reasoning: On the tax return: taxable income, taxes payable = taxable income × rate, and income tax paid (which may differ from payable). On the financial statements: EBT and income tax expense (provision). Do not force paid = payable = expense.

why_wrong.A: The chapter’s tax-return column lists payable and paid as separate rows: paid may differ from payable.
why_wrong.B: Expense is payable plus net deferred movement, not cash paid.

FSA-041.zh: 應付、實繳、稅費是三個數字。實繳可以不等於應付，更不必等於稅費。
FSA-041.core_idea: Income tax paid may differ from taxes payable
FSA-041.exam_trap: Tax payable ̸= tax expense; DTA vs DTL reversed
FSA-041.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-042.reasoning: Reasoning: Use the effective rate to project tax expense; use the cash tax rate to project cash taxes. The statutory rate is the domestic corporate rate. Common wedges: credits, withholding tax on dividends, prior-year adjustments, non-deductible items, and foreign operations.

why_wrong.A: The statutory rate is the domestic corporate rate; wedges (credits, withholding, prior-year adjustments, non-deductible items, foreign operations) are why the effective rate differs. The chapter does not say to ignore those wedges in every forecast.
why_wrong.C: That pairing reverses the two uses.

FSA-042.zh: 損益表稅費用有效稅率；現金稅用現金稅率。法定稅率只是本國名義稅率。
FSA-042.core_idea: Project tax expense with the effective rate; project cash taxes with the cash tax rate
FSA-042.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-043.reasoning: Reasoning: The workhorse DTL is tax depreciation faster than book. Flip the speeds and the sign flips: book depreciation higher →CA declines faster →CA below tax base →deductible temporary difference →DTA. Taxes payable exceed tax expense as the DTA is born. This is the reverse angle of the usual accelerated-tax-depreciation trap.

why_wrong.B: The asset rule is CA versus tax base, not ‘depreciation always DTL.’ If books take more depreciation now, CA falls faster than the tax base, which is the DTA direction.
why_wrong.C: Depreciation timing reverses; it is not grouped with permanent items.

FSA-043.zh: 反向：賬面折舊比較快→今年稅單較大→DTA。不要背成「凡折舊都是DTL」。
FSA-043.core_idea: Reverse the workhorse: extra book depreciation relative to tax creates a DTA
FSA-043.exam_trap: Tax payable ̸= tax expense; DTA vs DTL reversed
FSA-043.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-044.reasoning: Reasoning: Deductible temporary difference = 1,200. DTA = 1,200 × 0.35 = 420. Depreciation is equal, so it contributes nothing. Signing it as a DTL is the classic reversal. Given: t = 35%; warranty 1,200 book-only; depreciation equal. Asked: Originating deferred tax. Formula: 1,200 × 0.35 = 420 Variables: Warranty is book-first expense. Why this formula: Tax is overpaid now; a future deduction was prepaid. When claims are paid, the deduction appears on the return and the DTA reverses. Reasonableness check: A DTL answer would be the accelerated-tax-depreciation pattern, which the stem turned off. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-044.steps: ①Accounting causality: Expense↑now on books, not on the return →taxable income↑→tax paid now↑→DTA↑. ②DTA = 1,200 × 0.35 = 420.

why_wrong.A: 1,200 is the pretax temporary difference, not the deferred tax balance.
why_wrong.B: Warranty is the workhorse DTA, not a DTL.

FSA-044.zh: 保證費用1,200 × 35% = DTA 420。不要把暫時性差異本身當遞延稅，也不要簽 成DTL。
FSA-044.exam_trap: Tax payable ̸= tax expense; DTA vs DTL reversed
FSA-044.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-045.reasoning: Reasoning: Capitalizing, early years: higher NI, profitability ratios, assets and book value, taxable income and tax paid if tax follows the books; lower current expense and activity ratios. Do not assume capitalization is a tax shelter; that would be extra tax depreciation, a different fact.

why_wrong.A: Capitalization delays expense; if the return follows the books, the return also delays the deduction.
why_wrong.C: The chapter lists higher taxable income and tax paid if tax follows the books as part of the early-year capitalization effects. That is not ‘no tax effect.’

FSA-045.zh: 若報稅跟著賬：資本化會讓今年應稅所得和實繳稅都較高。那不是節稅，是延後 扣費用。
FSA-045.core_idea: If tax follows the books, capitalization raises taxable income and tax paid this period
FSA-045.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-046.reasoning: Reasoning: DTL = (5,800 - 2,200) × 0.28 = 1,008. DTA = 900 × 0.28 = 252. Expense - payable = 1,008 - 252 = 756. Given: t = 28%; book dep 2,200; tax dep 5,800; litigation accrual 900. Asked: Tax expense minus taxes payable. Formula: (3,600 × 0.28) −(900 × 0.28) = 756 Variables: Originating DTL from tax-faster depreciation; originating DTA from book-first accrual. Why this formula: Net deferred buildup is the bridge from the return bill to the provision. Payable understates expense by the net DTL. Reasonableness check: Net originating book-tax gap = 3,600 - 900 = 2,700; 2,700 × 0.28 = 756. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-046.steps: ①Extra tax depreciation 3,600 →DTL 1,008 (future taxable income↑). ②Book-first 900 →DTA 252 (tax overpaid now). ③Net 1,008 - 252 = 756.

why_wrong.C: Adds DTL 1,008 and DTA 252.

FSA-046.exam_trap: Tax payable ̸= tax expense; DTA vs DTL reversed
FSA-046.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-047.reasoning: Reasoning: Raising the valuation allowance lowers NI; releasing it raises NI. The allowance is a smoothing lever. This is the opposite-direction angle of the ‘raise the allowance’ question.

why_wrong.A: Recording and releasing are opposite NI directions.
why_wrong.B: A change in estimate about realizability is not automatically an error restatement.

FSA-047.zh: 沖回valuation allowance：稅費下降、NI 上升。和提列方向相反，不是前期錯誤 更正。
FSA-047.core_idea: Releasing a valuation allowance raises NI — the reverse of raising it
FSA-047.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-048.reasoning: Reasoning: Permanent differences and the listed wedges (credits, withholding tax on dividends, prior-year adjustments, non-deductible items, foreign operations) show up between the statutory rate and the effective rate. Temporary differences reverse and are the DTA/DTL machine. Do not book the entire ETR gap as deferred tax.

why_wrong.A: A rate wedge is not, by itself, a reversing temporary difference.
why_wrong.C: Same error with the opposite deferred sign.

FSA-048.zh: 稅額抵減、國外營運會拉開法定與有效稅率，本身不是自動的DTA ／DTL。
FSA-048.core_idea: Credits and foreign operations wedge statutory versus effective rates without creating deferred tax by themselves
FSA-048.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-049.reasoning: Reasoning: New DTL = 500 × 25/20 = 625. New DTA = 100 × 25/20 = 125. Net liability 400 →500, up 100. Tax expense rises 100; NI and equity fall; leverage rises. Same mechanism as a rate cut, opposite sign. Given: DTL 500, DTA 100 at 20%; enacted rate 25%. Asked: Effect on current tax expense and NI. Formula: DTL = 625, DTA = 125, ∆net DTL = +100 Variables: Net DTL was 400. Why this formula: Future tax on the same temporary differences is now heavier. Rate-change P&L is about old balances, not only this year’s originating items. Reasonableness check: Net × (0.25 - 0.20)/0.20 = 400 × 0.25 = 100. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-049.steps: ①Scale by 25/20: DTL 625, DTA 125. ②Net 400 →500. ③Expense +100; NI -100.

why_wrong.B: Prior-year balances are remeasured through this period’s expense. That is the point of the chapter’s rate-change teaching.
why_wrong.C: A rate increase enlarges a net DTL and increases tax expense — the opposite of the 40%→30% cut example.

FSA-049.zh: 稅率上升：淨DTL 變大→本期稅費上升→NI 下降。和降稅剛好相反，不是 「舊餘額不動」。
FSA-049.core_idea: Rate increase remeasures a net DTL up and raises current tax expense — opposite of a rate cut
FSA-049.formula: remeasure deferred balances at the new enacted rate
FSA-049.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-050.reasoning: Reasoning: Expense = payable + ∆DTL - ∆DTA = 480 + 0 - 90 = 390. When the books take expense the return has not yet allowed, payable exceeds expense. Treating payable as expense, or adding the DTA, is the trap. Given: Taxes payable = 480; ∆DTA = +90; ∆DTL = 0. Asked: Income tax expense. Formula: 480 + 0 −90 = 390 Variables: Warranty-type DTA origin. Why this formula: A new DTA means tax was overpaid relative to book expense. Expense is smaller than the cash/return bill when a DTA is born. Reasonableness check: Sign of ∆DTA in the formula is minus. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-050.steps: ①Causality: book warranty expense now →taxable income higher →payable 480 includes tax on that add-back →DTA 90 prepaid. ②Expense = 480 - 90 = 390.

why_wrong.A: 480 treats payable as expense.
why_wrong.B: 570 adds the DTA instead of subtracting it.

FSA-050.zh: 費用= 480 - 90 = 390。把應付當費用得480；把DTA 加回去得570。
FSA-050.core_idea: Tax expense can be below payable when a DTA originates by more than any DTL
FSA-050.exam_trap: Tax payable ̸= tax expense; DTA vs DTL reversed
FSA-050.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-051.reasoning: Reasoning: Use the effective rate to project tax expense: 1,000 × 0.22 = 220. The cash tax rate projects cash taxes (140), not the provision. Adding the rates has no chapter basis. Given: Forecast EBT = 1,000; ETR = 22%; cash tax rate = 14%. Asked: Projected income tax expense. Formula: 0.22 × 1,000 = 220 Variables: ETR for the provision; cash tax rate for cash. Why this formula: The income statement uses the provision, not cash paid. Do not drop the cash rate into the tax-expense cell. Reasonableness check: 220/1,000 = 22% = ETR. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-051.steps: ①Tax expense = 0.22 × 1,000 = 220. ②Cash taxes would be 140 if the cash rate holds.

why_wrong.A: 140 uses the cash tax rate on the income-statement line.
why_wrong.C: Adds the two rates (22%+14%) as if both apply to the provision.

FSA-051.zh: 損益表稅費用有效稅率22% →220。14% 是拿去預測現金稅，不是費用。
FSA-051.core_idea: Use ETR to project expense, not the cash tax rate, on the income statement
FSA-051.formula: Projected tax expense = ETR × forecast EBT
FSA-051.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-052.reasoning: Reasoning: Non-deductible expenses are permanent differences. They create no DTA or DTL. They widen the statutory-to-effective wedge (here, ETR up). Temporary book-first expenses (warranty) do create a DTA.

why_wrong.B: Never-deductible means no future deduction and no DTA.
why_wrong.C: The return does not allow the fine, so taxable income is higher than it would be if the fine were deductible; the ETR rises.

FSA-052.zh: 永不扣除的罰款是永久差異，不生DTA，有效稅率上升。不要和保證費用那種暫 時性差異搞混。
FSA-052.core_idea: Non-deductible expense is a permanent difference that raises the effective rate
FSA-052.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-053.reasoning: Reasoning: Temporary differences reverse. Deferred tax = temporary difference × the expected future tax rate (usually the current rate). Rate changes then remeasure the balances.

why_wrong.A: The cash tax rate projects cash taxes; it is not the deferred-tax multiplier.
why_wrong.B: Payable minus paid is a cash-timing residual, not the definition of deferred tax.

FSA-053.zh: 遞延稅= 暫時性差異× 預期未來稅率（通常是已立法的現行稅率），不是現金稅 率。
FSA-053.core_idea: DTAs and DTLs are measured at the expected future rate, usually the current enacted rate
FSA-053.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-054.reasoning: Reasoning: Taxable income 1,300 →payable 390. Deductible difference 300 →DTA 90. Expense = 390 - 90 = 300, which is also EBT × 30% with no permanent differences. The trap is reading ‘book below tax’ as a DTL or forcing payable = expense. Given: EBT = 1,000; taxable income = 1,300; t = 30%; gap is warranty timing. Asked: Payable, deferred item, and expense. Formula: 1,300 × 0.30 = 390; 300 × 0.30 = 90; expense = 300 Variables: Book-first warranty. Why this formula: Return bill on 1,300; books provision on 1,000. You overpay now relative to book expense and hold a DTA. Reasonableness check: 300/1,000 = 30% ETR. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Lower book income than taxable income from a book-first expense is the DTA pattern, not a DTL. Payable is 1,300 × 0.30, not 1,000 × 0.30.
why_wrong.C: Payable is not expense when a DTA originates.

FSA-054.zh: 賬面利潤較低是因為費用先認：應付390、DTA 90、費用300。不是DTL，也不 是應付＝費用。
FSA-054.core_idea: Book income below taxable income from a deductible difference means payable exceeds expense
FSA-054.exam_trap: Tax payable ̸= tax expense; DTA vs DTL reversed
FSA-054.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-055.reasoning: Reasoning: Rate changes remeasure DTA and DTL through current expense. The incomestatement effect is the change in the net position, but DTAs and DTLs are not netted for analysis even if presentation nets them. Do not freeze balances and do not skip the DTA side.

why_wrong.B: Both deferred balances use the expected future rate, so both remeasure.
why_wrong.C: The chapter remeasures and, separately, says not to net for analysis.

FSA-055.zh: 降稅兩邊都要重估；損益看淨變動，分析仍分開看DTA 與DTL。
FSA-055.core_idea: Analysis still separates DTA from DTL when a rate change hits both
FSA-055.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-056.reasoning: Reasoning: The originating difference (books first, tax later) is a DTA under both frameworks. Realizability is the overlay: IFRS reverses the DTA; U.S. GAAP records a valuation allowance. Either overlay raises tax expense and lowers NI. Do not treat the overlay as ‘U.S. GAAP never touches the DTA’ or as proof the difference is permanent.

why_wrong.A: U.S. GAAP uses the valuation allowance specifically to reduce the recognized DTA.
why_wrong.B: Warranty is the workhorse temporary DTA, not a permanent item.

FSA-056.zh: 同一筆保證差異，利益很可能沒有時：IFRS 沖DTA、美國提準備，NI 都會下 降。起源規則沒變。
FSA-056.core_idea: IFRS DTA reversal versus U.S. GAAP allowance is a measurement overlay, not a different originating-difference rule
FSA-056.exam_trap: Tax payable ̸= tax expense; DTA vs DTL reversed
FSA-056.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-057.reasoning: Reasoning: Inventory includes purchase cost, conversion cost, allocated fixed production overhead at normal capacity, and other costs to bring inventory to its present location and condition. Abnormal waste, most storage, administration, and selling costs are period costs, not inventory.

why_wrong.A: Abnormal waste, most storage, administration, and selling costs are period costs, not inventory.
why_wrong.C: Same period-cost list.

FSA-057.zh: 正常產能的固定製造費用進存貨。異常損耗、大部分倉儲、管理與銷售是期間費 用。
FSA-057.core_idea: Inventory includes purchase, conversion, normal-capacity overhead, and costs to bring to location/condition
FSA-057.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-058.reasoning: Reasoning: Cost flow: FIFO, LIFO, weighted average, and specific identification. IFRS permits FIFO and weighted average, not LIFO. U.S. GAAP permits LIFO; a firm that uses LIFO for tax must use it in the statements.

why_wrong.B: IFRS does not permit LIFO, and conservatism is not a license to use a forbidden method.
why_wrong.C: That pairing reverses both frameworks.

FSA-058.zh: IFRS 不准LIFO。美國可以，且報稅用LIFO 報表也要用。不要對調。
FSA-058.core_idea: IFRS permits FIFO and weighted average, not LIFO; U.S. GAAP permits LIFO with tax-book conformity
FSA-058.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-059.reasoning: Reasoning: FIFO: earliest costs to COGS; ending inventory is the most recent costs. In rising prices, COGS is lower, profit/tax/equity higher, ending inventory and the current ratio higher, inventory turnover lower (smaller numerator, larger denominator). LIFO is the opposite. Weighted average sits between.

why_wrong.A: That is LIFO relative to FIFO.
why_wrong.B: FIFO sends cheaper units to COGS and keeps costlier units in inventory, so turnover (COGS/inventory) is lower, not higher.

FSA-059.zh: 漲價時FIFO：便宜的進銷貨成本、貴的留在庫。周轉率分子更小、分母更大。
FSA-059.core_idea: Rising prices, stable quantities: FIFO has lower COGS and higher ending inventory than LIFO
FSA-059.exam_trap: Ratio moved because both num and den moved
FSA-059.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-060.reasoning: Reasoning: Inventory turnover = COGS / average inventory. FIFO in rising prices: cheaper units →COGS↓(numerator down) and newer costlier units remain →inventory↑(denominator up). The ratio falls for two reasons at once. Seeing ‘turnover up’ and stopping is the trap.

why_wrong.A: FIFO has older, cheaper COGS, not more current COGS. LIFO has the more current COGS.
why_wrong.C: Cost flow changes both COGS and ending inventory.

FSA-060.zh: 漲價改FIFO：銷貨成本下降、庫存上升，周轉率兩邊都在往下推。不要只看一 邊。
FSA-060.core_idea: FIFO in rising prices lowers turnover twice: COGS down and inventory up
FSA-060.exam_trap: Ratio moved because both num and den moved
FSA-060.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-061.reasoning: Reasoning: LIFO reports higher COGS, lower profit, lower inventory, lower current ratio and working capital, higher inventory turnover, and higher leverage ratios (smaller assets and equity). The quick ratio is unaffected because inventory is not in its numerator. Weighted average sits between FIFO and LIFO.

why_wrong.B: Inventory is not in the quick-ratio numerator, so the quick ratio is unaffected. LIFO has higher, not lower, COGS.
why_wrong.C: Inventory is an asset; smaller inventory and equity raise leverage ratios.

FSA-061.zh: 漲價LIFO：利潤與流動比率較低、周轉與槓桿較高。速動比率不含存貨，不受影 響。
FSA-061.core_idea: LIFO in rising prices: higher COGS, lower profit, inventory, current ratio and WC; higher turnover and leverage; quick ratio unaffected
FSA-061.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-062.reasoning: Reasoning: FIFO still sends earliest costs to COGS. If those earliest costs are higher than recent costs, FIFO COGS is higher and ending inventory (recent, cheaper) is lower. Do not memorize ‘FIFO = low COGS’ without the price direction.

why_wrong.A: FIFO is low-COGS only when older units are cheaper. When prices fall, older units are costlier.
why_wrong.B: The chapter states that in falling prices the signs reverse; cost flow still matters.

FSA-062.zh: 跌價時方向反轉：FIFO 把較貴的舊單位送進銷貨成本。不要背死「FIFO 一定低 COGS」。
FSA-062.core_idea: In falling prices the FIFO/LIFO signs reverse
FSA-062.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-063.reasoning: Reasoning: A LIFO reserve is FIFO inventory minus LIFO inventory. FIFO inventory = 4,200 + 800 = 5,000. Adding the reserve to inventory (and, after tax, to retained earnings) puts a LIFO firm on a FIFO basis. Given: LIFO inventory = 4,200; LIFO reserve = 800. Asked: FIFO inventory. Formula: 4,200 + 800 = 5,000 Variables: Reserve is the inventory gap. Why this formula: Definition rearranges to FIFO = LIFO + reserve. The balance-sheet inventory is understated versus FIFO by the reserve. Reasonableness check: Reserve = 5,000 - 4,200 = 800. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Subtracts the reserve instead of adding it.
why_wrong.C: The chapter’s conversion adds the reserve to inventory.

FSA-063.zh: LIFO reserve = FIFO 庫存- LIFO 庫存。4,200 + 800 = 5,000。不要減。
FSA-063.core_idea: LIFO reserve = FIFO inventory - LIFO inventory; add reserve (after tax, to RE) to put LIFO on FIFO
FSA-063.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-064.reasoning: Reasoning: LIFO COGS minus FIFO COGS equals the change in the LIFO reserve. Subtract that change from LIFO COGS to get FIFO COGS: 9,400 - (640 - 510) = 9,400 - 130 = 9,270. Given: LIFO COGS = 9,400; reserve 510 →640. Asked: FIFO COGS. Formula: 9,400 −(640 −510) = 9,270 Variables: ∆reserve = 130. Why this formula: The reserve increase is extra LIFO COGS versus FIFO. Rising prices plus LIFO, with quantities not liquidating, usually raise the reserve and make LIFO COGS higher. Reasonableness check: LIFO COGS - FIFO COGS = 130 = ∆reserve. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Adds the reserve change instead of subtracting it from LIFO COGS.
why_wrong.C: Subtracts the ending reserve (640) rather than the change (130).

FSA-064.zh: FIFO 銷貨成本= LIFO 銷貨成本- ∆reserve = 9,400 - 130 = 9,270。加回去或扣 整個準備都錯。
FSA-064.core_idea: LIFO COGS - FIFO COGS = change in the LIFO reserve
FSA-064.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-065.reasoning: Reasoning: A LIFO liquidation (quantities fall) pulls old cheap layers into COGS in a rising-price environment: margins jump, and the jump is not sustainable. Footnote decline in the LIFO reserve is the alert. Do not read it as a write-down reversal or as a new sustainable margin.

why_wrong.A: When quantities fall, LIFO no longer sends the most current costs to COGS — it reaches back to old layers.
why_wrong.B: A declining LIFO reserve from liquidation is not an NRV reversal.

FSA-065.zh: 量下降吃到舊便宜層：毛利突然變好，不可持續。準備下降是警訊，不是跌價迴 轉。
FSA-065.core_idea: LIFO liquidation in rising prices pulls old cheap layers into COGS: margins jump unsustainably
FSA-065.exam_trap: Wrong inventory measurement / illegal U.S. GAAP reversal
FSA-065.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-066.reasoning: Reasoning: IFRS (and U.S. GAAP other than LIFO or retail) measures inventory at the lower of cost and net realizable value. NRV = estimated selling price minus direct selling costs. Here NRV = 88 < 100, so write down to 88. Do not drop selling costs and do not import the LIFO market collar. Given: IFRS; cost 100; selling price 92; selling costs 4. Asked: Period-end inventory carrying amount. Formula: min(100, 92 −4) = 88 Variables: NRV = 88. Why this formula: Lower of cost and NRV is the IFRS inventory test. The write-down is typically COGS (or a separate expense) and is non-cash. Reasonableness check: If this were U.S. GAAP LIFO/retail, the test would be lower of cost or market, not this bare NRV comparison. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: NRV is estimated selling price minus direct selling costs.
why_wrong.C: Lower of cost or market with a replacement-cost collar is the U.S. GAAP LIFO/retail rule, not IFRS.

FSA-066.zh: IFRS 用成本與NRV 孰低。NRV = 售價- 直接銷售費用= 88。不要改用market ／重置成本。
FSA-066.core_idea: IFRS (and U.S. GAAP other than LIFO/retail) measures inventory at lower of cost and NRV
FSA-066.formula: NRV = estimated selling price −direct selling costs
FSA-066.exam_trap: Wrong inventory measurement / illegal U.S. GAAP reversal
FSA-066.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-067.reasoning: Reasoning: LIFO and retail inventory under U.S. GAAP use lower of cost or market, with market equal to replacement cost boxed between NRV and NRV minus a normal profit margin. RC 44 is between 40 and 48, so market = 44. Cost 50 > 44 →carry 44. Do not skip the collar and do not use IFRS NRV alone. Given: U.S. GAAP LIFO; cost 50; RC 44; NRV 48; NRV-NPM 40. Asked: Market and carrying amount. Formula: market = 44; min(50, 44) = 44 Variables: Collar [40, 48]. Why this formula: Market is RC unless RC is outside the NRV collar. Wrong measurement rule is the trap, not the arithmetic. Reasonableness check: If RC were 38, market would be floored at 40; if RC were 55, market would be capped at 48. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-067.steps: ①Collar is 40 to 48. RC 44 is inside →market 44. ②Lower of cost 50 and market 44 = 44.

why_wrong.B: IFRS-style bare NRV is not the LIFO/retail U.S. GAAP rule.
why_wrong.C: Market equals replacement cost when RC lies between NRV and NRV - normal profit. The lower bound is a floor for RC, not the automatic answer.

FSA-067.zh: 美國LIFO ／零售：market = 夾在NRV 與NRV-正常毛利之間的重置成本。這 裡44 在40 與48 之間。
FSA-067.core_idea: U.S. GAAP LIFO/retail uses lower of cost or market; market is RC boxed between NRV and NRV minus normal profit
FSA-067.exam_trap: Wrong inventory measurement / illegal U.S. GAAP reversal
FSA-067.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-068.reasoning: Reasoning: IFRS may reverse a write-down, but only up to the original write-down, as a reduction in cost of sales. U.S. GAAP does not reverse inventory write-downs. Copying the U.S. prohibition onto IFRS, or ignoring the cap, is the framework mix-up.

why_wrong.A: The cap is the original write-down. A 45 recovery does not create a 15 unrealized inventory gain above cost.
why_wrong.B: Reversal is an IFRS inventory fact, capped. U.S. GAAP does not reverse inventory write-downs. Do not import the U.S. prohibition onto IFRS.

FSA-068.zh: IFRS 存貨可衝回，上限是原先跌價，作為銷貨成本減少。美國存貨不準衝回。不 要整筆45 都衝，也不要說兩邊都不准。
FSA-068.core_idea: IFRS may reverse a write-down only up to the original write-down, as a reduction in cost of sales
FSA-068.exam_trap: Wrong inventory measurement / illegal U.S. GAAP reversal
FSA-068.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-069.reasoning: Reasoning: U.S. GAAP does not reverse inventory write-downs. Copying IFRS inventory reversal, or copying IFRS PPE revaluation, onto U.S. GAAP inventory is the same framework mix-up the chapter flags.

why_wrong.A: Reversal is IFRS inventory, capped, as a reduction in cost of sales — not U.S. GAAP inventory.
why_wrong.C: PPE revaluation surplus is an IFRS PPE/intangible model, not a U.S. GAAP inventory recovery.

FSA-069.zh: 美國存貨跌價不準衝回。不要把IFRS 存貨衝回或PPE 重估套過來。
FSA-069.core_idea: U.S. GAAP does not reverse inventory write-downs — including when NRV recovers
FSA-069.exam_trap: Wrong inventory measurement / illegal U.S. GAAP reversal
FSA-069.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-070.reasoning: Reasoning: Write-downs increase COGS (or a separate expense), raise activity ratios, and lower NI, gross and operating profit, EBIT, taxable income, working capital, carrying amounts, equity, and profitability, liquidity, and solvency ratios. Revenue, debt, and interest payments are not affected; the charge is non-cash.

why_wrong.B: The charge is non-cash and does not reduce revenue or contractual interest. It reduces inventory (a current asset), so liquidity ratios that include inventory fall; the quick ratio’s numerator excludes inventory.
why_wrong.C: Inventory is in current assets and in the current-ratio numerator; it is not in the quick-ratio numerator. The charge is not cash.

FSA-070.zh: 跌價：費用升、周轉升；利潤、權益、流動與償債比率降。收入、債務、利息現 金不受影響；非現金。
FSA-070.core_idea: Write-down: COGS/expense up, activity ratios up; NI, profits, WC, equity, profitability/liquidity/solvency down; revenue, debt, interest payments unaffected; non-cash
FSA-070.exam_trap: Wrong inventory measurement / illegal U.S. GAAP reversal
FSA-070.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-071.reasoning: Reasoning: Turnover is COGS / average inventory. Write-down →Inventory↓Expense↑(COGS↑) NI↓RE↓Assets↓. Both pieces of the ratio move in the direction that raises it.

why_wrong.A: Lower assets is a balance-sheet/solvency or ROA story, not the definition of inventory turnover.
why_wrong.B: Non-cash is true of the cash flow, not of COGS-based turnover.

FSA-071.zh: 跌價讓銷貨成本上升、庫存下降，周轉率分子分母同時把比率推高。非現金不表 示比率不動。
FSA-071.core_idea: Inventory write-down raises turnover because numerator up and denominator down
FSA-071.exam_trap: Ratio moved because both num and den moved
FSA-071.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-072.reasoning: Reasoning: Agriculture, forest products, minerals, and commodity broker-traders may be marked to NRV (or quoted price in an active market), with changes in profit or loss. That is not a license to mark ordinary merchandise above cost, and it is not PPE revaluation surplus.

why_wrong.A: The chapter lists this mark-to-NRV (or quoted price) path for agriculture, forest products, minerals, and commodity broker-traders.
why_wrong.C: That is the PPE revaluation-surplus model, not commodity inventory.

FSA-072.zh: 商品經紀商等可按NRV ／市價入損益。這是例外，不是普通存貨或PPE 重估盈 餘。
FSA-072.core_idea: Agriculture, forest products, minerals, and commodity broker-traders may mark to NRV through P/L
FSA-072.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-073.reasoning: Reasoning: Adding the reserve to inventory (and, after tax, to retained earnings) puts a LIFO firm on a FIFO basis. Inventory +1,000; DTL (or tax) 300; equity +700. The balance sheet balances. Given: LIFO reserve = 1,000; t = 30%. Asked: After-tax equity increase in a FIFO restatement. Formula: 1,000 × (1 −0.30) = 700 Variables: Inventory gross-up versus tax on the gross-up. Why this formula: The extra inventory was extra pre-tax income under FIFO in prior periods. Leverage falls because assets and equity both rise; equity rises by the after-tax reserve. Reasonableness check: 1,000 - 300 = 700. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-073.steps: ①Inventory↑1,000. ②Tax on the step-up 300 (DTL or payable, as the conversion requires). ③RE / equity↑700.

why_wrong.B: 1,000 ignores the tax on the inventory step-up.
why_wrong.C: 300 is the deferred-tax piece, not the equity piece.

FSA-073.zh: 庫存+1,000，稅300，權益+700。不要把整段準備當權益，也不要把稅當成權 益。
FSA-073.core_idea: After-tax LIFO-to-FIFO equity adjustment uses the reserve times (1 - t)
FSA-073.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-074.reasoning: Reasoning: In rising prices FIFO leaves newer, more expensive units in inventory →higher current assets →higher current ratio and working capital versus LIFO. The current ratio includes inventory; the quick ratio does not. Do not invent an automatic tax-payable offset that reverses the chapter’s direction.

why_wrong.A: The chapter states FIFO has a higher current ratio and working capital. It does not teach that extra tax payable more than offsets the inventory increase as a required outcome.
why_wrong.B: The current ratio is current assets / current liabilities; inventory is in current assets.

FSA-074.zh: 漲價FIFO 期末庫存較高，流動比率與營運資金較高。流動比率含存貨；不要自 行假設稅負債一定把效果沖光。
FSA-074.core_idea: Current ratio rises under FIFO in rising prices because inventory (a current asset) is higher; liabilities are not automatically higher
FSA-074.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-075.reasoning: Reasoning: Copying PPE-impairment reversal rules onto inventory, or copying inventory reversal onto U.S. GAAP, is the framework mix-up. U.S. GAAP: no held-for-use PPE reversal; no inventory write-down reversal. IFRS inventory reversal is capped and is not a U.S. GAAP fact.

why_wrong.A: The chapter forbids both: U.S. GAAP held-for-use impairments are not reversed, and U.S. GAAP does not reverse inventory write-downs. (Held-for-sale PPE is the PPE exception — not this stem.)
why_wrong.C: That pairing is backwards and treats inventory reversal as the U.S. GAAP fact.

FSA-075.zh: 美國：自用PPE 減損不衝回，存貨跌價也不衝回。不要把「價值回來就可以衝」 當成萬能規則。
FSA-075.core_idea: Do not copy PPE-impairment reversal onto U.S. GAAP inventory
FSA-075.exam_trap: Wrong inventory measurement / illegal U.S. GAAP reversal
FSA-075.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-076.reasoning: Reasoning: Write-down →Inventory↓120 →CA 800 →680; CL unchanged at 400. Current ratio 2.00 →1.70. Both the accounting identity and the ratio move. Activity ratios rise; this liquidity ratio falls. Do not apply the turnover story to every ratio. Given: Write-down 120; CA 800; CL 400. Asked: Current-ratio direction and values. Formula: 800/400 = 2.00; 680/400 = 1.70 Variables: Inventory is in CA; not in CL. Why this formula: Same CL, smaller CA. Numerator moved; denominator did not. Still check both sides on every ratio. Reasonableness check: Quick ratio numerator excludes inventory, so it would not move from this write-down. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-076.steps: ①Causality: Inventory↓Expense↑NI↓RE↓Assets↓. CL and debt unchanged. ②CA 800 - 120 = 680. ③Current ratio 680/400 = 1.70 versus 2.00.

why_wrong.B: Liquidity ratios that include inventory fall; the chapter lists liquidity ratios down.
why_wrong.C: Non-cash does not freeze the balance sheet. Inventory is a current asset.

FSA-076.zh: 跌價砍存貨：流動資產下降、流動負債不動，流動比率下降。周轉率上升是另一 個比率。
FSA-076.core_idea: Write-down current ratio: inventory down so current assets down; current liabilities unchanged
FSA-076.exam_trap: Ratio moved because both num and den moved
FSA-076.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-077.reasoning: Reasoning: Weighted average sits between FIFO and LIFO. In rising prices FIFO EI is highest, LIFO EI is lowest, and average is in between.

why_wrong.A: FIFO ending inventory is the most recent costs, so it is highest when prices rise. Averaging cannot exceed that latest-cost layer as a rule of the chapter.
why_wrong.B: IFRS permits FIFO and weighted average, not LIFO; that does not make average equal to LIFO.

FSA-077.zh: 漲價時加權平均的期末庫存在FIFO（最高）與LIFO（最低）之間。
FSA-077.core_idea: Weighted average sits between FIFO and LIFO
FSA-077.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-078.reasoning: Reasoning: NRV is estimated selling price minus direct selling costs, assessed by item or by groups of similar items, every period. Do not substitute replacement cost and do not treat the test as a one-time entry-date measurement.

why_wrong.A: Replacement cost is the U.S. GAAP LIFO/retail market starting point, not IFRS NRV.
why_wrong.C: The chapter defines NRV with the selling-cost subtraction and periodic reassessment.

FSA-078.zh: NRV = 估計售價- 直接銷售費用，按項目或類似組合、每期評估。不是重置成 本。
FSA-078.core_idea: NRV is assessed by item or by groups of similar items, every period
FSA-078.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-079.reasoning: Reasoning: Cost flow: FIFO, LIFO, weighted average, and specific identification. DDB and the treasury-stock method belong to other sections.

why_wrong.B: DDB is a depreciation method for long-lived assets.
why_wrong.C: Treasury-stock is the diluted-EPS method for options and warrants.

FSA-079.zh: 存貨流轉還有個別辨認法。不要把折舊或稀釋EPS 的方法塞進來。
FSA-079.core_idea: Specific identification is a permitted cost-flow method along with FIFO, LIFO, and weighted average
FSA-079.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-080.reasoning: Reasoning: Low DOH / high turnover: tight inventory management, or inadequate stock, or a write-down. High DOH: slow-moving or obsolete goods. The write-down raises turnover for two ratio reasons, so DOH falls even though obsolescence may have been the economic story.

why_wrong.A: Slow-moving goods raise DOH. A write-down can cut DOH even if the goods are still slow — that is why the chapter lists write-down as a low-DOH explanation.
why_wrong.B: Activity ratios use the written-down carrying amount; they are not switched off.

FSA-080.zh: 跌價會讓周轉上升、存貨天數下降。低DOH 不一定是經營變好，可能是減記。
FSA-080.core_idea: Low DOH can mean tight management, inadequate stock, or a write-down
FSA-080.exam_trap: Ratio moved because both num and den moved
FSA-080.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-081.reasoning: Reasoning: Market is replacement cost boxed between NRV and NRV - NPM. RC 68 > NRV 60, so market = 60 (cap). Lower of cost 70 and market 60 = 60. This is the collar-cap angle, different from the interior-RC question. Given: U.S. GAAP retail; cost 70; RC 68; NRV 60; NRV-NPM 52. Asked: Carrying amount. Formula: market = min(60, max(68, 52)) = 60; min(70, 60) = 60 Variables: Collar [52, 60]. Why this formula: RC is not allowed above NRV. Using IFRS-style cost-vs-NRV would also give 60 here, but the path is the market collar, not a reason to forget the collar on other facts. Reasonableness check: If RC were 54, market would be 54 (inside). If RC were 50, market would be 52 (floor). 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-081.steps: ①RC 68 is above the 60 cap →market 60. ②Lower of 70 and 60 = 60.

why_wrong.A: 68 uses uncapped RC. RC is above NRV, so market is capped at 60.
why_wrong.C: 70 is cost; cost exceeds market 60.

FSA-081.zh: 重置成本68 高於NRV 60，market 被蓋在60。成本與market 孰低= 60。
FSA-081.core_idea: U.S. GAAP LIFO market: RC above NRV is capped at NRV
FSA-081.exam_trap: Wrong inventory measurement / illegal U.S. GAAP reversal
FSA-081.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-082.reasoning: Reasoning: Reversal only up to the original write-down (12), restoring cost 40. NRV 46 does not justify carrying 46. U.S. GAAP would have stayed at 28; that is a different framework. Given: IFRS; original cost 40; carrying 28; NRV now 46. Asked: Post-reversal carrying amount. Formula: 28 + 12 = 40 = min(46, 40) Variables: Original write-down = 12. Why this formula: Cap is the original write-down, i.e., original cost. The extra 6 of NRV stays unrecognized. Reasonableness check: U.S. GAAP inventory would remain 28. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-082.steps: ①Allowed reversal = 12, not 18. ②Carrying amount = 40. ③COGS decreases by 12; Inventory↑NI↑RE↑Assets↑— but not above original cost.

why_wrong.B: 46 would recognize 6 above original cost.
why_wrong.C: IFRS allows a capped reversal as a reduction in cost of sales.

FSA-082.zh: IFRS 最多衝回到原成本40，不能衝到46。說不准衝回是美國規則。
FSA-082.core_idea: IFRS inventory recovery cannot take carrying amount above original cost
FSA-082.exam_trap: Wrong inventory measurement / illegal U.S. GAAP reversal

FSA-083.reasoning: Reasoning: Capitalizing a long-lived purchase, versus expensing it immediately, lowers income variability, raises early-year NI, ROA and ROE, raises CFO and lowers CFI (same total cash), and lowers leverage ratios. Later years reverse the income effect once depreciation exceeds what the immediate-expense alternative would have taken this period.

why_wrong.A: Early-year NI is higher under capitalization; leverage falls because assets and equity are higher.
why_wrong.B: Same total cash; only classification (CFI vs CFO) changes.

FSA-083.zh: 資本化：早期NI ／ROA ／ROE 較高，CFO 較高、CFI 較低，槓桿較低；總現 金一樣。後期折舊超過「當年費用化」時，損益方向反轉。
FSA-083.core_idea: Capitalizing a long-lived purchase raises early NI, ROA/ROE, and CFO, lowers CFI and leverage; later years reverse the income effect

FSA-084.reasoning: Reasoning: Capitalizing rather than expensing raises NI and raises assets: early ROA is not ‘profitability improved’ in isolation. A ratio moved because both the numerator and the denominator changed. Compare to the write-down and impairment traps: always check both sides.

why_wrong.A: The chapter’s trap is treating early ROA as a pure profitability improvement. Both sides move.
why_wrong.C: Both sides move the other way from this choice; neither one-sided rule is the teaching.

FSA-084.zh: 資本化讓NI 和資產同時上升，早期ROA 不是單純「獲利變好」。分子分母都動 了。
FSA-084.core_idea: Early ROA after capitalization is not ‘profitability improved’ in isolation: NI and assets both rise

FSA-085.reasoning: Reasoning: Straight-line allocates depreciable basis evenly. DDB applies twice the straight-line rate to carrying amount; salvage is not in the annual calculation, but carrying amount is not taken below salvage. Rate = 2/5 = 40%. Year 1: 0.40 × 10,000 = 4,000. Given: Cost 10,000; salvage 1,000; n = 5; DDB. Asked: Year-1 depreciation. Formula: (2/5) × 10,000 = 4,000 Variables: CA0 = 10,000; salvage is a floor only. Why this formula: DDB ignores salvage in the annual multiplication. Early years: higher depreciation, lower NI, assets, equity, ROA and ROE, higher asset turnover versus straight-line. Reasonableness check: Cash flow is the same if tax depreciation is unchanged. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-085.steps: ①SL rate = 1/5 = 20%; DDB rate = 40%. ②0.40 × 10,000 = 4,000. ③Carrying amount 6,000 > salvage 1,000, so no floor bind.

why_wrong.B: 3,600 wrongly puts salvage in the annual DDB calculation: 2/5 × (10,000 - 1,000).
why_wrong.C: 2,000 is straight-line on depreciable basis: (10,000 - 1,000)/5.

FSA-085.zh: DDB 用帳面乘兩倍直線率，殘值不進每年公式，只當下限。第一年40% × 10,000 = 4,000。
FSA-085.core_idea: DDB applies twice the straight-line rate to carrying amount; salvage is a floor, not in the annual rate

FSA-086.reasoning: Reasoning: Longer useful life or higher salvage lowers periodic depreciation and raises current NI. Estimate changes are prospective. A change in accounting principle is retrospective; an error is a prior-period adjustment.

why_wrong.A: Useful life and salvage are estimate changes, not principle changes, and they are not error restatements.
why_wrong.B: Estimate changes are prospective, not prior-period adjustments.

FSA-086.zh: 拉長年限或提高殘值：本期折舊下降、NI 上升，推延處理。不是原則追溯，也不 是前期錯誤。
FSA-086.core_idea: Longer useful life or higher salvage lowers periodic depreciation and raises current NI; estimate changes are prospective

FSA-087.reasoning: Reasoning: An identifiable intangible is separable or arises from contractual or legal rights, is controlled, is expected to produce probable future economic benefits, and has a reliably measured cost. Finite-life: amortize; review life and method at least annually. Indefinite-life: no amortization; impairment test; review the indefinite-life assumption.

why_wrong.A: Internally generated brands, mastheads, publishing titles, customer lists, startup, training, SG&A, advertising, relocation, and termination costs are expensed.
why_wrong.C: Finite-life intangibles are amortized; indefinite-life intangibles and goodwill are not amortized; they are tested for impairment.

FSA-087.zh: 可辨認無形：可分離或來自合約／法律權利，且可控制、有很可能的效益、成本 能量可靠。內部品牌等費用化；商譽與非確定耐用年限不攤銷。
FSA-087.core_idea: Identifiable intangible: separable or contractual/legal, controlled, probable benefits, reliably measured cost

FSA-088.reasoning: Reasoning: Exception: IFRS capitalizes development (not research) once technological feasibility is met. U.S. GAAP generally expenses internal research and development, with a software exception once technological feasibility is met. Purchased intangibles are capitalized (CFI outflow). Expensing rather than capitalizing raises current CFO outflow, reduces assets and CFI outflow, and reduces NI while current development spending exceeds the amortization that capitalized prior spending would have produced.

why_wrong.B: U.S. GAAP generally expenses internal R&D; the software exception is the stated carve-out. IFRS does not capitalize research.
why_wrong.C: IFRS capitalizes development (not research) once technological feasibility is met.

FSA-088.zh: IFRS：研究費用化，達技術可行性後的開發資本化。美國內部研發原則費用化， 軟體有例外。不要說IFRS 連研究也資本化。
FSA-088.core_idea: IFRS capitalizes development once technological feasibility is met; U.S. GAAP generally expenses internal R&D, with a software exception

FSA-089.reasoning: Reasoning: Goodwill is capitalized, not amortized, and tested annually. An impairment charge lowers current earnings and assets and raises future ROA (smaller denominator). Current ROA is a fight between a smaller numerator and a smaller denominator. Analysts often strip goodwill and its impairment for comparability; they should not automatically strip every identifiable intangible.

why_wrong.A: The impairment is a current-period NI hit. Subsequent periods do not keep reexpensing that loss; they have a smaller asset base.
why_wrong.B: Analysts often strip goodwill and its impairment for comparability; that is an analytical choice, not an automatic restatement of every ROA in the statements.

FSA-089.zh: 商譽減損：今年NI 與資產下降；以後分母變小，未來ROA 上升。今年ROA 則 是分子分母同時變小。
FSA-089.core_idea: Goodwill is capitalized, not amortized, tested annually; impairment lowers current earnings and assets and raises future ROA

FSA-090.reasoning: Reasoning: Under IFRS, an asset is impaired if carrying amount exceeds recoverable amount, the greater of fair value less costs to sell and value in use (PV of remaining cash flows). Recoverable amount = max(420, 455) = 455. Loss = 500 - 455 = 45. Given: IFRS; CA 500; FV-CTS 420; VIU 455. Asked: Impairment loss. Formula: 500 −max(420, 455) = 45 Variables: Recoverable amount is the higher of the two amounts. Why this formula: IFRS compares CA with that higher amount, not with FV alone. Using only exit price overstates the loss by 35. Reasonableness check: U.S. GAAP would next ask about undiscounted cash flows — a different test, not asked here. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-090.steps: ①Recoverable amount = 455. ②455 < 500 →impaired. ③Loss = 45. Causality: Asset↓Expense↑NI↓RE↓Equity↓.

why_wrong.A: 80 uses only FV less costs to sell and ignores value in use.
why_wrong.C: Value in use is an IFRS recoverable-amount input, not a reason to skip the test.

FSA-090.zh: IFRS 可回收金額取「公允價值減出售成本」與「使用價值」較高者： max(420,455)=455，減損45。不要只拿420。
FSA-090.core_idea: IFRS impairment: compare CA with recoverable amount = max(FV - sell costs, value in use)

FSA-091.reasoning: Reasoning: Under U.S. GAAP, first apply a recoverability test: impaired only if carrying amount exceeds undiscounted expected cash flows. If that test fails, write down to fair value. Here 300 > 280, so no impairment. Held-for-use impairments are not reversed. Given: U.S. GAAP held-for-use; CA 280; undiscounted CF 300; FV 220. Asked: Whether a U.S. GAAP impairment is recorded. Formula: 300 > 280 ⇒no loss Variables: Recoverability is undiscounted. Why this formula: Step 2 (write down to FV) exists only if step 1 fails. IFRS could still impair using recoverable amount 230 (loss 50) — a framework contrast, not this choice set. Reasonableness check: If undiscounted CF were 250, U.S. GAAP loss would be 280 - 220 = 60. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-091.steps: ①Compare 280 with 300. ②CA < undiscounted CF →stop. ③No loss.

why_wrong.B: The recoverability test failed to trigger (undiscounted CF exceed CA). Do not jump to step 2.
why_wrong.C: That imports the IFRS measurement (recoverable amount 230; loss 50) and also skips the U.S. gate.

FSA-091.zh: 美國先比未折現現金流：300 > 280 就沒有減損，不會走到按公允價值減記。
FSA-091.core_idea: U.S. GAAP: impaired only if CA exceeds undiscounted expected cash flows; then write down to fair value
FSA-091.study_section: Long-Lived Assets and Intangibles ｜長期資產與無形資產
FSA-091.formula: U.S. GAAP impaired only if CA > undiscounted CF

FSA-092.reasoning: Reasoning: IFRS recoverable amount = max(300, 320) = 320; loss = 360 - 320 = 40. U.S. GAAP: 360 > 340, so impaired; write down to fair value 305; loss = 55. Reversal later: IFRS allowed up to pre-impairment CA; U.S. GAAP held-for-use not reversed. Given: CA 360; FV-CTS 300; VIU 320; undiscounted CF 340; FV 305. Asked: IFRS loss and U.S. GAAP loss. Formula: 360 −320 = 40; 360 −305 = 55 Variables: Two different tests. Why this formula: IFRS uses discounted recoverable amount; U.S. GAAP uses an undiscounted gate then FV. Same mill, different losses, because the tests differ. Reasonableness check: If undiscounted CF were 400, U.S. GAAP loss would be 0 while IFRS would still be 40. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-092.steps: ①IFRS RA = 320; loss 40. ②U.S. GAAP 360 > 340 →impair; 360 - 305 = 55. ③Causality under both: Asset↓Expense↑NI↓RE↓; future depreciation may fall.

why_wrong.A: U.S. GAAP undiscounted CF 340 < 360, so the asset is impaired and written to FV 305: loss 55. ‘No impairment’ would require undiscounted CF above CA.
why_wrong.B: IFRS recoverable amount is max(300, 320) = 320, loss 40, not 60 (which uses only FV-CTS).

FSA-092.zh: IFRS 減損40（對320）。美國未折現340 < 360，減記到305，損失55。不要用 錯門檻。
FSA-092.core_idea: IFRS vs U.S. GAAP impairment on one asset: recoverable amount versus undiscounted gate
FSA-092.study_section: Long-Lived Assets and Intangibles ｜長期資產與無形資產
FSA-092.formula: IFRS : CA −max(FV −CTS, VIU); US : gate then CA −FV
FSA-092.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-093.reasoning: Reasoning: The loss is carrying amount minus recoverable amount. Reversal is allowed if recoverable amount recovers, but only up to the pre-impairment carrying amount (no revaluation through the impairment door). Subsequent depreciation is based on the new carrying amount.

why_wrong.A: 230 would use the impairment door as a revaluation model.
why_wrong.C: IFRS allows reversal if recoverable amount recovers, with the pre-impairment cap. (Inventory reversal is a separate capped COGS rule; this stem is PPE-style impairment.)

FSA-093.zh: IFRS 減損可衝回，但不能超過減損前帳面，也不能借減損之路做重估。
FSA-093.core_idea: IFRS impairment reversal allowed only up to pre-impairment carrying amount; no revaluation through the impairment door

FSA-094.reasoning: Reasoning: Held-for-sale: reclassify out of PPE, stop depreciation and amortization, and write down if carrying amount exceeds fair value minus cost to sell. U.S. GAAP held-for-use impairments are not reversed. Held-for-sale assets may be reversed if fair value recovers. U.S. GAAP does not revalue upward, except held-for-sale recoveries limited to prior write-downs.

why_wrong.B: HFS is not a label-only change: depreciation stops and a FV-CTS ceiling applies.
why_wrong.C: Reclassification does not, in the chapter, create an automatic write-up of old held-for-use losses without the HFS test.

FSA-094.zh: 待出售：停止折舊，按公允價值減出售成本檢視。美國自用減損不衝回；待出售 可以在原減記範圍內衝回。
FSA-094.core_idea: Held-for-sale: reclassify out of PPE, stop depreciation, write down if CA > FV - cost to sell; U.S. GAAP HFS may reverse

FSA-095.reasoning: Reasoning: Carrying amount = cost - accumulated depreciation - prior impairments = 80 - 50 - 5 = 25. Sale gain or loss = proceeds - CA = 18 - 25 = -7. Abandonment is the same with zero proceeds (loss 25). Exchange uses fair value unless it cannot be measured, in which case use carrying amount of the asset given up (no gain or loss). Given: Cost 80; accum. dep 50; prior impairments 5; proceeds 18. Asked: Gain or loss on sale. Formula: 18 −(80 −50 −5) = −7 Variables: CA = 25. Why this formula: The unamortized net book value is what leaves the balance sheet. Indirect CFO adds back the 7 loss so the sale cash can sit in CFI. Reasonableness check: Abandonment would lose the full 25. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-095.steps: ①CA = 25. ②18 - 25 = -7. ③Causality: Asset 25 out; cash 18 in; loss 7 hits NI; CFI gets the 18 cash.

why_wrong.A: Sign reversed: proceeds 18 versus CA 25 is a loss.
why_wrong.B: 62 uses cost minus proceeds and ignores accumulated depreciation and impairments.

FSA-095.zh: 帳面80-50-5=25，售價18，損失7。不要用成本減售價。
FSA-095.core_idea: Derecognition gain or loss = proceeds minus carrying amount; abandonment is the same with zero proceeds

FSA-096.reasoning: Reasoning: IFRS permits a revaluation model for PPE and, if an active market exists, for intangibles. Increases that reverse a prior charge go through income; the excess is OCI (revaluation surplus). Subsequent depreciation is based on the new carrying amount. U.S. GAAP does not revalue upward, except held-for-sale recoveries limited to prior write-downs.

why_wrong.A: Only the reversal of a prior income charge goes through income; the excess is surplus.
why_wrong.C: U.S. GAAP does not revalue upward, except held-for-sale recoveries limited to prior write-downs.

FSA-096.zh: IFRS 重估：先把以前進損益的減項衝回損益，多出來的進OCI。美國原則不上調 （待出售有限度例外）。
FSA-096.core_idea: IFRS revaluation: reversing a prior charge goes through income; the excess is OCI surplus; U.S. GAAP does not revalue upward except limited HFS recoveries
FSA-096.study_section: Long-Lived Assets and Intangibles ｜長期資產與無形資產

FSA-097.reasoning: Reasoning: Investment property (IFRS only) held for rent or appreciation may use a fair-value model in which increases go through income — unlike PPE revaluation surplus. Do not dump every IFRS building into OCI surplus.

why_wrong.B: The chapter contrasts investment-property FV-through-income with PPE revaluation surplus.
why_wrong.C: Investment property is IFRS only in this chapter’s telling, and the FV model is allowed.

FSA-097.zh: 投資性不動產（僅IFRS）公允價值增加進損益，和PPE 重估盈餘進OCI 不同。
FSA-097.core_idea: Investment property (IFRS only) fair-value model puts increases through income — unlike PPE revaluation surplus

FSA-097.exam_trap: Mixing investment-property FV-through-income with PPE revaluation surplus
FSA-097.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
