FSA-098.reasoning: Reasoning: Impairment is a non-cash charge: the asset’s recoverable / economic value has fallen below the relevant carrying-value threshold. An impairment may reveal that earlier depreciation assumptions were too optimistic, but that is not necessarily the cause. Subsequent depreciation or amortization may fall because the carrying amount is now lower, so later margins can look better on a smaller base.

why_wrong.A: Impairment is a non-cash charge.
why_wrong.B: The carrying amount is lower, so the remaining depreciable amount is typically lower, not higher.

FSA-098.zh: 減損是非現金。以後折舊可能變小，利潤率在較小的帳面上看起來比較好看—— 那是分母／折舊基數變了。
FSA-098.core_idea: Impairment is non-cash; later depreciation may fall so later margins can look better on a smaller base

FSA-099.reasoning: Reasoning: Impairment lowers current NI and lowers assets: current ROA is a fight between a smaller numerator and a smaller denominator; future ROA rises on the smaller base. Always ask whether both parts of the ratio moved.

why_wrong.A: If the loss is large enough, NI can fall more than assets and ROA can still drop this year. The trap is ignoring one side, not a mandated rise.
why_wrong.C: The current charge hits this year’s NI. Future ROA rises on the smaller base; current ROA is the fight.

FSA-099.zh: 今年減損：NI 下降、資產也下降，當年ROA 要兩邊一起看。以後才確定在較小 分母上變高。
FSA-099.core_idea: Current ROA after impairment: smaller NI and smaller assets — a fight, not an automatic decline

FSA-100.reasoning: Reasoning: In a business combination, identifiable assets and liabilities are marked to fair value; residual purchase price is goodwill. U.S. GAAP requires the item to be contractual/legal or separable. Goodwill is capitalized, not amortized, and tested annually.

why_wrong.B: Goodwill is capitalized, not immediately expensed, in the chapter’s combination model.
why_wrong.C: Goodwill is not amortized; finite-life intangibles are.

FSA-100.zh: 合併價差殘額是商譽：資本化、不攤銷、每年測減損。美國的可辨認項目要有合 約／法律權利或可分離。
FSA-100.core_idea: In a business combination, identifiable items are marked to FV; residual is goodwill; U.S. GAAP requires contractual/legal or separable

FSA-101.reasoning: Reasoning: In early years, accelerated methods mean higher depreciation, lower NI, assets, equity, ROA and ROE, and higher asset turnover; cash flow is the same if tax depreciation is unchanged. Asset turnover rises because the denominator (assets) is smaller — another both-sides check versus the NI decline.

why_wrong.A: Accelerated methods take more depreciation early, which lowers NI and ROA; they are not income-increasing.
why_wrong.B: Depreciation is non-cash. Cash changes only if tax depreciation changes.

FSA-101.zh: 早期加速折舊：費用高、NI ／資產／ROA 低、資產周轉高。稅務折舊不變則現 金不變。
FSA-101.core_idea: Early-year accelerated depreciation: higher dep, lower NI/assets/equity/ROA/ROE, higher asset turnover; cash same if tax dep unchanged

FSA-102.reasoning: Reasoning: Units-of-production follows use. Depreciation = 30,000 × 8,000/100,000 = 2,400. Straight-line would ignore the low-use year. Method choice changes the NI path; total depreciable amount over the life is the same if salvage and life/use estimates hold. Given: Basis 30,000; total 100,000 km; this year 8,000 km. Asked: This year’s UOP depreciation. Formula: 30,000 × 8,000/100,000 = 2,400 Variables: Use fraction = 8%. Why this formula: Cost follows consumption of service potential. A parked truck takes little UOP depreciation; SL would still take a full year. Reasonableness check: After 100,000 km the whole 30,000 has been allocated. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: A five-year straight-line amount is a different method. The chapter lists UOP as following use.
why_wrong.C: UOP allocates depreciable basis by use, not the entire basis in year 1.

FSA-102.zh: 生產數量法跟使用量：30,000 × 8% = 2,400。不要改用直線或一次提完。
FSA-102.core_idea: Units-of-production follows use; a low-use year has lower depreciation than straight-line on the same basis
FSA-102.study_section: Long-Lived Assets and Intangibles ｜長期資產與無形資產
FSA-102.formula: UOP = depreciable basis × (units this period/total units)
FSA-102.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-103.reasoning: Reasoning: Internally generated brands and advertising are expensed. Expensing rather than capitalizing raises current CFO outflow, reduces assets and CFI outflow, and reduces NI while current development/brand spending exceeds the amortization that capitalized prior spending would have produced. Purchased intangibles are capitalized (CFI outflow).

why_wrong.B: Purchased intangibles are capitalized (CFI). Internally generated brands and advertising are expensed (CFO).
why_wrong.C: Advertising is in the expensed list, not a capitalized identifiable internally generated brand.

FSA-103.zh: 自創品牌／廣告：費用化，CFO 流出較大、資產較小。外購品牌：資本化，現金 在CFI。
FSA-103.core_idea: Expensing internal brands raises current CFO outflow versus capitalizing a purchased brand (CFI)

FSA-104.reasoning: Reasoning: Fixed-asset turnover = net revenue / average net PPE. A low ratio is capital intensity or a young asset base (less accumulated depreciation, higher carrying amount). Total asset turnover = revenue / average assets, the DuPont turnover term. Older assets may be less competitive and closer to a capex wave — that is the PPE-age section, which uses accumulated depreciation / annual depreciation.

why_wrong.A: A fully depreciated (old) base has a smaller carrying amount and would tend to raise, not lower, this turnover. The chapter’s age story for a low ratio is a young base.
why_wrong.B: Fixed-asset turnover = net revenue / average net PPE, not the inventory-turnover formula.

FSA-104.zh: 固定資產周轉低：可能真的資本密集，也可能資產很新、累計折舊少、分母大。 舊資產分母小，周轉反而容易偏高。
FSA-104.core_idea: Low fixed-asset turnover can mean capital intensity or a young asset base (less accumulated depreciation)

FSA-105.reasoning: Reasoning: Amortized cost under IFRS 9: debt that meets the contractual-cash-flow tests and is held in a hold-to-collect business model. Equity is not amortized cost. The core box: do not put unlisted shares into amortized cost because fair value is hard to estimate.

why_wrong.A: Unlisted equity cannot be put in amortized cost because fair value is hard to estimate. Equity is not amortized cost.
why_wrong.C: Amortized cost remains for qualifying hold-to-collect debt.

FSA-105.zh: IFRS 9 攤銷後成本只給符合合約現金流、且是hold-to-collect 的債。股票不能因 為不好估就放進攤銷後成本。
FSA-105.core_idea: IFRS 9 amortized cost is hold-to-collect debt that meets contractual-cash-flow tests; equity is never amortized cost
FSA-105.exam_trap: Putting equity into IFRS 9 amortized cost
FSA-105.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-106.reasoning: Reasoning: U.S. GAAP amortized cost: HTM debt; loans and notes. Equity is not amortized cost. All equity securities are FVTPL. Available-for-sale is a debt category in the chapter’s U.S. GAAP column.

why_wrong.B: U.S. GAAP: all equity securities are FVTPL. Not-for-near-term is not an amortized-cost election.
why_wrong.C: Strategic labeling does not create an amortized-cost equity category.

FSA-106.zh: 美國攤銷後成本：持有至到期債、放款與票據。權益不是，全部走FVTPL。
FSA-106.core_idea: U.S. GAAP amortized cost: HTM debt, loans and notes; equity is not amortized cost
FSA-106.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-107.reasoning: Reasoning: FVOCI debt under IFRS 9: debt that meets the relevant contractual-cash-flow tests and is held to collect and sell. U.S. GAAP analog in the table: available-for-sale debt. Amortized cost needs hold-to-collect. FVTPL is residual/default.

why_wrong.A: Hold-to-collect (not collect-and-sell) is the amortized-cost business model.
why_wrong.B: FVTPL is the residual/default, not the designated collect-and-sell debt category.

FSA-107.zh: IFRS 9 債的FVOCI：通過合約現金流測試，且商業模式是收取與出售。不是 hold-to-collect，也不是自動交易帳。
FSA-107.core_idea: IFRS 9 FVOCI debt: contractual-cash-flow tests and hold-to-collect-and-sell
FSA-107.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-108.reasoning: Reasoning: FVOCI equity: eligible equity not held for trading; irrevocable election at initial recognition. Dividends generally to P/L; accumulated OCI is not recycled to P/L on disposal. That irrevocable election is FVOCI equity, not a label hung under FVTPL. It is not a U.S. GAAP category.

why_wrong.A: The chapter is explicit: accumulated OCI is not recycled to P/L on disposal for the equity FVOCI election.
why_wrong.C: Disposal does not create an amortized-cost equity category.

FSA-108.zh: IFRS 9 權益FVOCI：一開始不可撤銷選擇；股利一般進損益；處分時OCI 不轉 回損益。美國沒有這個類別。
FSA-108.core_idea: IFRS 9 equity FVOCI is an irrevocable election at initial recognition for eligible non-trading equity; OCI is not recycled
FSA-108.exam_trap: Recycling IFRS 9 equity FVOCI into P/L on sale
FSA-108.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-109.reasoning: Reasoning: Under U.S. GAAP, all equity securities are at FVTPL. Unrealized holding changes at fair value through P/L hit earnings (and therefore retained earnings).

why_wrong.B: OCI would describe an IFRS 9 equity FVOCI election — which is not U.S. GAAP and is not automatic even under IFRS.
why_wrong.C: Amortized cost is not the listed-equity model under IFRS 9 or U.S. GAAP.

FSA-109.zh: 美國上市股票：未實現損益進損益。不要用IFRS 的FVOCI 選擇或攤銷後成本去 答。
FSA-109.core_idea: U.S. GAAP listed equity: unrealized holding gains and losses in P/L, even if not held for nearterm sale
FSA-109.exam_trap: Treating U.S. GAAP equity as AFS/OCI or amortized cost
FSA-109.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-110.reasoning: Reasoning: FVTPL is residual/default. Trading equity is FVTPL. Other equity is FVTPL unless the eligible FVOCI election is made. U.S. GAAP FVTPL column: all equity securities; held-fortrading debt.

why_wrong.A: Long-term intent does not create amortized-cost equity.
why_wrong.B: FVOCI equity is an eligible irrevocable election at initial recognition, not an automatic unlisted default.

FSA-110.zh: FVTPL 是剩餘／預設。交易目的權益走FVTPL；其他權益除非一開始選了 FVOCI，否則也是FVTPL。
FSA-110.core_idea: FVTPL is residual/default; trading equity is FVTPL; other IFRS equity is FVTPL unless the eligible FVOCI election is made
FSA-110.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-111.reasoning: Reasoning: Unrealized holding changes at fair value through OCI bypass net income and sit in equity. Unrealized holding changes at fair value through P/L hit earnings (and therefore retained earnings). Interest income, and dividends when they are recognized in profit or loss, go through the income statement.

why_wrong.A: FVTPL unrealized changes hit P/L. FVOCI unrealized holding changes at fair value through OCI bypass NI.
why_wrong.C: Fair-value positions are on the balance sheet; OCI or RE is the equity home.

FSA-111.zh: FVOCI 未實現進OCI（權益），不進NI。FVTPL 未實現進損益與保留盈餘。利 息／已認列股利仍走損益。
FSA-111.core_idea: Unrealized FV through OCI bypasses NI and sits in equity; unrealized FV through P/L hits earnings and RE
FSA-111.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-112.reasoning: Reasoning: Realized gains and losses on amortized-cost and FVTPL instruments go through profit or loss. Accumulated OCI on an equity FVOCI election is not subsequently recycled — that is a different category. Derivatives used as trading instruments are treated as trading.

why_wrong.B: The chapter puts realized gains and losses on amortized-cost and FVTPL instruments through P/L.
why_wrong.C: There is no ‘skip P/L into RE’ rule for these realized amounts.

FSA-112.zh: 攤銷後成本與FVTPL 的已實現損益進損益。不要和權益FVOCI「不回收」搞混。
FSA-112.core_idea: Realized gains and losses on amortized-cost and FVTPL instruments go through P/L
FSA-112.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-113.reasoning: Reasoning: Fair value is the price received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction. Amortized cost is the amount initially recognized, minus principal repayments, plus or minus amortization of discount or premium, minus impairment.

why_wrong.A: That is the chapter’s fair-value definition.
why_wrong.B: Fair value and amortized cost are different subsequent-measurement bases.

FSA-113.zh: 攤銷後成本是初始金額- 還本± 折溢價攤銷- 減損。不是脫手價。
FSA-113.core_idea: Amortized cost = amount initially recognized - principal repayments ± amortization of discount/premium - impairment
FSA-113.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-114.reasoning: Reasoning: OCI also accumulates foreign-currency translation adjustments, unrealized gains and losses on qualifying hedges, and certain post-retirement remeasurements. Do not park ordinary interest and dividends there by default.

why_wrong.A: Interest income and dividends (when in P/L) go through the income statement.
why_wrong.C: OCI is equity / comprehensive income, not a cash-flow classification.

FSA-114.zh: OCI 還有外幣換算、符合條件的避險未實現、部分退休金再衡量。利息與股利預 設不是OCI。
FSA-114.core_idea: OCI also accumulates FX translation, qualifying-hedge unrealized G/L, and certain postretirement remeasurements
FSA-114.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-115.reasoning: Reasoning: FVOCI — equity is an IFRS 9 eligible irrevocable election and is not a U.S. GAAP category. U.S. GAAP: all equity securities at FVTPL. Wanting smoother earnings does not create the category.

why_wrong.B: The table marks FVOCI equity as not a U.S. GAAP category.
why_wrong.C: Unlisted equity is still not amortized cost, and U.S. GAAP equity is still FVTPL.

FSA-115.zh: 美國沒有權益FVOCI。想降低波動不能自己選進OCI；上市或未上市權益都是 FVTPL。
FSA-115.core_idea: U.S. GAAP has no equity FVOCI category
FSA-115.exam_trap: Treating U.S. GAAP equity as AFS/OCI or amortized cost
FSA-115.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-116.reasoning: Reasoning: Eligible equity not held for trading: irrevocable election at initial recognition. The core box: that irrevocable choice is FVOCI equity, not a label you hang under FVTPL later. Trading equity is FVTPL.

why_wrong.A: Ending trading intent does not create a retroactive FVOCI election.
why_wrong.B: Equity is not amortized cost, and the election is not a two-step recategorization through amortized cost.

FSA-116.zh: 權益FVOCI 要在初始認列時就做、且不可撤銷。不能今年交易、明年再改掛 FVOCI。
FSA-116.core_idea: FVOCI equity election must be at initial recognition and is irrevocable; it is not a later FVTPL add-on
FSA-116.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-117.reasoning: Reasoning: Interest income, and dividends when they are recognized in profit or loss, go through the income statement. Unrealized holding changes at FV through OCI bypass NI. Do not let the OCI label swallow contractual interest.

why_wrong.A: The FVOCI label is about unrealized fair-value holding changes, not about stripping interest from P/L.
why_wrong.C: Interest received may be CFO or CFI under IFRS, but that is classification of cash, not a rule that interest income skips the income statement.

FSA-117.zh: FVOCI 債的利息收入仍進損益；進OCI 的是未實現公允價值變動。現金分類是 另一件事。
FSA-117.core_idea: Interest income goes through the income statement even when the instrument is FVOCI
FSA-117.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-118.reasoning: Reasoning: The table: FVOCI debt under IFRS 9 aligns with available-for-sale debt under U.S. GAAP. Equity AFS is not the U.S. GAAP category in this teaching. HTM is amortized cost.

why_wrong.B: All equity securities are the U.S. GAAP FVTPL line, not AFS.
why_wrong.C: HTM debt / loans and notes are the amortized-cost line.

FSA-118.zh: 這章美國欄的AFS 是債，不是股票。股票在FVTPL；HTM 在攤銷後成本。
FSA-118.core_idea: U.S. GAAP AFS is a debt category in the chapter table, not equity
FSA-118.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-119.reasoning: Reasoning: Derivatives used as trading instruments are treated as trading. Qualifying hedges can put unrealized gains and losses in OCI — that is a different fact, listed under what OCI accumulates.

why_wrong.A: Contractual cash flows plus hold-to-collect is the debt amortized-cost test, not a derivatives-as-trading rule.
why_wrong.B: FVOCI equity is an eligible share election, not the trading-derivative model.

FSA-119.zh: 交易目的衍生性商品當交易（走交易／FVTPL 邏輯）。符合條件的避險才可能進 OCI。
FSA-119.core_idea: Trading derivatives are treated as trading (FVTPL-type)
FSA-119.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-120.reasoning: Reasoning: Unrealized FVTPL hits earnings and retained earnings. Unrealized FVOCI bypasses NI and sits in equity. Equity FVOCI OCI is not recycled on disposal. Same 70 shock, different NI, same direction for equity (down), different equity bucket.

why_wrong.A: FVOCI equity holding changes bypass NI. FVTPL does not.
why_wrong.C: Fair-value assets are remeasured on the balance sheet; equity moves via RE or OCI.

FSA-120.zh: 同一筆未實現下跌：FVTPL 打NI；FVOCI 權益只打OCI。權益都下降，但盈餘 品質含義不同。
FSA-120.core_idea: FVTPL unrealized loss lowers NI, RE, and equity; FVOCI unrealized loss lowers OCI/equity but not NI
FSA-120.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-121.reasoning: Reasoning: IFRS 16 uses a single on-balance-sheet lessee model. The lessee normally recognizes a ROU asset and a lease liability at the PV of future payments. IFRS lessees do not keep a U.S. GAAP-style operating-versus-finance classification for recognized leases. Do not call every termover-one-year contract a finance lease.

why_wrong.B: IFRS 16 puts recognized leases on the balance sheet. Off-balance-sheet is the exemption path (short-term / low-value), not ‘term > 1 year →operating.’
why_wrong.C: The chapter: IFRS lessees do not keep a U.S. GAAP-style operating-versus-finance classification for recognized leases. Subsequent expense resembles finance-lease expense; that is not the same as labeling every long lease ‘finance lease.’

FSA-121.zh: IFRS 16 承租人是單一上表：ROU 資產+ 租賃負債。不是把超過一年的合約一律 叫做finance lease，也不是長約還能當operating 藏在表外。
FSA-121.core_idea: IFRS 16 is a single on-balance-sheet lessee model: ROU asset + lease liability at PV of future payments
FSA-121.exam_trap: Calling every IFRS 16 recognized lease a classified finance lease
FSA-121.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-122.reasoning: Reasoning: Recognition exemptions include short-term leases (generally 12 months or less) and leases of low-value underlying assets. Those are the off-model paths. Everything else that is a lease is normally on balance sheet.

why_wrong.A: ‘Substantially all’ of fair value is a lessor/classification indicator, not the lessee recognition exemption.
why_wrong.B: IFRS 16 did not keep U.S. GAAP-style operating classification for recognized lessee leases.

FSA-122.zh: 豁免：短期（一般12 個月或以內）與低價值標的。不是「PV 不到100%」或「美 國operating 自動豁免」。
FSA-122.core_idea: IFRS 16 recognition exemptions: short-term (generally 12 months or less) and low-value underlying assets
FSA-122.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-123.reasoning: Reasoning: Interest expense = opening liability × discount rate = 8,000 × 0.05 = 400. Principal reduction = payment - interest = 600. ROU asset is amortized, usually straight-line, as depreciation. Income statement: interest and amortization are separate. Cash: principal is a CFF outflow; interest follows the interest-paid classification (CFO, or CFF under IFRS). Given: Opening liability 8,000; r = 5%; payment 1,000. Asked: Interest and principal reduction. Formula: 8,000 × 0.05 = 400; 1,000 −400 = 600 Variables: Finance-style subsequent accounting. Why this formula: The liability accretes then is reduced by the cash payment. Early-year interest + depreciation typically exceeds the cash payment — the finance-style NI pattern. Reasonableness check: Payment is never CFI under the chapter’s lease teaching. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-123.steps: ①Interest 400 →expense↑NI↓; liability accretes to 8,400 before payment. ②Cash 1,000: 400 interest (CFO or CFF under IFRS), 600 principal (CFF). ③Liability ends at 7,400. ROU amortization is a separate depreciation amount.

why_wrong.A: A single rent-expense equal to the payment is U.S. GAAP operating presentation, not recognized IFRS 16 subsequent accounting.
why_wrong.C: Principal is CFF, not CFI. Interest follows the interest-paid classification (CFO, or CFF under IFRS).

FSA-123.zh: 利息8,000×5%=400，本金600。本金現金在CFF，不是CFI。不要整筆當租金 費用。
FSA-123.core_idea: Subsequent IFRS 16 / finance-style: interest = opening liability × rate; principal = payment - interest; ROU usually SL; principal is CFF
FSA-123.formula: Interest = opening liability × r; principal = payment −interest
FSA-123.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-124.reasoning: Reasoning: U.S. GAAP still labels lessee leases operating or finance. Shared contrast versus a finance lease of the same payments: operating records a single rent expense equal to the periodic payment and classifies the cash as CFO, so CFO is lower and CFF is higher; finance splits interest and amortization and puts the principal portion in CFF, so early-year NI is lower (interest plus depreciation exceeds the payment). Total cash over the life is the same. The stem is a presentation contrast, not a claim that IFRS lessees still classify operating versus finance.

why_wrong.B: Separate interest and amortization is the finance (and recognized IFRS 16) subsequent pattern.
why_wrong.C: Principal in CFF is the finance cash-flow split.

FSA-124.zh: Operating：一筆租金、現金全在CFO →CFO 較低、CFF 較高。Finance：拆利 息與折舊、本金進CFF，早期NI 較低。
FSA-124.core_idea: U.S. GAAP operating vs finance, same payments: operating = one rent expense, all cash in CFO (CFO lower, CFF higher); finance splits, principal in CFF, lower early NI
FSA-124.exam_trap: Swapping operating and finance lease cash-flow presentation
FSA-124.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-125.reasoning: Reasoning: Early-year NI is lower under finance presentation because interest plus depreciation exceeds the payment: 140 versus 120. Later years reverse as interest (on a falling liability) shrinks. Total cash over the life is the same; year-1 NI is not. Given: Payment 120; interest 50; amortization 90. Asked: Year-1 NI versus operating presentation. Formula: (50 + 90) −120 = 20 Variables: Operating expense = 120. Why this formula: Two expenses versus one rent equal to cash. CFO is higher under finance if principal is in CFF; that is a classification story layered on the NI story. Reasonableness check: 50 + 90 - 120 = 20. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-125.steps: ①Finance expense 140. ②Operating expense 120. ③NI lower by 20 under finance.

why_wrong.A: Finance-style front-loads expense; it does not defer it in year 1.
why_wrong.B: Same total cash over the life does not equal same year-1 accrual expense.

FSA-125.zh: 早期利息+ 折舊140 > 租金120，finance 的NI 較低20。總現金相同̸= 當年損 益相同。
FSA-125.core_idea: Finance-style early NI is lower because interest plus depreciation exceeds the payment
FSA-125.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-126.reasoning: Reasoning: The discount rate is the rate implicit in the lease, or the lessee’s estimated secured borrowing rate. Motives for leasing include lower cash outlay, secured-borrowing rates, and transferring obsolescence risk — that is why the fallback rate is a secured borrowing rate, not a pension rate.

why_wrong.A: The chapter does not replace the lease rate with Treasuries.
why_wrong.C: The high-quality corporate bond rate discounts the defined-benefit obligation, not the lease liability.

FSA-126.zh: 租賃折現：隱含利率，或承租人估計的擔保借款利率。不要用公債或退休金的高 品質公司債利率。
FSA-126.core_idea: Discount rate is the rate implicit in the lease, or the lessee’s estimated secured borrowing rate
FSA-126.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-127.reasoning: Reasoning: The lease transfers substantially all risks and rewards when indicators such as ownership transfer, a reasonably certain purchase option, major part of remaining economic life, PV representing substantially all of FV, or a specialized asset with no alternative use to the lessor are present. Anything else is an operating lease for that classification.

why_wrong.B: The chapter’s trap language: substantially all is not 100% or more.
why_wrong.C: Indicators include major part of remaining economic life and several others; 50% is not the stated test.

FSA-127.zh: 「幾乎全部」不是「至少100%」。美國實務曾用75% 年限、90% 公允價值；IFRS 出租人看同一套經濟，沒有那些硬線。
FSA-127.core_idea: Classification indicators: ownership transfer, reasonably certain purchase option, major part of life, PV substantially all of FV, specialized asset — not 100%
FSA-127.exam_trap: Reading ‘substantially all’ as 100% of fair value
FSA-127.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-128.reasoning: Reasoning: Lessor accounting still splits. Finance lease: the underlying asset is derecognized and replaced by a lease receivable (and residual). A manufacturer-lessor may recognize selling profit at inception; interest income is then recognized. Operating lease: the asset stays, depreciation continues, lease receipts are revenue, and there is no interest income because the contract is not treated as financing.

why_wrong.A: That is the operating-lessor pattern.
why_wrong.B: The single on-balancesheet model is a lessee model. Lessor accounting still splits.

FSA-128.zh: 出租人finance：資產下表、出現應收，製造商可能認銷售利益，之後認利息。 Operating：資產留著、折舊繼續、租金當收入。
FSA-128.core_idea: Lessor finance: derecognize the asset, recognize a receivable (and residual); manufacturer-lessor may recognize selling profit
FSA-128.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-129.reasoning: Reasoning: Operating lease: the asset stays, depreciation continues, lease receipts are revenue, and there is no interest income because the contract is not treated as financing. That is the split the chapter still requires on the lessor side.

why_wrong.A: Interest income is the finance-lessor subsequent pattern.
why_wrong.C: Selling profit at inception is a finance manufacturer-lessor possibility, not an operating each-period rule.

FSA-129.zh: Operating 出租人：租金是收入、折舊繼續、沒有利息收入。不要把每筆租金當放 貸利息。
FSA-129.core_idea: Operating lessor: asset stays, depreciation continues, receipts are revenue, no interest income
FSA-129.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-130.reasoning: Reasoning: A lease conveys the right to use an identified asset in exchange for a fee, and the customer can direct the use and obtain the economic benefits. The lessee is the user (borrower); the lessor is the owner (lender). Motives for leasing rather than buying include lower cash outlay, secured-borrowing rates, and transferring obsolescence risk.

why_wrong.B: No identified asset means it is not this chapter’s lease.
why_wrong.C: Secured borrowing may be a motive comparison, but the definition still needs an identified asset and the right to direct use.

FSA-130.zh: 租賃要有已辨認資產，且客戶能主導使用、取得經濟效益。不是任何長期服務或 任何擔保借款。
FSA-130.core_idea: A lease conveys the right to use an identified asset; the customer directs use and obtains the economic benefits
FSA-130.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-131.reasoning: Reasoning: Interest expense is beginning carrying amount times the market rate at issuance: 9,600 × 0.05 = 480. A discount raises interest expense above the coupon (the cash coupon is smaller, so CFO is higher than for a par bond). The cash coupon 400 versus expense 480 amortizes 80 of discount onto the carrying amount. Given: CA 9,600; coupon cash 400; issuance yield 5%. Asked: Interest expense. Formula: 9,600 × 0.05 = 480 Variables: Discount bond. Why this formula: Effective-interest accretion uses the original market rate. Premium does the opposite: expense below coupon, CFO lower than par. Reasonableness check: 480 - 400 = 80 discount amortization. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-131.steps: ①Expense 480. ②Cash 400 →CFO (or IFRS CFF) outflow smaller than par. ③CA becomes 9,680.

why_wrong.A: 400 is the cash coupon, which is below expense on a discount bond.
why_wrong.B: Interest paid, when expensed, is CFO (U.S. GAAP) or CFO/CFF (IFRS) — not CFI. The 480 is the expense, not a CFI classification.

FSA-131.zh: 利息費用= 期初帳面× 發行時市場利率= 480。折價債費用大於票息，CFO 比 平價債高（票息現金較小）。不是CFI。
FSA-131.core_idea: Issued debt: interest expense = beginning carrying amount × market rate at issuance
FSA-131.formula: Interest expense = beginning CA × yield at issuance
FSA-131.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-132.reasoning: Reasoning: Early redemption produces a gain or loss equal to carrying amount minus cash paid to retire: 10,200 - 10,050 = 150 gain. The cash retirement is CFF; any gain or loss is stripped from indirect CFO. Given: CA 10,200; cash paid 10,050. Asked: Gain/loss and cash-flow classification. Formula: 10,200 −10,050 = 150 Variables: Retirement is financing. Why this formula: You extinguish the book liability for a different cash amount. Do not let a financing retirement leak into CFI or remain inside CFO. Reasonableness check: If cash paid were 10,400, the loss would be 200 and would be added back in indirect CFO. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-132.steps: ①Gain 150 →NI↑. ②Cash -10,050 CFF. ③Indirect CFO: start at NI, subtract the 150 gain so it does not sit in CFO.

why_wrong.A: The cash retirement is CFF, not a 150 CFI inflow. The 150 is a non-cash gain overlay on a CFF cash outflow.
why_wrong.C: CA 10,200 - cash 10,050 = gain 150, not a loss. Cash is CFF, not CFI.

FSA-132.zh: 提前贖回：帳面10,200 - 付現10,050 = 利益150。現金在CFF；間接法CFO 要 剔除這筆利益。
FSA-132.core_idea: Early redemption gain or loss = carrying amount minus cash paid; cash is CFF; gain/loss stripped from indirect CFO
FSA-132.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-133.reasoning: Reasoning: A discount raises interest expense above the coupon (cash coupon smaller, so CFO higher than for a par bond); a premium does the opposite. Issued-debt compact teaching sits with the lease section but is a debt effective-interest fact.

why_wrong.B: That is the discount-bond pattern.
why_wrong.C: Coupons are not CFI in the chapter’s teaching.

FSA-133.zh: 溢價債：費用< 票息，付現較多，CFO 比平價債低。折價相反。票息不是CFI。
FSA-133.core_idea: A premium bond: interest expense below coupon, so CFO is lower than for a par bond
FSA-133.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-134.reasoning: Reasoning: Day one: ROU asset↑and lease liability↑. Assets and leverage up. ROA denominator up with no instantaneous revenue. Later, interest + amortization hit NI (numerator) while assets and liabilities amortize (denominators). Always read both sides. This is the on-balance-sheet leverage/ROA angle, not the operating-versus-finance cash-flow angle.

why_wrong.A: Executory off-balance-sheet is what IFRS 16 largely ended for recognized lessee leases.
why_wrong.B: An asset increase without an immediate NI increase lowers ROA; it does not raise profitability.

FSA-134.zh: 上表當下：資產與租賃負債同時增加。ROA 分母變大、槓桿上升。不是「有資產 就更賺錢」。
FSA-134.core_idea: ROU + liability on day one raise assets and debt-like liabilities, so leverage and asset-based ratios move on both sides
FSA-134.exam_trap: Ratio moved because both num and den moved
FSA-134.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-135.reasoning: Reasoning: Cash: principal is a CFF outflow; interest follows the interest-paid classification (CFO, or CFF under IFRS). Interest paid is not classified as CFI. The ROU asset’s investing nature does not re-label the interest piece.

why_wrong.A: The ROU asset does not pull lease interest into CFI. Interest paid is not classified as CFI.
why_wrong.C: U.S. GAAP interest paid is CFO; IFRS allows CFO or CFF. Neither assigns lease interest to CFI.

FSA-135.zh: 租賃利息跟其他利息支付一樣：CFO 或（IFRS）CFF，不是CFI。不要因為有 ROU 資產就丟進投資。
FSA-135.core_idea: Interest on a recognized IFRS 16 lease follows interest-paid classification — CFO or CFF under IFRS, not CFI
FSA-135.exam_trap: IFRS interest paid classified as CFI
FSA-135.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-136.reasoning: Reasoning: Total cash over the life is the same. Operating: all cash in CFO. Finance: principal in CFF, interest in CFO (or IFRS CFF). Early finance NI is lower. Do not invent extra cash in one presentation.

why_wrong.B: Interest is the time value already inside the payments, not an extra cash tax on finance presentation.
why_wrong.C: Rent is the same cash as the finance payments in the chapter’s ‘same payments’ contrast.

FSA-136.zh: 同一組付款，一輩子總現金一樣。差在CFO ／CFF 拆法和費用時點，不是哪一 種多付了錢。
FSA-136.core_idea: Total cash over the lease life is the same under operating and finance presentation
FSA-136.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-137.reasoning: Reasoning: Defined contribution: the expense is the contribution. Cash reduces CFO; if unpaid, a compensation liability is accrued. The employee bears investment risk. There is no long-term funded-status asset or liability to estimate.

why_wrong.A: That net funded-status picture is defined benefit.
why_wrong.B: Unpaid contribution is accrued; expense is the contribution, not only the cash.

FSA-137.zh: 確定提撥：費用＝應提撥數。付現進CFO，未付就估負債。投資風險在員工。沒 有長期提撥狀況要估。
FSA-137.core_idea: Defined contribution: expense is the contribution; cash reduces CFO; employee bears investment risk; no long-term funded-status estimate
FSA-137.study_section: Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞
FSA-137.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-137.subtopic: 5.8 Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞

FSA-138.reasoning: Reasoning: The balance sheet reports a single net pension asset or liability: plan assets at fair value minus the present value of the obligation (overfunded versus underfunded). 2,400 - 2,650 = -250. The obligation is a present value, discounted at a high-quality corporate bond rate. Given: Assets 2,400; PVO 2,650. Asked: Net funded status on the balance sheet. Formula: 2,400 −2,650 = −250 Variables: Negative = underfunded liability. Why this formula: One net amount, not gross both sides in this teaching. Overfunded would be a net asset. Reasonableness check: Discount rate is a high-quality corporate bond rate, not asked numerically here. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Assets minus obligation is -250: underfunded, a net liability. Listing assets first does not flip the sign.
why_wrong.C: The chapter puts a single net pension asset or liability on the balance sheet.

FSA-138.zh: 淨額= 計畫資產公允價值- 義務現值= -250，低度提撥，列淨負債。不是表外。
FSA-138.core_idea: Defined benefit: net pension asset/liability = plan assets at FV minus PV of the obligation
FSA-138.study_section: Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞
FSA-138.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-138.subtopic: 5.8 Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞

FSA-139.reasoning: Reasoning: Production-related service cost sits in inventory/COGS; other employees’ cost sits in operating expense. IFRS P/L pension expense is service cost (including past-service cost from plan amendments) plus net interest on the net surplus or deficit. Remeasurements go to OCI.

why_wrong.B: Service cost is periodic P/L cost (with the production/SG&A split), not OCI remeasurement.
why_wrong.C: Pension cash funding hits CFO in the DC teaching; DB service cost is an accrual classification into COGS or opex, not CFF.

FSA-139.zh: 生產相關服務成本進存貨／銷貨成本；總部人員進營業費用。不要整筆丟進OCI 或CFF。
FSA-139.core_idea: Production-related service cost sits in inventory/COGS; other employees’ cost sits in operating expense
FSA-139.study_section: Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞
FSA-139.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-139.subtopic: 5.8 Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞

FSA-140.reasoning: Reasoning: IFRS splits the change. Income-statement expense is (i) service cost, including pastservice cost from plan amendments, plus (ii) net interest on the net surplus or deficit (net amount × discount rate). OCI takes remeasurement: actuarial gains and losses, and the actual return on plan assets. Those remeasurements are not amortized into later profit.

why_wrong.A: That puts remeasurements into current P/L service/net-interest expense.
why_wrong.B: Subsequent amortization is the U.S. GAAP model (and U.S. GAAP also parks pastservice cost in OCI first).

FSA-140.zh: IFRS 精算損益進OCI，以後不再攤回損益。攤回是美國做法。
FSA-140.core_idea: IFRS DB: service + net interest in P/L; remeasurements (actuarial G/L and actual asset return) in OCI, not subsequently amortized
FSA-140.study_section: Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞
FSA-140.exam_trap: Amortizing IFRS pension remeasurements the U.S. GAAP way
FSA-140.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-140.subtopic: 5.8 Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞

FSA-141.reasoning: Reasoning: U.S. GAAP income-statement pension expense is service cost plus interest on the obligation minus expected return on plan assets. Actuarial gains and losses and past-service cost go to OCI and are subsequently amortized into pension expense. IFRS does not amortize remeasurements and uses net interest on the net position.

why_wrong.A: That is the IFRS split.
why_wrong.C: DC expense is the contribution; DB is the service/interest/return construct.

FSA-141.zh: 美國：服務成本+ 義務利息- 預期資產報酬；精算與前期服務成本先OCI 再攤 回。IFRS 用淨利息、再衡量不攤。
FSA-141.core_idea: U.S. GAAP DB expense: service + interest on the obligation - expected return; actuarial G/L and past-service cost to OCI then amortized
FSA-141.study_section: Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞
FSA-141.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-141.subtopic: 5.8 Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞

FSA-142.reasoning: Reasoning: IFRS net interest on the net surplus or deficit = net amount × discount rate. Underfunded 400 × 5% = 20 expense. The actual return on plan assets is in OCI (as part of remeasurement), not as a P/L expected-return credit. Given: IFRS; underfunded 400; discount rate 5%. Asked: Net interest in P/L. Formula: 400 × 0.05 = 20 Variables: Net deficit × HQ corporate bond rate. Why this formula: IFRS applies the discount rate to the net position. An overfunded 400 would be 20 of net interest income in P/L. Reasonableness check: U.S. GAAP would still split obligation interest and expected return. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-142.steps: ①Net deficit 400. ②20 P/L expense. ③Actual asset return goes to OCI, not here.

why_wrong.B: U.S. GAAP uses interest on the obligation minus expected return on plan assets as separate pieces. IFRS uses net interest on the net amount.
why_wrong.C: Net interest is P/L, not OCI. OCI is remeasurement including the actual return.

FSA-142.zh: IFRS 淨利息= 淨缺口× 折現率= 20，在損益。實際報酬在OCI。不要改用美 國的「義務利息- 預期報酬」。
FSA-142.core_idea: IFRS net interest = net surplus or deficit × discount rate — not expected return as a separate P/L credit
FSA-142.study_section: Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞
FSA-142.formula: IFRS net interest = net funded status × discount rate
FSA-142.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-142.subtopic: 5.8 Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞

FSA-143.reasoning: Reasoning: Equity-settled awards are normally measured at grant-date fair value and recognized ratably over the service / vesting period. Subsequent share-price moves do not remeasure the equity award. 3.6 / 4 = 0.9. The offset is additional paid-in capital. Given: Equity-settled options; grant-date FV 3.6m; 4-year vest; price doubles in year 1. Asked: Year-1 compensation expense. Formula: 3.6/4 = 0.9 Variables: No subsequent remeasurement. Why this formula: Grant-date FV is locked for equity-settled awards. Earnings fall even though no cash changes hands at grant. Reasonableness check: Cash-settled would remeasure the liability to current FV. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-143.steps: ①3.6 / 4 = 0.9. ②Price change ignored. ③Dr expense 0.9, Cr APIC 0.9. NI↓RE↓; equity’s APIC↑— net equity unchanged except for the RE/APIC mix.

why_wrong.A: 1.8 would remeasure as if the award were cash-settled when the price doubled.
why_wrong.B: 3.6 expenses the whole grant in year 1 and ignores the service period.

FSA-143.zh: 權益交割：grant-date 3.6 分四年，一年0.9。股價翻倍不重估。1.8 是現金交割思 路。
FSA-143.core_idea: Equity-settled SBC: grant-date FV recognized ratably over vesting; later share-price moves do not remeasure
FSA-143.study_section: Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞
FSA-143.formula: Annual SBC expense = grant-date FV/service years
FSA-143.exam_trap: Remeasuring equity-settled SBC when the share price moves
FSA-143.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-143.subtopic: 5.8 Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞

FSA-144.reasoning: Reasoning: Cash-settled awards — SARs and phantom stock paid in cash — create a liability. Remeasure that liability to fair value at each reporting date and at settlement. Fair-value changes go through profit or loss. Do not apply the equity-settled ‘grant-date fixed’ slogan to every SBC plan. Given: Cash-settled SARs; year-end FV 62 (originated this year from 0 via grant-date 40 then remeasure). Asked: Year-1 P/L cost. Formula: year-1 expense = 62 if the award originated this year and ends the year at 62 Variables: Liability FV at each reporting date. Why this formula: The liability is marked through P/L. If the award had already been on the books at 40 from a prior date, this year’s P/L would be the 22 increase — the stem’s year-1 origination makes the full 62 the year’s cost. Reasonableness check: Equity-settled would have used grant-date 40 over the service period. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-144.steps: ①Recognize liability; remeasure to 62. ②P/L 62 for the year if starting from zero. ③Causality: Liability↑Expense↑NI↓RE↓. No shares issued; no EPS dilution from new shares.

why_wrong.A: Grant-date lock is the equity-settled rule, not cash-settled.
why_wrong.C: Cash-settled fair-value changes go through profit or loss, not OCI.

FSA-144.zh: 現金交割：認列負債，期末重估，差額進損益。這裡費用62，不是鎖定40，也不 是進OCI。
FSA-144.core_idea: Cash-settled SARs/phantom stock: liability remeasured to FV each period through P/L
FSA-144.study_section: Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞
FSA-144.exam_trap: Applying grant-date lock to cash-settled SBC
FSA-144.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-144.subtopic: 5.8 Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞

FSA-145.reasoning: Reasoning: Cash-settled SARs and phantom stock pay the change in share value without issuing shares: no EPS dilution, limited downside for the holder, unlimited upside. Options can push risktaking to extremes; extra share ownership can also make managers more risk-averse. Issuing shares dilutes EPS.

why_wrong.B: No shares issued means no EPS dilution from issuance. Cash settlement is a liability, not a share issue.
why_wrong.C: The chapter says options can push risk-taking to extremes; extra share ownership can also make managers more risk-averse. It does not say options never affect risk-taking.

FSA-145.zh: 現金交割SAR：不發新股，不稀釋EPS。選擇權才可能逼出過度冒險；持股增加 也可能讓經理人更避險。
FSA-145.core_idea: Cash-settled SARs: no EPS dilution from new shares; options can dilute; extra share ownership can also make managers more risk-averse

FSA-146.reasoning: Reasoning: At exercise, cash received plus the grant-date option value already in APIC become equity (common stock at par, remainder APIC). No cash changes hands at grant, but earnings fall over the service period. The offset during vesting is APIC.

why_wrong.A: Exercise does not convert an equity-settled plan into a liability plan.
why_wrong.B: Subsequent share-price moves do not remeasure the equity award, including at exercise for catch-up P/L.

FSA-146.zh: 履約時：收到的現金加上已在APIC 的grant-date 價值，轉成普通股面額與 APIC。不是改成負債，也不依現價重做損益。
FSA-146.core_idea: At exercise of equity-settled options: cash received plus grant-date option value already in APIC become equity (par + APIC)
FSA-146.study_section: Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞
