FSA-147.reasoning: Reasoning: IFRS income-statement expense is service cost, including past-service cost from plan amendments, plus net interest. U.S. GAAP: actuarial gains and losses and past-service cost go to OCI and are subsequently amortized. Do not flatten the two.

why_wrong.A: IFRS does put past-service cost in P/L service cost. U.S. GAAP does not leave it in OCI forever — it amortizes.
why_wrong.C: Past-service cost is not an investing cash classification in the chapter.

FSA-147.zh: 計畫修正的前期服務成本：IFRS 當期進損益的服務成本；美國先OCI 再攤回。
FSA-147.core_idea: IFRS past-service cost from plan amendments is in P/L service cost; U.S. GAAP parks pastservice cost in OCI first
FSA-147.study_section: Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞
FSA-147.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-147.subtopic: 5.8 Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞

FSA-148.reasoning: Reasoning: The obligation is a present value, discounted at a high-quality corporate bond rate. Do not import the lease rate or the tax rate.

why_wrong.B: The lease discount rate is implicit or the lessee’s estimated secured borrowing rate — a different object.
why_wrong.C: Tax rates measure deferred tax, not the pension obligation.

FSA-148.zh: 確定給付義務用高品質公司債利率折現。不是租賃的擔保借款利率，也不是稅率。
FSA-148.core_idea: DB obligation is discounted at a high-quality corporate bond rate
FSA-148.study_section: Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞
FSA-148.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-148.subtopic: 5.8 Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞

FSA-149.reasoning: Reasoning: No cash changes hands at grant, but earnings fall. Subsequent share-price moves do not remeasure the equity award. Indirect CFO will add back the non-cash SBC expense. Cashsettled awards can become cash outflows at settlement (CFO compensation), which is a different plan.

why_wrong.A: There is no grant-date cash for equity-settled options. Expense is non-cash (APIC offset).
why_wrong.B: A SAR liability is the cash-settled model.

FSA-149.zh: 權益交割給獎當下沒有現金，費用在既得期間認列（貸APIC）。不要把grantdate FV 當成當天CFO 流出。
FSA-149.core_idea: Equity-settled SBC lowers earnings with no grant-date cash; CFO is not reduced at grant
FSA-149.study_section: Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞
FSA-149.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-149.subtopic: 5.8 Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞

FSA-150.reasoning: Reasoning: The core box: do not memorize all SBC as ‘grant-date fixed, price irrelevant.’ That holds only for equity-settled awards. Cash-settled (SAR, phantom stock) is a liability remeasured through P/L.

why_wrong.A: SARs are the cash-settled counterexample.
why_wrong.C: Share options settled in shares are the equity-settled case that is not remeasured.

FSA-150.zh: 「給獎日鎖定、跟股價無關」只適用權益交割。現金交割每期重估進損益。
FSA-150.core_idea: Do not treat all share-based compensation as grant-date fixed and price-irrelevant
FSA-150.study_section: Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞
FSA-150.exam_trap: Remeasuring equity-settled SBC when the share price moves
FSA-150.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-150.subtopic: 5.8 Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞

FSA-151.reasoning: Reasoning: CFO + CFI + CFF = ∆cash. 70 - 90 + 30 = 10; 40 + 10 = 50. Non-cash investing and financing (a direct equipment-for-debt deal) are disclosed, not placed in the body of the statement — they do not enter this sum. Given: Beg cash 40; CFO 70; CFI -90; CFF 30. Asked: Ending cash. Formula: 40 + 70 −90 + 30 = 50 Variables: Signed flows. Why this formula: The statement reconciles beginning cash to ending cash. CFI can exceed CFO; financing covered the gap. Reasonableness check: 50 - 40 = 10 = 70 - 90 + 30. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: 140 adds the three flows to beginning cash without the negative CFI sign: 40+70+90+30, or ignores the minus.
why_wrong.C: Non-cash deals are disclosed and not placed in the body; they do not freeze the cash identity for the cash deals that did occur.

FSA-151.zh: 期初40 + (70 - 90 + 30) = 50。非現金投資／籌資只揭露、不進表身，但不能因 此說現金恆不變。
FSA-151.core_idea: CFO + CFI + CFF = ∆cash; non-cash investing/financing are disclosed, not placed in the body
FSA-151.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
FSA-151.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-151.subtopic: 5.9 Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽

FSA-152.reasoning: Reasoning: U.S. GAAP classification is relatively fixed: interest and dividends received, and interest paid, are CFO; dividends paid are CFF; taxes paid are CFO; bank overdrafts are financing. IFRS is flexible along specified lines; interest paid is not classified as CFI.

why_wrong.A: That pairing is closer to IFRS flexibility (and even then interest paid is not CFI).
why_wrong.B: Returns on capital are not automatically CFI under U.S. GAAP.

FSA-152.zh: 美國：利息收付與股利收入在CFO，股利支付在CFF。不要用IFRS 的彈性去答 美國題。
FSA-152.core_idea: U.S. GAAP: interest and dividends received and interest paid are CFO; dividends paid are CFF; taxes paid are CFO; overdrafts are financing
FSA-152.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
FSA-152.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-152.subtopic: 5.9 Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽

FSA-153.reasoning: Reasoning: IFRS: interest paid may be CFO or CFF; interest received may be CFO or CFI; dividends received may be CFO or CFI; dividends paid may be CFO or CFF. Taxes are normally CFO unless specifically identifiable with investing or financing. Overdrafts may be treated as cash equivalents. Interest paid is not classified as CFI.

why_wrong.A: CFO or CFI is the choice for interest received (and dividends received), not for interest paid.
why_wrong.C: Interest paid is not classified as CFI.

FSA-153.zh: IFRS 利息支付：CFO 或CFF，不是CFI。CFO 或CFI 是利息收取的選項。
FSA-153.core_idea: IFRS interest paid may be CFO or CFF, not CFI
FSA-153.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
FSA-153.exam_trap: IFRS interest paid classified as CFI
FSA-153.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-153.subtopic: 5.9 Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽

FSA-154.reasoning: Reasoning: Keep paid versus received straight. Interest/dividends received: CFO or CFI. Dividends paid: CFO or CFF. Interest paid: CFO or CFF, never CFI. Swapping the menus is the trap.

why_wrong.B: Interest received is not a CFF choice in the chapter. Dividends paid are not CFI.
why_wrong.C: Same illegal CFI home for dividends paid, and a CFF option the chapter does not give to interest received.

FSA-154.zh: 收息／收股利：CFO 或CFI。付股利：CFO 或CFF。不要和付息菜單對調，更 不要把付出的丟進CFI。
FSA-154.core_idea: IFRS interest/dividends received CFO or CFI; dividends paid CFO or CFF; do not swap paid and received
FSA-154.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
FSA-154.exam_trap: IFRS interest paid classified as CFI
FSA-154.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-154.subtopic: 5.9 Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽

FSA-155.reasoning: Reasoning: Cash from customers = Revenue - ∆AR = 880 - 55 = 825. Each line is the T-account identity: beginning + accrual - cash = ending. An AR increase means some revenue was not collected. Given: Revenue 880; ∆AR +55. Asked: Cash collected from customers. Formula: 880 −55 = 825 Variables: AR increase is uncollected revenue. Why this formula: Accrual revenue minus the increase in the receivable. CFO trails revenue when AR grows. Reasonableness check: If AR had fallen 55, collections would be 935. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Adds the AR increase as if an asset increase were cash in.
why_wrong.B: Ignores the AR change.

FSA-155.zh: 向客戶收現= 收入- ∆應收= 825。應收增加是還沒收到的收入，要減。
FSA-155.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
FSA-155.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-155.subtopic: 5.9 Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽

FSA-156.reasoning: Reasoning: Cash to suppliers = COGS + ∆Inventory - ∆AP = 510 + 40 - 25 = 525. Inventory increase is extra purchase not yet in COGS; AP increase is a purchase not yet paid. Given: COGS 510; ∆Inv +40; ∆AP +25. Asked: Cash paid to suppliers. Formula: 510 + 40 −25 = 525 Variables: Purchases = COGS + ∆Inv = 550; then minus ∆AP. Why this formula: Convert accrual COGS to cash purchases then to cash payments. WC investment in inventory consumed cash; stretching AP funded part of it. Reasonableness check: Signs: operating asset↑uses cash; operating liability↑provides cash. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Adds both inventory and AP (510+40+25) — wrong AP sign.
why_wrong.C: Subtracts inventory and AP (510-40-25), reversing both working-capital signs.

FSA-156.zh: 付供應商= 銷貨成本+ ∆庫存- ∆應付= 525。庫存增加要多付（或少少付的 相反），應付增加少付。
FSA-156.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
FSA-156.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-156.subtopic: 5.9 Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽

FSA-157.reasoning: Reasoning: Collections = 720 - (-30) = 750. Payments = 450 + (-20) - (-15) = 450 - 20 + 15 = 445. AR down: extra collections. Inventory down: purchases below COGS. AP down: extra payments. Given: Rev 720, ∆AR -30; COGS 450, ∆Inv -20, ∆AP -15. Asked: Collections and payments. Formula: 720 −(−30) = 750; 450 −20 −(−15) = 445 Variables: Declines reverse the usual growth-year signs. Why this formula: Same T-account identities with signed changes. A working-capital release can make CFO exceed NI even if margins are ordinary. Reasonableness check: Purchases = 430; plus 15 extra AP reduction = 445. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: 690 treats the AR decline as a subtraction (wrong). 485 adds the inventory decline instead of subtracting it and mishandles AP.
why_wrong.C: 385 subtracts the AP decline instead of adding it (AP down means more cash paid).

FSA-157.zh: 應收下降多收：750。庫存下降少買、應付下降多付：450-20+15=445。符號不要 全反。
FSA-157.core_idea: Combined collections and payments with new numbers
FSA-157.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
FSA-157.formula: Cash customers = Rev −∆AR; cash suppliers = COGS + ∆Inv −∆AP
FSA-157.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-157.subtopic: 5.9 Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽

FSA-158.reasoning: Reasoning: Start at NI 14. Add depreciation 6. Subtract gain 2 (belongs to CFI). Subtract AR increase 4. Add AP increase 3. Add inventory decrease 1. CFO = 14 + 6 - 2 - 4 + 3 + 1 = 18. Given: NI 14; dep 6; gain 2; ∆AR +4; ∆AP +3; ∆Inv -1. Asked: Indirect CFO. Formula: 14 + 6 −2 −4 + 3 + 1 = 18 Variables: NCC = depreciation; gain is CFI. Why this formula: Indirect CFO is NI minus the period’s non-cash operating accruals, after stripping investing/financing P/L items. CFO 18 versus NI 14: depreciation and a small WC release outweigh the AR use and the stripped gain. Reasonableness check: The sale cash itself is not in this 18; it is CFI = CA + gain. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 16 forgets to subtract the 2 gain (or forgets the inventory decrease add-back of 1).
why_wrong.B: 10 subtracts depreciation and adds the gain — both signs flipped on the non-operating pieces.

FSA-158.zh: 14+6-2-4+3+1=18。處分利益要剔除（現金在CFI）；經營資產增加減、經營負債 增加加。
FSA-158.core_idea: Indirect CFO: add non-cash charges, strip CFI/CFF gains and losses, subtract operating-asset increases, add operating-liability increases
FSA-158.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
FSA-158.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-158.subtopic: 5.9 Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽

FSA-159.reasoning: Reasoning: Method choice is presentation. Reconciliations and where interest/tax paid appear are the framework contrast. Do not claim different CFO totals.

why_wrong.A: Both allow both; totals match. U.S. GAAP does not forbid direct.
why_wrong.C: U.S. GAAP interest paid is CFO, not CFI.

FSA-159.zh: 直接法與間接法CFO 總額相同。美國用直接法仍要NI 調節；IFRS 要求利息與 稅金付現在表上可見。
FSA-159.core_idea: Both frameworks allow direct or indirect CFO; total CFO is the same; U.S. GAAP requires NI-to-CFO reconciliation if direct is used
FSA-159.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
FSA-159.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-159.subtopic: 5.9 Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽

FSA-160.reasoning: Reasoning: Cash from an asset sold = carrying amount + gain (- loss) = 33 + 7 = 40. Historical cost of equipment sold can be inferred from the gross equipment roll-forward; accumulated depreciation on the sale from depreciation expense versus the change in accumulated depreciation. Given: CA 33; gain 7. Asked: CFI cash from the sale. Formula: 33 + 7 = 40 Variables: Proceeds are what hit cash. Why this formula: Rearrangement of gain = proceeds - CA. A loss would be CA minus the loss. Reasonableness check: If loss were 7, cash would be 26. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-160.steps: ①Proceeds = 40. ②Indirect CFO subtracts the 7 so the 40 can live in CFI.

why_wrong.B: 33 is the book value, not the cash.
why_wrong.C: 7 is the gain, which is not the cash inflow.

FSA-160.zh: 處分收現= 帳面+ 利益= 40。不要只報帳面或只報利益。
FSA-160.core_idea: CFI cash from an asset sold = carrying amount + gain (- loss)
FSA-160.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
FSA-160.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-160.subtopic: 5.9 Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽

FSA-161.reasoning: Reasoning: Beginning RE + NI - dividends = ending RE →dividends = 200 + 45 - 230 = 15. Stock issuance is the change in common stock plus APIC — a different CFF line. Given: Beg RE 200; NI 45; end RE 230. Asked: Dividends. Formula: 200 + 45 −230 = 15 Variables: RE roll-forward. Why this formula: The plug in the RE identity is dividends. Under U.S. GAAP those 15 are CFF. Under IFRS they may be CFO or CFF. Reasonableness check: RE rose 30; 45 - 15 = 30. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 45 assumes the entire NI was paid out (would leave RE at 200).
why_wrong.B: 30 is the RE increase, which is NI minus dividends, not dividends.

FSA-161.zh: 股利= 期初RE + NI - 期末RE = 15。30 是留在RE 的盈餘，不是股利。
FSA-161.core_idea: Dividends = NI - ∆RE from beginning RE + NI - dividends = ending RE
FSA-161.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
FSA-161.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-161.subtopic: 5.9 Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽

FSA-162.reasoning: Reasoning: When the CFO form assumes interest paid was classified in CFO: FCFF = CFO + Interest(1-t) - FCInv = 120 + 20×(1-0.25) - 50 = 120 + 15 - 50 = 85. Free cash flow is also written as CFO minus capex (here 70) — that is not FCFF once you need the interest add-back. Given: CFO 120 includes interest paid 20; t = 25%; FCInv 50. Asked: FCFF. Formula: 120 + 20(1 −0.25) −50 = 85 Variables: Add-back only if interest was in CFO. Why this formula: FCFF is cash to debt and equity; interest must not stay deducted. FCFE = CFO + net borrowing - FCInv is a different claimant set. Reasonableness check: If interest paid had been CFF, you would not add back the 15. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 70 is CFO - FCInv, forgetting the after-tax interest add-back when interest sat in CFO.
why_wrong.C: 105 adds the full 20 interest without the tax shield: 120 + 20 - 50.

FSA-162.zh: 利息已在CFO 裡扣過，加回稅後利息15，再減資本支出50，得85。不要忘加 回，也不要加回稅前20。
FSA-162.core_idea: FCFF = NI + NCC + Interest(1-t) - FCInv - WCInv = CFO + Interest(1-t) - FCInv if interest paid sat in CFO
FSA-162.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
FSA-162.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-162.subtopic: 5.9 Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽

FSA-163.reasoning: Reasoning: If IFRS classified interest paid as CFF, do not add back Interest(1-t) — it was not deducted from CFO. If dividends paid were in CFO, add them back. Interest paid is not a CFI item in this teaching convention. FCFE = CFO + net borrowing - FCInv. Free cash flow in the sources is also written as CFO minus capex.

why_wrong.B: The CFO form of FCFF assumes interest paid sat in CFO. Classification changes the starting CFO.
why_wrong.C: Interest paid is not CFI, and you do not deduct it twice.

FSA-163.zh: IFRS 把利息支付放在CFF 時，那個CFO 沒扣過利息，就算FCFF 不要再加回 稅後利息。付息也不是CFI。
FSA-163.core_idea: If IFRS classified interest paid as CFF, do not add back Interest(1-t) when going from that CFO to FCFF
FSA-163.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
FSA-163.exam_trap: IFRS interest paid classified as CFI
FSA-163.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-163.subtopic: 5.9 Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽

FSA-164.reasoning: Reasoning: FCFE = CFO + net borrowing - FCInv = 90 + 25 - 40 = 75. Equity claimants get what is left after reinvestment, including cash from (or paid to) lenders. Given: CFO 90; net borrowing 25; FCInv 40. Asked: FCFE. Formula: 90 + 25 −40 = 75 Variables: Net borrowing can be negative (debt repaid). Why this formula: Cash to equity after capex, including financing from lenders. If the firm repaid 25 instead, FCFE would be 25. Reasonableness check: CFO - capex = 50 is free cash flow as CFO minus capex, not FCFE once borrowing is in the definition. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 50 is CFO - FCInv, omitting net borrowing.
why_wrong.B: 115 is CFO + net borrowing, omitting FCInv.

FSA-164.zh: FCFE = 90 + 25 - 40 = 75。漏掉淨舉債或漏掉資本支出都會錯。
FSA-164.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
FSA-164.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-164.subtopic: 5.9 Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽

FSA-165.reasoning: Reasoning: Cash for tax = tax expense - ∆tax payable = 48 - 6 = 42. Cash for interest = interest expense - ∆interest payable = 20 - (-3) = 23. Same T-account identity as the other direct-method lines. Tax paid may also differ from payable for reasons the tax section already separated. Given: Tax expense 48, ∆tax payable +6; interest expense 20, ∆interest payable -3. Asked: Cash tax and cash interest. Formula: 48 −6 = 42; 20 −(−3) = 23 Variables: Payable increases defer cash. Why this formula: Direct-method T-accounts. U.S. GAAP puts both cash lines in CFO. IFRS may put interest cash in CFF. Reasonableness check: A DTA/DTL can make tax expense ̸= payable; this line still converts the expense to cash using the payable change. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Opposite signs on both payable changes.
why_wrong.C: Expense equals cash only if the payable balances do not move.

FSA-165.zh: 稅金付現48-6=42。利息付現20-(-3)=23。應付增加少付；應付減少多付。
FSA-165.core_idea: Cash for tax = tax expense - ∆tax payable; cash for interest = interest expense - ∆interest payable
FSA-165.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
FSA-165.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-165.subtopic: 5.9 Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽

FSA-166.reasoning: Reasoning: IFRS: taxes are normally CFO unless specifically identifiable with investing or financing. U.S. GAAP: taxes paid are CFO. Do not default tax to CFI or CFF.

why_wrong.B: The default is CFO, not CFI.
why_wrong.C: The default is CFO, not CFF. U.S. GAAP taxes paid are CFO.

FSA-166.zh: IFRS 稅金付現原則在CFO，只有能明確歸到投資或籌資時才例外。美國固定在 CFO。
FSA-166.core_idea: IFRS taxes are normally CFO unless specifically identifiable with investing or financing
FSA-166.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
FSA-166.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-166.subtopic: 5.9 Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽

FSA-167.reasoning: Reasoning: U.S. GAAP: bank overdrafts are financing. IFRS: overdrafts may be treated as cash equivalents. Keep that contrast; do not invent an investing classification.

why_wrong.A: Neither framework parks overdrafts in CFI in the chapter.
why_wrong.B: That pairing invents CFI/CFO homes the chapter does not assign.

FSA-167.zh: 透支：美國當籌資；IFRS 可以當現金及約當現金。都不是CFI。
FSA-167.core_idea: Bank overdrafts: U.S. GAAP financing; IFRS may treat as cash equivalents
FSA-167.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
FSA-167.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-167.subtopic: 5.9 Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽

FSA-168.reasoning: Reasoning: Detection patterns: premature revenue (DSO rises); channel stuffing; stretching payables to park CFO; moving interest paid from CFO to CFF; adding back cash-settlement charges in a non-GAAP liquidity measure; CFO/NI persistently below 1. Classification games change the ratio’s numerator without changing the economics.

why_wrong.A: GAAP-compliant firms can still have poor earnings quality. CFO/NI persistently below 1 is a detection pattern, not an automatic ‘fictitious’ stamp.
why_wrong.C: Interest paid is not classified as CFI.

FSA-168.zh: CFO/NI 長期小於1 是警訊。再看有沒有靠延後付款或把利息從CFO 改到CFF 來化妝。利息不能改到CFI。
FSA-168.core_idea: CFO persistently below NI is an earnings-quality flag listed with stretching payables and interestpaid reclassification
FSA-168.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
FSA-168.exam_trap: IFRS interest paid classified as CFI
FSA-168.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-168.subtopic: 5.9 Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽

FSA-169.reasoning: Reasoning: AR and inventory generally rise with sales; AP rises with purchases. That investment can make CFO lag reported earnings growth: Sales↑→AR and inventory↑→WC investment↑→ CFO may trail NI growth.

why_wrong.B: Unchanged DSO/DOH means balances scale with sales; WC investment is not zero.
why_wrong.C: Purchases typically rise with sales, so AP usually rises rather than falls.

FSA-169.zh: 銷貨成長時，應收與存貨通常跟著長，營運資金投資會讓CFO 慢於NI。不要假 設現金跟盈餘同步。
FSA-169.core_idea: Sales↑→AR and inventory↑→WC investment↑→CFO may trail NI growth
FSA-169.study_section: Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模
FSA-169.exam_trap: Assuming CFO tracks NI when working-capital investment rises
FSA-169.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-169.subtopic: 5.10 Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模

FSA-170.reasoning: Reasoning: A Level I model is a linked forecast of the income statement, balance sheet, and cash flows. The explicit forecast horizon ends when the firm is assumed to reach a steady state; a terminal / beyond-horizon assumption then carries the rest of value. Do not treat management guidance as already realized.

why_wrong.A: Management guidance is an input, not a realized fact. The core box warns against treating guidance as already realized.
why_wrong.B: The chapter includes a terminal / beyond-horizon assumption after the explicit horizon.

FSA-170.zh: 明確預測期是你一筆筆做的年數，做到進入穩定狀態；之後用終值假設。管理層 指引不是已實現事實。
FSA-170.core_idea: The explicit horizon ends at steady state; a terminal/beyond-horizon assumption then carries the rest of value
FSA-170.study_section: Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模
FSA-170.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-170.subtopic: 5.10 Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模

FSA-171.reasoning: Reasoning: Operating expenses split into variable (move with sales) and fixed (create operating leverage). Revenue can come from volume × price, market growth × share, segment build-ups, capacity, or management guidance. Fixed costs are why margin can expand in an up-sales year.

why_wrong.A: The chapter splits operating expenses into variable (move with sales) and fixed (create operating leverage). Not all costs are variable.
why_wrong.C: Operating leverage is part of the model, not a reason to zero the terminal value.

FSA-171.zh: 固定成本創造營運槓桿：銷貨上升時，若變動成本跟著走，營業利益率可以變厚。 不是所有成本都是變動。
FSA-171.core_idea: Operating expenses split into variable (move with sales) and fixed (create operating leverage)
FSA-171.study_section: Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模
FSA-171.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-171.subtopic: 5.10 Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模

FSA-172.reasoning: Reasoning: Capital expenditure splits into maintenance capex (keep current capacity; often informed by depreciation) and growth capex. Depreciation follows the capex path with a lag. Financing assumptions close the model: if assets exceed spontaneous liabilities plus retained earnings, the plug is new debt or equity; interest then feeds back into the income statement.

why_wrong.B: The chapter does not set growth capex to NI or zero out maintenance under IFRS.
why_wrong.C: Depreciation follows the capex path with a lag — it does not lead as a mechanical identity for next year’s growth capex.

FSA-172.zh: 維修資本支出維持產能（常參考折舊）；成長資本支出擴產。折舊跟著資本支出、 而且有落後。
FSA-172.core_idea: Maintenance capex keeps current capacity (often informed by depreciation); growth capex expands capacity
FSA-172.study_section: Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模
FSA-172.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-172.subtopic: 5.10 Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模

FSA-173.reasoning: Reasoning: Financing assumptions close the model: if assets exceed spontaneous liabilities plus retained earnings, the plug is new debt or equity; interest then feeds back into the income statement. That feedback is why you do not treat the IS and BS as independent spreadsheets.

why_wrong.A: The chapter’s closer is new debt or equity, not an asset write-down rule.
why_wrong.B: The plug is financing, not an OCI residual.

FSA-173.zh: 資產大於自發負債加保留盈餘，就要用新債或新股軋平；新債利息再回到損益。 不是把資產砍回去年，也不是丟進OCI。
FSA-173.core_idea: The financing plug closes the balance sheet and interest feeds back into the income statement
FSA-173.study_section: Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模
FSA-173.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-173.subtopic: 5.10 Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模

FSA-174.reasoning: Reasoning: Inflation lifts nominal sales and, with a lag, many costs and working-capital balances; deflation does the reverse. Historical trend extrapolation is a starting point; mean reversion / convergence is the check against perpetual supernormal margins.

why_wrong.A: AR and inventory are nominal balances that move with nominal sales when days are held constant.
why_wrong.C: Inflation is not confined to the terminal year in the chapter.

FSA-174.zh: 通膨拉高名目銷貨，成本與營運資金餘額會落後跟上。天數不變時，應收存貨的 名目金額會變。
FSA-174.core_idea: Inflation lifts nominal sales and, with a lag, many costs and WC balances; deflation reverses
FSA-174.study_section: Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模
FSA-174.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-174.subtopic: 5.10 Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模

FSA-175.reasoning: Reasoning: Forecast bias is reduced by using base rates, explicit drivers, and a second scenario. Sensitivity analysis changes one assumption; scenario analysis changes a set of key quantities; simulation draws repeatedly from probability distributions. Those three tools were also introduced in the reporting-system section.

why_wrong.B: Anchoring on last year is the bias, not the cure.
why_wrong.C: The chapter does not prescribe dropping terminal value as the bias control.

FSA-175.zh: 對抗高估與錨定：用基準率、明確驅動因子、第二套情境。敏感度改一個假設， 情境改一組，模擬反覆抽樣。
FSA-175.core_idea: Forecast bias is reduced by base rates, explicit drivers, and a second scenario
FSA-175.study_section: Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模
FSA-175.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-175.subtopic: 5.10 Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模

FSA-176.reasoning: Reasoning: ∆NI = +20. ∆NWC (operating) = 12 + 10 - 7 = 15 use of cash. Incremental CFO = 20 - 15 = 5. Sales-driven growth can look like 25% NI growth while CFO barely moves. Causality: Sales↑→AR↑Inventory↑→WCInv↑→CFO trails NI. Given: ∆NI +20; ∆AR +12; ∆Inv +10; ∆AP +7. Asked: Incremental CFO versus incremental NI. Formula: 20 −(12 + 10 −7) = 5 Variables: NWC investment = ∆AR + ∆Inv - ∆AP. Why this formula: Indirect CFO subtracts operating-asset increases and adds operating-liability increases. A 25% NI increase is not a 25% cash increase. Reasonableness check: If AP had risen 22, WC investment would be 0 and CFO would match NI. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
FSA-176.steps: ①Accounting: AR↑Inv↑use cash; AP↑provides cash. ②WC investment 15. ③CFO increment 20 - 15 = 5, trailing NI.

why_wrong.A: WC investment is not zero; CFO does not automatically match ∆NI.
why_wrong.B: Operating-asset increases use cash; they do not add to CFO.

FSA-176.zh: NI 多20，營運資金多卡15，CFO 只多5。分子是盈餘、分母或現金是另一件事。
FSA-176.core_idea: Numerical WC investment can make CFO trail a NI increase
FSA-176.study_section: Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模
FSA-176.exam_trap: Assuming CFO tracks NI when working-capital investment rises
FSA-176.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-176.subtopic: 5.10 Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模

FSA-177.reasoning: Reasoning: Historical trend extrapolation is a starting point; mean reversion / convergence is the check against perpetual supernormal margins. Scenario and sensitivity map assumption risk. Do not treat a short hot streak as the steady state.

why_wrong.A: Two years is exactly the anchoring risk the chapter flags.
why_wrong.C: The terminal / beyond-horizon assumption carries value and includes operating assumptions such as margin.

FSA-177.zh: 兩年超高利潤不能直接變成永遠的終值利潤。歷史外推只是起點，要用均值回歸 檢查。
FSA-177.core_idea: Mean reversion / convergence checks perpetual supernormal margins
FSA-177.study_section: Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模
FSA-177.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-177.subtopic: 5.10 Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模

FSA-178.reasoning: Reasoning: AR and inventory generally rise with sales; AP rises with purchases. Holding days constant still usually requires net WC investment in growth. The payables offset is partial, not a law that ∆NWC = 0.

why_wrong.B: Constant days means the balances scale with the sales/COGS base — they are not fixed.
why_wrong.C: AP scales with purchases, not as an automatic dollar offset to AR. The chapter says the investment can make CFO lag; it does not say the lag is always zero.

FSA-178.zh: 天數不變，應收、存貨、應付都會隨規模變大。應付只能抵一部分，成長公司淨 營運資金投資通常仍是正的。
FSA-178.core_idea: AP rises with purchases, which typically rise with sales — a partial WC offset, not a full CFO match
FSA-178.study_section: Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模
FSA-178.exam_trap: Assuming CFO tracks NI when working-capital investment rises
FSA-178.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。
FSA-178.subtopic: 5.10 Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模

FSA-179.reasoning: Reasoning: Ratios are not meaningful in isolation. Different inventory methods, depreciation methods, and lease classifications break naive peer comparisons. Multi-industry firms are hard to benchmark. Judgment, not a single hurdle rate, is required.

why_wrong.A: The chapter says compare to history, industry, and each other; it does not ban comparison when methods align.
why_wrong.B: Judgment, not a single hurdle rate, is required.

FSA-179.zh: 方法不同（FIFO ／LIFO、折舊、租賃分類）不能天真比同業。也沒有單一門檻 可以取代判斷。
FSA-179.core_idea: Ratios need history, industry, and each other; inventory method, depreciation, and lease classification break naive peers
FSA-179.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-180.reasoning: Reasoning: Common-size: income statement items as a percentage of revenue; balance sheet items as a percentage of assets; cash flows either as a percentage of revenue or as a share of total inflows or outflows. Present tax as an effective rate, not as a percentage of sales.

why_wrong.A: The chapter carves tax out of the ‘everything / sales’ habit.
why_wrong.C: Balance-sheet common-size is of assets; that is not where the tax rate lives.

FSA-180.zh: 共同比：損益用營收、資產負債用資產。稅要列有效稅率，不要列成佔營收百分 比。
FSA-180.core_idea: Common-size: IS of revenue, BS of assets; present tax as an effective rate, not as a percentage of sales
FSA-180.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-181.reasoning: Reasoning: Current ratio = CA / CL. Working capital > 0 means the current ratio exceeds 1. Quick = (cash + ST marketable securities + AR) / CL. Cash ratio uses only cash and ST securities. Low liquidity ratios mean reliance on CFO or outside financing. The three differ only in how much of current assets they treat as liquid.

why_wrong.B: WC > 0 means CA > CL, so current ratio > 1.
why_wrong.C: Inventory is not in the quick or cash numerator, so a write-down need not move those two.

FSA-181.zh: 營運資金為正⇒流動比率> 1。三個流動比率差在分子願意承認多少流動資產； 存貨只進流動比率。
FSA-181.core_idea: Current, quick, and cash ratios differ only in how much of current assets they treat as liquid
FSA-181.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-182.reasoning: Reasoning: Defensive interval = liquid assets / daily cash expenditure. Daily spend = 540/365 ≈ 1.479. 90 / 1.479 ≈60.8 days. It is how many days the firm can fund itself without further inflows. Given: Liquid assets 90; annual cash expenditure 540; 365-day year. Asked: Defensive interval. Formula: 90/(540/365) ≈60.8 Variables: Cash expenditure = expenses - non-cash expenses. Why this formula: Stock of liquidity divided by a daily burn. Longer interval is more coverage without new inflows — still not a credit score by itself. Reasonableness check: 90 / 540 × 365 = 60.83. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 90/365 treats the stock of liquid assets as if it were already a day count, or uses 90 as days without dividing into daily spend.
why_wrong.B: 365 ignores the data and reports a year.

FSA-182.zh: 防禦間隔= 90 ÷ (540/365) ≈61 天。分子是存量，分母是每天現金支出（費用減 非現金）。
FSA-182.core_idea: Defensive interval = liquid assets / daily cash expenditure, where cash expenditure is expenses minus non-cash expenses
FSA-182.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-183.reasoning: Reasoning: Inventory turnover = 3,650/400 = 9.125, so DOH = 365/9.125 = 40 days. Receivables turnover = 7,300/600 ≈12.167, so DSO = 30 days. Payables turnover = 3,650/200 = 18.25, so DPO = 20 days. CCC = 40 + 30 - 20 = 50. Given: COGS 3,650; avg inv 400; rev 7,300; avg AR 600; purchases = COGS; avg AP 200; 365 days. Asked: Cash conversion cycle. Formula: 40 + 30 −20 = 50 Variables: DOH, DSO, DPO. Why this formula: Days from paying suppliers to collecting from customers. The firm finances 20 days of the 70-day operating cycle with payables. Reasonableness check: 40 + 30 - 20 = 50. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 70 is the operating cycle DOH + DSO, never subtracting DPO.
why_wrong.C: 10 is DSO - DPO, omitting DOH.

FSA-183.zh: CCC = 40+30-20 = 50。選70 是營業循環；選10 漏了存貨天數。
FSA-183.core_idea: CCC = DOH + DSO - DPO; operating cycle = DOH + DSO
FSA-183.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-184.reasoning: Reasoning: Rising DSO can mean premature revenue recognition; a write-off of receivables lowers DSO. Same trap family as the inventory write-down: the ratio moved because the AR denominator moved, not because customers paid faster. Check both the economic story and both parts of the ratio.

why_wrong.B: Premature revenue is a rising-DSO warning. A write-off is a different event that cuts AR and therefore DSO.
why_wrong.C: Activity ratios use the written-off AR balance.

FSA-184.zh: 沖銷應收會讓DSO 下降（分母變小），不是收款變好。DSO 上升才比較像提前認 列收入。
FSA-184.core_idea: Rising DSO can mean premature revenue; a receivables write-off lowers DSO
FSA-184.exam_trap: Ratio moved because both num and den moved
FSA-184.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-185.reasoning: Reasoning: Low DPO: unused credit lines or early-payment discounts. High DPO: stretching payables or lenient terms — check whether cash is actually scarce. CCC = DOH + DSO - DPO is days between paying for inventory and collecting from customers. A shorter CCC from stretching is not automatically healthier earnings quality.

why_wrong.A: Unused credit lines or early-payment discounts are the low-DPO interpretations.
why_wrong.B: High DPO shortens CCC (subtracted), but stretching to manufacture CFO is a quality flag, not proof of strength.

FSA-185.zh: DPO 變長可能是在拖付供應商來美化CFO。要問現金是不是真的緊，不要把短 CCC 自動當成經營變好。
FSA-185.core_idea: Low DPO: unused credit or early-payment discounts; high DPO: stretching or lenient terms — check whether cash is scarce
FSA-185.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-186.reasoning: Reasoning: For these ratios, total debt is interest-bearing short-and long-term debt; accrued liabilities and AP are not debt. 400 + 250 = 650. Debt-to-equity, debt-to-assets, and debt-tocapital use that debt. Financial leverage = average assets / average equity (the DuPont leverage term). Given: Bank loans 400; bonds 250; AP 180; accrued wages 40. Asked: Total debt for D/E, D/A, D/capital. Formula: 400 + 250 = 650 Variables: AP and accruals excluded. Why this formula: The chapter’s debt definition for these solvency ratios. AP still matters for CCC and the current ratio; it is just not this ‘debt.’ Reasonableness check: 870 would be the ‘all current and long-term claims’ mistake. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 870 adds AP and accruals, which the chapter excludes from ‘total debt’ for these ratios.
why_wrong.C: 180 is AP only.

FSA-186.zh: 這裡的「負債」是附息短長期借款650。應付帳款與應計費用不算進這些槓桿比率 的債務。
FSA-186.core_idea: Total debt for leverage ratios is interest-bearing short-and long-term debt; AP and accruals are not debt
FSA-186.formula: Total debt = interest-bearing ST + LT debt
FSA-186.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-187.reasoning: Reasoning: Tax burden 36/48 = 0.75. Interest burden 48/60 = 0.80. OPM 60/300 = 0.20. TAT 300/240 = 1.25. Leverage 240/80 = 3. Product = 0.75 × 0.80 × 0.20 × 1.25 × 3 = 0.45. Check: NI/equity = 36/80 = 45%. Given: NI 36; EBT 48; EBIT 60; rev 300; avg assets 240; avg equity 80. Asked: Five-way DuPont ROE. Formula: 0.75 × 0.80 × 0.20 × 1.25 × 3 = 0.45 Variables: Tax burden, interest burden, OPM, TAT, leverage. Why this formula: Each ratio isolates one layer; the product telescopes to NI/E. If ROE is weak, at least one of margin, turnover, or leverage is weak — and leverage can look helpful while raising risk. Reasonableness check: 36/80 = 45%. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: 12% is net margin 36/300.
why_wrong.C: 15% is ROA 36/240, the five-way product with leverage omitted.

FSA-187.zh: 五因素乘起來45%，等於NI ／權益。12% 停在淨利率；15% 是ROA，忘了乘槓 桿。
FSA-187.core_idea: Five-way DuPont: tax burden × interest burden × operating margin × asset turnover × leverage
FSA-187.formula:
ROE =
NI
EBT × EBT
EBIT × EBIT
Rev × Rev
A × A
E
FSA-187.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-188.reasoning: Reasoning: Three-way DuPont is net margin × turnover × leverage = 0.08 × 1.5 × 2.0 = 0.24, which is also ROA × leverage = 0.12 × 2.0. Tax burden = 1 - effective tax rate sits inside the five-way version as NI/EBT. Given: NPM 8%; TAT 1.5; A/E 2.0. Asked: Three-way ROE. Formula: 0.08 × 1.5 × 2.0 = 0.24 Variables: ROA = 12%. Why this formula: Leverage converts ROA into ROE. Helpful leverage is still more risk. High ROE is not automatically good. Reasonableness check: If leverage were 1.0, ROE would equal ROA. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 12% is ROA (8% × 1.5) with leverage omitted.
why_wrong.B: 8% stops at net margin.

FSA-188.zh: 三因素8% × 1.5 × 2 = 24%。12% 是ROA；不要忘了槓桿。
FSA-188.core_idea: Three-way DuPont is net margin × turnover × leverage, which is also ROA × leverage
FSA-188.formula: ROE = NPM × TAT × leverage = ROA × leverage
FSA-188.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-189.reasoning: Reasoning: ROE = NI / average (or beginning) equity. High ROE is not automatically good if it comes from shrinking equity faster than NI, or from borrowing to repurchase shares. Cash dividends shrink equity and mechanically raise ROE. Both sides of the ratio must be read: numerator unchanged, denominator down.

why_wrong.A: Dividends are a distribution, not an expense; they do not reduce NI. They reduce RE.
why_wrong.C: Beginning RE + NI - dividends = ending RE. Equity shrinks.

FSA-189.zh: 發現金股利不減NI，但權益變小，ROE 會機械性上升。那不是生意變好。
FSA-189.core_idea: Cash dividends shrink equity and mechanically raise ROE; high ROE is not automatically good
FSA-189.exam_trap: Ratio moved because both num and den moved
FSA-189.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-190.reasoning: Reasoning: ROA = NI / average assets = 70/500 = 14%. Because assets are funded by both equity and creditors while NI is after interest, an adjusted ROA adds back after-tax interest: (70 + 20×0.70)/500 = 84/500 = 16.8%. Operating ROA uses EBIT — a third variant, not asked here. Given: NI 70; interest 20; t = 30%; avg assets 500. Asked: ROA and interest-adjusted ROA. Formula: 70/500 = 14%; (70 + 14)/500 = 16.8% Variables: After-tax interest = 14. Why this formula: Put the return on a pre-financing (after-tax) basis over all assets. Ordinary ROA understates the asset return when the firm is levered. Reasonableness check: 20 × (1 - 0.30) = 14. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: 18.0% adds pretax interest 20 (70+20)/500, skipping the tax shield.
why_wrong.C: Swaps the two ROAs.

FSA-190.zh: 普通ROA = 14%。調整ROA 加回稅後利息14，得16.8%。不要加回稅前20。
FSA-190.core_idea: Adjusted ROA adds back after-tax interest because assets are funded by equity and creditors while NI is after interest
FSA-190.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-191.reasoning: Reasoning: Interest coverage = EBIT / interest = 90/15 = 6. Fixed-charge coverage adds lease expense to both numerator and denominator: (90+10)/(15+10) = 100/25 = 4. Both parts of the second ratio move — another numerator-and-denominator adjustment, not a one-sided add. Given: EBIT 90; interest 15; lease expense 10. Asked: Interest coverage and fixed-charge coverage. Formula: 90/15 = 6; 100/25 = 4 Variables: Lease added to both sides. Why this formula: Lease is a fixed claim like interest for this coverage. Adding the lease claim to both sides lowers coverage — more conservative. Reasonableness check: If you add 10 only to the numerator, you invent 6.67×, which the chapter does not define. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: The chapter adds lease expense to both sides for fixed-charge coverage.
why_wrong.B: Swaps the ratios.

FSA-191.zh: 利息保障90/15=6。固定支出保障兩邊都加租金：(90+10)/(15+10)=4。不要只 加一邊。
FSA-191.core_idea: Interest coverage = EBIT / interest; fixed-charge coverage adds lease expense to both numerator and denominator
FSA-191.exam_trap: Ratio moved because both num and den moved
FSA-191.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-192.reasoning: Reasoning: Age = accumulated depreciation / annual depreciation = 360/60 = 6. Remaining = net PPE / annual depreciation = 840/60 = 14. Total useful life = historical cost / annual depreciation = 20. Age + remaining = total. Older assets may be less competitive and closer to a capex wave. Given: Gross 1,200; accum. dep 360; annual dep 60; SL. Asked: Estimated average age. Formula: 360/60 = 6 Variables: Most reliable under straight-line. Why this formula: How many years of depreciation have already been taken at the current annual rate. A young base also helps explain a low fixed-asset turnover (higher net PPE denominator). Reasonableness check: 360/1,200 = 30% of life used; 30% × 20 = 6. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 14 is remaining life: net PPE 840 / 60.
why_wrong.C: 20 is estimated total useful life: 1,200 / 60.

FSA-192.zh: 平均年齡用累計折舊／年折舊= 6。14 是剩餘年限；20 是估計總年限。
FSA-192.core_idea: PPE age = accumulated depreciation / annual depreciation (straight-line most reliable)
FSA-192.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-193.reasoning: Reasoning: Basic EPS = (NI - preferred dividends) / weighted-average ordinary shares. Stock splits and stock dividends are applied as if they had occurred at the beginning of the year. Shares = 80 × 2 = 160. EPS = 216/160 = 1.35. Given: NI 240; pref. div 24; WASO 80 before a year-end 2-for-1 split. Asked: Basic EPS. Formula: (240 −24)/(80 × 2) = 1.35 Variables: Split retroactive for the year. Why this formula: Comparability of the share count across the year. Diluted EPS treats dilutive convertibles as converted and uses the treasury-stock method for options; basic is at least diluted when done correctly. Reasonableness check: Without the split you report twice the EPS. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: 2.70 ignores the split: (240-24)/80.
why_wrong.C: 3.00 ignores preferred dividends: 240/80, and also ignores the split.

FSA-193.zh: 股票分割當年度期初就發生：股數160，分子還要扣特別股股利，EPS = 1.35。
FSA-193.core_idea: Basic EPS uses NI minus preferred dividends over weighted-average ordinary shares; splits and stock dividends are applied as if at the beginning of the year
FSA-193.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-194.reasoning: Reasoning: Incremental shares = options issued minus shares that could be bought with the proceeds at the average market price: 100 - (100×12)/16 = 100 - 75 = 25. Options are dilutive only if exercise price is below average market price. Always test each security separately; antidilutive securities are omitted. Basic EPS is at least diluted EPS when the calculation is done correctly. Given: n = 100; X = 12; average price = 16. Asked: Incremental shares. Formula: 100 −1,200/16 = 25 Variables: Dilutive because 12 < 16. Why this formula: Cash assumed received is used to buy shares at the average price. If average price were 10, the options would be antidilutive and omitted. Reasonableness check: Convertible debt would add after-tax coupon to the numerator instead of this method. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 100 adds the whole option grant with no treasury-stock buy-back.
why_wrong.B: In-the-money options (exercise below average market) are the dilutive case; 0 is the opposite rule.

FSA-194.zh: 庫藏股法：100 - 1,200/16 = 25。履約價低於平均市價才稀釋。不要把100 張全 加，也不要說價內不稀釋。
FSA-194.core_idea: Treasury-stock method: incremental shares = options issued minus shares buyable with proceeds at average market price; dilutive only if exercise < average price
FSA-194.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-195.reasoning: Reasoning: Debt coverage = CFO / total debt = 80/320 = 0.25. Reinvestment = CFO / cash paid for long-term assets = 80/50 = 1.60. Similarly CFO over cash paid for long-term debt, over dividends, and over CFI-plus-CFF outflows. Performance versions: CFO/revenue, CFO/average assets, CFO/average equity, CFO/operating income, and (CFO - preferred dividends) / common shares. Given: CFO 80; debt 320; LT asset cash 50. Asked: Debt coverage and reinvestment. Formula: 80/320 = 0.25; 80/50 = 1.60 Variables: Total debt is interest-bearing. Why this formula: How many times CFO covers the claim or the reinvestment outlay. CFO covers a quarter of the debt stock this year and 1.6× this year’s LT-asset cash outlay. Reasonableness check: Inverted 4.00 would be years of CFO to repay debt if someone flipped the fraction. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 4.00 inverts debt coverage (debt/CFO) and 0.63 inverts reinvestment (capex/CFO).
why_wrong.C: Keeps debt coverage but inverts reinvestment.

FSA-195.zh: 債覆蓋80/320=0.25；再投資80/50=1.60。分子是CFO。不要把比率顛倒。
FSA-195.core_idea: Debt coverage = CFO / total debt; reinvestment = CFO / cash paid for long-term assets
FSA-195.formula: Debt coverage = CFO/total debt; reinvestment = CFO/LT asset cash
FSA-195.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-196.reasoning: Reasoning: High ROE is not automatically good if it comes from shrinking equity faster than NI, or from borrowing to repurchase shares. Cash dividends shrink equity and mechanically raise ROE. Read the numerator (NI, possibly after more interest) and the denominator (smaller equity) separately.

why_wrong.B: The repurchase price is a balance-sheet/CFF event, not an automatic NI deduction equal to the price.
why_wrong.C: Leverage is inside three-way and five-way ROE (assets/equity).

FSA-196.zh: 舉債庫藏股：權益變小，ROE 可能上升，即使利息讓NI 變差。高ROE 不自動 等於好生意。
FSA-196.core_idea: Share repurchase funded by borrowing can raise ROE while raising risk — NI may even fall after interest
FSA-196.exam_trap: Ratio moved because both num and den moved
FSA-196.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-197.reasoning: Reasoning: Gross, operating, pretax, and net margins isolate successive cost layers, all over revenue. Five-way uses EBIT/revenue as the operating-margin term. Do not rename ROA or the interest burden as a margin.

why_wrong.A: NI / assets is ROA, not a margin.
why_wrong.B: EBT/EBIT is the interest burden, not operating margin. Operating margin is EBIT/revenue in the five-way stack.

FSA-197.zh: 營業利益率是營業利益／營收，還在利息與稅之前。不要和ROA 或利息負擔因子 叫成同一個東西。
FSA-197.core_idea: Gross, operating, pretax, and net margins isolate successive cost layers, all over revenue
FSA-197.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-198.reasoning: Reasoning: LIFO reports lower inventory, lower profit, and higher leverage ratios (smaller assets and equity). FIFO in rising prices lowers COGS and raises inventory, so turnover falls twice — the sibling trap. Here the leverage ratio moves because both assets and equity changed, not because debt changed.

why_wrong.A: Inventory is an asset; LIFO’s lower inventory is a smaller asset base.
why_wrong.C: Higher COGS lowers NI and equity; it does not raise assets.

FSA-198.zh: 漲價LIFO：庫存與權益都比較小，槓桿上升。不是負債變了，是分子分母（或權 益邊）都被同一套成本流轉推動。
FSA-198.core_idea: LIFO versus FIFO in rising prices: leverage rises under LIFO because assets and equity are both smaller
FSA-198.exam_trap: Ratio moved because both num and den moved
FSA-198.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-199.reasoning: Reasoning: In early years, accelerated methods mean higher depreciation, lower NI, assets, equity, ROA and ROE, and higher asset turnover. The turnover rise is a smaller denominator. ROA is the fight: smaller NI and smaller assets. Same family as write-downs and impairments: ask which parts of the ratio moved.

why_wrong.B: Depreciation lowers carrying amount; that is the denominator channel.
why_wrong.C: Asset turnover’s numerator is revenue, not NI. The NI effect belongs to ROA/ROE.

FSA-199.zh: 加速折舊讓資產分母變小，周轉上升；同時NI 下降，ROA 要兩邊看。分子是營 收，不是NI。
FSA-199.core_idea: Accelerated depreciation raises asset turnover because the asset denominator is smaller — NI also fell
FSA-199.exam_trap: Ratio moved because both num and den moved
FSA-199.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

FSA-200.reasoning: Reasoning: Tax burden = NI/EBT = 56/80 = 0.70 = 1 - effective tax rate. ETR = 24/80 = 30%, so 1 - 0.30 = 0.70. Common-size tax is this effective rate, not tax/sales. Mixing ETR with the DuPont factor is the numerator/denominator slip. Given: EBT 80; tax expense 24; NI 56. Asked: Five-way tax-burden factor. Formula: 56/80 = 0.70 Variables: ETR = 30%. Why this formula: The factor is the fraction of EBT kept after tax, not the tax rate. A rate cut that remeasures a net DTL can raise this factor this period — that is a tax-expense story, not necessarily a better core business. Reasonableness check: If someone reports 30% as the DuPont tax term, they inserted ETR instead of 1 - ETR. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 0.30 is the effective tax rate, not the tax-burden factor.
why_wrong.B: 0.24 is tax expense / 100, or a raw tax number, not NI/EBT.

FSA-200.zh: 稅負因子是NI/EBT = 0.70，等於1 - 有效稅率。0.30 是有效稅率本身，不要直 接當DuPont 那一項。
FSA-200.core_idea: Tax burden in five-way DuPont is NI/EBT = 1 - effective tax rate
FSA-200.source_note: 解答依據 FSA_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Financial Statement Analysis。

EQ-001.reasoning: Reasoning: The sources define completeness by the availability of saving, funding, hedging, and access to needed assets. Operational efficiency is whether those functions run at low trading cost. Informational efficiency is whether prices reflect public information about fundamental value in a timely way. Completeness is the function set, not a zero spread and not a pricing test.

why_wrong.B: Operational efficiency is low trading cost. Completeness is whether the functions exist.
why_wrong.C: Informational efficiency is about prices reflecting fundamental information, a different test.

EQ-001.zh: 市場完整講的是功能在不在：能存、能借、能避險、能買到需要的資產。營運效 率才是交易成本低；資訊效率才是價格有沒有及時反映基本面。
EQ-001.core_idea: A complete market lets investors save, fund, hedge, and obtain needed assets at fair terms 核心觀念｜中文理解：市場完整講的是功能在不在：能存、能借、能避險、能買到需要的資產。
EQ-001.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-001.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-001.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-002.reasoning: Reasoning: Operational efficiency is low commissions, spreads, and price impact. Informational efficiency is timely, unbiased reflection of public information about fundamental value. Tight spreads with delayed earnings adjustment is operationally efficient and informationally inefficient. Allocational efficiency — sending capital to its most productive uses — rests on informational efficiency.

why_wrong.A: Slow adjustment after public earnings news is a failure of informational efficiency, not of trading cost.
why_wrong.B: Allocational efficiency is what informational efficiency is supposed to deliver; delayed prices do not get you there.

EQ-002.zh: 價差很窄是營運效率。公開盈餘出來好幾天價格才動，是資訊效率不足。配置效 率要靠資訊效率，不是「有人能交易」就自動成立。
EQ-002.core_idea: Operational efficiency is low trading cost; informational efficiency is timely reflection of public fundamentals 核心觀念｜中文理解：價差很窄是營運效率。
EQ-002.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-002.exam_trap: Treating cheap trading as proof that prices are informative
EQ-002.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。

EQ-003.reasoning: Reasoning: Financial assets are securities, derivatives, and currencies. Real assets are physical. The warehouse is physical. The share and the currency forward are claims or contracts, not the physical asset itself.

why_wrong.A: A listed share is a security, hence a financial asset.
why_wrong.C: A currency forward is a derivative, hence a financial asset.

EQ-003.zh: 金融資產是證券、衍生性商品、貨幣。實質資產是實體東西。倉庫是實物；股票 與遠期契約都是請求權或合約。
EQ-003.core_idea: Financial assets are securities, derivatives, and currencies; real assets are physical 核心觀念｜中文理解：金融資產是證券、衍生性商品、貨幣。
EQ-003.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-003.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-003.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-004.reasoning: Reasoning: Money markets are short-term debt. Capital markets are longer-term debt and equities. A 12-year corporate bond is longer-term debt, so it sits in the capital market. Bills and commercial paper do not become capital-market instruments just because they are debt.

why_wrong.B: A 60-day T-bill is short-term debt: money market.
why_wrong.C: Ninety-day commercial paper is also short-term debt: money market.

EQ-004.zh: 貨幣市場是短債；資本市場是較長天期的債加上股票。12 年公司債進資本市場。 不要把「凡是債券」都丟進資本市場。
EQ-004.core_idea: Money markets are short-term debt; capital markets are longer-term debt and equities 核心觀念｜中文理解：貨幣市場是短債；資本市場是較長天期的債加上股票。
EQ-004.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-004.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-004.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-005.reasoning: Reasoning: Brokers find counterparties. Dealers trade from inventory. A broker-dealer wears both hats: seek the client’s best price, and earn the bid–ask spread. Those two objectives pull against each other on the same order. The sources do not turn that conflict into a ban on matching or a requirement to use a dark pool.

why_wrong.A: Brokers and alternative systems also match orders; the conflict is agency versus inventory, not a ban on matching.
why_wrong.B: Dark pools hide orders; they are not a required legal channel for every block.

EQ-005.zh: 經紀商找對手；自營商用庫存買賣。同一家兼兩職時，幫客戶搶最好價格，和自 己賺價差，目標是對衝的。這不是「不准撮合」，也不是「一定要進暗池」。
EQ-005.core_idea: Brokers find counterparties; dealers trade from inventory; a broker-dealer has a conflict 核心觀念｜中文理解：經紀商找對手；自營商用庫存買賣。
EQ-005.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-005.exam_trap: Reading the broker-dealer conflict as a ban on matching
EQ-005.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-005.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-006.reasoning: Reasoning: Alternative trading systems do the matching without the exchange’s regulatory role. Those that hide client orders are dark pools. Dealer markets and call markets are different execution structures; hidden size is not their definition.

why_wrong.A: Dealers post bids and asks from inventory; hiding a client order is not what makes a dealer market.
why_wrong.C: Call markets accumulate orders for a session; hiding an order does not by itself create a call market.

EQ-006.zh: ATS 負責撮合、不做交易所的監管角色；把客戶委託藏起來的，叫做暗池。不要 把「隱藏」直接等同自營商市場或集合競價。
EQ-006.core_idea: Dark pools hide client orders; ATS match without the exchange’s regulatory role 核心觀念｜中文理解：ATS 負責撮合、不做交易所的監管角色；把客戶委託藏起來的，叫做暗池。
EQ-006.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-006.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-006.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-007.reasoning: Reasoning: A short sale borrows the security, sells it, posts proceeds with the broker, and later covers. The short benefits if the price falls: sold at 28, covered at 24. A long, including a margin long, benefits if the price rises.

why_wrong.B: A long benefits if the price rises, not if it falls.
why_wrong.C: A margin purchase is a leveraged long; it still needs the price to rise.

EQ-007.zh: 放空是借券賣出、把價金放在券商、之後買回還券。價格下跌才賺。多方（含融 資買進）是漲才賺。
EQ-007.core_idea: A short sale borrows the security, sells it, and later covers; the short benefits if the price falls 核心觀念｜中文理解：放空是借券賣出、把價金放在券商、之後買回還券。
EQ-007.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-007.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-007.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-008.reasoning: Reasoning: Cash deposited = 0.40 × 500 × 40 = 8,000, so the loan is 12,000. At 36, market value is 18,000. Equity = 18,000 - 12,000 = 6,000. Margin percentage = 6,000 / 18,000 = 33.3%. The sources define equity as market value minus the loan, and the margin percentage as that equity divided by current market value. The initial 40% is the starting deposit, not a frozen ratio. Given: 500 shares bought at 40; initial margin 40%; price now 36; loan unchanged. Asked: Current margin percentage. Formula: margin % = (MV −loan)/MV Variables: MV = current market value; loan = amount borrowed at purchase. Why this formula: The sources define account equity as market value minus the loan, and the margin percentage as equity over current market value. A 10% price drop cut equity by 2,000 on an 8,000 deposit, so the ratio fell from 40% to 33.3%. Reasonableness check: 40% is the opening deposit, not the current ratio. 11% is not equity/MV. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Leaves the initial 40% unchanged, as if margin percentage were a contract coupon.
why_wrong.B: Divides the 2,000 paper loss by the original 20,000 market value (10%) or mixes that 10% with the 40% deposit.

EQ-008.zh: 保證金比率是「現在權益÷ 現在市值」，不是當初繳的40% 永遠鎖住。權益＝市 值減借款。股價跌，市值變小、權益掉得更快，比率會下降。
EQ-008.core_idea: Equity in a long margin account is market value minus the loan; margin percentage is equity divided by market value 核心觀念｜中文理解：保證金比率是「現在權益÷ 現在市值」，不是當初繳的40% 永遠鎖住。
EQ-008.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-008.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-008.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-009.reasoning: Reasoning: Cash deposited = 0.50 × 200 × 55 = 5,500. Gain on the position = 200 × (60 - 55) = 1,000. Return = 1,000 / 5,500 = 18.18%. The sources define the margin-trade return as the position gain or loss divided by the cash deposited. The unlevered 9.1% uses the full purchase cost in the denominator. Doubling 18.2% invents a second layer of leverage the account does not have. Given: 200 shares at 55; initial margin 50%; sold at 60; ignore interest and fees. Asked: Rate of return on the margin trade. Formula: R = (∆P × Q)/(initial margin × P0 × Q) Variables: Cash deposited is the equity put up at t=0; the loan is not in the denominator. Why this formula: Leverage scales the return because the same dollar gain sits on a smaller cash outlay. A 9.1% price gain on 50% margin is about twice the unlevered return before interest. Reasonableness check: 9.1% is the cash purchase return. 36.4% would require a 25% deposit. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Uses the unlevered price return (60 - 55)/55 = 9.09% and ignores that only half the cost was cash.
why_wrong.C: Divides the 1,000 gain by half the cash deposit, double-counting leverage.

EQ-009.zh: 融資報酬的分母是你繳出去的現金，不是整筆市值。賺1,000、本金5,500，約 18%。不要用未槓桿的9%，也不要再把槓桿乘一次。
EQ-009.core_idea: Rate of return on a margin trade is the gain or loss on the position divided by the cash deposited 核心觀念｜中文理解：融資報酬的分母是你繳出去的現金，不是整筆市值。
EQ-009.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-009.formula: margin return = position gain or loss/cash deposited

EQ-009.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-010.reasoning: Reasoning: When the margin percentage falls below the maintenance margin, cash or securities must be deposited. The sources do not turn a margin call into a short sale or into a dividend. The return definition stays gain or loss over cash deposited — a call increases cash deposited, it does not create income.

why_wrong.B: A margin call is not a change in long versus short.
why_wrong.C: A deficit is a funding requirement, not income.

EQ-010.zh: 低於維持保證金就要補現金或證券。這不是自動改放空，也不是多一筆股息。補 繳會增加你投入的現金，不是創造報酬。
EQ-010.core_idea: If the margin percentage falls below maintenance margin, cash or securities must be deposited 核心觀念｜中文理解：低於維持保證金就要補現金或證券。
EQ-010.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
