EQ-010.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-011.reasoning: Reasoning: Dealers buy at the bid and sell at the ask. The investor is on the other side: buy at the ask, sell at the bid. Immediate purchase therefore pays 27.31. “Buyer pays the bid” reverses who is buying. The midquote is not the execution price in the sources’ quote mechanics.

why_wrong.A: The bid is the price at which the dealer buys — the price the investor receives when selling, not when buying.
why_wrong.B: The sources treat the posted ask as the take-out purchase price; they do not replace it with a midquote.

EQ-011.zh: 投資人買進用ask（較貴），賣出拿到bid（較便宜）。不要把「我是買方」說成 「我付bid」。中間價不是這題的成交價。
EQ-011.core_idea: An investor buys at the ask and sells at the bid; the spread is the investor’s cost of trading 核心觀念｜中文理解：投資人買進用ask（較貴），賣出拿到bid（較便宜）。
EQ-011.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-011.exam_trap: Bid/ask who pays — buyer pays the bid
EQ-011.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-011.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-012.reasoning: Reasoning: Selling immediately hits the posted bid: 41.80. The word “ask” in ordinary English is not the seller’s proceeds. The 0.25 spread is what a round-trip trader loses, not the sale receipt.

why_wrong.A: The ask is what a buyer pays the dealer, not what a seller receives.
why_wrong.C: The spread is the cost of a round trip, not the cash the seller takes home.

EQ-012.zh: 立刻賣出是打在bid 上。Ask 是買方要付給自營商的價格。價差是來回交易成本， 不是賣出拿到的現金。
EQ-012.core_idea: An investor who sells hits the bid; the dealer’s bid is the investor’s sale proceeds 核心觀念｜中文理解：立刻賣出是打在bid 上。
EQ-012.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-012.exam_trap: Bid/ask who pays — seller receives the ask
EQ-012.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-012.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-013.reasoning: Reasoning: Trading cost = Ask - Bid = 63.58 - 63.40 = 0.18. Buying at the ask and selling at the bid loses exactly that spread. Zero assumes the quote can be crossed for free. 0.36 double-counts the same gap. Given: Bid = 63.40; ask = 63.58; buy then immediately sell; ignore commissions. Asked: Round-trip trading cost. Formula: cost = Ask −Bid Variables: Ask is the dealer’s selling price; bid is the dealer’s buying price. Why this formula: The investor buys from the dealer at the ask and sells to the dealer at the bid, so the gap is the cost. The spread is dealer compensation and the investor’s cost, not extra return. Reasonableness check: 0 ignores the spread. 0.36 counts it twice. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Treats a posted two-sided quote as a costless crossing.
why_wrong.C: Counts the spread once on the buy and again on the sell as if both were paid in full on top of a mid-market price the question never uses.

EQ-013.zh: 買用ask、賣用bid，成本就是這一條價差0.18。有報價̸= 免費成交。不要把買賣 各算一次spread。
EQ-013.core_idea: Ask - Bid is the cost of trading; a buy-at-ask / sell-at-bid round trip loses the spread 核心觀念｜中文理解：買用ask、賣用bid，成本就是這一條價差0.18。
EQ-013.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-013.exam_trap: Bid/ask who pays — treating the quote as costless
EQ-013.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-013.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-014.reasoning: Reasoning: Ask = Bid × (1 + spread percentage) = 22.00 × 1.005 = 22.11. The ask exceeds the bid. Leaving the ask at 22.00 denies the spread. Subtracting 0.50% puts the ask below the bid, which the sources do not allow. Given: Bid = 22.00; spread = 0.50% of the bid. Asked: Ask. Formula: Ask = Bid × (1 + s) Variables: s is the spread as a fraction of the bid. Why this formula: The sources write the same spread as a percentage of the bid, which scales the bid up to the ask. Half a percent of 22 is 0.11, added to the bid. Reasonableness check: Ask must exceed bid, so 21.89 is the wrong direction. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Sets ask equal to bid, as if the percentage spread were only a statistic and not a price gap.
why_wrong.B: Subtracts 0.50% from the bid, reversing who is higher.

EQ-014.zh: Ask 一定高於Bid。用Bid 乘上(1+ 價差百分比)。不要把百分比從Bid 扣掉，那 會讓賣價低於買價。
EQ-014.core_idea: Ask = Bid × (1 + bid–ask spread percentage) 核心觀念｜中文理解：Ask 一定高於Bid。
EQ-014.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-014.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-014.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-015.reasoning: Reasoning: Traders who post bids and offers make the market. A quote that improves on the current best bid or offer makes a new market. Hitting those posted prices takes the market. Improving the bid is posting, not taking, and it is not a stop order.

why_wrong.A: Taking the market is hitting a posted price, not posting a better bid.
why_wrong.C: A stop-buy sits above the current price and starts a market order when hit; it is not a better bid.

EQ-015.zh: 掛出更好的買價或賣價是在「做市」（make），而且是make a new market。打上 別人已掛的價格才是take。Stop 是觸發條件，不是改報價。
EQ-015.core_idea: Traders who post bids and offers make the market; traders who hit posted prices take the market 核心觀念｜中文理解：掛出更好的買價或賣價是在「做市」（make），而且是make a new market。
EQ-015.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-015.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-015.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-016.reasoning: Reasoning: A market order takes the best price immediately available: execution is likely, the price is not protected. A limit order will not buy above (or sell below) the limit: the price is protected, the fill is not. Needing the shares tonight and accepting a worse print is the market-order trade-off. A stop-sell starts a sale once triggered.

why_wrong.B: A low limit buy may never fill, which fails the “must own tonight” constraint.
why_wrong.C: A stop-sell is for exiting a long, not for acquiring shares.

EQ-016.zh: 市價單換的是成交、不保護價格。限價單保護價格、不保證成交。今晚一定要拿 到股票，就不要掛一個離市很遠的限價買單。停損賣單是在賣，不是在買。
EQ-016.core_idea: A market order seeks immediate execution without price protection; a limit order protects price, not the fill 核心觀念｜中文理解：市價單換的是成交、不保護價格。
EQ-016.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-016.exam_trap: Using a limit when the constraint is execution, not price
EQ-016.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-016.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-017.reasoning: Reasoning: A marketable limit buy sets the limit above the best offer (or a marketable limit sell sets it below the best bid) so the order takes the quote and fills at once. 18.60 crosses 18.55. 18.20 does not. A stop-buy is a different instruction: it starts a market order only after the stop trades.

why_wrong.A: 18.20 is a resting limit; it does not cross the offer.
why_wrong.B: A stop-buy is not a limit that already crosses the quote; it is a trigger that later becomes a market order.

EQ-017.zh: 可立即成交的限價買單，限價要高過目前最好的ask，才會立刻吃掉報價。掛在 bid 下面是在排队。Stop-buy 是觸發後才變市價單，現在還沒開始交易。
EQ-017.core_idea: A marketable limit buy is set above the best offer so it takes the quote and fills at once 核心觀念｜中文理解：可立即成交的限價買單，限價要高過目前最好的ask，才會立刻吃掉報價。
EQ-017.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-017.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-017.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-018.reasoning: Reasoning: A stop does the opposite of a limit: it starts trading once the condition is met, then becomes a market order at the best available price. The stop price is a trigger, not a guaranteed fill. Filling at 28.80 after a 30 stop is consistent with that mechanics. Calling the stop a limit floor, or treating it as an immediate sale at 34, misreads the instruction.

why_wrong.A: Treating a stop as a limit floor is the sources’ named confusion: a stop starts a trade, it does not cap how bad the print can be.
why_wrong.C: A stop sits inactive until the trigger; it is not a live sale at the current bid.

EQ-018.zh: Stop 是「到價才開始交易」，觸發後變市價單，不保證成交價。不要把stop-loss 當成限價保護。現價34 時這張單還在睡覺，不是立刻以34 賣掉。
EQ-018.core_idea: A stop starts trading once a price condition is met, then becomes a market order; it is not limitprice protection 核心觀念｜中文理解：Stop 是「到價才開始交易」，觸發後變市價單，不保證成交價。
EQ-018.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-018.exam_trap: Reading a stop-loss as limit-price protection
EQ-018.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-018.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-019.reasoning: Reasoning: A stop-sell sits below the current price and can limit the loss on a long. A stop-buy sits above the current price and can limit the loss on a short (or enter after an upside confirmation). A short who needs an upside trigger wants the stop-buy. Relabelling a limit sell as a stop mixes the two instructions.

why_wrong.B: A stop-sell below the market is the long’s loss-limit, not the short’s.
why_wrong.C: A resting limit sell is not a stop; a stop becomes a market order when triggered.

EQ-019.zh: 空單要防價格上漲，停損是在現價上方的stop-buy。現價下方的stop-sell 是多單 在防下跌。限價賣單不會因為「可能成交不了」就變成stop。
EQ-019.core_idea: A stop-sell sits below the current price to limit a long’s loss; a stop-buy sits above to limit a short’s loss 核心觀念｜中文理解：空單要防價格上漲，停損是在現價上方的stop-buy。
EQ-019.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-019.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-019.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-020.reasoning: Reasoning: IOC orders are live only on receipt and may fill in part. FOK is similar but does not allow a partial fill. GTC remains until cancelled. Day orders die at the close. The “live on receipt, partial OK” pair is IOC.

why_wrong.A: FOK is similar but does not allow a partial fill.
why_wrong.B: GTC remains until the client cancels it; it is not a one-touch instruction.

EQ-020.zh: IOC：送到就比對，可以部分成交，剩下取消。FOK：不能部分成交。GTC：一 直掛到客戶取消。不要把「立刻」和「全部」混成同一張單。
EQ-020.core_idea: Day orders die at the close; GTC remains until cancelled; IOC may fill in part; FOK does not allow a partial fill 核心觀念｜中文理解：IOC：送到就比對，可以部分成交，剩下取消。
EQ-020.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-020.exam_trap: Treating IOC and FOK as the same instruction
EQ-020.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-020.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-021.reasoning: Reasoning: Good-on-close fills only at the close — market-on-close if it is a market order. Mutual funds use these because portfolios are marked at the closing price. IOC and FOK answer different validity questions (immediacy and completeness), not the mark-to-close constraint.

why_wrong.A: IOC is about immediacy on receipt, not about matching the official close.
why_wrong.C: FOK bans a partial fill; it does not lock the print to the close.

EQ-021.zh: 基金淨值用收盤價，所以要用收盤才成交的good-on-close / market-on-close。 IOC、FOK 管的是「現在」和「能不能部分成交」，對不齊收盤評價。
EQ-021.core_idea: Good-on-close / market-on-close fills only at the close; mutual funds use these because portfolios are marked at the close 核心觀念｜中文理解：基金淨值用收盤價，所以要用收盤才成交的good-on-close / market-on-close。
EQ-021.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-021.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-021.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-022.reasoning: Reasoning: The primary market is new issuance: IPOs, seasoned (secondary) issues, private placements, and shelf registrations. The word “secondary” in “seasoned (secondary) issue” is the sources’ label for a follow-on by an already-public firm, not investor-to-investor trading. Later trading is the secondary market. A shelf is still primary issuance.

why_wrong.B: The sources use “seasoned (secondary) issue” for new issuance by a firm that is already public; later investor-to-investor trading is the secondary market.
why_wrong.C: Shelf registration is repeat issuance under a master agreement, still primary-market issuance.

EQ-022.zh: 初級市場是公司把「新的」請求權賣出去，包括already-public 之後再發行的 seasoned (secondary) issue。次級市場才是投資人之間轉手。看到secondary issue 不要自動當 成次級市場成交。
EQ-022.core_idea: Primary market is new issuance; later trading is the secondary market 核心觀念｜中文理解：初級市場是公司把「新的」請求權賣出去，包括already-public 之後再發行的seasoned (secondary) issue。
EQ-022.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-022.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-022.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-023.reasoning: Reasoning: Call markets accumulate orders and trade at specific times, can be very liquid in session and illiquid between sessions, and use uniform pricing (one price that clears the book). Continuous markets trade whenever open; trade pricing there can be discriminatory. Brokered markets are for unique or illiquid assets, not for a uniform-price call.

why_wrong.A: A continuous market trades whenever it is open; discriminatory pricing lets time set the price of each match.
why_wrong.B: Brokered markets locate a counterparty for unique or illiquid assets; a scheduled uniform-price session is not that structure.

EQ-023.zh: 集合競價是累積委託、在特定時點用同一個成交價出清。連續競價是開盤就能一 直配對，價格可以一筆一筆不同。經紀撮合是去找特殊資產的對手，不是排程拍賣本身。
EQ-023.core_idea: Call markets accumulate orders and use uniform pricing; continuous markets trade whenever open and can use discriminatory pricing 核心觀念｜中文理解：集合競價是累積委託、在特定時點用同一個成交價出清。
EQ-023.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-023.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-023.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-024.reasoning: Reasoning: Three execution structures: quote-driven (investors trade with dealers who post bids and asks — most non-equity), order-driven (rules match anonymous buyers to sellers), and brokered (a broker locates a counterparty for unique or illiquid assets). Posted dealer quotes do not turn the venue into an order-driven book, and a dealer is not a broker.

why_wrong.A: Order-driven markets match anonymous buyers to sellers by rule; a dealer posting a two-sided quote is a different structure.
why_wrong.C: A dealer trades from inventory; a broker locates a counterparty. Brokered markets are for unique or illiquid assets such as blocks, real estate, or art.

EQ-024.zh: 報價驅動：跟自營商的bid/ask 成交，多數非股票是這樣。委託驅動：規則撮合匿 名買賣。經紀撮合：為了塊狀、不動產、藝術品去找對手。自營商不是經紀商。
EQ-024.core_idea: Quote-driven: trade with dealers. Order-driven: rules match anonymous buyers and sellers. Brokered: a broker locates a counterparty 核心觀念｜中文理解：報價驅動：跟自營商的bid/ask 成交，多數非股票是這樣。
EQ-024.study_section: Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構
EQ-024.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-024.subtopic: 6.1 Market Organization and Structure ｜市場組織與結構

EQ-025.reasoning: Reasoning: Matching is price first. Better prices trade before worse prices. At the same price, displayed liquidity generally has priority over hidden / non-displayed liquidity. Within the displayed class (or within the hidden class), time priority then applies. A hidden bid that arrived first does not automatically defeat a later displayed bid at the same price.

why_wrong.B: Time priority does not automatically beat display status. At the same price, displayed size generally ranks ahead of hidden size even if the hidden order arrived first.
why_wrong.C: Hidden orders wait; they do not receive priority over displayed size at the same price.

EQ-025.zh: 先比價格。同價時，顯示單通常優先於隱藏單；時間優先是在同一類（顯示或隱 藏）裡面才比。隱藏單先到，不能自動贏過後來的同價顯示單。
EQ-025.core_idea: Price priority first; at the same price displayed generally before hidden; time priority within class 核心觀念｜中文理解：先比價格。

EQ-026.reasoning: Reasoning: Trade pricing is uniform in a call market, discriminatory in a continuous market (time can set the price), or derived in a crossing network (the price is taken from another market). Importing another market’s print is derived pricing, not the call’s uniform auction and not the continuous book’s own discriminatory matches.

why_wrong.A: Uniform pricing is the call market’s own clearing price, not a price imported from elsewhere.
why_wrong.B: Discriminatory pricing is the continuous market’s own sequence of match prices.

EQ-026.zh: 交叉網路的成交價是從別的市場「借來的」，叫derived pricing。集合競價的統一 價是自己拍出來的；連續市場的差別定價是自己一筆一筆配出來的。
EQ-026.core_idea: A crossing network derives its price from another market 核心觀念｜中文理解：交叉網路的成交價是從別的市場「借來的」，叫derived pricing。

EQ-027.reasoning: Reasoning: Indexes are used to gauge sentiment; to proxy returns, systematic risk, and riskadjusted performance; to represent asset classes; to benchmark active portfolios (a passive fund is trying to match the index, not beat it); and as model portfolios for products such as ETFs. Matching is the passive benchmark use. It does not imply inefficiency, and it is not the definition of reconstitution.

why_wrong.A: Passive investing is the working strategy when markets are efficient; existence of a tracker is not evidence of inefficiency.
why_wrong.C: Reconstitution is the index provider changing membership; the fund copies that decision, it does not define reconstitution.

EQ-027.zh: 被動基金的工作是對齊指數，不是打敗它。這是基準／模型投組用途。有追蹤基 金̸= 市場沒效率。成分調整是指數公司在換名單。
EQ-027.core_idea: Indexes gauge sentiment, proxy returns and risk, represent asset classes, benchmark active portfolios, and serve as model portfolios 核心觀念｜中文理解：被動基金的工作是對齊指數，不是打敗它。

EQ-028.reasoning: Reasoning: Rebalancing restores weights to the method’s targets. Reconstitution changes membership (and usually the weights) and can move the prices of names about to enter or leave. Restoring 1/N after price drift, with the same names, is rebalancing.

why_wrong.B: Reconstitution changes membership. Here membership is unchanged.
why_wrong.C: A divisor reset is the price-weighted response to a split or membership change, not an equal-weight 1/N restore.

EQ-028.zh: 再平衡是把權重拉回方法規定的目標（等權就是再拉回1/N）。成分調整是換進換 出名單。拆股改除數是價格加權的動作。
EQ-028.core_idea: Rebalancing restores weights to the method’s targets; reconstitution changes membership (and usually the weights) 核心觀念｜中文理解：再平衡是把權重拉回方法規定的目標（等權就是再拉回1/N）。

EQ-029.reasoning: Reasoning: A price index uses security prices; its percentage change is the price return (PRI). Adding the return from dividends gives the total return (TRI). Over a long sample TRI exceeds PRI, because dividends are a positive piece of return. Do not treat a price return as a total return, and do not subtract dividends from the price path.

why_wrong.A: A price index omits dividends; the series do not coincide when dividends are positive.
why_wrong.B: Dividends are added in TRI, not subtracted. TRI is the larger path when dividends are positive.

EQ-029.zh: PRI 只看價格；TRI 把股息加回來。股息為正時，夠長的期間TRI 會高於PRI。 不要把價格漲幅當成總報酬，也不要把股息從指數裡扣掉。
EQ-029.core_idea: Price return uses prices only; total return adds the dividend piece; over a long sample TRI exceeds PRI 核心觀念｜中文理解：PRI 只看價格；TRI 把股息加回來。

EQ-030.reasoning: Reasoning: Levels chain as V_T = V_0 × (1+TRI_1) × (1+TRI_2) × ￿. 500 × 1.08 × 0.97 = 523.80. Adding 8% and -3% first, then applying 5% once, skips the compound. Dropping Year 2 leaves the index at 540. Given: V0 = 500; TRI1 = 8%; TRI2 = -3%. Asked: Total-return index level at the end of Year 2. Formula: V2 = 500 × (1.08) × (0.97) Variables: Each TRI is that year’s total return, already including dividends. Why this formula: Each period’s ending level is the starting point for the next period’s return. A later negative year compounds on the already-higher Year-1 level. Reasonableness check: 525 applies a net +5% once. 540 stops after Year 1. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Adds the two rates, 500 × (1 + 0.08 - 0.03) = 525, instead of compounding.
why_wrong.C: Compounds only the first year and ignores the second, 500 × 1.08 = 540.

EQ-030.zh: 多期指數水準是相乘，不是把各年報酬加減完再乘一次。500×1.08×0.97=523.80。 525 是先把8% 和-3% 抵成5%。
EQ-030.core_idea: Index levels chain as a product of (1 + period returns); do not add the period returns 核心觀念｜中文理解：多期指數水準是相乘，不是把各年報酬加減完再乘一次。

EQ-031.reasoning: Reasoning: Year 1 TRI = 6% + 2% = 8%. Chain: 2,000 × 1.08 × 1.05 = 2,268. Using 6% in Year 1 treats PRI as TRI. 2,260 adds 8% and 5% instead of compounding. Given: V0 = 2,000; Year 1 PRI = 6%, dividend return = 2%; Year 2 TRI = 5%. Asked: Total-return index level after two years. Formula: V2 = 2,000 × (1.06 + 0.02) × (1.05) Variables: TRI1 must include the dividend piece before chaining. Why this formula: The total-return index compounds total returns, not price returns. Omitting the 2% dividend in Year 1 understates the starting point for Year 2. Reasonableness check: 2,226 uses 1.06 in Year 1. 2,260 is an add-up, not a product. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Chains Year 1’s price return only: 2,000 × 1.06 × 1.05 = 2,226.
why_wrong.C: Adds the two total returns and applies once: 2,000 × (1 + 0.08 + 0.05) = 2,260.

EQ-031.zh: 第一年總報酬是價格6% 加股息2% ＝8%，再和次年5% 相乘： 2,000×1.08×1.05=2,268。只用6% 是把PRI 當TRI。2,260 是把兩年報酬加總一次。
EQ-031.core_idea: Year-1 TRI is PRI plus the dividend return; then chain the total-return factors 核心觀念｜中文理解：第一年總報酬是價格6% 加股息2% ＝8%，再和次年5% 相乘： 2,000×1.08×1.05=2,268。

EQ-032.reasoning: Reasoning: Price weight is P_i / Σ P_i. Here 48/78 ≈61.5%, 18/78 ≈23.1%, 12/78 ≈15.4%. A high-priced name moves the index more than a low-priced name with the same percentage change — the weights are somewhat arbitrary. Equal-weight is 1/N. A cheap-stock tilt versus this index is what equal-weight does, not what price-weight does. Given: Prices 12, 18, 48. Asked: Which name dominates a given percentage move. Formula: w48 = 48/(12 + 18 + 48) = 48/78 Variables: No share counts enter a price-weighted weight. Why this formula: The index is an average of prices, so a higher price is a larger slice of the average. A 10% move in the 48 name is a 4.8-point price change; a 10% move in the 12 name is 1.2 points. Reasonableness check: 1/3 would be equal-weight. Cheap-name dominance is the opposite tilt. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
EQ-032.steps: ①Sum of prices = 78. ②Weight of the 48 name = 48/78 ≈61.5%.

why_wrong.A: Equal weight is 1/N in dollars, a different method. Price-weighting uses prices, not equal dollars.
why_wrong.B: Price-weighting loads on high-priced names; the cheap-stock tilt is equal-weight versus price-weight, or fundamental versus cap-weight.

EQ-032.zh: 價格加權的權重是股價除以股價合計。48 那檔權重最大，同樣漲跌幅它最能拉動 指數。等權才是每檔1/N。便宜股權重較高是等權相對價格加權的結果，不是價格加權本身。
EQ-032.core_idea: Price-weighted weight is the name’s price over the sum of prices; a high-priced name moves the index more 核心觀念｜中文理解：價格加權的權重是股價除以股價合計。

EQ-033.reasoning: Reasoning: A price-weighted index is the arithmetic average of prices (after a divisor). A portfolio that holds an equal number of shares matches it. Equal dollars match equal-weight. Float-cap proportions match a float-adjusted value index.

why_wrong.A: Equal dollars replicate an equal-weighted index, not a price-weighted index.
why_wrong.C: Float-adjusted cap weights replicate a float-adjusted market-cap index.

EQ-033.zh: 價格加權：每檔買一樣的股數。等權：每檔買一樣的金額。自由流通市值加權： 按可投資市值比例抱。三種對沖方法不要對調。
EQ-033.core_idea: A portfolio that holds an equal number of shares matches a price-weighted index 核心觀念｜中文理解：價格加權：每檔買一樣的股數。
EQ-033.study_section: Security Market Indexes ｜證券市場指數

EQ-034.reasoning: Reasoning: A split would jump the average unless the divisor is changed so that the index value is unchanged. After the 2-for-1, prices are 16, 24, and 24. The new divisor satisfies (16+24+24)/d = 29.333, so d = 2.182. The index stays 29.33. 21.33 keeps the old divisor of 3. The split itself did not crash the index. Given: Pre-split prices 16, 24, 48; d = 3; 48-name splits 2-for-1. Asked: Index value immediately after the split. Formula: (16 + 24 + 24)/d = 29.333 Variables: d is reset so V is unchanged at the split instant. Why this formula: The split is not an economic loss; the divisor absorbs the mechanical drop in the price sum. Later genuine price changes, not the split, move the index. Reasonableness check: 21.33 is the trap that keeps d = 3. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
EQ-034.steps: ①Pre-split V = (16+24+48)/3 = 88/3 = 29.333. ②Post-split prices 16, 24, 24. Sum = 64. ③Choose d so 64/d = 29.333 →d = 2.182. ④Index remains 29.33.

why_wrong.B: Recomputes (16+24+24)/3 = 21.33 and forgets to reset the divisor.
why_wrong.C: Reports the new low price of the split stock as if it were the index.

EQ-034.zh: 拆股會讓價格加總變小，所以要改divisor，讓指數當下不變。還用除數3 會算出 21.33，好像指數崩了，其實那只是忘了重設。
EQ-034.core_idea: After a split, the price-weighted divisor is reset so the index value is unchanged 核心觀念｜中文理解：拆股會讓價格加總變小，所以要改divisor，讓指數當下不變。
EQ-034.study_section: Security Market Indexes ｜證券市場指數
EQ-034.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-034.subtopic: 6.2 Security Market Indexes ｜證券市場指數

EQ-035.reasoning: Reasoning: V = (22+28+34)/2.00 = 84/2 = 42.00. The split already reset the divisor; subsequent price changes do the work. Staying at 40 ignores those changes. Using divisor 3 treats the index as “three stocks” again and undoes the reset. Given: Post-split d = 2.00; later prices 22, 28, 34. Asked: Later price-index level. Formula: V = (22 + 28 + 34)/2.00 Variables: Use the reset divisor, not the original stock count. Why this formula: The divisor is a level-preserving scalar; after the reset it stays until the next corporate action or membership change. The index rose because the price sum rose, not because of the earlier split. Reasonableness check: 40 is the frozen post-split level. 28 uses d = 3. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Leaves the index at the post-split 40, as if a price-weighted index never moved after a divisor reset.
why_wrong.B: Averages the new prices with a divisor of 3: (22+28+34)/3 = 28.

EQ-035.zh: 除數已經在拆股當下重設完了，之後就用新除數去除新的價格加總。還停在40 是 假裝後來價格沒動；改回除數3 是把重設作廢。
EQ-035.core_idea: After the divisor reset, later price changes — not the split — move a price-weighted index 核心觀念｜中文理解：除數已經在拆股當下重設完了，之後就用新除數去除新的價格加總。

EQ-036.reasoning: Reasoning: Equal-weight price return is the arithmetic average of the percentage changes: (12 - 6 + 9)/3 = 5.00%. No share counts are needed. 12% is one name, not the index. 2% drops a constituent or otherwise fails to average all three. Given: Three names; returns +12%, -6%, +9%; equal-weighted. Asked: Index price return. Formula: R = (0.12 −0.06 + 0.09)/3 Variables: Each name has dollar weight 1/N at the start of the period. Why this formula: Equal dollars mean each percent return gets the same weight. The down name pulls as hard as either up name because weights are equal. Reasonableness check: 12% is not an average. 2% is an incomplete average. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Takes the largest constituent return as the index return.
why_wrong.C: Averages only the first two names and drops the third: (12 - 6)/3 = 2.00%.

EQ-036.zh: 等權的價格報酬就是各檔報酬率的算術平均。(12-6+9)/3=5%。不要只看漲最多 的那檔，也不要漏掉一檔再平均。
EQ-036.core_idea: Equal-weighted price return is the arithmetic average of the constituents’ percentage changes 核心觀念｜中文理解：等權的價格報酬就是各檔報酬率的算術平均。
EQ-036.study_section: Security Market Indexes ｜證券市場指數
EQ-036.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-036.subtopic: 6.2 Security Market Indexes ｜證券市場指數

EQ-037.reasoning: Reasoning: Equal weights are 1/N in dollars; a price move breaks that, so the index must rebalance. Market-cap weights use Q×P; a split changes Q and P in offsetting ways and does not require a divisor reset. Momentum bias is the value-weighted (including float-adjusted) story: winners become larger weights. Equal-weight does the opposite rebalance — sell winners, buy losers — to restore 1/N.

why_wrong.B: A split divisor reset is the price-weighted rule, not the market-cap rule. Capweighting does not need a split divisor.
why_wrong.C: Momentum — names that have already risen get larger weights — is a value-weighted trait, not an equal-weight trait.

EQ-037.zh: 等權是金額1/N，價格一動權重就歪，所以要常再平衡。市值加權遇拆股不必改 除數（那是價格加權）。動能偏向是市值加權的問題：漲過的權重變大。
EQ-037.core_idea: Equal-dollar weights drift as prices move, so an equal-weighted index needs frequent rebalancing 核心觀念｜中文理解：等權是金額1/N，價格一動權重就歪，所以要常再平衡。

EQ-037.exam_trap: Assigning the split-divisor or momentum rule to the wrong index

EQ-038.reasoning: Reasoning: Equal-weight is 1/N. Relative to the market’s actual value weights, large names are underrepresented and small names are overrepresented. That small-cap overweight is also a reason an equal-weighted index of the same names can outperform a cap-weighted index. Price-weighting, not equal-weighting, loads on high-priced names. Cap-weighting is the method that matches value proportions.

why_wrong.A: Highest-priced names dominate a price-weighted index, not an equal-weighted index.
why_wrong.B: Matching actual value proportions is the economic advantage of marketcap weighting.

EQ-038.zh: 同樣的股票，等權會把小市值捧高、大市值壓低。高價股權重大是價格加權。對 齊市場真實市值比例的是市值加權。
EQ-038.core_idea: Relative to market value weights, equal-weight underrepresents large names and overrepresents small names 核心觀念｜中文理解：同樣的股票，等權會把小市值捧高、大市值壓低。
EQ-038.study_section: Security Market Indexes ｜證券市場指數
EQ-038.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-038.subtopic: 6.2 Security Market Indexes ｜證券市場指數

EQ-039.reasoning: Reasoning: Price-weights are 8/60, 12/60, and 40/60 — the 40 name is two-thirds of the index. Equal-weight is 1/3 each, so it puts more weight on the cheaper stocks and less on the expensive one. Equal-weight is not a price average and does not use P_i in the numerator.

why_wrong.A: Loading on the high-priced name is the price-weighted tilt. Equal-weight does not copy that tilt.
why_wrong.C: Those fractions are the price-weights, not equal-weights. Equal-weight is 1/3 each.

EQ-039.zh: 價格加權裡40 那檔權重約三分之二；等權每檔三分之一，所以較便宜的兩檔權重 被拉高。等權的分子不是價格。
EQ-039.core_idea: Relative to a price-weighted index of the same names, equal-weight puts more weight on cheaper stocks 核心觀念｜中文理解：價格加權裡40 那檔權重約三分之二；等權每檔三分之一，所以較便宜的兩檔權重被 拉高。
EQ-039.study_section: Security Market Indexes ｜證券市場指數
EQ-039.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-039.subtopic: 6.2 Security Market Indexes ｜證券市場指數

EQ-040.reasoning: Reasoning: Market values are 400×10 = 4,000; 100×20 = 2,000; 50×40 = 2,000. Total = 8,000. w1 = 4,000/8,000 = 50%. Shares outstanding enter the weight. 1/3 is equal-weight. 10% treats the raw price as a weight. Given: Q = (400, 100, 50); P = (10, 20, 40); full market-cap weights. Asked: Weight of the first name. Formula: w1 = (400 × 10)/(400 × 10 + 100 × 20 + 50 × 40) Variables: Q is shares outstanding, not free float. Why this formula: Value weighting is each name’s market value over the basket’s market value. The first name is half the index even though it is not the highest-priced name. Reasonableness check: Equal-weight would be 33.3%. Price-weight would load on the 40 name. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Uses 1/3, as if the index were equal-weighted.
why_wrong.C: Uses the price weight 10/(10+20+40) = 14.3%, or the share-count weight 400/550, closest listed wrong price-only reading is 10% as if weight were the price itself.

EQ-040.zh: 市值加權要股數乘價格。第一檔4,000，總市值8,000，權重50%。等權才是33%。 只看股價10 不會得到權重。
EQ-040.core_idea: Market-cap weight is Q_i P_i over the index’s total market value; shares outstanding enter the weight 核心觀念｜中文理解：市值加權要股數乘價格。
EQ-040.study_section: Security Market Indexes ｜證券市場指數
EQ-040.source_note: 解答依據 EQ_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Equity Investments。
EQ-040.subtopic: 6.2 Security Market Indexes ｜證券市場指數

EQ-041.reasoning: Reasoning: In a market-cap index the weight is Q_i P_i. A split raises Q and cuts P so that product is unchanged; no divisor reset is required. Treating every split like a price-weighted average, or calling a split reconstitution, applies the wrong construction rule.

why_wrong.A: The split-divisor rule is the price-weighted mechanical fix. Cap-weighting already uses Q×P; Q triples when P falls to one-third.
why_wrong.B: A split is not a membership change. Reconstitution changes which names are inside the index.

EQ-041.zh: 市值加權的權重是股數× 價格。拆股讓股數變多、單價變小，乘積不變，不必為 了「指數不要崩」去改除數。那是價格加權的手續。拆股也不是換成分。
EQ-041.core_idea: A split or stock dividend does not require a market-cap divisor reset 核心觀念｜中文理解：市值加權的權重是股數× 價格。
EQ-041.study_section: Security Market Indexes ｜證券市場指數

EQ-042.reasoning: Reasoning: Cap-weight return is the value-weighted average, equivalently the percentage change in total market cap. Weights are 60/100 and 40/100. Return = 0.60×10% + 0.40×(-5%) = 6% - 2% = 4%. Equal-weight would be 2.50%. The 10% name is not the whole index. Given: Beginning MV 60 and 40; returns +10% and -5%. Asked: Cap-weighted price return. Formula: R = 0.60(0.10) + 0.40(−0.05) Variables: Beginning market values set the weights. Why this formula: The index is the basket’s total market cap; its percent change is the value-weighted return. Ending MV = 66 + 38 = 104; 104/100 - 1 = 4%. Reasonableness check: 2.50% is equal-weight. 10% ignores the second name. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Averages the two returns equally: (10 - 5)/2 = 2.50%.
why_wrong.C: Takes the larger name’s return as the index return.

EQ-042.zh: 市值加權報酬是各檔報酬按市值加權，也等於總市值的百分比變化。60:40 權重下 是4%。等權才是2.5%。大的那檔不是整座指數。
EQ-042.core_idea: A cap-weighted price return is the percentage change in the index’s total market cap 核心觀念｜中文理解：市值加權報酬是各檔報酬按市值加權，也等於總市值的百分比變化。

EQ-043.reasoning: Reasoning: Like other value weights, float-adjusted weights have a momentum bias: names that have already risen get larger weights. Doubling Name A’s price, other things equal, doubles its float market value and its weight. Fundamental-weighted indexes are the ones that shift away from names that have risen on price alone.

why_wrong.B: Contrarian versus a price run-up is the fundamental-weighted story, not the float-cap story.
why_wrong.C: Value weights are not 1/N, and reconstitution is a membership change, not a freeze at equal weight.

EQ-043.zh: 市值／自由流通市值加權有動能偏向：已經漲過的權重變大。基本面加權才是逆 勢，會把「只靠價格漲上去」的權重拆下來。等權不是市值加權的預設。
EQ-043.core_idea: Value weights have a momentum bias: names that have already risen get larger weights 核心觀念｜中文理解：市值／自由流通市值加權有動能偏向：已經漲過的權重變大。

EQ-044.reasoning: Reasoning: Float market values are 0.25×800×20 = 4,000 and 1.00×200×20 = 4,000. Total = 8,000. w1 = 50%. The controlling block cuts the first name from an 80% full-cap weight to a 50% float weight. The 25% float fraction is an input, not the weight. Given: P = 20, 20; Q = 800, 200; f = 0.25, 1.00. Asked: Float-adjusted weight of the first name. Formula: w1 = (0.25 × 800 × 20)/(0.25 × 800 × 20 + 1 × 200 × 20) Variables: f_i is the free-float fraction available to the investing public. Why this formula: Only investable shares enter a float-adjusted value weight. A large controlling block is why the first name is not 80% of this index. Reasonableness check: 80% is the full-cap weight. 25% is f, not w. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Uses full shares outstanding: (800×20)/(800×20+200×20) = 80%.
why_wrong.B: Reports the free-float fraction 25% as if it were already the index weight.

EQ-044.zh: 自由流通市值＝流通比例× 股數× 價格。第一檔4,000、第二檔4,000，權重各 50%。若用全部股本，第一檔會占80%。0.25 是流通比例，不是權重本身。
EQ-044.core_idea: Float-adjusted weight replaces shares outstanding with shares available to the investing public 核心觀念｜中文理解：自由流通市值＝流通比例× 股數× 價格。

EQ-045.reasoning: Reasoning: Float-adjusted market-cap replaces shares outstanding with shares actually available to the investing public. A firm with a large controlling block gets less weight than it does in a full market-cap index. Constituents are held in proportion to their float in the target market. Float adjustment is not a book-value scheme.

why_wrong.A: A controlling block reduces, not increases, the investable market value.
why_wrong.C: Book-value weighting is fundamental weighting, a third method.

EQ-045.zh: 大股東鎖住的持股不進自由流通量。同一家公司在float-adjusted 指數裡的權重， 會小於全市值指數。這不是改用帳面價值加權。
EQ-045.core_idea: A firm with a large controlling block gets less weight in a float-adjusted index than in a full market-cap index 核心觀念｜中文理解：大股東鎖住的持股不進自由流通量。

EQ-046.reasoning: Reasoning: Fundamental weight is F_i / Σ F_i (earnings, book, dividends, cash flow). Against a market-cap counterpart, the index has a value tilt — higher book, earnings, and dividends relative to market value — and is contrarian rather than momentum: it shifts away from names that have risen on price alone. It is not equal-weight and it is not a momentum index.

why_wrong.B: Momentum is the value-weighted price story. A book-value weight does not automatically rise when only the price rises.
why_wrong.C: Equal-weight is 1/N, not F_i / Σ F_i. Book values differ across names, so the weights are not equal.

EQ-046.zh: 基本面加權用盈餘、帳面、股息、現金流當分子。相對市值加權，它偏價值，而 且是逆勢：價格自己漲、基本面沒跟上，權重反而相對下降。這不是等權，也不是動能指數。
EQ-046.core_idea: Fundamental weight is F_i over the sum of that fundamental; versus cap-weight it has a value tilt and is contrarian 核心觀念｜中文理解：基本面加權用盈餘、帳面、股息、現金流當分子。

EQ-047.reasoning: Reasoning: A broad market index usually covers more than 90% of the equity market’s value. That is a value-coverage test, not a 100%-of-tickers test and not a mandate to use price weights.

why_wrong.A: Broad is a value-coverage idea (more than 90%), not a requirement to hold every ticker.
why_wrong.B: Weighting method is a separate construction choice; broad indexes are commonly value-weighted, not required to be price-weighted.

EQ-047.zh: 廣義市場指數通常覆蓋該股市市值的90% 以上。不是必須納入每一檔股票，也不 是必須用價格加權。
EQ-047.core_idea: A broad market index usually covers more than 90% of the equity market’s value 核心觀念｜中文理解：廣義市場指數通常覆蓋該股市市值的90% 以上。

EQ-048.reasoning: Reasoning: A sector index follows an economic sector. Sector indexes add up to the broad market index; they show whether an active result came from stock selection or from sector allocation, and they are model portfolios for sector ETFs. They are not a different weighting religion, and they do not shut down attribution when the parent is broad.

why_wrong.A: Sector indexes are slices of the same market; they are not a change of weighting method by definition.
why_wrong.C: Coverage of the broad index is a construction fact, not a rule that forbids attribution.

EQ-048.zh: 產業指數加總就是廣義市場指數。主動超額是來自選股還是產業配置，要靠這一 層拆。它不是換一套加權方法，也不會因為母指數夠廣就禁止拆解。
EQ-048.core_idea: Sector indexes add up to the broad market and help separate stock selection from sector allocation 核心觀念｜中文理解：產業指數加總就是廣義市場指數。

EQ-049.reasoning: Reasoning: A style index cuts by size (large to small) and/or by value versus growth. Exchange and currency are different classification choices (country of listing, or how a DR is quoted), not the style definition.

why_wrong.B: Listing venue is not the sources’ style cut.
why_wrong.C: Quotation currency is not the sources’ style cut.

EQ-049.zh: 風格指數是按市值大小，以及／或價值對成長來切。上市地點或報價貨幣不是這 裡的style。
EQ-049.core_idea: A style index cuts by size and/or by value versus growth 核心觀念｜中文理解：風格指數是按市值大小，以及／或價值對成長來切。
EQ-049.study_section: Security Market Indexes ｜證券市場指數

EQ-050.reasoning: Reasoning: A multi-market index combines country or regional markets. One construction capweights inside each country and then weights the country indexes by a fundamental such as GDP. The country layer is therefore not pure global cap-weight. It is not a price-weighted world index, and it is not equal-weight at the name level.

why_wrong.A: GDP is a fundamental, not a price. The stock layer is cap-weighted, not price-weighted.
why_wrong.B: Cap-weight inside countries plus GDP across countries is not 1/N at the stock level.

EQ-050.zh: 這種跨市場指數：國家內用市值加權，國家之間用GDP 這類基本面再加權。全球 並不是單一的市值比例，更不是價格加權或每檔1/N。
EQ-050.core_idea: One multi-market construction cap-weights inside each country and then weights country indexes by a fundamental such as GDP 核心觀念｜中文理解：這種跨市場指數：國家內用市值加權，國家之間用GDP 這類基本面再加權。
EQ-050.study_section: Security Market Indexes ｜證券市場指數
