DER-048.reasoning: Reasoning: At expiration, exercise a call if ST - X > 0 and a put if X - ST > 0. Otherwise the option is worth zero. Payoff is the exercise decision. Profit then subtracts the premium the long paid. They are not the same number. A long call that expires at-the-money has payoff 0 and profit -c0.

why_wrong.B: ATM (ST = X) gives payoff 0; there is nothing to exercise for.
why_wrong.C: The exercise decision is the payoff test max(0, ST - X), not the profit test. You may exercise with negative profit if ST > X.

DER-048.zh: 到期要不要行權，只看ST 是否大於X（call）。那是payoff。Profit 還要再減已付 權利金。價平payoff 是0，profit 仍虧權利金。
DER-048.core_idea: Exercise a call if ST - X > 0; otherwise the call is worth zero
DER-048.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-048.exam_trap: Reporting payoff as if it were profit (exercise rule vs profit rule)
DER-048.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-048.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-049.reasoning: Reasoning: Payoff = max(0, 71 - 60) = 11. Profit = 11 - 4 = 7. The premium is a sunk cash outflow for the long; forgetting it overstates the long’s result by c0. The question asked for profit, not payoff. The long is the buyer who paid 4. Given: Long call; X = 60; c0 = 4; ST = 71. Asked: Profit (not payoff). Formula: max(0, 71 −60) −4 Variables: Payoff is the exercise value; profit subtracts the premium the long paid. Why this formula: Profit = expiration value of the right minus what was paid for the right. The long made 7 after paying 4 for an 11 payoff. Reasonableness check: 11 is payoff. 4 is the premium alone. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 4 is the premium, unconnected to the 11-point exercise value.
why_wrong.C: 11 is the payoff max(0, 71 - 60), with the premium treated as zero.

DER-049.zh: 題目問profit。Payoff = 11，再減權利金4，得7。選11 是把權利金當零；選4 是只回報已付權利金。先寫payoff，再減p0/c0。
DER-049.core_idea: Long-call profit is max(0, ST - X) - c0, not the raw payoff 核心觀念｜中文理解：題目問profit。
DER-049.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-049.exam_trap: Reporting payoff as if it were profit
DER-049.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-049.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-050.reasoning: Reasoning: ST = X ⇒call payoff = 0. Profit = 0 - 2.50 = -2.50. Seeing “at the money” and writing profit = 0 is the payoff-as-profit trap. Breakeven for a long call is X + c0 = 47.50, not X. Given: Long call; X = 45; c0 = 2.50; ST = 45. Asked: Payoff and profit. Formula: 0 −2.50 Variables: ATM ⇒payoff 0; profit still charges the premium. Why this formula: Exercise value is zero; the premium is not refunded. ATM is not a scratch once a premium was paid. Reasonableness check: Zero profit requires ST = 47.50 if the call is exercised. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
DER-050.steps: ①Payoff = max(0, 0) = 0. ②Profit = -2.50. ③Breakeven would be 47.50.

why_wrong.A: The premium is not an ATM payoff. Payoff = max(0, 45 - 45) = 0.
why_wrong.B: ATM is a zero payoff, not a zero profit. The premium is already gone.

DER-050.zh: 價平call 的payoff 是0，profit 仍是-2.50。損益兩平在X+c0=47.50，不是執行 價。不要把ATM 聽成scratch。
DER-050.core_idea: A long call that expires at the strike has payoff 0 and profit -c0 核心觀念｜中文理解：價平call 的payoff 是0，profit 仍是-2.50。
DER-050.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-050.exam_trap: Reporting payoff as if it were profit
DER-050.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-050.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-051.reasoning: Reasoning: Profit = max(0, ST - 70) - 4 = 0 and the call is exercised ⇒ST - 70 = 4 ⇒ST = 74. The breakeven for a long call is X + c0, not X. In the chapter’s X = 100, c0 = 3 illustration, ST = 103 is the zero-profit call, not a 3 gain. Given: Long call; X = 70; c0 = 4; seek ST such that Π = 0 and the call is exercised. Asked: Breakeven spot. Formula: 70 + 4 Variables: Payoff must cover the premium. Why this formula: Set max(0, ST - X) - c0 = 0 with ST > X. Four points of payoff cancel the 4 premium. Reasonableness check: 70 leaves profit -4. 66 is the put-style subtraction. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 66 subtracts the premium from the strike, which is the long-put breakeven direction.
why_wrong.C: 70 is the strike. Payoff is then 0 and profit is -4, not zero.

DER-051.zh: Long call 損益兩平是X+c0=74，不是執行價70。70 的payoff 是0、profit 是-4。 66 是把權利金往下減，那是long put 的方向。
DER-051.core_idea: Long-call breakeven is X + c0, not X 核心觀念｜中文理解：Long call 損益兩平是X+c0=74，不是執行價70。
DER-051.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-051.exam_trap: Reporting payoff as if it were profit — breakeven at X instead of X+c0
DER-051.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-051.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-052.reasoning: Reasoning: Payoff = max(0, 30 - 24) = 6. Profit = 6 - 2 = 4. The question asked for profit, not payoff. The long paid 2; that cash is not returned. Given: Long put; X = 30; p0 = 2; ST = 24. Asked: Profit. Formula: max(0, 30 −24) −2 Variables: Long put payoff floors at 0; profit still subtracts p0. Why this formula: Profit = exercise value minus premium paid. The put paid 6 and cost 2. Reasonableness check: 6 is payoff. -2 ignores the 6-point intrinsic. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: -2 subtracts the premium as if the put expired worthless. It did not: payoff is 6.
why_wrong.C: 6 is the payoff max(0, 30 - 24), with the premium ignored.

DER-052.zh: Payoff = 6，profit = 6-2 = 4。選6 是只算行權價差；選-2 是當成到期沒價值還 在扣權利金。先寫payoff 再減p0。
DER-052.core_idea: Long-put profit is max(0, X - ST) - p0 核心觀念｜中文理解：Payoff = 6，profit = 6-2 = 4。
DER-052.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-052.exam_trap: Reporting payoff as if it were profit
DER-052.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-052.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-053.reasoning: Reasoning: Payoff = max(0, 83 - 80) = 3. Profit = 3 - 6 = -3. Exercise and a positive payoff do not imply a positive profit. The breakeven is 86. This is the chapter’s ST = 103 / c0 = 3 idea with new numbers: payoff 3 is a zero-profit call only when c0 = 3. Given: Long call; X = 80; c0 = 6; ST = 83. Asked: Payoff and profit. Formula: 3 −6 Variables: ITM payoff can still leave negative profit. Why this formula: Subtract the premium after the exercise value. Three points of intrinsic do not cover a 6 premium. Reasonableness check: Do not stop at 3. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: ST = 83 > 80, so the call is exercised. Payoff is not zero.
why_wrong.C: Payoff 3 is correct; profit is 3 - 6 = -3, not +3.

DER-053.zh: 行權了、payoff 是3，但權利金是6，profit 是-3。有行權̸= 有賺錢。損益兩平在 86。
DER-053.core_idea: A long call can be exercised and still show a profit loss if ST - X < c0 核心觀念｜中文理解：行權了、payoff 是3，但權利金是6，profit 是-3。
DER-053.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-053.exam_trap: Reporting payoff as if it were profit
DER-053.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-053.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-054.reasoning: Reasoning: Short-call payoff = -max(0, 52 - 40) = -12. Profit = -12 + 5 = -7. For the short, profit adds the premium received. Forgetting it understates the short’s result (makes it look worse) by c0. Name the side: this is the writer, not the long. Given: Short call; X = 40; c0 = 5; ST = 52. Asked: Writer’s profit. Formula: −12 + 5 Variables: Short profit adds the premium received. Why this formula: The writer already cashed 5; expiration obligation is -12. The written call lost 7 after keeping 5. Reasonableness check: -12 is payoff. 5 assumes no exercise. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 5 is the premium as if the call expired worthless. ST = 52 is deep in the money.
why_wrong.B: -12 is the short’s payoff, with the received premium ignored.

DER-054.zh: Short call 的payoff 是-12，再加上已收權利金5，profit = -7。選-12 是忘了加權 利金；選5 是當成沒被行權。空方是加權利金，多方是減。
DER-054.core_idea: Short-call profit is -max(0, ST - X) + c0
DER-054.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-054.exam_trap: Reporting payoff as if it were profit — short side
DER-054.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-054.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-055.reasoning: Reasoning: Short-put payoff = -max(0, 25 - 18) = -7. Profit = -7 + 1.50 = -5.50. The writer is forced to buy at 25 an asset worth 18. That obligation is not a long stock, even though both are hurt by a decline. Name payoff versus profit; name long versus short. Given: Short put; X = 25; p0 = 1.50; ST = 18. Asked: Writer’s profit. Formula: −7 + 1.50 Variables: Short put is the obligation to buy at X, not a long stock. Why this formula: Add the premium received to the negative exercise value. Premium 1.50 only partially offsets a 7-point assignment. Reasonableness check: -7 is payoff. 1.50 assumes expiration worthless. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 1.50 treats the put as expiring OTM. It is ITM by 7.
why_wrong.C: -7 is the short-put payoff -max(0, 25 - 18), premium omitted.

DER-055.zh: Short put payoff = -7，加已收1.50，profit = -5.50。這是被迫用25 接值18 的 貨，不是做多現貨。不要把payoff 當profit。
DER-055.core_idea: Short-put profit is -max(0, X - ST) + p0
DER-055.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-055.exam_trap: Reporting payoff as if it were profit — short put
DER-055.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-055.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-056.reasoning: Reasoning: Profit = max(0, 20 - ST) - 1.80 = 0 and the put is exercised ⇒20 - ST = 1.80 ⇒ST = 18.20. Long-put breakeven is X - p0. Always name payoff versus profit before solving for ST. Given: Long put; X = 20; p0 = 1.80; Π = 0 and exercised. Asked: Breakeven ST. Formula: 20 −1.80 Variables: Put payoff must cover p0. Why this formula: Set X - ST = p0. The underlying must fall 1.80 below the strike to repay the premium. Reasonableness check: 20 leaves -1.80. 21.80 is the call-style add. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 21.80 adds the premium, which is the long-call breakeven direction.
why_wrong.B: 20 is the strike: payoff 0, profit -1.80.

DER-056.zh: Long put 損益兩平是X-p0=18.20。20 只是執行價；21.80 是誤用call 的往上加。
DER-056.core_idea: Long-put breakeven is X - p0, not X
DER-056.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-056.exam_trap: Reporting payoff as if it were profit — put breakeven at X
DER-056.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-056.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-057.reasoning: Reasoning: Π = max(0, ST - 90) - 5 = 0 and exercised ⇒ST = 95. The chapter’s algebra: if the call’s profit is zero at maturity and the call is exercised, ST - F0(T) = c0, so F0(T) = ST - c0: the contracted forward price is below the underlying by exactly the option premium. New numbers (not the book’s 100 / 3 / 103). Given: Call and forward both struck at 90; c0 = 5; call profit = 0 and exercised. Asked: ST. Formula: 90 + 5 Variables: X = F0(T) = 90. Why this formula: Zero profit on an exercised call means payoff equals the premium. Spot sits one premium above the common strike. Reasonableness check: 90 and 85 do not zero the call profit. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
DER-057.steps: ①ST - 90 = 5. ②ST = 95. ③Then F0 = ST - c0 = 90.

why_wrong.A: 85 subtracts the premium. That is not the exercised-call zero-profit point.
why_wrong.B: 90 is the strike: call profit is -5, not zero.

DER-057.zh: Call 零利潤且有行權⇒ST = X+c0 = 95。90 會虧權利金5。這也表示遠期契約 價比現貨低正好一個權利金。
DER-057.core_idea: If a call’s profit is zero at maturity and the call is exercised, ST - F0(T) = c0 when X = F0(T) 核心觀念｜中文理解：Call 零利潤且有行權⇒ST = X+c0 = 95。
DER-057.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-057.formula: ST −F0(T) = c0 when X = F0(T) and Π = 0
DER-057.exam_trap: Reporting payoff as if it were profit — zero profit at the strike
DER-057.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-057.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-058.reasoning: Reasoning: A purchased put’s loss is the premium. A short forward’s loss is not capped. If the share price exceeds the forward price by more than the initial put premium, the loss on the forward sale exceeds the loss on the purchased put. Here 10 > 3. Directional similarity (both like lower prices) is not payoff identity. Given: Put: X = 50, p0 = 3. Short forward at 50. ST = 60. Asked: Compare losses. Formula: put loss 3; short fwd 50 −60 = −10 Variables: Name each contract and whether the result is payoff or profit. Why this formula: Put profit floors at -p0. Short forward is linear and uncapped. The extra 7 of forward loss is the uncapped left tail’s opposite: an uncapped right-tail loss for the short. Reasonableness check: Do not force both to -10. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: A long put is not a short stock and not a short forward. At ST = 60 the put expires worthless (loss = 3). The short forward loses 60 - 50 = 10.
why_wrong.C: Zero value is at initiation, not at T. Short-forward payoff = F0 - ST = -10.

DER-058.zh: Long put 最多虧權利金3；short 遠期在60 虧10，沒有上限。不要說long put = short 現貨= short 遠期。遠期到期價值不必為零。
DER-058.core_idea: A purchased put’s loss is the premium; a short forward’s loss is not capped 核心觀念｜中文理解：Long put 最多虧權利金3；short 遠期在60 虧10，沒有上限。
DER-058.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-058.formula:
Πlong put = −p0 if ST > X;
Πshort fwd = F0 −ST
DER-058.exam_trap: Equating long put with short the underlying (or with a short forward)
DER-058.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-058.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-059.reasoning: Reasoning: Payoff is the exercise decision. Profit subtracts the premium the long paid, or adds the premium the short received. They are not the same number. Always name the side (long/short) and name payoff versus profit before computing.

why_wrong.B: If payoff already netted the premium, the chapter would not write Π = payoff - c0.
why_wrong.C: The premium is cash. Forgetting it overstates the long by c0 or p0 and understates the short by the same amount.

DER-059.zh: Payoff 只問到期行權能拿多少；profit 還要把已付或已收的權利金算進去。看到 「賺了多少」先問題幹要的是哪一個。
DER-059.core_idea: Payoff is the exercise decision; profit subtracts (long) or adds (short) the premium
DER-059.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-059.exam_trap: Reporting payoff as if it were profit
DER-059.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-059.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-060.reasoning: Reasoning: ATM put payoff = max(0, 50 - 50) = 0. Profit = 0 - 3 = -3. The long paid 3 for a right that expired worthless. Name payoff versus profit. Given: Long put; X = 50; p0 = 3; ST = 50. Asked: Profit. Formula: 0 −3 Variables: ATM ⇒payoff 0. Why this formula: Premium is not refunded at ATM. ATM is a full-premium loss for the long. Reasonableness check: 0 is payoff. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 3 is the premium treated as a gain, or a sign error on the long.
why_wrong.B: 0 is the payoff, reported as if it were profit.

DER-060.zh: 價平put 的payoff 是0，profit 是-3。選0 是標準陷阱；選3 是把付出的權利金 當成賺到的。
DER-060.core_idea: A long put that expires at the strike has payoff 0 and profit -p0
DER-060.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-060.exam_trap: Reporting payoff as if it were profit
DER-060.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-060.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-061.reasoning: Reasoning: Moneyness compares the spot with the strike: call ITM if S > X; put ITM if S < X; both ATM if S = X. An option that would pay if exercised now is ITM. Do not bring PV(X) into moneyness or into ordinary exercise value.

why_wrong.A: Moneyness compares the spot with the strike, not with PV(X). S = 42 ̸= 40, so neither is ATM.
why_wrong.C: S > X makes the call ITM and the put OTM, not the reverse.

DER-061.zh: 價內外是即期對執行價：42>40，call 價內、put 價外。不要用PV(X) 來判斷 moneyness。
DER-061.core_idea: A call is ITM when S > X; a put is ITM when S < X

DER-062.reasoning: Reasoning: Intrinsic / exercise value is the value from immediate exercise: call intrinsic = max(0, S - X) = max(0, 48 - 45) = 3. Do not call S - PV(X) the ordinary exercise value. For European options, expressions that use PV(X) belong to the no-arbitrage price lower bound, not to intrinsic value. Mixing the two overstates a European call’s “intrinsic” by the financing gap between X and PV(X): 45 - 42.86 = 2.14, and 3 + 2.14 = 5.14. Given: S = 48; X = 45; r = 5%; T = 1; European call, no dividend. Asked: Ordinary intrinsic / exercise value. Formula: max(0, 48 −45) = 3; S −PV(X) = 48 −45/1.05 = 5.14 Variables: PV(X) is for the lower bound, not for intrinsic. Why this formula: Immediate exercise delivers S - X cash, not S - PV(X). Exercise now captures 3, not the discounted-strike gap. Reasonableness check: 5.14 is the trap number. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
DER-062.steps: ①Immediate exercise = 48 - 45 = 3. ②S - PV(X) = 5.14 is the bound, not the answer. ③The 2.14 gap is X - PV(X).

why_wrong.A: 48 is the spot, not the immediate-exercise amount.
why_wrong.C: 5.14 is 48 - 45/1.05 = S - PV(X), the no-arbitrage lower-bound ingredient, not ordinary exercise value.

DER-062.zh: 立刻行權能拿多少，才叫intrinsic：48-45=3。S-PV(X)=5.14 是歐式下限材料， 不是ordinary exercise value。兩者差在X 與PV(X) 的融資缺口。
DER-062.core_idea: Call intrinsic / exercise value is max(0, S - X), not S - PV(X) 核心觀念｜中文理解：立刻行權能拿多少，才叫intrinsic：48-45=3。

DER-063.reasoning: Reasoning: S = X ⇒call intrinsic = max(0, 0) = 0. Time value is the whole premium. S - PV(X) = 3.85 is positive and is part of the European lower bound max(0, S - PV(X)), not the exercise value. Mixing the two overstates “intrinsic” by the financing gap. Given: S = X = 100; r = 4%; T = 1. Asked: Ordinary exercise value. Formula: max(0, 100 −100) = 0; 100 −100/1.04 = 3.85 Variables: ATM does not make S - PV(X) an exercise value. Why this formula: Immediate exercise of an ATM call delivers nothing. The entire premium is time value. Reasonableness check: 3.85 is the trap. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
DER-063.steps: ①S - X = 0. ②Intrinsic = 0. ③Ignore 3.85 as intrinsic.

why_wrong.B: 4.00 is r × X, another way of writing the financing gap, still not immediate exercise.
why_wrong.C: 3.85 is 100 - 100/1.04 = S - PV(X). That is a lower-bound figure, not intrinsic.

DER-063.zh: 價平立刻行權拿不到錢，intrinsic = 0。S-PV(X)=3.85 仍是歐式下限，不是行使 價值。
DER-063.core_idea: An ATM European call has intrinsic 0 even though S - PV(X) is positive 核心觀念｜中文理解：價平立刻行權拿不到錢，intrinsic = 0。

DER-064.reasoning: Reasoning: Put intrinsic = max(0, X - S) = max(0, 70 - 62) = 8. Do not replace that with a discounted figure, and do not call S - PV(X) (the wrong sign and the wrong object) the put’s exercise value. European lower bounds may use present values; ordinary intrinsic does not. Given: S = 62; X = 70. Asked: Ordinary put intrinsic. Formula: 70 −62 Variables: Immediate exercise, not PV. Why this formula: Exercise now sells the asset for X. Eight points of immediate put exercise. Reasonableness check: Do not discount the 8 to invent an “intrinsic.” 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Exercise value is X - S, not X itself.
why_wrong.B: Discounting the 8 is a European timing/lower-bound instinct, not ordinary exercise value. Intrinsic is immediate exercise: 70 - 62 = 8.

DER-064.zh: Put 的intrinsic 是立刻用70 賣出值62 的標的，得8。不要折現，也不要用 S-PV(X) 套到put 上。
DER-064.core_idea: Put intrinsic is max(0, X - S), not a PV-of-strike construction 核心觀念｜中文理解：Put 的intrinsic 是立刻用70 賣出值62 的標的，得8。

DER-064.exam_trap: Calling S-PV(X) the call’s exercise value — put version

DER-065.reasoning: Reasoning: Intrinsic = max(0, 52 - 50) = 2. Time value = premium - intrinsic = 7 - 2 = 5. Time value decays toward zero at expiry. Do not back out a PV(X) story when the inputs are not even in the stem. Given: Call premium = 7; S = 52; X = 50. Asked: Time value. Formula: 7 −max(0, 52 −50) Variables: Intrinsic from immediate exercise only. Why this formula: Time value is the residual of the premium after intrinsic. Five of the seven points are not immediate exercise. Reasonableness check: 7 is the premium. A PV construction is unsupported here. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: S - PV(X) is not time value, and no rate or maturity was given for that construction.
why_wrong.B: 7 is the whole premium, i.e. intrinsic plus time value, not time value alone.

DER-065.zh: 權利金7 = 內含2 + 時間價值5。時間價值到期走向0。不要把S-PV(X) 當成時 間價值，題目也沒給利率。
DER-065.core_idea: Option premium = intrinsic value + time value; time value decays toward zero at expiry

DER-065.exam_trap: Calling S-PV(X) the call’s exercise value — leaking into time value

DER-066.reasoning: Reasoning: A European option cannot trade below a PV-based floor such as max(0, S - PV(X)) for a call on a non-dividend asset. That bound can exceed immediate-exercise value because X is not due today. Calling the bound “intrinsic” overstates exercise value by X - PV(X).

why_wrong.A: The chapter separates the objects: intrinsic is immediate exercise max(0, S - X). The PV expression is the floor on the European price.
why_wrong.B: Time value is premium minus intrinsic, not S - PV(X).

DER-066.zh: max(0, S-PV(X)) 是歐式無套利價格下限，不是intrinsic。Intrinsic 是max(0, S-X)。下限可以比立刻行權大，因為執行價不是今天付。
DER-066.core_idea: The European call lower bound is max(0, S - PV(X)) for a non-dividend asset; that is not intrinsic 核心觀念｜中文理解：max(0, S-PV(X)) 是歐式無套利價格下限，不是intrinsic。

DER-067.reasoning: Reasoning: If the strike equals the forward price, a long forward’s value is St - PVt(F0(T)), which can be negative. A call struck at that same F0(T) floors the same comparison at zero. Do not relabel S - PV(X) as intrinsic, and do not relabel the call as the forward.

why_wrong.A: S - PV(X) is the European lower bound, not intrinsic, and it is not equal to a -2 forward MTM as a definition of intrinsic.
why_wrong.C: A call is not a forward. The call’s expiration payoff is max(0, ST - F0), not ST - F0.

DER-067.zh: 遠期MTM 可以是-2；同一執行價的call 把這條比較卡在0。Call 不是遠期。 S-PV(X) 也不是intrinsic。
DER-067.core_idea: If the strike equals the forward price, a long forward’s value St - PV(F0) can be negative; a call floors that comparison at zero

DER-068.reasoning: Reasoning: Put ITM only if S < X. Here S > X ⇒OTM ⇒intrinsic = max(0, 50 - 55) = 0. The 5-point gap is the call’s immediate exercise, not the put’s. Given: S = 55; X = 50; put. Asked: Ordinary intrinsic. Formula: max(0, 50 −55) Variables: OTM put ⇒0. Why this formula: Immediate sale at 50 of a 55 asset would lose money, so no exercise. OTM put has no immediate-exercise value. Reasonableness check: 5 is the call. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: PV constructions are not ordinary put intrinsic. Immediate exercise of this put is worthless.
why_wrong.C: 5 would be the call’s intrinsic, or a sign error on the put (X - S is -5, floored at 0).

DER-068.zh: 55>50，put 價外，intrinsic = 0。5 是call 的內含。不要自創折現式當put intrinsic。
DER-068.core_idea: A put is OTM when S > X; intrinsic is then 0 even if X - PV(S) is cooked up

DER-068.exam_trap: Calling S-PV(X) the call’s exercise value — wrong object on a put

DER-069.reasoning: Reasoning: Ordinary intrinsic = max(0, 80 - 76) = 4. S - PV(X) = 80 - 76/1.05 = 80 - 72.38 = 7.62. Excess = 7.62 - 4 = 3.62, which is exactly X - PV(X) = 76 - 72.38. Mixing the two overstates “intrinsic” by that financing gap. Given: S = 80; X = 76; r = 5%; T = 1. Asked: S - PV(X) minus ordinary intrinsic. Formula: (80 −76/1.05) −(80 −76) Variables: The gap is the financing of X. Why this formula: Algebra: S - X(1+r)^-T - (S - X) = X - X(1+r)^-T. That 3.62 is why the objects must not be swapped. Reasonableness check: They are not identical, so the difference is not 0. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: The chapter says they are not the same object. The gap is the financing difference.
why_wrong.C: 4 is X × r, a linear approximation to the financing gap, not the exact X - PV(X) = 76 - 76/1.05 = 3.62.

DER-069.zh: Intrinsic = 4。S-PV(X) = 7.62。多出來的3.62 正好是X-PV(X)。把下限當內含， 會高估這一段融資差。
DER-069.core_idea: Mixing intrinsic with S - PV(X) overstates European-call “intrinsic” by X - PV(X) 核心觀念｜中文理解：Intrinsic = 4。

DER-070.reasoning: Reasoning: A long put has negative delta and benefits from price declines, but the payoff is nonlinear and floored. A short stock’s loss when S rises is not capped at a premium. Directional similarity is not payoff identity. Long put ̸= short the underlying.

why_wrong.A: The chapter’s trap is exactly this false shortcut. Do not write long put = short stock.
why_wrong.C: A short forward is a linear firm commitment with no premium floor. A long put is a contingent claim.

DER-070.zh: 方向都是標的跌才賺，但long put 有下限、非线性；放空現貨是直線、上漲虧損 無上限。Long put ̸= short 現貨。不要背這個捷徑。
DER-070.core_idea: Directional similarity is not payoff identity: long put ̸= short the underlying 核心觀念｜中文理解：方向都是標的跌才賺，但long put 有下限、非线性；放空現貨是直線、上漲虧損無 上限。

DER-071.reasoning: Reasoning: Long-put payoff = max(0, 40 - 55) = 0; profit = -2. Short share sold at 40 and the asset is 55: mark = -15. Both positions wanted a lower S, but the numbers differ. Never replace the put with a short stock. Given: Long put X = 40, p0 = 2; short share at 40; ST = 55. Asked: Compare P&L. Formula: put 0 −2; short 40 −55 Variables: Name each instrument; name payoff vs profit on the put. Why this formula: Contingent floor versus linear short. The extra 13 is why the shortcut fails. Reasonableness check: Do not force -15 on the put. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
DER-071.steps: ①Put OTM ⇒profit -2. ②Short share -15. ③Reject equality.

why_wrong.A: The put expires OTM: profit = -2, not -15. The shortcut long put = short stock is false.
why_wrong.C: The floor belongs to the put (loss = premium), not to the short share.

DER-071.zh: ST=55：put 價外，profit=-2；放空現貨虧15。方向相同、數字不同。禁止寫 long put = short stock。
DER-071.core_idea: A short stock’s loss is uncapped as S rises; a long put’s loss is the premium
DER-071.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-071.formula:
Πlong put = max(0, X −ST ) −p0;
Πshort share = S0 −ST
DER-071.exam_trap: Equating long put with short the underlying

DER-072.reasoning: Reasoning: A short put has positive delta, but it is not equivalent to owning the underlying. Directional similarity is not payoff identity. If S collapses, the short put is forced to buy at a rich X; that is related to, but not the same payoff as, holding the share from S0.

why_wrong.A: A short put collected a premium and has a floored assignment profile; a long forward has no premium and is linear.
why_wrong.B: The chapter forbids both shortcuts. Short put ̸= long the underlying.

DER-072.zh: Short put 和做多現貨都喜歡漲，但short put 不是持有現貨：你收了權利金，跌 深時被迫用X 接貨。Short put ̸= 做多現貨。
DER-072.core_idea: A short put is not a long stock even though both have positive delta

DER-072.exam_trap: Equating short put with long the underlying

DER-073.reasoning: Reasoning: Short-put payoff = -max(0, 40 - 22) = -18; profit = -18 + 2 = -16. Long share = 22 - 40 = -18. The 2-point gap is the premium the put writer kept. That single number already shows the positions are not identical. Name long/short and payoff/profit. Given: Short put X = 40, p0 = 2; long share at 40; ST = 22. Asked: Compare profits. Formula: −18 + 2 vs 22 −40 Variables: Assignment versus ownership. Why this formula: The put writer keeps p0; the stockholder does not. Premium income is why the short put is not the share. Reasonableness check: Do not report both as -18 or both as -16. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
DER-073.steps: ①Put assignment 18; profit -16. ②Share -18. ③Not equal.

why_wrong.A: Equality is the forbidden shortcut.
why_wrong.B: Long share = 22 - 40 = -18. The premium 2 does not attach to the stock unless you invent a package the stem does not give.

DER-073.zh: ST=22：short put 的profit 是-18+2=-16；做多現貨是-18。差在權利金。不是 同一個部位。
DER-073.core_idea: At a large decline, a short put’s loss is X - ST - p0, not the share’s S0 - ST 核心觀念｜中文理解：ST=22：short put 的profit 是-18+2=-16；做多現貨是-18。

DER-073.formula:
Πshort put = −max(0, X −ST ) + p0;
Πlong share = ST −S0

DER-074.reasoning: Reasoning: Long-put payoff = max(0, 25 - 0) = 25; profit = 25 - 3 = 22. Short share sold at 25, covers at 0: +25. Same crisis, different cash. The put paid 3 for the floor; the short share did not. Given: Long put X = 25, p0 = 3; short share at 25; ST = 0. Asked: Compare profits. Formula: 25 −3 vs 25 −0 Variables: Floor versus linear short. Why this formula: The put’s profit nets the premium; the short stock does not. The 3-point gap is the premium, the whole point of the distinction. Reasonableness check: Do not write both 25. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
DER-074.steps: ①Put profit = 22. ②Short share = 25. ③Reject equality.

why_wrong.B: The shortcut that sets them equal is false.
why_wrong.C: The short share covers at 0 and keeps the entire 25 sale proceeds. It does not pay a put premium.

DER-074.zh: 標的跌到0：long put 拿到25、扣權利金3，profit=22；放空現貨賺滿25。不是 同一個數字，更不是同一個部位。
DER-074.core_idea: A long put’s gain if S goes to zero is X - p0, not the short stock’s S0

DER-075.reasoning: Reasoning: Positive delta is a direction, not a replication. The call can expire worthless after paying c0; the share still has ST. Do not import the put/stock false shortcut onto calls.

why_wrong.B: A long call floors at zero payoff; a long forward can be negative. Different contracts.
why_wrong.C: There is no such identity. Long call ̸= long stock.

DER-075.zh: Long call 和做多現貨都要漲，但call 虧最多權利金、payoff 有下限；股票沒有這 個地板。不要發明long call = long stock。
DER-075.core_idea: A long call is not a long stock even though both have positive delta

DER-076.reasoning: Reasoning: Short-forward profit = 80 - 91 = -11 (uncapped linear). Long-put profit = 0 - 4 = -4. The chapter’s comparison: if the share exceeds the forward price by more than the initial put premium (11 > 4), the forward-sale loss exceeds the purchased-put loss. Given: Short forward 80; long put X = 80, p0 = 4; ST = 91. Asked: Compare losses. Formula: 80 −91 = −11; 0 −4 = −4 Variables: Uncapped short commitment versus floored put. Why this formula: Put profit cannot be worse than -p0. The extra 7 is the uncapped gap. Reasonableness check: Not both -11. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: The cap (loss = premium) is on the put, not on the forward.
why_wrong.B: The put is OTM at 91; it does not lose 11. Long put ̸= short forward.

DER-076.zh: 現貨91：short 遠期虧11（無上限）；long put 只虧權利金4。11>4，正好是課文 那個比較。不要把put 改寫成遠期。
DER-076.core_idea: If ST exceeds F0 by more than the put premium, the short-forward loss exceeds the purchased-put loss

DER-077.reasoning: Reasoning: Risky asset plus derivative equals a risk-free position, so the derivative can be isolated as a combination of the asset and risk-free borrowing or lending. That is a signed package, not the false identity long put = short stock.

why_wrong.A: ∆is chosen so the two binomial states cancel; it is not “always short one share.”
why_wrong.C: Replication for a put uses the hedge-ratio ∆= (pu - pd)/(Su - Sd), which is not automatically -1, plus lending or borrowing.

DER-077.zh: 複製是「∆份標的+ 借入或放貸」，不是把long put 改寫成裸空一股。∆由兩個 狀態算出來，通常不是-1。
DER-077.core_idea: Replication uses the asset plus borrowing or lending; it does not replace a put with a naked short stock
DER-077.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-077.exam_trap: Equating long put with short the underlying — fake replication shortcut
DER-077.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-077.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-078.reasoning: Reasoning: If the underlying price S increases: call higher, put lower. If the exercise price X increases: call lower, put higher. Those are opposite claims on the same comparison S versus X.

why_wrong.B: The table: S up →call higher, put lower.
why_wrong.C: Volatility is what raises both. A higher S helps the call and hurts the put.

DER-078.zh: 標的漲：call 貴、put 便宜。執行價漲：call 便宜、put 貴。兩邊一起變貴的是波 動，不是S。
DER-078.core_idea: Higher S raises a call and lowers a put; higher X does the reverse
DER-078.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-078.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-078.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-079.reasoning: Reasoning: Risk-free rate (options on assets other than bonds): higher r →call higher, put lower. Intuition that stays inside the chapter: a higher r raises the forward, which helps the claim that benefits from a higher future S (the call) and hurts the put.

why_wrong.B: Dividends / holding benefits lower the call and raise the put — the opposite pairing.
why_wrong.C: Volatility raises both. The rate effect is signed: call up, put down (non-bond underlyings).

DER-079.zh: 非債券標的：利率升，call 升、put 降。不要和波動（兩邊都升）或持有利益（call 降put 升）搞反。
DER-079.core_idea: A higher risk-free rate (options on assets other than bonds) raises the call and lowers the put
DER-079.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-079.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-079.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-080.reasoning: Reasoning: Volatility raises both values because the long cannot do worse than zero and can do better in the tail. That is the nonlinear floor — another reason a long put is not a short stock (a short stock does worse than zero in a rally, with no floor at a premium).

why_wrong.B: S has opposite effects. Volatility does not.
why_wrong.C: The long’s floor at zero is why extra dispersion is valuable to both sides’ buyers.

DER-080.zh: 波動升，call 和put 都變貴：買方虧不超過零，多出來的尾巴歸買方。這也說明 long put 不是short 現貨——現貨上漲沒有權利金地板。
DER-080.core_idea: Higher volatility raises both the call and the put
DER-080.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-080.exam_trap: Equating long put with short the underlying — volatility helps the put, not a short stock the same way
DER-080.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-080.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-081.reasoning: Reasoning: Time to expiration is not automatic for every put. Longer life usually helps because there is more room for volatility. For some European puts — especially deep ITM puts when the risk-free rate is high and expiration is already distant — stretching maturity further can lower the value, because the intrinsic amount is received only at expiration and a later cash inflow is worth less today.

why_wrong.B: The chapter’s exception is only for some European puts (deep ITM, high r, already-distant expiration). It is not “every put rises.”
why_wrong.C: Time to expiration is higher for the call in the table. It is not a discount that lowers every call.

DER-081.zh: 到期變長，call 一定較有利；put 通常也是，但深度價內的歐式put，在利率高、 到期已很遠時，再拉長可能變便宜——錢更晚才拿到。
DER-081.core_idea: More time usually raises both values; some deep-ITM European puts can fall as maturity lengthens
DER-081.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-081.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-081.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-082.reasoning: Reasoning: Benefits of holding the asset (dividends, interest, convenience yield): call lower, put higher. Storage costs: call higher, put lower. Storage costs make owning the asset itself less attractive, so the call (which does not require holding the asset) is worth more and the put (which is tied to delivering the asset) is worth less.

why_wrong.A: Storage costs have the opposite pairing: call higher, put lower.
why_wrong.C: Benefits of owning the asset make holding the asset itself more attractive relative to the call.

DER-082.zh: 股息、便利收益率讓持有現貨更值得：call 變便宜、put 變貴。倉儲成本相反： call 貴、put 便宜。
DER-082.core_idea: Benefits of holding the asset (dividends, convenience yield) lower the call and raise the put
DER-082.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-082.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-082.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-083.reasoning: Reasoning: Storage costs make owning the asset itself less attractive, so the call is worth more and the put is worth less. That is the same qualitative direction as a higher carry cost in the forward price: costs raise F0, which helps calls and hurts puts.

why_wrong.B: Dividends / convenience yield are the opposite row.
why_wrong.C: Costs do not automatically reduce every derivative. They make cash ownership less attractive, which helps the call.

DER-083.zh: 倉儲讓持有現貨更痛苦，call（不必持有現貨）變貴，put 變便宜。和股息那一列 正好相反。
DER-083.core_idea: Storage costs raise the call and lower the put
DER-083.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-083.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-083.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-084.reasoning: Reasoning: The only contractual difference is early exercise. For a call on an asset with no cash flows during the option’s life, early exercise has no advantage, so otherwise identical American and European calls have the same value.

why_wrong.A: The European cannot be worth more: it is the American minus an unused right.
why_wrong.B: The extra right has no value when it has no advantage. Values are then equal, not strictly American-rich.

DER-084.zh: 標的在存續期沒有現金流，提前行權call 沒好處，美式與歐式call 同價。多一個 用不到的權利，不必嚴格更貴。
DER-084.core_idea: With no cash flows during the option’s life, American and European calls have the same value
DER-084.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-084.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-084.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-085.reasoning: Reasoning: If the underlying pays a dividend, an American call can be worth more than the European call: the cash payment drops the asset and hurts a European call that cannot be exercised before the drop.

why_wrong.A: The European cannot exercise into the dividend; it is the one that can be hurt by the drop.
why_wrong.C: No-cash-flow is the equal-value case. A dividend is the exception that can make early exercise useful.

DER-085.zh: 有股息時，美式call 可能比歐式貴：股息會把股價打下來，歐式不能在除息前行 權。
DER-085.core_idea: A dividend can make an American call worth more than the European call
DER-085.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-085.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-085.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-086.reasoning: Reasoning: Cash distributions do not create an early-exercise argument for puts. The cash-timing argument still can: collect X now rather than PV(X) at expiration. That can put American puts above European puts.

why_wrong.B: The chapter’s zero-underlying example is exactly an early-exercise case for the American put.
why_wrong.C: A lower post-dividend S helps the put; that is why cash distributions are not an early-exercise argument for puts.

DER-086.zh: 股息不會讓put 想提前行權——股價被打低對put 有利。但深度價內put 可能為 了「現在就拿到X」而提前：標的跌到0，美式立刻收X，歐式只能等到到期拿PV(X)。
DER-086.core_idea: Cash distributions do not create an early-exercise argument for puts; a deep-ITM American put can still exceed the European for cash-timing reasons
DER-086.study_section: Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值
DER-086.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-086.subtopic: 8.2 Option payoffs and time value ｜選擇權到期損益與時間價值

DER-087.reasoning: Reasoning: Hedge accounting lets the derivative offset the hedged transaction or balance-sheet item and reduces reported volatility. Three types: cash-flow, fair-value, net-investment.

why_wrong.A: The chapter lists cash-flow, fair-value, and net-investment hedges — not a single type.
why_wrong.B: Without hedge accounting, derivatives can hit earnings. Hedge accounting is the offset that reduces reported vol.

DER-087.zh: 避險會計讓衍生工具去對沖被避險項目，降低帳上波動。三種：現金流、公允價 值、淨投資。
DER-087.core_idea: Hedge accounting lets the derivative offset the hedged item and reduces reported volatility
DER-087.study_section: Benefits, risks, and hedge accounting ｜效益、風險與避險會計
DER-087.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-087.subtopic: 8.3 Benefits, risks, and hedge accounting ｜效益、風險與避險會計

DER-088.reasoning: Reasoning: Cash-flow hedge: varying cash flows (for example floating-rate payments). The chapter’s example is a pay-fixed swap on floating-rate debt. Locking floating coupons into a fixed obligation is that cash-flow hedge, not a fair-value hedge of already-fixed debt.

why_wrong.A: Fair-value hedge example is a pay-float swap on fixed-rate debt (or commodity futures on inventory).
why_wrong.B: Net-investment is FX risk of the equity of a foreign operation — currency swap or currency forward.

DER-088.zh: 浮動負債鎖成固定，對的是現金流波動→現金流避險（pay-fixed）。公允價值避 險是固定利率債配pay-float。淨投資是國外營運的匯率。
DER-088.core_idea: A pay-fixed swap on floating-rate debt is a cash-flow hedge
DER-088.study_section: Benefits, risks, and hedge accounting ｜效益、風險與避險會計
DER-088.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-088.subtopic: 8.3 Benefits, risks, and hedge accounting ｜效益、風險與避險會計

DER-089.reasoning: Reasoning: Fair-value hedge: varying fair value of an asset or liability. The chapter’s example is a pay-float swap on fixed-rate debt (and commodity futures on inventory when a lower future price is the concern). Classification only: do not import a cash-flow-hedge story onto already-fixed coupons.

why_wrong.B: The debt is fixed-rate; there are no floating cash flows to absorb. Cash-flow hedge is the other swap.
why_wrong.C: Net-investment is about FX equity of a foreign operation, not a domestic rate swap on debt.

DER-089.zh: 固定利率負債配pay-float swap，課文歸類為公允價值避險。不要把它說成浮動利 息的現金流避險，更不是淨投資避險。
DER-089.core_idea: A pay-float swap on fixed-rate debt is a fair-value hedge
DER-089.study_section: Benefits, risks, and hedge accounting ｜效益、風險與避險會計
DER-089.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-089.subtopic: 8.3 Benefits, risks, and hedge accounting ｜效益、風險與避險會計

DER-090.reasoning: Reasoning: Net-investment hedge: FX risk of the equity of a foreign operation. Example: currency swap or currency forward. Keep the three types apart.

why_wrong.B: Pay-fixed on floating debt is cash-flow, not FX equity.
why_wrong.C: Commodity futures on inventory is the fair-value example.

DER-090.zh: 國外營運權益的匯率風險→淨投資避險，工具是貨幣swap 或貨幣遠期。不要和 利率負債、商品庫存那兩類對調。
DER-090.core_idea: A currency swap or currency forward on the equity of a foreign operation is a net-investment hedge
DER-090.study_section: Benefits, risks, and hedge accounting ｜效益、風險與避險會計
DER-090.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-090.subtopic: 8.3 Benefits, risks, and hedge accounting ｜效益、風險與避險會計

DER-091.reasoning: Reasoning: Benefits: transfer risk without trading the underlying; create exposures that do not exist in cash; reveal expected future prices and implied vol; smaller cash outlay; possibly higher liquidity; easier shorts. Risks are a separate list.

why_wrong.A: Leverage inviting speculative distress is listed as a risk, not a benefit.
why_wrong.C: Basis risk — a gap between the derivative’s expected value and the underlying — is a listed risk.

DER-091.zh: 好處：不用買賣現貨就能移轉風險、能創造現貨沒有的曝險、市場透露出預期價 格與隱含波動、現金占用較小。槓桿傷害和基差風險是壞處，不是好處。
DER-091.core_idea: Benefits include transferring risk without trading the underlying, revealing expected prices and implied vol, smaller cash outlay
DER-091.study_section: Benefits, risks, and hedge accounting ｜效益、風險與避險會計
DER-091.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-091.subtopic: 8.3 Benefits, risks, and hedge accounting ｜效益、風險與避險會計

DER-092.reasoning: Reasoning: Risks include: leverage and speculative distress; transparency (added positions can be hard to see); basis risk (gap between the derivative’s expected value and the underlying); liquidity risk (gap in cash-flow timing); excessive leverage feeding market stress; futures users failing a margin call (counterparty credit risk in that form). The long option buyer faces the writer’s default.

why_wrong.B: Novation removes bilateral default exposure; it is not the definition of basis risk.
why_wrong.C: Payoff versus profit is a different distinction, not “basis.”

DER-092.zh: 基差風險是衍生工具預期價值和標的之間的缺口。不是結算所的novation，也不 是payoff 對profit。
DER-092.core_idea: Basis risk is a gap between the derivative’s expected value and the underlying
DER-092.study_section: Benefits, risks, and hedge accounting ｜效益、風險與避險會計
DER-092.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-092.subtopic: 8.3 Benefits, risks, and hedge accounting ｜效益、風險與避險會計

DER-093.reasoning: Reasoning: Liquidity risk is a gap in cash-flow timing. Futures users can fail a margin call — counterparty credit risk in that form. Those are risks, not the “smaller cash outlay” benefit.

why_wrong.A: Daily MTM does not erase basis risk. Basis is the gap versus the underlying, not the variation-margin process.
why_wrong.C: A margin call is a cash-timing / credit event, not a benefit.

DER-093.zh: 期貨補繳保證金補不出來，是課文列的信用／流動性風險。不要把保證金追繳說 成「衍生工具現金占用小所以免費」。
DER-093.core_idea: Liquidity risk is a gap in cash-flow timing; futures users can fail a margin call
DER-093.study_section: Benefits, risks, and hedge accounting ｜效益、風險與避險會計
DER-093.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-093.subtopic: 8.3 Benefits, risks, and hedge accounting ｜效益、風險與避險會計

DER-094.reasoning: Reasoning: If a replicating portfolio matches the derivative’s cash flows, the two must trade at the same price. A long-and-short combination of the asset and the replicating book has a certain payoff, so risk aversion drops out of the price — risk-neutral pricing.

why_wrong.A: Intrinsic is immediate exercise, not the no-arbitrage price of a live European option.
why_wrong.B: Risk-adjusted discounting of a real-world forecast is what the chapter says is not the method. π* is a pricing probability, not that forecast.

DER-094.zh: 衍生工具用無套利／複製來定價，不是用真實世界期望損益再加風險溢酬折現。 風險規避會消掉。Intrinsic 也不是活著的歐式價格。
DER-094.core_idea: Derivatives are valued from a no-arbitrage condition, not by discounting expected cash flows at a risk-adjusted rate
DER-094.study_section: Arbitrage, carry, and forward pricing ｜套利、持有成本與遠期定價
DER-094.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-094.subtopic: 8.4 Arbitrage, carry, and forward pricing ｜套利、持有成本與遠期定價

DER-095.reasoning: Reasoning: Same future cash flows, different prices (law of one price). Sell the expensive, buy the cheap, pocket the opening gap. Offsetting terminal cash flows leave the opening 0.40 as a riskless profit. New numbers (not the chapter’s 99 / 99.15). Given: Two claims each worth 100 later; prices 88 and 88.40. Asked: Arbitrage opening cash. Formula: 88.40 −88 = 0.40 Variables: Same terminal, different price. Why this formula: Law of one price. The gap is the arbitrage. Reasonableness check: The other side loses 0.40 for sure. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
DER-095.steps: ①Sell B at 88.40, buy A at 88. ②Pocket 0.40. ③At T, 100 covers 100.

why_wrong.B: Buying the dear and selling the cheap is the wrong side of the inequality.
why_wrong.C: You do not need both; you need a long-cheap / short-dear package.

DER-095.zh: 未來現金流相同、現價不同：賣貴的、買便宜的，先入口袋0.40，到期兩邊的100 對沖。不要買貴賣便宜。
DER-095.core_idea: Law of one price: same future cash flows must have the same price, or buy cheap / sell dear
DER-095.study_section: Arbitrage, carry, and forward pricing ｜套利、持有成本與遠期定價
DER-095.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-095.subtopic: 8.4 Arbitrage, carry, and forward pricing ｜套利、持有成本與遠期定價

DER-096.reasoning: Reasoning: A known future price that is not the present value of that price at the appropriate discount rate: if S0 is not equal to the discounted known ST, trade the cheap side against the dear side until the equality holds.

why_wrong.A: You do not “fix” the quote by inventing a new discount rate. You trade.
why_wrong.C: The trades force the equality now; they do not wait for T.

DER-096.zh: 未來價格已知卻和用正確利率折現對不上：買便宜、賣昂貴，直到等式成立。不 是乾等，也不是亂改折現率。
DER-096.core_idea: If S0 is not the discounted known ST, trade cheap versus dear until equality holds
DER-096.study_section: Arbitrage, carry, and forward pricing ｜套利、持有成本與遠期定價
DER-096.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-096.subtopic: 8.4 Arbitrage, carry, and forward pricing ｜套利、持有成本與遠期定價

DER-097.reasoning: Reasoning: In signs: risky asset plus derivative equals a risk-free position, so the derivative can be isolated as a combination of the asset and risk-free borrowing or lending.

why_wrong.A: Long put ̸= short stock. Replication is a signed package with a bond, not that shortcut.
why_wrong.B: The hedge ratio is (cu - cd)/(Su - Sd), not automatically ±1.

DER-097.zh: 複製：標的± 衍生工具= 無風險，所以衍生工具= 標的與無風險借貸的組合。 不是long put = short 現貨，∆也不是永遠±1。
DER-097.core_idea: Replication: risky asset plus derivative equals a risk-free position
DER-097.study_section: Arbitrage, carry, and forward pricing ｜套利、持有成本與遠期定價
DER-097.exam_trap: Equating long put with short the underlying — fake ∆= -1
DER-097.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-097.subtopic: 8.4 Arbitrage, carry, and forward pricing ｜套利、持有成本與遠期定價

DER-098.reasoning: Reasoning: Greater benefits of owning the asset lower the no-arbitrage forward price. Greater holding costs raise it. If benefits dominate costs, F0(T) < S0.

why_wrong.A: The risk-free rate is the opportunity cost of tying up cash — a cost in the carry net.
why_wrong.C: Convenience yield is a non-cash benefit of holding the physical commodity, not a cash dividend, and it is not the whole of carry.

DER-098.zh: 持有成本是「持有現貨到到期」的成本與利益淨額。無風險利率是資金機會成本。 利益大於成本時，遠期價可以低於現貨。
DER-098.core_idea: Cost of carry is the net of costs and benefits of owning the underlying for the derivative’s horizon
DER-098.study_section: Arbitrage, carry, and forward pricing ｜套利、持有成本與遠期定價
DER-098.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。
DER-098.subtopic: 8.4 Arbitrage, carry, and forward pricing ｜套利、持有成本與遠期定價

DER-099.reasoning: Reasoning: Convenience yield is not a cash dividend. It is the non-cash benefit of having the physical commodity relative to holding only the derivative. That benefit makes holding spot more worthwhile; the no-arbitrage forward price is pressed down. Costs (storage, financing) raise the forward price.

why_wrong.A: It is not a cash dividend. The chapter contrasts it with dividends.
why_wrong.B: Storage is a cost and raises F. Convenience yield is a benefit and lowers F.

DER-099.zh: 便利收益率不是現金股息。它是「手上有實物」相對於「只有衍生品」的非現金好 處：缺貨時還能生產、交貨。這份好處壓低無套利遠期價。倉儲才是把遠期價抬高的成本。
DER-099.core_idea: Convenience yield is a non-cash benefit of holding the physical commodity and lowers the forward price
DER-099.study_section: Arbitrage, carry, and forward pricing ｜套利、持有成本與遠期定價

DER-100.reasoning: Reasoning: F0(T) = S0(1+r)^T = 80 × 1.040.75 = 82.39. The long forward is worth zero at initiation, so the contracted price is the spot grown at the opportunity cost of cash. Do not enter N = 1. P/Y = 1, C/Y = 1. Given: S0 = 80; r = 4% annual compounding; T = 0.75 year; no dividend, no storage. Asked: No-arbitrage F0(T). Formula: 80(1.04)0.75 Variables: T is in years when r is an annual effective rate. N can be a decimal. Why this formula: The contracted price grows the cash tied up in the asset at the opportunity cost r. Value at initiation is zero. Nine months of 4% carry is about 2.39, not a full 3.20. Reasonableness check: 80 ignores carry. 83.20 uses N = 1. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：TVM 已知：P/Y=1, C/Y=1, END; CLR TVM does not reset P/Y. S0=80; r=4%; T=0.75; no income, no storage 求：F0(T) = FV 按鍵： ①2nd →CLR TVM ②2nd →I/Y (P/Y) →1 →ENTER (CLR TVM does not reset P/Y or C/Y) ③↓confirm C/Y = 1 (enter 1 →ENTER if needed) ④2nd →CPT (QUIT) ⑤Confirm END (if BGN: 2nd →PMT/BGN →2nd →SET →2nd →QUIT) ⑥0.75 →N ⑦4 →I/Y ⑧80 →+/- →PV ⑨0 →PMT ⑩CPT →FV 結果：FV = 82.39 中文理解：這是現金的機會成本：把80 放到4% 過九個月變成多少。N 可以是小數。不要把 T=0.75 當成N=1 再乘1.04（那是83.20）。PV 打負號，代表今天把現貨買下來的現金流出。
DER-100.steps: ①P/Y = 1, C/Y = 1. Clear TVM. ②N = 0.75, I/Y = 4, PV = -80, PMT = 0, CPT FV. ③FV = 82.39 = F0(T).

why_wrong.A: 80 leaves the spot uncompounded, as if r = 0 or T = 0.
why_wrong.B: 83.20 is 80 × 1.04, treating nine months as a full year (N = 1).

DER-100.zh: 沒有股息、沒有倉儲：遠期價就是現貨用無風險利率長到到期。N 打0.75，不要 打1（那會得到83.20），也不要直接報80。
DER-100.core_idea: No extra income or storage: F0(T) = S0(1+r)^T and V0(T) = 0

DER-101.reasoning: Reasoning: F0 = 120 × 1.061.5 = 130.96. N = 1.5, not 1. Initiation value remains 0; 130.96 is the contracted price, not a prepaid value. Given: S0 = 120; r = 6% annual; T = 1.5; no dividend, no storage. Asked: F0(T). Formula: 120(1.06)1.5 Variables: Price at initiation, value = 0. Why this formula: Spot grown at the opportunity cost of cash. Eighteen months of 6% is more than one year of 6%. Reasonableness check: 127.20 is the one-year mistake. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：TVM 已知：P/Y=1, C/Y=1, END; CLR TVM does not reset P/Y. S0=120; r=6%; T=1.5 求：F0(T) 按鍵： ①2nd →CLR TVM ②2nd →I/Y (P/Y) →1 →ENTER (CLR TVM does not reset P/Y or C/Y) ③↓confirm C/Y = 1 (enter 1 →ENTER if needed) ④2nd →CPT (QUIT) ⑤Confirm END (if BGN: 2nd →PMT/BGN →2nd →SET →2nd →QUIT) ⑥1.5 →N ⑦6 →I/Y ⑧120 →+/- →PV ⑨0 →PMT ⑩CPT →FV 結果：FV = 130.96 中文理解：一年半不是把6% 只乘一次。N=1.5。PV 負號仍是「今天買現貨的流出」。
DER-101.steps: ①CLR TVM. ②N = 1.5, I/Y = 6, PV = -120, PMT = 0, CPT FV. ③FV = 130.96.

why_wrong.A: 120 ignores carry entirely.
why_wrong.B: 127.20 is 120 × 1.06, as if T were one year.

DER-101.zh: T=1.5 年：N 打1.5。打N=1 會得到127.20。期初價值仍是0；130.96 是契約價 格，不是先付的價值。
DER-101.core_idea: F0(T) = S0(1+r)^T with a multi-year horizon; do not drop the exponent

DER-102.reasoning: Reasoning: F0 = 36 × 1.032 = 36 × 1.0609 = 38.19. Two years of opportunity cost, not one. V0 = 0 still. Given: S0 = 36; r = 3%; T = 2; no income, no storage. Asked: F0(T). Formula: 36(1.03)2 Variables: N = 2. Why this formula: Cash tied up for two years earns r each year. Two 3% growth steps. Reasonableness check: 37.08 is one step. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：TVM 已知：P/Y=1, C/Y=1, END; CLR TVM does not reset P/Y. S0=36; r=3%; T=2 求：F0(T) 按鍵： ①2nd →CLR TVM ②2nd →I/Y (P/Y) →1 →ENTER (CLR TVM does not reset P/Y or C/Y) ③↓confirm C/Y = 1 (enter 1 →ENTER if needed) ④2nd →CPT (QUIT) ⑤Confirm END (if BGN: 2nd →PMT/BGN →2nd →SET →2nd →QUIT) ⑥2 →N ⑦3 →I/Y ⑧ 36 →+/- →PV ⑨0 →PMT ⑩CPT →FV 結果：FV = 38.19 中文理解：兩年就打N=2。這是契約價格。多方期初價值仍是零。
DER-102.steps: ①N = 2, I/Y = 3, PV = -36, PMT = 0, CPT FV. ②FV = 38.19.

why_wrong.A: 37.08 is 36 × 1.03, a one-year carry.
why_wrong.B: 36 is the spot, as if value and price were both frozen at S0.

DER-102.zh: 兩年：36×1.03²=38.19。不要只乘一年得到37.08，也不要報現貨36。價格是 38.19；期初價值是0。

DER-103.reasoning: Reasoning: Vt(T) = St - F0(T)(1+r)^-(T-t) = 88 - 90 / 1.040.5 = 88 - 88.25 = -0.25. The contracted price is still 90 (price); value is this small negative (value). The short is +0.25. At maturity there would be nothing left to discount. Given: Long; F0(T) = 90; St = 88; r = 4%; remaining 0.5 year. Asked: Long MTM value (not the contracted price). Formula: 88 −90(1.04)−0.5 Variables: Price F0 stays 90. Value is the discounted gap. Why this formula: You will pay 90 at T; that obligation is worth 90 discounted. Today you “have” the spot. The long is slightly underwater: spot 88 versus a 88.25 present cost of the old 90. Reasonableness check: -2 is undiscounted. +2 is the wrong side. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：TVM 已知：P/Y=1, C/Y=1, END; CLR TVM does not reset P/Y. contracted F0=90; r=4%; remaining T-t=0.5; St=88 求：PV of F0, then Vt = St - that PV 按鍵： ①2nd →CLR TVM ②2nd →I/Y (P/Y) →1 →ENTER (CLR TVM does not reset P/Y or C/Y) ③↓confirm C/Y = 1 (enter 1 →ENTER if needed) ④2nd →CPT (QUIT) ⑤Confirm END (if BGN: 2nd →PMT/BGN →2nd →SET →2nd →QUIT) ⑥0.5 →N ⑦4 →I/Y ⑧90 →FV ⑨0 →PMT ⑩CPT →PV 結果：PV of 90 = 88.25; long Vt = 88 - 88.25 = -0.25 中文理解：先把到期要付的90 折現，再和今天現貨比。這是價值，不是去改契約價格。多方 是現貨減這個現值。
DER-103.steps: ①Discount the contracted 90 for 0.5 year at 4%. ②N = 0.5, I/Y = 4, FV = 90, PMT = 0, CPT PV →88.25. ③Long value = 88 - 88.25 = -0.25.

why_wrong.A: -2 is ST-style 88 - 90 with no discounting of the contracted price. That is the maturity formula used too early.
why_wrong.B: +2 flips the side (or drops the discount and flips the sign).

DER-103.zh: 契約價格仍是90；價值是88 減90 的現值。半年折現後90 約88.25，long 的 MTM ≈-0.25。不要用到期公式直接88-90=-2。價格̸= 價值。
DER-103.core_idea: During the life, the long’s value is St - F0(T)(1+r)^-(T-t)

DER-104.reasoning: Reasoning: At maturity there is nothing left to discount: VT(T) = ST - F0(T) = 93 - 90 = 3. The short is -3. Distinguish this expiration value from the contracted price 90 and from any earlier Vt. Given: Long; F0 = 90; ST = 93. Asked: VT for the long. Formula: 93 −90 Variables: No remaining discount. Why this formula: The payment 90 is due now. Buying at 90 an asset worth 93. Reasonableness check: Not 0 and not the old -0.25. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Remaining-value reset to zero is the futures daily-settlement story, not the forward at T.
why_wrong.C: Mid-life MTM does not freeze. At T the formula drops the discount: 93 - 90 = 3.

DER-104.zh: 到期不再折現：long 價值= 93-90=3。不要沿用中途的-0.25，也不要把期貨每日 歸零套到遠期到期。
DER-104.core_idea: At maturity VT = ST - F0(T); nothing left to discount

DER-105.reasoning: Reasoning: If the quoted forward were above S0(1+r)^T, sell the forward, buy the asset with funds borrowed at r, deliver at T, repay the loan, and keep the gap. Fair F0 = 40 × 1.060.5 = 41.18. Quoted 42.80 is rich, so sell it. Those trades force the equality. Given: S0 = 40; r = 6%; T = 0.5; quoted F = 42.80; no dividend. Asked: Arbitrage direction. Formula: 40(1.06)0.5 = 41.18; quoted 42.80 Variables: Rich quote ⇒sell forward, buy spot with borrow. Why this formula: Deliver the purchased share into the rich sale. The 1.62 gap is locked in after financing. Reasonableness check: The reverse trade is for a cheap quote. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
DER-105.steps: ①Fair F = 41.18. ②Quoted > fair ⇒sell forward / buy spot borrowed.

why_wrong.B: Buy-forward / short-asset is the trade when the quoted forward is below fair, not above.
why_wrong.C: Long both is not a riskless package.

DER-105.zh: 報價遠期42.80 高於無套利41.18：賣遠期、借錢買現貨、到期交割還貸，吃價 差。報價偏低才是買遠期、放空現貨、放貸。
DER-105.core_idea: If the quoted forward is above S0(1+r)^T, sell the forward, buy the asset with borrowed funds

DER-106.reasoning: Reasoning: If the quoted forward were below, buy the forward, short the asset, invest the proceeds at r, and reverse at T. Cheap quote versus 41.18.

why_wrong.A: Sell-forward / buy-spot is for a rich quote. 40.10 is cheap versus 41.18.
why_wrong.C: F < S0 can be fair after carry or benefits; here the fair value is 41.18, so 40.10 is cheap, not automatically fair.

DER-106.zh: 報價40.10 低於公平41.18：買遠期、放空現貨、所得去放貸。不要做「賣遠期買 現貨」那套（那是報價偏貴時）。F<S 也不等於已經無套利。
DER-106.core_idea: If the quoted forward is below fair, buy the forward, short the asset, invest the proceeds at r

DER-107.reasoning: Reasoning: Replace the spot with a carry-adjusted amount: F0(T) = [S0 - PV0(I) + PV0(C)](1+r)^T. Greater benefits lower F; greater costs raise F.

why_wrong.A: The (1+r)^T factor remains. Raw I and C without PV and without compounding are not the formula.
why_wrong.C: Benefits lower the carry-adjusted spot; costs raise it. The signs in the first choice are the chapter’s.

DER-107.zh: 遠期價用「現貨- 利益現值+ 成本現值」再長利率。股息／便利收益壓低F；倉 儲抬高F。正負不要反。
DER-107.core_idea: With income I and holding costs C: F0 = [S0 - PV(I) + PV(C)](1+r)^T

DER-108.reasoning: Reasoning: PV0(I) = 2 / 1.04^0.5 = 1.96. F0 = (80 - 1.96) × 1.04 = 81.16. Dividends are a benefit of owning the asset and lower the no-arbitrage forward. Given: S0 = 80; r = 4%; T = 1; dividend 2 in 0.5 year; no storage. Asked: Carry-adjusted F0. Formula: F0 = ( 80 −2/1.040.5) (1.04) Variables: PV(I) uses the same r. Why this formula: Owning the share collects the dividend; the forward does not, so F must be lower. Carry net of the dividend is about 1.16, not 3.20. Reasonableness check: 83.20 forgot PV(I). 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：scientific / y^x 已知：S0=80; r=4%; T=1; dividend 2 at t=0.5 求：F0 按鍵： ①1.04 →y^x →0.5 →= ②2 →÷ →ANS →= →PV(I) ≈1.9608 ③80 →- →1.9608 → × →1.04 →= 結果：F0 ≈81.16 中文理解：y^x 算1.04^0.5 折現股息，從80 扣掉再乘1.04。不要把0.5 當成÷2。

why_wrong.A: 80 is the unadjusted spot.
why_wrong.C: 83.20 is 80 × 1.04, the no-dividend forward — forgetting to subtract PV(I).

DER-108.zh: 先把六個月後的2 折現約1.96，從80 扣掉再乘1.04，得81.16。忘了扣股息會得 到無股息的83.20。股息壓低遠期價。
DER-108.core_idea: Dividends cut the opportunity cost of buying the share today and lower F0 核心觀念｜中文理解：先把六個月後的2 折現約1.96，從80 扣掉再乘1.04，得81.16。

DER-109.reasoning: Reasoning: F0 = [40 + 1.50] × 1.05 = 43.58. Holding costs raise the forward. If PV(C) were treated as a benefit, the sign flips and F is too low. Given: S0 = 40; r = 5%; T = 1; PV(C) = 1.50; no benefit i. Asked: F0. Formula: (40 + 1.50)(1.05) Variables: Costs enter with a plus inside the brackets. Why this formula: The long forward avoids paying storage; F must compensate the spot holder. Storage added about 1.58 on top of the 2.00 finance carry. Reasonableness check: 42 forgot storage. 40.43 subtracted it. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 40.43 is 40 × 1.05 - 1.50, subtracting storage instead of adding it inside the brackets.
why_wrong.C: 42.00 is 40 × 1.05, ignoring PV(C).

DER-109.zh: 倉儲現值加進現貨：(40+1.50)×1.05=43.58。只做40×1.05 會得到42。把倉儲當 利益去減，會算太低。
DER-109.core_idea: Storage costs raise the no-arbitrage forward price

DER-110.reasoning: Reasoning: Vt(T) = [St - PVt(I) + PVt(C)] - F0(T)(1+r)^-(T-t). If PV(C) < PV(I), the long forward’s MTM is below the unadjusted St - PVt(F0(T)). Maturity is still ST - F0(T).

why_wrong.B: Benefits of owning the asset accrue to the spot holder, not to the long forward, so they reduce the long’s MTM versus the unadjusted formula.
why_wrong.C: Carry enters Vt before T; at T it has expired.

DER-110.zh: 剩餘利益現值大於剩餘成本時，long 遠期的MTM 會低於「不調整的St-PV(F0)」。 利益歸現貨持有人。到期只剩ST-F0。
DER-110.core_idea: During the life with carry: Vt = [St - PVt(I) + PVt(C)] - F0(T)(1+r)^-(T-t)
DER-110.study_section: Arbitrage, carry, and forward pricing ｜套利、持有成本與遠期定價
DER-110.exam_trap: Confusing carry-adjusted value with unadjusted St - PV(F0) or with price

DER-111.reasoning: Reasoning: F0 = S0 e^rT = 100 e^0.04×0.5 = 100 e^0.02 = 102.02. With carry rates c and i the chapter writes F0 = S0 e^(r+c-i)T. Given: S0 = 100; continuous r = 4%; T = 0.5; no extra carry. Asked: F0. Formula: 100e0.02 Variables: Exponent is rT, not r. Why this formula: Continuous analogue of S0(1+r)^T. Half a year of 4% continuous carry. Reasonableness check: 104.08 is a full year. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：scientific / e^x 已知：S0=100; continuous r=4%; T=0.5 求：F0 = 100 e^0.02 按鍵： ①0.02 →2nd →e^x →× →100 →= 結果：F0 ≈102.02 中文理解：連續複利用2nd e^x。指數是rT=0.02，不是滿一年的0.04。

why_wrong.A: 104.08 is e^0.04 on a one-year horizon, or 100 × 1.04.
why_wrong.B: 100 ignores continuous carry.

DER-111.zh: 連續複利、無額外持有調整：100×e^0.02=102.02。不要用滿一年的e^0.04。有倉 儲與利益時才改成e^(r+c-i)T。
DER-111.core_idea: Continuous compounding, no extra carry: F0(T) = S0 e^rT; with carry rates, S0 e^(r+c-i)T
DER-111.study_section: Arbitrage, carry, and forward pricing ｜套利、持有成本與遠期定價

計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：scientific / e^x
已知：S0=100; continuous r=4%; T=0.5
求：F0 = 100 e^0.02
按鍵：
①0.02 →2nd →e^x →× →100 →=
結果：F0 ≈102.02
中文理解：連續複利用2nd e^x。指數是rT=0.02，不是滿一年的0.04。

DER-112.reasoning: Reasoning: F0 = 80 e^(0.05+0.02-0.03)×1 = 80 e^0.04 = 83.27. Costs raise F; benefits lower F. Net carry here is +2%. Given: S0 = 80; r = 5%; c = 2%; i = 3%; T = 1; continuous. Asked: F0. Formula: 80e0.04 Variables: i enters with a minus. Why this formula: Benefits reduce the carry that must be built into F. Net 4% continuous carry on 80. Reasonableness check: Adding i overstates F. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：scientific / e^x 已知：S0=80; r=5%; c=2%; i=3%; T=1 求：F0 = 80 e^0.04 按鍵： ①0.04 →2nd →e^x →× →80 →= 結果：F0 ≈83.27 中文理解：指數r+c-i=0.04。2nd e^x 後再乘80。利益i 要減，不要加成。

why_wrong.A: 80 ignores net carry.
why_wrong.C: 86.59 is 80 e^(0.05+0.02+0.03) or 80 e^0.08, adding i instead of subtracting it.

DER-112.zh: 指數是r+c-i=0.04，80×e^0.04=83.27。把i 也加成+ 會得到偏高的86.59。利益 要減。
DER-112.core_idea: F0 = S0 e^(r+c-i)T nets storage against convenience / income
DER-112.study_section: Arbitrage, carry, and forward pricing ｜套利、持有成本與遠期定價

計算機操作｜BA II Plus

已知：S0=80; r=5%; c=2%; i=3%; T=1
求：F0 = 80 e^0.04
按鍵：
①0.04 →2nd →e^x →× →80 →=
結果：F0 ≈83.27
中文理解：指數r+c-i=0.04。2nd e^x 後再乘80。利益i 要減，不要加成。

DER-113.reasoning: Reasoning: F_0,f/d = S_0,f/d e^(r_f - r_d)T = 1.2500 e^(0.015-0.030)×0.5 = 1.2500 e^-0.0075 = 1.2407. Given: S = 1.2500 CAD per USD; rf = 1.50%; rd = 3.00%; T = 0.5; continuous. Asked: F0,f/d. Formula: 1.2500e(0.015−0.030)0.5 Variables: f = CAD, d = USD. Sign is rf - rd. Why this formula: Covered interest: borrow domestic, buy foreign spot, lend foreign. Fewer CAD per USD forward: CAD is the low-rate (richer-forward) currency. Reasonableness check: Flipping the rates gives 1.2594. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：scientific / e^x 已知：S=1.2500; rf=1.50%; rd=3.00%; T=0.5 求：F = 1.2500 e^-0.0075 按鍵： ①0.0075 →+/- →2nd →e^x ②× →1.2500 →= 結果：F ≈1.2407 中文理解：負指數先打0.0075 再+/-，然後2nd e^x。正負弄反會得到1.2594。

why_wrong.B: 1.2500 is the spot, as if the two rates were equal.

DER-113.core_idea: FX quote is foreign per domestic; F_f/d = S_f/d e^(r_f - r_d)T
DER-113.study_section: Arbitrage, carry, and forward pricing ｜套利、持有成本與遠期定價

計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：scientific / e^x
已知：S=1.2500; rf=1.50%; rd=3.00%; T=0.5
求：F = 1.2500 e^-0.0075
按鍵：
①0.0075 →+/- →2nd →e^x ②× →1.2500 →=
結果：F ≈1.2407
中文理解：負指數先打0.0075 再+/-，然後2nd e^x。正負弄反會得到1.2594。

DER-114.reasoning: Reasoning: The currency with the higher interest rate cheapens on a forward basis. If rf > rd, then F_f/d > S_f/d: more foreign units per domestic unit, so the foreign currency trades at a forward discount. The low-rate currency is the one that is richer forward.

why_wrong.A: The chapter’s formula is not F = S.
why_wrong.C: The high-rate currency cheapens forward, so you need more of it per domestic unit: F > S when rf > rd.

DER-114.zh: 利率較高的貨幣，遠期會變便宜。rf>rd 時，一單位本國幣可換到更多外幣 （F>S），外幣遠期貼水。低利率貨幣才是遠期較貴的那一個。
DER-114.core_idea: The currency with the higher interest rate cheapens on a forward basis

DER-115.reasoning: Reasoning: During the life, the long FX forward marks to market as Vt = S_t,f/d - F0 e^-(rfrd)(T-t). A decline in the spot is an MTM gain for the forward seller. At settlement the seller’s payoff is F0(T) - ST; the seller loses if F0(T) < ST.

why_wrong.A: Direction matters. A lower spot helps the seller (later seller of foreign per the quote).
why_wrong.C: Price is set; value moves. That is the usual price-versus-value distinction.

DER-115.zh: 外匯遠期空方：即期下跌，對賣方是MTM 獲利。到期空方損益是F0-ST，若 F0<ST 才虧。契約價格不變，價值會變。
DER-115.core_idea: A decline in the FX spot is an MTM gain for the forward seller
DER-115.study_section: Arbitrage, carry, and forward pricing ｜套利、持有成本與遠期定價
DER-115.exam_trap: Treating a fixed FX forward price as frozen value

DER-116.reasoning: Reasoning: JPY proceeds stay 110 (r_f = 0). USD loan grows to e^0.04 = 1.0408. Implied F = 110 / 1.0408 = 105.69, which is also 110 e^(0-0.04)×1. Same number as the formula. Replication produces the forward. Given: S = 110 JPY per USD; rf = 0%; rd = 4%; T = 1; continuous. Asked: Replicated forward rate. Formula: 110e−0.04 Variables: Foreign proceeds / domestic repayment. Why this formula: The two loan balances must offset at a unique F. High-rate USD cheapens JPY per USD (fewer yen per dollar forward). Reasonableness check: 114.49 is the flipped differential. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：scientific / e^x 已知：S=110; rf=0%; rd=4%; T=1 求：110 / e^0.04 按鍵： ①0.04 →2nd →e^x →STO →1 ②110 →÷ →RCL →1 →= 結果：F ≈105.69 中文理解：先算e^0.04，再用110 去除。不要把e^0.04 乘上去（那是114.49）。
DER-116.steps: ①JPY terminal = 110. ②USD terminal = e^0.04 = 1.0408. ③F = 110 / 1.0408 = 105.69.

why_wrong.A: 114.49 is 110 e^+0.04, flipping rf - rd.
why_wrong.B: 110 ignores the interest differential.

DER-116.zh: 借1 美元、即期換成110 日圓、日圓利率0% 所以到期仍110；美元貸款長成 e^0.04。隱含遠期= 110/e^0.04=105.69。正負弄反會到114.49。
DER-116.core_idea: Replication of an FX forward: borrow domestic, buy foreign spot, lend foreign 核心觀念｜中文理解：借1 美元、即期換成110 日圓、日圓利率0% 所以到期仍110；美元貸款長成 e^0.04。

結果：F ≈105.69

DER-117.reasoning: Reasoning: The low-rate currency is richer forward. CAD’s rate is lower, so a dollar buys fewer CAD later. Always read F versus S together with which rate is higher.

why_wrong.B: Forwards routinely sit below spot when the foreign rate is lower. That is not a misprint.
why_wrong.C: F < S here because rf < rd, not because CAD is high-rate. CAD is the low-rate currency.

DER-117.zh: USD 利率較高，遠期一美元換到的加元變少（F<S）。低利率的加元才是遠期較 貴。F<S 不是印錯。
DER-117.core_idea: High-rate domestic currency: F_f/d < S when rd > rf

DER-118.reasoning: Reasoning: F0 = 200 × 1.08^0.25 = 203.89. N = 0.25. Price, not value: V0 = 0. Given: S0 = 200; r = 8%; T = 0.25; no income, no storage. Asked: F0(T). Formula: 200(1.08)0.25 Variables: N = 0.25 year. Why this formula: Opportunity cost of cash for one quarter. Eight percent for a quarter is about 1.94%, not 8%. Reasonableness check: 216 is N = 1. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：TVM 已知：P/Y=1, C/Y=1, END; CLR TVM does not reset P/Y. S0=200; r=8%; T=0.25 求：F0(T) 按鍵： ①2nd →CLR TVM ②2nd →I/Y (P/Y) →1 →ENTER (CLR TVM does not reset P/Y or C/Y) ③↓confirm C/Y = 1 (enter 1 →ENTER if needed) ④2nd →CPT (QUIT) ⑤Confirm END (if BGN: 2nd →PMT/BGN →2nd →SET →2nd →QUIT) ⑥0.25 →N ⑦8 →I/Y ⑧200 →+/- →PV ⑨0 →PMT ⑩CPT →FV 結果：FV = 203.89 中文理解：一季不是把8% 整年加上去。N=0.25。PV 負號仍是今天買現貨。
DER-118.steps: ①CLR TVM. ②N = 0.25, I/Y = 8, PV = -200, PMT = 0, CPT FV. ③FV = 203.89.

why_wrong.A: 216 is 200 × 1.08, a full year.
why_wrong.C: 200 ignores three months of opportunity cost.

DER-118.zh: 三個月：N=0.25，不要打1 得到216。結果203.89 是契約價格，期初價值仍是0。
DER-118.core_idea: Quarter-year carry on a large spot: another BA II TVM forward

DER-119.reasoning: Reasoning: A forward rate agreement (FRA) is an OTC contract to apply a specified interest rate to a future period. The underlying is a market reference rate (MRR), not an asset price. A discount factor 1/(1+z)^T is the present value of one currency unit on a future date.

why_wrong.B: A plain vanilla IRS does not exchange notional. An FRA is a single-period OTC rate contract.
why_wrong.C: ST - X is an equity-option payoff, not an FRA.

DER-119.zh: FRA 是店頭契約，把某個利率套到未來一段期間。標的是參考利率MRR，不是 股價。名目本金通常不交換。
DER-119.core_idea: An FRA applies a specified interest rate to a future period; the underlying is MRR, not an asset price
DER-119.study_section: Interest-rate forwards and swaps ｜利率遠期與交換契約
DER-119.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。

DER-120.reasoning: Reasoning: A firm that will borrow in the future takes the long FRA. If MRR rises, the long receives a payment that offsets the higher borrowing cost. A firm that will lend takes the short FRA. Name the cash-market side first, then take the FRA side that pays when that exposure hurts.

why_wrong.A: A stock put is not an FRA hedge, and long put ̸= short stock (or short a rate).
why_wrong.B: The short FRA is the later lender’s hedge. A future borrower is long the FRA.

DER-120.zh: 以後要借款→做多FRA（以契約利率「借入」的那一側）。MRR 升，long 收到 補償。以後要放貸才是short FRA。這和股票put 無關。
DER-120.core_idea: A firm that will borrow later takes the long FRA; if MRR rises the long receives a payment
DER-120.study_section: Interest-rate forwards and swaps ｜利率遠期與交換契約
DER-120.exam_trap: Hedging by taking the same side as the business — FRA version

DER-121.reasoning: Reasoning: (0.030 - 0.024) × 8,000,000 × (180/360) = 0.006 × 8,000,000 × 0.5 = 24,000. Actual FRA settlement is the present value of this difference, because settlement is at the start of the interest period. The question asked for the undiscounted net interest difference. Given: Long FRA; NP = 8,000,000; period = 180/360; IFR = 2.40%; MRR = 3.00%. Asked: Undiscounted net interest difference (not the PV settlement). Formula: (0.030 −0.024) × 8000000 × (180/360) Variables: Long receives when MRR > IFR. Why this formula: Interest difference on the notional for the covered fraction of a year. The long is compensated for borrowing at a higher MRR. Reasonableness check: 48,000 forgot 180/360. -24,000 is the short. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
DER-121.steps: ①Rate gap = 0.006. ②Times 8,000,000 = 48,000 for a full year. ③Times 0.5 = 24,000.

why_wrong.A: 48,000 drops the period factor 180/360 = 0.5.
why_wrong.C: -24,000 is the short FRA.

DER-121.zh: Long 的未折現利息差= (3.00%-2.40%)×800 萬×180/360 = 24,000。漏掉天期會 得到48,000；看反多空是-24,000。真正交割還要把這筆折到利息期初。
DER-121.core_idea: Net interest difference for the long is (MRR - IFR) × notional × period; settlement is the PV of that amount at the start of the period
DER-121.study_section: Interest-rate forwards and swaps ｜利率遠期與交換契約
DER-121.source_note: 解答依據 DER_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Derivatives。

DER-122.reasoning: Reasoning: Settlement = 24,000 / [1 + 0.03 × (180/360)] = 24,000 / 1.015 = 23,645. An FRA settles at the beginning of the interest period, not the end. Name that as a timing distinction, not as a change of sign or of long versus short. Given: Undiscounted long difference = 24,000; MRR = 3%; period = 0.5. Asked: PV exchanged at period start. Formula: 24000/(1 + 0.03 × 0.5) Variables: Discount at the period’s MRR. Why this formula: Cash is paid at the start, so the end-of-period interest gap must be discounted. The long receives a bit less than 24,000 because the cash arrives early. Reasonableness check: 24,000 is undiscounted. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 24,360 compounds the difference forward instead of discounting it.
why_wrong.C: 24,000 is the undiscounted difference. Settlement is the present value.

DER-122.zh: FRA 在利息期初交割，要把24,000 用MRR 折現：24,000/1.015≈23,645。不要報 未折現24,000，也不要往後複利。
DER-122.core_idea: FRA settlement is at the beginning of the interest period, so the exchanged amount is the PV of the interest difference 核心觀念｜中文理解：FRA 在利息期初交割，要把24,000 用MRR 折現：24,000/1.015≈23,645。

DER-123.reasoning: Reasoning: The same payoff can be built as a synthetic FRA: borrow for the longer horizon and lend for the shorter horizon; the implied rate on the gap is the contract rate.

why_wrong.B: An equity forward’s underlying is an asset price, not MRR.
why_wrong.C: A stock put is not an FRA, and long put ̸= a rate position.

DER-123.zh: 合成FRA：借較長天期、放較短天期，缺口上的隱含利率就是契約利率。不是股 票put，也不是股權遠期。
DER-123.core_idea: A synthetic FRA is borrow the longer horizon and lend the shorter; the implied rate on the gap is the contract rate

DER-123.exam_trap: Equating long put with a short loan / FRA
