Why this formula: Quant GM is the multi-year wealth rate; Corp still needs NPV. GM < AM when returns vary. Reasonableness check: 1.07493 = 1.242. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Arithmetic mean (20 - 10 + 15)/3 = 8.33% overstates compound growth.
why_wrong.C: The three-year wealth change 24.2% is not an annual rate.

INT-029.zh: 沒有中途存提時，幾何平均就是複利年化。算術平均會高估。
INT-029.core_idea: Geometric mean recovers compounded wealth; it is not a substitute for NPV at WACC
INT-029.study_section: Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法
INT-029.exam_trap: Quoting the arithmetic mean as compound growth
INT-029.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-029.subtopic: INT.2 Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法

INT-030.reasoning: Reasoning: Ordinary PV = 70 × [1 - 1.12^-4]/0.12 = 212.61. NPV = 12.61. END is the book convention unless the stem says due. Given: Outlay 200; PMT 70; N 4; I/Y 12%; END. Asked: NPV. Formula: 70 × (1 −1.12−4)/0.12 −200 Variables: Ordinary annuity. Why this formula: Quant TVM values the Corp project annuity. The project just clears 12%. Reasonableness check: IRR slightly above 12%. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：TVM 已知：N = 4; I/Y = 12; PMT = 70; FV = 0; END; P/Y = 1; C/Y = 1 求：PV of inflows 按鍵： ①2nd →I/Y ②1 →ENTER (P/Y = 1) ③↓④1 →ENTER (C/Y = 1) ⑤2nd →CPT (QUIT) ⑥2nd →CLR TVM [CLR TVM does not reset P/Y or C/Y] ⑦2nd →PMT (confirm END; if BGN is displayed, 2nd →SET, then 2nd →CPT) ⑧4 →N ⑨12 →I/Y ⑩70 → PMT 11 0 →FV 12 CPT →PV →-212.61 結果：PV 212.61; NPV = 212.61 - 200 = 12.61 中文理解：先用2nd I/Y 把P/Y 與C/Y 設成1，再QUIT。CLR TVM 只清N、I/Y、PV、 PMT、FV，不會重設P/Y 或C/Y。普通年金用END。PMT 正號；NPV = 212.61 - 200。

why_wrong.A: 70 × 4 - 200 = 80, ignoring TVM.
why_wrong.C: Treats the annuity as due (BGN): PV = 212.61 × 1.12 = 238.1; NPV = 38.1.

INT-030.zh: 普通年金用END。四年現金直接加總是忽略時間價值。
INT-030.core_idea: A level after-tax annuity is a TVM PV; NPV is that PV minus the outlay
INT-030.study_section: Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法
INT-030.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：TVM
已知：N = 4; I/Y = 12; PMT = 70; FV = 0; END; P/Y = 1; C/Y = 1
求：PV of inflows
按鍵：
①2nd →I/Y ②1 →ENTER (P/Y = 1) ③↓④1 →ENTER (C/Y = 1) ⑤2nd →CPT
(QUIT) ⑥2nd →CLR TVM [CLR TVM does not reset P/Y or C/Y] ⑦2nd →PMT (confirm
END; if BGN is displayed, 2nd →SET, then 2nd →CPT) ⑧4 →N ⑨12 →I/Y ⑩70 →
PMT 11 0 →FV 12 CPT →PV →-212.61
結果：PV 212.61; NPV = 212.61 - 200 = 12.61
中文理解：先用2nd I/Y 把P/Y 與C/Y 設成1，再QUIT。CLR TVM 只清N、I/Y、PV、
PMT、FV，不會重設P/Y 或C/Y。普通年金用END。PMT 正號；NPV = 212.61 - 200。
INT-030.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-030.subtopic: INT.2 Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法

INT-031.reasoning: Reasoning: PV of operating cash = 400. Flotation is added to the outlay: NPV = 400 - 208 = 192. Given: Perpetual CF 40; WACC 10%; outlay 200; flotation 8. Asked: NPV after flotation. Formula: 40/0.10 −200 −8 Variables: Flotation is a t=0 cash cost. Why this formula: Corp flotation rule plus Quant perpetuity. The project still adds value after the issue cost. Reasonableness check: Ignoring 8 overstates NPV by the flotation. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Subtracts flotation from perpetual cash: (40 - 8)/0.10 - 200 = 120.
why_wrong.C: Ignores flotation: 40/0.10 - 200 = 200.

INT-031.zh: 發行成本加在期初支出，不是拿掉、也不是從每年現金扣。
INT-031.core_idea: Flotation costs are added to the initial outlay
INT-031.study_section: Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法
INT-031.exam_trap: Ignoring flotation or subtracting it from every year’s cash
INT-031.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-031.subtopic: INT.2 Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法

INT-032.reasoning: Reasoning: Break-point = 60 / 0.40 = 150. At 150 of total investment the firm has used 60 of equity and MCC steps up. Given: RE available 60; we = 40%. Asked: Retained-earnings break-point. Formula: 60/0.40 Variables: At 150 total, equity used = 60. Why this formula: Corp MCC schedule; Quant division by the weight. WACC is constant until that total, then it steps up. Reasonableness check: Debt used at the same point is 90 if wd = 60%. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Multiplies 60 × 0.40 = 24.
why_wrong.C: Treats the unused equity itself as the break-point.

INT-032.zh: 中斷點是便宜資金用完時的總投資：60 ÷ 40% = 150。
INT-032.core_idea: A break-point is available cheap capital divided by that source’s weight
INT-032.study_section: Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法
INT-032.exam_trap: Calling the unused equity balance the break-point
INT-032.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-032.subtopic: INT.2 Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法

INT-033.reasoning: Reasoning: Cumulative cash hits 100 at 2.5 years. NPV = -100 + 40/1.1 + 40/1.21 + 40/1.331 + 80/1.4641 = 54.11. Payback can ignore a year-4 hole just as easily as it ignored the year-4 gift. Given: CF -100, 40, 40, 40, 80; cutoff 3 years; r 10%. Asked: Payback versus NPV. Formula: −100 + 40(1.1−1 + 1.1−2 + 1.1−3) + 80/1.14 Variables: Payback 2.5 years. Why this formula: Quant TVM is what payback skips. Agreement this time is luck, not a reason to prefer payback. Reasonableness check: If CF4 were 0, payback would still be 2.5 but NPV would be about -0.5. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-033.steps: ①Payback = 2.5 years. ②NPV = 54.11. ③NPV is the value rule.

why_wrong.A: Year-4 cash is ignored by payback but not by NPV; NPV is still positive.
why_wrong.C: Undiscounted net is +100, but that is not NPV. Payback is 2.5, not 3.0.

INT-033.zh: 回收期不管折現、也不管截止日之後的現金。這裡回收2.5 年且NPV 約54。
INT-033.core_idea: Payback ignores TVM and cash after cutoff; NPV does not
INT-033.study_section: Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法
INT-033.exam_trap: Treating undiscounted net cash as NPV
INT-033.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-033.subtopic: INT.2 Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法

INT-034.reasoning: Reasoning: ROIC > required return suggests the firm has been creating value. It does not override ‘only one project.’ Take the larger NPV.

why_wrong.B: NPV, not IRR, ranks mutually exclusive projects.
why_wrong.C: ROIC vs WACC is firm-level and backward-looking; it does not cancel mutual exclusivity.

INT-034.zh: ROIC>WACC 不能拿來同時做兩個互斥案子。
INT-034.core_idea: ROIC versus WACC does not override a mutually exclusive NPV ranking
INT-034.study_section: Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法
INT-034.formula: compare ROIC with WACC; rank exclusive projects by NPV
INT-034.exam_trap: Using ROIC > WACC to override mutual exclusivity
INT-034.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-034.subtopic: INT.2 Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法

INT-035.reasoning: Reasoning: E[NPV] = 0.30×40 + 0.50×10 + 0.20×(-20) = 13. A positive expected NPV is an accept on that criterion; it is not a promise the slump will not occur. Given: NPVs 40, 10, -20; p 0.30, 0.50, 0.20. Asked: Expected NPV. Formula: 0.30 × 40 + 0.50 × 10 + 0.20 × (−20) Variables: Weights sum to 1. Why this formula: Quant expectation of Corp NPVs. The slump is already inside the average. Reasonableness check: Probabilities sum to 1. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Uses the modal (normal) NPV and ignores the tails.
why_wrong.C: Conditions on only the boom.

INT-035.zh: 期望NPV 是機率加權。13>0 可接受，但不保證不會碰到-20。
INT-035.core_idea: Expected NPV is the probability-weighted average of scenario NPVs
INT-035.study_section: Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法
INT-035.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-035.subtopic: INT.2 Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法

INT-036.reasoning: Reasoning: Independent + unlimited capital: take every NPV > 0. The zero-NPV project leaves wealth unchanged.

why_wrong.A: NPV = 0 ⇔IRR = r ⇔PI = 1 is indifference, not a strict accept.
why_wrong.C: 9% < WACC; that project’s NPV is negative.

INT-036.zh: 獨立常規：只做NPV>0。NPV=0 是無差異。
INT-036.core_idea: Independent conventional projects: take every NPV > 0; NPV = 0 is indifference
INT-036.study_section: Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法
INT-036.exam_trap: Treating NPV = 0 as a strict accept
INT-036.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-036.subtopic: INT.2 Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法

INT-037.reasoning: Reasoning: Monthly EAR = (1.0075)12 - 1 = 9.381%; continuous = e^0.09 - 1 = 9.417%. After tax: 7.036% and 7.063%. Ordering: stated < monthly < continuous. Given: Stated 9%; monthly vs continuous; t 25%. Asked: After-tax EARs. Formula: 0.75[(1.0075)12 −1] and 0.75(e0.09 −1) Variables: i = 0.09. Why this formula: Quant compounding plus Corp tax shield. Continuous is the upper bound on EAR for a fixed stated rate. Reasonableness check: ICONV does not do continuous. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Applies (1-t) to the stated rate and skips compounding.
why_wrong.B: Those are the pretax EARs.

INT-037.zh: 同樣9% 報價，連續複利EAR 最高，再乘(1-t)。
INT-037.core_idea: Continuous EAR = e^i - 1 exceeds the periodic EAR; then apply (1-t) only to debt
INT-037.study_section: Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法
INT-037.exam_trap: Taxing the stated rate and skipping the EAR step
INT-037.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-037.subtopic: INT.2 Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法

INT-038.reasoning: Reasoning: NPV = -8 - 3 + 14 = 3. Flexibility can flip a negative static NPV if the option value exceeds the static hole plus the cost of keeping it alive. Given: Static NPV -8; option cost 3; option value 14. Asked: Project NPV with the option. Formula: −8 −3 + 14 Variables: Three-layer analysis from the sources. Why this formula: Corp real-option layering. The option more than covers the static loss. Reasonableness check: If the option were worth only 10, combined NPV would be -1. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Adds the cost and ignores the value: -8 - 3 = -11.
why_wrong.C: Adds the option value but forgets the cost: -8 + 14 = 6.

INT-038.zh: 有選擇權的NPV = 靜態NPV - 成本+ 價值。
INT-038.core_idea: Project NPV with options = static NPV - option cost + option value
INT-038.study_section: Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法
INT-038.exam_trap: Dropping the option cost when adding flexibility
INT-038.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-038.subtopic: INT.2 Corporate + Quant ｜公司發行人與數量方法

INT-039.reasoning: Reasoning: Nominal rf = 1.02 × 1.04 - 1 = 6.08%. r = 6.08% + 5% = 11.08%. V0 = 3.00 / (0.1108 - 0.04) = 42.37. Given: Real rf 2%; π 4%; ERP 5%; β 1; D1 3.00; g 4%. Asked: Gordon value. Formula: 3/(1.02 × 1.04 −1 + 0.05 −0.04) Variables: Multiplicative nominal rf. Why this formula: Inflation sits in the rate; Equity Gordon uses that r. Higher inflation, unchanged nominal D1, lower price. Reasonableness check: Additive rf = 6% would give r = 11% and V = 42.9, close but not the source identity. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-039.zh: 通膨上升墊高名目rf 與r；D1 若沒上修，Gordon 下跌。不要漏掉g。
INT-039.core_idea: A higher inflation premium raises nominal rf and CAPM r and lowers Gordon if D1 is unchanged
INT-039.exam_trap: Forgetting to reprice r when inflation rises
INT-039.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-039.subtopic: INT.3 Economics + Equity ｜經濟學與權益

INT-040.reasoning: Reasoning: Policy tightens →real (and usually nominal) rates up →CAPM r up →r-g up →V0 down if D1 is fixed. A separate earnings-revision story can cut D1 further for cyclicals.

why_wrong.A: Gordon is V0 = D1/(r-g); r is required return.
why_wrong.B: Tighter money can weaken cyclical earnings — that would also cut D1 — but the stem holds D1 and g fixed, so the only channel is a higher r.

INT-040.zh: 緊縮升息會墊高r；若股利預測沒改，Gordon 價格下降。循環股還可能再下修 D1。
INT-040.core_idea: Tight monetary policy raises real rates and, through r, lowers equity values if cash forecasts are unchanged
INT-040.exam_trap: Assuming tighter money raises equity prices via earnings
INT-040.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-040.subtopic: INT.3 Economics + Equity ｜經濟學與權益

INT-041.reasoning: Reasoning: Cyclical: energy, financials, technology, materials, consumer discretionary. Defensive: utilities, staples, basic services. Forward P/E uses E1; a recession cuts cyclical E1 hardest.

why_wrong.A: Growth non-cyclicals have demand strong enough that the cycle barely shows — not a larger E1 collapse than cyclicals.
why_wrong.C: Defensives have relatively stable demand.

INT-041.zh: 衰退時循環股的E1 掉最多，前瞻P/E 的分母被壓縮。防禦型需求較穩。
INT-041.core_idea: Cyclical industries swing with GDP; non-cyclicals (especially defensives) do not
INT-041.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-041.subtopic: INT.3 Economics + Equity ｜經濟學與權益

INT-042.reasoning: Reasoning: Weaker forces →higher profit potential →higher ROE if the firm keeps a share. Sustainable g = retention × ROE rises with that ROE. Justified P/E = payout/(r-g) rises with g (other things equal). Commodity/undifferentiated industries are the opposite.

why_wrong.A: High concentration can still produce price wars if products are undifferentiated or exit barriers trap overcapacity — that is the commodity case, not this one.
why_wrong.B: Porter’s forces are the frame for relative profit potential.

INT-042.zh: 五力弱，利潤與ROE 較能持久，同樣配息下g 較高，合理P/E 也較高。商品型 產業相反。
INT-042.core_idea: Porter: weaker five forces support higher persistent ROE and a higher sustainable g
INT-042.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-042.subtopic: INT.3 Economics + Equity ｜經濟學與權益

INT-043.reasoning: Reasoning: CIP: F_f/d = S_f/d(1+r_f τ)/(1+r_d τ) = 1.2743. The high-interest currency cheapens forward. Equity translation of next year’s foreign EPS uses the future spot (or a forecast), not the CIP forward as if it were E[S]. Given: S 1.25; rd 3%; rf 5%; τ = 1. Asked: CIP forward and what it is not. Formula: 1.2500 × 1.05/1.03 Variables: Quote is foreign per domestic. Why this formula: Econ CIP versus Equity’s translation of foreign earnings. Covered interest is a cash-and-carry price. Reasonableness check: 1.25 × 1.03/1.05 = 1.2262 reverses the rates. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-043.steps: ①F = 1.2743. ②High-rate currency at a forward discount. ③Do not plug F in as E[S] for EPS.

why_wrong.B: Additive 1.25 × 1.02 = 1.2750 is an approximation, and CIP is not Gordon’s expected spot.

INT-043.zh: 拋補利率平價給的是無套利遠期，不是明年EPS 換匯的預測即期。高利率貨幣遠 期較便宜。
INT-043.core_idea: CIP sets the no-arbitrage forward; a multinational’s converted foreign earnings use the actual future spot, not CIP as a forecast
INT-043.exam_trap: Using CIP as a forecast of the spot that converts foreign EPS
INT-043.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-043.subtopic: INT.3 Economics + Equity ｜經濟學與權益

INT-044.reasoning: Reasoning: Government borrowing raises rates →CAPM r up. Displaced private investment can lower future earnings growth →g down. Both widen r-g and cut V0.

why_wrong.A: It is also a required-return story: higher rates enter CAPM rf.
why_wrong.B: Crowding-out is the rate-up, private-investment-down case.

INT-044.zh: 排擠升息：r 上升；被排掉的投資還可能壓低g。兩邊都讓r-g 變大。
INT-044.core_idea: Crowding-out raises interest rates and displaces private investment; equity r rises and growth can fall
INT-044.exam_trap: Reading crowding-out as stimulative for equity g
INT-044.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-044.subtopic: INT.3 Economics + Equity ｜經濟學與權益

INT-045.reasoning: Reasoning: Nominal D1 = 2.00 × 1.02 = 2.04. Nominal g = 1.03 × 1.02 - 1 = 5.06%. V0 = 2.04 / (0.11 - 0.0506) = 34.34. Given: Real D1 2.00; real g 3%; π 2%; nominal r 11%. Asked: Consistent Gordon value. Formula: 2.00 × 1.02/(0.11 −(1.03 × 1.02 −1)) Variables: Nominal g = 5.06%. Why this formula: Same inflation identity as in Quant/Econ, applied to Equity cash. Inflate both the dividend and growth, or deflate r; do not mix. Reasonableness check: Real r = 1.11/1.02 - 1 = 8.82%; 2.00/(0.0882-0.03) = 34.36, same. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Mixes real D1 with nominal r and real g: 2.00/(0.11 - 0.03) = 25.0.
why_wrong.C: Mixes real D1 with nominal r and uses inflation as g: 2.00/(0.11 - 0.02) = 22.2.

INT-045.zh: 名目配名目、實質配實質。實質股利配名目r 是混用。
INT-045.core_idea: Gordon needs a nominal r on nominal dividends, or a real r on real dividends — one pair, not a mix
INT-045.exam_trap: Mixing real dividends with a nominal required return
INT-045.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-045.subtopic: INT.3 Economics + Equity ｜經濟學與權益

INT-046.reasoning: Reasoning: The sources’ policy mix: easy fiscal + tight money →higher rates, smaller private sector, output can still rise. Higher rates enter rf and r. With D1 fixed, V0 falls. A separate forecast that raises cyclical D1 would be an extra assumption.

why_wrong.B: The mix is a rate story; r is an input to Gordon.
why_wrong.C: The stem holds D1 fixed; do not invent an instant earnings boom that offsets r.

INT-046.zh: 寬財政+ 緊貨幣：利率上升。D1 不變時Gordon 下跌。不要另外發明盈餘立刻大 增來抵銷。
INT-046.core_idea: Easy fiscal plus tight money raises rates and can still raise output; equity r rises
INT-046.exam_trap: Letting an unstated D1 boom offset the rate rise
INT-046.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-046.subtopic: INT.3 Economics + Equity ｜經濟學與權益

INT-047.reasoning: Reasoning: The industry life cycle maps onto the DDM choice. Mature, not very cyclical, g < r: Gordon. Launch/growth: multi-stage. Preferred: D/r.

why_wrong.A: Supernormal g is for the high-growth phase, and it must end.
why_wrong.C: Preferred uses a no-growth perpetuity; mature common still has g.

INT-047.zh: 成熟、不太循環、g<r，才用Gordon。導入期的高g 不能永遠套。
INT-047.core_idea: Gordon is a model for a mature, not very cyclical, constant-growth phase
INT-047.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-047.subtopic: INT.3 Economics + Equity ｜經濟學與權益

INT-048.reasoning: Reasoning: Sources: relative share can matter more than absolute share; undifferentiated products let buyers chase the lowest price; costly exit plus overcapacity produces price wars even among a few large firms. The rich multiple is unsupported.

why_wrong.A: Justified P/E = payout/(r-g) and g = retention × ROE, so ROE is relevant.
why_wrong.C: Four firms are an oligopoly, not a monopoly, and the sources warn against reading concentration as pricing power.

INT-048.zh: 高集中度̸= 定價權。商品型、退出成本高、產能過剩，會打價格戰，ROE 與合理 倍數都不該假設很高。
INT-048.core_idea: Undifferentiated commodity products erase pricing power even in a concentrated industry
INT-048.exam_trap: Reading industry concentration as proof of a rich justified P/E
INT-048.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-048.subtopic: INT.3 Economics + Equity ｜經濟學與權益

INT-049.reasoning: Reasoning: R_d/f up means fewer foreign goods per domestic basket: the dollar’s purchasing power over euro-area goods decreases. That is not ‘the euro is stronger,’ and it is not a license to replace the nominal spot when converting euro EPS into dollars.

why_wrong.B: The real rate is specifically the purchasing-power measure; it is not irrelevant.
why_wrong.C: A higher quoted real rate is not a stronger euro, and it is not a translation rate.

INT-049.zh: 實質USD/EUR 上升：一美元籃子能換到的歐元區商品變少。這是購買力，不是 「歐元變強」，也不是把子公司EPS 換算成美元的名目匯率。
INT-049.core_idea: A rise in the real exchange rate means fewer foreign goods per domestic basket — a hit to a foreign subsidiary’s domestic-currency value
INT-049.exam_trap: Reading a rise in the real exchange rate as a stronger foreign currency
INT-049.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-049.subtopic: INT.3 Economics + Equity ｜經濟學與權益

INT-050.reasoning: Reasoning: P1 = 1.89 / 0.07 = 27.00. V0 = (1.80 + 27.00) / 1.12 = 25.71. Given: D0 2.40 peak; recession D1 1.80; g 5% after year 1; r 12%. Asked: One-year HP value. Formula: (1.80 + 1.80 × 1.05/(0.12 −0.05))/1.12 Variables: D2 = 1.89. Why this formula: Econ cycle revises Equity’s first cash flow. The recession dividend is the one the buyer receives. Reasonableness check: Peak Gordon 2.40×1.05/0.07 = 36 is the usual trap. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-050.zh: 衰退要把循環股的D1 切下來，不能拿高峰D0 當明年股利。終值用衰退後的正常 g。
INT-050.core_idea: In a recession, cut cyclical D1 before applying Gordon; do not keep last year’s peak dividend
INT-050.exam_trap: Feeding a peak-cycle D0 into Gordon as if it were D1
INT-050.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-050.subtopic: INT.3 Economics + Equity ｜經濟學與權益

INT-051.reasoning: Reasoning: D1=1.20, D2=1.44, D3=1.512. V2=21.60. V0=1.20/1.12+(1.44+21.60)/1.12² = 19.44. The life-cycle stage forbids keeping 20% forever. Given: D0=1; gS=20% for 2 years; gL=5%; r=12%. Asked: Two-stage value. Formula: 1.20/1.12 + (1.44 + 1.512/0.07)/1.122 Variables: V2 uses D3. Why this formula: Industry stage selects multi-stage; TVM discounts it. High g is temporary; the sale sits at the last high-growth date. Reasonableness check: CF0=0, C01=1.20, C02=23.04, I=12. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：CF / NPV 已知：CF0=0; C01=1.20; C02=23.04; I=12 求：NPV=V0 按鍵： ①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②0 ENTER ③↓1.20 ENTER ④↓↓23.04 ENTER ⑤NPV 12 ENTER ⑥↓CPT 結果：19.44 中文理解：終值加在D2 那一期。

why_wrong.A: Applies Gordon from D0 at long-run g: 1.00×1.05/(0.12-0.05) = 15.0, skipping supernormal years.
why_wrong.C: Reports undiscounted V2 = 1.512/(0.12-0.05) = 21.6 as today’s price.

INT-051.zh: 導入期高成長要逐年折現；終值與最後一年高成長股利加在同一期。
INT-051.core_idea: A launch-stage firm needs multi-stage DDM; perpetual launch g is the wrong model
INT-051.exam_trap: Treating launch-stage g as perpetual Gordon g
INT-051.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：CF / NPV
已知：CF0=0; C01=1.20; C02=23.04; I=12
求：NPV=V0
按鍵：
①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②0 ENTER ③↓1.20 ENTER ④↓↓23.04 ENTER ⑤NPV
12 ENTER ⑥↓CPT
結果：19.44
中文理解：終值加在D2 那一期。
INT-051.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-051.subtopic: INT.3 Economics + Equity ｜經濟學與權益

INT-052.reasoning: Reasoning: RI = (0.11 - 0.08) × 400 = 12. Barriers can make that ROE persist, which is why a justified P/B can stay above 1. One year’s RI is still not V0. Given: ROE 11%; r 8%; book equity 400. Asked: Residual income and what it is not. Formula: (0.11 −0.08) × 400 Variables: Statutory barriers support persistence, not a price formula. Why this formula: Econ structure plus Equity residual screen. Persistent RI > 0 is why P/B can exceed 1. Reasonableness check: Gordon would still need a dividend path. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Do not capitalize the residual as equity / r.
why_wrong.B: Residual income is not book equity.

INT-052.zh: 進入障礙讓ROE 能高於r，剩餘收益是篩選不是股價。
INT-052.core_idea: Monopoly / high entry barriers support a persistent ROE above r; that is a residual-income screen, not a price
INT-052.exam_trap: Treating residual income as intrinsic value
INT-052.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-052.subtopic: INT.3 Economics + Equity ｜經濟學與權益

INT-053.reasoning: Reasoning: Difference = (0.055-0.040)×10,000,000×0.25 = 37,500. Settled PV = 37,500/(1+0.05×0.25) = 37,037. The extra borrow cost is about the same 15,000 at period-end; the FRA’s PV receipt funds it. Given: Notional 10m; 90-day; IFR 4%; MRR 5.5%; z 5%. Asked: FRA settlement and hedge purpose. Formula: (0.055 −0.040) × 10000000 × 0.25/(1 + 0.05 × 0.25) Variables: τ=0.25. Why this formula: Deriv FRA payoff hedges FI borrowing cost. Higher MRR hurts the loan and helps the long FRA. Reasonableness check: If MRR had fallen, the FRA would pay out and the loan would be cheaper. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-053.steps: ①Undiscounted 37,500. ②Divide by 1.0125 →37,037. ③Long FRA is the borrower hedge.

why_wrong.B: Settlement is at the beginning of the interest period, so the difference is presentvalued.
why_wrong.C: The future borrower is long the FRA (the side that ‘borrows’ at the contract rate).

INT-053.zh: 未來借款人做多FRA。結算在利息期初，差額要折現。利率上升時收款，剛好補 較貴的借款。
INT-053.core_idea: A future borrower goes long the FRA; settlement is the PV of the rate difference at the start of the period
INT-053.study_section: FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品
INT-053.exam_trap: Leaving the FRA difference undiscounted or reversing the hedge side
INT-053.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-053.subtopic: INT.4 FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品

INT-054.reasoning: Reasoning: Receive-fixed = long a fixed bond financed by issuing a floater. Higher yields lower the PV of the fixed leg. Swap price (the fixed rate) does not change; swap value does.

why_wrong.A: Pay-fixed is hurt when rates fall, not when they rise.
why_wrong.C: A long FRA (borrower hedge) gains when MRR rises.

INT-054.zh: 收固定＝長固定利率債券的風險。利率升，固定腿變便宜，MTM 虧。不要把 swap 的price 和value 搞混。
INT-054.core_idea: Pay-float receive-fixed has the risk-return profile of a long fixed-rate bond
INT-054.study_section: FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品
INT-054.exam_trap: Confusing swap price with swap value, or reversing the fixed-leg duration
INT-054.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-054.subtopic: INT.4 FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品

INT-055.reasoning: Reasoning: F0 = 80×1.060.5 = 82.37. Quote 84 is rich: sell forward, buy the asset with funds borrowed at 6%, deliver at T, repay 82.35, keep the gap. Given: S0=80; r=6%; T=0.5; quote=84; no income. Asked: Fair F0 and the arbitrage side. Formula: 80 × 1.060.5 Variables: V0=0 at a fair quote. Why this formula: Deriv carry price; FI/TVM is the loan. The gap is locked at T after the loan is repaid. Reasonableness check: If the quote were 81, reverse: buy forward, short spot, lend. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：TVM 已知：N = 0.5; I/Y = 6; PV = -80; PMT = 0; P/Y = 1; C/Y = 1 求：FV=F0 按鍵： ①2nd →I/Y ②1 →ENTER (P/Y = 1) ③↓④1 →ENTER (C/Y = 1) ⑤2nd →CPT (QUIT) ⑥2nd →CLR TVM [CLR TVM does not reset P/Y or C/Y] ⑦0.5 →N ⑧6 →I/Y ⑨80 →+/- →PV ⑩0 →PMT 11 CPT →FV 結果：82.37 中文理解：先用2nd I/Y 把P/Y 與C/Y 設成1，再QUIT。CLR TVM 只清N、I/Y、PV、 PMT、FV，不會重設P/Y 或C/Y。N 可以是0.5；不要改成N=1。
INT-055.steps: ①F0=82.37. ②84 > 82.35 →sell forward. ③Borrow and buy spot.

why_wrong.A: Quoted 84 > fair 82.3, so sell the rich forward and buy the cheap spot (cashand-carry).
why_wrong.C: N = 0.5, not 1. 80×1.06 = 84.80 is the one-year carry.

INT-055.zh: 無股息遠期是現貨用無風險利率長大。報價偏貴就賣遠期、借錢買現貨。T=0.5 不要當一年。
INT-055.core_idea: No-income forward F0 = S0(1+r)^T; a quoted forward above that is sold, and the asset is bought with borrowed cash
INT-055.study_section: FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品
INT-055.exam_trap: Using a full-year carry for a half-year forward
INT-055.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：TVM
已知：N = 0.5; I/Y = 6; PV = -80; PMT = 0; P/Y = 1; C/Y = 1
求：FV=F0
按鍵：
①2nd →I/Y ②1 →ENTER (P/Y = 1) ③↓④1 →ENTER (C/Y = 1) ⑤2nd →CPT
(QUIT) ⑥2nd →CLR TVM [CLR TVM does not reset P/Y or C/Y] ⑦0.5 →N ⑧6 →I/Y
⑨80 →+/- →PV ⑩0 →PMT 11 CPT →FV
結果：82.37
中文理解：先用2nd I/Y 把P/Y 與C/Y 設成1，再QUIT。CLR TVM 只清N、I/Y、PV、
PMT、FV，不會重設P/Y 或C/Y。N 可以是0.5；不要改成N=1。
INT-055.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-055.subtopic: INT.4 FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品

INT-056.reasoning: Reasoning: PV(X)=50/1.05=47.62. p=4.20+47.62-50=1.82. Fiduciary call (call + bond) equals protective put (stock + put). Given: S=X=50; r=5%; T=1; c=4.20. Asked: Put price. Formula: 4.20 + 50/1.05 −50 Variables: Bond pays 50 at T. Why this formula: Deriv parity uses an FI zero. The put is cheaper than the call because the bond is cheaper than the share when r>0. Reasonableness check: Forward is 52.5; X < F so the call should exceed the put. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Uses X - S = 0 and forgets the bond, or uses S - PV(X) = 2.38 as if it were a put.
why_wrong.B: Sets p = c because the options are at-the-money.

INT-056.zh: 買賣權平價裡的債券是FI 的零息現值。ATM 也不代表put=call（除非遠期平價 且X=F）。
INT-056.core_idea: Put-call parity: p = c + PV(X) - S; the bond is the FI piece
INT-056.study_section: FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品
INT-056.exam_trap: Setting p=c because the option is at-the-money on the spot
INT-056.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-056.subtopic: INT.4 FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品

INT-057.reasoning: Reasoning: Short-dated contracts with borrowing at rf have no material futures/forward gap, with two qualifications: convexity bias on rates, and MTM–rate correlation. Convexity is the FI property of a bond-like forward.

why_wrong.A: MTM–rate correlation can separate prices, but it is not an automatic ‘futures richer’ rule.
why_wrong.B: The sources list convexity bias as a reason they need not coincide.

INT-057.zh: 利率遠期對殖利率是凸的，利率期貨當線性，凸性偏誤會讓兩個價格分開。
INT-057.core_idea: Interest-rate forwards are convex in yield; futures are treated as linear — convexity bias can separate the prices
INT-057.study_section: FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品
INT-057.exam_trap: Treating futures and forwards as identical on long-dated rates
INT-057.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-057.subtopic: INT.4 FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品

INT-058.reasoning: Reasoning: CDS is a contingent claim that pays on a credit event. The FI cash bond still has its coupon, duration, and spread. The hedge is the credit piece, not a rewrite of the indenture.

why_wrong.A: CDS plus bond is a hedged credit position, not an automatic Treasury clone (basis, cheapest-to-deliver, counterparty).
why_wrong.B: The bond still exists and still pays its coupon unless it defaults.

INT-058.zh: 買CDS 是把信用風險轉出去，票息契約還在。不是把債券註銷，也不保證變成公 債。
INT-058.core_idea: A CDS transfers credit risk; it does not change the issuer’s contractual coupon
INT-058.study_section: FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品
INT-058.exam_trap: Treating CDS + bond as a cancelled bond or a perfect Treasury
INT-058.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-058.subtopic: INT.4 FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品

INT-059.reasoning: Reasoning: Floating debt + pay-fixed swap ≈synthetic fixed-rate debt. Each swap payment is an off-market FRA; together they lock the rate path. That is a cash-flow hedge of interest payments, not a fair-value hedge of a fixed bond’s price.

why_wrong.A: Equity options do not hedge MRR-linked coupons.
why_wrong.B: Receivefixed would add, not cancel, floating-rate exposure on the liability.

INT-059.zh: 浮息負債要鎖現金流：付固定、收浮動。這是現金流避險，不是去對沖固定債的 價格。
INT-059.core_idea: Pay-fixed on floating-rate debt is a cash-flow hedge of interest payments
INT-059.study_section: FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品
INT-059.exam_trap: Using receive-fixed to hedge floating-rate interest cash flows
INT-059.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-059.subtopic: INT.4 FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品

INT-060.reasoning: Reasoning: Par swap rate sets value to zero at t=0. Later, lower market rates make the old high fixed receipts valuable. Duration of receive-fixed is why the value signs like a long bond when yields fall.

why_wrong.A: Swaps do not daily-reset their contractual fixed rate to zero value the way futures reset MTM to zero.
why_wrong.B: Price is not value.

INT-060.zh: Swap 的price 是合約固定利率，不會改；value 才是MTM。市場利率下降，收固 定的value 為正。
INT-060.core_idea: Swap price is the fixed rate and stays put; swap value starts at zero and then moves
INT-060.study_section: FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品
INT-060.formula: value0 = 0 at the par swap rate
INT-060.exam_trap: Calling swap MTM the swap price
INT-060.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-060.subtopic: INT.4 FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品

INT-061.reasoning: Reasoning: OAS = 180 - 45 = 135 bp. Compare credit after stripping the embedded Deriv. Effective duration, not modified duration from own YTM, is the rate-risk tool when cash flows are call-dependent. Given: Z 180 bp; call worth 45 bp. Asked: OAS and its meaning. Formula: 180 −45 Variables: Putable would add the option. Why this formula: FI spread stack plus Deriv embedded option. 135 bp is what remains for credit/liquidity once the call is taken out. Reasonableness check: If the bond were putable, OAS would exceed the Z-spread. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: OAS = Z - option value in spread terms for a callable.
why_wrong.C: A call is the issuer’s option; it is not holder protection (that would be a put, OAS > Z).

INT-061.zh: 可贖回：OAS = Z - 選擇權價值。Call 對持有人不利。現金流會變時用有效存續 期間。
INT-061.core_idea: Callable: issuer’s call hurts the holder, so OAS < Z-spread; the option is a Deriv embedded in a FI price
INT-061.study_section: FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品
INT-061.exam_trap: Adding the call into OAS as if it were holder protection
INT-061.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-061.subtopic: INT.4 FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品

INT-062.reasoning: Reasoning: BPV = 5,000,000 × 0.0001 × 0.25 = 125. Ten bp × 125 = 1,250 loss for the long. A future lender who is hurt by lower rates would be long futures / short FRA; a future borrower is the opposite. Given: Notional 5m; 90-day MRR futures. Asked: BPV and the long’s P&L if MRR +10 bp. Formula: 5000000 × 0.0001 × 0.25 Variables: Quote falls when MRR rises. Why this formula: FI BPV arithmetic on a Deriv rate future. The borrower hedge is short this future (or long the FRA). Reasonableness check: A 10 bp fall would credit the long 1,250. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-062.steps: ①BPV=125. ②Long loses when MRR rises. ③10×125=1,250.

why_wrong.A: Quote = 100 - 100×MRR falls when MRR rises, so the long loses.
why_wrong.C: BPV without τ = 500; the period fraction is required. The long loses when MRR rises because the quote falls.

INT-062.zh: 報價100-100×MRR。利率升，報價跌，期貨多方虧。BPV 要乘天期分數。
INT-062.core_idea: Interest-rate futures on MRR are quoted 100 - 100×MRR; BPV = notional × 0.01% × period
INT-062.study_section: FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品
INT-062.exam_trap: Omitting the period fraction in BPV or reversing the long’s sign
INT-062.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-062.subtopic: INT.4 FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品

INT-063.reasoning: Reasoning: Putable = option-free + put (Deriv). Holder’s put raises price and OAS relative to Z. When yields rise and the put approaches exercise, effective duration can drop toward the put date.

why_wrong.B: Cash flows are rate-dependent, so effective duration — not own-YTM modified duration — is the tool.
why_wrong.C: A put is holder-friendly; it adds value. The ‘all embedded options cheapen the bond’ rule is false.

INT-063.zh: 可賣回＝直債+put，價格較高。利率敏感度用有效存續期間，不要把所有嵌入選 擇權都背成「一定比較便宜」。
INT-063.core_idea: A putable bond is a straight bond plus a put; effective duration is the right rate-risk measure
INT-063.study_section: FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品
INT-063.exam_trap: Treating every embedded option as value-destroying for the holder
INT-063.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-063.subtopic: INT.4 FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品

INT-064.reasoning: Reasoning: Vt = 62 - 60/1.050.25 = 62 - 59.27 = 2.73. At maturity the discount vanishes and payoff is ST - F0. Given: F0=60; St=62; r=5%; 0.25 year left; no carry extras. Asked: Long MTM. Formula: 62 −60/1.050.25 Variables: Short is the negative. Why this formula: Deriv MTM; FI/TVM discounts the contracted payment. The right to buy at 60 is already in the money on a discounted basis. Reasonableness check: If St were 59, value would be slightly negative. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Grows the contracted price forward instead of discounting it: 62 - 60×1.050.25.
why_wrong.B: Uses ST - F0 as if it were already maturity: 62 - 60 = 2.

INT-064.zh: 存續期間的遠期價值是現貨減「合約價的現值」，不是已到期的ST-F0。
INT-064.core_idea: During the life, long forward value is St - PV of the contracted price
INT-064.study_section: FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品
INT-064.exam_trap: Using the maturity payoff as the mid-life value
INT-064.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-064.subtopic: INT.4 FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品

INT-065.reasoning: Reasoning: Future borrower →long FRA. Higher MRR: FRA receipt, costlier CP. Net ≈contract rate. Do not read a T-bill/CP discount rate as YTM when you check the all-in cost.

why_wrong.A: Money-market discount rates are not YTMs; that mix understates cost.
why_wrong.B: The long FRA receives when MRR > IFR.

INT-065.zh: 未來借款人做多FRA：利率升，FRA 收款、票券變貴，軋起來接近鎖住的合約利 率。不要把貼現率當YTM。
INT-065.core_idea: If MRR rises, the long FRA receives a payment that offsets a higher future borrowing cost
INT-065.study_section: FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品
INT-065.exam_trap: Reading a CP discount rate as YTM when judging the hedge
INT-065.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-065.subtopic: INT.4 FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品

INT-066.reasoning: Reasoning: Approx/effective duration reprices under a curve shift. That is how the embedded Deriv enters a FI risk number. Modified duration from own YTM assumes a parallel yield shift with fixed cash flows.

why_wrong.B: A callable is not a zero; MacDur is not maturity, and YTM is a poor input when cash flows are optional.
why_wrong.C: The option changes percentage sensitivity; you cannot ignore it.

INT-066.zh: 現金流會隨利率變（call/put/MBS）時，改移基準曲線算有效存續期間，不要用 自己的YTM。
INT-066.core_idea: Effective duration uses a benchmark-curve shift so embedded options can change cash flows
INT-066.study_section: FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品
INT-066.exam_trap: Using own-YTM modified duration on a callable
INT-066.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-066.subtopic: INT.4 FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品

INT-067.reasoning: Reasoning: Lower yields raise a receive-fixed / long-duration position. On a forward that gain sits as value. On a future it has already been paid as variation margin. Cumulative MTM over the life is comparable to the forward payoff.

why_wrong.B: OTC forwards typically retain more counterparty exposure when not cleared.
why_wrong.C: Futures variation margin is exchanged daily; residual contract value is reset to zero.

INT-067.zh: 利率下跌，長存續期間部位賺錢。遠期把利潤留在合約價值；期貨每天結算，價 值歸零，現金已進保證金。
INT-067.core_idea: Futures daily settlement resets MTM to zero; a forward retains the accumulated value and counterparty risk
INT-067.study_section: FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品
INT-067.exam_trap: Assigning residual MTM value to a futures as if it were a forward
INT-067.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-067.subtopic: INT.4 FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品

INT-068.reasoning: Reasoning: 1 + z6×(180/360) = (1 + z3×90/360)×(1 + IFR×90/360). 1 + 0.036×0.5 = 1.018. 1 + 0.032×0.25 = 1.008. IFR×0.25 = 1.018/1.008 - 1 = 0.009921. IFR = 3.968% ≈4.00%. Long FRA: borrow long, lend short (lock in the later borrowing). Given: 90-day zero 3.20%; 180-day zero 3.60%; actual/360 style periods of 0.25 and 0.50. Asked: Implied 3×6 IFR and the synthetic long. Formula: (1 + 0.036 × 0.5)/(1 + 0.032 × 0.25) −1 Variables: Gap period = 0.25. Why this formula: FI spot–forward identity is the Deriv FRA rate. That implied rate is what a fairly priced FRA must use. Reasonableness check: A higher 180-day zero than 90-day zero produces a forward above both if compounding is respected — here the forward sits above 3.60%. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: The gap is not the simple difference of zeros, and the long synthetic FRA is not ‘lend long, borrow short.’
why_wrong.C: A single zero is not the forward.

INT-068.zh: 合成做多FRA：借長、貸短，鎖的就是中間那段遠期利率。不要用兩個零息相 減。
INT-068.core_idea: A synthetic FRA is borrow the longer horizon and lend the shorter; the implied rate is the contract rate
INT-068.study_section: FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品
INT-068.exam_trap: Subtracting zeros instead of chaining them, or reversing the synthetic
INT-068.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-068.subtopic: INT.4 FI + Derivatives ｜固定收益與衍生性商品

INT-069.reasoning: Reasoning: σp = √ [0.16×0.04 + 0.36×0.01 + 2×0.4×0.6×0.30×0.20×0.10] = √ 0.012880 = 11.35%. Any ρ<1 reduces risk below 14%. Given: w 40/60; σ 20% and 10%; ρ 0.30. Asked: Portfolio σ. Formula: √ 0.420.202 + 0.620.102 + 2 × 0.4 × 0.6 × 0.3 × 0.2 × 0.1 Variables: Covariance term = 0.00288. Why this formula: Quant covariance is the PM diversification engine. Diversification is the dropped piece versus 14%. Reasonableness check: ρ=0 would give 10.00%; ρ=1 would give 14.00%. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Uses ρ=1: 0.4×20% + 0.6×10% = 14.00%, the maximum risk for these weights.
why_wrong.C: Drops the covariance term as if ρ=0: √ (0.0064+0.0036)=10.00%.

INT-069.zh: 相關係數0.3 時，共變異那一項還在，但比ρ=1 小。不要直接加權平均σ。
INT-069.core_idea: Portfolio σ uses the covariance term; ρ=1 is the maximum, not the working case
INT-069.study_section: Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法
INT-069.exam_trap: Using the ρ=1 weighted-average σ as the portfolio risk
INT-069.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-069.subtopic: INT.5 Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法

INT-070.reasoning: Reasoning: Quant: independence ⇒uncorrelated, not the reverse. PM: drop 2w1w2ρσ1σ2 when ρ=0, but a nonlinear dependence can remain. Pearson’s t-test of ρ=0 is not a test of independence (chi-square is the categorical independence test).

why_wrong.A: Independent variables are uncorrelated; the converse is false.
why_wrong.B: ρ=0 still reduces σp below the ρ=1 maximum; it does not eliminate diversification.

INT-070.zh: ρ=0 只說沒有線性關係，組合風險公式可以去掉共變異項；但不能說兩個報酬獨 立。
INT-070.core_idea: ρ=0 is no linear association; it does not establish independence
INT-070.study_section: Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法
INT-070.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-070.subtopic: INT.5 Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法

INT-071.reasoning: Reasoning: Sharpe = (0.12-0.03)/0.16 = 0.562. That slope is the CAL through this risky fund. Comparable to the CML slope only if the fund is M. Given: E(R)=12%; Rf=3%; σ=16%. Asked: Sharpe and which line. Formula: (0.12 −0.03)/0.16 Variables: Numerator must be positive to rank. Why this formula: Quant excess-return ratio is PM’s CAL slope. If the fund is not fully diversified, Sharpe (total risk) is the right comparative tool. Reasonableness check: Treynor would need beta. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: The CML is the CAL that uses the market portfolio, not every fund.
why_wrong.B: Sharpe’s denominator is σ, not β. Treynor uses β.

INT-071.zh: Sharpe 是超額報酬除以總風險，也就是這檔風險組合的CAL 斜率。不是SML， 也不自動是CML。
INT-071.core_idea: Sharpe is excess return per unit of total risk — the CAL slope
INT-071.study_section: Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法
INT-071.exam_trap: Putting beta in Sharpe or calling every CAL the CML
INT-071.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-071.subtopic: INT.5 Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法

INT-072.reasoning: Reasoning: Sharpe = 8%/22% = 0.364. Treynor = 8%/0.80 = 0.10. The sources: Sharpe and M² are total-risk tools; Treynor and Jensen are beta tools. Use the first pair when the book is not fully diversified.

why_wrong.B: β < 1 is not a diversification proof.
why_wrong.C: Jensen and Treynor are beta tools for diversified portfolios.

INT-072.zh: 還沒分散好，分母用σ（Sharpe/M²）。β<1 不代表殘差已消失。
INT-072.core_idea: If the book still has unsystematic risk, rank with Sharpe/M², not Treynor/Jensen
INT-072.study_section: Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法
INT-072.exam_trap: Using Treynor on an undiversified book because beta is below 1
INT-072.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-072.subtopic: INT.5 Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法

INT-073.reasoning: Reasoning: ρ = 0.018/(0.30×0.15) = 0.40. β = 0.018/0.0225 = 0.80. Also β = ρ × σi/σm = 0.40 × 2 = 0.80. CAPM then uses β, not ρ, as the priced-risk number. Given: Cov 0.018; σi 30%; σm 15%. Asked: ρ and β. Formula: 0.018/(0.30 × 0.15) and 0.018/0.152 Variables: β is the SML x-axis. Why this formula: Quant covariance identities are PM’s beta. Higher own σ raises beta only if the correlation stays put. Reasonableness check: β=0 is not risk-free if σe is large. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Swaps the two standardizations.
why_wrong.B: Drops a volatility.

INT-073.zh: 同一個共變異，除以兩個σ 是相關，除以市場方差是β。不要對調。
INT-073.core_idea: ρ = Cov/(σi σm) and β = Cov/σm² are different standardizations of the same covariance
INT-073.study_section: Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法
INT-073.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-073.subtopic: INT.5 Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法

INT-074.reasoning: Reasoning: SE = 12%/ √ 36 = 2.0%. A 95% z interval for the mean is about ¯x ± 1.96×2%. VaR on one month still uses a distribution of single-period losses, not this SE. Given: n=36; σ=12%. Asked: SE and what it is for. Formula: 0.12/ √ Variables: CLT for the mean. Why this formula: Quant sampling plus PM return estimation. More months tighten the estimated average, not the monthly storm. Reasonableness check: n=144 would cut SE to 1%. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-074.steps: √ 36=6. ②SE=2%. ③CI for the mean, not one-month VaR.

why_wrong.B: Quadrupling n halves SE; dividing by n overstates the reduction.
why_wrong.C: σ is stand-alone monthly risk, not the SE of the mean.

INT-074.zh: 標準誤是「平均報酬」的不確定性，12%/6=2%。不要拿去當單月VaR 的σ。
INT-074.core_idea: SE of the sample mean is σ/√n; it is the uncertainty of an average return, not the asset’s σ
INT-074.study_section: Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法
INT-074.exam_trap: Using population σ as the SE of the mean, or dividing by n
INT-074.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-074.subtopic: INT.5 Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法

INT-075.reasoning: Reasoning: Type I: announce alpha when none exists. That probability is α. Cutting α from 5% to 1% makes false discoveries rarer and missed true alphas more common. PM performance tests inherit Quant’s error trade-off.

why_wrong.B: Lower α makes rejection harder: Type I down, power down.
why_wrong.C: Stricter α does not cut both errors.

INT-075.zh: 其實沒有alpha 卻宣布有，是Type I。把顯著水平降到1%，虛驚變少，漏網變 多。
INT-075.core_idea: Rejecting a true H0 of alpha=0 is a Type I error; lowering α cuts Type I and raises Type II
INT-075.study_section: Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法
INT-075.exam_trap: Thinking a smaller α reduces Type I and Type II together
INT-075.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-075.subtopic: INT.5 Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法

INT-076.reasoning: Reasoning: AM = (10+20-5)/3 = 8.33%. Product = 1.10×1.20×0.95 = 1.254. GM = 1.254^(1/3) - 1 ≈0.078365 ≈7.84%. PM expected return (SML, next-period) uses AM. Compounded track record uses GM (and TWR if there were external flows). Given: Returns 10%, 20%, -5%. Asked: AM for CAPM input vs GM for wealth. Formula: (0.10 + 0.20 −0.05)/3 and (1.10 × 1.20 × 0.95)1/3 −1 Variables: Harmonic ≤geometric ≤arithmetic on return relatives. Why this formula: Quant means assigned to PM uses. AM > GM whenever returns vary. Reasonableness check: Do not use the 25.4% three-year lump as an annual expected return. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 1.10×1.20×0.95 - 1 = 25.4% is the three-year HPR, not an annual rate.
why_wrong.C: Swaps AM and GM.

INT-076.zh: 下一期期望報酬用算術平均；多年複利成績用幾何平均。不要對調。
INT-076.core_idea: Arithmetic mean is the unbiased one-period expected return; geometric mean is the compound multi-period wealth rate
INT-076.study_section: Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法
INT-076.exam_trap: Swapping AM and GM for expected return vs compound growth
INT-076.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-076.subtopic: INT.5 Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法

INT-077.reasoning: Reasoning: Two successive full-year HPRs: annualized TWR = √ (1.08×1.02) - 1 = 4.98%. Sharpe’s numerator is excess return on the same return definition. Do not put MWR in the numerator when the job is to grade the manager. Given: HPRs 8% and 2%; Rf 3%; flows already stripped. Asked: TWR and Sharpe’s return input. Formula: √ Variables: Two full years. Why this formula: Quant TWR is the PM manager return. A big contribution just before the 8% year would have lifted MWR above TWR. Reasonableness check: Arithmetic 5.00% is close here because the two HPRs are not far apart. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-077.final_answer: 4.98% TWR; use TWR - Rf in Sharpe

why_wrong.A: 1.08×1.02 - 1 = 10.16% is two-year wealth, not the annualized geometric TWR of two full-year HPRs. The stem is two successive full years, so TWR = √ (1.08×1.02) - 1 = 4.98%.
why_wrong.C: MWR grades the client’s dollar path, not the manager after flows.

INT-077.zh: 兩年HPR 的TWR 是幾何平均。Sharpe 的分子要用同一套報酬，評經理人不要 改用MWR。
INT-077.core_idea: TWR is the manager-skill return chain; Sharpe then divides that excess by σ of the same series
INT-077.study_section: Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法
INT-077.exam_trap: Putting MWR in Sharpe when the task is manager evaluation
INT-077.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-077.subtopic: INT.5 Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法

INT-078.reasoning: Reasoning: σp = √ [2×0.25×0.18² + 2×0.25×0.10×0.18²] = 13.35%. Sharpe = 8%/13.35% = 0.599. Lower ρ raises Sharpe by cutting σp. Given: 50/50; σ=18% each; ρ=0.10; E(R)=11%; Rf=3%. Asked: Portfolio Sharpe. Formula: 0.08/ √ 0.520.182 × 2 + 2 × 0.5 × 0.5 × 0.10 × 0.182 Variables: Identical σ simplifies the variance. Why this formula: Quant variance is PM’s Sharpe denominator. The 0.10 correlation is the diversification that Sharpe captures. Reasonableness check: ρ=1 would put σp back at 18% and Sharpe at 0.444. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Uses a single-asset σ in the denominator: 8%/18% = 0.444.
why_wrong.B: Treats the assets as independent and divides σ by √ 2 without the ρ term: 8%/(18%/ √ 2) ≈0.628.

INT-078.zh: 先算分散後的σ，再除超額報酬。用單一資產σ 會低估Sharpe。
INT-078.core_idea: Equal-weight two-asset σ then Sharpe: diversification shows up in the denominator
INT-078.study_section: Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法
INT-078.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-078.subtopic: INT.5 Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法

INT-079.reasoning: Reasoning: CAL slope = Sharpe. Q’s CAL lies above P’s at every risk level, including through leverage. The CML is the special case when that tangency fund is the market portfolio.

why_wrong.B: Two-fund separation picks one optimal risky portfolio — the one with the steeper CAL — not an average of dominated funds.
why_wrong.C: A higher E(R) with a much higher σ can still lose on Sharpe.

INT-079.zh: CAL 斜率就是Sharpe。Q 比較陡，就用Q 搭配無風險資產。不要用兩個被支配 基金的平均。
INT-079.core_idea: The CAL with the higher Sharpe dominates: two-fund separation uses that risky portfolio plus Rf
INT-079.study_section: Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法
INT-079.exam_trap: Picking the higher E(R) fund instead of the steeper CAL
INT-079.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-079.subtopic: INT.5 Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法

INT-080.reasoning: Reasoning: σp = |w1×24% - w2×12| when ρ=-1. Set 0.24 w1 = 0.12 (1-w1) →w1 = 0.12/0.36 = 0.333. The safer asset takes the larger weight. Given: σ 24% and 12%; ρ=-1. Asked: Zero-risk weight on the 24% asset. Formula: 0.12/(0.24 + 0.12) Variables: w2 = 2/3. Why this formula: Quant two-asset math is PM’s perfect-hedge mix. ρ=0 cannot do this; only ρ=-1 can drive σp to zero. Reasonableness check: σp at 50/50 = |0.12-0.06| = 6%, not zero. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Puts the larger weight on the riskier asset (the weight that belongs on asset 2).
why_wrong.C: Equal weights do not zero the risk when σs differ.

INT-080.zh: 完全負相關才能組出零風險。權數與σ 成反比：波動大的少放。
INT-080.core_idea: When ρ=-1, a zero-risk mix exists; the weights are inverse to the σs
INT-080.study_section: Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法
INT-080.exam_trap: Equal-weighting a -1 pair that has unequal volatilities
INT-080.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-080.subtopic: INT.5 Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法

INT-081.reasoning: Reasoning: t = 0.40 × √ 20 / √ (1-0.16) = 1.95, df=20. Pearson tests linear association. Independence would be a different (e.g. chi-square) statement. PM still uses ρ in σp even if the t is only ‘borderline.’ Given: n=22; r=0.40. Asked: t and the correct reading. Formula: 0.40 √ 20/ √ 1 −0.16 Variables: df=20. Why this formula: Quant test sitting under a PM correlation input. Economic size of ρ still matters for σp even when t is large. Reasonableness check: Critical t around 2.1 for two-sided 5% with df=20; 1.95 is borderline. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-081.steps: ①t=1.95. ②H0 is ρ=0 linear. ③Not independence.

why_wrong.A: Wrong statistic family.
why_wrong.C: df is n-2, not n or n-1, and failure to reject is not a proof of independence.

INT-081.zh: Pearson 檢定的是有沒有線性關係，df=n-2。拒絕H0 不是證明任何依賴，沒拒絕 也不是證明獨立。
INT-081.core_idea: Pearson’s t uses df=n-2 and H0: ρ=0 (no linear association), not independence
INT-081.study_section: Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法
INT-081.exam_trap: Reading a Pearson test as a test of independence
INT-081.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-081.subtopic: INT.5 Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法

INT-082.reasoning: Reasoning: ρ = √ 0.64 = 0.80. Residual variance share is 0.36, which is not a negative correlation. Beta is the slope, not R². A high R² can still be economically small. Given: R²=0.64; positive slope. Asked: Correlation and the meaning of R². Formula: √ 0.64 Variables: Single-index residual share = 1-R². Why this formula: Quant SLR identity used on a PM index model. β still comes from Cov/Var, not from R². Reasonableness check: If the slope were negative, ρ = -0.80. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-082.steps: √ 0.64=0.80. ②Sign positive. ③R² is a variance share.

why_wrong.A: R² is not ρ and not a causal probability.
why_wrong.B: Positive slope → positive root.

INT-082.zh: R²=0.64 且斜率為正，相關是0.80。R² 不是機率、不是因果、也不是β。
INT-082.core_idea: In SLR, |ρ|= √ R² with the slope’s sign; R² is not a probability and not beta
INT-082.study_section: Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法
INT-082.exam_trap: Reading R² as correlation or as a causal probability
INT-082.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-082.subtopic: INT.5 Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法

INT-083.reasoning: Reasoning: 1.00% ± 1.96×0.40% = [0.22%, 1.78%]. That interval covers the mean. A 5% VaR is a tail threshold for a single-period loss, a different Quant object used in PM risk reports. Given: Mean 1.00%; SE 0.40%; z=1.96. Asked: 95% CI and what it is not. Formula: 0.01 ± 1.96 × 0.004 Variables: Known-variance z from the sources: 1.96 for 95%. Why this formula: Quant CI versus PM VaR. Tighter SE (more months) shrinks the interval for the mean, not the monthly storm. Reasonableness check: 90% would use 1.65; 99% would use 2.58. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: 1.65 is the 90% z.
why_wrong.C: σ/√n is already in the SE; do not put raw σ back.

INT-083.zh: 信賴區間包的是「平均報酬」。VaR 包的是單期損失門檻。不要把1.96×SE 當成 下個月的VaR。
INT-083.core_idea: A 95% z interval for the mean is ¯x ± 1.96 SE; it is not a 95% VaR band for next month
INT-083.study_section: Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法
INT-083.exam_trap: Reading a CI for the mean as a VaR band
INT-083.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-083.subtopic: INT.5 Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法

INT-084.reasoning: Reasoning: SF = (0.10-0.02)/0.16 = 0.500. Sharpe = (0.10-0.03)/0.16 = 0.438. Sources: if RL>Rf, Sharpe exceeds safety-first. Here RL<Rf, so SF exceeds Sharpe. Higher SF is better. Assumes normality. Given: E(R) 10%; σ 16%; RL 2%; Rf 3%. Asked: Safety-first vs Sharpe. Formula: (0.10 −0.02)/0.16 Variables: Normality assumed for SF. Why this formula: Quant standardized distance is PM’s downside screen. A lower floor is easier to clear, so SF looks better than Sharpe. Reasonableness check: If RL were 4%, SF would be 0.375 < Sharpe 0.438. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Numerator is E(R)-RL, not the reverse.
why_wrong.C: Sharpe uses Rf, not RL. They match only if RL=Rf.

INT-084.zh: 安全第一用門檻RL，Sharpe 用Rf。RL 低於Rf 時，SF 比較大。分子不要寫反。
INT-084.core_idea: Safety-first = (E(R)-RL)/σ; if RL>Rf, Sharpe exceeds safety-first
INT-084.study_section: Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法
INT-084.exam_trap: Replacing Rf with RL inside Sharpe and calling it the same ratio
INT-084.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-084.subtopic: INT.5 Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法

INT-085.reasoning: Reasoning: Quant: a contribution just before a strong period lifts MWR above TWR. PM/GIPS: composites use TWR so manager skill is not credited for client inflows. The client still feels MWR.

why_wrong.A: IRR/MWR is the client’s experienced return, not the manager measure after external flows.
why_wrong.B: TWR removes the client’s timing; it is not the client’s personal wealth rate when flows are large.

INT-085.zh: 大額資金剛好在好季度前進來，MWR>TWR。評經理人看TWR；客戶自己的錢 看MWR。
INT-085.core_idea: A contribution just before a strong period raises MWR above TWR; TWR still grades the manager
INT-085.study_section: Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法
INT-085.exam_trap: Using MWR to grade the manager after a well-timed client inflow
INT-085.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-085.subtopic: INT.5 Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法

INT-086.reasoning: Reasoning: Cov = ρσ1σ2 = -0.20×0.20×0.15 = -0.006. In σp² the term 2w1w2Cov is negative, so σp < √ (w1²σ1²+w2²σ2²). That is PM diversification from a Quant covariance. Given: σ 20% and 15%; ρ=-0.20; 50/50. Asked: Covariance and the sign effect. Formula: −0.20 × 0.20 × 0.15 Variables: 2w1w2Cov = 2×0.25×(-0.006)=-0.003. Why this formula: Quant covariance term is PM’s risk reduction. ρ=0 already diversifies versus ρ=1; ρ<0 diversifies more. Reasonableness check: ρ=1 covariance would be +0.030. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-086.steps: ①Cov=-0.006. ②Negative term cuts variance. ③σp below the ρ=0 case.

why_wrong.A: Negative ρ produces negative covariance by definition.
why_wrong.B: ρ is not added to get covariance, and the product σ1σ2 is 0.03, times -0.20 is -0.006.

INT-086.zh: 共變異=ρσ1σ2，單位是報酬的平方。負相關讓組合σ 低於ρ=0 的情形。
INT-086.core_idea: Covariance is the term that makes diversification work; it is return-units squared
INT-086.study_section: Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法
INT-086.exam_trap: Treating correlation as if it were already covariance
INT-086.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-086.subtopic: INT.5 Portfolio + Quant ｜投資組合與數量方法

INT-087.reasoning: Reasoning: Material impact on the risk profile →III(C): discuss, then IPS update, client-directed account, or exit. Minimal impact: discuss the misfit and follow firm policy (example: do not trade). This is an IPS problem, not a Loyalty-to-fill problem.

why_wrong.A: III(A) does not turn the member into an order clerk. Loyalty cannot override Suitability.
why_wrong.C: The sources give a conversation plus one of three paths, not a blanket ban on talking.

INT-087.zh: 客戶自己下單也不准用Loyalty 壓過Suitability。影響大：改IPS、獨立帳戶、或 結束關係。
INT-087.core_idea: Unsolicited unsuitable trade: Suitability, not Loyalty, sets the fork — material vs minimal
INT-087.study_section: Ethics + Portfolio ｜倫理與投資組合管理
INT-087.exam_trap: Using Loyalty to override Suitability on an unsolicited trade
INT-087.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-087.subtopic: INT.6 Ethics + Portfolio ｜倫理與投資組合管理

INT-088.reasoning: Reasoning: PM: ability prevails when willingness is high and ability is low. Ethics: Suitability/IPS must be jointly feasible. Educating a high-ability/low-willingness client is the other fork — not this stem.

why_wrong.B: Averaging is not a source rule.
why_wrong.C: Attitude does not override financial capacity. Loyalty is not a duty to implement an infeasible risk level.

INT-088.zh: 意願高、能力低：能力說了算。忠誠不是把客戶想要的高風險硬做進去。
INT-088.core_idea: When willingness is high and ability is low, ability sets IPS risk tolerance
INT-088.study_section: Ethics + Portfolio ｜倫理與投資組合管理
INT-088.exam_trap: Letting willingness override low ability via Loyalty
INT-088.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-088.subtopic: INT.6 Ethics + Portfolio ｜倫理與投資組合管理

INT-089.reasoning: Reasoning: GIPS exists so performance is comparable for prospective clients. III(D) also requires fair, accurate, complete performance. The PM composite construction rules and the Ethics presentation rule land on the same conduct: no star composite built by hiding accounts.

why_wrong.A: Terminated accounts belong in the history; dropping weak accounts is cherrypicking.
why_wrong.C: Verification is recommended and optional; if done it is firm-wide, not a composite certification.

INT-089.zh: GIPS 是公司層級。同策略的真實、收費、有裁量權帳戶都要進composite。 Verification 可選，不能拿來合理化藏帳戶。
INT-089.core_idea: GIPS is a firm claim; every fee-paying discretionary segregated account sits in a composite; verification is optional
INT-089.study_section: Ethics + Portfolio ｜倫理與投資組合管理
INT-089.exam_trap: Claiming GIPS for one composite or treating verification as required
INT-089.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-089.subtopic: INT.6 Ethics + Portfolio ｜倫理與投資組合管理

INT-090.reasoning: Reasoning: Loyalty asks ‘for whom?’ Suitability asks ‘does it fit?’ A fitting holding chosen for the bonus is a III(A) (and often I(B)/disclosure) problem, not an automatic III(C) fail.

why_wrong.A: The stem says the fund fits the IPS risk band; Suitability is not the hole.
why_wrong.C: I(B) is independence/objectivity (gifts, issuer pressure); it is not a blanket bonus ban.

INT-090.zh: 適合性問合不合IPS；忠誠問為誰做事。合IPS 但為了獎金，是忠誠問題。
INT-090.core_idea: III(A) is whose interest; III(C) is whether the holding fits the IPS/mandate
INT-090.study_section: Ethics + Portfolio ｜倫理與投資組合管理
INT-090.exam_trap: Calling every proprietary-fund placement a Suitability violation
INT-090.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-090.subtopic: INT.6 Ethics + Portfolio ｜倫理與投資組合管理

INT-091.reasoning: Reasoning: III(B) is inter-client fairness on recommendations. III(D) is fair, accurate, complete performance — including terminated accounts. PM composites inherit that completeness rule.

why_wrong.A: The sources’ icheck: simultaneous dissemination plus a later sizing call to large accounts can be consistent with III(B). Completeness of performance is III(D).
why_wrong.B: Terminated accounts stay in the history.

INT-091.zh: 先全體通知再打電話討論部位，可以符合公平交易。績效把已結束帳戶拿掉，才 是陳述不完整。
INT-091.core_idea: Fair Dealing is client-versus-client; a staggered performance story can also fail III(D)
INT-091.study_section: Ethics + Portfolio ｜倫理與投資組合管理
INT-091.exam_trap: Treating a later sizing call as automatic Fair Dealing failure
INT-091.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-091.subtopic: INT.6 Ethics + Portfolio ｜倫理與投資組合管理

INT-092.reasoning: Reasoning: Security selection can rest on mosaic. It cannot rest on MNPI. The PM process (idea generation) does not change the Standard.

why_wrong.A: A material selective tip is not cleaned by calling it mosaic.
why_wrong.B: II(A) bans material nonpublic information, not every nonpublic scrap.

INT-092.zh: 公開檔加非重大的非公開顏色＝拼圖，可以交易。未公布EPS 的私下電話＝重大 非公開，再怎麼研究都不能做。
INT-092.core_idea: Mosaic of public filings plus nonmaterial nonpublic color is allowed; a material tip is not
INT-092.study_section: Ethics + Portfolio ｜倫理與投資組合管理
INT-092.exam_trap: Banning every nonpublic input, or laundering MNPI as mosaic

INT-093.reasoning: Reasoning: PM presentations to consultants often over-claim verification. Ethics GIPS section: optional/recommended; if done, firm-wide; not a composite certification.

why_wrong.A: Verification is not a prerequisite to claim GIPS.
why_wrong.B: Verification is not a per-composite badge.

INT-093.zh: 有做verification，範圍是整家公司，不是幫某一檔composite 背書。沒做也能 claim GIPS。
INT-093.core_idea: Verification is optional and, if obtained, firm-wide; it does not certify one composite’s numbers

INT-093.exam_trap: Reading firm-wide verification as a composite certification or as required

INT-094.reasoning: Reasoning: Employer loyalty forbids stealing models and requires not injuring the firm — it does not authorize IPS-blind allocation. Client duties sit first.

why_wrong.A: IV(A) is not a duty to follow an instruction that violates duties to clients.
why_wrong.B: Past performance does not make an unsuitable allocation suitable.

INT-094.zh: 對僱主的忠誠不是聽令把所有新客戶丟進同一檔積極模型。適合性／IPS 優先。
INT-094.core_idea: IV(A) Loyalty to employer does not outrank duties to the client’s IPS

INT-094.exam_trap: Using employer Loyalty to override the IPS
