INT-095.reasoning: Reasoning: Encourage GIPS; weight composites properly; include terminated accounts; if attribution changes, show old and new. That is Ethics language sitting on a PM performance report.

why_wrong.A: This is performance presentation, not inter-client recommendation timing.
why_wrong.B: III(D) expressly includes attribution-method changes: show both so comparison is possible.

INT-095.zh: 弱帳戶拿掉、歸因方法改了只秀新的：完整性和可比性都失敗。
INT-095.core_idea: III(D): do not drop weak accounts; show old and new attribution if the method changes
INT-095.study_section: Ethics + Portfolio ｜倫理與投資組合管理
INT-095.exam_trap: Treating attribution-method changes as outside III(D)
INT-095.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-095.subtopic: INT.6 Ethics + Portfolio ｜倫理與投資組合管理

INT-096.reasoning: Reasoning: PM: TAA vs strategic weights vs security selection. Ethics: the IPS/mandate is the Suitability test. Communication of material changes belongs in the client relationship.

why_wrong.A: Tactical asset allocation is a defined, deliberate short-term deviation from strategic weights — inside the IPS.
why_wrong.C: Loyalty is not a return-max override of the mandate.

INT-096.zh: IPS 允許的戰術偏離可以。超出IPS 的大超配，不能用忠誠／追求報酬來辯。
INT-096.core_idea: Tactical deviations from IPS strategic weights must stay inside the IPS and be communicated
INT-096.study_section: Ethics + Portfolio ｜倫理與投資組合管理
INT-096.exam_trap: Calling every TAA a Suitability breach, or using Loyalty to justify an IPS breach
INT-096.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-096.subtopic: INT.6 Ethics + Portfolio ｜倫理與投資組合管理

INT-097.reasoning: Reasoning: PM trading and Ethics III(A) meet at the use of the client’s brokerage. Benefit must run to the client, with disclosure. Firm overhead is the contrary case.

why_wrong.B: GIPS does not require commission-funded research.
why_wrong.C: The sources’ icheck: client brokerage for research that benefits those clients can be consistent with III(A).

INT-097.zh: 用客戶佣金買研究、且研究用在這些客戶身上，可以符合忠誠。拿去付公司租金 不行。
INT-097.core_idea: Client brokerage used to buy research that benefits those clients can be consistent with III(A)
INT-097.study_section: Ethics + Portfolio ｜倫理與投資組合管理
INT-097.exam_trap: Treating all soft dollars as automatic III(A) violations
INT-097.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-097.subtopic: INT.6 Ethics + Portfolio ｜倫理與投資組合管理

INT-098.reasoning: Reasoning: PM: objectives must be jointly feasible; risk is how return above Rf is earned. Ethics: do not write or accept a mandate that cannot be implemented suitably. Educate and revise.

why_wrong.A: Loyalty is not a duty to promise the impossible.
why_wrong.C: A 60/40 mix does not produce a zero-drawdown two-year 9% real path.

INT-098.zh: 目標要同時可行。又要高實質報酬又要零回撤，是不適合的IPS，不能用忠誠去承 諾。
INT-098.core_idea: Return and risk objectives must be jointly feasible; an infeasible IPS is a Suitability failure waiting to happen
INT-098.study_section: Ethics + Portfolio ｜倫理與投資組合管理
INT-098.exam_trap: Accepting an infeasible IPS as Loyalty to the client’s wishes
INT-098.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-098.subtopic: INT.6 Ethics + Portfolio ｜倫理與投資組合管理

INT-099.reasoning: Reasoning: wd=40/130=30.77%. WACC=0.3077×7%×0.75 + 0.6923×13% = 10.62%. Book D/E may be the stated target metric; it is not the WACC weight. Given: Market D/E 40/90; book 70/30; rd 7%; re 13%; t 25%. Asked: Project WACC. Formula: (40/130) × 0.07 × 0.75 + (90/130) × 0.13 Variables: Interest deducted in full. Why this formula: FSA balance sheet supplies book; Corp WACC needs market. The opportunity cost is a replace-the-capital-today number. Reasonableness check: Preferred, if present, has no (1-t). 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.C: Uses market weights but skips the tax shield: 0.308×7% + 0.692×13% = 11.15%.

INT-099.zh: WACC 權數用市值。帳面槓桿可以是管理目標的表達，但不能拿來加權。
INT-099.core_idea: WACC uses market weights from the balance-sheet claims’ market values, not book values
INT-099.study_section: Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析
INT-099.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-099.subtopic: INT.7 Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析

INT-100.reasoning: Reasoning: Coverage = 60/12 = 5.0. Debt-to-capital = 80/(80+120) = 0.40. Accrued liabilities and AP are not debt in these ratios. Weak coverage is a capital-structure caution even if WACC still uses market weights. Given: EBIT 60; interest 12; IB debt 80; AP 40; equity 120. Asked: Coverage and debt-to-capital. Formula: 60/12, 80/(80 + 120) Variables: Total debt = interest-bearing only. Why this formula: FSA ratio definitions constrain Corp leverage talk. Fixed-charge coverage would add lease expense to both sides. Reasonableness check: CFO/debt is a separate cash coverage. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Uses EBIT / (interest + AP-days) or EBT/interest = 48/12=4, nearby 3 if someone uses (EBIT-interest)/interest.

INT-100.zh: 償債比用EBIT/利息。AP 不算進sources 的debt。覆蓋差是資本結構警訊。
INT-100.core_idea: Interest coverage = EBIT / interest; AP is not ‘debt’ in the sources’ solvency ratios
INT-100.study_section: Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析
INT-100.exam_trap: Putting AP into the debt used for leverage ratios
INT-100.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-100.subtopic: INT.7 Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析

INT-101.reasoning: Reasoning: CCC = 50+40-35 = 55. Stretch AP +10 →CCC 45. Corp liquidity: CCC is how long cash is tied in the cycle. Stretching payables is also an FSA detection pattern if it is used to park CFO. Given: 50, 40, 35 days. Asked: CCC and a 10-day AP stretch. Formula: 50 + 40 −35 Variables: Operating cycle = 90. Why this formula: FSA days are Corp’s cash-cycle lever. A shorter CCC is not free if suppliers cut off credit. Reasonableness check: Quick ratio ignores inventory; CCC does not. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-101.steps: ①CCC=55. ②AP+10 →45. ③Watch the CFO-parking flag.

why_wrong.B: AP is current; stretching it shortens CCC.
why_wrong.C: Operating cycle = 90; adding AP instead of subtracting gives 125.

INT-101.zh: CCC= 存貨天+ 應收天-應付天。拉長應付會縮短CCC，但也可能是粉飾CFO 的手法。
INT-101.core_idea: CCC = inventory days + AR days - AP days; liquidity policy is a Corp decision using FSA days
INT-101.study_section: Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析
INT-101.exam_trap: Adding payable days instead of subtracting them
INT-101.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-101.subtopic: INT.7 Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析

INT-102.reasoning: Reasoning: CF = 40×(1-0.25) + 8 - 5 = 33. Interest stays out (already in WACC). FSA’s indirect-CFO logic (add non-cash, subtract ∆WC) is the same arithmetic Corp uses on incremental CF. Given: EBIT 40; Dep 8; ∆WC +5; t 25%; interest 6. Asked: Incremental operating CF. Formula: 40 × 0.75 + 8 −5 Variables: Indirect CFO identity. Why this formula: FSA NI-to-CFO bridge applied to Corp incremental CF. The tax on operating earnings belongs; the tax shield of interest is in rd(1-t). Reasonableness check: If WC had fallen 5, CF would be 43. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.C: Starts from NI after interest: (40-6)×0.75 + 8 - 5 = 28.5, nearby 27 if depreciation is dropped.

INT-102.zh: 專案現金流：稅後EBIT + 折舊- 營運資金增加。利息不要扣，它在WACC 裡。
INT-102.core_idea: Incremental project CF starts from after-tax operating earnings plus non-cash charges minus WC investment — not NI after interest
INT-102.study_section: Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析
INT-102.exam_trap: Putting after-tax interest into project CF
INT-102.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-102.subtopic: INT.7 Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析

INT-103.reasoning: Reasoning: FSA: capitalize →CFO up, CFI down, same total cash. Corp: the 100 is still the t=0 outlay in the NPV column. Do not screen projects by first-year CFO.

why_wrong.A: Corp NPV is not an FSA statement classification.
why_wrong.C: Capitalization moves the outlay to CFI; it does not make the cash free.

INT-103.zh: 資本化只是把現金從CFO 改貼到CFI，NPV 仍要扣這100。不要用當年CFO 決 定專案。
INT-103.core_idea: Capitalized project cash is CFI; the NPV spreadsheet still uses total incremental cash, not CFO alone
INT-103.study_section: Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析
INT-103.exam_trap: Using CFO classification as the NPV cash definition
INT-103.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-103.subtopic: INT.7 Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析

INT-104.reasoning: Reasoning: rd is the current market yield 6.2%, not the coupon and not the book carrying amount. After-tax = 6.2% × 0.70 = 4.34%. FSA carrying amount drives interest expense; Corp WACC uses today’s yield. Given: Coupon 5; price 90; YTM 6.2%; CA 95; t 30%. Asked: After-tax rd. Formula: 0.062 × (1 −0.30) Variables: Interest deducted in full. Why this formula: FSA effective-interest vs Corp current yield. A discount bond’s interest expense exceeds the coupon; that is not the WACC input. Reasonableness check: If price were par and YTM equaled the coupon, all three rates would match. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Uses the coupon rate after tax: 5% × 0.70 = 3.50%.
why_wrong.C: Uses pretax YTM as if interest were not deductible.

INT-104.zh: 債務成本是今天的市場殖利率，再乘(1-t)。不要用票面利率或帳面。
INT-104.core_idea: After-tax rd is the market yield times (1-t), not the coupon over book
INT-104.study_section: Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析
INT-104.exam_trap: Using the coupon or book yield as rd in WACC
INT-104.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-104.subtopic: INT.7 Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析

INT-105.reasoning: Reasoning: ROIC = 56/400 = 14% > 10%. Sources: if ROIC > required return the firm looks as if it is creating value. It is not cash-based and is backward-looking. Mutually exclusive projects still rank by NPV. Given: NOPAT 56; IC 400; WACC 10%. Asked: ROIC vs WACC meaning. Formula: 56/400 Variables: NOPAT is after-tax operating. Why this formula: FSA operating profit vs Corp hurdle. A high ROIC firm can still pick the wrong mutually exclusive project. Reasonableness check: If NOPAT were 40, ROIC=10% = WACC, value-neutral on this screen. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-105.steps: ①ROIC=14%. ②> WACC. ③Screen, not a project rule.

why_wrong.A: ROIC is not ROE; the denominator is invested capital, not equity.
why_wrong.C: WACC is already after-tax; 14% is not ‘pre-tax WACC.’

INT-105.zh: ROIC=NOPAT/投入資本，跟WACC 比是回顧篩選，不是每個案子都做。
INT-105.core_idea: ROIC vs WACC is a backward value screen; it uses NOPAT and invested capital from the statements
INT-105.study_section: Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析
INT-105.exam_trap: Treating ROIC as ROE or as a project accept rule
INT-105.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-105.subtopic: INT.7 Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析

INT-106.reasoning: Reasoning: MM I (no tax): VL=VU. MM II: re = r0 + (r0-rd)(D/E). The rise in re cancels the mix shift. FSA book leverage can be how management states a target — it still does not license book weights or a ‘cheap debt’ value story.

why_wrong.A: ‘Debt is cheaper’ is not a value argument in no-tax MM.
why_wrong.C: WACC weights are market, not book.

INT-106.zh: 無稅MM：槓桿推高re，剛好把便宜債務對沖掉，WACC 不變。帳面D/E 不是 降WACC 的理由。
INT-106.core_idea: MM without tax: leverage raises re so WACC is unchanged; FSA D/E is not a value argument
INT-106.study_section: Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析
INT-106.exam_trap: Using book D/E and ‘debt is cheaper’ to claim a lower WACC under no-tax MM
INT-106.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-106.subtopic: INT.7 Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析

INT-107.reasoning: Reasoning: FCFF = 80 + 12×0.75 - 25 = 64. Firm = 64/0.09 = 711. Equity = 711 - 150 = 561. Add-back only because interest paid reduced CFO. Given: CFO 80; interest paid 12 in CFO; FCInv 25; t 25%; WACC 9%; net debt 150. Asked: Equity from FCFF. Formula: (80 + 12 × 0.75 −25)/0.09 −150 Variables: g=0 perpetuity. Why this formula: FSA FCFF bridge plus Corp WACC discount. This is a firm-value path, not an FCFE path. Reasonableness check: If interest paid were CFF under IFRS, the add-back would not be used. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports firm value 711 and calls it equity.
why_wrong.B: Forgets the Interest(1-t) add-back: (80-25)/0.09 - 150 = 461.

INT-107.zh: 利息在CFO 時，FCFF 要加回稅後利息再減資本支出。WACC 折現得到企業價 值，再減淨債。
INT-107.core_idea: FCFF from CFO (interest in CFO) discounted at WACC is firm value; subtract net debt for equity
INT-107.study_section: Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析
INT-107.exam_trap: Forgetting Interest(1-t) or calling firm value equity
INT-107.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-107.subtopic: INT.7 Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析

INT-108.reasoning: Reasoning: LIFO conformity: tax LIFO ⇒book LIFO. Higher COGS →lower tax →higher CFO. Corp liquidity improves even as FSA current ratio and inventory fall. That cash effect is not a reason to change WACC weights.

why_wrong.B: The method changes COGS, tax, and inventory.
why_wrong.C: IFRS does not permit LIFO. FIFO has lower COGS and higher tax when prices rise.

INT-108.zh: 物價上漲用LIFO：稅少繳、CFO 較高，但庫存與流動比率較低。IFRS 不准 LIFO。
INT-108.core_idea: In rising prices LIFO cuts taxable income if tax follows the books, raising after-tax cash — a liquidity, not a WACC-weight, effect
INT-108.study_section: Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析
INT-108.formula: LIFO tax cash benefit when prices rise
INT-108.exam_trap: Claiming IFRS allows LIFO or that cost flow never affects tax
INT-108.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-108.subtopic: INT.7 Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析

INT-109.reasoning: Reasoning: FSA: ROU + liability. Corp: WACC is an opportunity cost in the market. Leaseadjusted book leverage can inform a rating; it does not become the project discount-rate weight.

why_wrong.B: WACC weights remain market (target market) weights.
why_wrong.C: Modern lessee accounting puts the claim on the sheet; credit analysis should see it.

INT-109.zh: 租賃負債做槓桿／信用分析要加進去；WACC 權數仍是市值，不是帳面D/E。
INT-109.core_idea: On-balance-sheet lease liabilities are interest-bearing-like claims for leverage analysis; they still do not license book WACC weights
INT-109.study_section: Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析
INT-109.formula:
rW ACC = wmkt
d
rd(1 −t) + wmkt
e
re
INT-109.exam_trap: Turning a lease-adjusted book D/E into the WACC weight
INT-109.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-109.subtopic: INT.7 Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析

INT-110.reasoning: Reasoning: FSA indirect CFO subtracts ∆AR and ∆inventory. Corp incremental CF does the same. A NI beat with a WC spike is exactly the gap those identities flag.

why_wrong.A: Operating WC is operating cash, not CFF.
why_wrong.C: NPV is not NI.

INT-110.zh: NPV 用的就是稅後營運現金減WC。淨利達標但存貨與應收暴增，現金仍可能不 及格。
INT-110.core_idea: A project that beats WACC can still show NI below plan if WC absorbed cash — watch CFO, not just NI
INT-110.study_section: Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析
INT-110.exam_trap: Treating NI as the NPV actual
INT-110.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-110.subtopic: INT.7 Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析

INT-111.reasoning: Reasoning: Corp: internally generated cash has opportunity cost; pecking order. FSA: DSO rise is a premature-revenue detection pattern. An equity issue sold on the back of low-quality earnings is a governance/reporting-quality story, not a cheap-capital story.

why_wrong.B: Internal funds are not cheaper than WACC. Equity is last in the pecking-order path.
why_wrong.C: Pecking order is internal →debt →equity, not the reverse.

INT-111.zh: 內部現金不是免費，權益在啄食順序最後。DSO 上升還讓「現在發股」的故事更 可疑。
INT-111.core_idea: Pecking-order internal →debt →equity plus reporting-quality pressure: equity issue after weak internals is a last resort, not a cheap source
INT-111.study_section: Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析
INT-111.formula: rW ACC is the opportunity cost of internal cash
INT-111.exam_trap: Calling CFO free and equity costless
INT-111.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-111.subtopic: INT.7 Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析

INT-112.reasoning: Reasoning: Debt coverage = CFO/debt = 36/180 = 0.20. Sources also show CFO over capex, debt repayments, dividends. Weak cash coverage can raise rd and distress risk — that may later move WACC — but the ratio itself is not the hurdle. Given: CFO 36; IB debt 180; WACC 9%. Asked: Coverage and what it is not. Formula: 36/180 Variables: Total debt is interest-bearing. Why this formula: FSA cash coverage beside Corp WACC. A firm can have a tidy WACC and still fail cash debt coverage. Reasonableness check: Reinvestment coverage is CFO / cash paid for long-term assets. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-112.steps: ①Coverage=0.20. ②Not a rate. ③May inform rd later.

why_wrong.A: 0.20 is not 9% and is not a discount rate.
why_wrong.B: The reciprocal 180/36=5 is years-of-CFO, not the named coverage ratio.

INT-112.zh: CFO/負債=0.20 是現金償債篩選，不是折現率，也不能取代市值WACC。
INT-112.core_idea: CFO/debt coverage is a cash solvency screen that sits beside WACC, not inside it
INT-112.study_section: Corporate + FSA ｜公司發行人與財務報表分析
INT-112.exam_trap: Using CFO/debt as if it were WACC

INT-113.reasoning: Reasoning: r=3%+1.25×6%=10.5%. V=2.40/(0.105-0.04)=36.92. Forecast above this value is a buy on the SML only if the forecast is a return, not a second price. Given: Rf 3%; ERP 6%; β 1.25; D1 2.40; g 4%. Asked: Gordon value using CAPM r. Formula: 2.40/(0.03 + 1.25 × 0.06 −0.04) Variables: g < r. Why this formula: PM required return is Equity’s discount rate. Higher beta raises r and cuts the multiple. Reasonableness check: If D0=2.40 were used, V would be 4% too low. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Uses D1/g = 60, as if r were zero extra.
why_wrong.C: Uses β=1 by mistake: r=9%, V=2.40/0.05=48.0.

INT-113.zh: 先用CAPM 得出r，再把D1 放進Gordon。β 不要當1。
INT-113.core_idea: CAPM supplies r; Gordon uses D1 and that r
INT-113.study_section: Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理

INT-114.reasoning: Reasoning: Required = 3%+1.10×7%=10.7%. α=14%-10.7%=3.3%. Forecast above the SML: undervalued (buy). Same geometry, ex post vs ex ante. Given: R 14%; Rf 3%; β 1.10; E(Rm) 10%. Asked: Alpha and the SML verdict. Formula: 0.14 −(0.03 + 1.10 × 0.07) Variables: Premium = 7%, not 10%. Why this formula: PM SML is Equity’s mispricing graph. One-year realized alpha is not a DDM price. Reasonableness check: E(Rm) vs E(Rm)-Rf is the usual mix-up. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Alpha is a systematic-risk residual, not a total-risk measure, and positive alpha is not ‘overvalued.’
why_wrong.C: Beating Rm is not the SML test; the test is beating CAPM r given beta.

INT-114.zh: 詹森α= 實際-CAPM。正α 與「預測在SML 上方」同一方向：相對系統風險賺 多了。
INT-114.core_idea: Jensen’s alpha > 0 is outperformance vs the SML; it is the same direction as ‘forecast above the SML →buy’
INT-114.study_section: Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理
INT-114.exam_trap: Reading positive alpha as overvaluation or as beating the market raw

INT-115.reasoning: Reasoning: β=0.024/0.04=0.60. r=2%+0.60×5%=5.0%. V=1.50/(0.05-0.03)=75.0. Given: Cov 0.024; σm 20%; Rf 2%; ERP 5%; D1 1.50; g 3%. Asked: Gordon value. Formula: 1.50/(0.02 + (0.024/0.202) × 0.05 −0.03) Variables: β=0.60; r=5%. Why this formula: PM beta identity plus Equity Gordon. A defensive beta compresses r and supports a richer multiple. Reasonableness check: g < r still holds. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.C: Uses β=Cov/σm=0.12, then D1/r = 1.50/0.026=57.7 and drops g because r-g would be negative.

INT-115.zh: 先把共變異變成β，再CAPM，再Gordon。β 的分母是市場方差，不是σm。
INT-115.core_idea: β = Cov/σm², then CAPM r, then Gordon — three steps, one chain
INT-115.study_section: Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理
INT-115.exam_trap: Dividing covariance by σm instead of variance

INT-116.reasoning: Reasoning: Below the SML →overvalued →sell. Equity: P0 > V0 is the same claim. Do not mix E(Rm) with the premium when you recompute r.

why_wrong.B: Positive expected return is not the test; the test is expected vs required.
why_wrong.C: Above Rf is not the SML.

INT-116.zh: 預測報酬低於CAPM：高估、賣。這和市價高於內在價值是同一句話。
INT-116.core_idea: Forecast expected return above the SML means undervalued (buy); below means overvalued (sell)

INT-116.exam_trap: Treating any positive expected return as a buy

INT-117.reasoning: Reasoning: Equity selection inside a concentrated book still leaves σe. PM ratio table: total-risk tools vs beta tools. Do not rank A and B on Treynor and call A the winner.

why_wrong.A: Jensen is a beta tool for diversified portfolios.
why_wrong.C: Every security has a beta; that does not make Treynor appropriate for an undiversified book.

INT-117.zh: 集中持股看Sharpe；已分散的主動基金才看Treynor/Jensen。
INT-117.core_idea: A diversified stock picker can use Treynor/Jensen; a concentrated book should not
INT-117.study_section: Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理
INT-117.exam_trap: Using Treynor to rank a concentrated stock picker against a diversified fund

INT-118.reasoning: Reasoning: PM: CML uses total risk and M; SML uses beta and prices every security. Equity: a stock can be fairly priced (on the SML) and still have σ > βσm.

why_wrong.A: Individual securities sit below the CML; that is not a sell signal.
why_wrong.C: Only M is on the CML as the tangency risky fund; a fairly priced stock is on the SML, not on the CML.

INT-118.zh: 個股本來就在CML 下方（還有非系統風險）。看定價要看SML。兩條線都在，不 代表它是市場組合。
INT-118.core_idea: CML is E(R) vs σ for combinations of Rf and M; SML is E(R) vs β for any security

INT-119.reasoning: Reasoning: Implied r = D1/P0 + g = 3% + 5% = 8% < CAPM 9% →expected return below required →overvalued, same as P0 > D1/(r-g) = 1.50/0.04 = 37.5 < 50. Given: P 50; D1 1.50; g 5%; CAPM 9%. Asked: Implied vs required. Formula: 1.50/50 + 0.05 Variables: V0=37.5 at 9%. Why this formula: Equity implied return vs PM required return. The two tests agree. Reasonableness check: If price were 37.5, implied r would equal 9%. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Current yield 3% is not the implied total return.
why_wrong.C: Do not add CAPM r onto yield.

INT-119.zh: D1/P+g 是Gordon 隱含報酬，拿去跟CAPM 比。低於要求報酬就是貴。
INT-119.core_idea: Dividend yield + g is the Gordon implied return; compare it with CAPM r
INT-119.study_section: Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理
INT-119.exam_trap: Using current yield without g, or adding CAPM r to yield

INT-120.reasoning: Reasoning: r_cyc=3%+1.4×5%=10%; P/E=0.50/(0.10-0.04)=8.33. r_def=6.5%; P/E=0.50/(0.065-0.04)=20.0. PM beta is why Equity’s multiple differs. Given: β 1.4 vs 0.7; Rf 3%; ERP 5%; g 4%; payout 50%. Asked: Which justified P/E is lower. Formula: 0.50/(0.03 + 1.4 × 0.05 −0.04) Variables: g < r for both. Why this formula: PM beta into Equity multiple. A high trailing P/E on a cyclical can still be a collapsed E1. Reasonableness check: If g were also higher for the cyclical, the gap could shrink — the stem holds g fixed. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Justified P/E = payout/(r-g) and r uses beta.
why_wrong.B: A boom might lift the cyclical’s E1, which is a different object than the justified multiple.

INT-120.zh: 高β 循環股r 較高，r-g 較大，合理前瞻P/E 較低。不要用景氣熱來改公式。
INT-120.core_idea: A high-beta cyclical needs a higher CAPM r and usually a lower justified multiple
INT-120.study_section: Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理
INT-120.exam_trap: Giving cyclicals a richer justified P/E because the cycle is strong
INT-120.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-120.subtopic: INT.8 Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理

INT-121.reasoning: Reasoning: Jensen is a return residual. Equity value still needs D1, g, FCFE, or a multiple. Do not manufacture a price from alpha arithmetic that the sources do not give.

why_wrong.B: Alpha is not a P/B gap.
why_wrong.C: There is no source identity that rescales price by r/R.

INT-121.zh: 正α 只說相對同樣β 多賺了。要變成股價，還是要DDM ／FCFE，不能用 40×11/14 硬轉。
INT-121.core_idea: Alpha can be inverted to an implied mispricing versus CAPM, but it is not a Gordon V0
INT-121.study_section: Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理
INT-121.exam_trap: Rescaling price by required/actual return and calling it V0
INT-121.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-121.subtopic: INT.8 Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理

INT-122.reasoning: Reasoning: PM trap: β=0 ￿risk-free. Equity: if you still trust CAPM, r=Rf and Gordon can be huge — which is itself a warning that the beta or the growth is wrong. Given: β=0; σ=35%; D1 2.00; g 3%; Rf 4%. Asked: CAPM–Gordon and the β=0 trap. Formula: 2.00/(0.04 −0.03) Variables: σe ≈35%. Why this formula: PM β=0 trap plus Equity Gordon. A 35% σ zero-beta name is a residual-risk pile, not a T-bill. Reasonableness check: A multifactor model would put other premia into r. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-122.final_answer: V=200 if CAPM is trusted; stock is not risk-free

why_wrong.A: Risk-free ⇒β=0, not the converse. g is still used if it is persistent.
why_wrong.C: CAPM still gives r=Rf when β=0; that does not delete the model.

INT-122.zh: β=0 只代表沒有測到市場共變，不代表無風險。若仍用CAPM，r=Rf，Gordon 會很大，這本身就是警訊。
INT-122.core_idea: β=0 is not risk-free; a zero-beta stock still needs a DDM if it has cash flows, and it can have large σ
INT-122.study_section: Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理
INT-122.exam_trap: Reading β=0 as risk-free and banning growth
INT-122.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-122.subtopic: INT.8 Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理

INT-123.reasoning: Reasoning: Two-fund separation: one optimal risky portfolio plus Rf. That portfolio here is the fund, not the single stock. Equity expected return on one name is an SML question, not a CAL substitution. Given: Fund 9%/12%; stock 11%/40%; Rf 3%. Asked: Which CAL. Formula: (0.09 −0.03)/0.12 Variables: Stock Sharpe=0.20; fund Sharpe=0.50. Why this formula: PM CAL vs Equity single-name forecast. Pick the stock inside the fund (SML), do not make it the whole risky share. Reasonableness check: If the investor’s only risky holding were the stock, the stock CAL would be the relevant (inferior) line. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-123.steps: ①Fund Sharpe 0.50. ②Stock Sharpe 0.20. ③Use the fund CAL.

why_wrong.B: CML requires the market portfolio, not ‘a’ diversified fund.
why_wrong.C: Higher E(R) with much higher σ loses on Sharpe (0.20 < 0.50).

INT-123.zh: 跟現金做配置，要用整個風險組合的CAL。一檔股票的高期望報酬不能取代兩基 金分離。
INT-123.core_idea: A personal CAL uses the investor’s risky portfolio σ; a single stock’s σ is the wrong CAL slope unless the book is that stock
INT-123.study_section: Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理
INT-123.exam_trap: Replacing the CAL risky fund with a single high-E(R) stock
INT-123.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-123.subtopic: INT.8 Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理

INT-124.reasoning: Reasoning: r=4%+1.2×5%=10%. P/E=0.40/(0.10-0.05)=8.0. Market P/E below 8 is cheap versus this fundamental, not automatically cheap versus peers. Given: Payout 40%; g 5%; Rf 4%; β 1.2; ERP 5%. Asked: Justified forward P/E. Formula: 0.40/(0.04 + 1.2 × 0.05 −0.05) Variables: r=10%. Why this formula: PM r in Equity’s justified multiple. A peer P/E of 7 can still be rich versus this 8 if growth is lower. Reasonableness check: g ≥r would make the multiple meaningless. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-124.zh: 合理前瞻P/E= 配息率/(r-g)，r 來自CAPM。漏掉g 或把β 當1 都會錯。
INT-124.core_idea: Justified forward P/E uses CAPM r in the denominator
INT-124.study_section: Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理
INT-124.exam_trap: Dropping g or beta from the justified P/E
INT-124.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-124.subtopic: INT.8 Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理

INT-125.reasoning: Reasoning: D1=2.40, D2=2.88, D3=3.024, V2=43.20. V0=2.40/1.12+(2.88+43.20)/1.12²=38.88. CAPM only supplies r; it does not let you skip the high-growth years. Given: D0 2; gS 20% ×2; gL 5%; r 12%. Asked: Two-stage value. Formula: 2.40/1.12 + (2.88 + 3.024/0.07)/1.122 Variables: V2 uses D3. Why this formula: PM r plus Equity multi-stage. The CAPM r is the same in every year of the tree. Reasonableness check: CF0=0, C01=2.40, C02=2.88+V2. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：CF / NPV 已知：CF0=0; C01=2.40; C02=46.08; I=12 求：NPV=V0 按鍵： ①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②0 ENTER ③↓2.40 ENTER ④↓↓46.08 ENTER ⑤NPV 12 ENTER ⑥↓CPT 結果：38.88 中文理解：終值加進第二期。

why_wrong.A: Undiscounted V2=3.024/0.07=43.2.
why_wrong.C: Gordon from D1 at gL: 2.40/0.07=34.3.

INT-125.zh: 兩段DDM 的r 可以來自CAPM，但高成長年仍要逐年折。終值與D2 同一期。
INT-125.core_idea: Two-stage DDM discounted at CAPM r; Vn sits with Dn
INT-125.study_section: Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理
INT-125.exam_trap: Skipping supernormal years after computing CAPM r

INT-126.reasoning: Reasoning: rX=Rf+0.6 ERP < rY. Same numerator, smaller denominator gap for X? rX-g < rY-g →VX > VY. The 45% σ is mostly residual and is not in Gordon’s r.

why_wrong.A: Same D1 and g but different r produce different V0.
why_wrong.C: Lower σ does not lower CAPM r.

INT-126.zh: 定價看β 不看總σ。低β 高波動的股票，Gordon 反而可能比較貴。
INT-126.core_idea: CAPM/DDM use systematic risk; a high-σ low-β stock is not ‘cheap’ just because σ looks scary

INT-126.exam_trap: Putting total σ into the Gordon discount rate

INT-127.reasoning: Reasoning: PM: security selection is a deviation from index weights. Active return is vs that index. Jensen is vs CAPM. Equity: beating a cheap sector can still leave you below the SML.

why_wrong.B: The sector index is not M just because someone beat it.
why_wrong.C: They are different residuals: vs index weights vs vs CAPM r.

INT-127.zh: 贏過產業指數是主動報酬；詹森α 是贏過CAPM。兩個可以一正一負。
INT-127.core_idea: Active return vs a benchmark is not Jensen’s alpha unless the benchmark is the SML-required return
INT-127.study_section: Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理
INT-127.exam_trap: Equating active return with Jensen’s alpha
INT-127.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。

INT-128.reasoning: Reasoning: PM definitions. Equity industry bets are selection inside the equity class. Ethics/IPS: both must remain inside the document’s bands.

why_wrong.A: Picking energy inside equities is selection, not TAA.
why_wrong.B: TAA is a deliberate short-term deviation from IPS strategic weights — the bond/equity shift.

INT-128.zh: 產業超配是證券選擇；股債偏離戰略權數是戰術配置。兩者都要待在IPS 帶子裡。
INT-128.core_idea: Index weights vs security selection: TAA is across classes; selection is inside a class
INT-128.study_section: Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理
INT-128.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。

INT-129.reasoning: Reasoning: re=2%+1.1×6%=8.6%. V=30/(0.086-0.03)=535.7. WACC is for FCFF/firm value. Given: FCFE1 30; g 3%; β 1.1; Rf 2%; ERP 6%; WACC 7%. Asked: Equity value. Formula: 30/(0.02 + 1.1 × 0.06 −0.03) Variables: re=8.6%. Why this formula: PM CAPM is Equity’s FCFE rate. A 7% WACC would overstate equity by treating a levered claim as a firm claim. Reasonableness check: If net debt were given, FCFF at 7% minus debt is a second path. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-129.zh: FCFE 用股權成本折。WACC 是給FCFF 的。分子是明年FCFE。
INT-129.core_idea: FCFE is discounted at the CAPM cost of equity, not at WACC
INT-129.study_section: Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理
INT-129.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。

INT-130.reasoning: Reasoning: P>V and E(R)<r are one fact. PM says sell below the SML. Equity says sell above value. Market efficiency does not forbid the comparison; it says prices reflect information quickly, which is why a gap should be examined, not ignored.

why_wrong.A: Efficiency is a working assumption, not a ban on comparing P with V.
why_wrong.C: Higher price lowers D1/P+g, it does not raise expected return.

INT-130.zh: 市價80 ＞價值70，隱含報酬低於CAPM：SML 與DDM 都說賣。價格愈高期望 報酬愈低，不是愈高。
INT-130.core_idea: If expected return < CAPM r, the stock is overvalued — the SML sell is the DDM P>V sell
INT-130.study_section: Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理
INT-130.exam_trap: Reading a higher price as a higher expected return
INT-130.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-130.subtopic: INT.8 Equity + Portfolio ｜權益與投資組合管理

INT-131.reasoning: Reasoning: Coverage = 48/16 = 3.0. FSA solvency ratio feeds FI credit. Lower coverage →higher PD concern →wider G-spread/I-spread, not a mechanical YTM identity. Given: EBIT 48; interest 16; prior 6×. Asked: Coverage and the credit-spread direction. Formula: 48/16 Variables: Debt is interest-bearing only. Why this formula: FSA coverage is a FI credit input. Fixed-charge coverage would also add leases. Reasonableness check: CFO/debt is the cash companion. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-131.steps: ①Coverage=3.0. ②Weaker protection. ③Spreads can widen.

why_wrong.A: Weaker coverage widens spreads (higher YTM), it does not tighten them.
why_wrong.C: Coverage is EBIT/interest = 3, not the inverse.

INT-131.zh: 利息覆蓋=EBIT/利息。從6 倍掉到3 倍，信用利差可能走寬，不是殖利率下降。
INT-131.core_idea: Interest coverage = EBIT/interest is a credit-analysis input, not a YTM
INT-131.study_section: FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益
INT-131.exam_trap: Inverting coverage or assuming tighter yields after weaker coverage
INT-131.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。

INT-132.reasoning: Reasoning: FSA D/E uses interest-bearing debt. FI credit: leverage, solvency, profitability, liquidity, cyclicality. Materials are cyclical. The pair is the risk, not ROE cosmetics.

why_wrong.B: ROE lifted by leverage is not a credit comfort if earnings swing.
why_wrong.C: Sources list leverage and industry cyclicality among credit tools.

INT-132.zh: 槓桿上升又碰上循環產業，違約與利差都可能上升。ROE 被槓桿抬高不是信用加 分。
INT-132.core_idea: Higher FSA leverage plus a cyclical industry is a FI credit negative
INT-132.study_section: FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益
INT-132.exam_trap: Reading leverage-boosted ROE as a credit positive
INT-132.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-132.subtopic: INT.9 FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益

INT-133.reasoning: Reasoning: FSA recognition improved comparability. FI credit should have been adding leases already; now the face of the statements agrees. Spread may re-price if the market had ignored the footnote.

why_wrong.A: IFRS 16 puts the ROU and liability on the sheet.
why_wrong.C: Coupons do not rewrite themselves when accounting recognition changes.

INT-133.zh: 租賃入表讓槓桿更清楚，票息契約沒改。分析上本來就該把租賃當債。
INT-133.core_idea: Lease liabilities belong in credit leverage; they do not change the bond’s coupon contract
INT-133.study_section: FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益
INT-133.exam_trap: Treating lease capitalization as a coupon event or as still off-sheet
INT-133.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-133.subtopic: INT.9 FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益

INT-134.reasoning: Reasoning: 24/160=0.15. FI still needs coupon and principal from some cash source. Weaker CFO coverage is a credit deterioration even if the indenture coupon is unchanged. Given: CFO 24; IB debt 160. Asked: Ratio and meaning. Formula: 24/160 Variables: Interest-bearing debt only. Why this formula: FSA cash coverage for FI credit. Pair with interest coverage (accrual) and this cash ratio. Reasonableness check: CFO/interest is another cash screen the sources allow via CFO over claims. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-134.steps: ①0.15. ②Same coupon, less cash. ③Credit weaker.

why_wrong.B: The named ratio is CFO/debt, not debt/CFO.
why_wrong.C: Coverage is not a yield.

INT-134.zh: CFO/債=0.15。票息沒變但現金覆蓋變差，信用仍轉弱。不要把倒數或殖利率當 成這個比率。
INT-134.core_idea: CFO/debt is cash coverage of the FI claim
INT-134.study_section: FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益
INT-134.exam_trap: Calling debt/CFO the coverage ratio or equating it to YTM
INT-134.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-134.subtopic: INT.9 FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益

INT-135.reasoning: Reasoning: FSA: discount →expense > coupon →CFO higher than a par bond with a larger cash coupon. FI: the investor’s YTM was 6% at issue. Do not read the 4% coupon as the issuer’s cost of debt today.

why_wrong.A: Effective interest is also an FSA measurement: begin CA × issuance market rate.
why_wrong.C: Amortization is non-cash; it does not leave as CFO.

INT-135.zh: 折價債：利息費用＞現金票息，CFO 反而比平價債高。攤銷不是現金。今天的rd 仍是市場殖利率。
INT-135.core_idea: A discount bond’s interest expense exceeds the coupon; CFO is higher than for an otherwise identical par bond
INT-135.study_section: FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益
INT-135.exam_trap: Treating discount amortization as a cash outflow or coupon as rd
INT-135.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-135.subtopic: INT.9 FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益

INT-136.reasoning: Reasoning: FSA: reversing DTL →future taxable income higher →cash tax later. FI credit should not reclass that DTL into equity. The grower/non-reversing exception is the opposite case.

why_wrong.B: Taxes payable and deferred positions affect cash available for coupons.
why_wrong.C: Non-reversing DTL in a grower can be equity-like; this stem is the reversing case.

INT-136.zh: 會迴轉的DTL 是未來要補的稅，信用上比較像債。成長中永不迴轉的才比較像權 益。
INT-136.core_idea: A DTL that will reverse is a future tax claim; for credit it is closer to debt than to equity
INT-136.study_section: FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益
INT-136.exam_trap: Treating every DTL as equity for credit
INT-136.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-136.subtopic: INT.9 FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益

INT-137.reasoning: Reasoning: FSA classification flexibility changes CFO. FI coverage that uses CFO inherits the label. Reclassify to a common treatment before ranking credits.

why_wrong.B: Interest paid is not CFI in this teaching convention.
why_wrong.C: U.S. GAAP puts interest paid in CFO; it does not hide it.

INT-137.zh: IFRS 把利息放CFF 會讓CFO 比較好看。比CFO/債之前，先把利息調回同一套 分類。
INT-137.core_idea: IFRS interest paid in CFF raises CFO versus U.S. GAAP; coverage using CFO must be adjusted before comparing issuers
INT-137.study_section: FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益
INT-137.exam_trap: Comparing IFRS and U.S. GAAP CFO coverage without reclassifying interest
INT-137.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-137.subtopic: INT.9 FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益

INT-138.reasoning: Reasoning: FSA: loss = carrying - recoverable (max of FV-costs and value in use). Value in use is PV of remaining cash — the same object FI credit cares about. The charge may also hint that prior depreciation was optimistic.

why_wrong.A: Impairment is non-cash.
why_wrong.B: Future ROA optics are not a credit comfort if the business cash got worse.

INT-138.zh: 減損不是本期現金，但可回收金額下跌代表預期現金變差，對信用是負面。未來 ROA 變好看不是安慰。
INT-138.core_idea: An impairment can reveal weaker expected cash — a credit negative — even though the charge is non-cash
INT-138.study_section: FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益
INT-138.exam_trap: Treating impairment as this quarter’s cash or as a credit positive via future ROA
INT-138.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-138.subtopic: INT.9 FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益

INT-139.reasoning: Reasoning: Current=90/60=1.50. Quick=50/60=0.83. FI short-term claims of 25 sit inside the 60. A current ratio above 1 with a quick ratio below 1 means inventory is the bridge — a problem if that inventory is slow LIFO or written down. Given: CA 90; inv 40; CL 60; ST debt 25. Asked: Current, quick, and the credit read. Formula: 90/60, (90 −40)/60 Variables: WC>0 because current>1. Why this formula: FSA liquidity ratios for FI near-term claims. A CP program that cannot roll is the FI event this ratio is trying to see. Reasonableness check: Cash ratio would be even tighter. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-139.steps: ①Current=1.50. ②Quick=0.83. ③Inventory is the gap.

why_wrong.B: Liquidity ratios use all current liabilities, not only bank debt.
why_wrong.C: Quick drops inventory: (90-40)/60=0.83, not 1.50.

INT-139.zh: 流動1.50、速動0.83：近端債務要靠庫存才能過關。分母是全部流動負債，不是 只有短債。
INT-139.core_idea: Current ratio vs short-term debt: liquidity for near-term FI claims
INT-139.study_section: FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益
INT-139.exam_trap: Putting only short-term debt in the liquidity denominator
INT-139.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-139.subtopic: INT.9 FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益

INT-140.reasoning: Reasoning: Sources: for coverage, add capitalized interest back to interest expense. 50/12=4.17. Capitalized cash is CFI; expensed interest is CFO — another classification split that FI cash coverage must respect. Given: EBIT 50; expensed 8; capitalized 4. Asked: Analytic coverage. Formula: 50/(8 + 4) Variables: If the asset is for sale, capitalized interest sits in inventory. Why this formula: FSA capitalized interest plus FI coverage. The firm still paid (or owed) 12 of interest-like cost. Reasonableness check: CFO is higher if the 4 went to CFI — adjust cash coverage too. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Capitalized interest is still a financing cost.
why_wrong.B: The footnote add-back raises the denominator.

INT-140.zh: 資本化利息做覆蓋率時要加回分母。50/12≈4.17。不要只拿損益上的8。
INT-140.core_idea: Add capitalized interest back to interest expense for coverage
INT-140.study_section: FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益
INT-140.exam_trap: Leaving capitalized interest out of the coverage denominator
INT-140.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-140.subtopic: INT.9 FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益

INT-141.reasoning: Reasoning: FSA directions in rising prices. FI coupon is contractual. A LIFO reporter can look more levered and less covered than a FIFO peer with the same bonds. Restate with the reserve before ranking credits.

why_wrong.A: LIFO: higher COGS, lower profit and equity, higher leverage ratios.
why_wrong.B: The method changes EBIT and equity.

INT-141.zh: 物價上漲LIFO：權益較小、EBIT 較低，D/E 較高、覆蓋較差。票息沒變，先用 準備還原再比信用。
INT-141.core_idea: LIFO in rising prices: higher leverage ratios (smaller equity) — a credit optic, not a smaller coupon
INT-141.study_section: FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益
INT-141.exam_trap: Preferring LIFO as a credit-positive method
INT-141.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-141.subtopic: INT.9 FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益

INT-142.reasoning: Reasoning: FSA: permanent differences (tax-exempt interest) do not reverse and create no deferred position. FI after-tax coverage should use the tax the firm actually pays, not invent a DTL. The coupon is still pretax contractual.

why_wrong.A: Credit does look at cash tax.
why_wrong.B: Permanent differences create no DTA/DTL; they wedge statutory vs effective.

INT-142.zh: 永久差異只造成法定稅率與有效稅率的缺口，不產生DTL。稅後覆蓋要用真正會 繳的稅。
INT-142.core_idea: Effective vs statutory tax rate: a permanent-difference wedge is not a DTL and not a hidden coupon
INT-142.study_section: FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益
INT-142.exam_trap: Treating an effective-rate gap as a DTL
INT-142.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-142.subtopic: INT.9 FSA + Fixed Income ｜財務報表分析與固定收益

INT-143.reasoning: Reasoning: ModDur=6/1.05=5.71. %∆P ≈-5.71×0.01 = -5.71%. Policy rate →FI yield → duration price. Convexity would add a positive term. Given: MacDur 6; y 5%; ∆y +100 bp. Asked: % price change. Formula: −6/1.05 × 0.01 Variables: Option-free. Why this formula: Econ policy into FI duration. A 100 bp shock is large; convexity would cushion some of the loss. Reasonableness check: A cut of 100 bp would give about +5.71% before convexity. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Drops the minus sign: +5.71%.
why_wrong.B: Uses MacDur without dividing by 1+r: -6.0%.

INT-143.zh: 緊縮升息，殖利率上升，價格用修正存續期間估算下跌。不要忘了除以1+r，也 不要丟負號。
INT-143.core_idea: Tight money raises yields; duration translates that into a price drop
INT-143.study_section: Economics + FI ｜經濟學與固定收益
INT-143.exam_trap: Using MacDur as if it were already modified, or dropping the minus
INT-143.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-143.subtopic: INT.10 Economics + FI ｜經濟學與固定收益

INT-144.reasoning: Reasoning: Nominal = 1.02×1.03 - 1 = 5.06%. Same warning as Corp’s nominal WACC on real project CF: raise the coupons or strip the yield. Given: Real 2%; π 3%. Asked: Nominal YTM and the mix error. Formula: Variables: Additive 5% is an approximation. Why this formula: Quant/Econ inflation identity in a FI discount rate. TIPS-style real coupons need a real yield. Reasonableness check: 1.0506/1.03 - 1 = 2.00% real. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-144.steps: ①Nominal=5.06%. ②Do not mix with real coupons.

why_wrong.B: Mixing nominal y with real coupons understates price, it does not overstate it.
why_wrong.C: The source identity is multiplicative. Additive 5% is a close approximation, not the identity.

INT-144.zh: 名目殖利率=1.02×1.03-1=5.06%。用名目殖利率折實質票息，價格會被折太狠。
INT-144.core_idea: Nominal YTM embeds an inflation premium; real vs nominal must not be mixed in a price
INT-144.study_section: Economics + FI ｜經濟學與固定收益
INT-144.exam_trap: Discounting real coupons at a nominal YTM
INT-144.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-144.subtopic: INT.10 Economics + FI ｜經濟學與固定收益

INT-145.reasoning: Reasoning: Econ: government borrowing raises rates and displaces private I. FI: higher benchmark yield, fixed G-spread →higher YTM →lower price. Duration gap then says who is hurt more.

why_wrong.B: Price and yield move inversely even if spread is fixed.
why_wrong.C: Crowding-out is the rate-up case, not a price-up case.

INT-145.zh: 排擠升息：基準利率上升，信用利差即使不變，公司債價格也下跌。
INT-145.core_idea: Crowding-out raises government and private yields and can displace private issuance
INT-145.study_section: Economics + FI ｜經濟學與固定收益
INT-145.exam_trap: Reading crowding-out as bullish for existing bond prices
INT-145.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-145.subtopic: INT.10 Economics + FI ｜經濟學與固定收益

INT-146.reasoning: Reasoning: Sources’ mix: higher interest rates, smaller private sector, output can still rise. FI: positive gap →price risk dominates →the danger is a rise in yields. That is exactly this mix.

why_wrong.A: A nonzero gap does not immunize.
why_wrong.C: The mix raises rates; it does not cut them.

INT-146.zh: 寬財政+ 緊貨幣：利率上升。存續期間缺口為正（horizon 短於MacDur）時，怕 的就是價格風險。
INT-146.core_idea: Easy fiscal + tight money: higher rates, smaller private sector — bond prices down if duration is positive
INT-146.study_section: Economics + FI ｜經濟學與固定收益
INT-146.exam_trap: Flipping the duration-gap danger or the policy-mix rate sign
INT-146.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-146.subtopic: INT.10 Economics + FI ｜經濟學與固定收益

INT-147.reasoning: Reasoning: 1.0609/1.04 - 1 = 2.01%. The Quant/Econ identity is the same one used for nominal rf in CAPM. Given: Nominal 6.09%; π 4%. Asked: Real rf. Formula: 1.0609/1.04 −1 Variables: One-year zero. Why this formula: Econ inflation premium inside a FI YTM. Additive 2.09% is close in quiet inflation; the identity is still multiplicative. Reasonableness check: 1.0201×1.04-1=6.09%. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Adds the two quotes.

INT-147.zh: 實質＝(1+ 名目)/(1+ 通膨)-1，不要直接相減。
INT-147.core_idea: Fisher-style split of a nominal YTM: real + inflation, multiplicatively
INT-147.study_section: Economics + FI ｜經濟學與固定收益
INT-147.exam_trap: Subtracting inflation from a nominal YTM
INT-147.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-147.subtopic: INT.10 Economics + FI ｜經濟學與固定收益

INT-148.reasoning: Reasoning: FI: (1+zL tL)=(1+zS tS)(1+f tgap). Econ policy concentrated in the front end lifts zS and the implied f. Long spots embed later pause years, so they move less.

why_wrong.B: A par rate is not a forward.
why_wrong.C: Forwards are not mechanically inverse to spots.

INT-148.zh: 緊縮預期集中在前端時，短天期即期與遠期升較多。遠期是兩條零息中間的損益 兩平再投資率。
INT-148.core_idea: A rising policy path can lift near-term forwards more than long spots — a curve-shape story
INT-148.study_section: Economics + FI ｜經濟學與固定收益
INT-148.exam_trap: Treating forwards as moving opposite spots or as par rates
INT-148.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-148.subtopic: INT.10 Economics + FI ｜經濟學與固定收益

INT-149.reasoning: Reasoning: Econ cycle: weaker activity, often lower policy/real rates, risk-off. FI: Treasuries bid; HY spread is a credit object (PD up). Duration says how much price each yield move produces.

why_wrong.A: Recessions are not automatically tighter money; they often bring easier policy and lower real rates.
why_wrong.B: Flight-to-quality is not a parallel bp move across credit.

INT-149.zh: 衰退常有資金奔向公債（殖利率降、價格升），高收益利差卻可能走寬，公司債不 一定跟漲。
INT-149.core_idea: Recession flight-to-quality: government yields down, credit spreads often out
INT-149.study_section: Economics + FI ｜經濟學與固定收益
INT-149.exam_trap: Treating flight-to-quality as a parallel yield decline for HY
INT-149.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-149.subtopic: INT.10 Economics + FI ｜經濟學與固定收益

INT-150.reasoning: Reasoning: FI table: horizon > MacDur →negative gap →reinvestment; danger is a fall in yields. Econ easing is that fall. A one-time parallel shift is the experiment the immunization statement uses.

why_wrong.A: Gap = 5-8=-3, not +3. Negative gap →reinvestment risk →danger is falling yields.
why_wrong.B: Easing does not immunize; it is the scenario the negative-gap investor fears.

INT-150.zh: 缺口=5-8=-3，怕再投資（利率下跌）。寬鬆正好是這條路。不要把缺口正負弄 反。
INT-150.core_idea: Duration gap sign tells which policy-rate danger you face
INT-150.study_section: Economics + FI ｜經濟學與固定收益
INT-150.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-150.subtopic: INT.10 Economics + FI ｜經濟學與固定收益

INT-151.reasoning: Reasoning: F=1.10×1.05/1.02=1.1324. Covered interest: convert, earn rf, sell forward →domestic payoff equals 1+rd. The foreign bond’s extra 3% is eaten by the forward discount on the high-rate currency. Given: S 1.10; rd 2%; rf 5%; 1-year foreign zero. Asked: Forward and the hedged return. Formula: 1.1000 × 1.05/1.02 Variables: High-rate currency at a forward discount. Why this formula: Econ CIP plus FI foreign bond. Unhedged, the investor has FX risk on top of the foreign YTM. Reasonableness check: 1.10×1.02/1.05 reverses the carry. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
INT-151.steps: ①F=1.1324. ②Covered return = rd. ③No free 5%.

why_wrong.A: Rates inverted: 1.10×1.02/1.05=1.0686 is the wrong CIP.
why_wrong.B: CIP is not a forecast, and leaving FX open is an unhedged bet.

INT-151.zh: 拋補後賺到的是本國無風險利率，不是外國的5%。高利率貨幣遠期較便宜。
INT-151.core_idea: CIP forward is the no-arbitrage FX rate; a foreign bond’s cash still needs its own YTM
INT-151.study_section: Economics + FI ｜經濟學與固定收益
INT-151.exam_trap: Treating CIP as a forecast or as a free foreign yield
INT-151.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-151.subtopic: INT.10 Economics + FI ｜經濟學與固定收益

INT-152.reasoning: Reasoning: Econ inflation premium sits in nominal YTM. FI: coupon < YTM →discount. Pullto-par then works upward as maturity approaches if YTM stays at 7%.

why_wrong.A: Inflation is bad for an already-fixed nominal coupon.
why_wrong.B: Par requires coupon=YTM. After the shock they are 5% vs 7%.

INT-152.zh: 通膨預期上升墊高名目YTM，舊的5% 票息變折價。通膨不會讓名目票息變得更 香。
INT-152.core_idea: If expected inflation rises, a fixed-coupon bond’s YTM rises and a previously par bond goes to a discount
INT-152.study_section: Economics + FI ｜經濟學與固定收益
INT-152.exam_trap: Thinking inflation turns a fixed coupon into a premium bond

INT-153.reasoning: Reasoning: Mgmt=2.60, incentive=6.00, net=121.40, r=21.4%. Sharpe=(21.4-3)/12=1.53. Fees cut the PM numerator; σ often does not fall as much. Given: 100→130; 2% ending; 20% independent; Rf 3%; σ 12%. Asked: Net return and Sharpe. Formula: (130 −130 × 0.02 −30 × 0.20 −100)/100 Variables: No HWM shortfall. Why this formula: Alts fee math plus PM Sharpe. Gross Sharpe 2.25 vs net 1.53 is the fee drag. Reasonableness check: If incentive were net of management fee, the gain base would be 17.6. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Gross 30% ignores both fees.
why_wrong.C: Subtracts only the management fee: (130×0.98-100)/100=27.4%.

INT-153.zh: 先扣2 再扣獨立計算的20。Sharpe 要用扣費後報酬。只扣管理費或用毛報酬都會 高估。
INT-153.core_idea: Hedge-fund 2-and-20 net of independent incentive, then Sharpe on the net return

INT-154.reasoning: Reasoning: Alts: illiquid marks and appraisal NAVs damp reported returns. PM: Sharpe uses that damped σ. Correlation with public markets is also understated, which overstates diversification in a portfolio-σ calculation.

why_wrong.A: Appraisal smoothing is a source warning, not a proof of low priced risk.
why_wrong.C: Sharpe’s denominator is σ, not β.

INT-154.zh: 估價NAV 會把波動抹平，Sharpe 被墊高，跟上市REIT 的σ 比才看得出。
INT-154.core_idea: NAV smoothing understates σ and overstates Sharpe

INT-154.exam_trap: Taking a smoothed-NAV Sharpe as a SML dominance proof

INT-155.reasoning: Reasoning: Alts: committed vs invested; J-curve. PM: TWR on a tiny invested base plus a fee on 100 is a mechanical hole, not necessarily bad deals. MOIC later compares distributions+RV to invested (paid-in net of fees).

why_wrong.A: Early negatives are expected and still belong in a honest track record.
why_wrong.B: PE fees are typically on committed capital, not invested.

INT-155.zh: PE 管理費按承諾資本抽，早期J 曲線可以是負的。那不是已投資本的真實經營失 敗，也不該從績效史抹掉。
INT-155.core_idea: PE management fees on committed capital create a J-curve; TWR can look worse before capital is at work
INT-155.study_section: Alternatives + Portfolio ｜另類投資與投資組合
INT-155.formula: fee on commitment, not on invested
INT-155.exam_trap: Treating PE fees as AUM-on-invested or dropping J-curve years

INT-156.reasoning: Reasoning: σp= √ [0.25×0.0256+0.25×0.0064+0.5×0.10×0.16×0.08]=9.30%. Alts earn a PM diversification slot from that ρ, not from a claim that private σ is ‘true’ 8% if NAV is smoothed. Given: 50/50; σ 16% and 8%; ρ 0.10. Asked: Portfolio σ. Formula: √ 0.520.162 + 0.520.082 + 2 × 0.5 × 0.5 × 0.10 × 0.16 × 0.08 Variables: ρ=1 would be 12%. Why this formula: Alts correlation plus PM variance. Most of the win versus 12% is the 0.10 correlation. Reasonableness check: If the 8% is smoothed, raise it before you celebrate. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Drops covariance (ρ=0): 8.94%.
why_wrong.C: Average of the two σs (the ρ=1 case): 12%.

INT-156.zh: ρ=0.10 仍比ρ=1 更能降風險。若8% 是被抹平的NAV，真實分散沒有這麼美。
INT-156.core_idea: A low (but not -1) correlation with public equity still cuts portfolio σ
INT-156.study_section: Alternatives + Portfolio ｜另類投資與投資組合
INT-156.exam_trap: Using the ρ=1 average σ for a low-correlation alt mix

INT-157.reasoning: Reasoning: Alts: incentive only on gains above the mark. PM: that rule stops a Sharpe-looking bounce from being fee-drained twice. Year-2 still pays the 2% management fee on 105. Given: HWM 110; year-2 pre-fee 105; 2-and-20 independent. Asked: Year-2 incentive. Variables: Management fee still applies. Why this formula: Alts HWM plus PM net-performance integrity. A catch-up clause is a different GP-favoring term, used once a hurdle is cleared. Reasonableness check: If year-2 ended at 121, incentive would be 20% of (121-110) under a simple HWM, subject to the independent/net convention. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: HWM does not automatically reset on 1 January in the source description.
why_wrong.C: HWM is the highest prior net value; 105 < 110.

INT-157.zh: 高水位110，今年105 還沒站回去，激勵費為0。管理費仍要抽。這是避免復原行 情被抽第二次。
INT-157.core_idea: High-water mark: no incentive on a recovery until NAV exceeds the prior net peak
INT-157.study_section: Alternatives + Portfolio ｜另類投資與投資組合
INT-157.exam_trap: Charging incentive on a rebound that has not cleared the HWM

INT-158.reasoning: Reasoning: Alts liquidity terms vs PM IPS liquidity. Ability (spending, horizon) prevails over a willingness to ‘be in PE.’ Ethics: do not put an unsuitable lockup in a spending account and call it Loyalty.

why_wrong.A: A gate limits redemptions; it does not guarantee them.
why_wrong.B: A lockup is the minimum holding period before withdrawal — the opposite of spending liquidity.

INT-158.zh: 每年要提15%，就不能塞進12 年閉鎖的PE。閘門是限制贖回，不是保證提領。
INT-158.core_idea: Lockups, gates, and notice periods must fit the IPS liquidity constraint
INT-158.study_section: Alternatives + Portfolio ｜另類投資與投資組合
INT-158.exam_trap: Overriding IPS liquidity with an alt lockup because Sharpe looks good

INT-159.reasoning: Reasoning: Underlying: mgmt 2.4, incentive 4.0, LP 113.6 (13.6%). FoF: 1% of 113.6 = 1.136 and 10% of the 13.6 gain = 1.36. Net 111.10 →11.1%. Given: 100→120 underlying; 2-and-20 then 1-and-10. Asked: FoF LP net return. Formula: two layers of mgmt + incentive Variables: Independent incentives, no hurdle. Why this formula: Alts FoF fee stack plus PM net Sharpe. Diversification of manager risk is what the second layer is paying for. Reasonableness check: 120-2.4-4=113.6; 113.6-1.136-1.36=111.10. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Stops after a rough single layer or only management fees.
why_wrong.C: Uses the gross 20%.

INT-159.zh: FoF 的1 和10 疊在底層2 和20 之上。毛20% 會被抽兩層。
INT-159.core_idea: Fund of funds: 1-and-10 on top of underlying 2-and-20 — double fee drag on Sharpe
INT-159.study_section: Alternatives + Portfolio ｜另類投資與投資組合
INT-159.formula: FoF fees sit on already-net underlying proceeds
INT-159.exam_trap: Ignoring the second fee layer in a fund of funds

INT-160.reasoning: Reasoning: Alts smoothing plus PM variance. Public REITs are the higher-σ, higher-ρ check. IPS liquidity also differs: private capital calls vs daily REIT liquidity.

why_wrong.A: The U.S. REIT 90% distribution example is a tax-structure fact, not a correlation identity.
why_wrong.C: ρ=0 is not independence, and 0.15 is not 0.

INT-160.zh: 私募不動產跟股票的低相關，有一部分是估價抹平。回測Sharpe 與分散效果都會 被誇大。
INT-160.core_idea: Private real estate vs public equity: low measured ρ is partly smoothing, not a free diversification lunch
INT-160.study_section: Alternatives + Portfolio ｜另類投資與投資組合
INT-160.formula: σp uses ρ, and smoothed ρ is too low
INT-160.exam_trap: Treating a smoothed 0.15 correlation as independence or as a free lunch
INT-160.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。

INT-161.reasoning: Reasoning: Alts term-structure: backwardation vs contango and the roll. PM: the sleeve still has σ and some correlation with growth/inflation surprises. Do not budget it as cash.

why_wrong.A: β=0 ￿risk-free, and commodities are not β=0 by identity.
why_wrong.B: The sources: contango is not automatically good for long-only.

INT-161.zh: 正價差（contango）對長期多方不一定好，展期可能吃負收益。商品也不是無風險 資產。
INT-161.core_idea: Contango is not automatically good for a long-only commodity sleeve; roll yield can be negative
INT-161.study_section: Alternatives + Portfolio ｜另類投資與投資組合
INT-161.exam_trap: Treating contango as automatic long-only income

INT-162.reasoning: Reasoning: PM ability vs willingness. Alts: lockups, gates, J-curve, fees, smoothing. Ethics: unsuitable concentration is still unsuitable if a friend made money.

why_wrong.A: Loyalty does not override ability. Verification does not certify a composite or future returns.
why_wrong.C: The neighbor’s number is not an IPS input.

INT-162.zh: 能力／流動性不足，就不能因為鄰居的Sharpe 或「忠誠」去堆50% 閉鎖另類。
INT-162.core_idea: High willingness + low ability: do not fill an illiquid alt book; ability prevails
INT-162.study_section: Alternatives + Portfolio ｜另類投資與投資組合
INT-162.exam_trap: Using a neighbor’s Sharpe or Loyalty to override low ability in alts

INT-163.reasoning: Reasoning: p=3.50+40/1.05-40=1.60. Equity stock plus put equals call plus a FI zero that pays the strike. Given: S=X=40; r=5%; T=1; c=3.50. Asked: Put from parity. Formula: 3.50 + 40/1.05 −40 Variables: European, same T and X. Why this formula: Deriv parity on an Equity share. The share is more expensive than the strike’s PV, so the call exceeds the put. Reasonableness check: If r=0, ATM spot would give p=c. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Uses S-PV(X)=40-38.10=1.90 as the put (intrinsic-style).
why_wrong.C: Sets p=c because the call is at-the-money on the spot.

INT-163.zh: 保護性賣權＝股票+put，信託買權＝call+ 零息債。ATM 現貨也不表示 put=call。
INT-163.core_idea: Fiduciary call = protective put; that is put-call parity on a share
INT-163.study_section: Derivatives + Equity ｜衍生性商品與權益
INT-163.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-163.subtopic: INT.12 Derivatives + Equity ｜衍生性商品與權益

INT-164.reasoning: Reasoning: PV(div)=0.80/1.040.25=0.792. F=(60-0.792)×1.040.5=60.38. Owning the share has a benefit the forward does not, so F falls. Given: S=60; r=4%; T=0.5; div 0.80 in 0.25y. Asked: Carry-adjusted forward. Formula: (60 −0.80/1.040.25) × 1.040.5 Variables: No storage cost. Why this formula: Deriv carry on an Equity dividend. Greater benefits of owning the asset lower F. Reasonableness check: Two dividends would subtract two PVs. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Subtracts the raw 0.80 without discounting: 59.20×1.040.5=60.37.
why_wrong.B: Ignores the dividend: 60×1.040.5=61.19.

INT-164.zh: 股息是持有現貨的好處，遠期價格要扣股息現值再長大。不要整筆扣0.80 也不要 當沒股息。
INT-164.core_idea: Dividends cut the no-arbitrage equity forward: F=(S-PV(I))(1+r)^T
INT-164.study_section: Derivatives + Equity ｜衍生性商品與權益
INT-164.exam_trap: Ignoring the dividend or subtracting it undiscounted
INT-164.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-164.subtopic: INT.12 Derivatives + Equity ｜衍生性商品與權益

INT-165.reasoning: Reasoning: Deriv: intrinsic = max(S-X,0)=2. Equity option on a share. Lower bounds and parity use PV(X). Deep in-the-money American calls on dividend shares are the early-exercise story, not a forced price of 2.

why_wrong.A: Sources warn: do not call S-PV(X) the exercise value.
why_wrong.C: American equity calls can have time value; they need not trade at intrinsic.

INT-165.zh: 履約價值是max(S-X,0)=2，不是S-PV(X)=4。市價可以高於2（時間價值）。
INT-165.core_idea: A call’s intrinsic value is max(S-X,0), not S-PV(X); market value ≥intrinsic for an American, and can exceed it
INT-165.study_section: Derivatives + Equity ｜衍生性商品與權益
INT-165.exam_trap: Calling S-PV(X) the call’s intrinsic value
INT-165.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-165.subtopic: INT.12 Derivatives + Equity ｜衍生性商品與權益

INT-166.reasoning: Reasoning: Equity long stock plus Deriv short call. Profit = stock P&L - max(ST-X,0) + c0. Downside is still there, reduced by c0. Protective put is the floor; covered call is the cap.

why_wrong.A: Long put ̸= short stock, and short call ̸= short stock.
why_wrong.C: Premium cushions, it does not floor the position at zero loss.

INT-166.zh: 備兌買權是持有股票再賣call：上檔賣掉、收到權利金。不是保護性賣權，也不是 做空股票。
INT-166.core_idea: Covered call = long stock + short call: upside capped, still exposed below the strike net of premium
INT-166.study_section: Derivatives + Equity ｜衍生性商品與權益
INT-166.exam_trap: Treating a covered call as a short stock or as a protective put
INT-166.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-166.subtopic: INT.12 Derivatives + Equity ｜衍生性商品與權益

INT-167.reasoning: Reasoning: cu=12, cd=0, ∆=12/24=0.50. π*=(1.05-0.80)/(1.20-0.80)=0.625. c0=(0.625×12+0.375×0)/1.05=7.14. Given: S 60; 72/48; X 60; r 5%. Asked: Call value. Formula: (0.625 × 12)/1.05 Variables: u=1.2; d=0.8. Why this formula: Deriv tree on an Equity underlying. If the market call is 8, sell the rich call and replicate (∆shares, borrow B). Reasonableness check: ∆=0.50 share per call written to hedge. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports the up-node payoff 12 as today’s price.
why_wrong.C: Uses 50/50 real-world probabilities: 0.5×12/1.05=5.71.

INT-167.zh: 對沖比率讓上下兩態抵銷。風險中立機率不是預測漲跌機率。不要把期末12 當今 天價格。
INT-167.core_idea: One-period binomial: ∆= (cu-cd)/(Su-Sd); value is the replicating portfolio / risk-neutral PV
INT-167.study_section: Derivatives + Equity ｜衍生性商品與權益
INT-167.exam_trap: Using 50/50 real-world probabilities or the up payoff as the price
INT-167.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-167.subtopic: INT.12 Derivatives + Equity ｜衍生性商品與權益

INT-168.reasoning: Reasoning: F=53, X=48, p-c=(48-53)/1.06=-4.72. The call is worth more than the put when the forward is above the strike — the Equity carry is why F>S. Given: F 53; X 48; r 6%; T=1. Asked: p-c. Formula: (48 −53)/1.06 Variables: No dividend already in F. Why this formula: Deriv forward parity on Equity. A low strike relative to F is in-the-money for the call on a forward basis. Reasonableness check: If X=F, p=c. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Forgets to discount X-F.
why_wrong.C: Reverses the sign: (F-X)/(1+r).

INT-168.zh: 遠期平價：put-call=(X-F) 的現值。F>X 時call 比put 貴。
INT-168.study_section: Derivatives + Equity ｜衍生性商品與權益
INT-168.exam_trap: Forgetting to discount X-F or reversing the sign
INT-168.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-168.subtopic: INT.12 Derivatives + Equity ｜衍生性商品與權益

INT-169.reasoning: Reasoning: Stock gain to 60 is +5, then called away; plus premium 3 →+8. Or: (min(ST,X)- S0)+c0=(60-55)+3=8. Upside above 60 is the call buyer’s. Given: S0 55; ST 70; X 60; c0 3. Asked: Covered-call profit. Formula: 60 −55 + 3 Variables: Call finishes 10 ITM. Why this formula: Equity stock P&L plus Deriv short-call P&L. The 10 of extra stock gain went to the call buyer. Reasonableness check: If ST were 50, profit=50-55+3=-2 (premium cushion). 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Treats the position as short stock: 55-70+3=-12, nearby -8 if the premium sign flips.
why_wrong.C: Forgets the call was exercised: 70-55+3=18.

INT-169.zh: 股票漲到70 也被60 召回。利潤= 鎖在履約價的漲幅+ 權利金=8。不是做空股 票。
INT-169.core_idea: Long stock + short call payoff is the covered-call shape, not the short-stock shape
INT-169.study_section: Derivatives + Equity ｜衍生性商品與權益
INT-169.exam_trap: Ignoring exercise or treating covered call as short stock
INT-169.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-169.subtopic: INT.12 Derivatives + Equity ｜衍生性商品與權益

INT-170.reasoning: Reasoning: Equity dividend is Deriv carry I. Greater I →lower F. Calls on a lower forward cheapen; puts richen (parity: p-c = (X-F)/(1+r)^T becomes more positive).

why_wrong.B: Dividends cut F; they are a benefit of owning the asset, not the call.
why_wrong.C: The sources’ carry formula includes PV(I).

INT-170.zh: 特別股息讓遠期變便宜，call 變便宜、put 變貴。股息是持有現貨的好處，不是 call 的好處。
INT-170.core_idea: A larger expected dividend lowers the equity forward and, other things equal, lowers calls and raises puts
INT-170.study_section: Derivatives + Equity ｜衍生性商品與權益
INT-170.exam_trap: Treating a dividend as a gift to the call holder
INT-170.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-170.subtopic: INT.12 Derivatives + Equity ｜衍生性商品與權益

INT-171.reasoning: Reasoning: FSA quality flags (DSO, stuffing, AP stretch, CFO/NI) are the facts. Ethics: communicate fairly, accurately, completely. A true GAAP NI can still be an incomplete story.

why_wrong.A: Detection patterns are not automatic legal findings of fraud.
why_wrong.C: III(D) reaches performance and research presentation, not only illegal books.

INT-171.zh: 財報可以合規，簡報把塞貨與延後付款講成「創紀錄現金」，仍是陳述不完整。偵 測型態不是自動定罪。
INT-171.core_idea: Low-quality reporting (channel stuffing, stretched payables) is a III(D)/misrepresentation issue when used in a pitch
INT-171.study_section: Ethics + FSA ｜倫理與財務報表分析
INT-171.exam_trap: Treating GAAP NI as automatically a complete Ethics presentation
INT-171.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。
INT-171.subtopic: INT.13 Ethics + FSA ｜倫理與財務報表分析

INT-172.reasoning: Reasoning: FSA non-GAAP watchlist (SBC, impairment, litigation…). Ethics: do not present a track record that is true only because the awkward bits were dropped. Equal prominence is the U.S. presentation rule in the sources.

why_wrong.A: Issuer use does not clean the member’s repetition of a headline.
why_wrong.B: IFRS requires definition, relevance, and reconciliation — it does not forbid reconciliations.

INT-172.zh: 只講非GAAP 標題、把GAAP 藏在註腳，陳述不完整。美國還要求同等顯著與 調節。
INT-172.core_idea: Non-GAAP at equal prominence, with reconciliation — Ethics communication plus FSA non- GAAP rules
INT-172.study_section: Ethics + FSA ｜倫理與財務報表分析

INT-173.reasoning: Reasoning: Ethics I(B): gifts/issuer pressure. FSA: LIFO liquidation is an unsustainable margin flag. The two meet when access is exchanged for silence.

why_wrong.B: Diligence is real; issuer-paid luxury around a live accounting question is the I(B) fact pattern.
why_wrong.C: Suitability is a client-portfolio duty, not an issuer-entertainment duty.

INT-173.zh: 發行人買單、又正好在你質疑LIFO 清算的時候，客觀性有問題。實地訪查可以 做，不能被買斷判斷。
INT-173.core_idea: Independence/objectivity: an issuer-paid trip around an audit-quality concern is I(B), not a research freebie
INT-173.study_section: Ethics + FSA ｜倫理與財務報表分析
INT-173.exam_trap: Calling an issuer-paid trip required diligence

INT-174.reasoning: Reasoning: FSA footnotes are a public input. Ethics II(A) is material + nonpublic. Accounting numbers can be MNPI.

why_wrong.A: An unreleased impairment is material nonpublic accounting information.
why_wrong.C: Filed 10-K footnotes are public.

INT-174.zh: 已申報年報與附註是公開資訊。未發布的減損數字是重大非公開。會計數字一樣 可以是MNPI。
INT-174.core_idea: Public filings plus nonmaterial operations color is mosaic; a stolen unreleased 8-K is MNPI

INT-174.exam_trap: Treating filed footnotes as nonpublic, or accounting as never MNPI

INT-175.reasoning: Reasoning: FSA: impairment hits earnings and assets; future ROA can rise mechanically. Ethics III(D): do not present a track record that is true only because the weak pieces were dropped. Label any add-back.

why_wrong.B: GIPS composites are not a license to drop a subsidiary’s history from a company ROE without saying so.
why_wrong.C: Impairments are inside GAAP ROE unless a clearly labeled analytic adjustment is explained.

INT-175.zh: 把減損年和已出售虧損拿掉再平均ROE，是不完整。要調就明講，不能當官方 ROE。
INT-175.core_idea: III(D): do not present ratios that are true only because a weak year or a terminated segment was dropped
INT-175.study_section: Ethics + FSA ｜倫理與財務報表分析
INT-175.exam_trap: Silently dropping impairment years from an average ROE

INT-176.reasoning: Reasoning: FSA restatement (reserve to inventory and after-tax equity) is what makes P/B speak the same language. Ethics: reasonable diligence and a complete research basis.

why_wrong.A: V(A)/I(C) diligence includes the footnotes the ranking depends on.
why_wrong.B: IFRS does not permit LIFO. Market price does not cancel an inventory-method gap in book equity.

INT-176.zh: 一個LIFO、一個IFRS FIFO，不看準備就排P/B，是方法不可比，也是研究不 夠勤勉。
INT-176.core_idea: Diligence I(C)/V(A): do not ignore a known LIFO reserve or IFRS/GAAP difference when you publish a P/B rank
INT-176.study_section: Ethics + FSA ｜倫理與財務報表分析
INT-176.exam_trap: Publishing a raw LIFO-vs-FIFO P/B rank as diligence-clean
INT-176.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。

INT-177.reasoning: Reasoning: Firm=36/(0.09-0.03)=600. Equity=600-80=520. Gordon on FCFF at re is the wrong claim. Given: FCFF1 36; WACC 9%; g 3%; net debt 80. Asked: Equity value. Formula: 36/(0.09 −0.03) −80 Variables: Perpetual growth. Why this formula: Corp WACC plus Equity residual claim. A parallel FCFE at re should be in the same neighborhood if inputs cohere. Reasonableness check: If g≥WACC the model is unusable — same warning as Gordon. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Discounts FCFF at a 13% cost of equity: 360.
why_wrong.C: Reports firm value 600 as equity.

INT-177.zh: FCFF 用WACC 得到企業價值，減淨債才是股權。不要用股權成本折FCFF。
INT-177.core_idea: WACC-discounted FCFF is firm value; equity is residual after net debt — not a Gordon on FCFF
INT-177.study_section: Corporate + Equity ｜公司發行人與權益
INT-177.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。

INT-178.reasoning: Reasoning: re=10%. WACC=0.4×8%×0.75+0.6×10%=8.4%. NPV=- 100+40/1.084+80/1.084²=4.98. Equity CAPM is one WACC input, not the project hurdle. Given: Weights 40/60; rd 8%; t 25%; Rf 4%; β 1.2; ERP 5%; CF -100,40,80. Asked: NPV and the price implication. Formula: −100 + 40/1.084 + 80/1.0842 Variables: re=10%; WACC=8.4%. Why this formula: Equity CAPM inside Corp WACC/NPV. Positive NPV is a wealth increase at the firm level. Reasonableness check: CF worksheet at I=8.4. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：CF / NPV 已知：CF0=-100; C01=40; C02=80; I=8.4 求：NPV 按鍵： ①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②100 +/- ENTER ③↓40 ENTER ④↓↓80 ENTER ⑤NPV 8.4 ENTER ⑥↓CPT 結果：4.98 中文理解：I 是WACC 8.4，不是re 10。

why_wrong.A: Sources: in theory price rises by NPV/share; in practice prices already embed the firm’s ability to find projects.
why_wrong.C: re=4%+6%=10%, but WACC is not re.

INT-178.zh: CAPM 的re 只是WACC 的一項。專案要用WACC 折。理論上NPV 增加公司 價值，實務上價格可能已反映尋找專案的能力。
INT-178.core_idea: CAPM re enters WACC; NPV at that WACC is the estimated addition to firm value, not automatically to the share count
INT-178.study_section: Corporate + Equity ｜公司發行人與權益
INT-178.exam_trap: Discounting the project at re instead of WACC

INT-179.reasoning: Reasoning: VL=800+0.25×200=850. Equity=850-200=650. WACC falls with debt in this setting; 100% debt is optimal until distress is admitted. Equity holders own a smaller slice of a larger pie. Given: VU 800; t 25%; D 200; no distress. Asked: VL and levered equity. Formula: 800 + 0.25 × 200 Variables: MM with tax. Why this formula: Corp MM plus Equity residual claim. P/B can move because book equity did not pick up tD the same way. Reasonableness check: No-tax MM would have kept VL=800, E=600. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Ignores the tax shield: VL=800, E=600.
why_wrong.C: Adds full debt without t: VL=1000, or sets equity=VU.

INT-179.zh: 有稅無困境：VL=VU+tD。股權=VL-D。不要忘了稅盾，也不要把股權當成還 是VU。
INT-179.core_idea: MM with corporate tax, no distress: VL=VU+tD; equity value is VL-D, not VU
INT-179.study_section: Corporate + Equity ｜公司發行人與權益
INT-179.exam_trap: Dropping tD or treating levered equity as VU
INT-179.source_note: 解答依據 INT_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Cross-Chapter Integration。

INT-180.reasoning: Reasoning: Gordon re=2/40+4%=9.00%. CAPM re=3%+5.5%=8.50%. After-tax rd=5.25%. WACC_DDM=0.3×5.25%+0.7×9%=7.88%. WACC_CAPM=0.3×5.25%+0.7×8.5%=7.52%. Sources list both re methods; a gap is an input tension, not a license to pick the hurdle that accepts the project. Given: D1 2; P 40; g 4%; Rf 3%; β 1.1; ERP 5%; rd 7%; t 25%; 30/70. Asked: Two WACCs. Formula: 0.30 × 0.07 × 0.75 + 0.70 × (2/40 + 0.04) Variables: Bond-yield-plus-RP is a third source method not used here. Why this formula: Equity re estimates inside Corp WACC. Reconcile P0 vs V0 before you pick a hurdle. Reasonableness check: If P0 were equal to Gordon at CAPM r, the two re’s would match. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Those are the two re estimates, not WACC.
why_wrong.B: Debt still gets the tax shield.

INT-180.zh: 股權成本可以是D1/P+g 或CAPM，兩者都可進WACC，不必相等。差距是輸 入不一致，不能挑會讓專案過關的那個。
INT-180.core_idea: re can be CAPM or D1/P0+g; both can enter WACC — they need not match
INT-180.study_section: Corporate + Equity ｜公司發行人與權益
INT-180.formula:
re = D1/P0 + g
or
Rf + β ERP
INT-180.exam_trap: Reporting re as WACC, or skipping the debt tax shield
