SIM-001.reasoning: Reasoning: Standard I(A) requires the stricter of applicable law and the Code and Standards. Local law permits a practice the Code prohibits, so the Code governs. Disclosure does not convert a knowing violation into compliance.

why_wrong.A: Disclosure after the fact does not authorize a prohibited priority of transactions.
why_wrong.B: Local permission does not override a stricter Code prohibition.

SIM-001.zh: 法律允許、Code 禁止時，跟較嚴的那套。這裡是Code。事後揭露不能把違規變 成合規。
SIM-001.core_idea: Follow whichever is stricter: applicable law or the Code and Standards
SIM-001.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-002.reasoning: Reasoning: The Study Book rejects a universal confront-first sequence. Intermediate action depends on the facts. Remaining associated with an unremedied known violation is itself a violation, so dissociation and appropriate documentation follow if the activity continues.

why_wrong.A: Immediate resignation is not always required; documentation is not optional window-dressing.
why_wrong.C: Confronting the person is not a required first step.

SIM-002.zh: 沒有「一定先對質同事」的固定流程。重點是不要繼續參與；沒糾正就要脫離並視 情況留下紀錄。
SIM-002.core_idea: I(A) dissociation is not a mandatory confront-first sequence
SIM-002.exam_trap: I(A) sequence taught as mandatory confront →supervisor →dissociate
SIM-002.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-003.reasoning: Reasoning: I(B) asks whether independence reasonably could be compromised. Modest existingclient tokens, disclosed, can be consistent. A luxury charter designed to influence manager selection is not. Disclosure is not a cure for an influence gift.

why_wrong.B: Disclosure does not cleanse an influence gift tied to a pending allocation.
why_wrong.C: I(B) is not a blanket ban on every modest token gift.

SIM-003.zh: I(B) 看獨立性會不會被收買。普通節日禮盒加揭露可以一致；為了搶mandate 的 豪華招待要拒。
SIM-003.core_idea: I(B) modest gifts vs influence gifts
SIM-003.exam_trap: Prospective-client gifts treated as an automatic ban
SIM-003.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-004.reasoning: Reasoning: II(A) bans acting on material nonpublic information. Mosaic theory permits combining public information with nonmaterial nonpublic information to reach a material conclusion. The warehouse count was judged nonmaterial.

why_wrong.B: A material conclusion is not automatically illegal; the test is whether an input was material and nonpublic.
why_wrong.C: Not every nonpublic input is MNPI.

SIM-004.zh: 禁的是重大且非公開。公開財報加非重大卡車數，拼出重大結論，是mosaic，允 許。
SIM-004.core_idea: Mosaic theory vs material nonpublic information (MNPI)
SIM-004.study_section: II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信
SIM-004.exam_trap: Treating every nonpublic input as inside information
SIM-004.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-005.reasoning: Reasoning: A selective communication of unreleased earnings is MNPI. Prior public modeling does not convert a material tip into mosaic. Acting on that figure violates II(A).

why_wrong.A: Own work does not legalize a material nonpublic tip.
why_wrong.B: Mosaic requires that no input is material nonpublic.

SIM-005.zh: 非公開場合講出的下季EPS 是MNPI。先前做過公開模型，不能把內線變成拼 圖。
SIM-005.core_idea: A material tip on a selective call is MNPI, not mosaic
SIM-005.study_section: II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信
SIM-005.exam_trap: Treating a material conclusion as automatically illegal / mosaic over-claim
SIM-005.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-006.reasoning: Reasoning: On a material unsolicited trade that does not fit the IPS, III(C) requires a discussion and then an IPS update, a firm-policy client-directed account, or reconsideration of the relationship. Loyalty does not override Suitability.

why_wrong.B: III(A) does not turn the member into an order clerk on an unsuitable material request.
why_wrong.C: A one-line approval is not one of the three Study Book paths.

SIM-006.zh: 客戶自己要買，不能用Loyalty 蓋過Suitability。影響重大且不符IPS，走討論後 更新IPS、獨立帳戶或退出關係。
SIM-006.core_idea: Loyalty cannot override Suitability on a material unsolicited trade
SIM-006.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
SIM-006.exam_trap: Using Loyalty to override Suitability on an unsolicited trade
SIM-006.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-007.reasoning: Reasoning: III(B) requires fair, objective treatment and simultaneous dissemination. After the change has gone to all clients, calling the largest accounts to discuss implementation is permitted. Fair is not identical.

why_wrong.A: No fee condition is required.
why_wrong.B: After simultaneous distribution, a later implementation call is permitted; extra contact is not the same as earlier access.

SIM-007.zh: 公平不是完全相同。變更已同時送達所有客戶後，再打電話討論執行，與「先讓 大戶知道」不同。
SIM-007.core_idea: Fair Dealing allows a later implementation call after simultaneous dissemination
SIM-007.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
SIM-007.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-008.reasoning: Reasoning: The firm claims compliance. Verification is optional and recommended. If performed, an independent third party does it firm-wide. That review supports the claim; it does not certify one composite’s figures. Composites are required for all strategies with segregated accounts.

why_wrong.B: Verification is not a prerequisite, and it does not certify one composite’s numbers.
why_wrong.C: GIPS is a firm claim; a single-composite label while omitting required accounts is not what the rules describe.

SIM-008.zh: Verification 是選擇性、受鼓勵的。若做，必須firm-wide。它不是claim 的前提， 也不替單一composite 數字背書。
SIM-008.core_idea: Verification is optional and recommended; the firm claims compliance
SIM-008.study_section: Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS) ｜全球投資績效標準
SIM-008.exam_trap: Reading verification is firm-wide as verification is required to claim GIPS
SIM-008.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-009.reasoning: Reasoning: The anti-cherry-picking rule: every actual fee-paying discretionary segregated account belongs in at least one composite defined by the same mandate, objective, or strategy. A pooled fund that meets a composite’s definition must also be included.

why_wrong.A: Omitting a weak fee-paying discretionary account is cherry-picking.
why_wrong.B: GIPS is a firm claim, not a single-account methodology badge.

SIM-009.zh: 真實、收費、有裁量權的獨立帳戶都要進至少一個依策略定義的composite。不能 為了好看把虧的帳戶藏起來。
SIM-009.core_idea: Every actual fee-paying discretionary segregated account must sit in a composite
SIM-009.study_section: Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS) ｜全球投資績效標準
SIM-009.exam_trap: Claiming GIPS for one composite while omitting required accounts tute 會員或考生的責任
SIM-009.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-010.reasoning: Reasoning: The sources allow a true statement that a candidate passed a named CFA exam. They do not allow “CFA Level I” as a title, or “CFA” in a pseudonym that hides identity.

why_wrong.A: There is no “CFA Level I” designation.
why_wrong.B: CFA in an identity-concealing pseudonym is prohibited.

SIM-010.zh: 可以寫通過哪一關；不能把CFA Level I 當頭銜，也不能用CFA 當隱藏身分的網 名。
SIM-010.core_idea: CFA Level I is not a designation; a true pass statement is permitted
SIM-010.study_section: VII. Responsibilities as a CFA Institute Member or CFA Candidate ｜身為CFA Institute 會員或 考生的責任
SIM-010.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-011.reasoning: Reasoning: IV(A) forbids depriving the employer of skills, divulging confidential information, or taking firm records, models, or client lists. What remains in memory may be used. “I built this, so copies are mine” is still a taking of firm property.

why_wrong.B: Personal authorship is not ownership of the firm’s files.
why_wrong.C: Notice does not license taking employer materials.

SIM-011.zh: 模型是你做的，檔案仍是公司的。能帶走的是留在腦子裡的知識，不是USB 裡的 客戶名單。
SIM-011.core_idea: When leaving, do not take firm records; knowledge in memory may be used
SIM-011.study_section: IV. Duties to Employers ｜對僱主的責任
SIM-011.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-012.reasoning: Reasoning: If the compliance system is inadequate, the supervisor notifies management, recommends correction, and declines the responsibility in writing until procedures are adequate. Accepting the title “because someone has to sign” is a violation.

why_wrong.B: Tasks may be delegated; responsibility may not.
why_wrong.C: Resignation is the I(A) path for a continuing violation, not the supervisor procedure.

SIM-012.zh: 可以委派工作，不能委派責任。系統不夠用：通知管理層、建議改正、書面拒絕 監督，直到程序到位。
SIM-012.core_idea: A supervisor must decline inadequate supervision in writing; tasks delegate, responsibility does not
SIM-012.study_section: IV. Duties to Employers ｜對僱主的責任
SIM-012.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-013.reasoning: Reasoning: III(E) covers current, former, and prospective clients unless the information concerns suspected illegal activity, disclosure is required by law, or the client permits. A job interview is not an exception.

why_wrong.A: Former clients are still covered.
why_wrong.C: Track-record storytelling is not a listed exception.

SIM-013.zh: 前客戶也要保密。例外只有違法嫌疑、法律要求、客戶同意。面試秀績效不是例 外。
SIM-013.core_idea: Confidentiality covers former clients; a job interview is not an exception
SIM-013.study_section: III. Duties to Clients ｜對客戶的責任
SIM-013.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-014.reasoning: Reasoning: V(A): no obligation to dissociate from group research the member does not agree with, if the process has a basis. I(A) and II(A): no knowing participation in MNPI trading; dissociate from that violation.

why_wrong.B: A research disagreement is not an I(A) dissociation event.
why_wrong.C: Not personally trading does not license remaining associated with a known MNPI violation.

SIM-014.zh: 研究結論不同̸= 要dissociate。同事在用MNPI，才要脫離。兩件事不是同一條 Standard。
SIM-014.core_idea: No duty to dissociate from reasonable group research; I(A) dissociation is for Standards being broken
SIM-014.study_section: V. Investment Analysis, Recommendations, and Actions ｜投資分析、建議與行動
SIM-014.exam_trap: Applying MNPI dissociation to a research disagreement
SIM-014.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-015.reasoning: Reasoning: I(C) forbids knowingly misrepresenting facts and forbids guaranteeing investment results or saying past results will certainly be repeated. Stating a fact that is actually true is not a guarantee.

why_wrong.A: A true insurance or Treasury fact is not a performance guarantee.
why_wrong.B: The Study Book treats that Treasury description as stating a fact that is actually true, not as a guarantee of investment results.

SIM-015.zh: 保證績效或說過去一定會重演，違規。把確實受保的CD 或公債無違約風險照實 說，不是保證。
SIM-015.core_idea: I(C) bans guaranteeing results; stating a true fact (FDIC-insured CD) is not a guarantee
SIM-015.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-016.reasoning: Reasoning: II(B) bans distorting price or trading volume in order to mislead. Large trades that move the price are not, by themselves, manipulation. Intent to mislead is. Wash trades printed for a marketing story have that intent.

why_wrong.A: Size alone is not manipulation.
why_wrong.B: II(B) is not limited to research reports; intent to distort price or volume to mislead is the test.

SIM-016.zh: II(B) 看的是誤導意圖，不是成交量大不大。對敲刷量是操縱；單純因經濟理由的 大單把價格打下去，本身不是。
SIM-016.core_idea: II(B) requires intent to mislead; large trades that move price are not, by themselves, manipulation
SIM-016.study_section: II. Integrity of Capital Markets ｜資本市場誠信
SIM-016.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-017.reasoning: Reasoning: The periodic rate is 10%/4 = 2.5%. EAR = (1.025)4 - 1 = 10.381%. The stated quote is not the rate earned over a year. Given: Stated i = 10%; quarterly compounding (m = 4). Asked: Effective annual rate. Formula: EAR = ( 1 + i m )m −1 Variables: i = stated annual rate; m = compounding periods per year. Why this formula: EAR compounds the periodic rate m times and converts the wealth ratio back into a one-year rate. Later 2.5% slices are earned on interest already credited, so EAR exceeds the stated 10%. Reasonableness check: Annual < quarterly < monthly < continuous for a fixed stated rate. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：ICONV 已知：NOM = 10%; C/Y = 4 求：EFF (EAR) 按鍵： ①2nd →ICONV ②10 →ENTER (NOM) ③↓→4 →ENTER (C/Y) ④↓→CPT (EFF) 結果：EFF = 10.38% 中文理解：NOM 是題目印的stated rate，C/Y 是一年複利幾次，CPT EFF 才是EAR。手 算(1.025)4-1 一樣對。
SIM-017.steps: ①Periodic rate = 0.10 / 4 = 0.025. ②EAR = (1.025)4 - 1 = 0.10381. ③Closest listed figure is 10.38%.

why_wrong.A: Uses monthly compounding: (1 + 0.10/12)12 - 1 ≈10.47%.
why_wrong.C: Reports the stated rate as if it were already effective.

SIM-017.zh: 題目印的10% 只是報價。一季2.5%、複利四次，才是一年真正賺到的10.38%。
SIM-017.core_idea: EAR = (1 + i/m)^m - 1; more frequent compounding raises EAR for a fixed stated rate
SIM-017.study_section: Stated Rates and Effective Rates ｜名目利率與有效利率

按鍵：

結果：EFF = 10.38%

算(1.025)4-1 一樣對。
SIM-017.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-018.reasoning: Reasoning: The geometric mean is [(1.20)(0.90)(1.15)]^1/3 - 1 = 1.242^1/3 - 1 = 7.49%. That constant rate recovers the 24.20% three-year wealth ratio. The arithmetic mean overstates compound growth when returns vary. Given: Full-year returns +20%, -10%, +15%; no intra-year cash flows. Asked: Constant annual compound (geometric) growth rate. Formula: rG = [ (1.20)(0.90)(1.15) ]1/3 −1 Variables: r_i = period total returns. Why this formula: The root of the wealth product is the single annual rate that reproduces the multi-year path. Variability pulls the geometric mean below the 8.33% arithmetic mean. Reasonableness check: (1.0833)3 - 1 ≈27.1%, which overstates the actual 24.20% path. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports the three-year HPR (1.20 × 0.90 × 1.15 - 1 = 24.20%), not the annual compound rate.
why_wrong.B: Uses the arithmetic mean (20 - 10 + 15)/3 = 8.33%, which is not the compound rate.

SIM-018.zh: 問的是「每年同一個速率能否重現這條財富路徑」，那是幾何平均。算術平均 8.33% 當成年複利會高估。
SIM-018.core_idea: Geometric mean is the constant compound rate; arithmetic mean is not compound growth
SIM-018.exam_trap: Using the arithmetic mean as a compound growth rate
SIM-018.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-019.reasoning: Reasoning: After Year 1 the account is 130; the deposit makes 210; Year 2 leaves 178.5. TWR = √ (1.30 × 0.85) - 1 = 5.12%. External cash is stripped out. MWR is the IRR of the account flows and is dragged down because money was added just before the loss. Given: Start 100; Year 1 +30%; then deposit 80; Year 2 -15%; terminal withdrawn. Asked: Time-weighted return (annual compound of the two HPRs). Formula: TWR = √ Variables: r1, r2 = subperiod HPRs between external cash flows. Why this formula: TWR chains HPRs so client deposits do not enter the manager-skill measure. The manager’s two HPRs are still +30% and -15%. The deposit just before the loss hurts MWR, not TWR. Reasonableness check: Arithmetic 7.50% ignores compounding and is not either measure. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：CF / IRR (MWR check only) 已知：CF0 = -100; C01 = -80; C02 = +178.5. TWR is hand-calc. 求：TWR by y^x; MWR as IRR if asked 按鍵： ①TWR: 1.30 × 0.85 = 1.105 → √ →- 1 →5.12% ②CF →2nd →CLR WORK ③100 → +/- →ENTER (CF0) ④↓→80 →+/- →ENTER (C01) ⑤↓→1 →ENTER (F01) ⑥↓→ 178.5 →ENTER (C02) ⑦IRR →CPT →-0.54% (MWR, not the answer) 結果：TWR = 5.12% 中文理解：兩段HPR 用連乘再開根就是TWR，不必進CF 表。CF 表算的是客戶體驗到的 IRR（MWR）。
SIM-019.steps: ①Year-1 HPR = +30%. Value = 130 before the deposit. ②After the deposit the account is 210. Year-2 HPR = -15%. Terminal = 178.5. ③TWR = √ (1.30 × 0.85) - 1 = √ 1.105 - 1 = 5.12%. ④MWR (for the trap): CF0 = -100, C01 = -80, C02 = +178.5 →IRR ≈-0.54%.

why_wrong.A: This is the money-weighted IRR of -100, -80, +178.5, not TWR.
why_wrong.C: Averages +30% and -15% (arithmetic), which is not TWR.

SIM-019.zh: TWR 只看各段自己漲跌：+30% 與-15% 連乘再開根。MWR 才是帳戶IRR；錢 加在虧損前，會把MWR 拉低。
SIM-019.core_idea: TWR is the geometric mean of subperiod HPRs; MWR is the account IRR
SIM-019.study_section: Time-Weighted versus Money-Weighted ｜時間加權與資金加權

SIM-020.reasoning: Reasoning: P(news) = 0.70×0.12 + 0.20×0.88 = 0.26. P(takeover | news) = 0.084 / 0.26 = 32.3%. The news more than doubles the prior, but most news items still come from the larger non-takeover group. Given: P(T) = 12%; P(N|T) = 70%; P(N|T^c) = 20%. Asked: P(T | news). Formula: P(T | N) = 0.70 × 0.12 0.70 × 0.12 + 0.20 × 0.88 Variables: T = takeover; N = news item. Why this formula: The denominator is the total-probability weight of all paths that produce the news. A strong signal does not make a rare event likely if the complementary group is large. Reasonableness check: Posterior must lie between 0 and 1 and need not equal the likelihood. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports the likelihood P(news | takeover) instead of the posterior.
why_wrong.C: Leaves the prior unupdated.

SIM-020.zh: Bayes 把「看到新聞」之後的接管概率改寫。分子是這條路徑的聯合概率8.4%， 分母是所有會出現新聞的路徑26%。不要把70% 的likelihood 當成後驗。
SIM-020.core_idea: Posterior = likelihood × prior / unconditional probability of the information
SIM-020.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-021.reasoning: Reasoning: α is P(Type I). Lowering α makes rejection harder, so Type I falls and Type II (β) rises. Power = 1 - β therefore falls. The errors trade off.

why_wrong.A: Lower α is a larger critical value, so Type I falls and power falls.
why_wrong.C: The two errors do not fall together; a stricter critical value makes a false null harder to catch.

SIM-021.zh: α 從5% 改1%，比較不容易虛驚（Type I 下降），也比較容易漏掉真實關係 （Type II 上升、檢定力下降）。
SIM-021.core_idea: Lowering α lowers Type I and raises Type II; power = 1 - β falls
SIM-021.study_section: Type I and Type II Errors ｜型一與型二錯誤
SIM-021.exam_trap: Treating a stricter α as reducing both error types
SIM-021.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-022.reasoning: Reasoning: Uncorrelated means covariance is zero (no linear association). Independence requires P(X,Y) = P(X)P(Y). Independent variables are uncorrelated; ρ = 0 does not prove independence. In a portfolio formula, ρ = 0 does drop the cross term.

why_wrong.A: Zero correlation is possible with independence or with a nonlinear dependence; it does not require a curve.
why_wrong.B: Independence implies uncorrelated; the converse is false.

SIM-022.zh: ρ=0 只保證線性共動為零，組合變異數的交叉項會消失。獨立是更強的「聯合概 率可拆開」。不要把兩者畫等號。
SIM-022.core_idea: ρ = 0 is no linear association; independence is the stronger joint-probability factorization
SIM-022.study_section: Independence versus Uncorrelated ｜統計獨立與不相關
SIM-022.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-023.reasoning: Reasoning: R² = SSR/SST is the fraction of Y’s variation attributed to the linear relation with X. It is not a probability and not a causal claim. If the slope is positive, ρ = √ R².

why_wrong.B: With a positive slope, ρ = √ R² = 0.70, not 0.49.
why_wrong.C: R² is not P(X causes Y).

SIM-023.zh: R²=0.49 是「Y 的變異有49% 被這條直線解釋」。斜率為正時相關是0.70，不是 0.49，更不是因果概率。
SIM-023.core_idea: R² is the share of Y’s variance explained by the line; it is not ρ and not causality
SIM-023.study_section: Fit: SST, SSR, SSE, and R-squared ｜配適度
SIM-023.formula:
R2 = SSR/SST,
ρ = +
√
R2 if b1 > 0
SIM-023.exam_trap: Reading R² as the probability that X causes Y, or as the correlation itself
SIM-023.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-024.reasoning: Reasoning: Profit max is MR = MC in every structure. What differs is the demand curve that turns that quantity into a price. Perfect competition: horizontal demand, so P = MR. Monopolistic competition: downward demand, so P > MR.

why_wrong.B: P = MR only when firm demand is perfectly elastic.
why_wrong.C: All four structures use MR = MC. P = ATC is a long-run break-even result, not the output rule.

SIM-024.zh: 四種結構都用MR=MC。只有完全競爭的需求是水平線，才有P=MR。有差異化 就要降價才能多賣，所以P>MR。
SIM-024.core_idea: Every structure maximizes profit at MR = MC; P = MR only if demand is perfectly elastic
SIM-024.study_section: Firm and Market Structures ｜廠商與市場結構
SIM-024.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-025.reasoning: Reasoning: c(1 - t) = 0.70 × 0.75 = 0.525. Multiplier = 1 / (1 - 0.525) = 1 / 0.475 = 2.105 ≈ 2.11. A larger c raises the multiplier; a larger t lowers it. Given: c = 0.70; t = 0.25; only saving and a proportional tax leak. Asked: Fiscal multiplier ∆Y / ∆G. Formula: fiscal multiplier = 1 −c(1 −t) Variables: c = MPC out of disposable income; t = tax rate on national income. Why this formula: The recycled fraction of each round is c(1 - t); the infinite sum is 1 over one minus that fraction. An 80 increase in G would raise equilibrium Y by about 168, other leakages aside. Reasonableness check: Must lie between 1/(1 - c) = 3.33 (no tax) and a smaller number once tax leaks. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Uses 1 / (1 - c) = 1 / 0.30 = 3.33, dropping the tax leakage.

SIM-025.zh: 每一輪只有可支配的那塊能再被花掉，而且只花c。漏損是儲蓄和稅。漏掉稅會把 乘數做成1/(1-c)。
SIM-025.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-026.reasoning: Reasoning: The government spends the whole extra dollar. Households, facing one extra dollar of tax, cut consumption by only c < 1; the rest comes out of saving. First-round AD therefore rises by 1 - c, and that increment then runs through the multiplier.

why_wrong.A: The government spends 1 in full; households cut spending by only MPC, so the first round is + (1 - c), not negative.
why_wrong.C: Budget balance is an identity, not an AD offset.

SIM-026.zh: 預算平衡只表示G 與稅同一筆，不表示AD 抵銷。政府把一整塊花出去；家庭少 掉的消費只有MPC。
SIM-026.core_idea: A tax-financed rise in G is not AD-neutral because MPC < 1
SIM-026.exam_trap: Treating a tax-financed rise in G as AD-neutral
SIM-026.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-027.reasoning: Reasoning: Covered interest sets the two risk-free domestic payoffs equal: F_f/d = S_f/d(1 + r_f) / (1 + r_d) = 1.4000 × 1.05 / 1.03 = 1.4272. F > S because r_f > r_d: the price (foreign) currency has the higher rate and trades at a forward discount; the base cheapens in the quote as more foreign units per domestic unit. Given: S_f/d = 1.4000; r_d = 3%; r_f = 5%; τ = 1. Asked: No-arbitrage forward F_f/d. Formula: Ff/d = Sf/d 1 + rf 1 + rd Variables: S, F in foreign per one domestic; r_d domestic RF; r_f foreign RF. Why this formula: Investing one domestic unit at r_d must match converting, investing at r_f, and selling the foreign principal forward. The 1.94% forward premium on the base matches r_f > r_d. CIP is carry, not a forecast. Reasonableness check: If rates were swapped, F would lie below 1.4000. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Leaves the forward equal to spot, as if interest rates did not enter CIP.

SIM-027.zh: 遠期不是預測。高利率的那一邊遠期會變便宜。這裡r_f > r_d，所以F_f/d > S：一單位本幣換成更多外幣。
SIM-027.core_idea: CIP: F_f/d = S_f/d (1 + r_f) / (1 + r_d); the high-interest currency cheapens forward
SIM-027.study_section: Forwards and Covered Interest ｜遠期與拋補利率
SIM-027.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-028.reasoning: Reasoning: R_d/f = S_d/f × P_f / P_d is the real price of foreign goods in domestic terms. When it increases, each domestic basket buys fewer foreign goods. A 5% rise in the real rate is a 5% fall in A’s relative purchasing power over B.

why_wrong.A: “Up” is the real price of foreign goods, not a rise in purchasing power.
why_wrong.C: The real rate, not the nominal quote alone, is the purchasing-power statistic: R = S × P_f / P_d.

SIM-028.zh: 實質匯率是相對價格。R 上升表示外國貨變貴，本國相對購買力下降。不要把「上 升」讀成「購買力變好」。
SIM-028.core_idea: A rise in the real exchange rate R_d/f is a fall in domestic purchasing power over foreign goods
SIM-028.study_section: Quotes, participants, and the real rate
SIM-028.exam_trap: Reading a rise in the real exchange rate as a rise in purchasing power
SIM-028.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-029.reasoning: Reasoning: Break-even is P = ATC. If price is below ATC but covers AVC, the firm is losing money and will leave in the long run, but it should keep producing in the short run: shutdown would sacrifice the contribution toward sunk fixed cost. If P < AVC, shut down immediately.

why_wrong.B: P < ATC implies a loss and long-run exit, not an immediate shutdown. Immediate shutdown is P < AVC.
why_wrong.C: A perfect competitor is a price taker; it cannot lift the market price.

SIM-029.zh: 短期先問有沒有蓋住AVC。蓋住就繼續生產、幫忙攤固定成本；低於AVC 才立 刻停工。低於ATC 是長期要離開的訊號。
SIM-029.core_idea: Produce in the short run if P covers AVC; shut down immediately if P < AVC
SIM-029.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-030.reasoning: Reasoning: Leading examples include equity prices, building permits, and initial jobless claims. Coincident: industrial production. Lagging: average duration of unemployment, inventory-to-sales, unit labor cost. I/S rises late in expansion when sales slow, so it lags.

why_wrong.B: Duration of unemployment is lagging; building permits are leading.
why_wrong.C: I/S is lagging (a smaller ratio is the constructive signal); industrial production is coincident.

SIM-030.zh: 股票、許可、初次申領失業金偏領先。失業持續期間、I/S、單位勞動成本偏落 後。不要把I/S 當成領先。
SIM-030.core_idea: Leading indicators turn before the cycle; lagging indicators turn after it
SIM-030.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-031.reasoning: Reasoning: Decisions use incremental after-tax cash flows. Financing costs are not put in the project’s cash flows; they sit in WACC (or a project rate built from it). Putting loan interest in Year-1 CF and also discounting at WACC counts the same cost twice. Internally generated cash is not a cheaper source either.

why_wrong.A: Sunk costs are ignored; adding them would be a second error, not a cure.
why_wrong.B: Interest is a cash cost of financing, but the principle is that financing costs are not put in the project CFs.

SIM-031.zh: 借款利息不放進現金流，因為它已經在折現率裡。放進去又用WACC 折現，等於 把債務成本算兩次。
SIM-031.core_idea: Incremental after-tax cash flows only; financing costs sit in the discount rate, not in CF
SIM-031.exam_trap: Putting interest (or a sunk cost) in the NPV cash flows
SIM-031.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-032.reasoning: Reasoning: For mutually exclusive projects, NPV and IRR can rank differently because of size or cash-flow timing. NPV is the theoretically preferred ranking: it is the estimated addition to firm value. Here N adds more value even though M has the higher IRR.

why_wrong.B: IRR can rank a smaller project first; that is not the wealth ranking.
why_wrong.C: Independence would allow both; mutual exclusivity forces a ranking, and NPV is the ranking.

SIM-032.zh: 互斥項目要比誰比較能增加公司價值，那是NPV 的美元，不是IRR 的百分比。 小項目可以IRR 很高、NPV 比較小。
SIM-032.core_idea: For mutually exclusive projects, NPV is the theoretically preferred ranking
SIM-032.study_section: NPV, IRR, and the Other Screens
SIM-032.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-033.reasoning: Reasoning: Target (here, current) market weights: w_d = 50/200 = 0.25, w_e = 0.75. After-tax debt cost = 6% × 0.80 = 4.80%. WACC = 0.25 × 4.80% + 0.75 × 12% = 1.20% + 9.00% = 10.20%. Book weights and pretax r_d are the two Study Book traps. Given: Market D = 50, E = 150; r_d = 6%; r_e = 12%; t = 20%. Asked: WACC. Formula: rWACC = wdrd(1 −t) + were Variables: w_d, w_e = market-value weights; r_d pretax yield; t = tax rate. Why this formula: WACC is the market opportunity cost of replacing the firm’s capital today, with a tax adjustment only on deductible interest. This 10.20% is the project hurdle if the project has the same risk as the firm. Reasonableness check: Must sit between after-tax debt (4.80%) and equity (12%). 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.C: Applies (1 - t) to equity as well as debt: 0.25 × 6% × 0.80 + 0.75 × 12% × 0.80 = 8.40%. Only deductible interest gets the tax adjustment. The stem gives market debt 50 and equity 150; no book weights are supplied.

SIM-033.zh: 權數用市值，不是帳面。債務乘(1-t)，股權不要乘。用帳面權數或忘了稅盾，都 會算錯折現率。
SIM-033.core_idea: WACC uses target market-value weights and after-tax r_d(1 - t)
SIM-033.exam_trap: Using book-value weights, or forgetting r_d(1-t)
SIM-033.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-034.reasoning: Reasoning: Without taxes, capital structure is irrelevant: V_L = V_U. “Debt is cheaper” is not a value argument here: leverage raises r_e so that WACC stays at r_0. V_L = V_U + tD needs corporate tax and no distress. The interior D* needs distress costs.

why_wrong.B: The trade-off formula needs priced distress. The stem shut distress off as well.
why_wrong.C: tD is MM with corporate tax and no distress. The stem shut tax off.

SIM-034.zh: 看到MM，先核對假設。無稅：價值不變。有稅無困境：V_L=V_U+tD。有困 境：內部最優D*。不要把「債務比較便宜」直接做成價值論點。
SIM-034.core_idea: MM without tax: V_L = V_U and WACC is unchanged; do not drop the assumptions
SIM-034.exam_trap: Applying an MM conclusion after dropping its assumptions
SIM-034.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-035.reasoning: Reasoning: Asymmetric information makes outside investors treat a new share issue as a signal that managers think the stock is rich. Internal funds send almost no new signal; debt is weaker; external equity is last. The ranking is not merely “visible versus invisible.”

why_wrong.B: That reverses the information ranking.
why_wrong.C: After-tax cheapness is a WACC/MM point, not the pecking-order ranking.

SIM-035.zh: 融資順位看資訊敏感度：內部盈餘幾乎不發新訊號，借債較弱，發新股最敏感。 不要只背「比較便宜」。
SIM-035.core_idea: Pecking order: internal funds, then debt, then new external equity
SIM-035.exam_trap: — NPV, IRR, and the Other Screens
SIM-035.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-036.reasoning: Reasoning: PI = (PV of future cash flows) / initial outlay = 1 + NPV / outlay = 1 + 29.75 / 200 = 1.149 ≈1.15. Accept if PI > 1, which is the same accept rule as NPV > 0 (and IRR > r for a conventional independent project). Given: Outlay 200; CF 80, 90, 110; r = 10%; NPV = 29.75. Asked: Profitability index. Formula: PI = 1 + NPV initial outlay Variables: NPV already computed at the 10% hurdle. Why this formula: PI restates NPV as a ratio. PI > 1 is the same accept door as NPV > 0. The project returns 1.15 of present-value inflow per 1 of outlay. Reasonableness check: NPV > 0 ⇒PI > 1. IRR on these flows is about 17.8% > 10%. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：CF / NPV 已知：CF0 = -200; C01 = 80; C02 = 90; C03 = 110; I = 10% 求：NPV, then PI = 1 + NPV/200 按鍵： ①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②200 →+/- →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→80 →ENTER (C01) →↓→1 →ENTER (F01) ④↓→90 →ENTER (C02) →↓→1 →ENTER (F02) ⑤↓→ 110 →ENTER (C03) ⑥NPV →10 →ENTER →↓→CPT →29.75 ⑦PI by hand: 1 + 29.75 / 200 = 1.15 結果：NPV = 29.75; PI = 1.15 中文理解：不規則現金流用CF 表。NPV 鍵先輸入折現率再CPT。PI 是比值，計算機不會 直接吐；用1+NPV/投入。

why_wrong.B: Reports NPV / outlay = 0.149 without adding 1.
why_wrong.C: PI = 1 is the NPV = 0 boundary, not this project.

SIM-036.zh: PI 是未來現金流現值除以期初投入，也等於1+NPV/投入。NPV 為正，PI 就大 於1，不是把NPV 比率當成PI。
SIM-036.core_idea: NPV > 0 ⇔IRR > r ⇔PI > 1 for a conventional independent project; indifferent at equality
SIM-036.study_section: NPV, IRR, and the Other Screens
