直接吐；用1+NPV/投入。
SIM-036.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-037.reasoning: Reasoning: The books take the expense now; the return does not. Taxable income is higher this year, so tax is overpaid relative to book expense — a DTA = 600 × 0.30 = 180. Permanent differences never reverse and create no DTA/DTL. Given: Warranty expense 600 this year; not yet deductible on the return; t = 30%. Asked: Deferred tax created. Formula: DTA = 600 × 0.30 Variables: Temporary difference × enacted future tax rate. Why this formula: The extra tax paid now is a prepaid future deduction. Taxes payable exceed tax expense by 180 from this item, other things equal. Reasonableness check: If tax depreciation instead exceeded book depreciation, the sign would be a DTL. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: That is the accelerated-tax-depreciation pattern (tax deduction first).
why_wrong.B: Warranties reverse; they are not tax-exempt interest.

SIM-037.zh: 賬面先認費用、稅務以後才扣→今年先多繳→DTA。不要看到「費用」就選 DTL。
SIM-037.core_idea: Warranty expense now, tax-deductible later, creates a DTA
SIM-037.exam_trap: Reversing which difference creates a DTA
SIM-037.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-038.reasoning: Reasoning: FIFO sends older, cheaper units into COGS, so COGS is lower and newer, costlier units remain in inventory. Profit, taxes, equity, and the current ratio are higher; inventory turnover is lower. IFRS does not permit LIFO.

why_wrong.A: That is LIFO relative to FIFO.
why_wrong.C: FIFO has a smaller COGS numerator and a larger inventory denominator, so turnover is lower.

SIM-038.zh: 物價上漲時，FIFO 把舊的便宜單位送進COGS →利潤與庫存較高、周轉率較 低。LIFO 方向全部相反。
SIM-038.core_idea: Rising prices: FIFO has lower COGS and higher ending inventory than LIFO
SIM-038.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-039.reasoning: Reasoning: Lower of cost or NRV is the IFRS (and non-LIFO U.S. GAAP) rule. IFRS may reverse a write-down only up to the original amount. U.S. GAAP does not reverse inventory writedowns. LIFO/retail U.S. GAAP uses lower of cost or market. Do not copy PPE reversal rules onto inventory.

why_wrong.A: That swaps the frameworks and also mixes PPE-impairment lore into inventory.
why_wrong.B: There is no uncapped OCI inventory reversal in the sources.

SIM-039.zh: IFRS 存貨可用NRV，可以衝回（以原先跌價為限）。U.S. GAAP 存貨不能衝回。 不要把「減值以後可以衝回」套到所有準則。
SIM-039.core_idea: IFRS may reverse an inventory write-down up to the original amount; U.S. GAAP does not
SIM-039.exam_trap: Reversing a U.S. GAAP inventory write-down
SIM-039.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-040.reasoning: Reasoning: IFRS: impaired if carrying amount > recoverable amount. Recoverable amount = max(FV less costs to sell, value in use). The loss is carrying amount minus recoverable amount. Reversal is allowed only up to the pre-impairment carrying amount. U.S. GAAP held-for-use: first undiscounted cash flows, then write to fair value; no reversal.

why_wrong.A: The two-step recoverability test (undiscounted CF, then write to FV) is U.S. GAAP held-for-use.
why_wrong.B: IFRS recoverable amount is the greater of FVLCTS and value in use, not FVLCTS alone.

SIM-040.zh: IFRS 比的是可回收金額：賣淨值與使用價值取高。U.S. GAAP 先用不折現現金 流做可否回收測試。兩套不要對調。
SIM-040.core_idea: IFRS impairment: carrying amount versus recoverable amount (greater of FVLCTS and value in use)
SIM-040.study_section: Impairment and Held-for-Sale ｜減損與待出售
SIM-040.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-041.reasoning: Reasoning: IFRS 9 amortized cost is only for debt that meets the contractual-cash-flow tests and is held to collect. Equity is not amortized cost. Default for equity is FVTPL. Eligible non-trading equity may use an irrevocable FVOCI election; accumulated OCI is not recycled on disposal.

why_wrong.B: Equity is not amortized cost under IFRS 9 or U.S. GAAP.
why_wrong.C: IFRS FVOCI equity does not recycle OCI to P/L on disposal. That recycling is not the IFRS equity election.

SIM-041.zh: 未上市股票不能因為「公允價值不好估」就進amortized cost。權益預設FVTPL； 若一開始做了不可撤銷FVOCI，處分時OCI 不轉回損益。
SIM-041.core_idea: IFRS 9 amortized cost is only for qualifying hold-to-collect debt; equity is not amortized cost
SIM-041.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-042.reasoning: Reasoning: IFRS 16 uses a single on-balance-sheet lessee model: normally ROU asset and lease liability at PV of payments. Exemptions: short-term and low-value. Subsequent expense resembles finance (interest + amortization; principal in CFF). U.S. GAAP lessees still label operating vs finance.

why_wrong.A: IFRS 16 is a single on-balance-sheet lessee model, not the old operating offbalance-sheet treatment.
why_wrong.B: The sources do not say “term > 1 year ⇒finance lease.” Short-term (generally 12 months or less) and low-value assets can be exempted.

SIM-042.zh: IFRS 16 承租人是單一上表：ROU 資產+ 負債，不是把超過一年的合約一律叫做 finance lease。短期與低價值可以豁免。
SIM-042.core_idea: IFRS 16: single on-balance-sheet lessee model (ROU asset and lease liability)
SIM-042.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-043.reasoning: Reasoning: Equity-settled awards are measured at grant-date fair value and recognized ratably over the service period. Subsequent share-price moves do not remeasure the equity award. Cashsettled SARs and phantom stock create a liability that is remeasured each period.

why_wrong.A: No cash at grant does not mean no expense; earnings still fall as the grant-date FV is amortized.
why_wrong.C: Remeasurement through P/L is the cash-settled (liability) model.

SIM-043.zh: 權益交割：grant-date 公允價值攤提，後來股價漲跌不再重估。現金交割才每期重 估進損益。不要把所有SBC 都背成「股價無關」或「每期重估」。
SIM-043.core_idea: Equity-settled awards use grant-date FV and are not remeasured for later share-price moves
SIM-043.study_section: Pensions and Share-Based Compensation ｜退休金與股份基礎酬勞
SIM-043.exam_trap: Remeasuring an equity-settled award for later price moves
SIM-043.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-044.reasoning: Reasoning: U.S. GAAP: interest and dividends received, and interest paid, are CFO; dividends paid are CFF. IFRS: interest paid may be CFO or CFF; interest received may be CFO or CFI; dividends received may be CFO or CFI; dividends paid may be CFO or CFF. Interest paid is not classified as CFI.

why_wrong.B: U.S. GAAP is relatively fixed (interest paid = CFO). IFRS is flexible: interest paid may be CFO or CFF.
why_wrong.C: Interest paid is not a CFI item in this teaching convention.

SIM-044.zh: IFRS 利息支出可以進CFO 或CFF，不能進CFI。U.S. GAAP 利息支出固定在 CFO。不要把「資本成本」聯想到CFI。
SIM-044.core_idea: IFRS: interest paid may be CFO or CFF, not CFI; U.S. GAAP: interest paid is CFO
SIM-044.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
SIM-044.exam_trap: Classifying IFRS interest paid as CFI
SIM-044.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-045.reasoning: Reasoning: Sales ↑→AR and inventory ↑→WC investment ↑→CFO may trail NI growth. That is the modeling identity in the sources. Maintenance capex keeps capacity; growth capex expands it. Do not treat last year’s numbers times a growth rate as a finished model.

why_wrong.A: Indirect CFO also adjusts operating WC, not only depreciation.
why_wrong.B: Collections lag when AR rises; sales ̸= cash.

SIM-045.zh: 銷貨上去，應收和存貨通常也上去，營運資金投資會吃掉現金，所以CFO 可以比 損益表的成長慢。
SIM-045.core_idea: Sales growth that lifts AR and inventory can make CFO trail NI growth
SIM-045.study_section: Financial Statement Modeling ｜財務報表建模
SIM-045.exam_trap: Reading NI growth as proof of matching CFO growth
SIM-045.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-046.reasoning: Reasoning: Income tax expense = taxes payable + ∆DTL - ∆DTA. Accelerated tax depreciation: taxable income is lower, taxes payable are lower than tax expense, and a DTL of 2,500 × 0.20 = 500 is born. Extra tax expense relative to the books is a DTL, not a prepaid tax. Given: Book dep 1,500; tax dep 4,000; t = 20%; no other differences. Asked: Tax expense versus taxes payable. Formula: DTL = (4,000 −1,500) × 0.20 Variables: Taxable temporary difference × tax rate. Why this formula: Tax took more deduction now, so future taxable income will be higher. The cash tax bill is the payable; the income-statement provision includes the DTL buildup. Reasonableness check: Warranty (books first) would have the opposite sign: a DTA. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
SIM-046.steps: ①Difference = 2,500. ②DTL = 500. ③Tax expense exceeds taxes payable by 500.
SIM-046.final_answer: Tax expense is 500 higher than taxes payable

why_wrong.A: The temporary difference does not make this year’s expense equal the payable; deferred tax is the wedge.
why_wrong.B: Extra tax depreciation this year lowers taxes payable and creates a DTL, not a DTA.

SIM-046.zh: 稅務折舊快→今年少繳→DTL。Taxes payable 是現在欠稅局；tax expense 還 要加上未來要補的。不要把「費用比較多」想成DTA。
SIM-046.core_idea: Taxes payable is the tax-return bill; tax expense also includes net deferred-tax changes
SIM-046.exam_trap: Treating taxes payable as tax expense, or reversing DTA vs DTL
SIM-046.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-047.reasoning: Reasoning: CCC = DOH + DSO - DPO = 48 + 36 - 30 = 54 days. The operating cycle is DOH + DSO = 84. CCC is how long cash is tied up after suppliers have been used as financing. Given: DOH = 48; DSO = 36; DPO = 30. Asked: Cash conversion cycle. Formula: CCC = 48 + 36 −30 Variables: DOH from inventory turnover; DSO from receivables; DPO from payables. Why this formula: Inventory and receivables tie up cash; payables finance that cycle. Cash is committed for 54 days on average. Reasonableness check: CCC must be shorter than the operating cycle when DPO > 0. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Adds DPO instead of subtracting it (the operating cycle, 84, plus DPO).
why_wrong.C: Subtracts DSO as well as DPO: 48 - 36 - 30 = -18, then reports 18.

SIM-047.zh: CCC 是進貨到收回現金、再扣掉還供應商的天數。DOH+DSO 是營運週期；再減 DPO 才是現金轉換。
SIM-047.study_section: Liquidity and the Cash Conversion Cycle ｜現金轉換循環
SIM-047.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-048.reasoning: Reasoning: When interest paid was classified in CFO, FCFF = CFO + Interest(1 - t) - FCInv = 200 + 40 × 0.75 - 70 = 160. If IFRS had classified interest paid as CFF, do not add Interest(1 - t) back — it was not deducted from CFO. Given: CFO = 200 (interest paid in CFO); interest = 40; t = 25%; FCInv = 70. Asked: FCFF. Formula: FCFF = 200 + 40(1 −0.25) −70 Variables: CFO already after interest; add back the after-tax interest claim of lenders. Why this formula: FCFF is cash available to debt and equity after operating costs and reinvestment. Interest was deducted in CFO, so add it back after tax. Lenders’ after-tax coupon is restored so the measure is before capital-structure claims. Reasonableness check: If interest had been CFF, FCFF would be 200 - 70 = 130. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Forgets the after-tax interest add-back: 200 - 70 = 130.
why_wrong.B: Subtracts only the tax on interest (200 - 10 = 190) instead of adding back Interest(1 - t) and subtracting FCInv.

SIM-048.zh: 利息已在CFO 裡扣過，算FCFF 要加回稅後利息再扣capex。漏加回會得到 130。只扣利息稅盾會得到190。
SIM-048.core_idea: FCFF = CFO + Interest(1 - t) - FCInv when interest paid was in CFO
SIM-048.study_section: Cash Flows and How the Statements Connect ｜現金流量與報表勾稽
SIM-048.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-049.reasoning: Reasoning: Dealers buy at the bid and sell at the ask. The investor therefore buys at the ask and sells at the bid. Ask - bid is the cost of trading. The midpoint is not the taker’s fill.

why_wrong.A: The bid is the dealer’s buying price (investor sells there), not the investor’s buying price.
why_wrong.C: Posted quotes are bid and ask, not a midpoint for a market taker.

SIM-049.zh: 投資人買進用ask、賣出拿bid。中間的spread 是交易成本，不是市場多給你的報 酬。
SIM-049.core_idea: The investor buys at the ask and sells at the bid; the spread is the cost of trading
SIM-049.study_section: The quote: bid, ask, and who pays ｜報價：買價、賣價與誰付出成本
SIM-049.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-050.reasoning: Reasoning: Gordon discounts the cash the buyer will receive: V0 = D0(1 + g) / (r - g) = 1.80 × Given: D0 = 1.80 just paid; g = 6%; r = 12%. Asked: Gordon (constant-growth) value. Formula: V0 = 1.80 × 1.06 0.12 −0.06 Variables: D1 = first dividend the buyer receives; r > g required. Why this formula: The infinite growing perpetuity starts at next year’s cash flow. Using the dividend already gone understates value by one growth step. Reasonableness check: (1.12)(31.80) - 1.908 = 33.71, the implied P1, and 33.71 / 31.80 - 1 = 6% price growth, matching g. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Puts D0 in the numerator: 1.80 / (0.12 - 0.06) = 30.00.
why_wrong.C: Uses D1 / r and drops g in the denominator: 1.908 / 0.12 = 15.90.

SIM-050.zh: 題幹的1.80 是剛發完的D0。分子是買進之後才會拿到的D1=1.908，再除以r-g。
SIM-050.core_idea: Gordon numerator is D1 = D0(1 + g), not the dividend just paid
SIM-050.study_section: Dividend discount models ｜股利折現模型
SIM-050.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-051.reasoning: Reasoning: FCFE is a capacity to pay dividends and repurchase shares, not a record of the dividend actually paid. Notes treat FCFE as the preferred present-value model for a non-payer. Discount FCFE at the cost of equity.

why_wrong.B: Gordon can be used only if the first future dividend is forecast, and that forecast is fragile; DCF is not ruled out. FCFE is the preferred PV route for a non-payer.
why_wrong.C: A withheld dividend is not proof of zero value.

SIM-051.zh: 公司可以FCFE 很大卻一毛股息都不發。沒有股息̸= 權益沒有價值。對非發放公 司，優先折FCFE。
SIM-051.core_idea: FCFE is cash available to common shareholders, not cash currently paid; preferred PV model for a non-payer
SIM-051.study_section: Free cash flow to equity ｜股東自由現金流
SIM-051.exam_trap: Treating D0 = 0 as proof that equity is worth zero
SIM-051.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-052.reasoning: Reasoning: A market multiple is a comparable. A multiple from a model (Gordon) is a justified (fundamental) multiple. The two can disagree: a stock can look cheap versus a benchmark and expensive versus its own intrinsic value, or the reverse. Interpret a richer multiple with growth, ROE, risk, and accounting differences.

why_wrong.A: A screen versus peers is a relative reading, not a fundamental overvaluation proof.
why_wrong.C: A high multiple can mean richer, not cheaper; growth is an interpretation of the multiple, not automatic undervaluation.

SIM-052.zh: 倍數比較高只表示相對比較貴，不是已經證明高於內含價值。合理乘數（模型） 和市場乘數（可比）可以不一致。
SIM-052.core_idea: A richer market multiple is not by itself proof of overvaluation
SIM-052.exam_trap: Treating a high peer multiple as proof of overvaluation
SIM-052.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-053.reasoning: Reasoning: D1 = 2.30, D2 = 2.645, D3 = 2.77725. V2 = 2.77725 / (0.11 - 0.05) = 46.29. V0 = 2.30/1.11 + (2.645 + 46.29)/1.112 = 2.072 + 48.935 / 1.2321 = 41.79. Terminal value sits with D2, not today. Given: D0 = 2.00 paid; g_S = 15% for 2 years; g_L = 5%; r = 11%. Asked: Two-stage DDM value today. Formula: V0 = 2.30 1.112 Variables: D1, D2 from g_S; D3 = D2(1 + g_L); V2 is a Gordon value at t = 2. Why this formula: High-growth cash is discounted year by year; the first long-term dividend prices the terminal Gordon value at the last high-growth date. Most of today’s value is the terminal price, but that price is two years away. Reasonableness check: V2 discounted two years is 46.29 / 1.2321 ≈37.57, plus PV of D1 and D2 ≈4.22, totals 41.79. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：CF / NPV 已知：C01 = 2.30; C02 = 2.645 + 46.29 = 48.935; I = 11%; CF0 = 0 求：V0 as NPV 按鍵： ①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②0 →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→2.30 →ENTER (C01) ④↓→ 1 →ENTER (F01) ⑤↓→48.935 →ENTER (C02) ⑥NPV →11 →ENTER →↓→CPT 結果：NPV = 41.79 中文理解：CF0 打0，因為是在算這串未來現金今天值多少，不是再扣一次買價。V2 和D2 放同一期。

why_wrong.A: Reports V2 = D3/(r - g_L) = 46.29 as if it were today’s price.
why_wrong.C: Applies Gordon to D1 at the long-term rate: 2.30 / (0.11 - 0.05) = 38.33, skipping the two-stage path.

SIM-053.zh: 終值V2 必須和D2 加在同一期再一起折現。不要把D3/(r-g_L) 當成今天的股 價。
SIM-053.core_idea: Two-stage DDM: discount high-growth dividends and Vn = D_n+1/(r - g_L) at the last highgrowth date
SIM-053.study_section: Dividend discount models ｜股利折現模型
SIM-053.formula:
Vn = Dn+1/(r −gL),
V0 = ∑Dt/(1 + r)t + Vn/(1 + r)n
SIM-053.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：CF / NPV
已知：C01 = 2.30; C02 = 2.645 + 46.29 = 48.935; I = 11%; CF0 = 0
求：V0 as NPV
按鍵：
①CF →2nd →CLR WORK ②0 →ENTER (CF0) ③↓→2.30 →ENTER (C01) ④↓→
1 →ENTER (F01) ⑤↓→48.935 →ENTER (C02) ⑥NPV →11 →ENTER →↓→CPT
結果：NPV = 41.79
中文理解：CF0 打0，因為是在算這串未來現金今天值多少，不是再扣一次買價。V2 和D2
放同一期。
SIM-053.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-054.reasoning: Reasoning: Expected annual dividend = 0.05 × 40 = 2.00. For preferred, D0 = D1 (no growth). V0 = 2.00 / 0.08 = 25.00. The discount rate is the required return on similar preferred, not the quoted percentage. Given: 5% of 40 par; no maturity; r = 8%. Asked: Preferred value. Formula: V0 = 2.00/0.08 Variables: D = quoted percentage × par; r = required return on similar preferred. Why this formula: A no-growth perpetual dividend is PMT / r_s per payment period. The preferred is below par because the market required return exceeds the quoted dividend rate. Reasonableness check: If r equaled 5%, value would be par. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports par, as if the coupon rate were the discount rate.
why_wrong.B: Inverts the preferred formula as V = Par × r / coupon rate = 40 × 0.08 / 0.05 = 64. The stem supplies par 40, a 5% dividend, and required return 8%; the value is D/r = 2.00/0.08 = 25.00. No 4% input exists.

SIM-054.zh: 特別股固定股息、沒到期，就是永續年金。分子是每年股息2，分母是同類特別股 要求報酬8%，不是票面5%。
SIM-054.core_idea: A fixed preferred dividend with no maturity is a perpetuity V = D / r
SIM-054.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-055.reasoning: Reasoning: EV is the cost of taking over the firm: MV of outstanding securities minus cash and short-term investments, because the buyer assumes the claims but receives the cash. EV = 250 + 40 + 90 - 20 = 360. Given: MV common 250; preferred 40; debt 90; cash 20. Asked: Enterprise value. Formula: EV = 250 + 40 + 90 −20 Variables: Market values of claims minus cash the buyer receives. Why this formula: EV is a capital-structure-neutral takeover cost. EV/EBITDA then compares firms with different leverage. Reasonableness check: Common equity backed out of EV would be 360 - 40 - 90 + 20 = 250. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Adds cash instead of subtracting it: 250 + 40 + 90 + 20 = 400.
why_wrong.C: Forgets to subtract cash: 250 + 40 + 90 = 380. EV is the cost of taking over the claims, net of cash received.

SIM-055.zh: EV 是買下整家公司的代價：普通股+ 特別股+ 債，再扣掉現金（買方會拿到現 金）。不要漏特別股，也不要把現金加進去。
SIM-055.core_idea: EV = MV common + MV preferred + MV debt - cash and investments
SIM-055.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-056.reasoning: Reasoning: The forms nest. Weak: prices reflect market data →no edge from technical analysis. Semistrong: also public information →no abnormal returns from fundamental analysis after costs. If weak holds and semistrong fails, estimating intrinsic value from public information can have value.

why_wrong.A: Using MNPI violates II(A) and is not a “form of efficiency” trading implication the sources recommend. Strong form is the statement that even private information is already in the price.
why_wrong.B: Weak form already says market data (prices and volume) are in the price, so technical analysis has no abnormal edge.

SIM-056.zh: 弱式成立：技術分析沒有超額優勢。半強式若還沒成立：用公開財報估內含價值 仍可能有價值。不要把內線交易當成效率形式的「策略」。
SIM-056.core_idea: Weak form: prices reflect market data, so technical analysis has no abnormal edge
SIM-056.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-057.reasoning: Reasoning: A price-weighted index is an average of prices after a divisor. A split would jump the average unless the divisor is changed so the index value is unchanged. Market-cap weights use Q × P; a split scales Q up and P down, so value weights and the index need no divisor reset.

why_wrong.A: That reverses the two methods.
why_wrong.B: The split divisor rule is the price-weighted rule, not a universal rule.

SIM-057.zh: 價格加權遇到分割要改除數，否則指數會假跌。市值加權的股數與價格對沖，不 必為分割改除數。
SIM-057.core_idea: A split requires a price-weighted divisor reset; market-cap weights do not need that reset
SIM-057.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-058.reasoning: Reasoning: A limit order will not buy above (or sell below) the limit: price is protected, the fill is not. A stop does the opposite: it starts a market order once a price condition is met. A market order takes the best available price now.

why_wrong.A: A stop starts trading once the trigger is hit and then becomes a market order; the stop price is not a guaranteed fill. A buy stop sits above the current price.
why_wrong.B: A market order seeks immediate execution and does not protect the price.

SIM-058.zh: Limit 是價格到線就停，可能成交不了。Stop 是到線才開始交易，觸發後變市價 單，不保證成交價。
SIM-058.core_idea: A limit order protects price, not execution; a stop becomes a market order and does not guarantee fill price
SIM-058.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-059.reasoning: Reasoning: Interpolate the 5-year required yield: 3.80% + ½(4.40% - 3.80%) = 4.10%. Then discount this bond’s own cash flows at 4.10%: N = 5, PMT = 3.5, FV = 100, I/Y = 4.10 →PV ≈ 97.34. Do not average the comparables’ prices. Given: 4-year YTM 3.80%; 6-year YTM 4.40%; subject is 5-year 3.5% annual-pay, par 100. Asked: Matrix price. Formula: r = 0.041, PV = ∑ t=1 3.5/(1.041)t + 100/(1.041)5 Variables: Linear interpolation in yield space; then TVM on the subject coupon. Why this formula: Illiquid bonds are priced off a comparable required yield, not off an average price. Coupon 3.5% < YTM 4.10%, so the bond prices at a discount. Reasonableness check: A 3.5% coupon at 3.5% YTM would be par; 4.10% must pull price below 100. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：TVM 已知：N = 5; I/Y = 4.10; PMT = 3.5; FV = 100; P/Y = 1 求：PV 按鍵： ①2nd →CLR TVM ②5 →N ③4.10 →I/Y ④3.5 →PMT ⑤100 →FV ⑥CPT →PV 結果：PV = -97.34 (price 97.34) 中文理解：先插殖利率，再折這張券。P/Y=1。PV 負號是買方付出；價格報97.34。

why_wrong.A: Uses a perpetuity / current-yield shortcut: 3.50 / 0.0410 = 85.36585 ≈85.37, omitting repayment of 100 par that matrix pricing still discounts at the interpolated 4.10%.
why_wrong.B: Par would require the coupon to equal the interpolated yield.

SIM-059.zh: Matrix pricing 先向長得像的券借一個殖利率，再折這張券自己的現金流。不是去 平均可比券的價格。
SIM-059.core_idea: Estimate the required yield from comparables, then discount the subject bond’s own cash flows
SIM-059.formula: interpolated YTM, then PV = ∑PMT/(1 + r)t + FV/(1 + r)N
SIM-059.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：TVM
已知：N = 5; I/Y = 4.10; PMT = 3.5; FV = 100; P/Y = 1
求：PV
按鍵：
①2nd →CLR TVM ②5 →N ③4.10 →I/Y ④3.5 →PMT ⑤100 →FV ⑥CPT →PV
結果：PV = -97.34 (price 97.34)
中文理解：先插殖利率，再折這張券。P/Y=1。PV 負號是買方付出；價格報97.34。
SIM-059.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-060.reasoning: Reasoning: DR = (3/100) × (360/120) = 9.00%. AOR = (3/97) × (365/120) = 9.41%. DR uses face and 360 days, so it understates the rate of return. Compare quotes on the same add-on / 365 basis unless the question specifies otherwise. Given: Face 100; price 97; 120 days; DR on 360; AOR/BEY on 365. Asked: (DR, add-on / BEY). Formula: DR = 100 × 360 120, AOR = 3 97 × 365 Variables: Interest = 3; DR denominator is FV; AOR denominator is PV. Why this formula: The two quotes annualize the same cash gap on different bases. Same instrument, same cash, two quotes. The 9.00% is not “the” return. Reasonableness check: AOR > DR whenever PV < FV and 365 > 360. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Treats the discount quote as already the earned return.
why_wrong.B: Puts PV in the DR denominator: (3/97)×(360/120) = 9.28%, which is a 360-day add-on, not DR.

SIM-060.zh: Discount yield 的分母是面額、一年當360 天，會低估真實報酬。AOR/BEY 改用 投入本金和365 天。不要把印出來的T-bill 利率當成投資人報酬。
SIM-060.core_idea: Bank discount yield uses face and a 360-day year and understates the investor’s return
SIM-060.study_section: Money-market quotes: discount versus add-on ｜貨幣市場報價：貼現與加碼
SIM-060.formula:
DR = FV−PV
FV
× 360
days, AOR = FV−PV
PV
× 365
days
SIM-060.exam_trap: Treating a bank discount yield as the investor’s return
SIM-060.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-061.reasoning: Reasoning: MacDur is the PV-weighted average wait for the cash flows. Higher coupon or higher YTM shifts weights forward, so duration falls. Longer maturity usually raises duration. The long-discount exception is written so the maturity rule is not treated as absolute.

why_wrong.A: Longer maturity usually raises duration, but some long, low-coupon discount bonds are the stated exception.
why_wrong.C: Higher coupon feels like more rate exposure; it is the opposite: more value arrives sooner.

SIM-061.zh: 票息或殖利率上升，現值權重往近期移，MacDur 下降。到期日變長通常讓 duration 上升，但長期低票息折價債是例外。
SIM-061.core_idea: Higher coupon or higher YTM lowers MacDur; longer maturity usually raises it
SIM-061.exam_trap: Reversing the coupon, yield, or maturity effect on duration
SIM-061.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-062.reasoning: Reasoning: %∆PV ≈-AnnModDur × ∆y + ½ × AnnConv × (∆y)2 = -4.80 × 0.01 + 0.5 × 28 × 0.0001 = -0.0480 + 0.0014 = -4.66%. For an option-free bond the convexity adjustment is positive, so duration-only overstates the loss when yields rise and understates the gain when yields fall. Do not treat every embedded option as negative convexity. Given: AnnModDur = 4.80; AnnConv = 28; ∆y = +0.01 (decimal). Asked: Percentage price change with convexity. Formula: %∆PV = −4.80 × 0.01 + 1 2 × 28 × (0.01)2 Variables: Use decimal yields. Convexity is a whole number in this units convention. Why this formula: Duration is the slope; convexity is the curvature term that is always positive for an option-free bond. The bond still falls when yields rise; positive convexity just trims the loss versus the tangent. Reasonableness check: A 100 bp decline would be +4.80% + 0.14% = +4.94%, larger than the rise-side loss. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Duration only: -4.80 × 0.01 = -4.80%, dropping the +0.14% convexity term.
why_wrong.C: Drops the minus on the duration term, as if a yield rise raised price.

SIM-062.zh: Option-free 正凸性：同幅度降息的漲幅大於升息的跌幅。大的∆y 只乘duration 等於用切線代替曲線。這裡凸性把-4.80% 修成-4.66%。
SIM-062.core_idea: Option-free bonds have positive convexity; duration-only overstates the loss when yields rise
SIM-062.exam_trap: Signing convexity, or dropping it on a large yield move
SIM-062.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-063.reasoning: Reasoning: LGD rate = 1 - 0.60 = 40%. Expected-loss rate = PD × LGD rate = 0.03 × 0.40 = 1.20%. Do not confuse the LGD rate with a dollar LGD amount. An observed credit spread need not equal this EL rate unless the question says to use expected loss as the required compensation. Given: PD = 3%; recovery = 60%. Asked: Expected-loss rate. Formula: 0.03 × (1 −0.60) Variables: LGD rate is a percentage of exposure, not a money amount. Why this formula: EL rate is the probability-weighted fraction of par lost, before exposure scaling. 80 bp of a 3% default chance is recovered; 120 bp is the expected loss rate. Reasonableness check: EL rate must be less than PD if recovery is positive. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports PD as if LGD were 100%.
why_wrong.B: Uses PD × recovery: 3% × 60% = 1.80%.

SIM-063.zh: LGD rate = 1 - 回收率。預期損失率= PD × LGD rate。3% × 40% = 1.20%。 不要乘回收率，也不要把PD 當成EL。
SIM-063.core_idea: Expected-loss rate = PD × LGD rate; LGD rate = 1 - recovery
SIM-063.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-064.reasoning: Reasoning: Credit-loss priority: junior / subordinate tranches generally absorb losses before senior tranches. Principal / prepayment waterfall: sequential-pay principal usually retires the senior sequential class first. Junior losses first ̸= junior prepayments first.

why_wrong.B: That swaps both waterfalls.
why_wrong.C: Loss priority is not the same waterfall as the principal / prepayment waterfall.

SIM-064.zh: 「誰先承受損失」和「誰先拿本金／提前還款」是兩條瀑布。Junior 先虧，不等于 junior 先拿到提前還款。
SIM-064.core_idea: Junior tranches absorb credit losses first; sequential-pay principal retires the senior class first
SIM-064.study_section: Mortgage-backed and other ABS ｜房貸擔保與其他資產證券化
SIM-064.exam_trap: Confusing who takes losses first with who receives prepayments first
SIM-064.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-065.reasoning: Reasoning: Coupon 6% > YTM 5%, so the bond is a premium. PV = 6/1.05 + …+ 106/1.055 = 104.33. Holding YTM fixed, the premium is pulled to par as maturity approaches. Given: Annual-pay; N = 5; coupon 6; YTM 5%; par 100; no accrued interest. Asked: Flat price. Formula: PV = ∑ t=1 6/(1.05)t + 100/(1.05)5 Variables: r = YTM per coupon period. Why this formula: The market discount rate is the IRR that sets PV of remaining cash equal to price. You pay 104.33 today to receive 6 a year and 100 at maturity, earning 5%. Reasonableness check: Discount the 6% coupon at 6% and the price is par. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：TVM 已知：N = 5; I/Y = 5; PMT = 6; FV = 100; P/Y = 1; END 求：PV 按鍵： ①2nd →CLR TVM ②5 →N ③5 →I/Y ④6 →PMT ⑤100 →FV ⑥CPT →PV 結果：PV = -104.33 (price 104.33) 中文理解：買債是現金流出，PV 打出來是負號；價格報正的104.33。PMT 與FV 是之後要 收的，用正號。
SIM-065.steps: ①Premium because 6 > 5. ②TVM: N = 5, I/Y = 5, PMT = 6, FV = 100 →PV = -104.33.

why_wrong.A: Swaps the rates (5% coupon at 6% YTM), the discount case.
why_wrong.C: Par requires coupon = YTM.

SIM-065.zh: 票息高於YTM 是溢價。半年度付息時N 加倍、I/Y 與PMT 改成半年。這裡是 年付息，P/Y=1。
SIM-065.core_idea: Price is the PV of remaining coupons and principal at the periodic YTM
SIM-065.study_section: Price is discounted cash flow ｜價格即折現現金流
SIM-065.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：TVM
已知：N = 5; I/Y = 5; PMT = 6; FV = 100; P/Y = 1; END
求：PV
按鍵：
①2nd →CLR TVM ②5 →N ③5 →I/Y ④6 →PMT ⑤100 →FV ⑥CPT →PV
結果：PV = -104.33 (price 104.33)
中文理解：買債是現金流出，PV 打出來是負號；價格報正的104.33。PMT 與FV 是之後要
收的，用正號。
SIM-065.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-066.reasoning: Reasoning: Duration gap = MacDur - investment horizon. Horizon > MacDur →negative gap →reinvestment dominates; the danger is a fall in yields (coupons grow more slowly over the extra years). Horizon < MacDur →positive gap →price risk; the danger is a rise in yields.

why_wrong.A: Immunization for that shift needs a zero gap, not merely “has a duration.”
why_wrong.C: Gap = MacDur - horizon = 5 - 8 = -3, not positive. Price risk dominates when horizon < MacDur.

SIM-066.zh: Gap = MacDur - 投資期間。期間比MacDur 長，多出來的年份要再投資，怕的 是殖利率下跌。有duration ̸= 已經免疫。
SIM-066.core_idea: Duration gap = MacDur - horizon; gap < 0 means reinvestment risk dominates
SIM-066.exam_trap: Flipping the sign of the duration gap
SIM-066.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-067.reasoning: Reasoning: OAS = Z-spread minus the embedded option’s value in basis points per year. For a callable, the call hurts the holder, so OAS < Z. For a putable, OAS > Z. OAS is the spread left after removing the option — credit / liquidity, not another YTM.

why_wrong.A: The call is valuable to the issuer, not the holder. Putable is the case OAS > Z.
why_wrong.B: OAS is not a restated YTM; it is Z minus the option’s annual bp value.

SIM-067.zh: 從Z-spread 扣掉嵌入選擇權每年值多少個bp。Callable：OAS < Z。Putable： OAS > Z。不要把OAS 再算成一次YTM。
SIM-067.core_idea: OAS = Z-spread minus the embedded option’s value in bp; callable OAS < Z
SIM-067.study_section: Yield measures and spreads ｜殖利率衡量與利差
SIM-067.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-068.reasoning: Reasoning: (1.04)3 = (1.035)2 × (1 + 2y1y) ⇒2y1y = (1.04)3 / (1.035)2 - 1 = 5.007% ≈5.01%. The first number is when the loan starts; the second is tenor. The 3 × Z3 - 2 × Z2 approximation is a check, not the exam formula. Given: Z2 = 3.50%; Z3 = 4.00%; annual effective zeros. Asked: 2y1y implied forward. Formula: (1.04)3 = (1.035)2(1 + 2y1y) Variables: A = 2, B = 3, B - A = 1. Why this formula: Chaining a 2-year zero and a 1-year forward must reproduce the 3-year zero. The curve is upward-sloping, so the forward lies above both spots. Reasonableness check: On an upward-sloping curve, par < spot < forward. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports the 3-year spot.
why_wrong.C: Uses the linear approximation 3 × 4.00% - 2 × 3.50% = 5.00% as if it were the exact 2y1y. The exam formula is (1.04)3 / (1.035)2 - 1 ≈5.01%. The stem has no 5.5% input.

SIM-068.zh: 遠期是兩條零息之間的損益兩平再投資利率。2y1y 是兩年後開始、為期一年。不 要直接報長期spot，也不要把近似當公式。
SIM-068.core_idea: A forward is the break-even reinvestment rate linking two zeros
SIM-068.study_section: Spot, Par, and Forward ｜即期、平價與遠期利率
SIM-068.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-069.reasoning: Reasoning: PV^full = PV^flat + AI, and AI = (t/T) × PMT. Corporate AI typically uses 30/360; government bonds typically use actual/actual. On a reset date with no AI, flat equals full.

why_wrong.A: The buyer pays the coupon’s accrued slice plus the flat price, not AI alone.
why_wrong.B: The quoted price strips AI out; it is not what the buyer invoices.

SIM-069.zh: 成交發票是全價= 淨價+ 應計利息。報價常是淨價。不要把淨價當成已經含息。
SIM-069.core_idea: Full price = flat price + accrued interest; AI = (t/T) × PMT
SIM-069.study_section: Flat price, full price, accrued interest ｜淨價、全價與應計利息
SIM-069.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-070.reasoning: Reasoning: General obligation bonds are backed by the issuer’s tax base. Revenue bonds are repaid from a specified project. Relative to the same issuer’s GO bonds, project-only revenue bonds most likely have higher credit risk.

why_wrong.B: The issuer label is not enough; the repayment source differs.
why_wrong.C: Municipals can default; a project revenue pledge is not a general tax pledge.

SIM-070.zh: GO 靠稅基；收益債靠專案現金。同一發行人，只靠過路費的券信用風險通常比較 高。
SIM-070.core_idea: Revenue bonds depend on the project, not the tax base, so credit risk is typically higher than GO
SIM-070.study_section: General obligation versus revenue ｜一般義務債券與收益債券
SIM-070.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-071.reasoning: Reasoning: Hedgers go short the derivative when that instrument’s financial risk is positively correlated with the risk they already bear. Inventory is a long wheat exposure. The hedge is short futures. The test is correlation with the exposure you already have, not whether the commodity appears in production.

why_wrong.A: “Uses wheat” is the right hedge only if the firm is not yet long wheat — for example, it must buy later and holds no inventory.
why_wrong.C: The existing exposure is long wheat (inventory). Adding a long wheat futures increases that exposure.

SIM-071.zh: 已經持有庫存，風險是「小麥跌、庫存跌」，對沖必須是short futures。不要看到 加工業就直覺去long。
SIM-071.core_idea: Hedge the opposite side of the exposure you already have
SIM-071.exam_trap: Hedging by taking the same side as the business
SIM-071.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-072.reasoning: Reasoning: Payoff = max(0, 46 - 40) = 6. Profit = 6 - 3 = 3. The long-call breakeven is X + c0 = 43, not X. At 46 the call is in the money by 6 and still has to recover the 3 premium. Given: Long call; X = 40; c0 = 3; ST = 46. Asked: Profit (not payoff). Formula: Π = max(0, 46 −40) −3 Variables: Payoff is the exercise decision; profit nets the sunk premium. Why this formula: The premium is a cash outflow already paid by the long. ST = 43 would be zero profit; ST = 40 would be payoff 0 and profit -3. Reasonableness check: Short call profit would be the opposite, +3 - 6 = -3. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports the premium as if the call expired worthless.
why_wrong.B: This is the payoff max(0, 46 - 40) = 6, not profit.

SIM-072.zh: Payoff 只問行權價差；profit 還要減已付權利金。Long call 損益兩平是X+c0，不 是執行價。
SIM-072.core_idea: Payoff is exercise value; profit subtracts the premium paid
SIM-072.study_section: Payoff versus profit ｜到期損益與利潤
SIM-072.exam_trap: Reporting payoff as if it were profit
SIM-072.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-073.reasoning: Reasoning: Intrinsic / exercise value is the amount from immediate exercise: max(0, S - X) = max(0, 50 - 48) = 2. Do not call S - PV(X) the ordinary exercise value. For European options, PV(X) belongs to the price lower bound, not to intrinsic value.

why_wrong.A: Uses S - PV(X) = 4, the no-arbitrage lower-bound ingredient, not ordinary exercise value.
why_wrong.C: Reports the spot as if intrinsic were the share price.

SIM-073.zh: 立刻行權能拿多少，才叫intrinsic：max(0,S-X)=2。S-PV(X) 是歐式下限，不是 ordinary exercise value。
SIM-073.core_idea: Intrinsic value is max(0, S - X), not S - PV(X)
SIM-073.study_section: Moneyness, exercise value, time value ｜價內外、行使價值與時間價值
SIM-073.exam_trap: Calling S-PV(X) the call’s exercise value
SIM-073.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-074.reasoning: Reasoning: A long put has negative delta and benefits from price declines, but the payoff is max(0, X - ST) - p0: nonlinear and floored. A short stock’s loss is not capped if the price rises. Long put ̸= short the underlying; short put ̸= long the underlying.

why_wrong.A: A long put is the right to sell, not a long stock.
why_wrong.C: Directional similarity is not payoff identity.

SIM-074.zh: 方向感相似̸= payoff 相同。Long put 虧最多是權利金；空股票上漲虧損沒有上 限。
SIM-074.core_idea: A long put has negative delta but is not equivalent to a short stock
SIM-074.exam_trap: Equating long put with short the underlying
SIM-074.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-075.reasoning: Reasoning: No extra income or storage: F0(T) = S0(1 + r)^T = 80 × 1.05 = 84.00. The contract’s value is zero at initiation; the contracted price is not. If the quoted forward were above 84, sell the forward and buy the asset with borrowed cash. Given: S0 = 80; r = 5% annual compounding; T = 1; no dividend, no storage. Asked: No-arbitrage forward price. Formula: F0(1) = 80 × 1.05 Variables: r is the opportunity cost of tying up cash in the asset. Why this formula: The long forward pays nothing today, so F0 must equal the future value of buying the asset now. Carry of 4 is the financing cost of owning the share for a year. Reasonableness check: A six-month forward would be 80 × 1.05^0.5 ≈81.98, not 80 × 1.025. 計算機操作｜BA II Plus 使用：TVM 已知：PV = -80; N = 1; I/Y = 5; PMT = 0 求：FV = F0 按鍵： ①2nd →CLR TVM ②1 →N ③5 →I/Y ④80 →+/- →PV ⑤0 →PMT ⑥CPT →FV 結果：FV = 84.00 中文理解：這就是現金的機會成本。PV 打負號代表今天把現貨買下來。N 可以是小數；不要 把半年當成N=1 再乘1.05。

why_wrong.B: Sets the forward equal to spot because value is zero at initiation — that is V0, not F0.
why_wrong.C: Discounts the spot: 80 / 1.05 = 76.19, the wrong direction of carry.

SIM-075.zh: 遠期價格是現貨用資金機會成本長出來的結果。成交時價值是零，價格不是零， 也不是現貨本身。
SIM-075.core_idea: With no extra carry, F0(T) = S0(1 + r)^T and V0 = 0
SIM-075.calculator:
計算機操作｜BA II Plus
使用：TVM
已知：PV = -80; N = 1; I/Y = 5; PMT = 0
求：FV = F0
按鍵：
①2nd →CLR TVM ②1 →N ③5 →I/Y ④80 →+/- →PV ⑤0 →PMT ⑥CPT →FV
結果：FV = 84.00
中文理解：這就是現金的機會成本。PV 打負號代表今天把現貨買下來。N 可以是小數；不要
把半年當成N=1 再乘1.05。
SIM-075.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-076.reasoning: Reasoning: The price of the swap is the fixed rate in the contract; it does not reset. Value is zero at initiation and then moves. When MRR exceeds the agreed fixed rate, pay-float / receive-fixed is an MTM loss. An increase in expected future short-term rates raises the value of the fixed-rate payer’s position, not the receiver’s.

why_wrong.A: Receiving the old fixed rate while paying a higher floating rate is a loss, not a gain.
why_wrong.B: The fixed rate (price) is constant; value is not. That is the price-versusvalue mix-up.

SIM-076.zh: 收的是舊的固定利率，付出的浮動卻變貴。選「價值不變」是把swap 的price 當 成value。
SIM-076.core_idea: The swap price (fixed rate) is constant; value is zero at initiation and then moves
SIM-076.exam_trap: Treating the swap’s fixed price as if value could not move
SIM-076.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-077.reasoning: Reasoning: R_GP = 100 × 0.02 + max[0, (100 - 80) × 0.20] = 2 + 4 = 6. LP return = (100 - 80 - 6) / 80 = 17.5%. A high-water mark would block a second incentive on the same recovery; here the start is the mark. Given: P0 = 80; P1 = 100; rm = 2% of ending; p = 20% of the gain, independent; no hurdle. Asked: LP periodic return. Formula: RGP = 100 × 0.02 + (100 −80) × 0.20, ri = (20 −6)/80 Variables: Independent-of-management-fee convention from the notes. Why this formula: The notes’ first GP-fee identity adds the management fee on ending AUM to the incentive on the raw gain. If the incentive were net of the management fee, the gain base would be 100(0.98) - 80 = 18, incentive 3.6, GP 5.6, r_i = 18.0%. Reasonableness check: Ending capital in the fund is 100 - 6 = 94. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
SIM-077.steps: ①Management fee = 2. ②Incentive = 4. ③GP total = 6; LP dollar = 14; r_i = 14/80 = 17.5%.

why_wrong.A: Subtracts only the management fee: (100 - 80 - 2) / 80 = 22.5%, or reports the 20% incentive rate as the LP return.
why_wrong.C: Ignores all fees: (100 - 80) / 80 = 25%.

SIM-077.zh: 獨立計算：管理費2 加激勵費4。LP 報酬是扣完GP 之後除以期初。不要把毛 25% 當成投資人拿到的。
SIM-077.core_idea: Incentive fees are paid only on gains above the high-water mark
SIM-077.study_section: Who Is Paid, and on What Base ｜費用與分成基礎
SIM-077.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-078.reasoning: Reasoning: If convenience yield is little or none, carry dominates and S < F: contango. Roll yield is positive in backwardation and negative in contango. The long-only investor rolls into a richer deferred contract. Contango reduces the return; backwardation enhances it.

why_wrong.B: Higher deferred prices look like a richer market; for someone already long who must roll, those are the contracts that must be bought.
why_wrong.C: Low convenience yield relative to carry is the usual contango case, and the roll is negative, not zero.

SIM-078.zh: 遠月比較貴不是多方的好處。Long-only 換月時買的是那個更貴的遠月，所以 contango 是負的roll yield。
SIM-078.core_idea: Roll yield is negative in contango and positive in backwardation for a long-only futures investor
SIM-078.study_section: Contango, Backwardation, and the Long-Only Roll ｜正價差、逆價差與多方展期
SIM-078.exam_trap: Treating contango as good for the long-only commodity investor
SIM-078.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-079.reasoning: Reasoning: Private equity management fees are typically 1% to 3% of committed capital — the amount the LP has agreed to provide — not of capital already invested. Charging PE fees on committed capital is why early years can show negative returns before much capital is even at work. That path is the J-curve.

why_wrong.A: Hedge-fund style management fees are a percentage of AUM on invested capital. PE is typically on committed capital.
why_wrong.B: The fee is not charged only on dry powder.

SIM-079.zh: PE 管理費通常按承諾資本收，不是已投入。早期錢還沒完全到位就要付費，IRR 容易先負，這就是J 曲線的起點。
SIM-079.core_idea: PE management fees are typically charged on committed capital, not capital already invested
SIM-079.study_section: Who Is Paid, and on What Base ｜費用與分成基礎
SIM-079.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-080.reasoning: Reasoning: Deal-by-deal (American): incentive can be collected on each exited deal, even before LPs have capital back or the preferred return. Whole-of-fund (European): the GP takes no profit until LPs have their capital back and the hurdle is met. PE incentive fees are typically not earned until investors’ initial capital has been returned — the European pattern. A clawback lets LPs reclaim GP fees if later deals reverse early gains.

why_wrong.B: That is the deal-by-deal (American) waterfall, advantageous to the GP.
why_wrong.C: Management fees on committed capital are a different clock from the incentive waterfall.

SIM-080.zh: European 瀑布是整檔先還LP 本金和門檻，GP 才能分潤。American 是單筆交易 賺錢就可以先抽。管理費按承諾資本收，是另一件事。
SIM-080.core_idea: American (deal-by-deal) waterfall can pay the GP before LPs have capital back; European waits
SIM-080.study_section: Who Is Paid, and on What Base ｜費用與分成基礎
SIM-080.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-081.reasoning: Reasoning: MOIC = (realized value + unrealized value) / total invested capital = (30 + 50) / 60 = 1.333. Invested capital in the notes is paid-in minus management fees and fund expenses. MOIC ignores time; IRR does not. Do not compare a young fund’s IRR with a mature fund’s without the J-curve in mind. Given: Realized 30; unrealized 50; invested capital 60. Asked: MOIC. Formula: MOIC = (30 + 50)/60 Variables: Invested capital is paid-in minus fees and expenses in the notes. Why this formula: The ratio is total distributions plus residual value, relative to what was invested. Each 1 invested is marked at 1.33 of value, with no timing credit. Reasonableness check: If all 80 were realized tomorrow or in ten years, MOIC is the same; IRR is not. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.B: Uses only unrealized value / invested capital = 50 / 60 = 0.83, omitting realized value 30. MOIC = (30 + 50) / 60 = 1.33. The stem does not supply 44 or 108.
why_wrong.C: Uses only realized / invested = 0.50.

SIM-081.zh: MOIC 是財富倍數：已實現+ 未實現，除以投入資本。不管時間。IRR 才把時間 算進去。不要只用已實現。
SIM-081.core_idea: MOIC is (realized + unrealized) / invested capital: a wealth multiple, not a rate of return
SIM-081.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-082.reasoning: Reasoning: r_L = r + (Vb/Vc)(r - r_b) = 0.09 + (70/30)(0.09 - 0.04) = 0.09 + 0.1167 = 20.67%. Asset gain = 9; interest = 2.8; net = 6.2 on 30 of equity →20.67%. If r < r_b, leverage magnifies the loss. Breakeven is r = r_b. Given: Vc = 30; Vb = 70; r = 9%; r_b = 4%. Asked: Levered return on cash equity. Formula: rL = 0.09 + 70 30(0.09 −0.04) Variables: r is the return on the whole position; r_b is paid only on borrowed dollars. Why this formula: The extra per dollar of cash is the spread, scaled by borrowed dollars per cash dollar. Leverage raised the cash return because the assets earned more than the borrowing rate. Reasonableness check: Cash: 9.0 - 2.8 = 6.2; 6.2 / 30 = 20.67%. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。

why_wrong.A: Reports the spread r - r_b without scaling by Vb/Vc, or the borrowing rate.
why_wrong.B: Reports the unlevered asset return.

SIM-082.zh: 借錢不改資產報酬，改的是你那筆現金的報酬。利差乘上「每一塊現金配了多少 借款」。資產賺9、利息2.8，淨6.2 除以30。
SIM-082.core_idea: Leverage changes the return on cash equity, not the return on the assets
SIM-082.study_section: Simple Leveraged Return ｜簡單槓桿報酬
SIM-082.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-083.reasoning: Reasoning: Level 3 inputs have little or no market activity. Mark-to-model values tend to overstate reported returns and understate the volatility of those returns. The path looks smoother than the economics. Conservative close-out prices for traded hedge-fund positions are the bid for longs and the ask for shorts.

why_wrong.A: A model haircut for illiquidity is a possible conservative input; the notes’ smoothing statement is overstated return and understated volatility.
why_wrong.C: Level 3 is not a quoted price in an active market.

SIM-083.zh: 模型估價常讓報酬看起來比較高、波動看起來比較小，路徑被平滑。那不是Level 1 的成交價。
SIM-083.core_idea: Mark-to-model values tend to overstate reported returns and understate volatility
SIM-083.study_section: Valuation, NAV, and Smoothed Numbers ｜估值、NAV 與平滑化數字
SIM-083.exam_trap: Reading a smoothed NAV path as low economic risk
SIM-083.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-084.reasoning: Reasoning: A CAL can be drawn for any risky portfolio plus the risk-free asset. The CML is only the CAL that uses the market portfolio M. Lending sits between Rf and M; borrowing sits to the right of M; the risky fund does not change. Two-fund separation: risk tolerance changes the mix along the same CAL, not the risky basket.

why_wrong.B: That is the definition of a CAL (true of every CAL, not only the CML).
why_wrong.C: That is the SML: expected return against beta, not against total σ.

SIM-084.zh: 看到「無風險+ 風險組合」就寫CML，那是CAL。CML 的風險籃子被釘死為市 場組合。SML 的橫軸是β。
SIM-084.core_idea: The CML is the CAL that uses the market portfolio; lending/borrowing still holds M
SIM-084.study_section: CAL, CML, and Two-Fund Separation ｜CAL、CML 與兩基金分離
SIM-084.exam_trap: Calling every T-bill + fund mix the CML
SIM-084.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-085.reasoning: Reasoning: A risk-free asset has β = 0. The converse is false. Beta only scales market co-movement. σ_i2 = β_i2 σ_m2 + σ_e2. Zero covariance with the market does not erase residual volatility. CAPM still assigns E(R) = Rf when β = 0; that is a required-return statement, not a volatility statement.

why_wrong.A: Risk-free ⇒β = 0; the converse is false.
why_wrong.C: Priced risk is systematic, but stand-alone σ can still be large if the residual is large.

SIM-085.zh: risk-free ⇒β=0，但β=0 ￿risk-free。Beta 只量市場共同波動，不量全部風險。
SIM-085.core_idea: β = 0 means no measured market covariance, not that the asset is risk-free
SIM-085.study_section: What Is Priced: CAPM, SML, and Performance ｜定價：CAPM、SML 與績效
SIM-085.formula:
σ2
i = β2
i σ2
m + σ2

SIM-085.exam_trap: Reading β=0 as this asset is risk-free
SIM-085.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-086.reasoning: Reasoning: Sharpe = (E(R) - Rf) / σ = 10% / 20% = 0.50. Treynor = 10% / 1.25 = 0.08. Sharpe and M2 are total-risk tools — appropriate if the portfolio is not fully diversified. Treynor and Jensen are beta tools for diversified books. Negative numerators flip Sharpe/Treynor rankings. Given: E(R) = 13%; Rf = 3%; σ = 20%; β = 1.25; concentrated book. Asked: Which ratio, and its value. Formula: Sp = (0.13 −0.03)/0.20 = 0.50 Variables: Sharpe: total risk. Treynor: beta. Why this formula: The denominator must match the risk that still matters for this book. If the same excess return sat in a well-diversified fund, Treynor/Jensen would be the comparison. Reasonableness check: M2 uses the same ranking as Sharpe, restated as a return. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
SIM-086.steps: ①Excess return = 10%. ②Sharpe = 10/20 = 0.50. ③Treynor = 10/1.25 = 0.08 (not the ranking tool here).

why_wrong.B: Treynor and Jensen are beta tools for diversified portfolios.
why_wrong.C: Jensen is a systematic-risk measure used for diversified portfolios.

SIM-086.zh: 組合還沒分散好，分母用總風險σ（Sharpe）。已經分散，分母改用β（Treynor / Jensen）。這本題是三檔股票，先用Sharpe。
SIM-086.core_idea: Sharpe uses total risk; Treynor uses beta — choose the denominator that matches diversification
SIM-086.study_section: Sharpe, Treynor, M2, and Safety-First ｜夏普、崔納、M 平方與安全第一
SIM-086.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-087.reasoning: Reasoning: Ability is financial: longer horizon, more wealth relative to liabilities, more insurance, a secure job. Willingness is attitude. If willingness is high and ability is low, ability prevails. Objectives must be jointly feasible; that does not mean splitting the difference.

why_wrong.B: The sources do not average the two into a midpoint risk score.
why_wrong.C: If ability is high and willingness is low, the advisor may educate; the constraint is not simply ignored. That is the other fork — not this stem.

SIM-087.zh: 意願高、能力低，跟能力走。能力高、意願低，可以教育，但不能假裝能力不存 在。不要把兩者平均。
SIM-087.core_idea: If willingness is high and ability is low, ability prevails
SIM-087.study_section: IPS Contents ｜投資政策聲明內容
SIM-087.exam_trap: Letting willingness override a low ability to bear risk
SIM-087.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-088.reasoning: Reasoning: Value at risk is the minimum loss, over a stated horizon, that occurs with a stated probability — a tail threshold. A 5% VaR of 2 means: with 5% probability the loss is at least 2. CVaR is the expected loss given that the loss has already exceeded that threshold. The notes also warn that CVaR can understate risk. VaR is sensitive to the inputs used to estimate it.

why_wrong.A: VaR is not a maximum-loss statement.
why_wrong.C: Expected loss given that the threshold has been exceeded is CVaR, not VaR.

SIM-088.zh: VaR 是「最差5% 裡至少會虧多少」這條門檻，不是平均虧多少，更不是理論上 的最大虧損。門檻之後的平均是CVaR。
SIM-088.core_idea: VaR is a tail threshold (minimum loss at a stated probability), not expected loss or worst possible loss
SIM-088.exam_trap: Reading VaR as the expected loss or the worst possible loss
SIM-088.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-089.reasoning: Reasoning: E(R) = 2% + 1.25 × (10% - 2%) = 2% + 10% = 12%. Distinguish E(Rm) from the premium 8%. Forecast 14% > 12%: above the SML, undervalued (buy). Below the line: overvalued (sell). On the line: fairly priced. Given: Rf = 2%; E(Rm) = 10%; β = 1.25; forecast = 14%. Asked: Mispricing versus the SML. Formula: E(R) = 0.02 + 1.25(0.10 −0.02) Variables: Market risk premium = E(Rm) - Rf = 8%, not 10%. Why this formula: CAPM prices only systematic risk. The forecast is compared with that required return. Jensen’s alpha using the forecast as Rp would be +2%. Reasonableness check: Using 10% as the premium would give a 14.5% hurdle and a false “overvalued” read. 本題直接手算較快，不需要使用BA II Plus。
SIM-089.steps: ①Premium = 8%. ②Required = 2% + 1.25 × 8% = 12%. ③14% - 12% = +2% alpha versus CAPM →undervalued.

why_wrong.B: A forecast above the SML is a cheap (buy) reading, not a rich price.
why_wrong.C: The SML gives the required return; a higher forecast is off the line, above it.

SIM-089.zh: CAPM 只問就它的β 該賺多少。預測比較高，在SML 上方，當成低估。不要把 E(Rm) 直接當風險溢酬去乘。
SIM-089.core_idea: Forecast above the SML: undervalued (buy); distinguish E(Rm) from the premium
SIM-089.study_section: CAPM and the SML ｜CAPM 與證券市場線
SIM-089.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。

SIM-090.reasoning: Reasoning: ESG methods differ by where the screen sits. Negative screening: exclude. Positive / best-in-class: overweight higher-ESG names inside a universe. ESG integration: fold ESG risks and opportunities into ordinary financial analysis and valuation — not first deleting an industry. Thematic: allocate to a sustainability theme. Engagement: voting and dialogue. Impact: measurable outcome and a financial return.

why_wrong.B: Exclusion removes industries or issuers that fail a stated rule; the universe here is not cut that way.
why_wrong.C: Impact investing seeks a measurable environmental or social outcome and a financial return; folding a risk into valuation is integration.

SIM-090.zh: ESG 整合是把風險與機會直接放進正常估值，不是先排除某產業。排除是 negative screening。影響力投資還要可量度的成果。
SIM-090.core_idea: ESG integration folds ESG into ordinary valuation; it is not the same as exclusion or best-in-class
SIM-090.study_section: ESG in Portfolio Construction ｜投資組合中的ESG
SIM-090.source_note: 解答依據 SIM_answers_VERIFIED_V3_1.pdf；觀念依據講義 Exam Simulation。
